```mjs
const tryIt = (f) => `node lab.mjs replay PROJECT checks/fixtures/12/records.json --name ${f.name}`;

function expectedRecord(entry) {
  const inputs = entry.decisions
    .filter((e) => e.decision?.status === 'admitted')
    .map((e, i) => ({ n: i + 1, tick: e.tick, seq: e.parsed.input.seq, angle: e.parsed.input.angle, power: e.parsed.input.power, fire: e.parsed.input.fire }));
  return { v: 1, game: 'lob', mode: 9, seed: entry.seed, inputs, end: entry.session.tick, final: entry.session.final() };
}

// Your admission, with each call's own failure reported with the moment it happened.
function guarded(adm, where, workDir) {
  return {
    parseInput: (text) => call(() => adm.parseInput(text), { checked: `your parseInput, while the server ran ${where()}`, input: `parseInput(${quoted(text)})`, expected: '{ ok: true, input } or { ok: false, reason } (12.parse-accepts and 12.parse-refuses check it)', workDir }),
    admit: (state, input, facts) => call(() => adm.admit(state, input, facts), { checked: `your admit, while the server ran ${where()}`, input: `admit(${show(state)}, ${show(input)}, ${show(facts)})`, expected: 'a decision (12.admit-order and 12.admit-rounds check it)', workDir }),
  };
}
function guardedRecorder(createRecorder, where, workDir) {
  return (options) => {
    const r = call(() => createRecorder(options), { checked: 'createRecorder, called by the server for a new session', input: `createRecorder(${show(options)}) for ${where()}`, expected: '{ admitted(tick, input), finish(end, final) }', workDir });
    if (!r || typeof r.admitted !== 'function' || typeof r.finish !== 'function') {
      fail({ checked: 'what createRecorder returns', input: `createRecorder(${show(options)}) for ${where()}`, observed: show(r), expected: 'an object with the functions admitted(tick, input) and finish(end, final)' });
    }
    return {
      admitted: (tick, input) => call(() => r.admitted(tick, input), { checked: 'your recorder\'s admitted(tick, input)', input: `admitted(${tick}, ${show(input)}) in ${where()}`, expected: 'it notes the input', workDir }),
      finish: (end, final) => call(() => r.finish(end, final), { checked: 'your recorder\'s finish(end, final)', input: `finish(${end}, ${show(final)}) in ${where()}`, expected: 'the record', workDir }),
    };
  };
}

// Your admission as replay is given it, with the facts.tick of every admit call noted in
// order. Your own functions do the deciding.
function tickWatch(adm) {
  const ticks = [];
  return {
    ticks,
    admission: {
      parseInput: (text) => adm.parseInput(text),
      admit: (state, input, facts) => {
        ticks.push(facts !== null && typeof facts === 'object' ? facts.tick : undefined);
        return adm.admit(state, input, facts);
      },
    },
  };
}
const TICK_RULE = 'An input\'s tick is the number of ticks the session had run when it was applied: inputs apply before the frames of their tick. Re-check and apply the inputs of tick t, then step() takes the session from t to t + 1 ticks, and give admit the facts { tick, round, flying } of that moment';

// Each admit call's facts.tick against the tick of the input it re-checks, in order. (A
// record without a list of inputs is for the replay's own answer, or 12.recorder, to judge.)
function checkTicks(ticks, record, input) {
  const inputs = Array.isArray(record?.inputs) ? record.inputs : [];
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ticks.length, inputs.length); i++) {
    const x = inputs[i];
    if (x === null || typeof x !== 'object' || ticks[i] === x.tick) continue;
    const d = typeof ticks[i] === 'number' ? ticks[i] - x.tick : null;
    fail({
      checked: 'replay re-checks each input at its own tick',
      input,
      observed: `input n ${x.n} (seq ${x.seq}${x.fire ? ', a fire' : ''}) is re-checked by admit call ${i + 1}, and your replay gave it facts.tick ${show(ticks[i])}`,
      expected: `facts.tick ${x.tick}, the input's tick in the record. ${TICK_RULE}`,
      diff: d === null ? 'facts.tick must be the number of ticks the session has run' : d > 0 ? `yours is ${plural(d, 'tick')} after the record's: the frames of tick ${x.tick} ran before this input was re-checked` : `yours is ${plural(-d, 'tick')} before the record's`,
    });
  }
}
// After the replay's answer: admit called once for every input.
function checkAdmitCount(ticks, record, input) {
  if (!Array.isArray(record?.inputs)) return;
  const n = record.inputs.length;
  if (ticks.length === n) return;
  fail({
    checked: 'replay re-checks each input with your admit',
    input,
    observed: ticks.length === 0 ? 'your replay never called admit' : `your replay called admit ${plural(ticks.length, 'time')} for ${plural(n, 'input')}`,
    expected: 'admit called once for each input, in order: replay re-checks every input with your parseInput and your admit at its moment of the replay, as the server did when it admitted it',
  });
}
// What to look at when a genuine record does not replay to its final. `early` is a record
// finished while its session was still playing.
function genuineHint(out, early) {
  const reason = out?.ok === true ? 'final' : out?.ok === false ? out.reason : null;
  if (reason === 'order') return '. A genuine record is in order: n runs 1, 2, 3, ..., ticks never go down and stay below end, seq goes up (gaps are fine)';
  if (reason === 'refused') return '. Every input was admitted when it was recorded: apply each before the frames of its tick, read facts from the session at that moment, and carry admit\'s next to the next input';
  if (reason === 'shape') return '. A genuine record has v 1, game \'lob\', mode 9, and every field with the right type, at the top level, in each input and in final';
  if (reason !== 'final') return '';
  if (early) return '. This record was finished while the session was still playing, and two mistakes give another final here: applying an input after the frames of its tick instead of before them (apply the inputs of tick t, then step() takes the session from t to t + 1 ticks), and running past end (run exactly end ticks, not until the session is over)';
  return '. Run exactly end ticks from createLobSession({ seed, mode }), applying the inputs of tick t before step() takes the session from t to t + 1 ticks';
}

// Copies of a record your recorder made, each changed in one way whose reason API.md's
// rules fix, whatever the session: { name, reason, what, why, record }.
function ownTampers(record) {
  const out = [];
  const mid = Math.floor(record.inputs.length / 2);
  const tamper = (name, reason, change) => {
    const copy = structuredClone(record);
    const { what, why } = change(copy);
    out.push({ name, reason, what, why, record: copy });
  };
  tamper('edited-power', 'final', (r) => {
    const x = r.inputs.at(-1);
    const was = x.power;
    x.power = was <= 90 ? was + 10 : was - 10;
    return {
      what: `the last input, n ${x.n} at tick ${x.tick}, changed from power ${was} to power ${x.power}; final left as recorded`,
      why: `power ${x.power} is legal and nothing else about the input changed, so admit admits it at its moment and the replay plays to end; nothing after the last input changes the power, so the replayed final has power ${x.power}, and the record's says ${show(record.final?.power)}`,
    };
  });
  tamper('power-150', 'refused', (r) => {
    const x = r.inputs[mid];
    const was = x.power;
    x.power = 150;
    return {
      what: `input n ${x.n}, at tick ${x.tick}, changed from power ${was} to power 150`,
      why: 'the shape and order are as before (150 is a whole number), and your parseInput refuses power 150 when the replay re-checks that input',
    };
  });
  tamper('swapped-inputs', 'order', (r) => {
    let k = r.inputs.findIndex((x, i) => i >= mid && i + 1 < r.inputs.length && r.inputs[i + 1].tick !== x.tick);
    if (k < 0) k = r.inputs.findIndex((x, i) => i + 1 < r.inputs.length && r.inputs[i + 1].tick !== x.tick);
    const [a, b] = [r.inputs[k], r.inputs[k + 1]];
    const was = `n ${a.n} (tick ${a.tick}, seq ${a.seq}) and n ${b.n} (tick ${b.tick}, seq ${b.seq})`;
    [r.inputs[k], r.inputs[k + 1]] = [b, a];
    r.inputs.forEach((x, i) => { x.n = i + 1; });
    return {
      what: `inputs ${was} swapped, then n numbered 1, 2, 3, ... again`,
      why: `the tick goes down from ${b.tick} to ${a.tick}, and seq from ${b.seq} to ${a.seq}`,
    };
  });
  tamper('extra-key', 'shape', (r) => {
    r.note = 'trust me';
    return { what: 'an extra top-level field: "note": "trust me"', why: 'a record has exactly the fields v, game, mode, seed, inputs, end and final' };
  });
  tamper('input-extra-key', 'shape', (r) => {
    const x = r.inputs[mid];
    x.hit = true;
    return { what: `an extra field in input n ${x.n}: "hit": true`, why: 'an input has exactly the fields n, tick, seq, angle, power and fire' };
  });
  return out;
}
// Whether ownTampers can alter this record: a list of at least two inputs, each an object,
// with two neighbouring inputs at different ticks.
const alterable = (r) => Array.isArray(r?.inputs) && r.inputs.length >= 2 && r.inputs.every((x) => x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x))
  && r.inputs.some((x, i) => i + 1 < r.inputs.length && r.inputs[i + 1].tick !== x.tick);
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/13.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 13: hide what the client doesn't draw.
//
// 13.view-fields          your drawnView at every tick of two scripted sessions (the check
//                          presses the keys), field by field against the game's getters
// 13.view-noninterference changing one hidden thing on a copy of the game leaves your
//                          message byte for byte the same, at moments of legal players'
//                          sessions, every hidden name, three changes each
// 13.view-encodings       legal players and the searching client play live against your
//                          view; every message is searched for the hidden values present
//                          when it was built (checks/encodings.mjs)
// 13.leaks-finds          your findLeaks on the planted views in checks/fixtures/13/views.mjs,
//                          each handed over as a new function that calls the planted one
//
// Each check looks at more of the game than the one before it: the scripted sessions have
// one hit, the players' sessions a few, and the searching client hits most of its shots.
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { fail, show, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';
import { createLobSession } from '../public/session.mjs';
import { fullView } from '../public/full-view.mjs';
import { KEYS } from '../public/rules.mjs';
import {
  firstInterference, describeDifference, huntSession, playOne, describeSession, CHECK_SESSIONS,
} from './encodings.mjs';
import { PLANTED } from './fixtures/13/views.mjs';

export const title = "Hide what the client doesn't draw";

const VIEW = 'server/view.mjs';
const LEAKS = 'server/leaks.mjs';
const notWritten = (error) => String(error?.message ?? error).includes(NOT_WRITTEN);

// "server/view.mjs line 12" for the first stack line inside your project folder.
function whereIn(error, workDir) {
  const roots = new Set([workDir, pathToFileURL(workDir).href]);
  try { const real = realpathSync(workDir); roots.add(real); roots.add(pathToFileURL(real).href); } catch { /* keep the given path */ }
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    for (const root of roots) {
      const i = line.indexOf(root);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const m = line.slice(i + root.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${decodeURIComponent(m[1])} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
const threw = (error, workDir) => {
  const where = whereIn(error, workDir);
  return `it threw ${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}${where ? ` (${where})` : ''}`;
};

// Your drawnView, wrapped: "not written yet" passes through; a throw, or a result that is
// not a plain object, becomes a failure naming the moment. `moment()` describes where.
function guardedView(env, drawnView, moment) {
  return (game, info) => {
    let out;
    try {
      out = drawnView(game, info);
    } catch (error) {
      if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
      fail({ checked: 'your drawnView runs', input: moment(info), observed: threw(error, env.workDir), expected: 'a plain object holding the drawn fields' });
    }
    if (!out || typeof out !== 'object' || Array.isArray(out)) {
      fail({ checked: 'your drawnView returns a plain object', input: moment(info), observed: `it returned ${show(out, 80)}`, expected: 'a plain object holding the drawn fields (the server sends JSON.stringify of it)' });
    }
    return out;
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- scripted sessions

// Where a shot lands if it is fired now: on a copy of the game, turn to angle and power
// the way the server does (one key press per step), fire, and run frames until it lands.
// 1 hit, 2 short, 3 long.
function outcome(game, angle, power) {
  const copy = game.clone();
  for (let a = Math.round(copy.angle()); a < angle; a++) copy.key(KEYS.RIGHT);
  for (let a = Math.round(copy.angle()); a > angle; a--) copy.key(KEYS.LEFT);
  for (let p = copy.power(); p < power; p++) copy.key(KEYS.UP);
  for (let p = copy.power(); p > power; p--) copy.key(KEYS.DOWN);
  copy.key(KEYS.SPACE);
  for (let f = 0; f < 5000 && copy.flying(); f++) copy.tick(1);
  return copy.exports.r_result();
}

const RESULT = { short: 2, long: 3, hit: 1 };
const between = (lo, hi) => Array.from({ length: hi - lo + 1 }, (_, i) => lo + i);

// The angle and power of a shot that ends as `want` ('short', 'long' or 'hit'), tried on
// copies of the game, nearest the planned power first. Null when none does.
function aim(game, angle, power, want) {
  const order = want === 'long' ? [...between(power, 100), ...between(10, power - 1).reverse()]
    : want === 'short' ? [...between(10, power).reverse(), ...between(power + 1, 100)]
      : between(10, 100);
  const angles = want === 'hit' ? [angle, ...[5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30].flatMap((d) => [angle - d, angle + d]).filter((a) => a >= 5 && a <= 85)] : [angle];
  for (const a of angles) for (const p of order) if (outcome(game, a, p) === RESULT[want]) return { angle: a, power: p };
  return null;
}

// Play one session from a plan instead of a client. Each round: wait a few ticks, turn the
// angle and power (one input), wait, then fire the planned shot ('short', 'long', 'hit'),
// or not at all ('none': the round ends unshot after 200 ticks). visit(game, info, round)
// runs at tick 0 and after every tick, the way the server builds a message.
export function playScripted(seed, shots, visit) {
  const s = createLobSession({ seed });
  let seq = 0;
  const send = (angle, power, fire) => { seq += 1; s.apply({ v: 1, seq, angle, power, fire }); };
  const step = () => { s.step(); visit(s.game, { tick: s.tick, ack: seq }, s.round); };
  visit(s.game, { tick: s.tick, ack: seq }, s.round);
  while (!s.over()) {
    const round = s.round;
    const plan = shots[(round - 1) % shots.length];
    const angle = 20 + ((round * 7) % 50), power = 25 + ((round * 13) % 70);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4 + (round % 3); i++) step();
    send(angle, power, false);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) step();
    if (plan !== 'none') {
      const shot = aim(s.game, angle, power, plan) ?? { angle, power };
      send(shot.angle, shot.power, true);
    }
    while (!s.over() && s.round === round) step();
  }
}

const phase = (game) => (game.flying() ? 'the shell in flight' : game.impact() ? 'after the landing' : 'before a shot');
const after = (tick) => (tick === 0 ? 'before the first tick' : `after tick ${tick}`);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 13.view-fields

// One hit in all, so the score is 0 and then 1; round 3 of the first session and round 6
// of the second end unshot. The seeds give every wind level, -3 to 3, between them.
const FIELD_SESSIONS = [
  { seed: 13_100_011, shots: ['short', 'long', 'none', 'short', 'hit', 'long', 'short', 'long', 'short', 'long', 'short', 'long'] },
  { seed: 13_100_014, shots: ['long', 'short', 'long', 'short', 'long', 'none', 'short', 'long', 'short', 'long', 'short', 'long'] },
];
const ORDER = ['v', 'tick', 'ack', 'round', 'score', 'shots', 'angle', 'power', 'wind', 'flag', 'shell', 'trail', 'impact', 'message', 'cloud'];
const ARROWS = ['<<<', '<<', '<', '~', '>', '>>', '>>>'];

function checkFields(view, game, info, input) {
  const out = view(game.clone(), info);
  let text;
  try { text = JSON.stringify(out); } catch (error) {
    fail({ checked: 'your message is JSON', input, observed: `JSON.stringify of your view threw ${error.name}: ${error.message}`, expected: 'a plain object of numbers, strings, arrays and null' });
  }
  const sent = JSON.parse(text);
  const keys = Object.keys(sent);
  if (keys.join() !== ORDER.join()) {
    const missing = ORDER.filter((k) => !keys.includes(k)), extra = keys.filter((k) => !ORDER.includes(k));
    fail({
      checked: 'your message has exactly the drawn fields, in API.md\'s order',
      input,
      observed: `your fields: ${keys.join(', ')}`,
      expected: ORDER.join(', '),
      diff: missing.length ? `missing: ${missing.join(', ')}${extra.length ? `; not drawn: ${extra.join(', ')}` : ''}`
        : extra.length ? `fields the screen does not draw: ${extra.join(', ')}`
          : 'the same fields in another order; key order is part of the bytes the server sends',
    });
  }
  const field = (name, expected, rule) => {
    if (JSON.stringify(sent[name]) === JSON.stringify(expected)) return;
    const sameValues = JSON.stringify(sortKeys(sent[name])) === JSON.stringify(sortKeys(expected));
    fail({
      checked: `the field ${name}: ${rule}`,
      input,
      observed: `${name}: ${show(sent[name])}`,
      expected: `${name}: ${show(expected)}`,
      diff: sameValues ? 'the same values with the keys in another order; key order is part of the bytes'
        : Array.isArray(expected) ? firstDiff(sent[name], expected) : undefined,
    });
  };
  // Each expected value straight from the game's getters, at the precision the screen draws.
  field('v', 1, 'always 1');
  field('tick', info.tick, 'info.tick');
  field('ack', info.ack, 'info.ack');
  field('round', game.round(), 'game.round()');
  field('score', game.score(), 'game.score()');
  field('shots', game.shots(), 'game.shots()');
  field('angle', Math.round(game.angle()), 'game.angle() rounded with Math.round');
  field('power', game.power(), 'game.power()');
  field('wind', ARROWS[game.windLevel() + 3], `the arrows for wind level ${game.windLevel()}: '~' for 0, '>' n times for +n, '<' n times for -n`);
  field('flag', Math.round(game.targetX()), `game.targetX() (${game.targetX()}) rounded with Math.round`);
  const shell = game.shell();
  field('shell', shell ? [Math.round(shell.x), Math.round(shell.y)] : null, shell ? `[x, y] of game.shell() (${shell.x}, ${shell.y}), each rounded` : 'null: no shell in the air');
  field('trail', game.trail().map(([x, y]) => [Math.round(x), Math.round(y)]), `game.trail(), ${game.trail().length} points oldest first, each [x, y] rounded`);
  const impact = game.impact();
  field('impact', impact ? { x: Math.round(impact.x), age: impact.age } : null, impact ? `{ x, age } of game.impact() (x ${impact.x}), x rounded` : 'null: no landing this round (game.impact() is null)');
  field('message', game.message(), 'game.message(), exactly');
  field('cloud', Math.round(game.cloud()), `game.cloud() (${game.cloud()}) rounded with Math.round`);
}

function sortKeys(x) {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(sortKeys);
  if (x && typeof x === 'object') return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(x).sort().map((k) => [k, sortKeys(x[k])]));
  return x;
}
function firstDiff(a, b, path = '') {
  if (Array.isArray(b)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(a)) return `${path || 'the value'} should be a list`;
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
      if (JSON.stringify(a[i]) !== JSON.stringify(b[i])) return firstDiff(a[i], b[i], `${path}[${i}]`);
    }
    return a.length === b.length ? null : `yours has ${a.length} entries, the required value ${b.length}`;
  }
  return `at ${path || 'the value'}: yours ${show(a, 60)}, required ${show(b, 60)}`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 13.view-noninterference

// Legal players' sessions; the server sends them the full view, which their official
// client draws in its drawn mode, so the sessions are the same whatever your view does.
// Your view is tested on copies of the game at every SAMPLE-th tick.
const QUIET_SESSIONS = [
  { kind: 'expert', seed: 13_200_002 },
  { kind: 'expert', seed: 13_200_005 },
  { kind: 'reconnects', seed: 13_200_201 },
];
const SAMPLE = 5;

const fmt = (x) => (typeof x === 'number' ? String(x) : show(x, 60));
function describeChange(name, k, game) {
  const copy = game.clone();
  copy.setHidden(name, k);
  const call = `setHidden('${name}', ${k})`;
  switch (name) {
    case 'wind': return `${call}: the exact wind moved inside its arrows' band, ${fmt(game.serverWind())} to ${fmt(copy.serverWind())}`;
    case 'flagSpeed': return `${call}: the flag's speed, ${fmt(game.flagSpeed())} to ${fmt(copy.flagSpeed())} paces a second`;
    case 'flagTimer': return `${call}: the frames until the flag picks a new speed, ${game.flagTimer()} to ${copy.flagTimer()}`;
    case 'rng': return `${call}: the random state, ${game.rng()} to ${copy.rng()}`;
    case 'flagFraction': return `${call}: the flag moved inside its pace, x ${fmt(game.targetX())} to ${fmt(copy.targetX())}`;
    case 'shellFraction': return `${call}: the shell moved inside its pace, ${fmt([game.shell().x, game.shell().y])} to ${fmt([copy.shell().x, copy.shell().y])}`;
    case 'trailFraction': return `${call}: every trail point moved inside its pace`;
    case 'impactFraction': return `${call}: the impact mark moved inside its pace, x ${fmt(game.impact().x)} to ${fmt(copy.impact().x)}`;
    case 'cloudFraction': return `${call}: the cloud moved inside its pace, x ${fmt(game.cloud())} to ${fmt(copy.cloud())}`;
    case 'shellVelocity': { const a = game.velocity(), b = copy.velocity(); return `${call}: the shell's velocity, (${a.vx}, ${a.vy}) to (${b.vx}, ${b.vy})`; }
    default: return call;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 13.leaks-finds

// The moments the planted views are tried at, from one scripted session:
//   flight  the shell in the air with a trail; the flag moving left, 106 to 135 frames from
//           picking a new speed; the exact wind below the middle of its arrows' band. At
//           this moment a planted view that shows the flag's direction, whether the timer is
//           under half a second, or which side of the middle the wind is on leaks for some
//           of the three changes and not for others, so a finder must try all three.
//   landed  after a landing: the impact mark and the trail, no shell
//   empty   before the first shot: no shell, no impact mark, no trail
//   timer   the flag 203 to 231 frames from picking a new speed: of setHidden's three changes
//           of the timer (public/lob.mjs), only one brings it under 30 frames, so a planted
//           view that shows whether the timer is under 30 leaks for that change alone
const MOMENT_SEED = 13_400_002;
const MOMENT_SHOTS = ['long', 'short', 'long', 'short'];
function windBelowMiddle(game) {
  const level = game.windLevel();
  const middle = level >= 3 ? 4.375 : level <= -3 ? -4.375 : 1.5 * level;
  return game.serverWind() < middle;
}
const MOMENTS = {
  flight: (g) => g.flying() && g.trail().length >= 3 && g.flagSpeed() < 0 && g.flagTimer() >= 106 && g.flagTimer() <= 135 && windBelowMiddle(g),
  landed: (g) => !g.flying() && g.impact() !== null && g.trail().length > 0,
  empty: (g) => !g.flying() && g.impact() === null && g.trail().length === 0 && g.round() >= 1,
  timer: (g) => g.flagTimer() >= 203 && g.flagTimer() <= 231,
};
function findMoments() {
  const found = {};
  playScripted(MOMENT_SEED, MOMENT_SHOTS, (game, info) => {
    for (const [name, test] of Object.entries(MOMENTS)) {
      if (!found[name] && info.tick > 0 && test(game)) found[name] = { name, game: game.clone(), info: { ...info } };
    }
  });
  for (const name of Object.keys(MOMENTS)) if (!found[name]) throw new Error(`checks/13.mjs: the scripted session on game seed ${MOMENT_SEED} has no "${name}" moment (a course problem, not yours)`);
  return found;
}
const describeMoment = (m) => `the scripted session on game seed ${MOMENT_SEED}, after tick ${m.info.tick} (info ${show(m.info)}): ${{
  flight: `the shell in flight with ${m.game.trail().length} trail points; flag speed ${m.game.flagSpeed()}, flag timer ${m.game.flagTimer()}, exact wind ${m.game.serverWind()} (arrows ${m.game.windLevel()})`,
  landed: `after a landing: impact x ${m.game.impact()?.x}, ${m.game.trail().length} trail points, no shell`,
  empty: 'before the first shot: no shell, no impact mark, no trail',
  timer: `the flag ${m.game.flagTimer()} frames from picking a new speed (flag speed ${m.game.flagSpeed()}), ${m.game.flying() ? 'the shell in flight' : 'no shell in the air'}`,
}[m.name]}`;

// Which planted view at which moment. A view whose hidden thing is absent at a moment
// leaks nothing there.
const LEAK_PLAN = [
  ['windTwoDecimals', 'flight'], ['windFloatBase64', 'flight'], ['flagUnrounded', 'flight'],
  ['trailUnrounded', 'flight'], ['flagDirection', 'flight'], ['flagTurnsSoon', 'flight'], ['flagTimerUnder30', 'timer'],
  ['rngBase36', 'landed'], ['shellVelocity', 'flight'], ['shellUnrounded', 'flight'],
  ['impactUnrounded', 'landed'], ['windKeyOrder', 'flight'], ['cloudAndWind', 'landed'],
  ['correct', 'flight'], ['correct', 'landed'], ['correct', 'empty'],
  ['trailUnrounded', 'empty'], ['shellVelocity', 'landed'], ['impactUnrounded', 'empty'], ['windTwoDecimals', 'empty'],
];

const present = (game, name) => [1, 2, 3].some((k) => game.clone().setHidden(name, k));

function snapshot(game) {
  return { memory: game.memory().slice(), wind: game.serverWind(), fields: game.fields() };
}
function changedSince(before, game) {
  if (game.serverWind() !== before.wind) return `the exact wind (serverWind()) changed from ${before.wind} to ${game.serverWind()}`;
  const fields = game.fields();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(before.fields)) if (!Object.is(fields[k], v)) return `the game's ${k} changed from ${v} to ${fields[k]}`;
  const now = game.memory();
  for (let i = 0; i < before.memory.length; i++) if (now[i] !== before.memory[i]) return `the game's memory changed at byte ${i}`;
  return null;
}
```

```mjs
// Unit 14: meet the limit, then detect. API.md, "Unit 14", is the contract these checks test.
// Your features are compared with the check's own computation of API.md's definitions on
// fixed sessions; chooseThreshold, count and precisionAt on crafted inputs; and your frozen
// detector on the dev split, on held-out-sized sessions of the check's own and on the two
// recordings. The check's held-out sessions come from seeds no lab command uses, so
// `node lab.mjs check` never reads the split that `node lab.mjs heldout` measures.
// Every session is generated inside the check from its seed (public/corpus.mjs), so a
// failure can be reproduced with the call it names.
// Your features are always called with a session's play alone, { record: { inputs }, rounds }:
// never its id, label, kind or seed. The counts the checks judge are made from those calls;
// your evaluate, which needs the labels to count, must make the same decisions.
import { makeCorpus, playCorpusSession, KINDS, DEFAULT_COUNTS } from '../public/corpus.mjs';
import { median, quantile, mean, sd, correlation, makeRandom } from '../public/stats.mjs';
import { fail, show, readJson, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';

export const title = 'Meet the limit, then detect';

const BUDGET = 0.002;           // one false flag in 500 legal sessions (API.md, detect/settings.json)
// At most this many of the check's 2,000 held-out legal sessions flagged. A threshold set as
// API.md says (the second-highest of 1,000 dev legal scores) leaves each fresh legal session
// a Beta(2, 999) chance of reaching it, so its false flags here are BetaBinomial(2000, 2, 999):
// 4 on average, more than 15 about once in 100 (more than 6, the old cap, about one time in 5).
const HELDOUT_FALSE_FLAGS = 15;
const HELDOUT_RECALL = 0.9;     // at least this share of its 200 held-out searcher sessions flagged
const HELDOUT_SEEDS = 24_000_000; // the check's held-out sessions: seed 24,000,000 + 100,000 × the kind's place + n
const DELAY_RECALL = 0.2;       // at least this share of the 60 sessions in recordings/delay.json flagged
const FEATURES = ['shots', 'hitRate', 'missMedian', 'fireMedian', 'fireSpread', 'inputsMedian', 'cadenceCV', 'missLag1'];
const COUNT_FIELDS = ['total', 'tp', 'fp', 'tn', 'fn', 'recall', 'falsePositiveRate', 'precision'];
const RATES = new Set(['recall', 'falsePositiveRate', 'precision']);

// Equal within a tolerance (absolute below 1, relative above), or both null.
const close = (a, b, tol) => typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number' && (a === b || Math.abs(a - b) <= tol * Math.max(1, Math.abs(b)));
const sameValue = (a, b, tol) => (b === null ? a === null : close(a, b, tol));
const plural = (n, one, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
const ratio = (k, n) => (n ? k / n : null);
const grouped = (n) => Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US');

// What your features are given: a fresh copy of the session's play, its record.inputs and
// rounds, and nothing else (API.md, features). Every call to your features goes through this.
const playOf = (c) => ({ record: { inputs: structuredClone(c.record.inputs) }, rounds: structuredClone(c.rounds) });
const PLAY = '{ record: { inputs }, rounds }';

// Calls your function. An error it throws is passed on with what it was given, so the failure
// says which input broke it (and the line in your file, as for any error). A starter's
// "not written yet" passes through unchanged.
function call(what, f) {
  try {
    return f();
  } catch (error) {
    if (String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
    if (error instanceof Error) { error.message = `${what}: ${error.message}`; throw error; }
    throw new Error(`${what}: it threw ${show(error, 80)}`);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the features, by API.md

// The latest round whose start is at or before the tick.
function roundAt(rounds, tick) {
  let found = null;
  for (const r of rounds) if (r.start <= tick && (found === null || r.start >= found.start)) found = r;
  return found ? found.round : null;
}

// API.md's eight features of one case, and a note on how each was reached (for messages).
function expectedFeatures({ record, rounds }) {
  const shotRounds = rounds.filter((r) => r.shot !== null);
  const shots = shotRounds.length;
  const hits = shotRounds.filter((r) => r.result === 'hit').length;
  const fireTimes = shotRounds.map((r) => r.shot.tick - r.start);
  const misses = shotRounds.map((r) => Math.abs(r.miss));
  const inputs = shotRounds.map((r) => r.inputs);

  const gaps = [];
  let previous = null;
  for (const input of record.inputs) {
    const round = roundAt(rounds, input.tick);
    if (previous && previous.round === round) gaps.push(input.tick - previous.tick);
    previous = { round, tick: input.tick };
  }
  const gapMean = mean(gaps);
  const cadenceCV = gaps.length < 5 || gapMean === 0 ? null : sd(gaps) / gapMean;

  const byNumber = new Map(rounds.map((r) => [r.round, r]));
  const xs = [], ys = [];
  for (const a of rounds) {
    const b = byNumber.get(a.round + 1);
    if (a.shot && b && b.shot) { xs.push(a.miss); ys.push(b.miss); }
  }
  const missLag1 = xs.length < 4 ? null : correlation(xs, ys);
  const q75 = quantile(fireTimes, 0.75), q25 = quantile(fireTimes, 0.25);

  return {
    values: {
      shots,
      hitRate: shots ? hits / shots : null,
      missMedian: median(misses),
      fireMedian: median(fireTimes),
      fireSpread: shots ? q75 - q25 : null,
      inputsMedian: median(inputs),
      cadenceCV,
      missLag1,
    },
    notes: {
      shots: `${shots} of the ${rounds.length} rounds have a shot`,
      hitRate: `${plural(hits, 'hit')} in ${plural(shots, 'shot round')}`,
      missMedian: shots ? `abs(miss) over the shot rounds: ${show(misses, 120)}` : 'no shot rounds',
      fireMedian: shots ? `fire times, shot.tick - start: ${show(fireTimes, 120)}` : 'no shot rounds',
      fireSpread: shots ? `upper quartile ${q75} - lower quartile ${q25} of the fire times ${show(fireTimes, 100)}` : 'no shot rounds',
      inputsMedian: shots ? `inputs of the shot rounds: ${show(inputs, 120)}` : 'no shot rounds',
      cadenceCV: gaps.length < 5 ? `${plural(gaps.length, 'same-round gap')}, fewer than 5` : gapMean === 0 ? `${gaps.length} same-round gaps, all 0 ticks: a mean of 0` : `${gaps.length} same-round gaps with mean ${gapMean}`,
      missLag1: xs.length < 4 ? `${plural(xs.length, 'pair')} of consecutive shot rounds, fewer than 4` : `${xs.length} pairs of consecutive shot rounds`,
    },
  };
}

const HINT = {

  missMedian: 'the median of abs(miss) over shot rounds; null with no shots',
  fireMedian: 'the median of shot.tick - start over shot rounds, in ticks from the start of the round',
  fireSpread: 'the upper quartile minus the lower quartile of the fire times, with quantile from public/stats.mjs (it interpolates); null with no shots',

  missLag1: 'correlation (public/stats.mjs) of the miss in round r with the miss in round r + 1, over consecutive rounds that both had a shot; null with fewer than 4 such pairs',
};

function featureCases() {
  const played = new Map();
  const play = (kind, seed) => {
    const key = `${kind} ${seed}`;
    if (!played.has(key)) played.set(key, playCorpusSession(kind, seed));
    return played.get(key);
  };
  const out = [];
  for (const [kind, seeds] of Object.entries(SEEDS)) {
    for (const seed of seeds) {
      const { record, rounds } = play(kind, seed);
      out.push({ id: `check-${kind}-${seed}`, input: `c = playCorpusSession('${kind}', ${seed}) from public/corpus.mjs`, c: { record, rounds } });
    }
  }
  for (const x of CHANGED) {
    const { record, rounds } = x.make(structuredClone(play(x.kind, x.seed)));
    const id = `check-${x.kind}-${x.seed}-${x.tag}`;
    out.push({ id, input: `c = playCorpusSession('${x.kind}', ${x.seed}) from public/corpus.mjs, ${x.how}`, c: { record, rounds } });
  }
  return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ chooseThreshold, by API.md

// The smallest t among the scores such that count(score >= t) / n <= budget.
function expectedThreshold(scores, budget) {
  const n = scores.length;
  for (const t of [...new Set(scores)].sort((a, b) => a - b)) if (scores.filter((s) => s >= t).length / n <= budget) return t;
  return Infinity;
}

function explainThreshold(scores, budget, t) {
  const n = scores.length, allowed = budget * n;
  const atOrAbove = (x) => scores.filter((s) => s >= x).length;
  const top = Math.max(...scores);
  if (t === Infinity) return `no score qualifies: even the highest, ${top}, has ${atOrAbove(top)} scores at or above it, more than ${budget} × ${n} = ${allowed}`;
  const below = scores.filter((s) => s < t);
  const next = below.length ? Math.max(...below) : null;
  return `${atOrAbove(t)} of the ${n} scores are at or above ${t}, within ${budget} × ${n} = ${allowed}${next === null ? '' : `; the next lower score, ${next}, would make ${atOrAbove(next)}`}`;
}

function realisticScores() {
  // 997 scores from a seeded normal (the highest 5.986), then 9.5 and two of 9.25, shuffled.
  const random = makeRandom(1414);
  const scores = Array.from({ length: 997 }, () => Math.round(random.normal() * 2000) / 1000);
  scores.push(9.5, 9.25, 9.25);
  for (let i = scores.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(random.next() * (i + 1)); [scores[i], scores[j]] = [scores[j], scores[i]]; }
  return scores;
}

const THRESHOLDS = [
  { scores: [5, 1, 9, 3, 7, 2, 8, 4, 6, 10], budget: 0.2, about: 'unsorted scores' },
  { scores: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6], budget: 0.25, about: 'a tie at the cut: three scores of 5' },
  { scores: [3, 1, 3, 2, 3], budget: 0.4, about: 'a tie at the top, so no score qualifies' },
  { scores: [0.5, 0.25, 0.75], budget: 0, about: 'budget 0, so no score qualifies' },
  { scores: [4, -2, 7, 0], budget: 1, about: 'budget 1, so every score qualifies' },
  { scores: [2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5], budget: 0.5, about: 'all scores equal' },
  { scores: [2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5], budget: 1, about: 'all scores equal, budget 1' },
  { scores: [100, 20, 90, 40, 10, 60, 80, 30, 70, 50], budget: 0.15, about: '0.15 × 10 = 1.5, so at most 1 score' },
  { scores: [0.1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.3], budget: 0.5, about: '0.5 × 4 = 2, so exactly 2 scores may be at or above' },
  { scores: [7], budget: BUDGET, about: 'one score and a budget of 1 in 500' },
  { scores: realisticScores(), budget: BUDGET, about: '1,000 scores with a budget of 1 in 500: the highest are 9.5, 9.25 and 9.25, and the next is 5.986', long: true },
];

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ count and precisionAt, by API.md

function expectedCount(decisions) {
  let tp = 0, fp = 0, tn = 0, fn = 0;
  for (const d of decisions) {
    if (d.label === 'cheat') { if (d.flagged) tp++; else fn++; } else if (d.flagged) fp++; else tn++;
  }
  return { total: decisions.length, tp, fp, tn, fn, recall: ratio(tp, tp + fn), falsePositiveRate: ratio(fp, fp + tn), precision: ratio(tp, tp + fp) };
}

// The first field where your count differs from the required one, or null.
function countDifference(got, want) {
  if (!got || typeof got !== 'object') return `count returned ${show(got, 80)}, not an object`;
  for (const k of COUNT_FIELDS) {
    const ok = RATES.has(k) ? sameValue(got[k], want[k], 1e-12) : got[k] === want[k];
    if (!ok) return `${k}: yours is ${show(got[k], 60)}, required ${show(want[k], 60)}`;
  }
  return null;
}

const decisionList = (pattern) => [...pattern].map((ch) => ({ label: 'CN'.includes(ch) ? 'cheat' : 'legal', flagged: 'CL'.includes(ch) }));
// C a flagged cheat, N a cheat not flagged, L a flagged legal session, O a legal session not flagged.
const describe = (pattern) => [...pattern].map((ch) => ({ C: 'flagged cheat', N: 'cheat not flagged', L: 'flagged legal', O: 'legal not flagged' })[ch]).join(', ');

function bigDecisions() {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2200; i++) {
    const cheat = i % 11 === 0; // 200 cheats among 2,200 sessions
    out.push({ label: cheat ? 'cheat' : 'legal', flagged: cheat ? i < 2090 : i % 700 === 1 });
  }
  return out;
}

const COUNTS = [
  { decisions: decisionList('COCLONOCLO'), input: `count of 10 decisions: ${describe('COCLONOCLO')}` },
  { decisions: decisionList('OOOOO'), input: 'count of 5 legal sessions, none flagged: no cheats and nothing flagged' },
  { decisions: decisionList('CCCC'), input: 'count of 4 cheats, all flagged: no legal sessions' },
  { decisions: decisionList('LLL'), input: 'count of 3 legal sessions, all flagged: no cheats' },
  { decisions: [], input: 'count of an empty list of decisions' },
  { decisions: bigDecisions(), input: 'count of 2,200 decisions: 200 cheats (sessions 0, 11, 22, ...; the 190 before session 2,090 flagged) and 2,000 legal sessions (sessions 1, 701 and 1,401 flagged)' },
];

const PRECISIONS = [
  { args: [0.01, 0.95, 0.0015], about: 'cheaters 1 in 100' },
  { args: [0.01, 1, 0.0005], about: 'cheaters 1 in 100, every cheat flagged' },
  { args: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], about: 'half cheaters' },
  { args: [0, 0.9, 0.01], about: 'no cheaters, some false flags: precision 0' },
  { args: [1, 0.8, 0.3], about: 'only cheaters: precision 1' },
  { args: [0.01, 0, 0], about: 'nothing flagged: a denominator of 0' },
  { args: [0, 0.9, 0], about: 'no cheaters and no false flags: a denominator of 0' },
];
const expectedPrecision = (b, r, f) => { const d = b * r + (1 - b) * f; return d === 0 ? null : (b * r) / d; };

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ your detector on labelled sessions

// Your features of each case's play alone, and your score of those; your evaluate's
// decisions should be exactly these.
function scoreAll(cases, features, score, settings) {
  return cases.map((c) => {
    const f = call(`your features threw on case ${c.id}, given ${PLAY} only`, () => features(playOf(c)));
    return call(`your score threw on case ${c.id}`, () => score(f, settings));
  });
}

// The check's decisions, one per case: your score of its play against your threshold.
const decide = (cases, scores, threshold) => expectedCount(cases.map((c, i) => ({ label: c.label, flagged: scores[i] >= threshold })));

// What evaluate must agree with, for the checks that compare it with those decisions.
const AGREE = 'evaluate makes the decisions your features and score make from each session\'s play';
const AGREE_WHY = `the check called your features with each session's ${PLAY} only, scored that with your score and flagged it at or above your threshold. Your evaluate is given the whole cases, because it needs their labels to count, and must make the same decision for every session. If it does not, your features or evaluate reads something other than record.inputs and rounds, such as the case's label, id or kind (API.md, features)`;

// The play of one session handed to evaluate twice, as itself and as a searcher's session (id,
// label and kind changed; record and rounds the same), first with the threshold at the score of
// that play, then just above it. A decision made from the play alone is the same for both
// copies: flagged at the score (>=, not >), not flagged above it.
function labelBlind(evaluate, c, s, settings) {
  const disguised = { ...structuredClone(c), id: c.id.replace(c.kind, 'searcher'), label: 'cheat', kind: 'searcher' };
  const above = s + 1e-6 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(s));
  for (const [threshold, flagged] of [[s, true], [above, false]]) {
    const want = expectedCount([{ label: 'legal', flagged }, { label: 'cheat', flagged }]);
    const got = call(`your evaluate threw on case ${c.id}`, () => evaluate([structuredClone(c), structuredClone(disguised)], { ...structuredClone(settings), threshold }));
    const d = countDifference(got, want);
    if (!d) continue;
    const split = got && typeof got === 'object' && got.tp !== got.fp; // one copy flagged, the other not
    fail({
      checked: 'evaluate decides each session from its play alone, and flags a score equal to the threshold',
      input: `evaluate([case ${c.id} (playCorpusSession('${c.kind}', ${c.id.split('-').at(-1)})), the same record and rounds as { id: '${disguised.id}', label: 'cheat', kind: 'searcher' }], your settings with threshold ${threshold === s ? `${s}, the score your features and score give that play` : `${above}, just above ${s}, the score your features and score give that play`})`,
      observed: `evaluate returned ${show(got)}`,
      expected: `${show(want)}: both copies ${flagged ? 'flagged' : 'not flagged'}. ${split
        ? 'The two copies have the same play and got different decisions, so your features or evaluate reads the case\'s id, label or kind: API.md\'s features use only record.inputs and rounds'
        : flagged ? 'A session whose score equals the threshold is flagged (>=, not >)'
          : `Their play scores ${s}, below this threshold, so neither is flagged. Your evaluate must flag a case only when your score of features(c) reaches settings.threshold, and your features must give the whole case the same values as its record.inputs and rounds alone: reading its id, label or kind changes them`}`,
      diff: d,
    });
  }
}

// The check's own held-out sessions: as many of each kind as the held-out split has, played
// from seeds no lab command uses.
function checkHeldout() {
  const out = [];
  KINDS.forEach((kind, place) => {
    for (let n = 0; n < DEFAULT_COUNTS.heldout[kind]; n++) {
      const seed = HELDOUT_SEEDS + 100_000 * place + n;
      const { record, rounds } = playCorpusSession(kind, seed);
      out.push({ id: `check-${kind}-${seed}`, label: kind === 'searcher' ? 'cheat' : 'legal', kind, record, rounds });
    }
  });
  return out;
}

function settingsWithThreshold(json, need) {
  const settings = json('detect/settings.json');
  if (!settings || typeof settings !== 'object' || Array.isArray(settings)) fail({ checked: 'detect/settings.json holds an object', observed: `it holds ${show(settings, 80)}`, expected: 'a JSON object with your score\'s settings, "budget": 0.002 and "threshold"' });
  if (typeof settings.threshold !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(settings.threshold)) {
    fail({ checked: `detect/settings.json has a finite threshold${need ? ` (${need})` : ''}`, input: 'detect/settings.json', observed: `threshold is ${show(settings.threshold, 60)}`, expected: 'a finite number: the threshold your chooseThreshold gives on the dev split\'s legal scores (node lab.mjs tune project --write stores it)' });
  }
  return settings;
}

const scoreText = (s) => (typeof s === 'number' && Number.isFinite(s) ? s.toFixed(3) : show(s, 30));
const listScores = (cases, scores, k = 8) => cases.slice(0, k).map((c, i) => `${c.id} (${scoreText(scores[i])})`).join(', ');

function evaluateResult(r, what, n) {
  if (!r || typeof r !== 'object') fail({ checked: 'evaluate returns the counts', input: what, observed: `evaluate returned ${show(r, 80)}`, expected: '{ total, tp, fp, tn, fn, recall, falsePositiveRate, precision }, as count returns' });
  const sum = r.tp + r.fp + r.tn + r.fn;
  if (r.total !== n || sum !== n) {
    fail({
      checked: 'evaluate makes one decision per session',
      input: what,
      observed: `total ${show(r.total, 30)}; tp + fp + tn + fn = ${show(r.tp, 20)} + ${show(r.fp, 20)} + ${show(r.tn, 20)} + ${show(r.fn, 20)} = ${show(sum, 30)}`,
      expected: `${n} for both: one decision per case (per session, never per round or per shot), counted with count`,
    });
  }
}

    async run({ fn, json }) {

      }
      const { decided, what, n } = results.delay;
      const need = Math.ceil(DELAY_RECALL * n);
      if (decided.tp < need) {
        fail({
          checked: `recordings/delay.json sessions flagged by your frozen detector (at least ${need} of ${n} required)`,
          input: what,
          observed: `${decided.tp} of ${n} flagged (recall ${(decided.tp / n).toFixed(3)})`,
          expected: `at least ${need} of ${n} (${DELAY_RECALL * 100}%). These sessions aim like the searcher but time their inputs like an expert, so a score built on timing misses them. Hit rate alone does not set them apart either: over a session's 12 rounds the best experts hit about as often as the searcher, and your threshold has to stay above those experts. Look at how close the shots land, the good ones above all, not only at whether they hit. You may design on these sets (node lab.mjs recordings project), but a change to your detector means fitting the threshold on the dev split again and freezing again; your receipt shows the later freeze`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
];

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/15.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 15: latency on the courier game. Crafted rings, round trips, outcomes and rows
// test each function against API.md's rules, boundaries included. The last case plays
// courier sessions with your functions on seeds the lessons do not use, and works out
// every decision and every count of the window table again by the same rules.
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { fail, show, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';
import { runCourier, createHistory, recordPosition, TICK_MS, RANGE, RTT_SAMPLES, HISTORY_TICKS } from '../public/courier.mjs';

export const title = 'Latency on the courier game';

const FILE = 'courier/rewind.mjs';
const notWritten = (error) => String(error?.message ?? error).includes(NOT_WRITTEN);

// "courier/rewind.mjs line 12" for the first stack line inside your project folder.
function whereIn(error, workDir) {
  const roots = new Set([workDir, pathToFileURL(workDir).href]);
  try { const real = realpathSync(workDir); roots.add(real); roots.add(pathToFileURL(real).href); } catch { /* keep the given path */ }
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    for (const root of roots) {
      const i = line.indexOf(root);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const m = line.slice(i + root.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${decodeURIComponent(m[1])} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
const threw = (error, workDir) => {
  const where = whereIn(error, workDir);
  return `it threw ${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}${where ? ` (${where})` : ''}`;
};

// Runs one call of your code. "not written yet" passes through; any other error becomes a
// failure that shows the exact call.
function attempt(env, call, { checked, input, expected }) {
  try {
    return call();
  } catch (error) {
    if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
    return fail({ checked, input, observed: threw(error, env.workDir), expected });
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the rules, as API.md states them

function readRing(history, tick) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(tick) || tick < 0) return null;
  const slot = history.slots[tick % history.size];
  return slot && slot.tick === tick ? { x: slot.x, y: slot.y } : null;
}

function rttRule(samples) {
  const recent = samples.slice(-RTT_SAMPLES);
  return recent.length ? Math.max(...recent) / TICK_MS : 0;
}

// The judge's answer and the reason for it, step by step.
function judgeRule({ seen, now, window, rtt, history, target, range, readyAt }) {
  if (seen > now) return { want: { accept: false, at: now, reason: 'future' }, why: `seen ${seen} is after now ${now}` };
  if (now < readyAt) return { want: { accept: false, at: now, reason: 'cooldown' }, why: `now ${now} is before readyAt ${readyAt}, and the cooldown is judged at now` };
  const bound = Math.ceil(rtt) + 1;
  const allowed = Math.min(window, bound);
  let at = Math.max(seen, now - allowed);
  let why = `the rewind allowed is min(window ${window}, ceil(rtt ${rtt}) + 1 = ${bound}) = ${allowed} ticks, so at = max(seen ${seen}, now ${now} - ${allowed} = ${now - allowed}) = ${at}`;
  let spot = readRing(history, at);
  if (!spot) {
    const slot = history.slots[at % history.size];
    why += `; the ring does not hold tick ${at} (slot ${at % history.size} ${slot ? `holds tick ${slot.tick}` : 'is empty'}), so it is judged at now, ${now}`;
    at = now;
    spot = readRing(history, now);
  }
  if (!spot) return { want: { accept: false, at, reason: 'range' }, why };
  const d2 = (spot.x - target.x) ** 2 + (spot.y - target.y) ** 2;
  const ok = d2 <= range * range;
  why += `; at tick ${at} the courier stood at (${spot.x}, ${spot.y}), distance squared ${d2} from the target (${target.x}, ${target.y}), ${ok ? 'at most' : 'more than'} ${range} * ${range} = ${range * range}`;
  return { want: { accept: ok, at, reason: ok ? 'ok' : 'range' }, why };
}

const ROW_FIELDS = ['honest', 'legit', 'legitRate', 'naive', 'naiveCheats', 'slow', 'slowCheats'];
function countRule(outcomes) {
  const row = { honest: 0, legit: 0, legitRate: 0, naive: 0, naiveCheats: 0, slow: 0, slowCheats: 0 };
  for (const o of outcomes) {
    const cheat = o.accepted && !o.inRangeNow;
    if (o.who === 'honest') { row.honest += 1; if (!o.accepted && o.inRangeAtSeen) row.legit += 1; }
    if (o.who === 'naiveFaker') { row.naive += 1; if (cheat) row.naiveCheats += 1; }
    if (o.who === 'slowPongFaker') { row.slow += 1; if (cheat) row.slowCheats += 1; }
  }
  row.legitRate = row.honest ? row.legit / row.honest : 0;
  return row;
}
const RULE_TEXT = {
  honest: 'honest interactions',
  legit: 'honest interactions refused although the courier was in range at seen',
  legitRate: 'legit / honest, or 0 when honest is 0',
  naive: 'naiveFaker interactions',
  naiveCheats: 'naiveFaker interactions accepted while the courier was not in range now',
  slow: 'slowPongFaker interactions',
  slowCheats: 'slowPongFaker interactions accepted while the courier was not in range now',
};

// The first field of a tally row that differs from the rule's count, or null.
function rowDifference(got, want) {
  if (!got || typeof got !== 'object') return `the row should be an object but is ${show(got, 60)}`;
  for (const k of ROW_FIELDS) {
    const g = got[k];
    const same = k === 'legitRate' ? typeof g === 'number' && Math.abs(g - want[k]) <= 1e-12 : g === want[k];
    if (!same) return `field ${k}: yours is ${show(g, 60)}, required ${show(want[k], 60)} (${RULE_TEXT[k]})`;
  }
  return null;
}

function pickRule(rows, budget) {
  let best = null;
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.legitRate > budget) continue;
    if (!best || row.slowCheats < best.slowCheats || (row.slowCheats === best.slowCheats && row.window < best.window)) best = row;
  }
  return best ? best.window : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- crafted rings

function ring(from, to, place, size = HISTORY_TICKS) {
  const history = createHistory(size);
  for (let tick = from; tick <= to; tick += 1) {
    const p = place(tick);
    recordPosition(history, tick, p.x, p.y);
  }
  return history;
}
function describeRing(history) {
  const ticks = history.slots.filter(Boolean).map((s) => s.tick).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const runs = [];
  for (const t of ticks) {
    const last = runs.at(-1);
    if (last && t === last[1] + 1) last[1] = t;
    else runs.push([t, t]);
  }
  const held = runs.map(([a, b]) => (a === b ? `${a}` : `${a} to ${b}`)).join(', ');
  return `a ring of ${history.size} slots holding ${runs.length ? `ticks ${held}` : 'no ticks'}`;
}
const numbers = (from, to) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);
const sameSpot = (got, want) => (want === null ? got === null : !!got && typeof got === 'object' && got.x === want.x && got.y === want.y);

function judgeScene({ seen, now = 100, window = 10, rtt = 4, readyAt = 0, places = {}, everywhere = null }) {

const SWEEP_SEEDS = [11, 29];

// Wraps your measureRtt and judgeInteract for runCourier: every call is compared with the
// rules at the moment it is made, and the first difference is kept with its interaction
// number (the k-th judge call of a run makes the run's k-th outcome).
function watch(f) {
  const state = { calls: 0, problem: null };
  const keep = (problem) => { state.problem ??= problem; };
  function measureRtt(samples) {
    const copy = samples.slice();
    const want = rttRule(copy);
    let got;
    try {
      got = f.measureRtt(samples);
    } catch (error) {
      if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
      keep({ kind: 'threw', name: 'measureRtt', call: state.calls, error, call_: `measureRtt(${show(copy, 200)})` });
      return want;
    }
    if (typeof got !== 'number' || !(Math.abs(got - want) <= 1e-9)) keep({ kind: 'rtt', call: state.calls, samples: copy, got, want });
    return got;
  }
  function judge(args) {
    const call = state.calls;
    state.calls += 1;
    const slots = args.history.slots;
    const before = slots.map((s) => (s ? { tick: s.tick, x: s.x, y: s.y } : null));
    const frozen = { ...args, history: { size: args.history.size, slots: before }, target: { ...args.target } };
    const { want, why } = judgeRule(frozen);
    let got;
    try {
      got = f.judgeInteract(args);
    } catch (error) {
      if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
      keep({ kind: 'threw', name: 'judgeInteract', call, error, args: frozen });
      return want;
    }
    const changed = slots.findIndex((s, i) => (s ? JSON.stringify({ tick: s.tick, x: s.x, y: s.y }) : 'null') !== JSON.stringify(before[i]));
    if (changed >= 0) keep({ kind: 'ring', call, slot: changed, was: before[changed], now: slots[changed] && { tick: slots[changed].tick, x: slots[changed].x, y: slots[changed].y }, args: frozen });
    else if (!sameVerdict(got, want)) keep({ kind: 'judge', call, args: frozen, got, want, why });
    return got;
  }
  return { measureRtt, judge, state };
}

const showArgs = (a) => `judgeInteract({ seen: ${a.seen}, now: ${a.now}, window: ${a.window}, rtt: ${a.rtt}, readyAt: ${a.readyAt}, target: { x: ${a.target.x}, y: ${a.target.y} }, range: ${a.range}, history, positionAt }) with history ${describeRing(a.history)}`;

function sweepFailure(env, problem, run, setup) {
  const o = run.outcomes[problem.call];
  const input = `runCourier(${setup}), session ${o?.session ?? '?'}, the interaction decided at tick ${o?.now ?? problem.args?.now ?? '?'} (interaction ${problem.call + 1} of the run)`;
  if (problem.kind === 'rtt') {
    fail({ checked: 'measureRtt on the round trips the server measured', input, observed: `measureRtt(${show(problem.samples, 200)}) returned ${show(problem.got)}`, expected: `${problem.want}: the largest of the last ${RTT_SAMPLES} samples (${problem.samples.length ? Math.max(...problem.samples.slice(-RTT_SAMPLES)) : 'none'}) divided by ${TICK_MS}` });
  }
  if (problem.kind === 'threw') {
    fail({ checked: `${problem.name} runs on every interaction of the sessions`, input: `${input}: ${problem.args ? showArgs(problem.args) : problem.call_}`, observed: `your ${problem.name} ${threw(problem.error, env.workDir)}`, expected: 'an answer by the rules in API.md' });
  }
  if (problem.kind === 'ring') {
    fail({ checked: 'judgeInteract (and the positionAt it uses) only read the position ring', input: `${input}: ${showArgs(problem.args)}`, observed: `slot ${problem.slot} held ${show(problem.was)} before the call and ${show(problem.now)} after it`, expected: 'the ring unchanged: it is the server\'s record of where the courier stood, and later presses are judged from it (does your positionAt hand out the slot object itself, and does something change it?)' });
  }
  fail({ checked: 'judgeInteract decides every interaction of the sessions by the rules', input: `${input}: ${showArgs(problem.args)}`, observed: `your result: ${show(problem.got)}`, expected: `${showVerdict(problem.want)}: ${problem.why}` });
}

    async run(env) {

        const input = `measureRtt(${show(samples, 400)}) (${about})`;
        const got = attempt(env, () => measureRtt(samples.slice()), { checked: 'measureRtt runs on these samples', input, expected: String(want) });
        const ok = typeof got === 'number' && (samples.length ? Math.abs(got - want) <= 1e-9 : Object.is(got, 0) || got === 0);
        if (!ok) {
          const recent = samples.slice(-RTT_SAMPLES);
          fail({ checked: 'measureRtt returns the largest of the last 20 round trips, in ticks', input, observed: `your result: ${show(got)}`, expected: samples.length ? `${want}: the largest of the last ${recent.length} samples is ${Math.max(...recent)} ms, and ${Math.max(...recent)} / ${TICK_MS} = ${want}` : '0: with no samples the round trip is 0 (not null)' });
        }
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '15.judge', title: 'judgeInteract rewinds no further than allowed', timeLimitMs: 10000,
    requirement: 'judgeInteract refuses future claims and presses in the cooldown at now, rewinds at most min(window, ceil(rtt) + 1) ticks but never past seen, judges at now when the ring does not hold that tick, and accepts when the courier was within range there.',
    async run(env) {
      const judgeInteract = await env.fn(FILE, 'judgeInteract');
      for (const [what, scene, [accept, at, reason]] of JUDGE) {
        const { args, input } = judgeScene(scene);
        const want = { accept, at, reason };

        if (!sameVerdict(got, want)) fail({ checked: `judgeInteract: ${what}`, input, observed: `your result: ${show(got)}`, expected: `${showVerdict(want)}: ${judgeRule(args).why}` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '15.tally', title: 'tally counts one row of the window table', timeLimitMs: 10000,
    requirement: 'tally(outcomes) counts honest, legit (honest and refused although in range at seen), legitRate (0 with no honest), naive, slow, and the fakers\' accepted presses while not in range now.',
    async run(env) {
      const tally = await env.fn(FILE, 'tally');
      for (const [what, outcomes] of TALLY) {
        const want = countRule(outcomes);
        const listed = outcomes.length > 8 ? `${outcomes.length} outcomes` : show(outcomes.map((o) => ({ who: o.who, accepted: o.accepted, reason: o.reason, inRangeNow: o.inRangeNow, inRangeAtSeen: o.inRangeAtSeen })), 900);

      }
    },
  },

    async run(env) {
      const pickWindow = await env.fn(FILE, 'pickWindow');
      for (const [what, rows, budget, want] of PICK) {
        const input = `pickWindow(rows, ${budget}), rows as { window, legitRate, slowCheats }: ${show(rows.map((r) => ({ window: r.window, legitRate: r.legitRate, slowCheats: r.slowCheats })), 900)}`;
        const got = attempt(env, () => pickWindow(rows.map((r) => ({ ...r })), budget), { checked: `pickWindow runs: ${what}`, input, expected: show(want) });
        if (got !== want) fail({ checked: `pickWindow: ${what}`, input, observed: `your result: ${show(got)}`, expected: show(want) });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '15.sweep', title: 'your functions run the courier sessions', timeLimitMs: 30000,
    requirement: 'With your functions, runCourier on fresh seeds decides every interaction as API.md says, and tally and pickWindow give the rules\' window table and choice for those outcomes.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = {};
      for (const name of ['positionAt', 'measureRtt', 'judgeInteract', 'tally', 'pickWindow']) f[name] = await env.fn(FILE, name);
      for (const seed of SWEEP_SEEDS) {
        const rows = [];

          const w = watch(f);
```
