```mjs
            const fact = o.at === o.now ? ['now', o.inRangeNow] : o.at === o.seen ? ['seen', o.inRangeAtSeen] : null;
            if (fact && fact[1] !== o.accepted) fail({ checked: 'every decision agrees with where the courier really stood', input: `runCourier(${setup}), session ${o.session}, the interaction decided at tick ${o.now} (interaction ${k + 1} of the run)`, observed: `${o.accepted ? 'accepted' : `refused (${o.reason})`}, judged at tick ${o.at}`, expected: `${fact[1] ? 'accepted' : 'refused'}: the server's full record says the courier was ${fact[1] ? '' : 'not '}in range at tick ${o.at} (${fact[0]})` });
          }
          const want = countRule(run.outcomes);
          const input = `tally(the ${run.outcomes.length} outcomes of runCourier(${setup}))`;
          const got = attempt(env, () => f.tally(run.outcomes), { checked: 'tally runs on the outcomes of the sessions', input, expected: show(want) });
          const diff = rowDifference(got, want);
          if (diff) fail({ checked: 'tally counts the sessions\' outcomes by the rules', input, observed: `your row: ${show(got)}`, expected: show(want), diff });
          rows.push({ ...got, window });
        }
        for (const budget of BUDGETS) {
          const want = pickRule(rows, budget);
          const input = `pickWindow(rows, ${budget}) on your window table for seed ${seed}, ${SWEEP_SESSIONS} sessions per model, windows ${SWEEP_WINDOWS.join(', ')}: ${show(rows.map((r) => ({ window: r.window, legitRate: Number(r.legitRate.toFixed(4)), slowCheats: r.slowCheats })), 600)}`;
          const got = attempt(env, () => f.pickWindow(rows.map((r) => ({ ...r })), budget), { checked: 'pickWindow runs on the window table', input, expected: show(want) });
          if (got !== want) fail({ checked: 'pickWindow chooses from the sessions\' window table', input, observed: `your result: ${show(got)}`, expected: show(want) });
        }
      }
    },
  },
];

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/16.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 16: the duplicated item. Every case builds stores with public/store.mjs and calls
// your trade and recover. After a crash the check plays the server: it restarts the
// store and calls your recover before anything else (recovery may itself be crashed and
// rerun), then the client sends its request again. Only inv: and coins: keys are read;
// every other key is yours. Inventories are compared as lists in any order, and a
// missing inventory counts as empty, missing coins as 0.
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createStore, Crash } from '../public/store.mjs';
import { fail, show, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';

export const title = 'The duplicated item';

const FILE = 'trade/trade.mjs';
const notWritten = (error) => String(error?.message ?? error).includes(NOT_WRITTEN);

function whereIn(error, workDir) {
  const roots = new Set([workDir, pathToFileURL(workDir).href]);
  try { const real = realpathSync(workDir); roots.add(real); roots.add(pathToFileURL(real).href); } catch { /* keep the given path */ }
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    for (const root of roots) {
      const i = line.indexOf(root);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const m = line.slice(i + root.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${decodeURIComponent(m[1])} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- worlds and requests

const WORLDS = {
  market: { 'inv:ana': ['sword', 'lamp'], 'inv:bo': ['bow'], 'inv:cy': ['cap'], 'coins:ana': 20, 'coins:bo': 100, 'coins:cy': 60 },
  sparse: { 'inv:dee': ['gem'], 'inv:fay': ['map', 'rope'], 'coins:eli': 35, 'coins:fay': 12 },
  odd: { 'inv:gus': ['hat', 'map9', 'key-9'], 'inv:hal': [], 'inv:ivy': ['orb'], 'coins:gus': 0, 'coins:hal': 0, 'coins:ivy': 7 },
};
const req = (key, seller, buyer, item, price) => ({ key, seller, buyer, item, price });
const SALE = req('sale-1', 'ana', 'bo', 'sword', 40);
const RIVAL = req('sale-2', 'ana', 'cy', 'sword', 30);
const LONG_KEY = 'K'.repeat(36) + '_9-z';

// Scripts for the crash cases: no item is sold twice under two keys.
const SCRIPTS = [
  { name: 'one sale', world: 'market', requests: [[SALE, 'ok']] },
  { name: 'a buyer with exactly the price, and missing keys', world: 'sparse', requests: [[req('k7', 'dee', 'eli', 'gem', 35), 'ok']] },
  { name: 'price 0, an item last in its list, an empty inventory, a refusal between sales', world: 'odd', requests: [[req(LONG_KEY, 'gus', 'hal', 'key-9', 0), 'ok'], [req('b2', 'ivy', 'gus', 'orb', 0), 'ok'], [req('b3', 'gus', 'ivy', 'hat', 8), 'funds'], [req('b4', 'gus', 'ivy', 'map9', 7), 'ok']] },
  { name: 'three sales, a repeat and a changed body', world: 'market', requests: [[SALE, 'ok'], [req('s4', 'cy', 'ana', 'cap', 15), 'ok'], [SALE, 'ok'], [{ ...SALE, price: 45 }, 'conflict'], [req('s5', 'bo', 'cy', 'bow', 50), 'ok']] },
];

const RECEIPT = ['key', 'seller', 'buyer', 'item', 'price'];
const receiptOf = (r) => Object.fromEntries(RECEIPT.map((k) => [k, r[k]]));
const describe = (r) => (r && typeof r === 'object' && !Array.isArray(r) && typeof r.key === 'string' && 'price' in r ? `${r.key}: ${r.seller} sells ${r.buyer} the ${r.item} for ${show(r.price)}` : show(r));

// The answers and belongings API.md requires for a script run without crashes.
function model(script) {
  const world = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WORLDS[script.world]));
  const done = new Map();
  return script.requests.map(([request, reason]) => {
    const before = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(world));
    const body = JSON.stringify([request.seller, request.buyer, request.item, request.price]);
    if (reason === 'ok' && done.get(request.key) !== body) {
      done.set(request.key, body);
      const { seller, buyer, item, price } = request;
      const from = world[`inv:${seller}`] ?? [];
      from.splice(from.indexOf(item), 1);
      world[`inv:${seller}`] = from;
      world[`inv:${buyer}`] = [...(world[`inv:${buyer}`] ?? []), item];
      world[`coins:${buyer}`] = (world[`coins:${buyer}`] ?? 0) - price;
      world[`coins:${seller}`] = (world[`coins:${seller}`] ?? 0) + price;
    }
    const want = reason === 'ok' ? { ok: true, receipt: receiptOf(request) } : { ok: false, reason };
    return { request, want, before, after: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(world)) };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- belongings

const OWN = /^(inv|coins):/;
const playersIn = (...snaps) => [...new Set(snaps.flatMap((s) => Object.keys(s).filter((k) => OWN.test(k)).map((k) => k.slice(k.indexOf(':') + 1))))].sort();
// Belongings only, normalized: inventories sorted, players with nothing left out.
function canon(snap) {
  return JSON.stringify(playersIn(snap).map((p) => {
    const inv = snap[`inv:${p}`];
    return [p, Array.isArray(inv) ? [...inv].sort() : inv ?? [], snap[`coins:${p}`] ?? 0];
  }).filter(([, inv, coins]) => !(Array.isArray(inv) && !inv.length && coins === 0)));
}
const coinTotal = (snap) => Object.entries(snap).filter(([k, v]) => k.startsWith('coins:') && typeof v === 'number').reduce((sum, [, v]) => sum + v, 0);
function worldText(snap, also = {}) {
  const parts = playersIn(snap, also).map((p) => {
    const inv = snap[`inv:${p}`];
    const coins = snap[`coins:${p}`];
    return `${p} ${Array.isArray(inv) ? `[${inv.join(' ')}]` : inv === undefined ? '[]' : show(inv, 40)} ${coins === undefined ? 0 : show(coins, 20)}`;
  });
  return `${parts.join(', ')} (coins ${coinTotal(snap)})`;
}

// What breaks the invariants: an item held other than exactly once, or a coin total that changed.
function invariantProblems(snap, world) {
  const out = [];
  const holders = new Map();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(snap)) {
    if (key.startsWith('inv:')) {
      if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.some((id) => typeof id !== 'string')) { out.push(`${key} holds ${show(value, 60)}, not a list of item ids`); continue; }
      for (const id of value) holders.set(id, [...(holders.get(id) ?? []), key.slice(4)]);
    } else if (key.startsWith('coins:') && !Number.isSafeInteger(value)) out.push(`${key} holds ${show(value, 60)}, not a whole number`);
  }
  const items = Object.entries(world).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('inv:')).flatMap(([, list]) => list);
  for (const id of items) {
    const h = holders.get(id) ?? [];
    if (h.length !== 1) out.push(`the ${id} is held ${h.length ? `${h.length} times (${h.join(', ')})` : 'by nobody'}`);
  }
  for (const [id, h] of holders) if (!items.includes(id)) out.push(`the ${id}, which did not exist, is held by ${h.join(', ')}`);
  if (coinTotal(snap) !== coinTotal(world)) out.push(`the coins add up to ${coinTotal(snap)}, not ${coinTotal(world)}`);
  return out;
}

// The guarantee a list of invariantProblems breaks, for a failure's headline and "required"
// line: the items, the coins, or both, so the message names what actually went wrong.
function guaranteeBroken(broken, world) {
  const coins = broken.filter((p) => p.startsWith('the coins add up') || p.startsWith('coins:')).length;
  const items = broken.length - coins;
  if (items && coins) return { checked: 'every item is in exactly one inventory and the coins add up', expected: `every item held once and ${coinTotal(world)} coins in all` };
  if (items) return { checked: 'every item is in exactly one inventory', expected: 'every item held once' };
  return { checked: 'no coin is made or lost', expected: `${coinTotal(world)} coins in all, as at the start` };
}

const sameAnswer = (got, want) => !!got && typeof got === 'object' && (want.ok
  ? got.ok === true && !!got.receipt && typeof got.receipt === 'object' && RECEIPT.every((k) => got.receipt[k] === want.receipt[k])
  : got.ok === false && got.reason === want.reason);
const showAnswer = (a) => show(a, 300);
const writesText = (n) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'write' : 'writes'}`;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- calling your code

// Calls your function. A Crash and "not written yet" pass through; any other error is a
// failure that says where in the story it happened.
function call(env, name, fn, args, story) {
  try {
    return fn(...args);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Crash || notWritten(error)) throw error;
    const where = whereIn(error, env.workDir);
    return fail({ checked: `your ${name} runs`, input: story(), observed: `your ${name} threw ${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}${where ? ` (${where})` : ''}`, expected: 'an answer by the rules in API.md' });
  }
}
const copyOf = (value) => (value && typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) : value);

async function load(env) {
  return { trade: await env.fn(FILE, 'trade'), recover: await env.fn(FILE, 'recover') };
}

// The script without crashes: its answers and belongings must be the model's. Returns the
// writes each request made: [first, last] (first > last when it wrote nothing).
function clean(env, f, script, steps) {
  const store = createStore(WORLDS[script.world]);
  const ranges = [];
  const story = () => `the ${script.world} world (${worldText(WORLDS[script.world])}), script "${script.name}": ${steps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${describe(s.request)}`).join('; ')}; no crash`;
  for (const [i, step] of steps.entries()) {
    const first = store.writes + 1;
    let answer;
    try {
      answer = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], story);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Crash) fail({ checked: 'trade runs without a crash', input: story(), observed: 'a Crash came out of the store although no crash was armed (does your code call crashAfter?)', expected: 'no crash' });
      throw error;
    }
    if (!sameAnswer(answer, step.want)) fail({ checked: `without any crash, request ${i + 1} is answered by the rules`, input: story(), observed: `request ${i + 1} (${describe(step.request)}) answered ${showAnswer(answer)}`, expected: showAnswer(step.want) });
    if (canon(store.snapshot()) !== canon(step.after)) fail({ checked: `without any crash, request ${i + 1} moves exactly its item and coins`, input: story(), observed: `after request ${i + 1}: ${worldText(store.snapshot(), step.after)}`, expected: worldText(step.after) });
    ranges.push([first, store.writes]);
  }
  return ranges;
}

function crashText(script, steps, ranges, g, recoveryCrashes) {
  const i = ranges.findIndex(([a, b]) => g >= a && g <= b);
  const [a, b] = ranges[i];
  const where = steps.length === 1
    ? `crash after write ${g} of the trade (${b} writes; ${describe(steps[0].request)})`
    : `crash after write ${g} of the script: write ${g - a + 1} of ${b - a + 1} of request ${i + 1} (${describe(steps[i].request)})`;
  const recovery = recoveryCrashes.map((m) => `then recover, crashed after its write ${m}`).join(', ');
  return `${where}, ${recovery ? `${recovery}, ` : ''}then recover, then the retry`;
}

// Runs the script with a crash after write g, restarts, and runs recovery crashed after
// each write in recoveryCrashes (restarting after each). Stops before the last recovery.
function upToRecovery(env, f, script, steps, g, recoveryCrashes, story) {
  const store = createStore(WORLDS[script.world]);
  store.crashAfter(g);
  for (const [i, step] of steps.entries()) {
    try {
      call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], story);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error;
      store.restart();
      for (const m of recoveryCrashes) {
        store.crashAfter(m);
        let fired = false;
        try { call(env, 'recover', f.recover, [store], story); } catch (inner) { if (!(inner instanceof Crash)) throw inner; fired = true; }
        store.restart();
        if (!fired) fail({ checked: 'recovery makes the same writes when it runs again from the same store', input: story(), observed: `recover finished before its write ${m}`, expected: `a crash after recovery's write ${m}, as on an identical store before` });
      }
      return { store, index: i };
    }
  }
  return fail({ checked: 'the trade makes the same writes when run again', input: story(), observed: `the crash armed for write ${g} never came: with it armed, your trades made only ${writesText(store.writes)}`, expected: `at least ${g} writes, as without the crash` });
}

// The last recovery, the checks after it, the client's retry, then the rest of the script.
function finishScenario(env, f, script, steps, store, index, story) {
  const step = steps[index];
  const pre = store.snapshot();
  const finished = call(env, 'recover', f.recover, [store], story);
  const post = store.snapshot();
  const shown = `before the request: ${worldText(step.before)}; after recovery: ${worldText(post, step.before)}`;
  const broken = invariantProblems(post, WORLDS[script.world]);
  if (broken.length) fail({ checked: 'after recovery every item is in exactly one inventory and the coins add up', input: story(), observed: `${broken.join('; ')}. ${shown}`, expected: `every item held once and ${coinTotal(WORLDS[script.world])} coins in all; with the trade made the world is ${worldText(step.after)}` });
  const made = canon(post) === canon(step.after);
  if (!made && canon(post) !== canon(step.before)) fail({ checked: 'after recovery the trade happened wholly or not at all', input: story(), observed: shown, expected: `either the world before the request, or the trade made: ${worldText(step.after)}` });
  const key = step.request.key;
  if (!Array.isArray(finished) || finished.some((k) => typeof k !== 'string')) fail({ checked: 'recover returns the keys of the trades it finished', input: story(), observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}`, expected: 'a list of request keys' });
  if (finished.some((k, i) => i > 0 && !(finished[i - 1] < k))) fail({ checked: 'recover returns the keys sorted, each once', input: story(), observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}`, expected: 'the keys sorted, each once' });
  const stray = finished.find((k) => k !== key);
  if (stray !== undefined) fail({ checked: 'recover returns the keys of the trades it finished', input: story(), observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}, which names ${show(stray)}`, expected: `only ${show(key)} could have been interrupted` });
  if (finished.includes(key) && !made) fail({ checked: 'recover returns the keys of the trades it finished', input: story(), observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}, but the trade is not made: ${shown}`, expected: `${show(key)} only when the trade is made after recovery` });
  if (!finished.includes(key) && made && canon(pre) !== canon(step.after)) fail({ checked: 'recover returns the keys of the trades it finished', input: story(), observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}, yet it completed the trade: before recovery ${worldText(pre, step.before)}, after it ${worldText(post, step.before)}`, expected: `${show([key])}` });
  // The client gets no answer from a server that crashed, so it sends the request again.
  const retry = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], story);
  if (!sameAnswer(retry, step.want)) fail({ checked: 'the retry returns the receipt of the trade that happened', input: story(), observed: `the retry answered ${showAnswer(retry)}; ${shown}`, expected: showAnswer(step.want) });
  if (canon(store.snapshot()) !== canon(step.after)) fail({ checked: 'after the retry the trade has happened exactly once', input: story(), observed: `after the retry: ${worldText(store.snapshot(), step.after)}; ${shown}`, expected: worldText(step.after) });
  if (step.want.ok) {
    const writes = store.writes;
    const again = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], story);
    if (!sameAnswer(again, step.want) || store.writes !== writes) fail({ checked: 'nothing happens twice: a second retry returns the same receipt and writes nothing', input: story(), observed: `the second retry answered ${showAnswer(again)} and made ${writesText(store.writes - writes)}`, expected: `${showAnswer(step.want)} and no writes` });
    const changed = { ...step.request, price: step.request.price + 1 };
    const other = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, changed], story);
    if (other?.ok !== false || other?.reason !== 'conflict' || store.writes !== writes) fail({ checked: 'after recovery, the same key with a different body is a conflict', input: `${story()}, then ${describe(changed)}`, observed: `answered ${showAnswer(other)} and made ${writesText(store.writes - writes)}`, expected: '{ ok: false, reason: "conflict" } and no writes' });
  }
  for (const [j, later] of steps.entries()) {
    if (j <= index) continue;
    const answer = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(later.request)], story);
    if (!sameAnswer(answer, later.want)) fail({ checked: 'after recovery and the retry, the rest of the script is answered as without a crash', input: story(), observed: `request ${j + 1} (${describe(later.request)}) answered ${showAnswer(answer)}`, expected: showAnswer(later.want) });
  }
  const last = steps.at(-1).after;
  if (canon(store.snapshot()) !== canon(last)) fail({ checked: 'after the whole script the world is as without a crash', input: story(), observed: worldText(store.snapshot(), last), expected: worldText(last) });
}

function storyOf(script, steps, ranges, g, recoveryCrashes) {
  return () => `the ${script.world} world (${worldText(WORLDS[script.world])}), script "${script.name}": ${steps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${describe(s.request)}`).join('; ')}; ${crashText(script, steps, ranges, g, recoveryCrashes)}`;
}

// How many writes one more recovery makes from where upToRecovery stopped.
function recoveryWrites(env, f, script, steps, g, recoveryCrashes, story) {
  const { store } = upToRecovery(env, f, script, steps, g, recoveryCrashes, story);
  const copy = createStore(store.snapshot());
  call(env, 'recover', f.recover, [copy], story);
  return copy.writes;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- cases

// Requests the shape rule refuses, each against the market world.
const BAD_SHAPES = [

export const cases = [
  {
    id: '16.trade', title: 'trade answers by the rules, with no crash', timeLimitMs: 10000,
    requirement: 'trade refuses shape, self, conflict, missing and funds in that order and writes nothing when it refuses; a sale moves the item and the coins and returns the receipt; the same key and body again returns the same receipt and writes nothing.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = await load(env);
      for (const [request, about] of BAD_SHAPES) {
        const store = createStore(WORLDS.market);
        const story = () => `the market world (${worldText(WORLDS.market)}): trade(store, ${show(request, 200)}): ${about}`;
        const answer = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(request)], story);
        if (answer?.ok !== false || answer?.reason !== 'shape') fail({ checked: 'trade refuses a request of the wrong shape', input: story(), observed: `answered ${showAnswer(answer)}`, expected: '{ ok: false, reason: "shape" }' });
        if (store.writes) fail({ checked: 'a refusal writes nothing', input: story(), observed: `it made ${writesText(store.writes)}`, expected: 'no writes' });
      }
      for (const script of TRADE_SCRIPTS) {
        const steps = model(script);
        const store = createStore(WORLDS[script.world]);
        for (const [i, step] of steps.entries()) {
          const story = () => `the ${script.world} world (${worldText(WORLDS[script.world])}), requests in order on one store: ${steps.slice(0, i + 1).map((s, j) => `${j + 1}. ${describe(s.request)}`).join('; ')}`;
          const writes = store.writes;
          const before = canon(store.snapshot());
          const answer = call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], story);
          if (!sameAnswer(answer, step.want)) fail({ checked: `request ${i + 1} is answered by the rules`, input: story(), observed: `request ${i + 1} answered ${showAnswer(answer)}; the world before it: ${worldText(step.before)}`, expected: showAnswer(step.want) });
          const repeat = canon(step.before) === canon(step.after);
          if (repeat && store.writes !== writes) fail({ checked: step.want.ok ? 'a request whose key was carried out with the same body writes nothing' : 'a refusal writes nothing', input: story(), observed: `request ${i + 1} made ${writesText(store.writes - writes)}`, expected: 'no writes' });
          if (repeat && canon(store.snapshot()) !== before) fail({ checked: 'a request that changes nothing leaves every belonging as it was', input: story(), observed: worldText(store.snapshot(), step.before), expected: worldText(step.before) });
          if (canon(store.snapshot()) !== canon(step.after)) fail({ checked: `request ${i + 1} moves exactly its item and its coins`, input: story(), observed: `after request ${i + 1}: ${worldText(store.snapshot(), step.after)}`, expected: worldText(step.after) });
        }
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '16.crash-trade', title: 'a crash after any write of a trade, then recover and the retry', timeLimitMs: 20000,
    requirement: 'For a crash after every write of a trade, then recover, then the client\'s retry: every item is in exactly one inventory, the coins add up, the trade happened wholly or not at all, recover names the trade it finished, and the retry returns the receipt without anything happening twice.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = await load(env);
      for (const script of SCRIPTS) {
        const steps = model(script);
        const ranges = clean(env, f, script, steps);
        const total = ranges.at(-1)[1];
        for (let g = 1; g <= total; g += 1) {
          const story = storyOf(script, steps, ranges, g, []);
          const { store, index } = upToRecovery(env, f, script, steps, g, [], story);
          finishScenario(env, f, script, steps, store, index, story);
        }
        // With nothing interrupted, recovery has nothing to finish.
        const store = createStore(WORLDS[script.world]);
        for (const step of steps) call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(step.request)], () => `script "${script.name}" without a crash`);
        const finished = call(env, 'recover', f.recover, [store], () => `script "${script.name}" without a crash, then recover`);
        if (!Array.isArray(finished) || finished.length) fail({ checked: 'recover finishes nothing when no crash interrupted a trade', input: `the ${script.world} world, script "${script.name}": ${steps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${describe(s.request)}`).join('; ')}; no crash, then recover`, observed: `recover returned ${show(finished)}`, expected: '[]' });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '16.crash-recover', title: 'a crash during recovery, then recover again', timeLimitMs: 30000,
    requirement: 'After a crash in a trade, recovery itself is crashed after each of its writes (and the second recovery after each of its own), then recover runs to the end: the same guarantees hold, and the retry returns the receipt.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = await load(env);
      for (const script of SCRIPTS) {
        const steps = model(script);
        const ranges = clean(env, f, script, steps);
        const total = ranges.at(-1)[1];
        const deep = script.requests.length === 1;  // two levels of recovery crashes for the short scripts
        for (let g = 1; g <= total; g += 1) {
          const first = recoveryWrites(env, f, script, steps, g, [], storyOf(script, steps, ranges, g, []));
          for (let m = 1; m <= first; m += 1) {
            const story = storyOf(script, steps, ranges, g, [m]);
            const { store, index } = upToRecovery(env, f, script, steps, g, [m], story);
            finishScenario(env, f, script, steps, store, index, story);
            if (!deep) continue;
            const second = recoveryWrites(env, f, script, steps, g, [m], story);
            for (let m2 = 1; m2 <= second; m2 += 1) {
              const story2 = storyOf(script, steps, ranges, g, [m, m2]);
              const again = upToRecovery(env, f, script, steps, g, [m, m2], story2);
              finishScenario(env, f, script, steps, again.store, again.index, story2);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '16.double-sell', title: 'one item sold to two buyers', timeLimitMs: 20000,
    requirement: 'Two sales of one item to two buyers never both succeed, with or without a crash in the first: the other is refused missing, and the item\'s new owner can sell it on.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = await load(env);
      const sell = (store, request, story) => call(env, 'trade', f.trade, [store, copyOf(request)], story);
      const expectAnswer = (got, want, checked, story, store) => {
        if (!sameAnswer(got, want)) fail({ checked, input: story(), observed: `answered ${showAnswer(got)}; the world now: ${worldText(store.snapshot())}`, expected: showAnswer(want) });
      };
      const ok = (r) => ({ ok: true, receipt: receiptOf(r) });
      const missing = { ok: false, reason: 'missing' };
      // Without a crash, in two worlds.
      for (const [world, first, rival, resale, late] of [
        ['market', SALE, RIVAL, req('sale-3', 'bo', 'cy', 'sword', 50), req('sale-4', 'ana', 'bo', 'sword', 10)],
        ['odd', req('h1', 'gus', 'hal', 'hat', 0), req('h2', 'gus', 'ivy', 'hat', 0), req('h3', 'hal', 'ivy', 'hat', 0), req('h4', 'gus', 'hal', 'hat', 0)],
      ]) {
        const store = createStore(WORLDS[world]);
        const done = [];
        const story = () => `the ${world} world (${worldText(WORLDS[world])}), requests in order: ${done.map((r, i) => `${i + 1}. ${describe(r)}`).join('; ')}`;
        for (const [request, want, checked] of [
          [first, ok(first), 'the first sale succeeds'],
          [rival, missing, 'a second sale of the same item by the same seller is refused missing'],
          [resale, ok(resale), 'the new owner can sell the item on'],
          [late, missing, 'the first seller still cannot sell it'],
          [first, ok(first), 'the first sale\'s request again still returns its receipt'],
        ]) {
          done.push(request);
          expectAnswer(sell(store, request, story), want, checked, story, store);
        }
        const broken = invariantProblems(store.snapshot(), WORLDS[world]);
        if (broken.length) fail({ ...guaranteeBroken(broken, WORLDS[world]), input: story(), observed: `${broken.join('; ')}: ${worldText(store.snapshot())}` });
      }
      // A crash after each write of the first sale; after recovery the rival comes first, then the retry.
      const steps = model(SCRIPTS[0]);
      const ranges = clean(env, f, SCRIPTS[0], steps);
      for (let g = 1; g <= ranges[0][1]; g += 1) {
        const base = storyOf(SCRIPTS[0], steps, ranges, g, []);
        const story = () => base().replace(/then the retry$/, `then ${describe(RIVAL)}, then the retry of sale-1`);
        const { store } = upToRecovery(env, f, SCRIPTS[0], steps, g, [], story);
        call(env, 'recover', f.recover, [store], story);
        const rival = sell(store, RIVAL, story);
        const retry = sell(store, SALE, story);
        const wins = [rival?.ok === true, retry?.ok === true].filter(Boolean).length;
        const now = worldText(store.snapshot());
        if (wins !== 1) fail({ checked: 'exactly one of the two sales of the sword succeeds', input: story(), observed: `${describe(RIVAL)} answered ${showAnswer(rival)}; the retry answered ${showAnswer(retry)}; the world now: ${now}`, expected: `one ok with its receipt, the other { ok: false, reason: "missing" }` });
        const [won, lost, lostAnswer] = rival.ok ? [RIVAL, SALE, retry] : [SALE, RIVAL, rival];
        expectAnswer(won === RIVAL ? rival : retry, ok(won), `the sale that succeeded returns its receipt`, story, store);
        expectAnswer(lostAnswer, missing, `the other sale (${lost.key}) is refused missing`, story, store);
        const broken = invariantProblems(store.snapshot(), WORLDS.market);
        if (broken.length) fail({ ...guaranteeBroken(broken, WORLDS.market), input: story(), observed: `${broken.join('; ')}: ${now}` });
        const holder = store.snapshot()[`inv:${won.buyer}`] ?? [];
        if (!holder.includes('sword')) fail({ checked: 'the sword went to the buyer of the sale that succeeded', input: story(), observed: now, expected: `${won.buyer} holds the sword` });
        const onward = req('sale-9', won.buyer, won.buyer === 'bo' ? 'cy' : 'bo', 'sword', 0);
        expectAnswer(sell(store, onward, story), ok(onward), 'the new owner can sell the sword on', story, store);
      }
    },
  },
];
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/17.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 17: the scoreboard. Each case plays fresh sessions, on seeds no lab command uses,
// through checks/scoreboard.mjs (the code node lab.mjs scoreboard measures with) and holds
// your whole defence to its budgets from API.md's unit 17. A failure names the budget,
// what was measured, a session that shows it, and the lesson to revisit.
import { fail, show } from './harness.mjs';
import * as sb from './scoreboard.mjs';

export const title = 'The scoreboard';

// Lob session n of row r has server seed 71,000,000 + 100,000 * r + n (the rows in
// checks/scoreboard.mjs's ROWS order); the courier's runCourier seed is 71. The scoreboard
// command uses 17,000,000+ and 17, the corpus 1,000,000+ and 2,000,000+.
const BASE = 71_000_000;
const COURIER_SEED = 71;
// Sessions per row: per protocol cheat, per legal model, of the searcher, per courier model.
export const COUNTS = Object.freeze({ protocol: 40, legal: 250, searcher: 150, courier: 150 });
// The legal sessions in all (1,500), and how many of them may be flagged (12: 1 in 125).
const LEGAL_SESSIONS = COUNTS.legal * sb.LEGAL.length;
const LEGAL_FLAGS = Math.floor(LEGAL_SESSIONS / sb.BUDGET.legalFlagsOneIn);

// A square at dusk: four players, four items, 80 coins. The gem is sold, offered again by
// its first owner, sold on for nothing; one sale is a coin short, the next has exactly the
// price; the first request comes again, and a request reuses a key with another body.
const WORLD = Object.freeze({ 'inv:hal': ['gem', 'hat'], 'inv:ida': ['oar'], 'inv:jo': [], 'inv:kit': ['map'], 'coins:hal': 5, 'coins:ida': 50, 'coins:jo': 25, 'coins:kit': 0 });
const SCRIPT = Object.freeze([
  { key: 'c1', seller: 'hal', buyer: 'jo', item: 'gem', price: 25 },
  { key: 'c2', seller: 'hal', buyer: 'ida', item: 'gem', price: 30 },
  { key: 'c3', seller: 'jo', buyer: 'kit', item: 'gem', price: 0 },
  { key: 'c4', seller: 'ida', buyer: 'hal', item: 'oar', price: 31 },
  { key: 'c5', seller: 'ida', buyer: 'hal', item: 'oar', price: 30 },
  { key: 'c1', seller: 'hal', buyer: 'jo', item: 'gem', price: 25 },
  { key: 'c3', seller: 'jo', buyer: 'kit', item: 'gem', price: 1 },
]);

const grouped = (n) => Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
const pct2 = (x) => `${(100 * x).toFixed(2)}%`;
const courierCall = (window) => `runCourier({ seed: ${COURIER_SEED}, sessions: ${COUNTS.courier}, window: ${window}, judge: your judgeInteract, measureRtt: your measureRtt, positionAt: your positionAt }) from public/courier.mjs`;
const tradeStory = `the trade script of checks/17.mjs (${SCRIPT.map((r) => sb.describeRequest(r)).join('; ')}) from ${Object.entries(WORLD).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${show(v)}`).join(', ')}`;

// Runs part of the scoreboard. Your function's error, or a session that stops, becomes a
// failure that names the session; "not written yet" passes through.
function measured(env, where, f) {
  try {
    return f();
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof sb.LearnerError) {
      if (e.notWritten) throw e.error;
      const at = sb.whereIn(e.error, env.workDir);
      fail({
        checked: `your ${e.fn} runs ${where}`,
        input: `${e.session ? sb.sessionText(e.session.row, e.session.seed) : where}${e.call ? `; the call: ${e.call}` : ''}`,
        observed: `${e.message}${at ? ` (${at})` : ''}`,
        expected: 'an answer by API.md\'s rules, with no error',
      });
    }
    if (e instanceof sb.SessionError) {
      const at = sb.whereIn(e.error, env.workDir) ?? sb.whereInCourse(e.error);
      fail({
        checked: 'every session plays to its end',
        input: sb.sessionText(e.session.row, e.session.seed),
        observed: `the session stopped: ${e.error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${e.message}${at ? ` (${at})` : ''}`,
        expected: 'the session runs to its end: the official client and the players read every message your view sends, and your detector reads your recorder\'s record',
      });
    }
    throw e;
  }
}

function needThreshold(lob) {
  if (lob.settingsProblem) fail({ checked: `${sb.FILES.settings} holds your frozen threshold`, input: sb.FILES.settings, observed: lob.settingsProblem, expected: `a finite threshold: revisit ${sb.LESSON.detector}` });
}

const sessionAt = (x) => `${sb.sessionText(x.row, x.seed)}: the message ${show(x.text, 220)}, decided at tick ${x.tick}`;

export const cases = [
  {
    id: '17.protocol', title: 'every cheating input refused', timeLimitMs: 30000,
    requirement: `The four protocol cheats (hitClaim, fireTwice, outOfRange, replay), ${COUNTS.protocol} fresh sessions each through your admission: every input API.md's rules refuse (a message that is not exactly the five fields in range, a seq not above the newest admitted, anything while the shell flies, a second fire in a round) is refused, in every session.`,
    async run(env) {
      const lob = await sb.loadLob(env, { detector: false });
      const rows = sb.CHEATS.map((id) => measured(env, `in the ${id} sessions`, () => sb.playLobRow({ row: id, base: BASE, sessions: COUNTS.protocol, lob, detect: false })));
      const v = sb.protocolVerdict(rows);
      for (const c of v.cheats) {
        if (!c.cheating) fail({ checked: `the ${c.row} sessions send cheating inputs`, input: `${grouped(c.sessions)} ${c.row} sessions from server seed ${sb.lobSeed(BASE, c.row, 0)}`, observed: 'no message the rules refuse was sent', expected: `${c.row}'s cheat, as public/adversaries.mjs describes it (report this: the course's client did not cheat)` });
      }
      if (!v.pass) {
        const f = v.first;
        const c = v.cheats.find((x) => x.row === f.row);
        fail({
          checked: 'each protocol cheat: every cheating input refused, in every session (API.md, unit 17)',
          input: sessionAt(f),
          observed: `${f.answer}. ${c.row}: ${grouped(c.cheating - c.refused)} of its ${grouped(c.cheating)} cheating inputs admitted, in ${grouped(c.broken)} of ${grouped(c.sessions)} sessions`,
          expected: `refused, because ${f.why}. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.admission}.`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '17.legal', title: 'legal players: nothing refused, few flagged, experts hit', timeLimitMs: 60000,
    requirement: `The six legal player models, ${COUNTS.legal} fresh sessions each (${grouped(LEGAL_SESSIONS)} in all) through your admission, view, recorder and frozen detector: no input refused except as stale (seq not above the newest admitted); at most ${LEGAL_FLAGS} of the ${grouped(LEGAL_SESSIONS)} sessions flagged; experts hit at least ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.expertHitRate)}% of their shots.`,
    async run(env) {

      const v = sb.legalVerdict(rows);
      if (!v.refusals.pass) {
        const f = v.refusals.first;
        fail({
          checked: 'legal players, all six models: no input refused except as stale (API.md, unit 17)',
          input: sessionAt(f),
          observed: `${f.answer}. In ${grouped(v.refusals.sessions)} of the ${grouped(v.sessions)} legal sessions an input was refused other than as stale`,
          expected: f.rule === 'admit'
            ? `admitted, because ${f.why}: a legal player's input may be refused only as stale. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.admission}.`
            : `a legal player's input refused only as stale; the rules refuse this one because ${f.why} (report this: the course's player sent it)`,
        });
      }
      if (!v.expert.pass) {
        fail({
          checked: `expert players: hit rate at least ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.expertHitRate)}% (API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: `${grouped(v.expert.sessions)} expert sessions, server seeds ${sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'expert', 0)} to ${sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'expert', v.expert.sessions - 1)} (${sb.sessionText('expert', sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'expert', 0))}, and so on)`,
          observed: `hit rate ${sb.percent(v.expert.rate)} (${grouped(v.expert.hits)} hits of ${grouped(v.expert.shots)} shots)`,
          expected: `at least ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.expertHitRate)}%. Your admission refused none of their inputs, so look at what your view sends: experts aim from the screen it draws. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.view}.`,
        });
      }
      if (!v.flags.pass) {
        const top = [...v.flags.which].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, 5);
        fail({
          checked: `legal sessions flagged by your frozen detector (at most ${grouped(v.flags.allowed)} of ${grouped(v.flags.sessions)} allowed; API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: `${grouped(v.flags.sessions)} legal sessions (${COUNTS.legal} of each model), your score of each session's { record: { inputs }, rounds } against ${sb.FILES.settings}'s threshold ${lob.settings.threshold}`,
          observed: `${grouped(v.flags.flagged)} flagged, among them ${top.map((x) => `${x.row} with server seed ${x.seed} (score ${Number(x.score).toFixed(3)})`).join(', ')}`,
          expected: `at most ${grouped(v.flags.allowed)}. Your threshold must come from the dev split alone: the one chooseThreshold gives on the dev legal scores at budget 0.002 (${sb.LESSON.detector}). Fitted that way, it flags more than ${grouped(v.flags.allowed)} of these ${grouped(v.flags.sessions)} sessions only about once in 100, by chance. Do not move it to fit these sessions: any change to your detector now is a re-tune, which means freezing again, and your receipt shows the later freeze.`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '17.searcher', title: 'the searching client: bounded and caught', timeLimitMs: 30000,
    requirement: `The searching client (public/adversaries.mjs searcher), ${COUNTS.searcher} fresh sessions live against your view, admission and recorder: its hit rate at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.searcherHitRate)}%, and at least ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.searcherFlagged)}% of its sessions flagged by your frozen detector.`,
    async run(env) {
      const lob = await sb.loadLob(env);
      needThreshold(lob);
      const t = measured(env, 'in the searcher sessions', () => sb.playLobRow({ row: 'searcher', base: BASE, sessions: COUNTS.searcher, lob }));
      const v = sb.searcherVerdict(t);
      const seeds = `${grouped(t.sessions)} searcher sessions, server seeds ${sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'searcher', 0)} to ${sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'searcher', t.sessions - 1)} (${sb.sessionText('searcher', sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'searcher', 0))}, and so on)`;
      if (!v.hit.pass) {
        fail({
          checked: `the searching client, live against your view: hit rate at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.searcherHitRate)}% (API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: seeds,
          observed: `hit rate ${sb.percent(v.hit.rate)} (${grouped(v.hit.hits)} hits of ${grouped(v.hit.shots)} shots)`,
          expected: `at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.searcherHitRate)}%: it aims from what your view sends, so it hits more when the view tells it more than the screen draws. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.view}.`,
        });
      }
      if (!v.flags.pass) {
        const missed = [];
        // The first few sessions your detector let through, to look at.
        for (let n = 0; n < t.sessions && missed.length < 3; n += 1) {
          const seed = sb.lobSeed(BASE, 'searcher', n);
          if (!t.flaggedSessions.some((x) => x.seed === seed)) missed.push(seed);
        }
        fail({
          checked: `the searching client: at least ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.searcherFlagged)}% of its sessions flagged (API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: `${seeds}, your score against ${sb.FILES.settings}'s threshold ${lob.settings.threshold}`,
          observed: `${grouped(v.flags.flagged)} of ${grouped(v.flags.sessions)} flagged (${sb.percent(v.flags.sessions ? v.flags.flagged / v.flags.sessions : null)}); not flagged: server seeds ${missed.join(', ')}${t.unscored ? `; your score gave no finite number in ${grouped(t.unscored)} sessions` : ''}`,
          expected: `at least ${grouped(Math.ceil(sb.BUDGET.searcherFlagged * v.flags.sessions))}. Its hit rate here was ${sb.percent(v.hit.rate)}. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.detector}.`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '17.courier', title: 'the courier at your window', timeLimitMs: 20000,
    requirement: `capstone/defence.json's rewindWindow, with your judgeInteract, measureRtt and positionAt, on ${COUNTS.courier} fresh courier sessions per client model: honest presses refused although in range at seen at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.honestRefused)}% of honest presses, and the naive faker's presses accepted while not in range now at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.naiveAccepted)}% of its presses.`,
    async run(env) {
      const { window, problem } = sb.windowOf(env.json(sb.FILES.defence));
      if (problem) fail({ checked: `${sb.FILES.defence} holds your window`, input: sb.FILES.defence, observed: problem, expected: '{ "rewindWindow": <the window you chose in lesson 15, a whole number of ticks> } (lesson 17, "Your window")' });
      const rewind = await sb.loadRewind(env);
      const c = measured(env, `in the courier sessions of ${courierCall(window)}`, () => sb.courierAt({ seed: COURIER_SEED, sessions: COUNTS.courier, window, rewind }));
      const v = sb.courierVerdict(c);
      if (!v.honest.pass) {
        const o = v.honest.first;
        fail({
          checked: `courier at your window ${window}: honest presses refused at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.honestRefused)}% (API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: courierCall(window),
          observed: `${pct2(v.honest.rate)}: ${grouped(v.honest.refused)} of ${grouped(v.honest.of)} honest presses refused although the courier was in range at the tick the player saw; the first in session ${o.session}, seen ${o.seen}, decided at tick ${o.now}, judged at ${o.at} (${o.reason})`,
          expected: `at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.honestRefused)}%. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.window}: lesson 15's table prices each window, and the budget is judged on sessions you have not seen.`,
        });
      }
      if (!v.naive.pass) {
        const o = v.naive.first;
        fail({
          checked: `courier at your window ${window}: the naive faker's lies accepted at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.naiveAccepted)}% (API.md, unit 17)`,
          input: courierCall(window),
          observed: `${pct2(v.naive.rate)}: ${grouped(v.naive.accepted)} of its ${grouped(v.naive.of)} presses accepted while the courier was not in range at the deciding tick; the first in session ${o.session}, claiming seen ${o.seen}, decided at tick ${o.now}, judged at ${o.at}`,
          expected: `at most ${Math.round(100 * sb.BUDGET.naiveAccepted)}%: it answers pings at once, so its own round trip allows a rewind of about 2 ticks. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.window}: the rewind is min(window, ceil(rtt) + 1).`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '17.trade', title: 'trades survive a crash at any write', timeLimitMs: 20000,
    requirement: 'A script of trades with your trade and recover, crashed after each of its writes; recovery itself crashed after each of its writes and run again; then the client\'s retry and the rest of the script: every item in exactly one inventory and the coins adding up to what they did, after recovery and at the end.',
    async run(env) {
      const f = await sb.loadTrade(env);
      const t = measured(env, `in the crash test of ${tradeStory}`, () => sb.crashTrades({ world: WORLD, script: SCRIPT, ...f }));
      const v = sb.tradeVerdict(t);
      if (t.unreached.length) {
        fail({
          checked: 'trades: a crash at any write (API.md, unit 17)',
          input: tradeStory,
          observed: `with a crash armed for write ${t.unreached[0]}, your trades made fewer writes and the crash never came`,
          expected: `the same ${grouped(t.writes)} writes as without a crash, so each can be crashed. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.trade}.`,
        });
      }
      if (!v.pass) {
        const first = [...t.first.afterRecovery.map((x) => `after recovery ${x}`), ...t.first.atEnd.map((x) => `at the end ${x}`)];
        fail({
          checked: 'trades: no item in two places and no coin made or lost, after a crash at any write (API.md, unit 17)',
          input: `${tradeStory}; ${t.first.story}`,
          observed: `${first.join('; ')}. Over all ${grouped(t.crashPoints + t.recoveryPoints)} crash points: ${grouped(t.heldTwice)} items held twice, ${grouped(t.missing)} held by nobody, ${grouped(t.coinsMoved)} coins made or lost`,
          expected: `every item in exactly one inventory and ${Object.entries(WORLD).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('coins:')).reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0)} coins in all, at every crash point. Revisit ${sb.LESSON.trade}.`,
        });
      }
    },
  },
];

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/encodings.mjs`:

```mjs
// The course's leak hunt, used by the unit 13 checks and by `node lab.mjs leaks`.
//
// Two ways to find a leak:
//
// 1. Non-interference (what your findLeaks does). Change one hidden thing on a copy of
//    the game, without changing anything the screen draws, and compare the two messages
//    byte for byte. It finds a leak under any encoding, even one nobody thought of.
//
// 2. The encoding search (this file's main job). Search every message the server sent
//    for the hidden values present when it was built, written the ways a leak is usually
//    written. It only finds what it searches for, but when it finds something it can say
//    which value, written how, and where in the message, which makes the leak easy to
//    find in your code.
//
// The values searched, with their names in game.hidden:
//   the exact wind (wind)                 as a double, and as a 32-bit float
//   the flag's speed (flagSpeed)          a 32-bit float
//   the random state (rng)                a 32-bit whole number
//   the flag's exact x (flagFraction)     a 32-bit float; only its forms with a fractional
//                                         part, since the screen draws the whole pace
//   the shell's velocity (shellVelocity)  vx and vy, 32-bit floats, while the shell flies
// The flag timer and the fractions of the other positions are small numbers that occur
// all over a correct message; non-interference covers them.
//
// The ways each value is written (its "forms"):
//   decimal  4 to 17 significant digits, and 2 to 6 digits after the point. Only forms
//            with a fractional part: a whole number is what the screen draws.
//   scaled   the value times 10,000 or 1,000,000, rounded or cut to a whole number, when
//            that is 10,000 or more in size (more than any number a correct message holds)
//   whole    the random state as a whole number, when it is 100,000 or more
//   bits     a float's 32 bits read as a whole number, when that is 100,000 or more
//   hex      the value's bytes (8 for a double, 4 for a float or the random state), first
//            byte first and last byte first, in either case; the random state also as
//            rng.toString(16)
//   base64   the same bytes, standard and URL-safe alphabets, with or without padding
// A number in a message matches when it equals a form. Text (a string value, or a key)
// matches when it contains a form: a digit form not touching other digits, a hex form in
// any case, a base64 form exactly.
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { createLobServer } from '../public/runtime.mjs';
import { playSession } from '../public/sim.mjs';
import { link } from '../public/net.mjs';
import { makePlayer } from '../public/players.mjs';
import { searcher } from '../public/adversaries.mjs';
import { fullView } from '../public/full-view.mjs';
import { mixSeed } from '../public/stats.mjs';

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the values

// What each searched value is called in reports, and the game.hidden name it belongs to.
export const SEARCHED = [
  { id: 'wind', hidden: 'wind', label: 'the exact wind' },
  { id: 'flagSpeed', hidden: 'flagSpeed', label: "the flag's speed" },
  { id: 'rng', hidden: 'rng', label: 'the random state' },
  { id: 'flagX', hidden: 'flagFraction', label: "the flag's exact x" },
  { id: 'vx', hidden: 'shellVelocity', label: "the shell's velocity, vx" },
  { id: 'vy', hidden: 'shellVelocity', label: "the shell's velocity, vy" },
];
const LABEL = Object.fromEntries(SEARCHED.map((s) => [s.id, s.label]));

const SCALED_MIN = 10_000;
const WHOLE_MIN = 100_000;
const fractional = (n) => Number.isFinite(n) && !Number.isInteger(n);

// Whether a value can be searched for: a float with a fractional part (a float that
// happens to be a whole number looks like the whole numbers a correct message is full of),
// or a random state of 100,000 or more.
export const searchable = (v) => (v.type === 'whole' ? v.value >= WHOLE_MIN : fractional(v.value));

// The searched values the game holds right now, the ones that can be searched for:
// [{ id, value, type, note }], type 'double', 'float' or 'whole'. Read them when the
// message is built. The wind is searched twice: as the double the server keeps, and as
// that double turned into a 32-bit float.
export function hiddenAt(game) {
  const wind = game.serverWind();
  const values = [
    { id: 'wind', value: wind, type: 'double' },
    { id: 'wind', value: Math.fround(wind), type: 'float', note: 'of the wind as a 32-bit float' },
    { id: 'flagSpeed', value: game.flagSpeed(), type: 'float' },
    { id: 'rng', value: game.rng(), type: 'whole' },
    { id: 'flagX', value: game.targetX(), type: 'float' },
  ];
  if (game.flying()) {
    const { vx, vy } = game.velocity();
    values.push({ id: 'vx', value: vx, type: 'float' }, { id: 'vy', value: vy, type: 'float' });
  }
  return values.filter(searchable);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the forms

const DIGITS = 'digits', HEX = 'hex', B64 = 'base64';

function bytesOf(value, type) {
  const b = Buffer.alloc(type === 'double' ? 8 : 4);
  if (type === 'double') b.writeDoubleLE(value);
  else if (type === 'float') b.writeFloatLE(value);
  else b.writeUInt32LE(value >>> 0);
  return b;
}

// Every form of one searchable value:
// { numbers: Map(number -> encoding), texts: [{ text, encoding, match }] }.
function formsOf({ value, type, note }) {
  const numbers = new Map();
  const texts = [];
  const seenText = new Set();
  const of = note ? `, ${note}` : '';
  const addNumber = (n, encoding) => { if (!numbers.has(n)) numbers.set(n, encoding + of); };
  const addText = (text, encoding, match) => {
    const key = match === HEX ? text.toLowerCase() : text;
    if (seenText.has(match + key)) return;
    seenText.add(match + key);
    texts.push({ text: key, encoding: encoding + of, match });
  };

  if (type !== 'whole') {
    // Decimal forms: a whole-number form is what the screen draws, so it is never searched.
    const decimal = (text, encoding) => {
      const n = Number(text);
      if (!fractional(n)) return;
      addNumber(n, encoding);
      addText(text, encoding, DIGITS);
      addText(String(n), encoding, DIGITS);
    };
    decimal(String(value), 'decimal, as JavaScript prints it');
    for (let p = 4; p <= 17; p++) decimal(value.toPrecision(p), `decimal, ${p} significant digits`);
    for (let d = 2; d <= 6; d++) decimal(value.toFixed(d), `decimal, ${d} digits after the point`);
    for (const [scale, name] of [[1e4, '10,000'], [1e6, '1,000,000']]) {
      for (const [cut, how] of [[Math.round, 'rounded'], [Math.trunc, 'cut']]) {
        const n = cut(value * scale);
        if (Math.abs(n) < SCALED_MIN) continue;
        addNumber(n, `scaled: times ${name}, ${how} to a whole number`);
        addText(String(n), `scaled: times ${name}, ${how} to a whole number`, DIGITS);
      }
    }
  } else {
    addNumber(value, 'a whole number');
    addText(String(value), 'a whole number', DIGITS);
  }

  const bytes = bytesOf(value, type);
  if (type === 'float') {
    const bits = bytes.readUInt32LE(0);
    if (bits >= WHOLE_MIN) {
      addNumber(bits, "the float's 32 bits as a whole number");
      addText(String(bits), "the float's 32 bits as a whole number", DIGITS);
    }
  }
  const size = type === 'double' ? '8 bytes of the double' : type === 'float' ? '4 bytes of the float' : '4 bytes';
  for (const [b, order] of [[bytes, 'first byte first'], [Buffer.from(bytes).reverse(), 'last byte first']]) {
    addText(b.toString('hex'), `hex: the ${size}, ${order}`, HEX);
    addText(b.toString('base64').replace(/=+$/, ''), `base64: the ${size}, ${order}`, B64);
    addText(b.toString('base64url'), `base64 (URL-safe): the ${size}, ${order}`, B64);
  }
  if (type === 'whole') addText((value >>> 0).toString(16), 'hex: rng.toString(16)', HEX);
  return { numbers, texts };
}

// Forms are reused while a value stays the same (the wind holds for a round).
const cache = new Map();
function formsCached(v) {
  const key = `${v.id}:${v.type}:${v.value}`;
  let forms = cache.get(key);
  if (!forms) {
    if (cache.size > 5000) cache.clear();
    forms = formsOf(v);
    cache.set(key, forms);
  }
  return forms;
}

// A digit form inside text counts only when no other digit (or a decimal point before
// it) touches it, so 3.217 is not found inside 13.2174.
function containsDigits(haystack, needle) {
  let at = haystack.indexOf(needle);
  while (at >= 0) {
    const before = at > 0 ? haystack[at - 1] : '';
    const after = haystack[at + needle.length] ?? '';
    if (!/[0-9.]/.test(before) && !/[0-9]/.test(after)) return true;
    at = haystack.indexOf(needle, at + 1);
  }
  return false;
}

function textHits(text, values, where, hits) {
  if (text.length < 4) return;
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  const hasDigit = /[0-9]/.test(text);
  for (const v of values) {
    for (const f of formsCached(v).texts) {
      if (f.match === DIGITS ? hasDigit && containsDigits(text, f.text)
        : f.match === HEX ? lower.includes(f.text)
          : text.includes(f.text)) {
        hits.push({ id: v.id, label: LABEL[v.id], value: v.value, encoding: f.encoding, form: f.text, path: where });
      }
    }
  }
}

// Search one message (its JSON text) for the given values. Returns every hit:
// { id, label, value, encoding, form, path }, path saying where in the message.
export function searchMessage(text, given) {
  const values = given.filter(searchable);
  const hits = [];
  let message;
  try {
    message = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    textHits(String(text), values, 'the message text (not valid JSON)', hits);
    return hits;
  }
  const numbers = new Map();
  for (const v of values) {
    for (const [n, encoding] of formsCached(v).numbers) {
      if (!numbers.has(n)) numbers.set(n, []);
      numbers.get(n).push({ v, encoding });
    }
  }
  const walk = (x, path) => {
    if (typeof x === 'number') {
      for (const { v, encoding } of numbers.get(x) ?? []) hits.push({ id: v.id, label: LABEL[v.id], value: v.value, encoding, form: String(x), path: path || 'the whole message' });
    } else if (typeof x === 'string') {
      textHits(x, values, path || 'the whole message', hits);
    } else if (Array.isArray(x)) {
      x.forEach((y, i) => walk(y, `${path}[${i}]`));
    } else if (x && typeof x === 'object') {
      for (const [k, y] of Object.entries(x)) {
        textHits(k, values, `the key "${k}"${path ? ` in ${path}` : ''}`, hits);
        walk(y, path ? `${path}.${k}` : k);
      }
    }
  };
  walk(message, '');
  return hits;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ non-interference

// The first hidden change that alters view's message at this moment, or null.
// Each name in game.hidden is changed with setHidden(name, k), k = 1, 2, 3, on its own
// copy of the game; the view is never run on `game` itself. A copy with nothing changed
// must give the same bytes as a second such copy, or the view depends on something other
// than the game's state and info (it then comes back as { name: null }).
// Returns { name, k, before, after } with the two messages' texts.
export function firstInterference(view, game, info) {
  const before = JSON.stringify(view(game.clone(), info));
  const again = JSON.stringify(view(game.clone(), info));
  if (again !== before) return { name: null, k: null, before, after: again };
  for (const name of game.hidden) {
    for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
      const copy = game.clone();
      if (!copy.setHidden(name, k)) continue;
      const after = JSON.stringify(view(copy, info));
      if (after !== before) return { name, k, before, after };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// For the lab: which hidden names are present at this moment (setHidden can change them),
// and which of those change the view's message. { present: [names], changed: [names] }.
export function interferenceAt(view, game, info) {
  const before = JSON.stringify(view(game.clone(), info));
  const present = [], changed = [];
  for (const name of game.hidden) {
    let here = false, moved = false;
    for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
      const copy = game.clone();
      if (!copy.setHidden(name, k)) continue;
      here = true;
      if (JSON.stringify(view(copy, info)) !== before) { moved = true; break; }
    }
    if (here) present.push(name);
    if (moved) changed.push(name);
  }
  return { present, changed };
}

// Where two message texts first differ, in words: the first field whose value differs,
// a field one has and the other lacks, or the same fields in another order.
export function describeDifference(beforeText, afterText) {
  let a, b;
  try { a = JSON.parse(beforeText); b = JSON.parse(afterText); } catch { return 'the texts differ'; }
  const show = (x) => { const s = JSON.stringify(x); return s === undefined ? 'nothing' : s.length > 80 ? `${s.slice(0, 77)}...` : s; };
  if (!a || !b || typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object') return `${show(a)} became ${show(b)}`;
  const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b);
  for (const k of ka) {
    if (!(k in b)) return `field ${k} is gone`;
    if (JSON.stringify(a[k]) !== JSON.stringify(b[k])) return `field ${k}: ${show(a[k])} became ${show(b[k])}`;
  }
  const extra = kb.find((k) => !(k in a));
  if (extra) return `a field ${extra} appeared: ${show(b[extra])}`;
  return `the same fields in another order: ${ka.join(', ')} became ${kb.join(', ')}`;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ sessions

// The sessions here are played by honest clients, so they need no parser: an input is
// admitted unless it is older than the newest admitted one, the shell is in the air, or it
// is a second fire in a round (API.md's rules, without the reasons). Your own admission is
// not involved, so these sessions test your view and nothing else. A client confused by a
// wrong view may send an input those rules refuse; it is refused, as your server would.
export const honestAdmission = {
  parseInput: (text) => ({ ok: true, input: JSON.parse(text) }),
  admit(state, input, { round, flying }) {
    if (input.seq <= state.lastSeq || flying || (input.fire && state.firedRound === round)) return { status: 'refused' };
    return { status: 'admitted', next: { lastSeq: input.seq, firedRound: input.fire ? round : state.firedRound } };
  },
};

const KIND_NAMES = {
  novice: 'a novice player', skilled: 'a skilled player', expert: 'an expert player', highLatency: 'a player on a slow connection',
  jitter: 'a player on a jittery connection', reconnects: 'a player who drops out and reconnects', searcher: 'the searching client',
};
export const describeSession = (s) => `${KIND_NAMES[s.kind] ?? s.kind} (server seed ${s.seed})`;

// One session as the corpus plays it: the client from mixSeed(seed, 2), the links from
// mixSeed(seed, 3) and mixSeed(seed, 4), the client's own network unless one is given.
// `view` is what the server sends. A player's official client runs in `screen` mode
// ('drawn' or 'full', client.mjs); the searching client uses whatever the server sends.
// `onView(game, info)` runs when each message is built, before the view, and must not
// change the game. Returns playSession's result.
export function playOne({ kind, seed, view, screen = 'drawn', network = null, onView = null, keepMessages = false }) {
  const client = kind === 'searcher' ? searcher(mixSeed(seed, 2)) : makePlayer(kind, mixSeed(seed, 2), { screen });
  const net = network ?? client.network;
  const server = createLobServer({
    seed,
    admission: honestAdmission,
    view: onView ? (game, info) => { onView(game, info); return view(game, info); } : view,
  });
  return playSession({
    server,
    client,
    up: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 3), ...net }),
    down: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 4), ...net }),
    keepMessages,
  });
}

// Play a session with `view` and search every message it sent for the hidden values
// present when that message was built. `probe(game, info)`, if given, also runs as each
// message is built (it must not change the game). Returns { messages, bytes, largest,
// hits, searched, found, result }: searched and found count messages per value id.
export function huntSession(session, view, { probe = null } = {}) {
  const hiddenByTick = new Map();
  const onView = (game, info) => {
    hiddenByTick.set(info.tick, hiddenAt(game));
    if (probe) probe(game, info);
  };
  const result = playOne({ ...session, view, keepMessages: true, onView });
  const searched = {}, found = {};
  const hits = [];
  let bytes = 0, largest = 0;
  for (const m of result.messages) {
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(m.text);
    bytes += size;
    largest = Math.max(largest, size);
    const values = hiddenByTick.get(m.tick) ?? [];
    for (const id of new Set(values.map((v) => v.id))) searched[id] = (searched[id] ?? 0) + 1;
    const here = searchMessage(m.text, values);
    for (const id of new Set(here.map((h) => h.id))) found[id] = (found[id] ?? 0) + 1;
    for (const h of here) hits.push({ ...h, tick: m.tick });
  }
  return { messages: result.messages.length, bytes, largest, hits, searched, found, result };
}

// The sessions 13.view-encodings plays: legal players and the searching client, each over
// its own network.
export const CHECK_SESSIONS = [
  { kind: 'expert', seed: 13_300_002 },
  { kind: 'novice', seed: 13_300_104 },
  { kind: 'reconnects', seed: 13_300_203 },
  { kind: 'jitter', seed: 13_300_401 },
  { kind: 'searcher', seed: 13_300_301 },
  { kind: 'searcher', seed: 13_300_307 },
];

// For the course's self-test: the encoding search over every session 13.view-encodings
// plays, once with the given drawn view (a correct one must give no hits at all) and once
// with the full view (every searched value must be found, in every message where it is
// present and can be searched for). Returns { sessions, drawn, full, missed, ok }.
export function calibrate({ drawnView, sessions = CHECK_SESSIONS }) {
  const drawn = { messages: 0, hits: 0, first: null };
  const full = { messages: 0, values: {} };
  for (const id of SEARCHED.map((s) => s.id)) full.values[id] = { searched: 0, found: 0 };
  for (const s of sessions) {
    const mine = huntSession(s, drawnView);
    drawn.messages += mine.messages;
    drawn.hits += mine.hits.length;
    if (!drawn.first && mine.hits.length) drawn.first = { session: describeSession(s), ...mine.hits[0] };
    const all = huntSession(s, fullView);
    full.messages += all.messages;
    for (const id of Object.keys(full.values)) {
      full.values[id].searched += all.searched[id] ?? 0;
      full.values[id].found += all.found[id] ?? 0;
    }
  }
  const missed = Object.entries(full.values).filter(([, c]) => c.found < c.searched || c.searched === 0).map(([id, c]) => `${id} found in ${c.found} of ${c.searched} messages`);
  return { sessions: sessions.length, drawn, full, missed, ok: drawn.hits === 0 && missed.length === 0 };
}
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/fixtures/13/views.mjs`:

```mjs
// Planted views for 13.leaks-finds. Each one sends what the official client draws, plus
// one leak (or two), and lists exactly the hidden names (game.hidden) it leaks at the
// moment 13.leaks-finds tries it at (LEAK_PLAN in checks/13.mjs). A hidden thing that is
// absent at a moment (no shell in the air, no impact mark, no trail) leaks nothing there.
//
// They share a base, `screen`, which leaks nothing. It is not API.md's drawn view: it has
// fields of its own (the HUD line as the game prints it, the trail as one flat list), so
// a finder that works by comparing against the drawn view, instead of changing hidden
// things one at a time, gets these wrong.
//
// `note` says what makes a view hard to catch; 13.leaks-finds prints it when your
// findLeaks misses that view's leak. 13.leaks-finds hands your findLeaks a new function
// that calls the planted view, so a view is known only by what its messages hold.
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';

// What the screen shows, in a shape of its own: every position to the nearest pace.
export function screen(game, { tick, ack }) {
  const shell = game.shell();
  const impact = game.impact();
  return {
    t: tick,
    a: ack,
    hud: game.line(),
    msg: game.message(),
    flag: Math.round(game.targetX()),
    cloud: Math.round(game.cloud()),
    shell: shell && [Math.round(shell.x), Math.round(shell.y)],
    trail: game.trail().flatMap(([x, y]) => [Math.round(x), Math.round(y)]),
    mark: impact && [Math.round(impact.x), impact.age],
  };
}

// The middle of the band of exact winds that show the current arrows.
function bandMiddle(level) {
  if (level >= 3) return 4.375;
  if (level <= -3) return -4.375;
  return 1.5 * level;
}

export const correct = {
  about: 'the base view: whole paces and the HUD line only',
  leaks: [],
  view: screen,
};

};

  about: "sends the flag's exact x instead of the nearest pace",
  leaks: ['flagFraction'],
  view: (game, info) => ({ ...screen(game, info), flag: game.targetX() }),

};

// non-interference with three changes cannot see it.
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/harness.mjs`:

```mjs
// Shared helpers for the checks. A check either returns (pass) or throws a
// CheckFailure saying what was checked, the input, what was observed and what
// was required.
//
// Your files are read from your project folder by their path in it:
//   await fn('server/admission.mjs', 'parseInput')    an exported function
//   await cls('trade/trade.mjs', 'Ledger')            an exported class
//   json('detect/settings.json')                       a JSON file, parsed
// A file counts as "not written yet" when it is missing from the project, when a
// function in it throws an error saying "not written yet" (as every starter function
// does), and, for a JSON file, when it is empty or still holds the words
// "not written yet" (the starter's placeholder).
import { readFileSync, existsSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

export const courseRoot = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
export const NOT_WRITTEN = 'not written yet';

export class CheckFailure extends Error {
  constructor(fields) { super(fields.observed ?? 'check failed'); this.fields = fields; }
}
export function fail(fields) { throw new CheckFailure(fields); }

// Short, readable rendering of a value.
export function show(value, limit = 240) {
  const text = render(value);
  return text.length > limit ? text.slice(0, limit - 3) + '...' : text;
}
function render(value) {
  if (value === undefined) return 'nothing (undefined)';
  if (value === null) return 'null';
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return `${value}n`;
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) value = Array.from(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return '[' + value.map(render).join(', ') + ']';
  if (typeof value === 'string') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Object.is(value, -0)) return '-0';
  if (typeof value === 'object') return '{ ' + Object.entries(value).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${render(v)}`).join(', ') + ' }';
  return String(value);
}

export function same(a, b) {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(a)) a = Array.from(a);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(b)) b = Array.from(b);
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => same(x, b[i]));
  if (a && b && typeof a === 'object' && typeof b === 'object') {
    const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b);
    return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every(k => same(a[k], b[k]));
  }
  return Object.is(a, b);
}

export function firstDifference(observed, expected, path = '') {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(observed)) observed = Array.from(observed);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(expected)) expected = Array.from(expected);
  if (Array.isArray(expected)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(observed)) return `${path || 'the value'} should be a list but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    const n = Math.min(observed.length, expected.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!same(observed[i], expected[i])) return firstDifference(observed[i], expected[i], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}position ${i}`);
    if (observed.length !== expected.length) return `${path ? path + ': ' : ''}yours has ${observed.length} entries, the required value has ${expected.length}`;
    return null;
  }
  if (expected && typeof expected === 'object') {
    if (!observed || typeof observed !== 'object') return `${path || 'the value'} should be an object but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    for (const k of Object.keys(expected)) if (!same(observed[k], expected[k])) return firstDifference(observed[k], expected[k], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}field ${k}`);
    const extra = Object.keys(observed).filter(k => !(k in expected));
    if (extra.length) return `${path ? path + ': ' : ''}yours has a field the required value lacks: ${extra[0]}`;
    return null;
  }
  return `at ${path || 'the value'}: yours is ${show(observed, 60)}, required ${show(expected, 60)}`;
}

export function expectSame(observed, expected, { checked, input, what = 'your result' }) {
  if (same(observed, expected)) return;
  fail({ checked, input, observed: `${what}: ${show(observed)}`, expected: show(expected), diff: firstDifference(observed, expected) });
}

// Run fn, expecting it to throw. A starter "not written yet" error is passed through.
export function thrown(fn) {
  try { fn(); } catch (error) {
    if (String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
    return error;
  }
  return null;
}

// A course file (not one of yours), by its path from the course folder.
export function readJson(rel) { return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, rel), 'utf8')); }

function notWritten(file, why) { return Error(`${file}: ${NOT_WRITTEN} (${why})`); }

// Load your files from your project folder. Paths may be nested: 'server/admission.mjs'.
export function makeLoader(workDir) {
  const cache = new Map();
  let real = workDir;
  try { real = realpathSync(workDir); } catch { /* the folder is checked below, per file */ }
  const tidy = (message) => String(message).split('\n')[0].split(workDir).join('PROJECT').split(real).join('PROJECT');

  async function load(file) {
    if (!cache.has(file)) {
      if (!existsSync(join(workDir, file))) throw notWritten(file, `it is missing from your project; copy starter/${file} to begin`);
      let mod;
      try {
        mod = await import(pathToFileURL(join(workDir, file)).href);
      } catch (error) {
        if (String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
        throw new CheckFailure({
          checked: `loading your ${file}`,
          observed: `${file} could not be loaded: ${tidy(error?.message ?? error)}`,
          expected: `${file} loads as an ES module (look for a syntax error or a misspelled import)`,
          loadError: true,
        });
      }
      cache.set(file, mod);
    }
    return cache.get(file);
  }

  async function get(file, name, kind = 'function') {
    const mod = await load(file);
    if (typeof mod[name] !== 'function') fail({ checked: `${file} exports ${name}`, observed: `${file} has no exported ${kind} named ${name}`, expected: `export ${kind === 'class' ? 'class' : 'function'} ${name} in ${file}` });
    return mod[name];
  }

  // A JSON file of yours, parsed afresh on every call.
  function json(file) {
    const path = join(workDir, file);
    if (!existsSync(path)) throw notWritten(file, `it is missing from your project; copy starter/${file} to begin`);
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    if (!text.trim()) throw notWritten(file, "the file is empty");
    if (text.includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw notWritten(file, `it still holds the starter's "${NOT_WRITTEN}": replace that with your values`);
    try {
      return JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (error) {
      fail({
        checked: `reading your ${file}`,
        observed: `${file} is not valid JSON: ${tidy(error.message)}`,
        expected: `${file} holds one JSON value (look for a trailing comma, a comment or a missing quote)`,
        loadError: true,
      });
    }
  }

  return { load, json, fn: (file, name) => get(file, name), cls: (file, name) => get(file, name, 'class') };
}
```
