`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs the cases of one unit against a project folder, one process per case, so an
// endless loop is stopped by a time limit and one case cannot disturb another.
// A unit is checks/NN.mjs exporting `title` and `cases`: [{ id, title, requirement,
// timeLimitMs?, run({ fn, cls, json, load, workDir }) }].
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { join, dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const UNITS = ['12', '13', '14', '15', '16', '17'];
export const DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS = 10000;

// The lesson section that teaches each check, from lessons/sections.json.
export function sectionFor(id) {
  let map;
  try { map = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(here, '..', 'lessons', 'sections.json'), 'utf8')).checks; } catch { return null; }
  const m = map?.[id];
  return m ? `lesson ${m.lesson}, "${m.section}"` : null;
}

// { unit, title, cases } for a unit. When checks/NN.mjs does not exist yet the answer
// has missing: true; when it exists but does not load, loadError says why. Neither throws.
export async function listCases(unit) {
  if (!UNITS.includes(unit)) throw Error(`There is no unit ${unit}: choose ${UNITS.join(', ')}`);
  const file = join(here, `${unit}.mjs`);
  if (!existsSync(file)) return { unit, title: null, cases: [], missing: true };
  try {
    const mod = await import(pathToFileURL(file).href);
    if (!Array.isArray(mod.cases)) return { unit, title: mod.title ?? null, cases: [], loadError: `checks/${unit}.mjs exports no list named cases` };
    return { unit, title: mod.title ?? null, cases: mod.cases };
  } catch (error) {
    return { unit, title: null, cases: [], loadError: String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0] };
  }
}

function runCase(workDir, unit, c) {
  const limit = c.timeLimitMs ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS;
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const child = fork(join(here, 'worker.mjs'), [], { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe', 'ipc'], execArgv: ['--max-old-space-size=1024', '--stack-size=4000'] });
    let done = false;
    let stderr = '';
    const started = Date.now();
    // Keep the end of stderr: after an uncaught error Node prints the error, its stack and then
    // its own version line, so the useful line is near the end but not last.
    child.stderr.on('data', d => { stderr = (stderr + d).slice(-8000); });
    const finish = r => {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      child.kill('SIGKILL');
      resolve({ ...r, ms: Date.now() - started });
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'timeout', limitMs: limit }), limit);
    child.once('message', finish);
    child.once('error', e => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: e.message }));
    // 'close', not 'exit': 'close' comes after the IPC channel has delivered the worker's last message.
    child.once('close', (code, signal) => { const why = lastErrorLine(stderr); finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `the check process ended early (exit code ${code}${signal ? ', signal ' + signal : ''})${why ? ': ' + why : ''}` }); });
    child.send({ workDir, unit, caseId: c.id });
  });
}

// Runs the unit's cases (or only the ids listed) with `jobs` processes at a time.
// A unit whose checks are missing or do not load comes back with no results and pass: false.
// The line of a child's stderr that says what went wrong: the last line that names an error,
// else the last line that is neither a stack frame nor Node's version line.
function lastErrorLine(text) {
  const lines = text.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l && !/^at /.test(l) && !/^Node\.js v\d/.test(l));
  return [...lines].reverse().find((l) => /^\w*(Error|Exception)\b/.test(l)) ?? lines.at(-1) ?? '';
}

export async function runUnit(workDir, unit, { only = null, jobs = 1 } = {}) {
  const listed = await listCases(unit);
  if (listed.missing || listed.loadError) return { ...listed, results: [], pass: false };
  const dir = resolve(workDir);
  const todo = listed.cases.filter(c => !only || only.includes(c.id));
  const results = new Array(todo.length);
  let next = 0;
  const lane = async () => { while (next < todo.length) { const k = next++; const c = todo[k]; const r = await runCase(dir, unit, c); results[k] = { ...r, title: c.title, reread: sectionFor(c.id), requirement: c.requirement }; } };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(jobs, todo.length)) }, lane));
  return { unit, title: listed.title, results, pass: results.length > 0 && results.every(r => r.pass) };
}
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/scoreboard.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 17's scoreboard: the course's clients against a whole defence, counted. Both
// `node lab.mjs scoreboard` (labcmds/17.mjs) and the unit 17 checks (checks/17.mjs)
// measure through this file, with different seeds, so a number the lab prints and the
// number a check judges mean the same thing.
//
// Lob. Every session is a new server, public/runtime.mjs's createLobServer, with your
// admission (server/admission.mjs), your view (server/view.mjs) and your recorder
// (server/recorder.mjs), and one client that joins it, played by public/sim.mjs over two
// seeded links (public/net.mjs). The seeding is public/corpus.mjs's: for server seed
// `seed` the client is seeded mixSeed(seed, 2), the link up mixSeed(seed, 3) and the link
// down mixSeed(seed, 4), and every client plays on its own kind of network. Your
// features get each session as { record: { inputs }, rounds }: the inputs your recorder
// wrote and the rounds the server played, and nothing else (no id, label, kind or seed),
// as API.md says. A session is flagged when your score reaches detect/settings.json's
// threshold.
//
// Every message the server receives is also judged by API.md's rules at the moment it
// is decided, from the session's facts and the newest seq the server has admitted, so
// that a refusal the rules require can be told from one they do not:
//   - a message that is not exactly { v: 1, seq, angle, power, fire }, each value in
//     its range (public/rules.mjs), is refused;
//   - an input whose seq is not above the newest seq admitted is stale: replayed, or
//     overtaken on the network by a newer one;
//   - nothing is admitted while the shell is in the air, and a round has at most one fire.
// A cheating input is one these rules refuse. A legal player's input may be refused only
// as stale.
//
// Courier. public/courier.mjs's runCourier at your rewindWindow, with your
// judgeInteract, measureRtt and positionAt, counted by unit 15's rules.
//
// Trades. A short script of trades on public/store.mjs's store, crashed after each of
// its writes; the server restarts and runs your recover (also crashed after each of its
// own writes and run again), then the client sends its interrupted request again, then
// the rest of the script. Every item must stay in exactly one inventory and the coins
// must add up to what they did.
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { show, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';
import { createLobServer } from '../public/runtime.mjs';
import { playSession } from '../public/sim.mjs';
import { link } from '../public/net.mjs';
import { fullView } from '../public/full-view.mjs';
import { makePlayer, PLAYER_KINDS } from '../public/players.mjs';
import { hitClaim, fireTwice, outOfRange, replay, searcher } from '../public/adversaries.mjs';
import { runCourier } from '../public/courier.mjs';
import { createStore, Crash } from '../public/store.mjs';
import { mixSeed } from '../public/stats.mjs';
import { INPUT_MAX_BYTES, ANGLE, POWER, SEQ } from '../public/rules.mjs';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the budgets (API.md, unit 17)

export const BUDGET = Object.freeze({
  // At most 1 legal session in 125 flagged: 12 of the check's 1,500. The threshold aims at
  // 1 in 500 on 1,000 dev legal sessions; fitted exactly that way it flags more than 12 of
  // 1,500 fresh ones about once in 100, by chance (BetaBinomial(1500, 2, 999)).
  legalFlagsOneIn: 125,
  expertHitRate: 0.18,   // expert players hit at least 18% of their shots
  searcherHitRate: 0.75, // the searching client, live against your view, hits at most 75%
  searcherFlagged: 0.9,  // and at least 90% of its sessions are flagged
  honestRefused: 0.01,   // courier: honest presses refused although in range at seen, at most 1%
  naiveAccepted: 0.01,   // courier: the naive faker's presses accepted while not in range now, at most 1%
});

// In this order; a row's place in the list is its r in the seeds.
export const ROWS = Object.freeze([
  ...LEGAL.map((kind) => ({ id: kind, label: kind, prose: kind, group: 'legal', make: (seed) => makePlayer(kind, seed), call: (s) => `makePlayer('${kind}', ${s})` })),
  ...CHEATS.map((id) => ({ id, label: id, prose: id, group: 'protocol', make: CHEAT_CLIENTS[id], call: (s) => `${id}(${s})` })),
  { id: 'searcher', label: 'searcher, your view', prose: 'searching client\'s', group: 'searcher', make: (seed) => searcher(seed, { perceive: 'auto' }), call: (s) => `searcher(${s}, { perceive: 'auto' })` },
  { id: 'searcherFull', label: 'searcher, full view', prose: 'searching client\'s full-view', group: 'contrast', fullView: true, make: (seed) => searcher(seed, { perceive: 'auto' }), call: (s) => `searcher(${s}, { perceive: 'auto' })` },
]);
export const MAX_SESSIONS = 100_000;
export const rowOf = (id) => {
  const row = ROWS.find((r) => r.id === id);
  if (!row) throw Error(`no scoreboard row ${id}`);
  return row;
};
// Session n (0, 1, 2, ...) of a row: server seed base + 100,000 * r + n.
export const lobSeed = (base, id, n) => base + 100_000 * ROWS.indexOf(rowOf(id)) + n;

const grouped = (n) => Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US');

// How to play one session again: the call, and what it does.
export function sessionText(id, seed) {
  const row = rowOf(id);
  return `the ${row.prose} session with server seed ${seed} (checks/scoreboard.mjs playLobSession({ row: '${id}', seed: ${seed} }): createLobServer({ seed: ${seed}, admission: yours, view: ${row.fullView ? 'fullView' : 'yours'}, recorder: yours }) against ${row.call(`mixSeed(${seed}, 2)`)}, on the client's own network, links seeded mixSeed(${seed}, 3) up and mixSeed(${seed}, 4) down)`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- your functions

// An error thrown by one of your functions, with what it was given.
export class LearnerError extends Error {
  constructor({ fn, file, error, call }) {
    super(`your ${fn} in ${file} threw ${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${firstLine(error)}`);
    this.name = 'LearnerError';
    this.fn = fn;
    this.file = file;
    this.error = error;
    this.call = call;
    this.notWritten = firstLine(error).includes(NOT_WRITTEN);
  }
}

// An error that stopped a session somewhere else (the server, a client reading your
// view's message), with the session it stopped.
export class SessionError extends Error {
  constructor(error, session) {
    super(firstLine(error));
    this.name = 'SessionError';
    this.error = error;
    this.session = session;
  }
}

export function firstLine(error) {
  return String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0];
}

// "server/view.mjs line 12" for the first stack line inside the folder, or null.
export function whereIn(error, folder) {
  if (!folder) return null;
  const roots = new Set([folder, pathToFileURL(folder).href]);
  try { const real = realpathSync(folder); roots.add(real); roots.add(pathToFileURL(real).href); } catch { /* keep the given path */ }
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    for (const root of roots) {
      const i = line.indexOf(root);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const m = line.slice(i + root.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${decodeURIComponent(m[1])} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
const course = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname;
// The first stack line in the course's own files ("public/client.mjs line 80"), or null.
export const whereInCourse = (error) => whereIn(error, course);

// Wraps one of your functions: an error it throws becomes a LearnerError naming it and
// what it was given. Errors that pass (a store Crash) go through unchanged.
export function guarded(fn, file, f, describe = null, passes = () => false) {
  return (...args) => {
    try {
      return f(...args);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof LearnerError || passes(error)) throw error;
      let call = null;
      try { call = describe ? describe(...args) : null; } catch { /* keep null */ }
      throw new LearnerError({ fn, file, error, call });
    }
  };
}

// Loads your functions through a loader with fn(file, name) and json(file): checks/harness.mjs's
// makeLoader, or a check's env. Each part loads only its own files.
export async function loadLob(loader, { detector = true } = {}) {
  const parseInput = await loader.fn(FILES.admission, 'parseInput');
  const admit = await loader.fn(FILES.admission, 'admit');
  const drawnView = await loader.fn(FILES.view, 'drawnView');
  const createRecorder = await loader.fn(FILES.recorder, 'createRecorder');
  const lob = {
    admission: {
      parseInput: guarded('parseInput', FILES.admission, parseInput, (text) => `parseInput(${show(text, 220)})`),
      admit: guarded('admit', FILES.admission, admit, (state, input, facts) => `admit(${show(state)}, ${show(input)}, ${show(facts)})`),
    },
    view: guarded('drawnView', FILES.view, drawnView, (game, info) => `drawnView(game, ${show(info)}) after tick ${info?.tick}`),
    createRecorder: recorderOf(createRecorder),
  };
  if (detector) {
    const settings = loader.json(FILES.settings);
    lob.settings = settings;
    lob.settingsProblem = settingsProblem(settings);
    lob.features = guarded('features', FILES.features, await loader.fn(FILES.features, 'features'), () => 'features({ record: { inputs }, rounds })');
    lob.score = guarded('score', FILES.detector, await loader.fn(FILES.detector, 'score'), (f) => `score(${show(f, 400)}, settings)`);
  }
  return lob;
}

function recorderOf(createRecorder) {
  const make = guarded('createRecorder', FILES.recorder, createRecorder, (options) => `createRecorder(${show(options)})`);
  return (options) => {
    const recorder = make(options);
    return {
      admitted: guarded('createRecorder', FILES.recorder, (tick, input) => recorder.admitted(tick, input), (tick, input) => `the recorder's admitted(${tick}, ${show(input)})`),
      finish: guarded('createRecorder', FILES.recorder, (end, final) => recorder.finish(end, final), (end, final) => `the recorder's finish(${end}, ${show(final)})`),
    };
  };
}

export function settingsProblem(settings) {
  if (!settings || typeof settings !== 'object' || Array.isArray(settings)) return `${FILES.settings} holds ${show(settings, 80)}, not a JSON object with your score's settings and "threshold"`;
  if (typeof settings.threshold !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(settings.threshold)) return `${FILES.settings} holds threshold ${show(settings.threshold)}, not a finite number: lesson 14 has you store the threshold chooseThreshold gives on the dev split (node lab.mjs tune PROJECT --write) and freeze it`;
  return null;
}

export async function loadRewind(loader) {
  const out = {};
  for (const name of ['positionAt', 'measureRtt', 'judgeInteract']) out[name] = await loader.fn(FILES.rewind, name);
  return {
    positionAt: guarded('positionAt', FILES.rewind, out.positionAt, (history, tick) => `positionAt(history, ${show(tick)})`),
    measureRtt: guarded('measureRtt', FILES.rewind, out.measureRtt, (samples) => `measureRtt(${show(samples, 200)})`),
    judgeInteract: guarded('judgeInteract', FILES.rewind, out.judgeInteract, (a) => `judgeInteract({ seen: ${a?.seen}, now: ${a?.now}, window: ${a?.window}, rtt: ${a?.rtt}, readyAt: ${a?.readyAt}, target: ${show(a?.target)}, range: ${a?.range}, history, positionAt })`),
  };
}

// The window in capstone/defence.json, or a problem saying what is wrong with the file.
export function windowOf(defence) {
  if (!defence || typeof defence !== 'object' || Array.isArray(defence)) return { problem: `${FILES.defence} holds ${show(defence, 80)}, not a JSON object like { "rewindWindow": <ticks> }` };
  const w = defence.rewindWindow;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(w) || w < 0) return { problem: `${FILES.defence} holds rewindWindow ${show(w)}, not a whole number of ticks, 0 or more (the window you chose in lesson 15)` };
  return { window: w };
}

export async function loadTrade(loader) {
  const trade = await loader.fn(FILES.trade, 'trade');
  const recover = await loader.fn(FILES.trade, 'recover');
  const passes = (e) => e instanceof Crash;
  return {
    trade: guarded('trade', FILES.trade, trade, (store, request) => `trade(store, ${show(request)})`, passes),
    recover: guarded('recover', FILES.trade, recover, () => 'recover(store)', passes),
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- API.md's rules for one message

const FIVE = ['v', 'seq', 'angle', 'power', 'fire'];

// { input } for a well-formed input, or { kind, fault }: what is wrong, in words.
function readInput(text) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string') return { kind: 'shape', fault: 'it is not text' };
  if (Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8') > INPUT_MAX_BYTES) return { kind: 'shape', fault: `it is longer than ${INPUT_MAX_BYTES} bytes` };
  let value;
  try { value = JSON.parse(text); } catch { return { kind: 'shape', fault: 'it is not JSON' }; }
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return { kind: 'shape', fault: 'it is not a JSON object' };
  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  const extra = keys.filter((k) => !FIVE.includes(k));
  if (extra.length) return { kind: 'shape', fault: `it has a field an input does not have: ${extra.join(', ')}` };
  const missing = FIVE.filter((k) => !keys.includes(k));
  if (missing.length) return { kind: 'shape', fault: `it has no ${missing.join(' or ')}` };
  if (value.v !== 1) return { kind: 'shape', fault: `its v is ${show(value.v)}, not 1` };
  for (const [name, { min, max }] of [['seq', SEQ], ['angle', ANGLE], ['power', POWER]]) {
    const x = value[name];
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(x) || x < min || x > max) return { kind: 'range', fault: `its ${name} ${show(x)} is not a whole number from ${grouped(min)} to ${grouped(max)}` };
  }
  if (typeof value.fire !== 'boolean') return { kind: 'range', fault: `its fire ${show(value.fire)} is not true or false` };
  return { input: { v: 1, seq: value.seq, angle: value.angle, power: value.power, fire: value.fire } };
}

// What the rules say about a message arriving now: why it must be refused, or null.
function judgeText(text, facts, newest) {
  const at = { tick: facts.tick, round: facts.round, flying: facts.flying, fired: facts.fired, newest };
  const { input, kind, fault } = readInput(text);
  if (!input) return { ...at, kind, why: fault };
  if (input.seq <= newest) return { ...at, input, kind: 'stale', why: `its seq ${input.seq} is not above ${newest}, the newest seq the server had admitted` };
  if (facts.flying) return { ...at, input, kind: 'flying', why: 'the shell was in the air' };
  if (input.fire && facts.fired) return { ...at, input, kind: 'fired', why: `round ${facts.round} had already had its shot` };
  return { ...at, input, kind: null, why: null };
}

// Why the rules admit a message, in words.
const admitWhy = (j) => `${j.newest ? `its seq ${j.input.seq} is above ${j.newest}, the newest seq admitted` : `its seq ${j.input.seq} is the session's first admitted`}, the shell was not in the air${j.input.fire ? `, and round ${j.round} had no shot yet` : ''}`;

// What your admission answered for one message.
// The server (public/runtime.mjs) applies an input when parseInput's answer has a truthy
// ok and admit's answer has status 'admitted'; anything else is a refusal.
function answerText(event) {
  const { parsed, decision } = event;
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return `your parseInput returned ${show(parsed, 120)}, so the server refused it`;
  if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.ok === false ? `your parseInput refused it (reason ${show(parsed.reason)})` : `your parseInput returned ${show(parsed, 120)}, so the server refused it`;
  if (decision && decision.status === 'admitted') return 'your admission admitted it';
  if (!decision || typeof decision !== 'object') return `your parseInput accepted it and your admit returned ${show(decision, 120)}, so the server refused it`;
  return `your admit refused it (reason ${show(decision.reason)})`;
}
const appliedBy = (event) => !!(event.parsed && event.parsed.ok) && !!event.decision && event.decision.status === 'admitted';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- one Lob session

// Plays one session of a row with your files (from loadLob) and counts what happened.
export function playLobSession({ row: id, seed, lob, detect = true }) {
  const row = rowOf(id);
  const out = {
    row: id, seed, gameSeed: null, shots: 0, hits: 0,
    texts: 0, refused: 0, stale: 0, cheating: 0, cheatingRefused: 0, refusedOther: 0, refusedAdmissible: 0,
    firstStale: null, firstRefusal: null, firstCheatAdmitted: null, faults: {},
    score: null, flagged: false,
  };
  let server = null;
  let pending = null;
  let newest = 0;
  const admission = {
    parseInput(text) {
      pending = judgeText(text, server.sessions[0].session.facts(), newest);
      return lob.admission.parseInput(text);
    },
    admit: (state, input, facts) => lob.admission.admit(state, input, facts),
  };
  const onEvent = (event) => {
    const j = pending;
    pending = null;
    const admitted = appliedBy(event);
    out.texts += 1;
    if (admitted) {
      const s = event.parsed.input?.seq;
      if (Number.isSafeInteger(s) && s > newest) newest = s;
    } else out.refused += 1;
    const seen = () => ({ tick: j.tick, text: event.text, answer: answerText(event), rule: j.why ? 'refuse' : 'admit', kind: j.kind, why: j.why ?? admitWhy(j) });
    if (j.why) {
      out.cheating += 1;
      out.faults[j.kind] = (out.faults[j.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
      if (!admitted) {
        out.cheatingRefused += 1;
        if (j.kind === 'stale') { out.stale += 1; out.firstStale ??= seen(); } else { out.refusedOther += 1; out.firstRefusal ??= seen(); }
      } else out.firstCheatAdmitted ??= seen();
    } else if (!admitted) {
      out.refusedAdmissible += 1;
      out.firstRefusal ??= seen();
    }
  };
  try {
    server = createLobServer({ seed, admission, view: row.fullView ? fullView : lob.view, recorder: lob.createRecorder, onEvent });
    const client = row.make(mixSeed(seed, 2));
    const net = client.network;
    const result = playSession({ server, client, up: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 3), ...net }), down: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 4), ...net }) });
    out.gameSeed = server.sessions[0].seed;
    for (const r of result.outcomes) if (r.shot) { out.shots += 1; if (r.result === 'hit') out.hits += 1; }
    if (detect) {
      const f = lob.features({ record: { inputs: result.record?.inputs }, rounds: result.outcomes });
      out.score = lob.score(f, lob.settings);
      out.flagged = typeof out.score === 'number' && out.score >= lob.settings.threshold;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof LearnerError) { error.session ??= { row: id, seed }; throw error; }
    throw new SessionError(error, { row: id, seed });
  }
  return out;
}

// Plays sessions 0 .. sessions-1 of a row and adds them up.
export function playLobRow({ row: id, base, sessions, lob, detect = true }) {
  const t = {
    row: id, label: rowOf(id).label, group: rowOf(id).group, sessions: 0, shots: 0, hits: 0,
    flagged: 0, flaggedSessions: [], scored: 0, unscored: 0, firstUnscored: null,
    texts: 0, refused: 0, stale: 0, staleSessions: [], cheating: 0, cheatingRefused: 0, refusedOther: 0, refusedAdmissible: 0,
    refusedNotStaleSessions: 0, firstRefusedNotStale: null, cheatSessionsBroken: 0, firstCheatAdmitted: null, faults: {},
  };
  for (let n = 0; n < sessions; n += 1) {
    const seed = lobSeed(base, id, n);
    const s = playLobSession({ row: id, seed, lob, detect });
    t.sessions += 1;
    t.shots += s.shots;
    t.hits += s.hits;
    if (s.flagged) { t.flagged += 1; t.flaggedSessions.push({ seed, score: s.score }); }
    if (detect) {
      if (typeof s.score === 'number' && Number.isFinite(s.score)) t.scored += 1;
      else { t.unscored += 1; t.firstUnscored ??= { seed, score: s.score }; }
    }
    for (const k of ['texts', 'refused', 'stale', 'cheating', 'cheatingRefused', 'refusedOther', 'refusedAdmissible']) t[k] += s[k];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(s.faults)) t.faults[k] = (t.faults[k] ?? 0) + v;
    if (s.stale) t.staleSessions.push({ seed, count: s.stale, first: s.firstStale });
    if (s.refusedOther + s.refusedAdmissible) { t.refusedNotStaleSessions += 1; t.firstRefusedNotStale ??= { seed, ...s.firstRefusal }; }
    if (s.firstCheatAdmitted) { t.cheatSessionsBroken += 1; t.firstCheatAdmitted ??= { seed, ...s.firstCheatAdmitted }; }
  }
  return t;
}

export const hitRate = (t) => (t.shots ? t.hits / t.shots : null);
export const percent = (x, digits = 1) => (x === null || x === undefined ? '-' : `${(100 * x).toFixed(digits)}%`);
export const hitText = (t) => `${percent(hitRate(t))} (${grouped(t.hits)}/${grouped(t.shots)})`;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Lob budgets

// Each protocol cheat: every input the rules refuse, refused, in every session.
export function protocolVerdict(rows) {
  const cheats = rows.filter((t) => t.group === 'protocol');
  const broken = cheats.find((t) => t.firstCheatAdmitted);
  return {
    pass: !broken,
    cheats: cheats.map((t) => ({ row: t.row, cheating: t.cheating, refused: t.cheatingRefused, sessions: t.sessions, broken: t.cheatSessionsBroken, first: t.firstCheatAdmitted, faults: t.faults, refusedAdmissible: t.refusedAdmissible })),
    first: broken ? { row: broken.row, ...broken.firstCheatAdmitted } : null,
  };
}

// Legal players: no input refused except as stale; at most 1 session in 125 flagged; experts hit at least 18%.
export function legalVerdict(rows) {
  const legal = rows.filter((t) => t.group === 'legal');
  const sessions = legal.reduce((s, t) => s + t.sessions, 0);
  const bad = legal.reduce((s, t) => s + t.refusedNotStaleSessions, 0);
  const firstBad = legal.find((t) => t.firstRefusedNotStale);
  const flagged = legal.reduce((s, t) => s + t.flagged, 0);
  const expert = legal.find((t) => t.row === 'expert');
  const rate = expert ? hitRate(expert) : null;
  const stale = legal.reduce((s, t) => s + t.stale, 0);
  return {
    sessions,
    refusals: { pass: bad === 0, sessions: bad, first: firstBad ? { row: firstBad.row, ...firstBad.firstRefusedNotStale } : null, stale, staleSessions: legal.flatMap((t) => t.staleSessions.map((x) => ({ row: t.row, ...x }))) },
    flags: { pass: flagged * BUDGET.legalFlagsOneIn <= sessions, flagged, allowed: Math.floor(sessions / BUDGET.legalFlagsOneIn), sessions, which: legal.flatMap((t) => t.flaggedSessions.map((x) => ({ row: t.row, ...x }))) },
    expert: { pass: rate !== null && rate >= BUDGET.expertHitRate, rate, hits: expert?.hits ?? 0, shots: expert?.shots ?? 0, sessions: expert?.sessions ?? 0 },
  };
}

// The searching client, live against your view: hit rate at most 75%; at least 90% flagged.
export function searcherVerdict(t) {
  const rate = hitRate(t);
  return {
    hit: { pass: rate === null || rate <= BUDGET.searcherHitRate, rate, hits: t.hits, shots: t.shots },
    flags: { pass: t.flagged >= BUDGET.searcherFlagged * t.sessions, flagged: t.flagged, sessions: t.sessions, missed: t.sessions - t.flagged },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the recordings (unit 14)

export function scoreRecordings(cases, lob) {
  const t = { sessions: cases.length, shots: 0, hits: 0, flagged: 0 };
  for (const c of cases) {
    for (const r of c.rounds) if (r.shot) { t.shots += 1; if (r.result === 'hit') t.hits += 1; }
    const s = lob.score(lob.features({ record: { inputs: c.record.inputs }, rounds: c.rounds }), lob.settings);
    if (typeof s === 'number' && s >= lob.settings.threshold) t.flagged += 1;
  }
  return t;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the courier

// runCourier at one window with your functions, counted by unit 15's rules.
export function courierAt({ seed, sessions, window, rewind }) {
  const run = runCourier({ seed, sessions, window, judge: rewind.judgeInteract, measureRtt: rewind.measureRtt, positionAt: rewind.positionAt });
  const c = { seed, sessions, window, honest: 0, honestRefused: 0, naive: 0, naiveAccepted: 0, slow: 0, slowAccepted: 0, firstHonestRefused: null, firstNaiveAccepted: null };
  for (const o of run.outcomes) {
    if (o.who === 'honest') {
      c.honest += 1;
      if (!o.accepted && o.inRangeAtSeen) { c.honestRefused += 1; c.firstHonestRefused ??= o; }
    } else if (o.who === 'naiveFaker') {
      c.naive += 1;
      if (o.accepted && !o.inRangeNow) { c.naiveAccepted += 1; c.firstNaiveAccepted ??= o; }
    } else if (o.who === 'slowPongFaker') {
      c.slow += 1;
      if (o.accepted && !o.inRangeNow) c.slowAccepted += 1;
    }
  }
  const mean = (who) => { const mine = run.sessions.filter((s) => s.who === who); return mine.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.deliveries, 0) / mine.length; };
  c.deliveries = { honest: mean('honest'), naive: mean('naiveFaker'), slow: mean('slowPongFaker') };
  return c;
}

export function courierVerdict(c) {
  const honestRate = c.honest ? c.honestRefused / c.honest : 0;
  const naiveRate = c.naive ? c.naiveAccepted / c.naive : 0;
  return {
    honest: { pass: honestRate <= BUDGET.honestRefused, rate: honestRate, refused: c.honestRefused, of: c.honest, first: c.firstHonestRefused },
    naive: { pass: naiveRate <= BUDGET.naiveAccepted, rate: naiveRate, accepted: c.naiveAccepted, of: c.naive, first: c.firstNaiveAccepted },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- trades under a crash

const copy = (v) => (v && typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)) : v);
const coinsIn = (snap) => Object.entries(snap).filter(([k, v]) => k.startsWith('coins:') && typeof v === 'number').reduce((sum, [, v]) => sum + v, 0);
const holdersOf = (snap, item) => Object.entries(snap).filter(([k, v]) => k.startsWith('inv:') && Array.isArray(v)).flatMap(([k, v]) => v.filter((id) => id === item).map(() => k.slice(4)));
export const describeRequest = (r) => `${r.key}: ${r.seller} sells ${r.buyer} the ${r.item} for ${r.price}`;

// Every item held other than once, and whether the coins still add up.
function damage(snap, items, total) {
  const twice = [], missing = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    const h = holdersOf(snap, item);
    if (h.length > 1) twice.push(`the ${item} is held ${h.length} times (${h.join(', ')})`);
    if (h.length === 0) missing.push(`the ${item} is held by nobody`);
  }
  const coins = coinsIn(snap);
  return { twice, missing, delta: coins - total, coins };
}

// A crash after each write of the script, recovery crashed after each of its own writes,
// then recovery, the client's retry and the rest of the script.
export function crashTrades({ world, script, trade, recover }) {
  const items = Object.entries(world).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('inv:')).flatMap(([, v]) => v);
  const total = coinsIn(world);
  const clean = createStore(world);
  const writesAfter = [];
  for (const request of script) {
    trade(clean, copy(request));
    writesAfter.push(clean.writes);
  }
  const t = { requests: script.length, writes: clean.writes, crashPoints: 0, recoveryPoints: 0, heldTwice: 0, missing: 0, coinsWrong: 0, coinsMoved: 0, broken: 0, first: null, unreached: [] };
  const requestAt = (g) => writesAfter.findIndex((w) => g <= w);
  const story = (g, m) => {
    const i = requestAt(g);
    const first = i > 0 ? writesAfter[i - 1] + 1 : 1;
    return `a crash after write ${g} of the script (write ${g - first + 1} of request ${i + 1}, ${describeRequest(script[i])})${m ? `, then recover crashed after its write ${m}` : ''}, then recover, the retry of request ${i + 1} and the rest of the script`;
  };

  // Runs the script until the crash; null when the crash never came.
  function upToCrash(g) {
    const store = createStore(world);
    store.crashAfter(g);
    for (const [i, request] of script.entries()) {
      try {
        trade(store, copy(request));
      } catch (error) {
        if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error;
        store.restart();
        return { store, at: i };
      }
      // A trade that caught the Crash and went on: the server died there all the same.
      if (store.writes >= g) { store.restart(); return { store, at: i }; }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function scenario(g, m) {
    const start = upToCrash(g);
    if (!start) { t.unreached.push(g); return; }
    const { store, at } = start;
    if (m) {
      store.crashAfter(m);
      try { recover(store); } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error; }
      store.restart();
    }
    recover(store);
    const afterRecovery = damage(store.snapshot(), items, total);
    for (const request of script.slice(at)) trade(store, copy(request));
    const atEnd = damage(store.snapshot(), items, total);
    const twice = [...new Set([...afterRecovery.twice, ...atEnd.twice])];
    const missing = [...new Set([...afterRecovery.missing, ...atEnd.missing])];
    const delta = afterRecovery.delta || atEnd.delta;
    t.heldTwice += twice.length;
    t.missing += missing.length;
    if (delta) { t.coinsWrong += 1; t.coinsMoved += Math.abs(delta); }
    if (twice.length || missing.length || delta) {
      t.broken += 1;
      if (!t.first) {
        const after = [...afterRecovery.twice, ...afterRecovery.missing, ...(afterRecovery.delta ? [`the coins add up to ${afterRecovery.coins}, not ${total}`] : [])];
        const end = [...atEnd.twice, ...atEnd.missing, ...(atEnd.delta ? [`the coins add up to ${atEnd.coins}, not ${total}`] : [])];
        t.first = { story: story(g, m), afterRecovery: after, atEnd: end };
      }
    }
  }

  for (let g = 1; g <= t.writes; g += 1) {
    t.crashPoints += 1;
    scenario(g, 0);
    // How many writes recovery makes from this crash, on a copy of the store.
    const start = upToCrash(g);
    if (!start) continue;
    const probe = createStore(start.store.snapshot());
    recover(probe);
    for (let m = 1; m <= probe.writes; m += 1) {
      t.recoveryPoints += 1;
      scenario(g, m);
    }
  }
  return t;
}

export function tradeVerdict(t) {
  return { pass: t.broken === 0 && t.unreached.length === 0, ...t };
}
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/checks/worker.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs one check case in its own process.
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { makeLoader, CheckFailure, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';

// "server/admission.mjs line 12" for the first stack line inside the project folder.
function whereInWork(error, workDir) {
  const roots = new Set([workDir, pathToFileURL(workDir).href]);
  try { const real = realpathSync(workDir); roots.add(real); roots.add(pathToFileURL(real).href); } catch { /* keep the given path */ }
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    for (const root of roots) {
      const i = line.indexOf(root);
      if (i < 0) continue;
      const m = line.slice(i + root.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${decodeURIComponent(m[1])} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

process.on('message', async ({ workDir, unit, caseId }) => {
  let result;
  try {
    const { cases } = await import(`./${unit}.mjs`);
    const c = cases.find(x => x.id === caseId);
    if (!c) throw Error(`checks/${unit}.mjs has no case ${caseId}`);
    await c.run({ ...makeLoader(workDir), workDir });
    result = { id: caseId, pass: true };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = String(error?.message ?? error);
    if (error instanceof CheckFailure) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'failure', fields: error.fields };
    else if (message.includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'not-written', message: message.split('\n')[0] };
    else result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${message.split('\n')[0]}`, where: whereInWork(error, workDir) };
  }
  try {
    process.send(result, (error) => process.exit(error ? 3 : 0));
  } catch (error) {
    // A field that cannot be sent (a BigInt, say) must not hide the outcome.
    process.send({ id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `the check's result could not be reported: ${error.message}` }, (error) => process.exit(error ? 3 : 0));
  }
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/admission-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 12 end checkpoint: server/admission.mjs with every walked-through region filled.
// examples/start-chapter.mjs copies it into a project as server/admission.mjs; there the
// import below reads ../../public/rules.mjs, one folder deeper.
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { INPUT_MAX_BYTES, ANGLE, POWER, SEQ } from '../public/rules.mjs';

const INPUT_KEYS = ['angle', 'fire', 'power', 'seq', 'v'];

export function parseInput(text) {
  // region: parse-shape
  if (typeof text !== 'string') return refuse('text');
  if (Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8') > INPUT_MAX_BYTES)
    return refuse('too-long');
  let value;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return refuse('json');
  }
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
    return refuse('object');
  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
  if (
    keys.length !== INPUT_KEYS.length ||
    keys.some((key, i) => key !== INPUT_KEYS[i])
  )
    return refuse('keys');
  // endregion: parse-shape
  // region: parse-values
  if (value.v !== 1) return refuse('version');
  if (!inRange(value.seq, SEQ)) return refuse('seq');
  if (!inRange(value.angle, ANGLE)) return refuse('angle');
  if (!inRange(value.power, POWER)) return refuse('power');
  if (typeof value.fire !== 'boolean') return refuse('fire');
  return {
    ok: true,
    input: {
      v: 1,
      seq: value.seq,
      angle: value.angle,
      power: value.power,
      fire: value.fire,
    },
  };
  // endregion: parse-values
}

// region: admit
export function admit(state, input, facts) {
  if (input.seq <= state.lastSeq)
    return { status: 'refused', reason: 'stale', next: state };
  if (facts.flying) return { status: 'refused', reason: 'flying', next: state };
  if (input.fire && state.firedRound === facts.round)
    return { status: 'refused', reason: 'fired', next: state };
  return {
    status: 'admitted',
    next: {
      lastSeq: input.seq,
      firedRound: input.fire ? facts.round : state.firedRound,
    },
  };
}
// endregion: admit

// region: in-range
function inRange(value, { min, max }) {
  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= min && value <= max;
}
// endregion: in-range

function refuse(reason) {
  return { ok: false, reason };
}
```

```mjs
// few flags in each: [kind, how many scores, how far its scores sit above the novices'].

function generated(seed, kinds) {

  const legal = [];
  for (const [kind, n, shift] of kinds)
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)

for (const seed of [11, 38])
  LISTS.push({
    name: `the generated list of seed ${seed} (novice 1500, skilled 2500, expert 1000 scores)`,
    budget: 0.002,
    legal: generated(seed, LARGE),
  });
// One kind too small for the budget to allow it a single flag, holding the highest scores.
LISTS.push({
  name: 'the generated list of seed 11 with a fourth kind, pro, of 100 scores above all the others',
  budget: 0.002,
  legal: generated(11, [...LARGE, ['pro', 100, 8]]),
});

// At threshold t: for each kind, how many of its scores are at or above t, of how many.
function shares(legal, t) {
  const byKind = new Map();
  for (const { kind, score } of legal) {
    const k = byKind.get(kind) ?? { at: 0, n: 0 };
    k.n++;
    if (score >= t) k.at++;
    byKind.set(kind, k);
  }
  return byKind;
}
const over = (legal, t, budget) =>
  [...shares(legal, t)].filter(([, k]) => k.at / k.n > budget);
// "expert scores 9, 8, 2, 1; skilled scores 0.5 (16 times); budget 0.25"
function said(legal, budget, name) {
  if (name) return `on ${name}, budget ${budget}, your function`;
  const kinds = [...new Set(legal.map((x) => x.kind))].map((kind) => {
    const scores = legal.filter((x) => x.kind === kind).map((x) => x.score);
    const same = scores.every((v) => v === scores[0]) && scores.length > 2;
    return `${kind} scores ${same ? `${scores[0]} (${scores.length} times)` : scores.join(', ')}`;
  });
  return `on ${kinds.length ? kinds.join('; ') : 'an empty list'}, budget ${budget}, your function`;
}

const results = [];
function report(name, problem) {
  results.push({ name, pass: !problem, detail: problem ?? '' });
  console.log(
    `${problem ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS'} ${name}${problem ? `\n     ${problem}` : ''}`,
  );
}
function attemptCase(name, run) {
  try {
    report(name, run());
  } catch (error) {
    report(name, `threw: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

attemptCase('returns one of the scores, or Infinity', () => {
  for (const { legal, budget, name } of LISTS) {
    const t = chooseThresholdByKind(copy(legal), budget);
    if (t !== Infinity && !legal.some((x) => x.score === t))
      return `${said(legal, budget, name)} returned ${JSON.stringify(t)}, which is not one of the scores`;
  }
});

attemptCase('at the threshold, every kind is within the budget', () => {
  for (const { legal, budget, name } of LISTS) {
    const t = chooseThresholdByKind(copy(legal), budget);
    const bad = over(legal, t, budget);
    if (bad.length)
      return `${said(legal, budget, name)} returned ${t}; at ${t}, ${bad.map(([kind, k]) => `${k.at} of ${k.n} ${kind} scores`).join(' and ')} are at or above it, more than ${budget} of the kind`;
  }
});

attemptCase('no smaller score keeps every kind within the budget', () => {
  for (const { legal, budget, name } of LISTS) {
    const t = chooseThresholdByKind(copy(legal), budget);
    // A higher threshold never flags more, so only the largest score below t need be tried.
    const below = legal.map((x) => x.score).filter((s) => s < t);
    const next = below.length ? Math.max(...below) : null;
    if (next !== null && !over(legal, next, budget).length)
      return `${said(legal, budget, name)} returned ${t}, but ${next} also keeps every kind within ${budget}, and it is smaller`;
  }
});

attemptCase('does not change the list it is given', () => {
  for (const { legal, budget, name } of LISTS) {
    const given = copy(legal);
    chooseThresholdByKind(given, budget);
    if (JSON.stringify(given) !== JSON.stringify(legal))
      return `${said(legal, budget, name)} changed its list`;
  }
});

const passed = results.filter((r) => r.pass).length;

// The dev split only, with your own detector as it stands: what the rule changes.
let dev = null;
if (passed === results.length) {
  try {
    const settings = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(join(project, 'detect', 'settings.json'), 'utf8'),
    );
    const { features } = await load('detect/features.mjs');
    const { score } = await load('detect/detector.mjs');
    if (typeof settings.threshold !== 'number')
      throw new Error('detect/settings.json has no threshold yet');
    const scored = makeCorpus({ split: 'dev' }).map((c) => ({
      kind: c.kind,
      label: c.label,
      score: score(
        features({ record: { inputs: c.record.inputs }, rounds: c.rounds }),
        settings,
      ),
    }));
    const legal = scored.filter((x) => x.label === 'legal');
    const cheats = scored.filter((x) => x.label === 'cheat');
    const byKind = chooseThresholdByKind(
      legal.map(({ kind, score: s }) => ({ kind, score: s })),
      settings.budget,
    );
    const line = (flag) =>
      `${legal.filter((x) => flag(x.score)).length} legal and ${cheats.filter((x) => flag(x.score)).length} of ${cheats.length} searcher sessions flagged`;
    // A threshold need not be one of the legal scores: anything above the highest of them
    // flags no legal session at all.
    const highest = Math.max(...legal.map((x) => x.score));
    dev = {
      threshold: settings.threshold,
      byKind: String(byKind),
      highestLegal: highest,
      atThreshold: line((s) => s >= settings.threshold),
      atByKind: line((s) => s >= byKind),
      aboveHighest: line((s) => s > highest),
    };
    console.log(
      `On the dev split, with your detector and budget ${settings.budget}:`,
    );
    console.log(`  your threshold ${settings.threshold}: ${dev.atThreshold}`);
    console.log(`  chooseThresholdByKind ${byKind}: ${dev.atByKind}`);
    console.log(
      `  any threshold above your highest legal score, ${highest}: ${dev.aboveHighest}`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.log(
      `(No dev split comparison: your detector did not run as it stands: ${error.message.split('\n')[0]})`,
    );
  }
}

saveReceipt({ results, dev });
console.log(`${passed} of ${results.length} cases pass.`);
console.log(saved());
process.exitCode = passed === results.length ? 0 : 1;
```

```mjs
// new folder under PROJECT/attempts/, then runs the files in PROJECT, and saves its results
// beside the copies. The

// A server with one session, driven message by message.
function scripted(seed) {
  const server = createLobServer({
    seed,
    admission,
    view: fullView,
    recorder: createRecorder,
  });
  const token = server.join();
  let seq = 0;
  return {
    send: (angle, power, fire) =>
      server.receive(
        token,
        JSON.stringify({ v: 1, seq: ++seq, angle, power, fire }),
      ),
    run: (ticks) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < ticks; i++) server.tick();
    },
    cut: () => ({
      record: server.record(token),
      state: { ...server.session(token).state },
    }),
  };
}

const cases = {
  'no message admitted yet': () => {
    const s = scripted(5);
    s.run(10);
    return s.cut();
  },
  'round 1 runs out unshot, round 2 has a shot, round 3 an aim': () => {
    const s = scripted(6);
    s.send(40, 60, false);
    s.run(205);
    s.send(45, 70, true);
    s.run(150);
    s.send(50, 55, false);
    s.run(5);
    return s.cut();
  },
  'cut while the shell is in the air': () => {
    const s = scripted(7);
    s.send(50, 65, true);
    s.run(8);
    return s.cut();
  },
  "a whole session of the expert, the record command's defaults": () => {
    const seed = 1;
    const server = createLobServer({
      seed,
      admission,
      view: fullView,
      recorder: createRecorder,
    });
    const net = PLAYER_KINDS.expert.network;
    const result = playSession({
      server,
      client: makePlayer('expert', mixSeed(seed, 2)),
      up: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 3), ...net }),
      down: link({ seed: mixSeed(seed, 4), ...net }),
    });
    return {
      record: server.record(result.token),
      state: { ...server.session(result.token).state },
    };
  },
};

const results = [];
function report(name, pass, detail) {
  results.push({ name, pass, detail });
  console.log(
    `${pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name}${detail ? `\n     ${detail}` : ''}`,
  );
}
function attemptCase(name, run) {
  try {
    run();
  } catch (error) {
    report(name, false, `threw: ${error.message}`);
  }
}
const show = (value) => JSON.stringify(value);
// Records are JSON, so a JSON round trip copies one completely.
const copy = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

let swapped = null;
for (const [name, make] of Object.entries(cases)) {
  attemptCase(name, () => {
    const { record, state } = make();
    if (name.startsWith('round 1')) swapped = copy(record);
    const checked = replay(copy(record), admission);
    if (!checked.ok)
      return report(
        name,
        false,
        `your replay refuses this genuine record (${show(checked)}); make unit 12 pass first`,
      );
    const yours = resumeState(copy(record), admission);
    const required = { ok: true, state };
    report(
      name,
      isDeepStrictEqual(yours, required),
      isDeepStrictEqual(yours, required)
        ? ''
        : `yours ${show(yours)}, required ${show(required)} (the server's state when the record was finished)`,
    );
  });
}

attemptCase('a record whose seqs do not go up', () => {
  if (!swapped) throw Error('the case it is built from did not run');
  [swapped.inputs[0].seq, swapped.inputs[1].seq] = [
    swapped.inputs[1].seq,
    swapped.inputs[0].seq,
  ];
  const required = replay(copy(swapped), admission);
  const yours = resumeState(copy(swapped), admission);
  report(
    'a record whose seqs do not go up',
    isDeepStrictEqual(yours, required),
    isDeepStrictEqual(yours, required)
      ? ''
      : `yours ${show(yours)}, required what your replay returns, ${show(required)}`,
  );
});

const passed = results.filter((r) => r.pass).length;
saveReceipt({ results });
console.log(`${passed} of ${results.length} cases pass.`);
console.log(saved());
process.exitCode = passed === results.length ? 0 : 1;
```

```mjs
// Cases for the new application in lesson 13: spectatorView in server/spectator.mjs.
// node examples/check-spectator.mjs PROJECT --help-used "what helped"
// Every run first copies your view, leaks and spectator files (and report.md, when there
// is one) into a new folder under PROJECT/attempts/, then runs the files in PROJECT, and
// saves its results beside the copies; node lab.mjs status PROJECT lists each run. The
// cases change the game on a copy and watch your message, so this checker holds no
// spectatorView of its own.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createLobSession } from '../public/session.mjs';
import { KEYS } from '../public/rules.mjs';

const [folder, flag, help] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!folder || flag !== '--help-used' || !help || process.argv.length !== 5) {
  console.error(
    'Usage: node examples/check-spectator.mjs PROJECT --help-used "what helped"',
  );
  process.exit(2);
}
const project = resolve(folder);
let identity = null;
try {
  identity = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(project, 'PROJECT.json'), 'utf8'));
} catch {
  // reported just below
}
if (identity?.course !== 'anti-cheat-engineering-part-two') {
  console.error(`${folder} is not a project of this course.`);
  process.exit(2);
}

const files = [
  'server/view.mjs',
  'server/leaks.mjs',
  'server/spectator.mjs',
  'report.md',
];
const attempt = join(
  project,
  'attempts',
  `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-spectator`,
);
mkdirSync(join(attempt, 'server'), { recursive: true });
for (const file of files)
  if (existsSync(join(project, file)))
    writeFileSync(join(attempt, file), readFileSync(join(project, file)));
function saveReceipt(fields) {
  writeFileSync(
    join(attempt, 'spectator-receipt.json'),
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        course: identity.course,
        unit13_start_route: identity.unit13_start_route ?? 'not recorded',
        help_used: help,
        ...fields,
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      null,
      2,
    ) + '\n',
  );
}
const saved = () =>
  `Saved this attempt in ${relative(process.cwd(), attempt) || '.'}.`;

// A file that cannot be loaded (it throws as it loads, or imports something that is not
// there) is a failed attempt like any other: it is saved with a receipt that status lists.
const loaded = {};
for (const file of ['server/view.mjs', 'server/spectator.mjs']) {
  try {
    loaded[file] = await import(pathToFileURL(join(project, file)).href);
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0];
    saveReceipt({ results: [], load_error: { file, reason } });
    console.log(`${file} could not be loaded, so no case ran: ${reason}`);
    console.log('0 cases pass.');
    console.log(saved());
    process.exitCode = 1;
    await new Promise((done) => process.stdout.write('', done));
    process.exit();
  }
}
const { drawnView } = loaded['server/view.mjs'];
const { spectatorView } = loaded['server/spectator.mjs'];

// Every 3rd tick of a scripted session of two rounds: aiming, a shot, its flight, the
// result, the next round's aiming and shot. Each moment is a copy of the game.
function moments(seed) {
  const session = createLobSession({ seed });
  const out = [];
  let seq = 0;
  const send = (angle, power, fire) =>
    session.apply({ v: 1, seq: ++seq, angle, power, fire });
  for (let tick = 0; tick < 260; tick++) {
    if (tick === 6) send(50, 40, false);
    if (tick === 12) send(52, 45, true);
    if (
      session.round === 2 &&
      session.facts().fired === false &&
      tick % 20 === 0
    )
      send(40 + (tick % 7), 60, tick % 40 === 0);
    if (tick % 3 === 0)
      out.push({
        game: session.game.clone(),
        info: { tick: session.tick, ack: seq },
      });
    session.step();
  }
  return out;
}

const results = [];
function report(name, problem) {
  results.push({ name, pass: !problem, detail: problem ?? '' });
  console.log(
    `${problem ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS'} ${name}${problem ? `\n     ${problem}` : ''}`,
  );
}
function attemptCase(name, run) {
  try {
    report(name, run());
  } catch (error) {
    report(name, `threw: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

const all = [...moments(31), ...moments(32)];
const at = ({ game, info }) =>
  `tick ${info.tick}, round ${game.round()}, ${game.flying() ? 'shell in the air' : 'no shell in the air'}`;
const AIM = ['RIGHT', 'LEFT', 'UP', 'DOWN'];

attemptCase('the same moment always gives the same bytes', () => {
  for (const m of all)
    if (
      JSON.stringify(spectatorView(m.game, m.info)) !==
      JSON.stringify(spectatorView(m.game.clone(), m.info))
    )
      return `two calls at ${at(m)} gave different bytes`;
});

attemptCase('every field but angle and power equals your drawnView', () => {
  for (const m of all) {
    const yours = spectatorView(m.game, m.info);
    const drawn = drawnView(m.game, m.info);
    const want = Object.keys(drawn);
    if (JSON.stringify(Object.keys(yours)) !== JSON.stringify(want))
      return `at ${at(m)} your fields are ${Object.keys(yours).join(', ')}; your drawnView's are ${want.join(', ')}`;
    for (const key of want) {
      if (key === 'angle' || key === 'power') continue;
      if (JSON.stringify(yours[key]) !== JSON.stringify(drawn[key]))
        return `at ${at(m)} ${key} is ${JSON.stringify(yours[key])}; your drawnView has ${JSON.stringify(drawn[key])}`;
    }
  }
});

attemptCase('while the shell is in the air, the aim is the shot', () => {
  const flying = all.filter((m) => m.game.flying());
  if (!flying.length) return 'the script had no moment with a shell in the air';
  for (const m of flying) {
    const yours = spectatorView(m.game, m.info);
    const want = [Math.round(m.game.angle()), m.game.power()];
    if (yours.angle !== want[0] || yours.power !== want[1])
      return `at ${at(m)} angle ${yours.angle} and power ${yours.power}; the shot was angle ${want[0]}, power ${want[1]}`;
  }
});

attemptCase('at every other moment, angle and power are both null', () => {
  const still = all.filter((m) => !m.game.flying());
  if (!still.length)
    return 'the script had no moment without a shell in the air';
  const show = (value) => JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value);
  for (const m of still) {
    const yours = spectatorView(m.game, m.info);
    if (yours.angle !== null || yours.power !== null)
      return `at ${at(m)}, angle is ${show(yours.angle)} and power is ${show(yours.power)}; with no shell in the air both must be null`;
  }
});

attemptCase(
  'at every other moment, a change of aim never reaches the message',
  () => {
    const still = all.filter((m) => !m.game.flying());
    for (const m of still) {
      const before = JSON.stringify(spectatorView(m.game, m.info));
      for (const key of AIM)
        for (let presses = 1; presses <= 3; presses++) {
          const copy = m.game.clone();
          for (let i = 0; i < presses; i++) copy.key(KEYS[key]);
          if (JSON.stringify(spectatorView(copy, m.info)) !== before)
            return `at ${at(m)}, ${presses} press${presses > 1 ? 'es' : ''} of ${key} changed your message`;
        }
    }
  },
);

attemptCase('no hidden thing reaches the message', () => {
  for (const m of all) {
    const before = JSON.stringify(spectatorView(m.game, m.info));
    for (const name of m.game.hidden)
      for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
        const copy = m.game.clone();
        if (
          copy.setHidden(name, k) &&
          JSON.stringify(spectatorView(copy, m.info)) !== before
        )
          return `at ${at(m)}, setHidden('${name}', ${k}) changed your message`;
      }
  }
});

const passed = results.filter((r) => r.pass).length;
saveReceipt({ results });
console.log(`${passed} of ${results.length} cases pass.`);
console.log(saved());
process.exitCode = passed === results.length ? 0 : 1;

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/check-swap.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cases for the new application in lesson 16: swap and recoverSwaps in trade/swap.mjs.
// node examples/check-swap.mjs PROJECT --help-used "what helped"
// Every run first copies your trade and swap files (and report.md, when there is one) into
// a new folder under PROJECT/attempts/, then runs the file in PROJECT, and saves its results
// beside the copies; node lab.mjs status PROJECT lists each run. Each case checks what the
// world looks like after your functions run, crashing the store after every write of a swap
// and of a recovery, so this checker holds no swap of its own.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createStore, Crash } from '../public/store.mjs';

const [folder, flag, help] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!folder || flag !== '--help-used' || !help || process.argv.length !== 5) {
  console.error(
    'Usage: node examples/check-swap.mjs PROJECT --help-used "what helped"',
  );
  process.exit(2);
}
const project = resolve(folder);
let identity = null;
try {
  identity = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(project, 'PROJECT.json'), 'utf8'));
} catch {
  // reported just below
}
if (identity?.course !== 'anti-cheat-engineering-part-two') {
  console.error(`${folder} is not a project of this course.`);
  process.exit(2);
}

const files = ['trade/trade.mjs', 'trade/swap.mjs', 'report.md'];
const attempt = join(
  project,
  'attempts',
  `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-swap`,
);
mkdirSync(join(attempt, 'trade'), { recursive: true });
for (const file of files)
  if (existsSync(join(project, file)))
    writeFileSync(join(attempt, file), readFileSync(join(project, file)));
function saveReceipt(fields) {
  writeFileSync(
    join(attempt, 'swap-receipt.json'),
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        course: identity.course,
        unit16_start_route: identity.unit16_start_route ?? 'not recorded',
        help_used: help,
        ...fields,
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      null,
      2,
    ) + '\n',
  );
}
const saved = () =>
  `Saved this attempt in ${relative(process.cwd(), attempt) || '.'}.`;

// A file that cannot be loaded (it throws as it loads, or imports something that is not
// there) is a failed attempt like any other: it is saved with a receipt that status lists.
const loaded = {};
for (const file of ['trade/swap.mjs']) {
  try {
    loaded[file] = await import(pathToFileURL(join(project, file)).href);
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0];
    saveReceipt({ writes: 0, results: [], load_error: { file, reason } });
    console.log(`${file} could not be loaded, so no case ran: ${reason}`);
    console.log('0 cases pass.');
    console.log(saved());
    process.exitCode = 1;
    await new Promise((done) => process.stdout.write('', done));
    process.exit();
  }
}
const { swap, recoverSwaps } = loaded['trade/swap.mjs'];

// Ana swaps her sword for Bo's bow; Cy holds a cap and has nothing to do with it.
const WORLD = {
  'inv:ana': ['sword', 'lamp'],
  'inv:bo': ['bow'],
  'inv:cy': ['cap'],
  'coins:ana': 20,
  'coins:bo': 100,
  'coins:cy': 60,
};
const SWAP = { key: 'swap-1', a: 'ana', b: 'bo', itemA: 'sword', itemB: 'bow' };
const RIVAL = {
  key: 'swap-2',
  a: 'ana',
  b: 'cy',
  itemA: 'sword',
  itemB: 'cap',
};
const copy = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

// What a world looks like to a player: each inventory as a sorted list, and the coins.
function belongings(store) {
  const out = {};
  for (const key of store.keys('inv:')) out[key] = [...store.get(key)].sort();
  for (const key of store.keys('coins:')) out[key] = store.get(key);
  return JSON.stringify(out);
}
// The world after the swap happened exactly once.
function swapped(world, { a, b, itemA, itemB }) {
  const after = copy(world);
  after[`inv:${a}`] = after[`inv:${a}`].filter((id) => id !== itemA);
  after[`inv:${b}`] = after[`inv:${b}`].filter((id) => id !== itemB);
  after[`inv:${a}`].push(itemB);
  after[`inv:${b}`].push(itemA);
  return belongings(createStore(after));
}
const BEFORE = belongings(createStore(WORLD));
const AFTER = swapped(WORLD, SWAP);
const ITEMS = Object.entries(WORLD)
  .filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('inv:'))
  .flatMap(([, items]) => items);
function holders(store, item) {
  return store.keys('inv:').flatMap((key) =>
    store
      .get(key)
      .filter((id) => id === item)
      .map(() => key.slice(4)),
  );
}
function itemsOnce(store) {
  for (const item of ITEMS) {
    const h = holders(store, item);
    if (h.length !== 1)
      return `the ${item} is held ${h.length ? `${h.length} times (${h.join(', ')})` : 'by nobody'}`;
  }
  return null;
}
const sameReceipt = (answer, request) =>
  answer?.ok === true &&
  ['key', 'a', 'b', 'itemA', 'itemB'].every(
    (k) => answer.receipt?.[k] === request[k],
  );
const shown = (answer) => JSON.stringify(answer) ?? 'nothing';
const swapText = (r) =>
  `${r.key}: ${r.a} gives ${r.b} the ${r.itemA} for the ${r.itemB}`;

const results = [];
function attemptCase(name, run) {
  let problem;
  try {
    problem = run();
  } catch (error) {
    problem = `threw ${error.name}: ${error.message.split('\n')[0]}`;
  }
  results.push({ name, pass: !problem, detail: problem ?? '' });
  console.log(
    `${problem ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS'} ${name}${problem ? `\n     ${problem}` : ''}`,
  );
}

// The run with no crash: how many writes a swap makes.
let writes = 0;
attemptCase('a swap with no crash', () => {
  const store = createStore(WORLD);
  const answer = swap(store, copy(SWAP));
  writes = store.writes;
  if (!sameReceipt(answer, SWAP))
    return `${swapText(SWAP)} answered ${shown(answer)}, not { ok: true } with the receipt { key, a, b, itemA, itemB }`;
  if (belongings(store) !== AFTER)
    return `after ${swapText(SWAP)} the inventories are ${belongings(store)}, not ${AFTER}`;
  if (writes < 1) return 'the swap wrote nothing';
});

attemptCase('a request sent again gets its receipt and writes nothing', () => {
  const store = createStore(WORLD);
  swap(store, copy(SWAP));
  const n = store.writes;
  const again = swap(store, copy(SWAP));
  if (!sameReceipt(again, SWAP))
    return `the same request sent again answered ${shown(again)}, not the receipt`;
  if (store.writes !== n)
    return `the same request sent again made ${store.writes - n} writes`;
});

attemptCase('refusals write nothing', () => {
  const cases = [
    [{ ...SWAP, b: 'ana', itemB: 'lamp' }, 'self'],
    [{ ...SWAP, itemA: 'cap' }, 'missing'],
    [{ ...SWAP, itemB: 'sword' }, 'missing'],
  ];
  for (const [request, reason] of cases) {
    const store = createStore(WORLD);
    const answer = swap(store, copy(request));
    if (answer?.ok !== false || answer.reason !== reason)
      return `${swapText(request)} answered ${shown(answer)}, not { ok: false, reason: '${reason}' }`;
    if (store.writes)
      return `${swapText(request)} was refused but made ${store.writes} writes`;
  }
  const store = createStore(WORLD);
  swap(store, copy(SWAP));
  const n = store.writes;
  const other = { ...SWAP, itemB: 'lamp' };
  const answer = swap(store, copy(other));
  if (answer?.ok !== false || answer.reason !== 'conflict')
    return `after ${swapText(SWAP)}, the same key with another body (${swapText(other)}) answered ${shown(answer)}, not { ok: false, reason: 'conflict' }`;
  if (store.writes !== n)
    return `the conflicting request made ${store.writes - n} writes`;
});

// A crash after write g of the swap, a restart and recoverSwaps (crashing it after write h of
// its own, then restarting and recovering again, when h is given), then the retry and the
// rival swap of the same sword to Cy.
function crashAt(g, h = null) {
  const store = createStore(WORLD);
  store.crashAfter(g);
  try {
    swap(store, copy(SWAP));
    return `a crash after write ${g}: your swap caught the Crash and went on, but a crashed server cannot answer`;
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error;
  }
  store.restart();
  const where = `a crash after write ${g} of the swap${h ? ` and after write ${h} of recoverSwaps` : ''}`;
  if (h) {
    // When recovery makes fewer than h writes, no crash comes, and the checks below run on
    // what it left.
    store.crashAfter(h);
    try {
      recoverSwaps(store);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Crash)) throw error;
    }
    store.restart();
  }
  recoverSwaps(store);
  const broken = itemsOnce(store);
  if (broken) return `after ${where} and recovery, ${broken}`;
  if (![BEFORE, AFTER].includes(belongings(store)))
    return `after ${where} and recovery, the swap is half made: ${belongings(store)}`;
  const retry = swap(store, copy(SWAP));
  if (!sameReceipt(retry, SWAP))
    return `after ${where}, recovery and the retry, the retry answered ${shown(retry)}, not the receipt`;
  if (belongings(store) !== AFTER)
    return `after ${where}, recovery and the retry, the swap has not happened exactly once: ${belongings(store)}`;
  const rival = swap(store, copy(RIVAL));
  if (rival?.ok !== false || rival.reason !== 'missing')
    return `after ${where}, recovery and the retry, ${swapText(RIVAL)} answered ${shown(rival)}, not missing: the sword is now ${holders(store, 'sword').join(', ')}'s`;
  return null;
}

attemptCase(
  'a crash after every write of the swap, then recovery and the retry',
  () => {
    if (!writes)
      return 'the swap with no crash did not run, so there is nothing to crash';
    for (let g = 1; g <= writes; g++) {
      const problem = crashAt(g);
      if (problem) return problem;
    }
  },
);

attemptCase('a crash during recovery, then recovery again', () => {
  if (!writes)
    return 'the swap with no crash did not run, so there is nothing to crash';
  for (let g = 1; g <= writes; g++)
    for (let h = 1; h <= writes; h++) {
      const problem = crashAt(g, h);
      if (problem) return problem;
    }
});

const passed = results.filter((r) => r.pass).length;
saveReceipt({ writes, results });
console.log(
  `${passed} of ${results.length} cases pass${writes ? `; your swap makes ${writes} writes, so ${writes} crash points` : ''}.`,
);
console.log(saved());
process.exitCode = passed === results.length ? 0 : 1;
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/courier-row.mjs`:

```mjs
// Read one row of the scoreboard, the courier, from capstone/defence.json to the budget lines
// it prints, with the scoreboard's own functions (checks/scoreboard.mjs) and seeds
// (labcmds/17.mjs). Nothing here is new machinery: it calls what node lab.mjs scoreboard calls.
// node examples/courier-row.mjs PROJECT           your window, from capstone/defence.json
// node examples/courier-row.mjs PROJECT WINDOW    another window, for comparison
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { makeLoader } from '../checks/harness.mjs';
import * as sb from '../checks/scoreboard.mjs';
import { SEEDS, DEFAULTS } from '../labcmds/17.mjs';

const [folder, given] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!folder || process.argv.length > 4) {
  console.log('Usage: node examples/courier-row.mjs PROJECT [WINDOW]');
  process.exit(2);
}
const project = resolve(folder);
if (!existsSync(join(project, 'PROJECT.json'))) {
  console.log(`${folder} is not a project folder.`);
  process.exit(2);
}
const percent = (x) => `${(100 * x).toFixed(2)}%`;
// A file that is not written yet, or a function that throws, stops the tour with one line.
function stop(error) {
  console.log(String(error?.fields?.observed ?? error?.message).split('\n')[0]);
  process.exit(1);
}

// region: read-window
const loader = makeLoader(project);
let window;
if (given === undefined) {
  let defence;
  try {
    defence = loader.json(sb.FILES.defence);
  } catch (error) {
    stop(error);
  }
  const read = sb.windowOf(defence);
  if (read.problem) {
    console.log(read.problem);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  window = read.window;
  console.log(`${sb.FILES.defence}: rewindWindow ${window}`);
} else {
  window = Number(given);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(window) || window < 0)
    stop(
      new Error(`WINDOW is a whole number of ticks, 0 or more, not ${given}`),
    );
  console.log(
    `window ${window}, given on the command line (${sb.FILES.defence} is not read)`,
  );
}
// endregion: read-window

// region: play-courier
const rewind = await sb.loadRewind(loader).catch(stop);
const courier = sb.courierAt({
  seed: SEEDS.courier,
  sessions: DEFAULTS.courier,
  window,
  rewind,
});
console.log(
  `runCourier seed ${SEEDS.courier}, ${DEFAULTS.courier} sessions per model, window ${window}, your rewind functions:`,
);
console.log(
  `  honest       ${courier.honest} presses, ${courier.honestRefused} refused although in range at seen`,
);
console.log(
  `  naive faker  ${courier.naive} presses, ${courier.naiveAccepted} accepted while not in range now`,
);
console.log(
  `  slow-pong    ${courier.slow} presses, ${courier.slowAccepted} accepted while not in range now`,
);
// endregion: play-courier

// region: verdict
const verdict = sb.courierVerdict(courier);
for (const [what, part, budget] of [
  ['honest presses refused', verdict.honest, sb.BUDGET.honestRefused],
  ["the naive faker's lies accepted", verdict.naive, sb.BUDGET.naiveAccepted],
])
  console.log(
    `  ${part.pass ? 'PASS' : 'MISS'}  ${what}: ${percent(part.rate)}, at most ${percent(budget)} allowed`,
  );
// endregion: verdict

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/crash-output.txt`:

```txt
Crash test: your trade and recover.
  start: ana [sword lamp] 20, bo [bow] 100, cy [cap] 60 (coins 180)
  script: 1. sale-1: ana sells bo the sword for 40; 2. sale-2: ana sells cy the sword for 30
  without a crash: sale-1 ok, sale-2 missing; 6 writes in all, so 6 crash points.
  At each crash point the server restarts, runs your recover, and the client sends the interrupted request again.
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/detector-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 14, end-of-unit checkpoint: detect/detector.mjs, as lesson 14 walks through it.
// Its score is the lesson's worked example and uses one feature, hitRate. It shows the
// shape of a score; it is not a detector to hand in. Which features your score uses, and
// how it combines them, is your own design (lesson 14, "Your score").
import { features as sessionFeatures } from './features-checkpoint.mjs';

// region: robust-z
function robustZ(value, { transform, direction, median, scale, cap }) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return 0;
  const x = transform === 'log' ? Math.log1p(value) : value;
  const z = (direction * (x - median)) / scale;
  return Math.min(cap, Math.max(-cap, z));
}
// endregion: robust-z

// region: score
export function score(features, settings) {
  return robustZ(features.hitRate, settings.features.hitRate);
}
// endregion: score

// region: choose-threshold
export function chooseThreshold(legalScores, budget) {
  const sorted = [...legalScores].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (i > 0 && sorted[i] === sorted[i - 1]) continue;
    if ((n - i) / n <= budget) return sorted[i];
  }
  return Infinity;
}
// endregion: choose-threshold

// region: count
export function count(decisions) {
  let tp = 0;
  let fp = 0;
  let tn = 0;
  let fn = 0;
  for (const { label, flagged } of decisions) {
    if (label === 'cheat') {
      if (flagged) tp++;
      else fn++;
    } else if (flagged) fp++;
    else tn++;
  }
  return {
    total: decisions.length,
    tp,
    fp,
    tn,
    fn,
    recall: tp + fn ? tp / (tp + fn) : null,
    falsePositiveRate: fp + tn ? fp / (fp + tn) : null,
    precision: tp + fp ? tp / (tp + fp) : null,
  };
}
// endregion: count

// region: evaluate
export function evaluate(cases, settings) {
  return count(
    cases.map((c) => ({
      label: c.label,
      flagged: score(sessionFeatures(c), settings) >= settings.threshold,
    })),
  );
}
// endregion: evaluate

// region: precision-at
export function precisionAt(baseRate, recall, fpr) {
  const denominator = baseRate * recall + (1 - baseRate) * fpr;
  return denominator === 0 ? null : (baseRate * recall) / denominator;
}
// endregion: precision-at

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/features-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 14, end-of-unit checkpoint: detect/features.mjs, as lesson 14 walks through it.
// One session's features, from its play alone: record.inputs and rounds (API.md, "features").
import { median, quantile, mean, sd, correlation } from '../public/stats.mjs';

// region: features
export function features({ record, rounds }) {
  const shotRounds = rounds.filter((r) => r.shot !== null);
  const shots = shotRounds.length;
  const hits = shotRounds.filter((r) => r.result === 'hit').length;
  const fireTimes = shotRounds.map((r) => r.shot.tick - r.start);
  return {
    shots,
    hitRate: shots ? hits / shots : null,
    missMedian: median(shotRounds.map((r) => Math.abs(r.miss))),
    fireMedian: median(fireTimes),
    fireSpread: shots
      ? quantile(fireTimes, 0.75) - quantile(fireTimes, 0.25)
      : null,
    inputsMedian: median(shotRounds.map((r) => r.inputs)),
    cadenceCV: cadenceCV(record.inputs, rounds),
    missLag1: missLag1(rounds),
  };
}
// endregion: features

// region: cadence-cv
function cadenceCV(inputs, rounds) {
  const gaps = [];
  let previous = null;
  for (const input of inputs) {
    const round = roundAt(rounds, input.tick);
    if (previous && previous.round === round)
      gaps.push(input.tick - previous.tick);
    previous = { round, tick: input.tick };
  }
  if (gaps.length < 5) return null;
  const m = mean(gaps);
  return m > 0 ? sd(gaps) / m : null;
}

function roundAt(rounds, tick) {
  let found = null;
  for (const r of rounds) if (r.start <= tick) found = r.round;
  return found;
}
// endregion: cadence-cv

// region: miss-lag1
function missLag1(rounds) {
  const xs = [];
  const ys = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < rounds.length; i++) {
    const a = rounds[i];
    const b = rounds[i + 1];
    if (a.shot && b.shot && b.round === a.round + 1) {
      xs.push(a.miss);
      ys.push(b.miss);
    }
  }
  return xs.length < 4 ? null : correlation(xs, ys);
}
// endregion: miss-lag1

```

```mjs
// Unit 13 end checkpoint: server/leaks.mjs with its walked-through region filled.
// examples/start-unit13.mjs copies it into a project as server/leaks.mjs.

// region: find-leaks
export function findLeaks(viewFn, game, info) {
  const before = JSON.stringify(viewFn(game, info));
  const leaking = [];
  for (const name of game.hidden) {
    for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
      const copy = game.clone();
      const changed = copy.setHidden(name, k);
      if (changed && JSON.stringify(viewFn(copy, info)) !== before) {
        leaking.push(name);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return leaking.sort();
}
// endregion: find-leaks
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering-part-two/examples/moments.mjs`:

```mjs
// Three moments of one scripted Lob session, for the unit 13 probes: aiming before the
// first shot, the shell in the air, and just after it lands. Each is { label, game, info }.
import { createLobSession } from '../public/session.mjs';

export function moments() {
  const session = createLobSession({ seed: 7 });
  const at = (label) => ({
    label,
    game: session.game.clone(),
    info: { tick: session.tick, ack: 1 },
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) session.step();
  session.apply({ v: 1, seq: 1, angle: 60, power: 35, fire: false });
  session.step();
  const aiming = at('aiming');
  session.apply({ v: 1, seq: 2, angle: 60, power: 35, fire: true });
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) session.step();
  const flying = at('in flight');
  while (session.game.flying()) session.step();
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) session.step();
  const landed = at('landed');
  for (const m of [flying, landed]) m.info.ack = 2;
  return [aiming, flying, landed];
}
```
