# Capstone author and integration notes

The new resource rule is independent of the existing Courier movement and scoring rules. It uses an owned local HTTP adapter with real requests. `policy.mjs` exports synchronous `repair(state,actorId,{requestId,stationId}) -> {reason,receipt,state}`. `state.mjs` defines the validated initial state and two-station configuration. Policy decision order and fields are pinned in `prompt.json` and `LEARNER.md`.

Learner preparation includes only `template.mjs` renamed to `capstone/policy.mjs`, `scenario-template.mjs` renamed to `capstone/scenario.mjs`, `client.mjs`, the exact prompt, learner guide and response template. Never copy `policy.mjs`, `author-scenario.mjs`, controls or fixtures as learner source. The source is an actual two-file exercise; written responses remain separate and ungraded.

Shared-runner extension required (owned by integration): descriptor fields `scenario:'capstone/scenario.mjs'`, `scenarioTemplate:'capstone/scenario-template.mjs'`, `client:'capstone/client.mjs'`; scaffold the scenario template and client; require captured policy and scenario; import only the captured policy in the core worker and call `fixtures.assess({...policyModule,policyPath,scenarioPath})`. Both paths must be absolute paths inside the captured execution tree. Do not import the scenario in the core worker. Preserve hashes and provenance for both sources and any captured relative helpers; verify the supplied client remains unchanged. Existing single-file descriptors continue unchanged. Prompt version 4 clarifies response-first assertions and incomplete-check evidence; version 3 added the expanded behavioral panel and removed the former assertion-dataflow claim; existing frozen prompts/attempts are not rewritten.

APIs:

- `server.mjs`: `createRepairServer({policy=repair,requestAdapter=adaptRequest}={})` provides `base,moveActor,snapshot,record,observation,activity,close`; `withRepairServer(exercise,options)` always closes it. It binds ephemeral loopback only. `moveActor(id,{x,y})` is a direct owner control limited to integer coordinates within ±10000; no HTTP route sets position or resources. `snapshot()` and `record()` return detached copies. Owner-only response observations match opaque response IDs to actual returned state; activity counts state reads and repair requests. Trace entries omit transport tokens. Policy application is synchronous between request-body completion and state commit; no async policy is supported.
- `adaptRequest(state,actorId,body) -> {state,request}` validates exact two-field bodies with 1–40 character IDs using letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Adapter injection exists only for the author calibration that accepts forbidden claims.
- `client.mjs`: `request(base,path,options)`, `session(base)`, `state(base,token)`, `submit(base,token,body)` are learner-safe HTTP plumbing. Only plain `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` origins are accepted. Network/runtime exceptions are distinct from assertion failures.
- `fixtures.mjs`: `cases()` returns independently keyed pure cases, including two actors using the same ID and an independent receipt capacity; `assessPolicy(candidate)` checks just the policy. `runScenario(scenarioPath,{variant='reference',policyPath,timeout=1000,deadline})` returns `{status,activity,trace,traceDropped,error?,exit}` after a fresh child process closes. Named variants come from the immutable control list; `submitted` imports the supplied absolute policy path. Async `assess({repair,policyPath,scenarioPath})` checks the submitted pair, two correct controls and thirteen wrong variants. Its absolute 8-second whole-panel deadline also bounds each active child's timer and reaps that child before proceeding. These limits constrain the teaching runner and make no production performance claim. Failure details preserve expected, actual and a teaching pointer.
- `scenario-worker.mjs` is a trusted owner module. Each worker imports a fresh captured scenario/module graph and hosts one loopback server. It accepts only genuine `assert.AssertionError` failures, requires a repair and a state read from completed successful runs, and clears the variant/path arguments before importing learner code. The full panel establishes finite behavioral discrimination; it does not prove assertion dataflow. Strings-only plus incidental debug reads misses three isolated resource controls. Native assertion imports, callable assertions, JSON, sorting and cloning are unmodified, and assertion order has no grading significance. Workers share the core worker process group and exit on parent IPC disconnect; the parent owns group cleanup after every outcome. Self-detaching descendants remain outside that boundary. This is not an OS sandbox.
- `runScenario` preserves the first 4096 output bytes and native expected/actual assertion evidence. Timeout, worker exit without a result, output overflow and panel-budget exhaustion are runner failures. `assess` throws `ScenarioRunnerError` so the core runner records an incomplete check rather than a completed learner behavior result. Learner code can cause a timeout; this verdict does not diagnose infrastructure. The error retains completed criteria and bounded per-variant diagnostics under `input`. Neither runtime nor runner failures detect wrong variants.
- `author-cold-clone-scenario.mjs` is an unchanged, authorized cold-learner source snapshot retained only as an author regression fixture, never a prepared learner solution.
- `controls.mjs`: two independently structured correct policies and fifteen wrong policies, of which twelve have reachable HTTP differences from the declared initial session. Partial-top-up, input-mutation and returned-alias controls are pure-fixture checks. An additional adapter control accepts client claims. Isolated wrong controls add only two energy, alter only the receipt balance, or debit on a range refusal. `author-scenario.mjs` is a completed author-only calibration scenario.

Sessions begin at energy 4 and credits 6. Repairs cost 2, add up to 3 energy and cap at 10. The radius is 400 mm and capacity is two successful receipts per actor. Bound exhaustion refuses new IDs without eviction; old retries are still resolved before other checks. HTTP 200 returns rule decisions, 400 rejects a dedicated `RequestRejection` from malformed bodies, and 401 rejects missing/unknown session tokens. A policy exception returns 500 `policy-failure` and its error name; it does not become a malformed-request error or commit state. At most eight sessions, 256 HTTP requests and 4096 request-body bytes are accepted per server run. This is not durable storage, a production authorization service or an OS sandbox.

Run from the project directory:

```sh
node --test tests/capstone.test.mjs
```

The printer design is an ungraded transfer prompt (`assessment-02`, `assessment-15`). Automated success is not human learning evidence (`evaluation-01`). Shared runner integration, page/render checks and independent cold-reader review remain parent acceptance work.

## Review repairs, 2026-10-16

Opus F1/F2 showed that getter reads could count unrelated assertions while legitimate early failures lost credit. The replacement removes the observer instead of maintaining an assertion-language subset. Regression checks reproduce status-only plus debug reads, both assertion orders, loose and callable assertions, in-place sorting, native diffs, and unchanged cold-learner cloning. Four multi-failure pure cases pin station → history → range → full → funds (F4). F6 distinguishes request rejection, policy exceptions and runner resource failures. These changes address `assessment-09`, `projects-03` and `feedback-07`; a pass remains bounded evidence about the declared cases.

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/capstone/author-cold-clone-scenario.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { request, session, submit, state } from './client.mjs';

export async function scenario({ base, moveActor }) {
  function actorIn(snapshot, id) {
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(snapshot.actors), 'state exposes the documented actors array');
    const actor = snapshot.actors.find(candidate => candidate.id === id);
    assert.ok(actor, 'the authenticated actor is present');
    return actor;
  }

  async function repaired(owner, receipt) {
    const before = await state(base, owner.token);
    const expected = structuredClone(before);
    const actor = actorIn(expected, owner.id);
    actor.energy = receipt.energy;
    actor.credits = receipt.credits;
    actor.receipts.push(receipt);
    const result = await submit(base, owner.token, {
      requestId: receipt.requestId,
      stationId: receipt.stationId,
    });
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.data.reason, 'repaired');
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.receipt, receipt);
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.state, expected);
    assert.deepEqual(await state(base, owner.token), expected);
  }

  async function unchanged(owner, body, reason, receipt = null) {
    const before = await state(base, owner.token);
    const result = await submit(base, owner.token, body);
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.data.reason, reason);
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.receipt, receipt);
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.state, before);
    assert.deepEqual(await state(base, owner.token), before);
  }

  const a = await session(base);
  await moveActor(a.id, { x: 400, y: 0 });
  const initialA = actorIn(await state(base, a.token), a.id);
  assert.equal(initialA.energy, 4);
  assert.equal(initialA.credits, 6);
  assert.deepEqual(initialA.receipts, []);
  const firstReceipt = {
    requestId: 'first-repair', stationId: 'alpha', energyAdded: 3,
    creditsSpent: 2, energy: 7, credits: 4,
  };
  await repaired(a, firstReceipt);

  await moveActor(a.id, { x: 2400, y: 1000 });
  await unchanged(a, { requestId: 'first-repair', stationId: 'alpha' }, 'duplicate', firstReceipt);
  await unchanged(a, { requestId: 'first-repair', stationId: 'beta' }, 'conflict');

  await moveActor(a.id, { x: 0, y: 0 });
  await repaired(a, {
    requestId: 'second-repair', stationId: 'alpha', energyAdded: 3,
    creditsSpent: 2, energy: 10, credits: 2,
  });
  await unchanged(a, { requestId: 'third-repair', stationId: 'alpha' }, 'history-full');
  await unchanged(a, { requestId: 'first-repair', stationId: 'alpha' }, 'duplicate', firstReceipt);

  const b = await session(base);
  await moveActor(b.id, { x: 300, y: 300 });
  await unchanged(b, { requestId: 'retry-after-range', stationId: 'alpha' }, 'range');
  await moveActor(b.id, { x: 0, y: 0 });
  await repaired(b, {
    requestId: 'retry-after-range', stationId: 'alpha', energyAdded: 3,
    creditsSpent: 2, energy: 7, credits: 4,
  });

  const c = await session(base);
  await moveActor(c.id, { x: 0, y: 0 });
  const beforeInvalid = await state(base, c.token);
  const injected = await submit(base, c.token, {
    requestId: 'client-claims', stationId: 'alpha', actorId: a.id,
    x: 0, y: 0, energy: 10, credits: 999, price: 0, score: 999,
  });
  assert.equal(injected.status, 400);
  assert.deepEqual(await state(base, c.token), beforeInvalid);

  const missingToken = await request(base, '/repair', {
    method: 'POST', json: { requestId: 'unauthenticated', stationId: 'alpha' },
  });
  assert.equal(missingToken.status, 401);
  const unknownToken = await request(base, '/state', { token: 'not-a-real-session-token' });
  assert.equal(unknownToken.status, 401);
  assert.deepEqual(await state(base, c.token), beforeInvalid);

  await unchanged(c, { requestId: 'missing-station', stationId: 'unknown-station' }, 'station');
  await repaired(c, {
    requestId: 'first-repair', stationId: 'alpha', energyAdded: 3,
    creditsSpent: 2, energy: 7, credits: 4,
  });
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { request, session, submit, state } from './client.mjs';

const actor = (world, id) => world.actors.find((item) => item.id === id);
const balances = (world, id) => {
  const { energy, credits, receipts } = actor(world, id);
  return { energy, credits, receipts };
};

/** Author calibration only. Never copy this completed scenario to a learner. */
export async function scenario({ base, moveActor }) {
  const player = await session(base);
  const body = { requestId: 'retry', stationId: 'alpha' };
  moveActor(player.id, { x: 800, y: 0 });
  const far = await state(base, player.token);
  const failed = await submit(base, player.token, body);
  assert.equal(failed.status, 200);
  assert.equal(failed.data.reason, 'range');
  assert.deepEqual(failed.data.state, far);
  moveActor(player.id, { x: 399, y: 0 });
  const first = await submit(base, player.token, body);
  assert.equal(first.data.reason, 'repaired');
  assert.deepEqual(first.data.receipt, { ...body, energyAdded: 3, creditsSpent: 2, energy: 7, credits: 4 });
  assert.deepEqual(balances(first.data.state, player.id), { energy: 7, credits: 4, receipts: [first.data.receipt] });
  moveActor(player.id, { x: 900, y: 0 });
  const beforeRetry = await state(base, player.token);
  const retry = await submit(base, player.token, body);
  assert.equal(retry.data.reason, 'duplicate');
  assert.deepEqual(retry.data.receipt, first.data.receipt);
  assert.deepEqual(retry.data.state, beforeRetry);
  const conflict = await submit(base, player.token, { ...body, stationId: 'beta' });
  assert.equal(conflict.data.reason, 'conflict');
  assert.deepEqual(conflict.data.state, beforeRetry);
  moveActor(player.id, { x: 400, y: 0 });
  const second = await submit(base, player.token, { requestId: 'second', stationId: 'alpha' });
  assert.equal(second.data.reason, 'repaired');
  assert.deepEqual([actor(second.data.state, player.id).energy, actor(second.data.state, player.id).credits], [10, 2]);
  const beforeFull = await state(base, player.token);
  const full = await submit(base, player.token, { requestId: 'third', stationId: 'alpha' });
  assert.equal(full.data.reason, 'history-full');
  assert.deepEqual(full.data.state, beforeFull);
  assert.deepEqual((await submit(base, player.token, body)).data.receipt, first.data.receipt);

  const other = await session(base);
  moveActor(other.id, { x: 300, y: 300 });
  const diagonal = await state(base, other.token);
  const outside = await submit(base, other.token, { requestId: 'diagonal', stationId: 'alpha' });
  assert.equal(outside.data.reason, 'range');
  assert.deepEqual(outside.data.state, diagonal);
  moveActor(other.id, { x: 0, y: 0 });
  const unknown = await submit(base, other.token, { requestId: 'unknown', stationId: 'missing' });
  assert.equal(unknown.data.reason, 'station');
  assert.equal(actor(unknown.data.state, other.id).receipts.length, 0);
  const beforeClaim = await state(base, other.token);
  const claimed = await submit(base, other.token, { requestId: 'claims', stationId: 'alpha', x: 0, y: 0, energy: 1, credits: 100 });
  assert.equal(claimed.status, 400);
  assert.deepEqual(await state(base, other.token), beforeClaim);
  const independent = await submit(base, other.token, body);
  assert.equal(independent.data.reason, 'repaired');
  assert.deepEqual([actor(independent.data.state, other.id).energy, actor(independent.data.state, other.id).credits], [7, 4]);
  assert.equal((await request(base, '/repair', { method: 'POST', json: body })).status, 401);
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/capstone/client.mjs`:

```mjs
import http from 'node:http';

/** Learner-safe HTTP plumbing. Assertions belong in your scenario. */
export function request(base, path, { method = 'GET', token, json } = {}) {
  const endpoint = new URL(base);
  if (endpoint.protocol !== 'http:' || endpoint.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' || endpoint.username || endpoint.password || endpoint.pathname !== '/' || endpoint.search || endpoint.hash) throw new Error('Use the owned loopback HTTP origin.');
  const body = json === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(json);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const headers = {};
    if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    if (body !== undefined) Object.assign(headers, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) });
    const req = http.request({ hostname: endpoint.hostname, port: endpoint.port, path, method, headers }, (res) => {
      const chunks = [];
      let length = 0;
      res.on('data', (chunk) => {
        length += chunk.length;
        if (length > 262144) return res.destroy(new Error('Response exceeded the lab byte bound.'));
        chunks.push(chunk);
      });
      res.on('error', reject);
      res.on('end', () => {
        const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
        let data;
        try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = null; }
        resolve({ status: res.statusCode, data });
      });
    });
    req.setTimeout(2000, () => req.destroy(new Error('Loopback request timed out.')));
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.end(body);
  });
}

export async function session(base) {
  const response = await request(base, '/session', { method: 'POST', json: {} });
  if (response.status !== 201) throw new Error(`Session failed: HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  return response.data;
}

export const submit = (base, token, requestBody) => request(base, '/repair', { method: 'POST', token, json: requestBody });

export async function state(base, token) {
  const response = await request(base, '/state', { token });
  if (response.status !== 200) throw new Error(`State failed: HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  return response.data;
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/capstone/controls.mjs`:

```mjs
import { adaptRequest } from './server.mjs';

function queuePolicy(state, actorId, request) {
  const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
  const actor = next.actors.filter((item) => item.id === actorId)[0];
  const old = actor.receipts.filter((item) => item.requestId === request.requestId)[0];
  const reply = (reason, receipt = null) => ({ reason, receipt, state: next });
  if (old) return reply(old.stationId === request.stationId ? 'duplicate' : 'conflict', old.stationId === request.stationId ? old : null);
  const station = next.stations.filter((item) => item.id === request.stationId)[0];
  if (!station) return reply('station');
  if (actor.receipts.length === next.config.receiptLimit) return reply('history-full');
  if ((actor.x - station.x) ** 2 + (actor.y - station.y) ** 2 > next.config.rangeMm ** 2) return reply('range');
  if (actor.energy === next.config.energyCap) return reply('full');
  if (actor.credits < next.config.repairCost) return reply('funds');
  const energy = Math.min(actor.energy + next.config.repairEnergy, next.config.energyCap);
  const receipt = { requestId: request.requestId, stationId: request.stationId, energyAdded: energy - actor.energy, creditsSpent: next.config.repairCost, energy, credits: actor.credits - next.config.repairCost };
  Object.assign(actor, { energy, credits: receipt.credits, receipts: [...actor.receipts, receipt] });
  return reply('repaired', receipt);
}

function transactionPolicy(state, actorId, request) {
  const actor = state.actors.find((item) => item.id === actorId);
  const old = actor.receipts.find((item) => item.requestId === request.requestId);
  const station = state.stations.find((item) => item.id === request.stationId);
  let reason = 'repaired';
  if (old) reason = old.stationId === request.stationId ? 'duplicate' : 'conflict';
  if (!old && !station) reason = 'station';
  if (!old && station && actor.receipts.length >= state.config.receiptLimit) reason = 'history-full';
  if (reason === 'repaired' && Math.hypot(actor.x - station.x, actor.y - station.y) > state.config.rangeMm) reason = 'range';
  if (reason === 'repaired' && actor.energy >= state.config.energyCap) reason = 'full';
  if (reason === 'repaired' && actor.credits < state.config.repairCost) reason = 'funds';
  const next = structuredClone(state);
  if (reason === 'duplicate') return { reason, receipt: structuredClone(old), state: next };
  if (reason !== 'repaired') return { reason, receipt: null, state: next };
  const updated = next.actors.find((item) => item.id === actorId);
  const energyAdded = Math.min(state.config.repairEnergy, state.config.energyCap - actor.energy);
  updated.energy += energyAdded;
  updated.credits -= state.config.repairCost;
  const receipt = { requestId: request.requestId, stationId: request.stationId, energyAdded, creditsSpent: state.config.repairCost, energy: updated.energy, credits: updated.credits };
  updated.receipts = updated.receipts.concat(receipt);
  return { reason, receipt, state: next };
}

export const correctPolicies = [
  { name: 'copied bounded receipt queue', repair: queuePolicy },
  { name: 'decide before copying transaction', repair: transactionPolicy },
];
const actorIn = (state, id) => state.actors.find((actor) => actor.id === id);
const failure = (state, reason) => ({ reason, receipt: null, state: structuredClone(state) });

export const wrongPolicies = [
  { name: 'duplicate charged again', intended: 'original receipt', repair(state, id, request) {
    const copy = structuredClone(state);
    actorIn(copy, id).receipts = actorIn(copy, id).receipts.filter((receipt) => receipt.requestId !== request.requestId);
    return queuePolicy(copy, id, request);
  } },
  { name: 'range checked before receipt', intended: 'retry after movement', repair(state, id, request) {
    const actor = actorIn(state, id);
    const station = state.stations.find((item) => item.id === request.stationId);
    if (station && Math.hypot(actor.x - station.x, actor.y - station.y) > state.config.rangeMm) return failure(state, 'range');
    return queuePolicy(state, id, request);
  } },
  { name: 'conflict treated as duplicate', intended: 'station conflict', repair(state, id, request) {
    const old = actorIn(state, id).receipts.find((receipt) => receipt.requestId === request.requestId);
    return queuePolicy(state, id, old ? { ...request, stationId: old.stationId } : request);
  } },
  { name: 'failed ID reserved', intended: 'failed request changes nothing', repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason !== 'range') return result;
    const actor = actorIn(result.state, id);
    actor.receipts.push({ ...request, energyAdded: 0, creditsSpent: 0, energy: actor.energy, credits: actor.credits });
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'exclusive distance boundary', intended: 'inclusive range edge', repair(state, id, request) {
    const actor = actorIn(state, id);
    const station = state.stations.find((item) => item.id === request.stationId);
    if (station && Math.hypot(actor.x - station.x, actor.y - station.y) === state.config.rangeMm) return failure(state, 'range');
    return queuePolicy(state, id, request);
  } },
  { name: 'one-credit repair', intended: 'successful resource transaction', repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason !== 'repaired') return result;
    actorIn(result.state, id).credits += 1;
    result.receipt.creditsSpent = 1;
    result.receipt.credits += 1;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'two-energy repair', intended: 'successful resource transaction', repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason !== 'repaired') return result;
    actorIn(result.state, id).energy -= 1;
    result.receipt.energyAdded -= 1;
    result.receipt.energy -= 1;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'wrong receipt balance', intended: 'successful resource transaction', repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason === 'repaired') result.receipt.energy += 1;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'range refusal debits credit', intended: 'failed request changes nothing', repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason === 'range') actorIn(result.state, id).credits -= 1;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'evict oldest receipt', intended: 'history bound', repair(state, id, request) {
    const copy = structuredClone(state);
    const actor = actorIn(copy, id);
    if (actor.receipts.length >= copy.config.receiptLimit && !actor.receipts.some((receipt) => receipt.requestId === request.requestId)) actor.receipts.shift();
    return queuePolicy(copy, id, request);
  } },
  { name: 'ignore vertical distance', intended: 'diagonal range', repair(state, id, request) {
    const copy = structuredClone(state);
    const station = copy.stations.find((item) => item.id === request.stationId);
    if (station) actorIn(copy, id).y = station.y;
    return queuePolicy(copy, id, request);
  } },
  { name: 'ignore energy cap', intended: 'partial top-up', policyOnly: true, repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.reason !== 'repaired') return result;
    const actor = actorIn(result.state, id);
    actor.energy = actorIn(state, id).energy + state.config.repairEnergy;
    result.receipt.energyAdded = state.config.repairEnergy;
    result.receipt.energy = actor.energy;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'mutate input state', intended: 'source unchanged', policyOnly: true, repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    Object.assign(state, result.state);
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'return aliased rejection state', intended: 'fresh state', policyOnly: true, repair(state, id, request) {
    const result = queuePolicy(state, id, request);
    if (result.receipt === null) result.state = state;
    return result;
  } },
  { name: 'globally scoped request IDs', intended: 'same ID and receipt capacity', repair(state, id, request) {
    const previous = state.actors.flatMap((actor) => actor.receipts).find((receipt) => receipt.requestId === request.requestId);
    if (previous) return { reason: 'duplicate', receipt: structuredClone(previous), state: structuredClone(state) };
    return queuePolicy(state, id, request);
  } },
];

export const wrongAdapters = [{ name: 'accept client resource claims', requestAdapter(state, id, body) {
  const actor = actorIn(state, id);
  for (const key of ['x', 'y', 'energy', 'credits']) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(body, key)) actor[key] = body[key];
  }
  return adaptRequest(state, id, { requestId: body.requestId, stationId: body.stationId });
} }];

function details(error) {
  return { name: error?.name ?? 'Error', message: String(error?.message ?? error), expected: error?.expected ?? null, actual: error?.actual ?? null };
}

function objectReferences(value, seen = new Set()) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || seen.has(value)) return seen;
  seen.add(value);
  for (const child of Object.values(value)) objectReferences(child, seen);
  return seen;
}

export const SCENARIO_TIMEOUT_MS = 1000;
export const SCENARIO_BUDGET_MS = 8000;
export class ScenarioRunnerError extends Error {
  constructor(message) { super(message); this.name = 'ScenarioRunnerError'; }
}

/** One fresh process and module graph per variant, including imported helpers. */
export function runScenario(scenarioPath, { variant = 'reference', policyPath = '', timeout = SCENARIO_TIMEOUT_MS, deadline } = {}) {
  if (typeof scenarioPath !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(scenarioPath)) throw new TypeError('Use an absolute captured scenarioPath, not an imported function.');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(timeout) || timeout < 1 || timeout > SCENARIO_BUDGET_MS) throw new RangeError('Invalid scenario timeout.');
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const env = { ...process.env };
    for (const key of ['NODE_TEST_CONTEXT', 'NODE_OPTIONS', 'NODE_PATH']) delete env[key];
    const child = fork(fileURLToPath(new URL('./scenario-worker.mjs', import.meta.url)), [scenarioPath, variant, policyPath], {
      env, execArgv: [], detached: false, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ipc'],
    });
    let result;
    let problem;
    let outputBytes = 0;
    let output = '';
    let messages = 0;
    const stop = (message) => { problem ??= message; child.kill('SIGKILL'); };
    const wait = deadline === undefined ? timeout : Math.max(0, Math.min(timeout, deadline - Date.now()));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => stop('Scenario timed out.'), wait);
    for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr]) stream.on('data', (chunk) => {
      outputBytes += chunk.length;
      if (Buffer.byteLength(output) < 4096) output = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(output), chunk]).subarray(0, 4096).toString('utf8');
      if (outputBytes > 65536) stop('Scenario exceeded its output bound.');
    });
    child.on('message', (message) => {
      messages += 1;
      if (messages !== 1 || message?.type !== 'capstone-result') return stop('Invalid scenario result channel.');
      result = message.result;
    });
    child.once('error', (error) => { problem = error.message; });
    child.once('close', (code, signal) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (problem || code !== 0 || !result) return resolve({ status: 'runner-failure', error: { message: problem ?? `Worker exited without a result (${code ?? signal}).` }, trace: [], outputBytes, output, exit: { code, signal } });
      resolve({ ...result, outputBytes, output, exit: { code, signal } });
    });
  });
}

export function assessPolicy(candidate) {
  const criteria = [];
  if (typeof candidate?.repair !== 'function') return { passed: false, criteria: [{ name: 'export repair', passed: false, error: { message: 'Export repair(state, actorId, request).', expected: 'function', actual: typeof candidate?.repair, source: 'LEARNER.md#policy-contract' } }] };
  for (const item of cases()) {
    const state = copy(item.state);
    const input = copy(item.request);
    let actual;
    try { actual = candidate.repair(state, item.actorId ?? 'actor-1', input); }
    catch (error) { actual = { threw: details(error) }; }
    const passed = isDeepStrictEqual(actual, item.expected);
    criteria.push({ name: item.name, passed, ...(!passed ? { error: { message: `Check ${item.name}.`, expected: item.expected, actual, source: `LEARNER.md#${item.section}` } } : {}) });
    const unchanged = isDeepStrictEqual(state, item.state) && isDeepStrictEqual(input, item.request);
    criteria.push({ name: `${item.name}: source unchanged`, passed: unchanged, ...(!unchanged ? { error: { message: 'Return fresh state without changing the input.', expected: { unchanged: true }, actual: { unchanged }, source: 'LEARNER.md#policy-contract' } } : {}) });
    const sourceObjects = objectReferences(state);
    const fresh = Boolean(actual?.state) && [...objectReferences(actual.state)].every((value) => !sourceObjects.has(value));
    criteria.push({ name: `${item.name}: fresh state`, passed: fresh, ...(!fresh ? { error: { message: 'Detach the returned state, including nested state objects, from the input.', expected: { fresh: true }, actual: { fresh }, source: 'LEARNER.md#policy-contract' } } : {}) });
  }
  return { passed: criteria.every((criterion) => criterion.passed), criteria };
}

export async function assess(candidate, { timeout = SCENARIO_TIMEOUT_MS, budget = SCENARIO_BUDGET_MS } = {}) {
  const { criteria } = assessPolicy(candidate);
  if (typeof candidate?.scenarioPath !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(candidate.scenarioPath) || typeof candidate?.policyPath !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(candidate.policyPath)) {
    criteria.push({ name: 'captured policy and independent HTTP scenario', passed: false, error: { message: 'The owner runner must supply absolute captured policyPath and scenarioPath.', expected: 'two captured source paths', actual: { policyPath: typeof candidate?.policyPath, scenarioPath: typeof candidate?.scenarioPath }, source: 'LEARNER.md#independent-http-tests' } });
    return { passed: false, criteria };
  }
  const variants = [
    { name: 'submitted policy with captured scenario', variant: 'submitted', expected: 'passed' },
    ...correctPolicies.map((policy) => ({ name: policy.name, variant: policy.name, expected: 'passed' })),
    ...wrongPolicies.filter((policy) => !policy.policyOnly).map((policy) => ({ name: policy.name, variant: policy.name, expected: 'assertion-failure' })),
    ...wrongAdapters.map((adapter) => ({ name: adapter.name, variant: adapter.name, expected: 'assertion-failure' })),
  ];
  const deadline = Date.now() + Math.min(budget, SCENARIO_BUDGET_MS);
  const scenarios = [];
  for (const variant of variants) {
    const remaining = deadline - Date.now();
    const result = remaining > 0
      ? await runScenario(candidate.scenarioPath, { variant: variant.variant, policyPath: candidate.policyPath, timeout, deadline })
      : { status: 'runner-failure', error: { message: 'Whole scenario budget exhausted.' }, trace: [] };
    const diagnostic = { name: variant.name, variant: variant.variant, status: result.status,
      output: result.output ?? '', outputBytes: result.outputBytes ?? 0,
      outputTruncated: (result.outputBytes ?? 0) > 4096 };
    scenarios.push(diagnostic);
    if (result.status === 'runner-failure') {
      const error = new ScenarioRunnerError(`${variant.name}: ${result.error.message}`);
      error.input = { scenarios, completedCriteria: criteria,
        incompleteCriterion: `HTTP scenario: ${variant.name}` };
      throw error;
    }
    const passed = result.status === variant.expected;
    criteria.push({ name: `HTTP scenario: ${variant.name}`, passed, ...(!passed ? { error: { message: variant.expected === 'passed' ? `The scenario must read state, submit a repair and allow correct behavior. ${result.error?.message ?? ''}` : 'Expose this defect through real HTTP state assertions; crashes and fabricated errors do not count.', expected: variant.expected, actual: { status: result.status, error: result.error ?? null, activity: result.activity ?? null, output: result.output ?? '' }, source: 'LEARNER.md#independent-http-tests' } } : {}) });
  }
  return { passed: criteria.every((criterion) => criterion.passed), criteria, evidence: { scenarios } };
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/capstone/policy.mjs`:

```mjs
/** Decide one validated repair request using only server-owned state. */
export function repair(state, actorId, request) {
  const next = structuredClone(state);
  const actor = next.actors.find(({ id }) => id === actorId);
  const previous = actor.receipts.find(({ requestId }) => requestId === request.requestId);
  const result = (reason, receipt = null) => ({ reason, receipt, state: next });
  if (previous && previous.stationId !== request.stationId) return result('conflict');
  if (previous) return result('duplicate', previous);
  const station = next.stations.find(({ id }) => id === request.stationId);
  if (!station) return result('station');
  if (actor.receipts.length >= next.config.receiptLimit) return result('history-full');
  const distanceSquared = (actor.x - station.x) ** 2 + (actor.y - station.y) ** 2;
  if (distanceSquared > next.config.rangeMm ** 2) return result('range');
  if (actor.energy >= next.config.energyCap) return result('full');
  if (actor.credits < next.config.repairCost) return result('funds');
  const energyAdded = Math.min(next.config.repairEnergy, next.config.energyCap - actor.energy);
  actor.energy += energyAdded;
  actor.credits -= next.config.repairCost;
  const receipt = { requestId: request.requestId, stationId: request.stationId, energyAdded, creditsSpent: next.config.repairCost, energy: actor.energy, credits: actor.credits };
  actor.receipts.push(receipt);
  return result('repaired', receipt);
}

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { createRepairServer } from './server.mjs';
import { repair } from './policy.mjs';
import { correctPolicies, wrongPolicies, wrongAdapters } from './controls.mjs';

const AssertionError = assert.AssertionError;
const send = process.send?.bind(process);
if (!send) throw new Error('Run this trusted worker through the scenario fixture.');
process.send = undefined;
const abortOnDisconnect = () => process.exit(1);
process.once('disconnect', abortOnDisconnect);

const [scenarioPath, variantName, policyPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
// Variant identity belongs to the owner; it is not an input to the scenario.
process.argv = [process.argv[0]];

async function selectedVariant(name) {
  if (name === 'submitted') {
    const candidate = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(policyPath)));
    if (typeof candidate.repair !== 'function') throw new Error('Captured policy must export repair.');
    return { policy: candidate.repair };
  }
  if (name === 'reference') return { policy: repair };
  const policy = [...correctPolicies, ...wrongPolicies].find((item) => item.name === name);
  if (policy) return { policy: policy.repair };
  const adapter = wrongAdapters.find((item) => item.name === name);
  if (adapter) return { policy: correctPolicies[0].repair, requestAdapter: adapter.requestAdapter };
  throw new Error('Unknown scenario variant.');
}

function errorDetails(error) {
  return { name: error?.name ?? 'Error', message: String(error?.message ?? error), expected: error?.expected ?? null, actual: error?.actual ?? null };
}

let server;
let result;
try {
  server = await createRepairServer(await selectedVariant(variantName));
  const candidate = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(scenarioPath)));
  if (typeof candidate.scenario !== 'function') throw new Error('Export async scenario({base,moveActor}).');
  let failure;
  try { await candidate.scenario({ base: server.base, moveActor: server.moveActor }); }
  catch (error) { failure = error; }
  const activity = server.activity();
  // This checks participation only. The complete variant panel checks whether
  // the scenario actually distinguishes behavior; no assertion dataflow is inferred.
  const meaningful = activity.stateReads > 0 && activity.repairRequests > 0;
  let status = failure ? 'runtime-failure' : 'passed';
  if (failure instanceof AssertionError) status = 'assertion-failure';
  // A genuine mismatch may stop before the next state read. Participation is
  // required of completed runs; the full panel rejects blanket assertion throws.
  if (!failure && !meaningful) status = 'insufficient-evidence';
  const trace = server.record();
  result = { status, activity, ...(failure ? { error: errorDetails(failure) } : {}), trace: trace.slice(0, 32), traceDropped: Math.max(0, trace.length - 32) };
} catch (error) {
  result = { status: server ? 'runtime-failure' : 'runner-failure', error: errorDetails(error), activity: server?.activity() ?? { requests: 0, stateReads: 0, repairRequests: 0 }, trace: [] };
} finally {
  await server?.close();
}
const seen = new WeakSet();
const encoded = JSON.stringify(result, (_key, value) => {
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return String(value);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (seen.has(value)) return '<repeated reference>';
  seen.add(value);
  return value;
});
if (Buffer.byteLength(encoded) > 512 * 1024) result = { status: 'runtime-failure', error: { message: 'Scenario evidence exceeded its byte bound.' }, trace: [] };
else result = JSON.parse(encoded);
send({ type: 'capstone-result', result }, () => { process.removeListener('disconnect', abortOnDisconnect); process.disconnect(); });

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/capstone/server.mjs`:

```mjs
import http from 'node:http';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { repair } from './policy.mjs';
import { addActor, initialState } from './state.mjs';

export class RequestRejection extends Error {
  constructor(message) { super(message); this.name = 'RequestRejection'; }
}

export function adaptRequest(state, actorId, body) {
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body) || Object.keys(body).length !== 2 || !Object.hasOwn(body, 'requestId') || !Object.hasOwn(body, 'stationId')) throw new RequestRejection('Send only requestId and stationId.');
  for (const key of ['requestId', 'stationId']) {
    if (typeof body[key] !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(body[key])) throw new RequestRejection('Request identifiers must use 1–40 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.');
  }
  return { state, request: { requestId: body.requestId, stationId: body.stationId } };
}

async function readBody(request) {
  let length = 0;
  const chunks = [];
  for await (const chunk of request) {
    length += chunk.length;
    if (length <= 4096) chunks.push(chunk);
  }
  if (length > 4096) throw new RequestRejection('Request exceeds 4096 bytes.');
  try { return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')); }
  catch { throw new RequestRejection('Send a JSON body.'); }
}

function send(response, status, data, observationId) {
  response.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'X-Ivy-Capstone-Observation': observationId });
  response.end(JSON.stringify(data));
}

/** Local owner adapter. moveActor is a test control, never an HTTP endpoint. */
export async function createRepairServer({ policy = repair, requestAdapter = adaptRequest } = {}) {
  let world = initialState();
  const sessions = new Map();
  const trace = [];
  const observations = new Map();
  let requestCount = 0;
  const server = http.createServer(async (request, response) => {
    requestCount += 1;
    const observationId = randomUUID();
    const respond = (status, data) => {
      if (status === 200 && ['/state', '/repair'].includes(request.url)) observations.set(observationId, { route: request.url, status, data: structuredClone(data) });
      send(response, status, data, observationId);
    };
    if (requestCount > 256) return respond(429, { error: 'request-bound' });
    try {
      if (request.method === 'POST' && request.url === '/session') {
        const body = await readBody(request);
        if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body) || Object.keys(body).length !== 0) return respond(400, { error: 'session-body' });
        if (sessions.size >= 8) return respond(429, { error: 'session-bound' });
        const id = `actor-${sessions.size + 1}`;
        const token = randomUUID();
        world = addActor(world, id);
        sessions.set(token, id);
        return respond(201, { id, token });
      }
      const token = request.headers.authorization?.match(/^Bearer (.+)$/)?.[1];
      const actorId = sessions.get(token);
      if (!actorId) return respond(401, { error: 'session' });
      if (request.method === 'GET' && request.url === '/state') return respond(200, structuredClone(world));
      if (request.method !== 'POST' || request.url !== '/repair') return respond(404, { error: 'route' });
      const body = await readBody(request);
      const adapted = requestAdapter(structuredClone(world), actorId, body);
      const result = policy(adapted.state, actorId, adapted.request);
      if (!result || !result.state || typeof result.reason !== 'string') throw new Error('Policy returned no usable state.');
      world = structuredClone(result.state);
      trace.push({ actorId, request: adapted.request, reason: result.reason, receipt: result.receipt, state: structuredClone(world) });
      return respond(200, result);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RequestRejection) return respond(400, { error: error.message });
      respond(500, { error: 'policy-failure', name: error?.name ?? 'Error' });
    }
  });
  server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
  await once(server, 'listening');
  return {
    base: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`,
    moveActor(id, { x, y }) {
      if (![x, y].every((value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Math.abs(value) <= 10000)) throw new RangeError('Owner positions must be integer coordinates within 10000 mm.');
      const actor = world.actors.find((item) => item.id === id);
      if (!actor) throw new Error('Unknown actor.');
      actor.x = x;
      actor.y = y;
    },
    snapshot: () => structuredClone(world),
    record: () => structuredClone(trace),
    observation: (id) => observations.get(id),
    activity: () => ({ requests: requestCount, stateReads: [...observations.values()].filter(({ route }) => route === '/state').length, repairRequests: trace.length }),
    close: () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { server.closeAllConnections(); server.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()); }),
  };
}

export async function withRepairServer(exercise, options) {
  const server = await createRepairServer(options);
  try { return await exercise(server); }
  finally { await server.close(); }
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clients/adversarial.mjs`:

```mjs
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { input, join, request, state } from './http-client.mjs';
import { parseOptions, submit, waitUntilTick } from './live.mjs';

export const scenarios = ['remote-pickup', 'stale-ordering', 'forged-fields', 'detector', 'equivalent-valid-traffic'];

export async function runAdversarial(base, scenario) {
  if (!scenarios.includes(scenario)) throw new Error(`Unknown scenario ${scenario}.`);
  const actor = await join(base);
  if (scenario === 'forged-fields') {
    const response = await request(base, '/input', { method: 'POST', token: actor.token, json: { v: 1, seq: 1, move: 'idle', interact: false, score: 999 } });
    return { scenario, response: { status: response.status, data: response.data }, state: await state(base, actor.token) };
  }
  if (scenario === 'stale-ordering') {
    const fresh = await submit(base, actor.token, 2, 'N', false);
    const stale = await input(base, actor.token, 1, 'E', true);
    await waitUntilTick(base, fresh.tick + 1);
    return { scenario, staleDecision: stale.data, state: await state(base, actor.token), note: 'Live timing is observational; owner-clock tests check the exact one-tick invariant.' };
  }
  if (scenario === 'equivalent-valid-traffic') {
    const twin = await join(base);
    const localRendering = { displayedScore: 999 };
    const responses = await Promise.all([actor, twin].map((session) => submit(base, session.token, 1, 'E', false)));
    await waitUntilTick(base, Math.max(...responses.map((response) => response.tick)) + 4);
    return { scenario, localRendering, ordinary: await state(base, actor.token), alteredRendering: await state(base, twin.token), note: 'Both clients send valid intent only. This server cannot infer a local rendering change from those messages.' };
  }
  const attempts = scenario === 'detector' ? 3 : 1;
  for (let seq = 1; seq <= attempts; seq += 1) {
    const admission = await submit(base, actor.token, seq, 'idle', true);
    await waitUntilTick(base, admission.tick + 1);
  }
  return { scenario, state: await state(base, actor.token) };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  try {
    const { base, scenario } = parseOptions(process.argv.slice(2), { scenarios });
    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(await runAdversarial(base, scenario), null, 2)}\n`);
  } catch (error) {
    process.stderr.write(`Adversarial client failed: ${error.message}\n`);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clients/http-client.mjs`:

```mjs
import http from 'node:http';

export function localEndpoint(value) {
  const url = new URL(value);
  if (url.protocol !== 'http:' || !['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(url.hostname)) {
    throw new Error('This teaching client only connects to an owned loopback HTTP server.');
  }
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || url.pathname !== '/') {
    throw new Error('Use a plain loopback origin such as http://127.0.0.1:8787.');
  }
  return url;
}

/** Raw HTTP is intentional: tests can exercise malformed bodies and headers. */
export function request(base, path, { method = 'GET', token, json, body, headers = {}, agent } = {}) {
  const endpoint = localEndpoint(base);
  const payload = json === undefined ? body : JSON.stringify(json);
  const requestHeaders = { ...headers };
  if (json !== undefined && !Object.hasOwn(requestHeaders, 'Content-Type')) requestHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
  if (token) requestHeaders.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  if (payload !== undefined) requestHeaders['Content-Length'] = Buffer.byteLength(payload);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request({
      hostname: endpoint.hostname, port: endpoint.port, path, method,
      headers: requestHeaders, agent,
    }, (res) => {
      const chunks = [];
      let bytes = 0;
      res.on('data', (chunk) => {
        bytes += chunk.length;
        if (bytes > 1024 * 1024) {
          res.destroy(new Error('Teaching server response exceeded 1 MiB.'));
          return;
        }
        chunks.push(chunk);
      });
      res.on('error', reject);
      res.on('end', () => {
        const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
        let data = null;
        try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* Preserve non-JSON rejection bodies. */ }
        resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers, data, text });
      });
    });
    req.setTimeout(7000, () => req.destroy(new Error('Loopback HTTP request timed out.')));
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.end(payload);
  });
}

export async function join(base, options) {
  const result = await request(base, '/join', { method: 'POST', json: {}, ...options });
  if (result.status !== 201 || typeof result.data?.token !== 'string' || typeof result.data?.id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(`Join failed with HTTP ${result.status}: ${result.text}`);
  }
  return result.data;
}

export function input(base, token, seq, move = 'idle', interact = false, options = {}) {
  return request(base, '/input', { method: 'POST', token, json: { v: 1, seq, move, interact }, ...options });
}

export async function state(base, token, options = {}) {
  const result = await request(base, '/state', { token, ...options });
  if (result.status !== 200 || !result.data?.actor) throw new Error(`State failed with HTTP ${result.status}: ${result.text}`);
  return result.data;
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clients/live.mjs`:

```mjs
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { input, join, localEndpoint, request, state } from './http-client.mjs';

export function parseOptions(argv, { scenarios = [] } = {}) {
  let base = 'http://127.0.0.1:8787';
  let scenario = scenarios[0];
  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 2) {
    const name = argv[index];
    const value = argv[index + 1];
    if (!value) throw new Error(`Missing value for ${name}.`);
    if (name === '--url') { base = value; continue; }
    if (name === '--port' && /^\d+$/.test(value) && Number(value) >= 1 && Number(value) <= 65535) {
      base = `http://127.0.0.1:${value}`;
      continue;
    }
    if (name === '--scenario' && scenarios.includes(value)) { scenario = value; continue; }
    throw new Error(`Unsupported option ${name} ${value}.`);
  }
  localEndpoint(base);
  return { base, scenario };
}

export async function waitUntilTick(base, target, timeout = 3000) {
  const deadline = performance.now() + timeout;
  while (performance.now() < deadline) {
    const response = await request(base, '/health');
    if (response.status !== 200 || !Number.isSafeInteger(response.data?.tick)) throw new Error('Health endpoint did not return a tick.');
    if (response.data.tick >= target) return response.data.tick;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
  }
  throw new Error('Server clock did not advance. Start the normal server without --test.');
}

export async function submit(base, token, seq, move, interact) {
  const result = await input(base, token, seq, move, interact);
  if (result.status !== 200 || result.data?.status !== 'admitted') throw new Error(`Valid client input failed: ${result.text}`);
  return result.data;
}

export async function runLiveHonest(base) {
  const actor = await join(base);
  const deadline = performance.now() + 30000;
  for (let seq = 1; seq <= 120 && performance.now() < deadline; seq += 1) {
    const current = await state(base, actor.token);
    if (current.actor.score >= 1) return { scenario: 'honest-delivery', outcome: 'delivered', state: current };
    const target = current.actor.cargo ? current.depot : current.core;
    const dx = target.x - current.actor.x;
    const dy = target.y - current.actor.y;
    const inRange = dx * dx + dy * dy <= 62500;
    const interact = inRange && current.tick >= current.actor.nextInteractTick;
    const move = inRange ? 'idle' : toward(dx, dy);
    const admission = await submit(base, actor.token, seq, move, interact);
    await waitUntilTick(base, admission.tick + 1);
  }
  throw new Error('Honest delivery did not complete within 120 inputs and 30 seconds.');
}

function toward(dx, dy) {
  if (dx > 0) return 'E';
  if (dx < 0) return 'W';
  if (dy > 0) return 'S';
  return 'N';
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clients/scenarios.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { input, join, state } from './http-client.mjs';

export class InvariantViolation extends Error {
  constructor(code, message, observed) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'InvariantViolation';
    this.code = code;
    this.observed = observed;
  }
}

export async function admitted(base, token, seq, move = 'idle', interact = false) {
  const response = await input(base, token, seq, move, interact);
  assert.equal(response.status, 200, 'input must complete over HTTP');
  assert.equal(response.data?.status, 'admitted', 'fresh valid input must be admitted');
  return response;
}

export async function honestWin({ base, advance }) {
  const actor = await join(base);
  const first = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.equal(first.core.x, 2500, 'this hand-authored trace uses seed 17');
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 1, 'E');
  await advance(4);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 2, 'E');
  await advance(2);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 3, 'idle', true);
  await advance(1);
  const pickup = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.deepEqual([pickup.actor.x, pickup.actor.y, pickup.actor.cargo, pickup.actor.score], [2500, 1000, true, 0]);
  assert.equal(pickup.lastDecision?.reason, 'pickup');
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 4, 'W');
  await advance(4);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 5, 'W');
  await advance(2);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 6, 'idle', true);
  await advance(1);
  const deposit = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.deepEqual([deposit.actor.x, deposit.actor.y, deposit.actor.score, deposit.actor.cargo], [1000, 1000, 1, false]);
  assert.equal(deposit.lastDecision?.reason, 'deposit');
  assert.deepEqual(deposit.core, { x: 2500, y: 1000 });
  return { actor, pickup, deposit };
}

export async function probeRemotePickup({ base, advance }) {
  const actor = await join(base);
  const before = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.deepEqual([before.actor.x, before.actor.y, before.actor.cargo, before.actor.score], [1000, 1000, false, 0]);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 1, 'idle', true);
  await advance(1);
  const after = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.equal(after.tick, before.tick + 1, 'probe must observe the acknowledged tick');
  assert.deepEqual([after.actor.x, after.actor.y, after.actor.score], [1000, 1000, 0]);
  return { before, after };
}

export function assertRemotePickupInvariant(observed) {
  if (observed.after.actor.cargo !== false) {
    throw new InvariantViolation('REMOTE_PICKUP', 'remote pickup must leave cargo false', observed);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(observed.after.lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'range', tick: observed.after.tick });
}

export async function probeStaleOrdering({ base, advance }) {
  const actor = await join(base);
  const before = await state(base, actor.token);
  await admitted(base, actor.token, 2, 'N');
  const retry = await input(base, actor.token, 1, 'E', true);
  assert.equal(retry.status, 200, 'stale probe must reach admission over HTTP');
  assert.ok(['admitted', 'stale'].includes(retry.data?.status), 'probe must produce an admission decision');
  await advance(1);
  const after = await state(base, actor.token);
  assert.equal(after.tick, before.tick + 1, 'probe must observe the acknowledged tick');
  return { before, after, retry: retry.data };
}

export function assertStaleOrderingInvariant(observed) {
  if (observed.after.actor.x !== 1000 || observed.after.actor.y !== 750) {
    throw new InvariantViolation('STALE_DIRECTION', 'a stale E input must not replace the newer N intent', observed);
  }
  assert.equal(observed.retry.status, 'stale');
  assert.equal(observed.after.actor.lastSeq, 2);
  assert.equal(observed.after.lastDecision, null, 'stale interaction must not enter the pending bit');
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clients/schedules.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { input, join, state } from './http-client.mjs';

// Application receipt schedules, not TCP simulation. Geometry and route lengths
// are hand-authored for each seed; the engine is never used as the oracle.
const SEEDS = Object.freeze({
  17: { start: 2, sequence: 170, coreX: 2500, coreSteps: 6, approachSteps: 3 },
  31: { start: 3, sequence: 310, coreX: 2250, coreSteps: 5, approachSteps: 2 },
  99: { start: 1, sequence: 990, coreX: 2000, coreSteps: 4, approachSteps: 1 },
});

export const DELIVERY_SCHEDULES = Object.freeze([
  'continuous-renewals', 'reordered-input', 'same-tick-clump', 'expiry-gap',
  'lost-request', 'lost-response', 'state-polling', 'human-repress',
  'human-anticipatory', 'distant-script',
]);

async function begin(server, name, seed) {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(SEEDS, seed)) throw new Error(`No hand-authored schedule fixture for seed ${seed}`);
  const fixture = SEEDS[seed];
  await server.advance(fixture.start);
  const actor = await join(server.base);
  const run = { server, name, seed, actor, ...fixture, checkpoints: [] };
  const initial = await checkpoint(run, 'joined', { tick: run.start });
  assert.deepEqual(initial.core, { x: run.coreX, y: 1000 }, `${name}: seeded core geometry`);
  assert.deepEqual(initial.depot, { x: 1000, y: 1000 }, `${name}: depot geometry`);
  return run;
}

async function deliver(run, seq, move = 'idle', interact = false) {
  const response = await input(run.server.base, run.actor.token, seq, move, interact);
  assert.equal(response.status, 200, `${run.name}: gameplay input reaches HTTP admission`);
  return response;
}

async function checkpoint(run, label, {
  tick, x = 1000, y = 1000, seq = 0, expiry = 0, cargo = false, score = 0,
  cooldown = 0, decision = null, findings = [],
}) {
  const observed = await state(run.server.base, run.actor.token);
  assert.deepEqual({ tick: observed.tick, actor: observed.actor, lastDecision: observed.lastDecision, findings: observed.findings }, {
    tick,
    actor: { id: run.actor.id, x, y, score, cargo, lastSeq: seq, expiresAt: expiry, nextInteractTick: cooldown },
    lastDecision: decision, findings,
  }, `${run.name}/${label}: exact authoritative state`);
  run.checkpoints.push({ name: label, state: observed });
  return observed;
}

const denied = (tick, reason = 'range') => ({ status: 'denied', reason, tick });
const pickup = (tick) => ({ status: 'applied', reason: 'pickup', tick });

async function continuous(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  await deliver(run, n, 'E');
  await checkpoint(run, 'admitted-before-movement', { tick: t, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await server.advance(3);
  await checkpoint(run, 'three-tick-gap', { tick: t + 3, x: 1750, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'E');
  await server.advance(4);
  await checkpoint(run, 'four-tick-gap', { tick: t + 7, x: 2750, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 7 });
  await deliver(run, n + 2, 'W');
  await server.advance(4);
  await checkpoint(run, 'inclusive-renewal', { tick: t + 11, x: 1750, seq: n + 2, expiry: t + 11 });
  await deliver(run, n + 3, 'W');
  await server.advance(2);
  await checkpoint(run, 'continuous-no-catch-up', { tick: t + 13, x: 1250, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 15 });
}

async function toCore(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server, coreSteps } = run;
  await deliver(run, n, 'E');
  await server.advance(4);
  await checkpoint(run, 'route-fourth-tick', { tick: t + 4, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  if (coreSteps === 4) return { at: t + 4, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 };
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'E');
  await server.advance(coreSteps - 4);
  await checkpoint(run, 'at-core', { tick: t + coreSteps, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 8 });
  return { at: t + coreSteps, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 8 };
}

async function reordered(run) {
  const { at: t, seq: n } = await toCore(run);
  await deliver(run, n + 2);
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'W', true);
  await run.server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'older-input-adds-no-interaction', { tick: t + 1, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 2, expiry: t + 4 });
  await deliver(run, n + 3, 'idle', true);
  await run.server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'fresh-repress-picks-up', {
    tick: t + 2, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 5, cargo: true, cooldown: t + 6, decision: pickup(t + 2),
  });
}

async function clump(run) {
  const { at: t, seq: n } = await toCore(run);
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'W', true);
  await deliver(run, n + 2, 'idle', true);
  await deliver(run, n + 3, 'E', false);
  await checkpoint(run, 'clump-does-not-move-immediately', { tick: t, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 4 });
  await run.server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'latest-move-and-one-interaction', {
    tick: t + 1, x: run.coreX + 250, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 4, cargo: true, cooldown: t + 5, decision: pickup(t + 1),
  });
  await run.server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'pending-interaction-consumed-once', {
    tick: t + 2, x: run.coreX + 500, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 4, cargo: true, cooldown: t + 5, decision: pickup(t + 1),
  });
}

async function expiryGap(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  await deliver(run, n, 'E');
  await server.advance(3);
  await checkpoint(run, 'third-active-tick', { tick: t + 3, x: 1750, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'fourth-active-tick', { tick: t + 4, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'fifth-tick-stopped', { tick: t + 5, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await server.advance(3);
  await checkpoint(run, 'outside-envelope-gap', { tick: t + 8, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'E');
  await checkpoint(run, 'readmitted-before-next-tick', { tick: t + 8, x: 2000, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 12 });
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'resumes-one-step', { tick: t + 9, x: 2250, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 12 });
}

async function lostRequest(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  // The first application attempt is withheld; only its retry reaches HTTP.
  const withheld = { seq: n, move: 'E', interact: true };
  await server.advance(2);
  await checkpoint(run, 'undelivered-request-has-no-effect', { tick: t + 2 });
  await deliver(run, withheld.seq, withheld.move, withheld.interact);
  await checkpoint(run, 'first-delivered-copy', { tick: t + 2, seq: n, expiry: t + 6 });
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'delivered-copy-applies-once', { tick: t + 3, x: 1250, seq: n, expiry: t + 6, decision: denied(t + 3) });
  await deliver(run, withheld.seq, withheld.move, withheld.interact);
  await server.advance(2);
  await checkpoint(run, 'retry-keeps-original-expiry-and-decision', { tick: t + 5, x: 1750, seq: n, expiry: t + 6, decision: denied(t + 3) });
}

async function lostResponse(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  // Discard the first successful response at the application boundary. The
  // subsequent requests contain the exact same command, including sequence.
  await deliver(run, n, 'E', true);
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'response-discarded-after-effect', { tick: t + 1, x: 1250, seq: n, expiry: t + 4, decision: denied(t + 1) });
  for (const [offset, x] of [[2, 1500], [3, 1750], [4, 2000]]) {
    await deliver(run, n, 'E', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    await checkpoint(run, `unchanged-retry-${offset}`, { tick: t + offset, x, seq: n, expiry: t + 4, decision: denied(t + 1) });
  }
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'retry-did-not-renew', { tick: t + 5, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4, decision: denied(t + 1) });
}

async function polling(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  await deliver(run, n, 'E');
  await server.advance(3);
  const thirdTick = { tick: t + 3, x: 1750, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 };
  await checkpoint(run, 'poll-before-expiry', thirdTick);
  await checkpoint(run, 'same-tick-poll-is-read-only', thirdTick);
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'poll-at-expiry', { tick: t + 4, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await server.advance(1);
  const stopped = { tick: t + 5, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 };
  await checkpoint(run, 'poll-after-expiry', stopped);
  await checkpoint(run, 'repeat-expired-poll', stopped);
  await server.advance(2);
  await checkpoint(run, 'polling-does-not-renew', { tick: t + 7, x: 2000, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
}

async function humanRepress(run) {
  const { at: t, seq: n } = await toCore(run);
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'idle', true);
  await run.server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'human-pickup', {
    tick: t + 1, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + 4, cargo: true, cooldown: t + 5, decision: pickup(t + 1),
  });
  for (const offset of [2, 3, 4]) {
    await deliver(run, n + offset, 'idle', true);
    await run.server.advance(1);
    await checkpoint(run, `ordinary-repress-${offset - 1}`, {
      tick: t + offset, x: run.coreX, seq: n + offset, expiry: t + offset + 3,
      cargo: true, cooldown: t + 5, decision: denied(t + offset, 'cooldown'),
    });
  }
}

async function anticipation(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server, approachSteps: k } = run;
  await deliver(run, n, 'E');
  await server.advance(k);
  await checkpoint(run, 'approaching-core', { tick: t + k, x: run.coreX - 750, seq: n, expiry: t + 4 });
  await deliver(run, n + 1, 'E', true);
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'press-at-500-mm', { tick: t + k + 1, x: run.coreX - 500, seq: n + 1, expiry: t + k + 4, decision: denied(t + k + 1) });
  await deliver(run, n + 2, 'E', true);
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'press-at-250-mm-picks-up', {
    tick: t + k + 2, x: run.coreX - 250, seq: n + 2, expiry: t + k + 5,
    cargo: true, cooldown: t + k + 6, decision: pickup(t + k + 2),
  });
  await deliver(run, n + 3, 'E', true);
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'nearby-repress-during-cooldown', {
    tick: t + k + 3, x: run.coreX, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + k + 6,
    cargo: true, cooldown: t + k + 6, decision: denied(t + k + 3, 'cooldown'),
  });
}

async function distant(run) {
  const { start: t, sequence: n, server } = run;
  for (const offset of [1, 2, 3]) {
    await deliver(run, n + offset - 1, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    const findings = offset === 3 ? [{ kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: t + 3 }] : [];
    await checkpoint(run, `distant-denial-${offset}`, {
      tick: t + offset, seq: n + offset - 1, expiry: t + offset + 3, decision: denied(t + offset), findings,
    });
  }
  await deliver(run, n + 3, 'E');
  await server.advance(1);
  await checkpoint(run, 'advisory-does-not-block-movement', {
    tick: t + 4, x: 1250, seq: n + 3, expiry: t + 7, decision: denied(t + 3),
    findings: [{ kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: t + 3 }],
  });
}

const RUNNERS = Object.freeze({
  'continuous-renewals': continuous, 'reordered-input': reordered, 'same-tick-clump': clump,
  'expiry-gap': expiryGap, 'lost-request': lostRequest, 'lost-response': lostResponse,
  'state-polling': polling, 'human-repress': humanRepress,
  'human-anticipatory': anticipation, 'distant-script': distant,
});

/** Run on a fresh owner-clock server; gameplay always crosses actual HTTP. */
export async function runDeliverySchedule(server, name, { seed = 17 } = {}) {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(RUNNERS, name)) throw new Error(`Unknown delivery schedule: ${name}`);
  const runner = RUNNERS[name];
  const run = await begin(server, name, seed);
  await runner(run);
  return { name, seed, actor: run.actor, checkpoints: run.checkpoints };
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/clock.mjs`:

```mjs
export const TICK_MS = 50;
export const MAX_CATCH_UP_TICKS = 5;

function checkTime(time) {
  if (typeof time !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(time) || time < 0) {
    throw new TypeError('Clock time must be a finite, non-negative number.');
  }
}

/** Convert monotonic millisecond readings into bounded simulation work. */
export function createClock(startTime = 0) {
  checkTime(startTime);
  let previousTime = startTime;
  let remainder = 0;
  let overruns = 0;

  return {
    sample(now) {
      checkTime(now);
      if (now < previousTime) throw new RangeError('Clock time cannot go backwards.');

      const elapsed = now - previousTime + remainder;
      const due = Math.floor(elapsed / TICK_MS);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(due)) throw new RangeError('Clock interval is too large.');

      const ticks = Math.min(due, MAX_CATCH_UP_TICKS);
      const dropped = due - ticks;
      previousTime = now;
      remainder = elapsed - due * TICK_MS;
      if (dropped > 0) overruns += 1;
      return { ticks, dropped, overruns, remainder };
    },
  };
}
