`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/grade.mjs`:

```mjs
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readdir, realpath, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { PREDICTION_CONTRACT, loadPredictionFeedback, predictionTemplate, validatePredictions, predictionCustody, preservePredictionRefusal, prepareFreshPractice, submitFreshPractice } from './predictions.mjs';
import { moduleFor } from './registry.mjs';
import { acquireCheckLock, releaseCheckLock } from './lock.mjs';
import { captureBundle, hashTree, jsonBytes, regularFile, saveJson, sha256, verifyReference, writeBundle } from './trust.mjs';

export const WORKER_TIMEOUT = 10000;
export const OUTPUT_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024;

async function submittedFiles(root, prefix = '') {
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of (await readdir(join(root, prefix), { withFileTypes: true })).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
    if (['artifacts', 'node_modules', '.git'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const path = prefix + entry.name;
    if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`Symlinks are not submitted: ${path}`);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...await submittedFiles(root, path + '/'));
    if (entry.isFile()) files.push(path);
  }
  return files.sort();
}

async function priorAttempt(directory) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true }); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return null; throw error; }
  let latest = null;
  let feedback = false;
  for (const entry of entries.filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory()).sort((a, b) => b.name.localeCompare(a.name))) {
    let submission;
    try { submission = JSON.parse(await regularFile(directory, `${entry.name}/submission.json`)); }
    catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') continue; throw error; }
    latest ??= submission.attemptId;
    try { await regularFile(directory, `${entry.name}/feedback-started.json`); feedback = true; }
    catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  }
  return latest ? { attemptId: latest, feedback } : null;
}

function runnerFailure(message) {
  return { kind: 'runner-failure', healthy: false, passed: false, error: { message } };
}

function sourcePointer(source) {
  if (typeof source === 'string') return source;
  if (source && typeof source.path === 'string') return source.path + (source.anchor ? `#${source.anchor}` : '');
  return JSON.stringify(source);
}

/** Run one bounded child, preserving assertion evidence supplied by the fixture. */
export function runWorker({ worker, policy, fixtures, scenario, cwd, timeout = WORKER_TIMEOUT, outputLimit = OUTPUT_LIMIT }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const env = { ...process.env };
    for (const key of ['NODE_TEST_CONTEXT', 'NODE_OPTIONS', 'NODE_PATH']) delete env[key];
    const child = fork(worker, [policy, fixtures, ...(scenario ? [scenario] : [])], {
      cwd, env, execArgv: [], detached: true,
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ipc'],
    });
    const chunks = [];
    let outputBytes = 0;
    let result;
    let forced;
    let messages = 0;
    const reapGroup = () => {
      try { process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL'); }
      catch { child.kill('SIGKILL'); }
    };
    const terminate = (reason) => {
      forced ??= reason;
      reapGroup();
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => terminate('Worker timed out.'), timeout);
    for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr]) stream.on('data', (bytes) => {
      const remaining = Math.max(0, outputLimit - outputBytes);
      chunks.push(bytes.subarray(0, remaining));
      outputBytes += bytes.length;
      if (outputBytes > outputLimit) terminate('Worker exceeded its output budget.');
    });
    child.on('message', (message) => {
      messages += 1;
      if (messages !== 1 || message?.type !== 'core-result') return terminate('Worker sent an invalid result.');
      result = message.result;
    });
    child.once('error', (error) => { forced = error.message; });
    child.once('close', (code, signal) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      // Successful workers can leave unref'ed descendants in their group too.
      // A descendant that deliberately creates a new session is outside this
      // local teaching runner's boundary; this is not an OS sandbox.
      reapGroup();
      if (forced || code !== 0 || !result) result = runnerFailure(forced ?? `Worker exited without a complete result (${code ?? signal}).`);
      if (!['pass', 'behavior-failure', 'runner-failure'].includes(result.kind)) result = runnerFailure('Worker returned an invalid result.');
      resolve({ ...result, exit: { code, signal }, output: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'), outputBytes });
    });
  });
}

export async function executeCaptured({ executionRoot, bundle, captured, module, timeout, outputLimit }) {
  const trusted = join(executionRoot, 'trusted');
  const candidate = join(executionRoot, 'candidate');
  await mkdir(executionRoot, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  await writeBundle(trusted, bundle);
  await writeBundle(candidate, captured);
  const hashes = await hashTree(executionRoot);
  let result = await runWorker({
    worker: join(trusted, 'lab/core/worker.mjs'), policy: join(candidate, module.policy),
    fixtures: join(trusted, module.fixtures), scenario: module.scenario && join(candidate, module.scenario), cwd: candidate, timeout, outputLimit,
  });
  let afterHashes;
  try {
    afterHashes = await hashTree(executionRoot);
    if (JSON.stringify(hashes) !== JSON.stringify(afterHashes)) result = { ...result, ...runnerFailure('Execution files changed while running.') };
  } catch (error) {
    result = { ...result, ...runnerFailure(`Execution changed while running: ${error.message}`) };
  }
  return { ...result, hashes, afterHashes };
}

function validateCapture({ captured, session, owner, module, manifest }) {
  const required = [module.policy, module.prompt, module.guide, 'response.md', 'lab/core/help.json', 'lab/core/session.json'];
  if (module.scenario) required.push(module.scenario, module.client);
  for (const path of required) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(captured, path)) throw new Error(`Missing submitted file: ${path}`);
  }
  if (sha256(captured['lab/core/session.json']) !== owner.sessionHash || JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(captured['lab/core/session.json'])) !== JSON.stringify(session)) throw new Error('Prepared session changed during submission.');
  if (sha256(captured[module.prompt]) !== manifest.files[module.prompt]) throw new Error('Prompt changed; restore its original wording before submitting.');
  if (sha256(captured[module.guide]) !== owner.guideHash) throw new Error('Learner guide changed; restore the prepared guide before submitting.');
  if (module.client && sha256(captured[module.client]) !== manifest.files[module.client]) throw new Error('Supplied HTTP client changed; restore it before submission. Put your assertions in scenario.mjs.');
  const help = JSON.parse(captured['lab/core/help.json']);
  if (!help || !Array.isArray(help.consulted) || help.consulted.some((item) => typeof item !== 'string') || (help.note !== undefined && typeof help.note !== 'string')) throw new Error('Help metadata must contain a consulted list of strings and an optional note.');
  return help;
}

export async function checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance, timeout, outputLimit, afterCaptureRead, fresh = false }) {
  if (typeof assistance !== 'string' || !assistance.trim() || assistance.length > 10000) throw new Error('Declare the assistance used, or "none".');
  workspace = await realpath(workspace);
  if (session.schema !== 'courier-core-session-v1' || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(session.sessionId)) throw new Error('Invalid prepared session.');
  const root = await realpath(session.referenceRoot);
  const module = moduleFor(session.module);
  const { bundle, manifest, manifestHash } = await verifyReference(root, session.referenceManifest);
  const ownerSession = join(root, 'artifacts/core/sessions', session.sessionId);
  const owner = JSON.parse(await regularFile(ownerSession, 'session.json'));
  if (owner.workspace !== workspace || owner.referenceRoot !== root || owner.referenceManifest !== manifestHash || owner.module !== module.id) throw new Error('Prepared session identity changed.');
  const lease = await acquireCheckLock({ ownerSession, root, sessionId: session.sessionId });
  try {
    const paths = await submittedFiles(workspace);
    const { captured, hashes } = await captureBundle(workspace, paths, afterCaptureRead);
    if (JSON.stringify(paths) !== JSON.stringify(await submittedFiles(workspace))) throw new Error('Submission inventory changed during capture. Save all files and retry.');
    const help = validateCapture({ captured, session, owner, module, manifest });
    let predictions;
    if (fresh && session.predictionContract !== PREDICTION_CONTRACT) throw new Error('Fresh practice requires a newly prepared workspace.');
    if (session.predictionContract === PREDICTION_CONTRACT) {
      const attempts = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', session.sessionId);
      const refusals = join(root, 'artifacts/core/refusals', session.sessionId);
      if (fresh) return await submitFreshPractice({ workspace, root, module: module.id, captured, assistance, attempts, directory: join(root, 'artifacts/core/practice', session.sessionId), refusals, help });
      const feedback = (await loadPredictionFeedback(root, module.id)).postCheckFeedback();
      try { predictions = validatePredictions(captured['predictions.json'], predictionTemplate(feedback, module.id)); }
      catch (error) { return await preservePredictionRefusal({ directory: refusals, captured, assistance, module: module.id, stage: 'prediction', error }); }
    }
    return await assessSubmission({ root, workspace, session, owner, module, bundle, manifestHash, captured, hashes, help, predictions, assistance, timeout, outputLimit, checkId: lease.token });
  } finally {
    await releaseCheckLock(lease);
  }
}

async function assessSubmission({ root, workspace, session, owner, module, bundle, manifestHash, captured, hashes, help, predictions, assistance, timeout, outputLimit, checkId }) {
  const attempts = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', session.sessionId);
  const previous = await priorAttempt(attempts);
  const attemptId = `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID()}`;
  const destination = join(attempts, attemptId);
  const executionRoot = join(root, 'artifacts/core/executions', session.sessionId, attemptId);
  const custody = {
    ...(predictions ? predictionCustody(predictions, assistance, Boolean(previous?.feedback), help) : {}),
    assistance, help, helpHash: hashes['lab/core/help.json'],
    attemptKind: previous ? 'revision' : 'first', previousAttemptId: previous?.attemptId ?? null,
    priorFeedbackExposure: Boolean(previous?.feedback),
  };
  let evaluationEvidence;
  if (module.id === 'evaluation' && bundle['evaluation/custody.mjs']) {
    const { getEvidenceLinks } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, 'evaluation/custody.mjs')));
    evaluationEvidence = await getEvidenceLinks({ workspace, session });
  }
  await mkdir(destination, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  await writeBundle(join(destination, 'submitted'), captured);
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'assistance.json'), custody);
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'submission.json'), {
    schema: 'courier-core-submission-v1', module: module.id, sessionId: session.sessionId,
    attemptId, checkId, submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(), workspace, ...custody,
    ...(predictions ? { predictions: predictions.document } : {}),
    prompt: owner.prompt, referenceRoot: root, referenceManifest: manifestHash,
    hashes, assistanceHash: sha256(jsonBytes(custody)), ownerExecutionRoot: executionRoot,
    ...(evaluationEvidence === undefined ? {} : { evaluationEvidence }),
    provenance: { policy: `captured ${module.policy}`, fixtures: `sealed ${module.fixtures}`, ...(module.scenario ? {scenario: `captured ${module.scenario}`} : {}), runtime: 'sealed reference bundle in owner execution tree' },
    limits: 'Local reproducible custody, not an OS sandbox against the machine owner. Written responses and self-reported assistance are preserved, not graded.',
  });
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'feedback-started.json'), { startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), note: 'Later submissions are revisions with prior checker feedback exposure, including incomplete runs.' });
  console.log(`Saved attempt: ${destination}`);
  let result;
  try { result = await executeCaptured({ executionRoot, bundle, captured, module, timeout, outputLimit }); }
  catch (error) { result = runnerFailure(error.message); }
  await writeFile(join(destination, 'output.txt'), result.output ?? '', { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'result.json'), result);
  if (bundle[`${module.id}/feedback.mjs`]) {
    const { postCheckFeedback } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, module.id, 'feedback.mjs')));
    const feedback = postCheckFeedback();
    if (predictions) await prepareFreshPractice(workspace, feedback, module.id);
    await saveJson(join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'), { ...feedback, ...(predictions ? { submittedPredictions: predictions.document } : {}), submittedResponse: captured['response.md'].toString('utf8'), note: 'Compare these answers with the captured response. Written reasoning is not automatically graded; append corrections and retain the original.' });
    console.log(`Prediction answers and fresh questions: ${join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json')}`);
  }
  console.log(`Criterion summary: ${result.kind === 'pass' ? 'PASS' : result.kind === 'behavior-failure' ? 'FAIL' : 'RUNNER FAILURE'}`);
  for (const criterion of result.criteria ?? []) {
    console.log(`  ${criterion.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${criterion.name}`);
    if (criterion.error) console.log(`    ${criterion.error.message ?? 'See saved criterion evidence.'}`);
    if (criterion.error?.source) console.log(`    Source: ${sourcePointer(criterion.error.source)}`);
  }
  if (result.error) console.log(`  ${result.error.message}`);
  console.log(`Evidence: ${join(destination, 'result.json')}\nWritten response and help are saved, not graded. Owner runtime and fixtures remain outside the learner workspace.`);
  return { ...result, destination, attemptId };
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/lock.mjs`:

```mjs
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { lstat, mkdir, readdir, rename, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { regularFile, saveJson } from './trust.mjs';

function alive(pid) {
  try { process.kill(pid, 0); return true; }
  catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 'ESRCH') return false;
    if (error.code === 'EPERM') return true;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function lockOwner(lock) {
  let owner;
  try { owner = JSON.parse(await regularFile(lock, 'owner.json')); }
  catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`Check lock metadata is incomplete. Retry shortly; no work was removed. (${error.message})`);
  }
  if (owner.schema !== 'courier-core-lock-v1' || !Number.isSafeInteger(owner.pid) || owner.pid < 1 || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(owner.token)) throw new Error('Check lock metadata is incomplete. Retry shortly; no work was removed.');
  return owner;
}

async function recordInterruption({ root, sessionId, owner }) {
  const attempts = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId);
  let entries;
  try { entries = await readdir(attempts, { withFileTypes: true }); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; }
  const interrupted = [];
  for (const entry of entries.filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory())) {
    let submission;
    try { submission = JSON.parse(await regularFile(attempts, `${entry.name}/submission.json`)); }
    catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') continue; throw error; }
    if (submission.checkId !== owner.token) continue;
    try { await regularFile(attempts, `${entry.name}/result.json`); continue; }
    catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
    const record = {
      schema: 'courier-core-interruption-v1', attemptId: submission.attemptId,
      checkId: owner.token, ownerPid: owner.pid, recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      reason: 'The previous checker process is no longer running. Its saved submission and any feedback exposure remain unchanged.',
    };
    try { await saveJson(join(attempts, entry.name, 'interrupted.json'), record); }
    catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error; }
    interrupted.push(submission.attemptId);
  }
  return interrupted;
}

async function recoverLock({ lock, ownerSession, root, sessionId }) {
  const recovery = join(lock, 'recovery');
  const recoveryToken = randomUUID();
  try { await mkdir(recovery, { mode: 0o700 }); }
  catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return;
    if (error.code === 'EEXIST') throw new Error('Check lock recovery is already in progress or has incomplete metadata. Retry shortly; no work was removed.');
    throw error;
  }
  let moved = false;
  try {
    await saveJson(join(recovery, 'owner.json'), { token: recoveryToken, pid: process.pid });
    // Read the owner only after claiming this lock generation. A competing
    // recovery may have replaced the path before this claim was acquired.
    const owner = await lockOwner(lock);
    if (alive(owner.pid)) throw new Error(`A check is already running for this session (PID ${owner.pid}). Retry when it finishes; no work was removed.`);
    const interrupted = await recordInterruption({ root, sessionId, owner });
    await saveJson(join(recovery, 'recovery.json'), {
      schema: 'courier-core-lock-recovery-v1', recoveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      previousOwner: owner, recoveredByPid: process.pid, interruptedAttempts: interrupted,
    });
    const archives = join(ownerSession, 'recovered-locks');
    await mkdir(archives, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    await rename(lock, join(archives, `${owner.token}-${recoveryToken}`));
    moved = true;
  } finally {
    if (!moved) {
      let current;
      try { current = JSON.parse(await regularFile(recovery, 'owner.json')); }
      catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
      if (current?.token === recoveryToken) await rm(recovery, { recursive: true });
    }
  }
}

export async function acquireCheckLock({ ownerSession, root, sessionId }) {
  const lock = join(ownerSession, 'checking');
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      await mkdir(lock, { mode: 0o700 });
      const owner = { schema: 'courier-core-lock-v1', pid: process.pid, token: randomUUID(), createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await saveJson(join(lock, 'owner.json'), owner);
      const stat = await lstat(lock);
      return { lock, token: owner.token, inode: stat.ino };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;
    }
    await recoverLock({ lock, ownerSession, root, sessionId });
  }
  throw new Error('Another checker acquired this session. Retry shortly; no work was removed.');
}

export async function releaseCheckLock(lease) {
  let owner;
  try { owner = await lockOwner(lease.lock); }
  catch { return; }
  if (owner.token !== lease.token || (await lstat(lease.lock)).ino !== lease.inode) return;
  await rm(lease.lock, { recursive: true });
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/predictions.mjs`:

```mjs
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

export const PREDICTION_CONTRACT = 'courier-predictions-v1';
const bytes = (value) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n');
const save = (path, value) => writeFile(path, bytes(value), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
const identity = () => `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID()}`;

export async function loadPredictionFeedback(root, module) {
  const path = module === 'spatial' ? 'lab' : module === 'order' ? 'lab/order' : module;
  return import(pathToFileURL(join(root, path, 'feedback.mjs')));
}

export function predictionTemplate(feedback, module, stage = 'prediction') {
  return {
    schema: PREDICTION_CONTRACT, module, stage,
    predictions: feedback.predictions.map(({ id, question, freshVariant }) => ({
      id, question: stage === 'fresh' ? freshVariant.question : question, answer: '', skipReason: '',
    })),
  };
}

/** Require a committed answer or a deliberate skip, never infer prose correctness. */
export function validatePredictions(raw, expected) {
  let document;
  try { document = JSON.parse(raw); }
  catch { throw new Error('Save valid JSON in the prediction file; its draft has been preserved.'); }
  if (document?.schema !== expected.schema || document.module !== expected.module || document.stage !== expected.stage || !Array.isArray(document.predictions)) throw new Error('Prediction identity changed; keep its original schema, module and stage.');
  if (document.predictions.length !== expected.predictions.length) throw new Error('Keep every original prediction question exactly once.');
  for (const [index, question] of expected.predictions.entries()) {
    const submitted = document.predictions[index];
    if (!submitted || submitted.id !== question.id || submitted.question !== question.question) throw new Error(`Keep the exact original id and wording for prediction ${question.id}.`);
    if (typeof submitted.answer !== 'string' || (submitted.skipReason !== undefined && typeof submitted.skipReason !== 'string')) throw new Error(`Prediction ${question.id} needs a text answer or explicit skipReason.`);
    if (submitted.answer.length > 20000 || (submitted.skipReason?.length ?? 0) > 10000) throw new Error(`Prediction ${question.id} exceeds the text limit.`);
    const answered = Boolean(submitted.answer.trim());
    const skipped = Boolean(submitted.skipReason?.trim());
    if (answered === skipped) throw new Error(`Prediction ${question.id}: fill answer OR an explicit skipReason before checking.`);
  }
  const skippedIds = document.predictions.filter((item) => item.skipReason?.trim()).map((item) => item.id);
  return { document, skippedIds, answeredCount: document.predictions.length - skippedIds.length, graded: false };
}

export function predictionCustody(predictions, assistance, priorFeedbackExposure = false, help = {}) {
  const skipped = predictions.skippedIds.length > 0;
  const assisted = skipped || priorFeedbackExposure || assistance.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'none' || (help.consulted?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  return {
    predictionStatus: skipped ? 'assisted-skipped' : 'answered',
    skippedQuestionIds: predictions.skippedIds,
    assistanceClass: assisted ? 'assisted' : 'self-reported-unaided',
    proseGraded: false,
  };
}

const capturedHashes = (captured) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(captured).map(([path, content]) => [path, createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex')]));

async function saveCaptured(destination, captured) {
  await mkdir(join(destination, 'submitted'), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  for (const [path, content] of Object.entries(captured)) {
    await mkdir(dirname(join(destination, 'submitted', path)), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    await writeFile(join(destination, 'submitted', path), content, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
  }
}

export async function preservePredictionRefusal({ directory, captured, assistance, module, stage, error }) {
  const refusalId = identity();
  const destination = join(directory, refusalId);
  await saveCaptured(destination, captured);
  const result = { schema: 'courier-prediction-refusal-v1', refusalId, module, stage, hashes: capturedHashes(captured), submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(), kind: 'submission-refused', graded: false, healthy: false, passed: false, assistance, feedbackReleased: false, error: { message: error.message } };
  await save(join(destination, 'result.json'), result);
  console.log(`Submission refused: ${error.message}\nDraft preserved without grading or answer release: ${destination}`);
  return { ...result, destination };
}

export async function prepareFreshPractice(workspace, feedback, module) {
  try { await save(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json'), predictionTemplate(feedback, module, 'fresh')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error; }
}

async function latestCommitted(directory, requireFeedback = true) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true }); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return null; throw error; }
  for (const entry of entries.filter((item) => item.isDirectory()).sort((a, b) => b.name.localeCompare(a.name))) {
    try {
      const submission = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, entry.name, 'submission.json')));
      if (requireFeedback) await readFile(join(directory, entry.name, 'prediction-feedback.json'));
      return submission;
    } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  }
  return null;
}

/** A second commit is required before fresh-answer feedback; it never scores prose. */
export async function submitFreshPractice({ workspace, root, module, captured, assistance, attempts, directory, refusals, help = {} }) {
  const source = await latestCommitted(attempts);
  const { postCheckFeedback, reviewerFeedback } = await loadPredictionFeedback(root, module);
  const feedback = postCheckFeedback();
  let predictions;
  try {
    if (!source) throw new Error('Complete a source check before submitting fresh practice.');
    predictions = validatePredictions(captured['fresh-practice.json'], predictionTemplate(feedback, module, 'fresh'));
  } catch (error) { return preservePredictionRefusal({ directory: refusals, captured, assistance, module, stage: 'fresh', error }); }
  const previous = await latestCommitted(directory, false);
  const attemptId = identity();
  const destination = join(directory, attemptId);
  // Save every submitted byte before loading or writing any fresh answer key.
  await saveCaptured(destination, captured);
  const custody = predictionCustody(predictions, assistance, Boolean(previous), help);
  await save(join(destination, 'submission.json'), { schema: 'courier-fresh-practice-submission-v1', attemptId, module, submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(), sourceAttemptId: source.attemptId, referenceRoot: root, referenceManifest: source.referenceManifest, prompt: source.prompt, sessionId: source.sessionId ?? null, hashes: capturedHashes(captured), attemptKind: previous ? 'revision' : 'first', previousAttemptId: previous?.attemptId ?? null, priorFeedbackExposure: Boolean(previous), assistance, help, ...custody, predictions: predictions.document });
  await save(join(destination, 'feedback-started.json'), { startedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  const reviewer = reviewerFeedback();
  const answers = reviewer.freshVariantAnswers ?? reviewer.freshVariants;
  if (!Array.isArray(answers)) throw new Error('This module has no fresh-practice answer key.');
  const freshVariantAnswers = feedback.predictions.map((item) => {
    const keyed = answers.find(({ id }) => id === item.id);
    if (!keyed?.answer) throw new Error(`Fresh-practice answer missing for ${item.id}.`);
    return { id: item.id, question: item.freshVariant.question, submitted: predictions.document.predictions.find(({ id }) => id === item.id), answer: keyed.answer, reason: keyed.reason ?? keyed.answer, source: item.source };
  });
  await save(join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'), { schema: 1, module, freshVariantAnswers, proseGraded: false, note: 'Compare the captured answer with the key and governing reason. This is feedback, not a score of prose correctness.' });
  const result = { kind: 'practice-recorded', healthy: true, passed: true, graded: false, sourceAttemptId: source.attemptId, ...custody };
  await save(join(destination, 'result.json'), result);
  console.log(`Fresh practice saved before feedback: ${destination}\nCompare your captured answers: ${join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json')}`);
  return { ...result, destination, attemptId };
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, realpath } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { PREDICTION_CONTRACT, loadPredictionFeedback, predictionTemplate } from './predictions.mjs';
import { moduleFor } from './registry.mjs';
import { snapshotReference } from './snapshot.mjs';
import { jsonBytes, saveJson, sha256, verifyReference, writeBundle } from './trust.mjs';

export async function prepareWorkspace({ root, id, name }) {
  root = await realpath(root);
  const module = moduleFor(id);
  if (name !== undefined && !/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$/.test(name)) throw new Error('Workspace name must use 1–40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.');
  const reference = await verifyReference(root);
  const { bundle, manifestHash } = reference;
  for (const path of Object.entries(module).filter(([key]) => !['id', 'scenario'].includes(key)).map(([, value]) => value)) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(bundle, path)) throw new Error(`Sealed module is missing ${path}.`);
  }
  const prompt = JSON.parse(bundle[module.prompt]);
  if (!prompt.id || !prompt.version) throw new Error('The prompt must declare an id and version.');
  const referenceRoot = await snapshotReference({ root, ...reference });
  const workspace = join(root, 'artifacts/core', `${id}${name ? `-${name}` : ''}-workspace`);
  await mkdir(dirname(workspace), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  try { await mkdir(workspace, { mode: 0o700 }); }
  catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 'EEXIST') throw new Error(`A workspace already exists at ${workspace}. Existing work was preserved.`);
    throw error;
  }
  const hasPredictions = Boolean(bundle[`${id}/feedback.mjs`]);
  const feedback = hasPredictions ? (await loadPredictionFeedback(referenceRoot, id)).postCheckFeedback() : null;
  const sessionId = randomUUID();
  const session = {
    schema: 'courier-core-session-v1', sessionId, module: id,
    ...(hasPredictions ? { predictionContract: PREDICTION_CONTRACT } : {}),
    referenceRoot, referenceManifest: manifestHash,
  };
  const sessionBytes = jsonBytes(session);
  const scaffold = {
    [module.policy]: bundle[module.template],
    [module.guide]: bundle[module.guide],
    [module.prompt]: bundle[module.prompt],
    'response.md': bundle[module.response],
    ...(hasPredictions ? { 'predictions.json': jsonBytes(predictionTemplate(feedback, id)) } : {}),
    ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(bundle).filter(([path]) => path.startsWith('learning-support/') && path.endsWith('.md'))),
    'lab/core/check.mjs': bundle['lab/core/check.mjs'],
    'lab/core/session.json': sessionBytes,
    'lab/core/help.json': jsonBytes({ consulted: [], note: 'Record hints, AI help, worked examples or reference consultation here.' }),
    'package.json': jsonBytes({
      name: `courier-${id}-learner-workspace`, private: true, type: 'module',
      engines: { node: '>=22' }, scripts: { 'core:check': 'node lab/core/check.mjs', ...(hasPredictions ? { 'core:practice': 'node lab/core/check.mjs --fresh' } : {}) },
    }),
  };
  if (module.scenario) {
    scaffold[module.scenario] = bundle[module.scenarioTemplate];
    scaffold[module.client] = bundle[module.client];
  }
  const ownerSession = join(referenceRoot, 'artifacts/core/sessions', sessionId);
  await mkdir(ownerSession, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  await saveJson(join(ownerSession, 'session.json'), {
    ...session, workspace, preparedAt: new Date().toISOString(), sessionHash: sha256(sessionBytes),
    prompt: { id: prompt.id, version: prompt.version, sha256: sha256(bundle[module.prompt]) },
    guideHash: sha256(bundle[module.guide]),
  });
  await writeBundle(workspace, scaffold);
  return { workspace, sessionId, referenceRoot };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  try {
    if (process.argv.length !== 3 && !(process.argv.length === 5 && process.argv[3] === '--name')) throw new Error('Usage: node lab/core/prepare.mjs <module-id> [--name label]');
    const result = await prepareWorkspace({ root: resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..'), id: process.argv[2], name: process.argv[4] });
    console.log(`Created ${result.workspace}\n\ncd "${result.workspace}"\nRead ${process.argv[2]}/LEARNER.md and complete predictions.json (answer OR skipReason for every exact question), its required source files and response.md.\nRun npm run core:check -- --assistance "none" (or describe help used).\n\nReference answers, fixtures and authoritative attempt history remain outside this workspace.`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Preparation refused: ${error.message}`);
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/recover.mjs`:

```mjs
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { lstat, realpath, rename } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { moduleFor } from './registry.mjs';
import { regularFile, sha256, verifyReference } from './trust.mjs';

function isAlive(pid) {
  try { process.kill(pid, 0); return true; }
  catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 'ESRCH') return false;
    if (error.code === 'EPERM') return true;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function knownPids(lock, relative) {
  let bytes;
  try { bytes = await regularFile(lock, relative); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; }
  // --stopped permits recovery of incomplete JSON. Still honor any PID already
  // written by its initializer, including a valid field in a partial record.
  return [...new Set([...bytes.toString('utf8').matchAll(/"pid"\s*:\s*(\d+)/g)].map((match) => Number(match[1])))].filter((pid) => Number.isSafeInteger(pid) && pid > 0);
}

async function assertStopped(lock) {
  const owners = [
    ...await knownPids(lock, 'owner.json'),
    ...await knownPids(lock, 'recovery/owner.json'),
  ];
  for (const pid of owners) {
    if (isAlive(pid)) throw new Error(`Check or recovery owner PID ${pid} is still alive. Stop all checks before using --stopped; no work was moved.`);
  }
}

async function sessionFor(workspace) {
  const bytes = await regularFile(workspace, 'lab/core/session.json');
  const session = JSON.parse(bytes);
  if (session.schema !== 'courier-core-session-v1' || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(session.sessionId) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(session.referenceManifest)) throw new Error('Invalid prepared session.');
  moduleFor(session.module);
  const root = await realpath(session.referenceRoot);
  await verifyReference(root, session.referenceManifest);
  const ownerSession = join(root, 'artifacts/core/sessions', session.sessionId);
  const owner = JSON.parse(await regularFile(ownerSession, 'session.json'));
  if (owner.workspace !== workspace || owner.referenceRoot !== root || owner.referenceManifest !== session.referenceManifest || owner.module !== session.module || owner.sessionHash !== sha256(bytes)) throw new Error('Prepared session identity changed. No work was moved.');
  return ownerSession;
}

/** Explicit maintenance only; unknown/partial owners are never auto-reaped. */
export async function recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped }) {
  if (stopped !== true) throw new Error('Stop all checks, then pass --stopped to confirm before recovering a lock.');
  workspace = await realpath(workspace);
  const ownerSession = await sessionFor(workspace);
  const lock = join(ownerSession, 'checking');
  let initial;
  try { initial = await lstat(lock, { bigint: true }); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return { recovered: false, workspace }; throw error; }
  if (!initial.isDirectory() || initial.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('Check lock must be a regular directory without symlinks. No work was moved.');
  await assertStopped(lock);
  // Recheck immediately before the one mutation; --stopped is the operator's
  // assertion that no check is starting while ambiguous metadata is examined.
  await assertStopped(lock);
  const current = await lstat(lock, { bigint: true });
  if (current.dev !== initial.dev || current.ino !== initial.ino) throw new Error('The check lock changed during recovery. Retry only after stopping all checks.');
  const archive = join(ownerSession, `checking-recovered-manual-${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID()}`);
  await rename(lock, archive);
  return { recovered: true, workspace, archive };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  try {
    const [workspace, stopped, ...extra] = process.argv.slice(2);
    if (!workspace || stopped !== '--stopped' || extra.length) throw new Error('Stop all checks, then run: node lab/core/recover.mjs <workspace> --stopped');
    const result = await recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true });
    console.log(result.recovered ? `Archived check lock: ${result.archive}\nAll attempts and feedback remain unchanged. You can retry the checker.` : `No check lock exists for ${result.workspace}. All attempts and feedback remain unchanged.`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Recovery refused: ${error.message}`);
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { hashBundle, jsonBytes, readBundle, referenceFiles, REFERENCE_PATH, REFERENCE_SCHEMA } from './trust.mjs';

export async function sealReference(root) {
  const files = await referenceFiles(root);
  const manifest = { schema: REFERENCE_SCHEMA, files: hashBundle(await readBundle(root, files)) };
  await writeFile(join(root, REFERENCE_PATH), jsonBytes(manifest));
  return manifest;
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
  const manifest = await sealReference(root);
  console.log(`Sealed ${Object.keys(manifest.files).length} core reference files. Review and commit ${REFERENCE_PATH}.`);
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/snapshot.mjs`:

```mjs
import { lstat, mkdir, mkdtemp, rename, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { REFERENCE_PATH, verifyReference, writeBundle } from './trust.mjs';

async function directory(root, relative) {
  let current = root;
  for (const part of relative.split('/')) {
    current = join(current, part);
    try { await mkdir(current, { mode: 0o700 }); }
    catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error; }
    const stat = await lstat(current);
    if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || !stat.isDirectory()) throw new Error(`Reference snapshot directory is not a regular directory: ${current}`);
  }
  return current;
}

async function verifySnapshot(path, hash) {
  const stat = await lstat(path);
  if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || !stat.isDirectory()) throw new Error('Reference snapshot must be a directory without symlinks.');
  await verifyReference(path, hash);
  return path;
}

/** Publish once by atomic directory rename. A concurrent publisher must match. */
export async function snapshotReference({ root, bundle, manifestHash, manifestBytes }) {
  const references = await directory(root, 'artifacts/core/references');
  const destination = join(references, manifestHash);
  let existing;
  try { existing = await lstat(destination); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  if (existing) return verifySnapshot(destination, manifestHash);
  const staging = await mkdtemp(join(references, '.pending-'));
  try {
    await writeBundle(staging, bundle);
    await writeFile(join(staging, REFERENCE_PATH), manifestBytes, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
    await verifySnapshot(staging, manifestHash);
    try { await rename(staging, destination); }
    catch (error) {
      if (!['EEXIST', 'ENOTEMPTY'].includes(error.code)) throw error;
      // Another prepare has published this same digest. Never overwrite it.
    }
    return await verifySnapshot(destination, manifestHash);
  } finally {
    await rm(staging, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/trust.mjs`:

```mjs
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { constants } from 'node:fs';
import { lstat, mkdir, open, readdir, realpath, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';

export const REFERENCE_PATH = 'lab/core/reference.json';
export const REFERENCE_SCHEMA = 'courier-core-reference-v1';
const FILE_LIMIT = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const BUNDLE_LIMIT = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
const FILE_COUNT_LIMIT = 1000;
export const sha256 = (bytes) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
export const jsonBytes = (value) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n');
export const saveJson = (path, value) => writeFile(path, jsonBytes(value), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });

async function boundedRead(file, relative) {
  const chunks = [];
  let length = 0;
  while (length <= FILE_LIMIT) {
    const buffer = Buffer.allocUnsafe(Math.min(64 * 1024, FILE_LIMIT + 1 - length));
    const { bytesRead } = await file.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length, length);
    if (!bytesRead) return Buffer.concat(chunks, length);
    chunks.push(buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead));
    length += bytesRead;
  }
  throw new Error(`Not a bounded regular file: ${relative}`);
}

export function safePath(path) {
  if (typeof path !== 'string' || !path || path.includes('\\') || /[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(path)) throw new Error('Invalid relative file path.');
  if (path.split('/').some((part) => !part || part === '.' || part === '..')) throw new Error(`Invalid relative file path: ${path}`);
  return path;
}

/** Refuse symlinks at every component and files replaced during a read. */
export async function regularFile(root, relative) {
  safePath(relative);
  const base = await realpath(root);
  const path = resolve(base, relative);
  if (!path.startsWith(base + sep)) throw new Error(`File escapes its root: ${relative}`);
  const parts = relative.split('/');
  let initial;
  for (let i = 1; i <= parts.length; i += 1) {
    const stat = await lstat(join(base, ...parts.slice(0, i)), { bigint: true });
    if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`Symlinks are not accepted: ${relative}`);
    initial = stat;
  }
  if (!initial.isFile() || initial.size > BigInt(FILE_LIMIT)) throw new Error(`Not a bounded regular file: ${relative}`);
  const file = await open(path, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW | constants.O_NONBLOCK);
  try {
    const before = await file.stat({ bigint: true });
    if (!before.isFile() || before.size > BigInt(FILE_LIMIT)) throw new Error(`Not a bounded regular file: ${relative}`);
    if (before.dev !== initial.dev || before.ino !== initial.ino) throw new Error(`File changed during capture: ${relative}`);
    const bytes = await boundedRead(file, relative);
    const after = await file.stat({ bigint: true });
    const current = await lstat(path, { bigint: true });
    if (!current.isFile() || current.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`File changed during capture: ${relative}`);
    for (const key of ['dev', 'ino', 'size', 'mtimeNs', 'ctimeNs']) {
      if (before[key] !== after[key] || before[key] !== current[key]) throw new Error(`File changed during capture: ${relative}`);
    }
    return bytes;
  } finally {
    await file.close();
  }
}

export async function readBundle(root, paths) {
  if (paths.length > FILE_COUNT_LIMIT) throw new Error('File count exceeds the bundle limit.');
  const bundle = Object.create(null);
  let total = 0;
  for (const path of [...paths].sort()) {
    const bytes = await regularFile(root, path);
    total += bytes.length;
    if (total > BUNDLE_LIMIT) throw new Error('Bundle exceeds its byte limit.');
    bundle[path] = bytes;
  }
  return bundle;
}

export function hashBundle(bundle) {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(bundle).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([path, bytes]) => [path, sha256(bytes)]));
}

export async function writeBundle(root, bundle) {
  for (const [path, bytes] of Object.entries(bundle)) {
    safePath(path);
    await mkdir(dirname(join(root, path)), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    await writeFile(join(root, path), bytes, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
  }
}

/** Double reads detect ordinary concurrent edits; this is not an OS sandbox. */
export async function captureBundle(root, paths, afterRead = async () => {}) {
  const captured = await readBundle(root, paths);
  await afterRead();
  const hashes = hashBundle(captured);
  if (JSON.stringify(hashes) !== JSON.stringify(hashBundle(await readBundle(root, paths)))) throw new Error('Submission changed during capture. Save all files and retry.');
  return { captured, hashes };
}

function excluded(path) {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  if (parts.some((part) => part.startsWith('.') || ['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(part))) return true;
  // The old spatial/order manifests may pin each other. No generated lab seal
  // participates in another seal; actual runtime and judge source still does.
  return path.startsWith('lab/') && path.endsWith('/reference.json');
}

export async function referenceFiles(root, prefix = '') {
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of (await readdir(join(root, prefix), { withFileTypes: true })).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
    const path = prefix + entry.name;
    if (excluded(path)) continue;
    if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`Reference contains a symlink: ${path}`);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...await referenceFiles(root, path + '/'));
    if (entry.isFile() && /\.(?:mjs|cjs|js|json|md)$/i.test(path)) files.push(path);
  }
  return files.sort();
}

export async function verifyReference(root, expectedHash) {
  const bytes = await regularFile(root, REFERENCE_PATH);
  if (expectedHash && sha256(bytes) !== expectedHash) throw new Error('Reference manifest changed since preparation.');
  const manifest = JSON.parse(bytes);
  if (manifest.schema !== REFERENCE_SCHEMA || !manifest.files || Array.isArray(manifest.files) || !Object.keys(manifest.files).length) throw new Error('Core reference is not sealed. Run node lab/core/seal.mjs.');
  const paths = Object.keys(manifest.files).sort();
  for (const path of paths) {
    safePath(path);
    if (excluded(path) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(manifest.files[path])) throw new Error(`Invalid sealed file: ${path}`);
  }
  if (JSON.stringify(paths) !== JSON.stringify(await referenceFiles(root))) throw new Error('Trusted reference inventory changed. Review and reseal the reference.');
  const { captured: bundle, hashes } = await captureBundle(root, paths);
  for (const path of paths) {
    if (hashes[path] !== manifest.files[path]) throw new Error(`Trusted reference changed: ${path}. Review and reseal the reference.`);
  }
  return { manifest, manifestHash: sha256(bytes), manifestBytes: bytes, bundle };
}

export async function hashTree(root, prefix = '') {
  const bundle = Object.create(null);
  for (const entry of (await readdir(join(root, prefix), { withFileTypes: true })).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
    const path = prefix + entry.name;
    if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`Execution contains a symlink: ${path}`);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) Object.assign(bundle, await hashTree(root, path + '/'));
    if (entry.isFile()) bundle[path] = sha256(await regularFile(root, path));
  }
  return bundle;
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/core/worker.mjs`:

```mjs
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

function errorEvidence(error) {
  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') return { message: String(error) };
  const result = {};
  for (const key of ['name', 'message', 'stack', 'code', 'operator', 'expected', 'actual', 'source', 'input']) {
    if (key in error) result[key] = error[key];
  }
  return result;
}

function normalize(assessment) {
  if (!assessment || typeof assessment.passed !== 'boolean' || !Array.isArray(assessment.criteria) || !assessment.criteria.length || assessment.criteria.length > 256) throw new Error('Fixture returned an invalid assessment.');
  const names = new Set();
  const criteria = assessment.criteria.map((criterion) => {
    if (!criterion || typeof criterion.name !== 'string' || !criterion.name.trim() || criterion.name.length > 300 || names.has(criterion.name) || typeof criterion.passed !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Fixture returned an invalid criterion.');
    names.add(criterion.name);
    return { name: criterion.name, passed: criterion.passed, ...(criterion.error === undefined ? {} : { error: errorEvidence(criterion.error) }) };
  });
  if (assessment.passed !== criteria.every((criterion) => criterion.passed)) throw new Error('Fixture summary disagrees with its criteria.');
  return { kind: assessment.passed ? 'pass' : 'behavior-failure', healthy: true, passed: assessment.passed, criteria, ...(assessment.evidence === undefined ? {} : { evidence: assessment.evidence }) };
}

async function main() {
  const send = process.send?.bind(process);
  if (!send) throw new Error('The core worker requires its owner process.');
  const abortOnDisconnect = () => process.exit(1);
  process.once('disconnect', abortOnDisconnect);
  // Prevent accidental or trivial candidate use of the runner result channel.
  process.send = undefined;
  let result;
  try {
    const [policy, fixtures, scenario] = process.argv.slice(2);
    const judge = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(fixtures)));
    if (typeof judge.assess !== 'function') throw new Error('Fixture must export assess(candidate).');
    let candidate = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(policy)));
    if (scenario) {
      candidate = { ...candidate, scenarioPath: resolve(scenario), policyPath: resolve(policy) };
    }
    result = normalize(await judge.assess(candidate, { onCriterion: name => console.log(`Criterion started: ${String(name).slice(0, 300)}`) }));
  } catch (error) {
    result = { kind: 'runner-failure', healthy: false, passed: false, error: errorEvidence(error) };
  }
  // JSON serialization bounds and validates the evidence before it crosses IPC.
  let encoded;
  try {
    encoded = JSON.stringify(result, (_key, value) => typeof value === 'bigint' ? String(value) : value);
    if (Buffer.byteLength(encoded) > 512 * 1024) throw new Error('Fixture result exceeded its evidence budget.');
  } catch (error) {
    encoded = JSON.stringify({ kind: 'runner-failure', healthy: false, passed: false, error: errorEvidence(error) });
  }
  send({ type: 'core-result', result: JSON.parse(encoded) }, () => {
    process.removeListener('disconnect', abortOnDisconnect);
    process.disconnect?.();
  });
}

await main();

```

```md
# Author an admission policy and an HTTP test

Implementation reference for **M2/M3: admission and independent testing**. Start with [the guided learning route at `/learn`](/learn) on the reference server, then return here for the exact source contract. This Markdown file does not submit answers or certify mastery. Use the [support and attempt workflow](../../learning-support/README.md) for worked siblings, gradual guidance and help recording. A prepared source workspace need not serve `/learn`; keep the reference server open for that route.

Your result is two runnable source files: admission.mjs, which the server loads, and learner-scenario.mjs, which exercises actual HTTP. Record required predictions in `predictions.json` and explanations in `response.md`. This is a local owned teaching project, not production anti-cheat.

## Prepare

Run `npm run order:prepare` from the complete reference project, then change into the printed artifacts/order-workspace directory. The working copy has an incomplete policy and scenario. The reference policy, author variants and judging tests stay outside it. Looking at the reference is permitted assistance; record it accurately.

Read the contract below. Fill each required answer or explicit skip reason in `predictions.json` before editing; use `response.md` for your reasoning. Use an editor to implement admission.mjs and learner-scenario.mjs; no code is uploaded through the browser. You can start your completed copy with `npm start`. Stop it with Ctrl-C.

## Policy contract

Inputs have already passed strict parsing. Do not rewrite the parser, engine or clock.

- `admitInput(state,input,tick)` returns `{status,next}`.
- State fields: lastSeq, lastSeen, expiresAt, move, pendingInteract.
- If input.seq is not strictly greater than lastSeq, return status stale with every state field unchanged. A stale input cannot contribute its interaction bit.
- Otherwise return admitted; set lastSeq to the input sequence, lastSeen to tick and expiresAt to tick+4; replace move and OR the existing pendingInteract with input.interact.
- `movementActive(state,tick)` returns whether the intention is still active. T+4 is included, T+5 excluded. Reading state must change nothing.
- The engine owns movement, identity, score, cargo and tick order. No policy result can supply those authorities.

A sequence is an ordering number, not client time. One tick is 50 ms. Movement is continuous only when fresh admissions arrive no more than four ticks apart; a longer gap must stop without catch-up. These controls protect intended behavior. In this instanced game they do not themselves prevent a competitive scoring advantage.

## Your scenario

Export `async function scenario({base,advance})`. Use the supplied HTTP helpers to join, send inputs and read state. `advance` is the bounded owner-side test clock; it is not a gameplay HTTP endpoint. Use ordinary assertions on authoritative state, not only status or error text.

A **seed** is a repeatable fixture selector; a **fixture** is known starting data for a test. A **variant** is a deliberately changed implementation used to test your test. Interaction **coalescing** means that several admitted true interaction bits become one action on the next tick, even if a later input has interact=false.

Cover these contracts with short, understandable cases:

1. Newer input followed by older conflicting input: the older request changes neither direction nor staged interaction.
2. Duplicate retry: it has no repeated effect and produces no finding.
3. Expiry: exactly four movement steps, then stop; a later request resumes without catch-up.
4. Renewal at T+4: the next step still happens.
5. State polling: reading snapshots does not keep movement alive.
6. Legitimate clumping/reordering: at most one interaction per tick; predictable state at named ticks; no cheating inference from a transport retry.

Each scenario starts a fresh server at tick 0 and runs once for each seed in `lab/order/seeds.json`: 17, 31 and 99. All actors spawn at (1000,1000). The core is at (2500,1000), (2250,1000) and (2000,1000), respectively. Read `snapshot.core` when your scenario needs its location. Cardinal movement is 250 mm per active tick. Keep timing tests away from the wall so collision cannot hide an expiry bug. `advance(n)` accepts integers from 1 through 100, with at most 400 total ticks per scenario. You may join at most four actors per run.

The supplied helpers return parsed values. `input(base,token,seq,move,interact)` returns the HTTP response with `status` and `data`; `state(base,token)` returns the snapshot itself. This observation-only example does not solve an assessment case:

```js
const { token } = await join(base);
const seen = await state(base, token);
// seen.tick: 0
// seen.actor: {id, x:1000, y:1000, score:0, cargo:false,
//              lastSeq:0, expiresAt:0, nextInteractTick:0}
// seen.core: {x, y}; seen.depot: {x:1000, y:1000}
// seen.lastDecision: null; seen.findings: []
```

### From an observation to a test

An **assertion** compares a returned value with the contract's expected value and throws when they disagree. A **Promise** represents an operation whose result becomes available later. An `async` function permits `await` inside it; `await` pauses that function until the operation finishes. Awaiting HTTP does not itself advance this test clock. Only `advance(n)` asks the owner to process n ticks.

This complete sibling example checks the remote-pickup rule you already learned in M1. It does not test ordering, expiry or any of this module's seven variants. In a fresh run the core is at least 1000 mm from the actor, outside the 250 mm interaction radius:

```js
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { join, input, state } from './clients/http-client.mjs';

export async function scenario({ base, advance }) {
  const { token } = await join(base);
  const response = await input(base, token, 1, 'idle', true);
  assert.equal(response.status, 200, 'well-shaped input reaches admission');
  await advance(1);
  const seen = await state(base, token);
  assert.equal(seen.actor.cargo, false, 'remote pickup must not grant cargo');
  assert.equal(seen.lastDecision.reason, 'range', 'owner denies distant interaction');
}
```

Read it as arrange (join), act (request then tick), observe (state), assert (compare). HTTP 200 means the input request was handled; the later authoritative decision can still deny the pickup. Checking HTTP status alone would miss an erroneous cargo grant. A failed `assert.equal` reports expected and actual values; preserve that evidence rather than catching and ignoring it.

Completion practice: from a new actor, send one idle interaction, advance one tick, read state, then finish `assert.equal(seen.actor.score, ___, 'remote pickup cannot award a score')`. Predict before running. Use the M1 rule to explain the value. Keep this practice separate from your independent ordering scenario; a passing copy of the worked example cannot discriminate the seven ordering defects.

After an interaction is applied or denied, `lastDecision` is `{status,reason,tick}`. Status is `applied` or `denied`; reasons are `pickup`, `deposit`, `range` or `cooldown`. `findings` contains advisory records. Reading a snapshot must not change any of these fields.

Your scenario is checked against these seven deliberate defects, separately: `equal-seq-admitted` (duplicate changes intent), `stale-admitted` (older input changes intent), `stale-interact` (stale input stages interaction), `expiry-T+3` (one tick too early), `expiry-T+5` (one tick too late), `read-renews` (state polling extends intent), and `stale-finding` (retries create advisory findings). A single assertion need not catch all seven; the complete scenario must. Both correct implementations must pass.

## Submit, inspect, repair

Use [the HTTP construction companion](../../learning-support/http-tests.md) for the full sequence from a solved M1 sibling, through two completion steps, to an independent ordering case. Its final source scenario is deliberately absent.

## Build in four checked milestones

| Milestone | Evidence to inspect |
| --- | --- |
| Pure admission | Hand-trace one newer request, one equal sequence and one older conflicting request. Compare every returned state field, including a previously pending interaction. |
| Expiry decision | Evaluate the same admitted state at T+4 and T+5 without mutating it. In `/learn`, complete the boundary check before using this predicate in a scenario. |
| One HTTP observation | Run the remote-pickup sibling, then complete its score and idle-position assertions. Explain why a handled input can still produce a denied interaction. |
| Independent scenario | Map each required behavior to an observed field and a separating tick. Use `order:check` to inspect correct controls and surviving wrong variants. Add missing observations instead of weakening correct-control expectations. |

An admission sibling: with `lastSeq:2` and `pendingInteract:true`, a newer idle request with `interact:false` still leaves one pending interaction. Coalescing preserves that already staged request until the engine consumes it. Completion: with an existing west direction and sequence 7, fill every state field after an older east request with `interact:true`; use the stale rule, not the spelling of the direction. Then implement the general branch for independently supplied inputs.

<details><summary>Hint 1 — find the first changed authority</summary>

Separate parsing, admission and engine ticks. Your policy controls admission fields; it cannot grant cargo, score or position directly. This makes a snapshot mismatch easier to trace back to its cause.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 2 — observe private intent through later state</summary>

The snapshot does not expose the private direction or staged interaction directly. Arrange a later tick that makes the intended difference visible as movement or an interaction result. Keep that test away from a wall.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 3 — worked sibling, after a saved attempt</summary>

In the M1 sibling, an idle interaction has HTTP 200 but the next snapshot has `cargo:false` and a `range` denial. The request and its effect are separate observations. Record the companion as assistance, then choose the distinct state observation needed by your ordering case.

</details>

The console prints a JSON evidence path for every component and scenario run. Open that file for its named criteria, expected/actual values and runtime trace. The neighboring `.output.txt` file retains raw process output.

The command captures your source files, response, original prompt/version, help, seed data and trusted runtime identity. Tests use those captured bytes. Changed files during capture refuse a submission. A missing/changed trusted reference refuses grading. An import error, crashed server or timeout is a failed run, not a detected mutant. Every attempt and later revision remains distinct. Use the first failed criterion and raw observed/expected values to diagnose the relevant file.

The files are local and editable by their owner. This preserves evidence for review; it cannot certify honesty against someone who controls the machine. Explanation quality and transfer are not automatically graded.

```mjs
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const workspace = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const fresh = args[0] === '--fresh';
if (fresh) args.shift();
if (args.length !== 2 || args[0] !== '--assistance' || !args[1]?.trim()) {
  console.error('Record help used: node lab/order/check.mjs --assistance "none" (or describe it).');
  process.exitCode = 2;
} else {
  try {
    const session = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'lab/order/session.json'), 'utf8'));
    if (!session.prepared || session.exercise !== 'courier-order-01') throw new Error('Invalid prepared session.');
    // Verify bytes before importing even the reference verification helper.
    const manifestBytes = await readFile(join(session.referenceRoot, 'lab/order/reference.json'));
    const hash = (bytes) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
    if (hash(manifestBytes) !== session.referenceManifest) throw new Error('Reference manifest changed since preparation.');
    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestBytes);
    if (manifest.schema !== 'courier-order-reference-v1') throw new Error('Invalid reference manifest.');
    for (const [path, expected] of Object.entries(manifest.files)) {
      if (path.startsWith('/') || path.split('/').includes('..')) throw new Error('Invalid reference path.');
      if (hash(await readFile(join(session.referenceRoot, path))) !== expected) throw new Error(`Trusted reference changed: ${path}`);
    }
    // Execute the judge from the reference, never a workspace-supplied test or fixture.
    const { verifyReference } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(session.referenceRoot, 'lab/trust.mjs')));
    await verifyReference(session.referenceRoot, session.referenceManifest);
    const { checkSubmission } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(session.referenceRoot, 'lab/order/grade.mjs')));
    const result = await checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance: args[1], fresh });
    process.exitCode = result.kind === 'submission-refused' ? 2 : result.passed ? 0 : 1;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Submission refused: ${error.message}\nPrepare a workspace from the sealed reference with node lab/order/prepare.mjs.`);
    process.exitCode = 2;
  }
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/lab/order/grade.mjs`:

```mjs
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, rename, readFile, readdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { captureBundle, hashTree, saveJson, sha256, verifyReference, writeBundle } from '../trust.mjs';
import { PREDICTION_CONTRACT, loadPredictionFeedback, predictionTemplate, validatePredictions, predictionCustody, preservePredictionRefusal, prepareFreshPractice, submitFreshPractice } from '../core/predictions.mjs';
import { CORRECT_VARIANTS, WRONG_VARIANTS, variantFiles } from '../../author/order/variants.mjs';

export const SUBMITTED_FILES = ['admission.mjs', 'learner-scenario.mjs', 'response.md', 'lab/order/prompt.json', 'lab/order/help.json', 'lab/order/seeds.json', 'lab/order/session.json'];

async function previousAttempt(directory) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = await readdir(directory); } catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return null; throw error; }
  let latest = null;
  let priorFeedbackExposure = false;
  for (const name of entries.sort().reverse()) {
    try {
      const submission = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, name, 'submission.json'), 'utf8'));
      latest ??= submission.attemptId;
      try { await readFile(join(directory, name, 'feedback-started.json')); priorFeedbackExposure = true; } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
    } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  }
  return latest ? { attemptId: latest, feedbackRecorded: priorFeedbackExposure } : null;
}

function runWorker(root, mode, seed, timeout = 25000) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const env = { ...process.env };
    delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
    const child = fork(join(root, 'author/order/worker.mjs'), [mode, String(seed)], { cwd: root, env, detached: true, execArgv: [], stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ipc'] });
    let output = '';
    let result;
    let forced;
    function terminate(reason) {
      forced = reason;
      try { process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL'); } catch { child.kill('SIGKILL'); }
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => terminate('Worker timed out.'), timeout);
    for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr]) stream.on('data', (bytes) => {
      output += bytes;
      if (Buffer.byteLength(output) > 1024 * 1024) terminate('Worker exceeded its output budget.');
    });
    child.on('message', (message) => { if (message?.type === 'result') result = message.result; });
    child.once('error', (error) => { forced = error.message; });
    child.once('close', (code, signal) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (forced || code !== 0 || !result) result = { kind: 'runner-failure', healthy: false, error: { message: forced ?? `Worker exited without a complete result (${code ?? signal}).` } };
      resolve({ ...result, exit: { code, signal }, output: output.slice(0, 1024 * 1024) });
    });
  });
}

export async function executeVariant({ destination, executionRoot = join(destination, 'execution'), bundle, captured, mode, variant, seed, timeout }) {
  const root = join(executionRoot, mode, variant, String(seed));
  await mkdir(root, { recursive: true });
  const files = { ...bundle, ...variantFiles(variant, bundle['admission.mjs'].toString(), bundle['engine.mjs'].toString()) };
  files['learner-scenario.mjs'] = captured['learner-scenario.mjs'];
  if (mode === 'component') files['admission.mjs'] = captured['admission.mjs'];
  await writeBundle(root, files);
  const before = await hashTree(root);
  let result = await runWorker(root, mode, seed, timeout);
  const after = await hashTree(root);
  if (JSON.stringify(before) !== JSON.stringify(after)) result = { ...result, kind: 'runner-failure', healthy: false, error: { message: 'Execution files changed while running.' } };
  const evidence = { mode, variant, seed, executionRoot: root, ...result, hashes: before, afterHashes: after };
  const prefix = `${mode}-${variant}-${seed}`;
  await saveJson(join(destination, prefix + '.json'), evidence);
  await writeFile(join(destination, prefix + '.output.txt'), result.output, { flag: 'wx' });
  return evidence;
}

export function assessResults(component, scenarios, seeds = [17, 31, 99]) {
  const componentPassed = component.length === seeds.length && seeds.every((seed) => component.some((result) => result.seed === seed && result.kind === 'pass'));
  const correct = scenarios.filter((result) => CORRECT_VARIANTS.includes(result.variant));
  const wrong = scenarios.filter((result) => WRONG_VARIANTS.includes(result.variant));
  const correctPassed = correct.length === CORRECT_VARIANTS.length * seeds.length && CORRECT_VARIANTS.every((variant) => seeds.every((seed) => correct.some((result) => result.variant === variant && result.seed === seed && result.kind === 'pass')));
  const wrongDetected = wrong.length === WRONG_VARIANTS.length * seeds.length && WRONG_VARIANTS.every((variant) => seeds.every((seed) => wrong.some((result) => result.variant === variant && result.seed === seed && result.kind === 'assertion' && result.healthy)));
  return { componentPassed, scenarioPassed: correctPassed && wrongDetected, correctPassed, wrongDetected, passed: componentPassed && correctPassed && wrongDetected };
}

export async function checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance, fresh = false }) {
  const { bundle, manifest, manifestHash } = await verifyReference(session.referenceRoot, session.referenceManifest);
  if (bundle['lab/core/predictions.mjs'] && session.predictionContract !== PREDICTION_CONTRACT) throw new Error('Prepared prediction contract changed. Restore the original session.');
  const previous = await previousAttempt(join(workspace, 'artifacts/order-attempts'));
  const attemptId = `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID()}`;
  let destination = join(workspace, session.predictionContract === PREDICTION_CONTRACT ? 'artifacts/order-captures' : 'artifacts/order-attempts', attemptId);
  const executionRoot = join(session.referenceRoot, 'artifacts/order-executions', attemptId);
  await mkdir(destination, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const paths = [...SUBMITTED_FILES];
  if (session.predictionContract === PREDICTION_CONTRACT) {
    const file = fresh ? 'fresh-practice.json' : 'predictions.json';
    try { await readFile(join(workspace, file)); paths.push(file); } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
  }
  const { captured, hashes } = await captureBundle(workspace, paths, join(destination, 'submitted'));
  if (JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(captured['lab/order/session.json'])) !== JSON.stringify(session)) throw new Error('Prepared session changed during submission. Retry with a stable workspace.');
  if (sha256(captured['lab/order/prompt.json']) !== manifest.files['lab/order/prompt.json']) throw new Error('Prompt changed; restore its original wording before submitting.');
  if (sha256(captured['lab/order/seeds.json']) !== manifest.files['lab/order/seeds.json']) throw new Error('Assessment seeds changed; restore the prepared seed list.');
  const help = JSON.parse(captured['lab/order/help.json']);
  let predictions;
  if (fresh && session.predictionContract !== PREDICTION_CONTRACT) throw new Error('Fresh practice requires a newly prepared workspace.');
  if (session.predictionContract === PREDICTION_CONTRACT) {
    const attempts = join(workspace, 'artifacts/order-attempts');
    const refusals = join(workspace, 'artifacts/order-refusals');
    if (fresh) return submitFreshPractice({ workspace, root: session.referenceRoot, module: 'order', captured, assistance, attempts, directory: join(workspace, 'artifacts/order-practice'), refusals, help });
    const feedback = (await loadPredictionFeedback(session.referenceRoot, 'order')).postCheckFeedback();
    try { predictions = validatePredictions(captured['predictions.json'], predictionTemplate(feedback, 'order')); }
    catch (error) { return preservePredictionRefusal({ directory: refusals, captured, assistance, module: 'order', stage: 'prediction', error }); }
    await mkdir(attempts, { recursive: true });
    const committed = join(attempts, attemptId);
    await rename(destination, committed);
    destination = committed;
  }
  const { seeds } = JSON.parse(captured['lab/order/seeds.json']);
  const prompt = JSON.parse(captured['lab/order/prompt.json']);
  const custody = {
    ...(predictions ? predictionCustody(predictions, assistance, Boolean(previous?.feedbackRecorded), help) : {}),
    assistance, help, attemptKind: previous ? 'revision' : 'first', previousAttemptId: previous?.attemptId ?? null,
    priorFeedbackExposure: Boolean(previous?.feedbackRecorded),
    note: 'Prior recorded feedback is tracked independently of the self-reported assistance declaration.',
  };
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'submitted/assistance.json'), custody);
  hashes['assistance.json'] = sha256(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(custody, null, 2) + '\n'));
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'submission.json'), {
    schema: 'courier-order-submission-v1', attemptId, submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ...custody,
    ...(predictions ? { predictions: predictions.document } : {}),
    referenceRoot: session.referenceRoot, referenceManifest: manifestHash, prompt: { id: prompt.id, version: prompt.version }, seeds, hashes,
    ownerExecutionRoot: executionRoot,
    provenance: { runtime: 'sealed reference bundle', componentFixtures: 'sealed author/order/component-fixtures.mjs and clients/schedules.mjs', scenario: 'captured learner-scenario.mjs', variants: 'sealed author/order/variants.mjs; materialized only in execution copies' },
    limits: 'Local reproducible custody, not an OS sandbox against a malicious machine owner. Written predictions/explanations are preserved and ungraded.',
  });
  console.log(`Saved attempt: ${destination}`);
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'feedback-started.json'), { startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), note: 'Subsequent runs are revisions with prior checker feedback exposure, including incomplete runs.' });
  const component = [];
  const scenarios = [];
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const result = await executeVariant({ destination, executionRoot, bundle, captured, mode: 'component', variant: 'submitted-component', seed });
    component.push(result);
    console.log(`Component seed ${seed}: ${result.kind}`);
    for (const criterion of result.criteria ?? []) console.log(`  ${criterion.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${criterion.name}`);
    console.log(`  Evidence: ${join(destination, `component-submitted-component-${seed}.json`)}`);
  }
  for (const variant of [...CORRECT_VARIANTS, ...WRONG_VARIANTS]) {
    for (const seed of seeds) {
      const result = await executeVariant({ destination, executionRoot, bundle, captured, mode: 'scenario', variant, seed });
      scenarios.push(result);
      const label = WRONG_VARIANTS.includes(variant) && result.kind === 'assertion' ? 'detected by assertion' : result.kind;
      console.log(`Scenario ${variant}, seed ${seed}: ${label}`);
      console.log(`  Evidence: ${join(destination, `scenario-${variant}-${seed}.json`)}`);
    }
  }
  const verdict = assessResults(component, scenarios);
  await saveJson(join(destination, 'result.json'), { ...verdict, component: component.map(summary), scenarios: scenarios.map(summary) });
  if (bundle['lab/order/feedback.mjs']) {
    const { postCheckFeedback } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(session.referenceRoot, 'lab/order/feedback.mjs')));
    const feedback = postCheckFeedback();
    if (predictions) await prepareFreshPractice(workspace, feedback, 'order');
    await saveJson(join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'), { ...feedback, ...(predictions ? { submittedPredictions: predictions.document } : {}), submittedResponse: captured['response.md'].toString('utf8') });
    console.log(`Compare your captured response with answers and fresh practice: ${join(destination, 'prediction-feedback.json')}`);
  }
  console.log(`\nCriterion summary: component ${verdict.componentPassed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}; scenario ${verdict.scenarioPassed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}.`);
  const failure = [...component, ...scenarios].find((item) => item.kind !== 'pass' && !(WRONG_VARIANTS.includes(item.variant) && item.kind === 'assertion'));
  if (failure) {
    const error = failure.error ?? failure.criteria?.find((item) => !item.passed)?.error;
    console.log(`First failed phase: ${failure.mode}/${failure.variant}/seed ${failure.seed}. ${error?.message ?? 'See criterion evidence.'}`);
    if (error && (Object.hasOwn(error, 'expected') || Object.hasOwn(error, 'actual'))) console.log(`Expected: ${JSON.stringify(error.expected)}\nObserved: ${JSON.stringify(error.actual)}`);
  }
  const missed = scenarios.find((item) => WRONG_VARIANTS.includes(item.variant) && item.kind === 'pass');
  if (missed) console.log(`Undetected behavior: ${missed.variant}, seed ${missed.seed}. Add an assertion on the state that this rule protects.`);
  console.log('Each per-variant JSON preserves expected/actual, runtime trace and byte hashes; .output.txt preserves raw output. Predictions and explanations are saved but ungraded.');
  console.log(`Runtime copies stay in the reference at ${executionRoot}. Consulting reference or author source is assistance.`);
  return { ...verdict, destination };
}

function summary({ mode, variant, seed, kind, error, criteria }) {
  return { mode, variant, seed, kind, error, criteria: criteria?.map(({ name, passed, error }) => ({ name, passed, error })) };
}
