# Telemetry author and integration notes

`runtime.mjs` wraps the existing engine without changing its v1 record/replay API. It is dependency-free browser-compatible JavaScript; its only import is `../engine.mjs`, which uses the existing pure admission and detector modules. Expose those modules through an explicit server allowlist if using browser playback.

Exports:

- `RUNTIME_RELEASE`: `courier-runtime-1`.
- `MAX_WINDOW_EVENTS`: `256`.
- `capture(world)` and `restore(checkpoint)`: detached causal state, strict schema validation, no old history or transport credentials. Unknown mutant selections are refused.
- `createReplayEngine()`: frozen `{release,restore,apply,canonical,equal}` facade. `apply` mutates the restored world, accepting only declared `join`, `input` and one-tick events; stale valid input remains causal evidence.
- `createRecordedEngine(seed,{capacity=128,mutant})`: `{world,join,admit,advance,window}`. `join()` returns the original actor; `admit(id,input)` preserves the engine's return value; `advance(n)` accepts 1–100 ticks and records each separately. All mutations must use the wrappers; `.world` remains available to existing snapshot/owner code. `window()` returns a detached complete window. Optional `mutant` forwards the existing owner-test-only selection; it is never recorded in a checkpoint. The replay facade uses normal rules, so altered behavior may fail its final-state comparison.

`startIndex` denotes the last operation before the window, so entries are `startIndex+1` through `endIndex`. On overflow, checkpoint capture happens before the next accepted operation and indices keep increasing. Rejected admissions, failed joins and invalid advance requests do not consume indices or replace the window. Safe-integer limits refuse counter overflow. The new window stores at most the configured capacity, while the unchanged engine still keeps its bounded 4096-event v1 history.

Checkpoints preserve intent, pending interactions, sequence, expiry, cooldown, last decision, all 20 detector buckets and at most 128 findings per actor. Validation checks shape, ranges, runtime constants, sequential actor identities and local consistency. It does not prove that a structurally valid checkpoint has an authentic producer or that every possible checkpoint was reached by a historical session. `final` is the existing public canonical gameplay state; strict checkpoint state and public canonical state have different purposes.

`policy.mjs` is the reference policy. `template.mjs`, `prompt.json`, `LEARNER.md` and `response-template.md` are the learner inputs. The shared runner should copy only the learner inputs, never `policy.mjs`, `fixtures.mjs`, `controls.mjs` or runtime implementation into the editable policy location as a solution.

`fixtures.mjs` exports async `assess(candidate)` returning `{passed,criteria:[{name,passed,error?}]}` and `cases()` for author inspection. `controls.mjs` exports `correctPolicies` (two independent implementations) and `wrongPolicies` (seven annotated behavioral controls). Criteria carry expected/observed results and teaching-section pointers; the fixtures never import the candidate by an arbitrary learner-controlled path.

Run from the project directory:

```sh
node --test tests/telemetry.test.mjs
```

The tests cover continuation after checkpoint/rollover, stale operation evidence, malformed/incompatible/incomplete history, final-state alteration, token exclusion, finite bounds, unchanged legacy replay and grader calibration. They do not establish network timing, authentication, browser visual quality, production capacity or learner outcomes. Browser rendering and the actual prepare/edit/check route are integration acceptance work.

Course-craft trace: the executable policy and stated requirements support `assessment-03`; independent correct/wrong controls support `assessment-09`; expected/observed feedback and section pointers support `feedback-07`; separate response predictions and appended revisions support preserving attempts. The transfer scenario is explicitly an ungraded review prompt (`assessment-02`, `assessment-15`), not evidence of learning.

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/telemetry/controls.mjs`:

```mjs
import { replayWindow } from './policy.mjs';

// An independent implementation walks a shrinking sequence interval and folds
// events through the facade. It shares no validation helpers with the reference.
export function replayByInterval(record, engine) {
  const refuse = (reason) => ({ ok: false, reason });
  const names = new Set(['schema', 'runtimeRelease', 'startIndex', 'checkpoint', 'events', 'endIndex', 'complete', 'final']);
  if (record === null || typeof record !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record) || record.schema !== 1) return refuse('schema');
  if (Object.keys(record).some((key) => !names.has(key))) return refuse('schema');
  if (typeof record.runtimeRelease !== 'string' || record.runtimeRelease !== engine.release) return refuse('incompatible');
  if (record.complete !== true || !Array.isArray(record.events) || record.events.length > 256) return refuse('incomplete');
  const indices = [record.startIndex, record.endIndex];
  if (!indices.every((index) => Number.isSafeInteger(index) && index >= 0)) return refuse('sequence');
  if (record.endIndex - record.startIndex !== record.events.length) return refuse('sequence');
  let remaining = record.endIndex - record.startIndex;
  for (const item of record.events) {
    if (!item || Array.isArray(item) || typeof item !== 'object') return refuse('sequence');
    if (Object.keys(item).sort().join(',') !== 'event,index') return refuse('sequence');
    if (item.index !== record.endIndex - remaining + 1) return refuse('sequence');
    remaining -= 1;
  }
  let restored;
  try {
    restored = record.events.reduce((world, item) => {
      engine.apply(world, item.event);
      return world;
    }, engine.restore(record.checkpoint));
  } catch {
    return refuse('event');
  }
  try {
    const observed = engine.canonical(restored);
    return engine.equal(record.final, observed) ? { ok: true, state: observed } : refuse('final');
  } catch {
    return refuse('final');
  }
}

export const correctPolicies = {
  'validate-then-replay': { replayWindow },
  'interval-and-fold': { replayWindow: replayByInterval },
};

const copy = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

// These are author calibration controls. Their names describe their defect;
// none is copied into a learner workspace.
export const wrongPolicies = {
  'trust-the-final': {
    replayWindow: (record) => ({ ok: true, state: record.final }),
  },
  'ignore-completeness': {
    replayWindow: (record, engine) => replayWindow({ ...record, complete: true }, engine),
  },
  'ignore-runtime-release': {
    replayWindow: (record, engine) => replayWindow({ ...record, runtimeRelease: engine.release }, engine),
  },
  'sort-the-evidence': {
    replayWindow(record, engine) {
      const sorted = copy(record);
      if (Array.isArray(sorted?.events)) sorted.events.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
      return replayWindow(sorted, engine);
    },
  },
  'renumber-the-evidence': {
    replayWindow(record, engine) {
      const changed = copy(record);
      if (!Array.isArray(changed?.events)) return replayWindow(changed, engine);
      changed.events = changed.events.map((item, index) => ({ ...item, index: changed.startIndex + index + 1 }));
      changed.endIndex = changed.startIndex + changed.events.length;
      return replayWindow(changed, engine);
    },
  },
  'omit-final-comparison': {
    replayWindow(record, engine) {
      const result = replayWindow(record, { ...engine, equal: () => true });
      return result;
    },
  },
  'discard-stale-inputs': {
    replayWindow(record, engine) {
      const changed = copy(record);
      const last = new Map();
      changed.events = changed.events.filter(({ event }) => {
        if (event?.type !== 'input') return true;
        if (event.input.seq <= (last.get(event.id) ?? 0)) return false;
        last.set(event.id, event.input.seq);
        return true;
      });
      return replayWindow(changed, engine);
    },
  },
};

```mjs
import { createRecordedEngine, createReplayEngine, capture } from './runtime.mjs';

const input = (seq, move = 'idle', interact = false) => ({ v: 1, seq, move, interact });
const copy = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

function sample(capacity = 128) {
  const engine = createRecordedEngine(17, { capacity });
  const first = engine.join();
  engine.join();
  engine.admit(first.id, input(2, 'E', true));
  engine.admit(first.id, input(1, 'W', true));
  engine.advance(1);
  engine.admit(first.id, input(3, 'idle', true));
  engine.advance(1);
  engine.admit(first.id, input(4, 'idle', true));
  engine.advance(1);
  engine.admit(first.id, input(5, 'N', true));
  engine.advance(1);
  return engine.window();
}

function change(source, edit) {
  const record = copy(source);
  edit(record);
  return record;
}

function evidence(value) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value, (_key, item) => {
      if (item === undefined) return { type: 'undefined' };
      if (typeof item === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(item)) return { type: 'number', value: String(item) };
      if (['bigint', 'function', 'symbol'].includes(typeof item)) return { type: typeof item, value: String(item) };
      return item;
    }));
  } catch {
    return { type: 'non-JSON result' };
  }
}

/** Author-owned cases, built from real engine operations rather than answer text. */
export function cases() {
  const complete = sample();
  const rolled = sample(3);
  const quiet = createRecordedEngine(-3);
  const maximal = createRecordedEngine(31, { capacity: 256 });
  maximal.join();
  maximal.advance(100);
  maximal.advance(100);
  maximal.advance(55);
  const checkpointOnly = createRecordedEngine(17);
  const actor = checkpointOnly.join();
  checkpointOnly.admit(actor.id, input(1, 'E', true));
  const pending = {
    schema: 1, runtimeRelease: complete.runtimeRelease, startIndex: 90,
    checkpoint: capture(checkpointOnly.world), events: [], endIndex: 90,
    complete: true, final: checkpointOnly.window().final,
  };
  const positive = (name, record) => ({ name, record, expected: { ok: true, state: record.final }, section: 'complete-windows' });
  const negative = (name, record, reason, section) => ({ name, record, expected: { ok: false, reason }, section });
  return [
    positive('complete: replay joins, stale input and interactions', complete),
    positive('rolled: restore retained causal state at a nonzero index', rolled),
    positive('empty: an untouched world has a complete zero-event window', quiet.window()),
    positive('checkpoint: zero events preserve pending intent', pending),
    positive('bound: exactly 256 events remain valid', maximal.window()),
    negative('schema: unknown schema refuses before replay', change(complete, (r) => { r.schema = 2; }), 'schema', 'schema-and-release'),
    negative('schema: an unexpected envelope field is refused', { ...complete, token: 'not-allowed' }, 'schema', 'schema-and-release'),
    negative('release: incompatible engine release is refused', change(complete, (r) => { r.runtimeRelease = 'courier-runtime-unknown'; }), 'incompatible', 'schema-and-release'),
    negative('complete: false cannot be repaired by guessing missing history', change(complete, (r) => { r.complete = false; }), 'incomplete', 'complete-windows'),
    negative('bound: 257 events exceed the finite window limit', change(maximal.window(), (r) => { r.events.push({ index: 257, event: { type: 'tick' } }); r.endIndex = 257; }), 'incomplete', 'complete-windows'),
    negative('sequence: removing a middle input leaves a gap', change(complete, (r) => { r.events.splice(3, 1); }), 'sequence', 'absolute-order'),
    negative('sequence: reordering evidence must not sort it silently', change(complete, (r) => { [r.events[2], r.events[3]] = [r.events[3], r.events[2]]; }), 'sequence', 'absolute-order'),
    negative('sequence: duplicated indices are not a contiguous history', change(complete, (r) => { r.events[3].index = r.events[2].index; }), 'sequence', 'absolute-order'),
    negative('sequence: a fractional boundary cannot identify operations', change(complete, (r) => { r.startIndex = 0.5; }), 'sequence', 'absolute-order'),
    negative('sequence: an unsafe boundary cannot identify operations', change(complete, (r) => { r.endIndex = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1; }), 'sequence', 'absolute-order'),
    negative('event: an unknown event type is refused', change(complete, (r) => { r.events[2].event.type = 'teleport'; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('event: invalid input cannot write state', change(complete, (r) => { r.events[2].event.input.seq = 0; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('event: an unknown actor cannot provide an input', change(complete, (r) => { r.events[2].event.id = 'actor-9'; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('checkpoint: missing private intent is refused', change(rolled, (r) => { delete r.checkpoint.actors[0].pendingInteract; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('checkpoint: missing detector history is refused', change(rolled, (r) => { delete r.checkpoint.actors[0].detector; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('checkpoint: nonfinite positions are refused', change(rolled, (r) => { r.checkpoint.actors[0].x = Infinity; }), 'event', 'causal-state'),
    negative('final: truncated actor state is refused', change(complete, (r) => { r.final.actors.pop(); }), 'final', 'final-comparison'),
    negative('final: altered score is refused', change(complete, (r) => { r.final.actors[0].actor.score += 1; }), 'final', 'final-comparison'),
    negative('final: absent final state is refused', change(complete, (r) => { delete r.final; }), 'final', 'final-comparison'),
  ];
}

/** Each failure reports behavior, expected result, observed result and a repair pointer. */
export async function assess(candidate, { onCriterion = () => {} } = {}) {
  if (typeof candidate?.replayWindow !== 'function') {
    return { passed: false, criteria: [{ name: 'export replayWindow(record, engine)', passed: false, error: {
      message: 'Export the replayWindow function declared in the contract.',
      expected: 'function', actual: typeof candidate?.replayWindow, source: 'LEARNER.md#the-contract',
    } }] };
  }
  const facade = createReplayEngine();
  const criteria = [];
  for (const item of cases()) {
    onCriterion(item.name);
    const expected = copy(item.expected);
    let observed;
    try {
      observed = await candidate.replayWindow(item.record, facade);
    } catch (error) {
      criteria.push({ name: item.name, passed: false, error: {
        message: 'The candidate threw instead of returning a replay result.',
        expected, actual: { threw: String(error?.message ?? error) }, source: `LEARNER.md#${item.section}`,
      } });
      continue;
    }
    const passed = facade.equal(observed, expected);
    const result = { name: item.name, passed };
    if (!passed) result.error = {
      message: `The result violates this requirement: ${item.name}.`,
      expected, actual: evidence(observed), source: `LEARNER.md#${item.section}`,
    };
    criteria.push(result);
  }
  return { passed: criteria.every((criterion) => criterion.passed), criteria };
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/telemetry/policy.mjs`:

```mjs
const RECORD_KEYS = ['schema', 'runtimeRelease', 'startIndex', 'checkpoint', 'events', 'endIndex', 'complete', 'final'];

/** Check one complete causal window. This does not authenticate its producer. */
export function replayWindow(record, engine) {
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record) || record.schema !== 1) return { ok: false, reason: 'schema' };
  if (Object.keys(record).some((key) => !RECORD_KEYS.includes(key))) return { ok: false, reason: 'schema' };
  if (typeof record.runtimeRelease !== 'string' || record.runtimeRelease !== engine.release) return { ok: false, reason: 'incompatible' };
  if (record.complete !== true || !Array.isArray(record.events) || record.events.length > 256) return { ok: false, reason: 'incomplete' };
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(record.startIndex) || record.startIndex < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(record.endIndex)) return { ok: false, reason: 'sequence' };
  if (record.endIndex !== record.startIndex + record.events.length) return { ok: false, reason: 'sequence' };
  for (let offset = 0; offset < record.events.length; offset += 1) {
    const entry = record.events[offset];
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) return { ok: false, reason: 'sequence' };
    if (Object.keys(entry).length !== 2 || !Object.hasOwn(entry, 'event') || !Object.hasOwn(entry, 'index') || entry.index !== record.startIndex + offset + 1) return { ok: false, reason: 'sequence' };
  }
  let world;
  try {
    world = engine.restore(record.checkpoint);
    for (const { event } of record.events) engine.apply(world, event);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'event' };
  }
  try {
    const state = engine.canonical(world);
    if (!engine.equal(state, record.final)) return { ok: false, reason: 'final' };
    return { ok: true, state };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'final' };
  }
}

{
  "id": "courier-telemetry-01",
  "version": 1,
  "objective": "Implement a replay policy that accepts a complete bounded causal window and refuses missing, reordered, incompatible or inconsistent evidence.",
  "question": "Implement replayWindow(record, engine) in telemetry/policy.mjs. Validate the window, restore its checkpoint through the supplied facade, apply each indexed event in its supplied order, and compare the resulting canonical state with final. Return {ok:true,state} only when all checks pass; otherwise return {ok:false,reason}. Record your predictions, assistance and explanations in response.md before your first check, and append repairs without replacing your original answers.",
  "constraints": [
    "The only submitted executable file is telemetry/policy.mjs. Keep the function independent of Node, files, clocks and network APIs; do not import a reference solution.",
    "The envelope fields are schema, runtimeRelease, startIndex, checkpoint, events, endIndex, complete and final. Schema must equal 1; runtimeRelease must equal engine.release. Refuse unexpected envelope fields.",
    "The complete flag must be true and events must be an array of at most 256 entries. An empty complete window is allowed.",
    "startIndex is the number of the last operation before the retained window. Each entry has exactly index and event. Its index is startIndex+1, startIndex+2 and so on in the given order. endIndex equals startIndex+events.length; both boundaries are nonnegative safe integers.",
    "Use engine.restore(checkpoint) to create a fresh world and engine.apply(world,event) for each event. The facade validates checkpoint and event shape, including input limits, and throws on invalid data. Valid stale input is still an event and must not be dropped.",
    "Use engine.canonical(world) and engine.equal(state,final); object key order is irrelevant. Do not accept final as evidence of execution.",
    "Failure reasons are schema for an unsupported schema or unexpected envelope field, incompatible for a runtime release mismatch, incomplete for incomplete/oversized/invalid event storage, sequence for bad boundaries or indexed entries, event for an invalid checkpoint/event, and final for a missing or mismatched canonical result. Apply checks in that order.",
    "Replay checks deterministic gameplay reproduction. It does not authenticate who supplied the record or prove HTTP identity, network delivery order, wall-clock timing or unmodified client execution."
  ],
  "assessment": "Owner-side fixtures run captured learner code with the real engine facade. Two independently structured correct policies must pass; policies that trust final, ignore completeness/version, sort or renumber evidence, discard stale input or skip final comparison must fail by their behavior. Passing these bounded cases establishes agreement with the stated contract, not production security or measured learning."

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/telemetry/runtime.mjs`:

```mjs
import { createWorld, join, admit, advance, canonical } from '../engine.mjs';

export const RUNTIME_RELEASE = 'courier-runtime-1';
export const MAX_WINDOW_EVENTS = 256;
const MAX_TICK = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 4;
const MOVES = new Set(['N', 'S', 'E', 'W', 'idle']);
const MUTANTS = new Set(['omit-proximity', 'omit-sequence']);
const ACTOR_KEYS = ['id', 'x', 'y', 'score', 'cargo', 'lastSeq', 'lastSeen', 'expiresAt',
  'nextInteractTick', 'move', 'pendingInteract', 'lastDecision', 'detector'];

function object(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

function exact(value, names) {
  if (!object(value)) return false;
  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  return keys.length === names.length && names.every((name) => Object.hasOwn(value, name));
}

function integer(value, low, high) {
  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= low && value <= high;
}

function array(value, max) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > max || Object.keys(value).length !== value.length) return false;
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(value, index)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function copy(value) {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function validDecision(decision, tick) {
  if (decision === null) return true;
  if (!exact(decision, ['status', 'reason', 'tick']) || !integer(decision.tick, 1, tick)) return false;
  if (decision.status === 'applied') return decision.reason === 'pickup' || decision.reason === 'deposit';
  return decision.status === 'denied' && (decision.reason === 'range' || decision.reason === 'cooldown');
}

function validBucket(bucket, index, tick) {
  if (!exact(bucket, ['tick', 'observations']) || !array(bucket.observations, 1)) return false;
  if (bucket.tick === -1) return bucket.observations.length === 0;
  if (!integer(bucket.tick, Math.max(1, tick - 19), tick) || bucket.tick % 20 !== index) return false;
  if (bucket.observations.length !== 1) return false;
  const observation = bucket.observations[0];
  return exact(observation, ['tick', 'reason']) && observation.tick === bucket.tick && observation.reason === 'range';
}

function validDetector(detector, tick) {
  if (!exact(detector, ['buckets', 'findings'])) return false;
  if (!array(detector.buckets, 20) || detector.buckets.length !== 20) return false;
  if (!detector.buckets.every((bucket, index) => validBucket(bucket, index, tick))) return false;
  if (!array(detector.findings, 128)) return false;
  return detector.findings.every((finding, index, findings) => exact(finding, ['kind', 'tick'])
    && finding.kind === 'repeated-invalid-action' && integer(finding.tick, 3, tick)
    && (index === 0 || finding.tick > findings[index - 1].tick));
}

function validActor(actor, index, tick) {
  if (!exact(actor, ACTOR_KEYS) || actor.id !== `actor-${index + 1}`) return false;
  if (!integer(actor.x, 0, 8000) || !integer(actor.y, 0, 4000) || actor.x % 250 || actor.y % 250) return false;
  if (actor.x >= 4000 && actor.x <= 4250 && actor.y <= 2500) return false;
  if (!integer(actor.score, 0, tick) || typeof actor.cargo !== 'boolean') return false;
  if (!integer(actor.lastSeq, 0, 1_000_000) || !integer(actor.lastSeen, 0, tick)) return false;
  if (!integer(actor.expiresAt, 0, MAX_TICK + 4) || !integer(actor.nextInteractTick, 0, tick + 4)) return false;
  if (!MOVES.has(actor.move) || typeof actor.pendingInteract !== 'boolean') return false;
  if (actor.lastSeq === 0 && (actor.lastSeen !== 0 || actor.expiresAt !== 0 || actor.move !== 'idle' || actor.pendingInteract)) return false;
  if (actor.lastSeq > 0 && actor.expiresAt !== actor.lastSeen + 4) return false;
  if (!validDecision(actor.lastDecision, tick) || !validDetector(actor.detector, tick)) return false;
  if (actor.lastDecision?.status === 'applied' && actor.nextInteractTick !== actor.lastDecision.tick + 4) return false;
  return true;
}

function validCheckpoint(checkpoint) {
  if (!exact(checkpoint, ['schema', 'seed', 'tick', 'core', 'actors']) || checkpoint.schema !== 1) return false;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(checkpoint.seed) || !integer(checkpoint.tick, 0, MAX_TICK)) return false;
  const offset = ((checkpoint.seed % 3) + 3) % 3;
  if (!exact(checkpoint.core, ['x', 'y']) || checkpoint.core.x !== 2000 + offset * 250 || checkpoint.core.y !== 1000) return false;
  if (!array(checkpoint.actors, 4)) return false;
  return checkpoint.actors.every((actor, index) => validActor(actor, index, checkpoint.tick));
}

/** Capture causal state only. HTTP credentials and the old event log are excluded. */
export function capture(world) {
  if (!world || !Array.isArray(world.actors)) throw new Error('invalid checkpoint world');
  if (world.mutant !== undefined && !MUTANTS.has(world.mutant)) throw new Error('invalid checkpoint world');
  const actors = world.actors.map((actor) => Object.fromEntries(ACTOR_KEYS.map((key) => [key, actor[key]])));
  const checkpoint = { schema: 1, seed: world.seed, tick: world.tick, core: world.core, actors };
  if (!validCheckpoint(checkpoint)) throw new Error('invalid checkpoint state');
  return copy(checkpoint);
}

/** Restore a detached world; old v1 history starts empty and is not invented. */
export function restore(checkpoint) {
  if (!validCheckpoint(checkpoint)) throw new Error('invalid checkpoint');
  const saved = copy(checkpoint);
  const world = createWorld(saved.seed);
  world.tick = saved.tick;
  world.core = saved.core;
  world.actors = saved.actors;
  return world;
}

function validInput(input) {
  return exact(input, ['v', 'seq', 'move', 'interact']) && input.v === 1
    && integer(input.seq, 1, 1_000_000) && MOVES.has(input.move) && typeof input.interact === 'boolean';
}

function apply(world, event) {
  if (exact(event, ['type']) && event.type === 'tick') {
    if (!integer(world.tick, 0, MAX_TICK - 1)) throw new Error('tick limit reached');
    advance(world, 1);
    return;
  }
  if (exact(event, ['type', 'id']) && event.type === 'join') {
    if (event.id !== `actor-${world.actors.length + 1}`) throw new Error('invalid join identity');
    join(world);
    return;
  }
  if (exact(event, ['type', 'id', 'input']) && event.type === 'input' && validInput(event.input)) {
    if (admit(world, event.id, event.input).status === 'rejected') throw new Error('invalid input actor');
    return;
  }
  throw new Error('invalid replay event');
}

/** Compare JSON values without relying on key insertion order or Node APIs. */
export function equal(left, right) {
  const pending = [[left, right]];
  let remaining = 20_000;
  while (pending.length > 0) {
    if (--remaining < 0) return false;
    const [a, b] = pending.pop();
    if (typeof a !== typeof b) return false;
    if (a === null || b === null) {
      if (a !== b) return false;
      continue;
    }
    if (typeof a !== 'object') {
      if (!['string', 'boolean', 'number'].includes(typeof a) || a !== b) return false;
      if (typeof a === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(a)) return false;
      continue;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(a) !== Array.isArray(b)) return false;
    if (!Array.isArray(a) && (!object(a) || !object(b))) return false;
    if (Array.isArray(a) && a.length !== b.length) return false;
    const keys = Object.keys(a);
    if (keys.length !== Object.keys(b).length) return false;
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (!Object.hasOwn(b, key)) return false;
      pending.push([a[key], b[key]]);
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** The policy uses this facade; gameplay remains the existing real engine. */
export function createReplayEngine() {
  return Object.freeze({ release: RUNTIME_RELEASE, restore, apply, canonical, equal });
}

/** Record through these wrappers. Direct mutations of .world are not recorded. */
export function createRecordedEngine(seed, { capacity = 128, mutant } = {}) {
  if (!integer(capacity, 1, MAX_WINDOW_EVENTS)) throw new Error('capacity must be an integer from 1 to 256');
  const world = createWorld(seed, { mutant });
  let checkpoint = capture(world);
  let startIndex = 0;
  let endIndex = 0;
  let events = [];

  function before() {
    if (endIndex === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) throw new Error('event index limit reached');
    return events.length === capacity ? capture(world) : null;
  }

  function append(event, nextCheckpoint) {
    if (nextCheckpoint) {
      checkpoint = nextCheckpoint;
      startIndex = endIndex;
      events = [];
    }
    endIndex += 1;
    events.push({ index: endIndex, event: copy(event) });
  }

  return {
    world,
    join() {
      const nextCheckpoint = before();
      const actor = join(world);
      append({ type: 'join', id: actor.id }, nextCheckpoint);
      return actor;
    },
    admit(id, input) {
      const nextCheckpoint = before();
      const result = admit(world, id, input);
      if (result.status !== 'rejected') append({ type: 'input', id, input }, nextCheckpoint);
      return result;
    },
    advance(ticks) {
      if (!integer(ticks, 1, 100)) throw new Error('ticks must be an integer from 1 to 100');
      if (world.tick > MAX_TICK - ticks) throw new Error('tick limit reached');
      for (let index = 0; index < ticks; index += 1) {
        const nextCheckpoint = before();
        advance(world, 1);
        append({ type: 'tick' }, nextCheckpoint);
      }
    },
    window() {
      return {
        schema: 1, runtimeRelease: RUNTIME_RELEASE, startIndex, checkpoint: copy(checkpoint),
        events: copy(events), endIndex, complete: true, final: canonical(world),
      };
    },
  };
}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/README.md`:

```md
# HTTP verification

These independently authored tests implement the frozen revision 2 spike contract. Gameplay requests use real loopback HTTP; only the owning parent process can advance the deterministic clock through IPC. The tests do not import admission, movement, collision or detector implementation. Replay tests import only the public replay API to compare the recorded transcript with its canonical final state.

From `courses/anti-cheat-engineering/project`:

```sh
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
node tests/mutants.mjs
node --test tests/proximity.test.mjs
```

The focused proximity check is also suitable for an editable source exercise: it requires both honest delivery and rejection of remote pickup. `withServer(callback, {entry})` can point it at an explicit copied server entry. The default entry is `../server.mjs` relative to the harness.

`tests/mutants.mjs` first runs an unmodified baseline. For each owner-only mutant it also completes honest delivery, then requires the named state invariant to fail. A refused connection, malformed response, startup error, crash, or unrelated assertion fails the runner and is never reported as a killed mutant. The runner prints the observed authoritative state for both kills.

The suite checks honest delivery, stale ordering, expiry, coalescing, malformed authority claims, isolation, authentication, Host/Origin boundaries, JSON/body limits, owner-control isolation, advisory detection, legal retry false positives, token resume/restart, transcript replay and bounds, normal-clock progress, and shutdown. Its 100-request timing sample is a bounded local responsiveness smoke, not a load or capacity claim. The live-clock smoke asserts progress and eventual expiry without claiming exact wall-clock scheduling.

The known miss is explicit: a client can alter its own rendering and still send the same valid messages. Equivalent valid traffic gives equivalent legal state, with no inferred self-integrity verdict or invented inspection endpoint.

For manual normal-clock runs, start the server on a chosen port, then run one client per fresh process run (the game permits four sessions):

```sh
node server.mjs --port 8787 --seed 17
node clients/honest.mjs --port 8787
node clients/adversarial.mjs --port 8787 --scenario remote-pickup
```

Other adversarial scenarios are `stale-ordering`, `forged-fields`, `detector`, and `equivalent-valid-traffic`. `--url` accepts only plain loopback HTTP origins. Clients never receive owner clock access, and their printed normal-clock traces remain observations; deterministic invariant claims come from the owner-clock tests.

async function storageStates(server, viewport) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.addInitScript(() => { Storage.prototype.setItem = () => { throw new DOMException('Quota full', 'QuotaExceededError'); }; });
  await page.goto(server.base + '/completion');
  await page.fill('#show-timing-answer', 'Preserve this answer when saving is unavailable.');
  await page.click('#show-timing');
  await capture(page, 'completion-storage-error');
  if (includeLearn) {
    await page.goto(server.base + '/learn');
    await page.locator('#global-status[role="alert"]').waitFor();
    await capture(page, 'learn-storage-error');
  }
  await context.close();
}

try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, timeout: 15_000 });
  manifest.browserVersion = browser.version();
  for (const viewport of viewports) {
    await withServer(async server => {
      const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
      const page = await context.newPage();
      page.setDefaultTimeout(10_000);
      page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(15_000);
      const errors = [];
      page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
      await visit(page, server, '/course', 'course-initial');
      await visit(page, server, '/', 'game-initial');
      await page.click('#connect');
      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('#connection').textContent === 'Connected');
      await capture(page, 'game-connected');
      await page.click('#forge');
      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('#exchange').textContent.includes('input-keys'));
      await capture(page, 'game-forged-input-error');
      await visit(page, server, '/order', 'order-initial');
      await notebookStates(page, server);
      await visit(page, server, '/sources', 'sources-initial');
      if (includeLearn) await learningStates(page, server);
      assert.deepEqual(errors, [], 'No unhandled learner-page errors');
      await context.close();
      await storageStates(server, viewport);
      // Each viewport has a fresh four-slot game server. Fill it through real HTTP.
      for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) await joinGame(server.base);
      const full = await browser.newPage({ viewport });
      await full.goto(server.base);
      await full.click('#connect');
      await full.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('#announcement').textContent.includes('All four lab slots'));
      await capture(full, 'game-session-capacity-error');
      await full.close();
    }, { entry: join(project, 'server.mjs') });
  }
  assert.equal(timedOut, false, 'Accessibility smoke completed inside its deadline');
} catch (error) {
  manifest.error = { name: error.name, message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await browser?.close();
  clearTimeout(watchdog);
  clearTimeout(hardStop);
  manifest.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  manifest.finalSource = await sourceIdentity();
  manifest.sourceStable = manifest.finalSource.commit === manifest.sourceCommit
    && JSON.stringify(manifest.finalSource.files) === JSON.stringify(manifest.sourceFiles);
  if (!manifest.sourceStable) manifest.error ??= { message: 'Server source changed during the audit; rerun against a stable candidate.' };
  manifest.summary = {
    scans: manifest.scans.length,
    violations: manifest.scans.reduce((sum, scan) => sum + scan.violations.length, 0),
    incomplete: manifest.scans.reduce((sum, scan) => sum + scan.incomplete.length, 0),
    overflow: manifest.scans.filter(scan => scan.layout.scrollWidth > scan.width).map(scan => `${scan.width}-${scan.name}`),
  };
  await writeFile(join(output, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ sourceCommit: manifest.sourceCommit, output, ...manifest.summary, error: manifest.error?.message }, null, 2));
}
if (manifest.error || manifest.summary.violations || manifest.summary.overflow.length) process.exitCode = 1;

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/admission.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { admitInput, movementActive } from '../admission.mjs';

const initial = () => ({ lastSeq: 0, lastSeen: 0, expiresAt: 0, move: 'idle', pendingInteract: false });
const input = (seq, move = 'idle', interact = false) => ({ v: 1, seq, move, interact });

test('fresh admission changes exactly the five intent fields without mutating its arguments', () => {
  const state = Object.freeze(initial());
  const request = Object.freeze(input(17, 'E', true));
  const result = admitInput(state, request, 9);
  assert.deepEqual(result, {
    status: 'admitted',
    next: { lastSeq: 17, lastSeen: 9, expiresAt: 13, move: 'E', pendingInteract: true },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(state, initial());
  assert.deepEqual(request, input(17, 'E', true));
  assert.notEqual(result.next, state);
});

test('duplicate and older inputs leave every intent field unchanged, including after expiry', () => {
  const state = Object.freeze({ lastSeq: 31, lastSeen: 5, expiresAt: 9, move: 'N', pendingInteract: false });
  for (const seq of [31, 30, 1]) {
    for (const tick of [5, 9, 12]) {
      const result = admitInput(state, Object.freeze(input(seq, 'E', true)), tick);
      assert.equal(result.status, 'stale');
      assert.deepEqual(result.next, state);
    }
  }
});

test('new sequence gaps are legal and pending interaction survives later false inputs', () => {
  const staged = admitInput(initial(), input(17, 'W', true), 3).next;
  const replacement = admitInput(Object.freeze(staged), input(99, 'E', false), 3);
  assert.deepEqual(replacement, {
    status: 'admitted',
    next: { lastSeq: 99, lastSeen: 3, expiresAt: 7, move: 'E', pendingInteract: true },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(admitInput(initial(), input(99, 'N'), 4).next, {
    lastSeq: 99, lastSeen: 4, expiresAt: 8, move: 'N', pendingInteract: false,
  });
});

test('movement is active through inclusive expiry and renewal starts the next four ticks', () => {
  assert.equal(movementActive(initial(), 1), false);
  const state = Object.freeze(admitInput(initial(), input(1, 'E'), 7).next);
  assert.deepEqual([8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13].map((tick) => movementActive(state, tick)), [true, true, true, true, false, false]);
  const renewed = admitInput(state, input(2, 'E'), 11).next;
  assert.equal(renewed.expiresAt, 15);
  assert.equal(movementActive(renewed, 12), true);
  assert.equal(movementActive(renewed, 15), true);
  assert.equal(movementActive(renewed, 16), false);
});

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { withServer } from './harness.mjs';
import { join } from '../clients/http-client.mjs';

// Browser evidence uses the same real server and owner-clock boundary as the HTTP suite.
const output = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../../dist/anti-cheat-browser/game/', import.meta.url));
await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
const results = [];
try {
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1280, 1050], ['mobile', 390, 844], ['narrow', 320, 740]]) {
    await withServer(async (server) => {
      const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
      const errors = [];
      let joins = 0;
      page.on('request', request => { if (request.url().endsWith('/join')) joins += 1; });
      page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
      await page.goto(server.base);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Connect to server', exact: true }).click();
      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.getElementById('connection').textContent === 'Connected');
      async function input(action) {
        const reply = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.url().endsWith('/input') && response.request().method() === 'POST');
        await action();
        return (await reply).json();
      }
      async function tick(count) {
        const reply = await server.advance(count);
        await page.waitForFunction((target) => Number(document.getElementById('tick').textContent) >= target, reply.tick);
      }
      async function move(key, ticks) {
        await input(() => page.keyboard.down(key));
        await tick(ticks);
        await input(() => page.keyboard.up(key));
      }
      await move('ArrowRight', 4);
      await move('ArrowRight', 2);
      await input(() => page.locator('#interact').click());
      await tick(1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#cargo').textContent(), 'Core aboard');
      await move('ArrowLeft', 4);
      await move('ArrowLeft', 2);
      await input(() => page.locator('#interact').click());
      await tick(1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#score').textContent(), '1');
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#cargo').textContent(), 'Empty');
      await page.reload();
      await page.waitForFunction(() => document.getElementById('connection').textContent === 'Connected');
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#score').textContent(), '1', 'same-tab reload resumes score');
      assert.equal(joins, 1, 'reload must not consume another session');
      const forged = await input(() => page.locator('#forge').click());
      assert.equal(forged.error, 'input-keys');
      await tick(1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#score').textContent(), '1');
      // Native keyboard activation of the visible direction button also moves.
      await page.locator('[data-move="N"]').focus();
      await input(() => page.keyboard.down('Enter'));
      await tick(1);
      await input(() => page.keyboard.up('Enter'));
      assert.match(await page.locator('#actor').getAttribute('transform'), /1000 750/);
      const layout = await page.evaluate(() => ({ width: innerWidth, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        controls: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-move]')].map((element) => ({ width: element.getBoundingClientRect().width, height: element.getBoundingClientRect().height })) }));
      assert.equal(layout.scroll, layout.width, 'no horizontal overflow');
      assert.ok(layout.controls.every((rect) => rect.width >= 44 && rect.height >= 44), '44px movement controls');
      assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
      await page.screenshot({ path: `${output}/${name}.png`, fullPage: true });
      results.push({ name, ...layout, errors, honestDelivery: true, forgedScoreRejected: true, nativeButtonKeyboard: true, reloadResumes: true });
      await page.goto(server.base + '/order');
      await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Old input. New consequences.' }).waitFor();
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth), width);
      await page.screenshot({ path: `${output}/${name}-lesson.png`, fullPage: true });
      await page.goto(server.base + '/evidence');
      await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Which bytes? Which history?' }).waitFor();
      await page.locator('#compare-package-worked').waitFor();
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#package-feedback').isVisible(), false);
      await page.locator('#compare-package-worked').click();
      await page.getByText('RECORDED MATCH', { exact: false }).waitFor();
      await page.locator('#package-case').selectOption('changed');
      await page.locator('#compare-package-worked').click();
      assert.match(await page.locator('#package-verdict').textContent(), /REFUSAL.*digest/);
      await page.locator('#trace-case').selectOption('missing');
      await page.locator('#replay-trace-worked').click();
      assert.match(await page.locator('#trace-verdict').textContent(), /REFUSAL.*sequence/);

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtemp, writeFile, readFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { repair } from '../capstone/policy.mjs';
import { initialState, addActor } from '../capstone/state.mjs';
import { assess, assessPolicy, cases, runScenario } from '../capstone/fixtures.mjs';
import { correctPolicies, wrongPolicies, wrongAdapters } from '../capstone/controls.mjs';
import { createRepairServer, withRepairServer } from '../capstone/server.mjs';
import { request, session, submit, state } from '../capstone/client.mjs';
import * as template from '../capstone/template.mjs';

const actor = (world, id) => world.actors.find((item) => item.id === id);
const body = { requestId: 'once', stationId: 'alpha' };
const scenarioPath = fileURLToPath(new URL('../capstone/author-scenario.mjs', import.meta.url));
const policyPath = fileURLToPath(new URL('../capstone/policy.mjs', import.meta.url));
const controlsUrl = new URL('../capstone/controls.mjs', import.meta.url).href;
const clientUrl = new URL('../capstone/client.mjs', import.meta.url).href;

async function source(t, code, name = 'scenario.mjs') {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-capstone-scenario-'));
  t.after(() => rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const path = join(directory, name);
  await writeFile(path, code);
  return path;
}

test('fifteen distinct wrong policy controls fail with intended expected/actual feedback', () => {
  assert.equal(wrongPolicies.length, 15);
  for (const control of wrongPolicies) {
    const result = assessPolicy(control);
    assert.equal(result.passed, false, control.name);
    const failure = result.criteria.find((item) => !item.passed && item.name.includes(control.intended));

    assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(failure.error, 'expected'));

  }

  assert.equal(assessPolicy({}).passed, false);
  assert.equal(assessPolicy({ repair: async (...args) => repair(...args) }).passed, false);
});

test('empty, blanket-failing and crashing scenarios do not pass the independent test-quality gate', async (t) => {
  const emptyPath = await source(t, 'export async function scenario() {}');
  const empty = await assess({ repair, policyPath, scenarioPath: emptyPath });
  assert.equal(empty.passed, false);
  assert.equal(empty.criteria.filter((item) => !item.passed && item.name.startsWith('HTTP scenario:')).length, 16);
  const blanketPath = await source(t, "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; export async function scenario() { assert.fail('always fails'); }");
  const blanket = await assess({ repair, policyPath, scenarioPath: blanketPath });
  assert.equal(blanket.passed, false);
  // A genuine assertion may end a wrong run early. Blanket failure is rejected
  // by all three required correct runs, rather than field/read instrumentation.
  const blanketHttp = blanket.criteria.filter(item => item.name.startsWith('HTTP scenario:'));
  assert.equal(blanketHttp.filter(item => !item.passed).length, 3);
  assert.ok(blanketHttp.slice(0, 3).every(item => !item.passed));
  const crashPath = await source(t, "export async function scenario() { throw new Error('not an assertion'); }");
  const crashed = await runScenario(crashPath);
  assert.equal(crashed.status, 'runtime-failure');
  assert.equal((await runScenario(fileURLToPath(new URL('../capstone/scenario-template.mjs', import.meta.url)))).status, 'runtime-failure');
  const absent = await assess({ repair });
  assert.equal(absent.criteria.at(-1).name, 'captured policy and independent HTTP scenario');
});

test('real simultaneous duplicate requests debit once and return the original receipt after movement', async () => {
  await withRepairServer(async (server) => {
    const player = await session(server.base);
    const replies = await Promise.all([submit(server.base, player.token, body), submit(server.base, player.token, body)]);
    assert.deepEqual(replies.map((reply) => reply.data.reason).sort(), ['duplicate', 'repaired']);
    assert.deepEqual(replies[0].data.receipt, replies[1].data.receipt);
    const after = await state(server.base, player.token);
    assert.deepEqual([actor(after, player.id).energy, actor(after, player.id).credits, actor(after, player.id).receipts.length], [7, 4, 1]);
    server.moveActor(player.id, { x: 1000, y: 0 });
    const beforeRetry = await state(server.base, player.token);
    const retry = await submit(server.base, player.token, body);
    assert.equal(retry.data.reason, 'duplicate');
    assert.deepEqual(retry.data.receipt, replies[0].data.receipt);
    assert.deepEqual(retry.data.state, beforeRetry);
    assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(server.record()), new RegExp(player.token));
  });
});

test('real HTTP rejects client authority claims, malformed bodies and unknown sessions without changing state', async () => {
  await withRepairServer(async (server) => {
    const player = await session(server.base);
    const before = server.snapshot();
    for (const field of ['x', 'y', 'energy', 'credits', 'price', 'score', 'actorId', 'timestamp', 'counter']) {
      const reply = await submit(server.base, player.token, { ...body, [field]: 100 });
      assert.equal(reply.status, 400, field);
      assert.deepEqual(server.snapshot(), before, field);
    }
    for (const value of [null, [], 4, {}, { requestId: '', stationId: 'alpha' }, { ...body, requestId: 'x'.repeat(5000) }]) {
      assert.equal((await submit(server.base, player.token, value)).status, 400);
      assert.deepEqual(server.snapshot(), before);
    }
    assert.equal((await request(server.base, '/repair', { method: 'POST', json: body })).status, 401);
    assert.equal((await submit(server.base, 'unknown', body)).status, 401);
    assert.equal((await request(server.base, '/owner/move', { method: 'POST', token: player.token, json: { x: 0, y: 0 } })).status, 404);
    assert.deepEqual(server.snapshot(), before);
    for (const value of [1, true, null, [], { energy: 0 }]) assert.equal((await request(server.base, '/session', { method: 'POST', json: value })).status, 400);
  });
});

test('sessions and owner movement have explicit bounds and fresh snapshots', async () => {
  const server = await createRepairServer();
  try {
    const first = await session(server.base);
    const detached = server.snapshot();
    server.moveActor(first.id, { x: 400, y: -300 });
    assert.deepEqual([actor(detached, first.id).x, actor(detached, first.id).y], [0, 0]);
    assert.throws(() => server.moveActor(first.id, { x: 10001, y: 0 }), /within/);
    assert.throws(() => server.moveActor('unknown', { x: 0, y: 0 }), /Unknown/);
    for (let index = 1; index < 8; index += 1) await session(server.base);
    assert.equal((await request(server.base, '/session', { method: 'POST', json: {} })).status, 429);
  } finally { await server.close(); }
  assert.throws(() => request('https://example.com', '/state'), /loopback/);

test('structuredClone preserves observed JSON, nested aliases, cycles and native transfer behavior', async (t) => {
  const path = await source(t, `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {session,state,submit} from ${JSON.stringify(clientUrl)};
    export async function scenario({base}) {
      const player=await session(base);
      const before=await state(base,player.token);
      const expected=structuredClone(before);
      expected.actors[0].energy=7; expected.actors[0].credits=4;
      const receipt={requestId:'clone',stationId:'alpha',energyAdded:3,creditsSpent:2,energy:7,credits:4};
      expected.actors[0].receipts.push(receipt);
      assert.equal(before.actors[0].energy,4); assert.equal(before.actors[0].credits,6); assert.deepEqual(before.actors[0].receipts,[]);
      const outer={before,alias:before}; outer.self=outer;
      const detached=structuredClone(outer);
      assert.equal(detached.self,detached); assert.equal(detached.before,detached.alias);
      assert.notEqual(detached.before,before); assert.deepEqual(detached.before,before);
      const buffer=new ArrayBuffer(4);
      const mixed=structuredClone({before,buffer,date:new Date(0)}, {transfer:[buffer]});
      assert.equal(buffer.byteLength,0); assert.equal(mixed.buffer.byteLength,4); assert.equal(mixed.date.getTime(),0);
      const response=await submit(base,player.token,{requestId:'clone',stationId:'alpha'});
      assert.deepEqual(response.data.state,expected);
      assert.deepEqual(structuredClone(await state(base,player.token)),expected);
    }`);
  const result = await runScenario(path);
  assert.equal(result.status, 'passed', JSON.stringify(result));
});

  code = code.replace("const far = await state(base, player.token);", "const far = await state(base, player.token); JSON.stringify(far);");
  code = code.replace("assert.equal(first.data.reason, 'repaired');", "assert.equal(first.data.reason, 'repaired'); assert.equal(first.data.receipt.creditsSpent, 2);");
  const path = await source(t, code);

});

for (const style of ['strict credits first', 'strict receipts first', 'loose assert', 'callable assert', 'in-place receipt sort']) {
  test(`${style} preserves genuine early assertion failures and ordinary JSON`, async (t) => {
    const statements = style === 'callable assert'
      ? "assert(actor.energy === 7); assert(actor.credits === 4); assert(actor.receipts.length === 1);"
      : style === 'strict receipts first'
        ? "assert.deepEqual(actor.receipts, [response.data.receipt]); assert.equal(actor.energy,7); assert.equal(actor.credits,4);"
        : "assert.equal(actor.energy,7); assert.equal(actor.credits,4); assert.deepEqual(actor.receipts, [response.data.receipt]);";
    const module = style === 'loose assert' || style === 'callable assert' ? 'node:assert' : 'node:assert/strict';
    const code = `import assert from '${module}'; import {session,state,submit} from ${JSON.stringify(clientUrl)};
      export async function scenario({base}) { const p=await session(base); await state(base,p.token); const response=await submit(base,p.token,{requestId:'style',stationId:'alpha'}); const actor=response.data.state.actors[0]; ${style === 'in-place receipt sort' ? 'actor.receipts.sort((a,b)=>a.requestId.localeCompare(b.requestId));' : ''} ${statements} }`;
    const path = await source(t, code);
    assert.equal((await runScenario(path)).status, 'passed');
    const wrong = await runScenario(path, { variant: 'one-credit repair' });
    assert.equal(wrong.status, 'assertion-failure', JSON.stringify(wrong));
    assert.doesNotMatch(wrong.error.message, /Getter|Setter|fabricated/);
  });
}

test('multi-failure fixtures reject the formerly undetected reordered policy', () => {
  const reordered = (state, id, request) => {
    const actor = state.actors.find((value) => value.id === id);
    const station = state.stations.find((value) => value.id === request.stationId);
    const old = actor.receipts.some((value) => value.requestId === request.requestId);
    if (old || !station) return repair(state, id, request);
    const deny = (reason) => ({reason, receipt:null, state:structuredClone(state)});
    if (Math.hypot(actor.x-station.x,actor.y-station.y)>state.config.rangeMm) return deny('range');
    if (actor.credits<state.config.repairCost) return deny('funds');
    if (actor.energy>=state.config.energyCap) return deny('full');
    return repair(state,id,request);
  };
  const result = assessPolicy({repair:reordered});
  assert.equal(result.passed,false);
  assert.ok(result.criteria.some(({name,passed}) => name === 'history takes precedence over range full and funds' && !passed));
  assert.ok(result.criteria.some(({name,passed}) => name === 'full energy takes precedence over funds' && !passed));
});

test('a later scenario runner failure retains earlier completed diagnostics', async t => {
 const authorUrl = new URL('../capstone/author-scenario.mjs', import.meta.url).href;
 const path = await source(t, `import {scenario as original} from ${JSON.stringify(authorUrl)};
import {session,submit} from ${JSON.stringify(clientUrl)};
export async function scenario(context){
 console.log('panel-history-marker');
 const p=await session(context.base);
 const result=await submit(context.base,p.token,{requestId:'preflight',stationId:'alpha'});
 if(result.data.state.actors.find(actor=>actor.id===p.id).credits===5){await new Promise(()=>{});}

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/clock.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createClock, TICK_MS, MAX_CATCH_UP_TICKS } from '../clock.mjs';

test('fractional elapsed time is retained across callbacks', () => {
  const clock = createClock(100);
  assert.equal(TICK_MS, 50);
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(124.5), { ticks: 0, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 24.5 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(150), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(249.75), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 49.75 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(250), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(250), { ticks: 0, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 0 });
});

test('each callback processes at most five ticks and drops excess whole ticks', () => {
  const clock = createClock();
  assert.equal(MAX_CATCH_UP_TICKS, 5);
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(250), { ticks: 5, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(826.5), { ticks: 5, dropped: 6, overruns: 1, remainder: 26.5 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(850), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 1, remainder: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(1351), { ticks: 5, dropped: 5, overruns: 2, remainder: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(1351), { ticks: 0, dropped: 0, overruns: 2, remainder: 1 });
});

test('invalid or backwards readings fail without consuming valid elapsed time', () => {
  const clock = createClock(10);
  clock.sample(35);
  for (const invalid of [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -1, '60', null, undefined]) {
    assert.throws(() => clock.sample(invalid), TypeError);
  }
  assert.throws(() => clock.sample(34.99), RangeError);
  assert.throws(() => clock.sample(Number.MAX_VALUE), RangeError);
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(60), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 0 });
});

test('invalid clock origins are rejected', () => {
  for (const invalid of [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -1, '0', null]) {
    assert.throws(() => createClock(invalid), TypeError);
  }
});

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';

import { recoverWorkspace } from '../lab/core/recover.mjs';

import { captureBundle, hashBundle, referenceFiles, regularFile, sha256, verifyReference, writeBundle } from '../lab/core/trust.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const execute = promisify(execFile);
const correct = 'export function decide(value) { return value % 2 === 0; }\n';
const alternate = 'export const decide = value => [0, 2, 4, 6, 8].includes(value % 10);\n';
const fixtures = `import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { examples } from '../runtime.mjs';
export async function assess(candidate) {
  const criteria = [];
  for (const [value, expected] of examples) {
    try {
      assert.equal(candidate.decide(value), expected);
      criteria.push({name:'classify ' + value, passed:true});
    } catch (error) {
      criteria.push({name:'classify ' + value, passed:false, error});
    }
  }
  return {passed:criteria.every(c => c.passed), criteria};
}
`;

async function cli(cwd, script, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [script, ...args], { cwd, env, timeout: 15000, maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024 }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}

async function reference(t) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-core-lab-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  await cp(join(project, 'lab/core'), join(root, 'lab/core'), { recursive: true, filter: (path) => !path.endsWith('/reference.json') });
  await writeFile(join(root, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({ private: true, type: 'module' }));
  await writeFile(join(root, 'runtime.mjs'), 'export const examples = [[1,false],[2,true]];\n');
  for (const id of ['integrity', 'telemetry', 'evaluation', 'retention']) {
    await mkdir(join(root, id));
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'policy.mjs'), correct);
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'template.mjs'), 'export function decide() { return false; } // TODO\n');
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'fixtures.mjs'), fixtures);
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'prompt.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: `core-${id}`, version: 1, wording: 'Classify each number by its parity.' }));
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'LEARNER.md'), '# Decide\nRecord a prediction before the first run.\n');
    await writeFile(join(root, id, 'response-template.md'), 'My prediction:\nMy repair:\n');
  }
  await mkdir(join(root, 'author'));
  await writeFile(join(root, 'author/solution.mjs'), correct);
  await mkdir(join(root, 'public'));
  await writeFile(join(root, 'public/viewer.js'), 'export const view = true;');
  await sealReference(root);
  return root;
}

async function prepared(t, id = 'integrity') {
  const root = await reference(t);
  const { workspace, sessionId } = await prepareWorkspace({ root, id });
  const session = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'lab/core/session.json')));
  return { root: session.referenceRoot, sourceRoot: root, workspace, sessionId, session };
}

async function attemptList(root, sessionId) {
  try { return (await readdir(join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId))).sort(); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; }
}

// assessment-09: calibrate the harness with genuine behavioral failures and
// independently expressed correct policies, not crashes presented as detections.
test('seal covers real source files, detects additions and has no generated-manifest cycle', async (t) => {

  await mkdir(join(root, 'lab/order'));

  await writeFile(join(root, 'lab/reference.json'), '{"spatial":"seal"}');

  await writeFile(join(root, 'artifacts/not-sealed.mjs'), 'throw 1;');

  await writeFile(join(root, 'node_modules/not-sealed.mjs'), 'throw 1;');
  const before = await readFile(join(root, 'lab/core/reference.json'));
  await sealReference(root);
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(join(root, 'lab/core/reference.json')), before);
  const { manifest } = await verifyReference(root);

  assert.ok(firstRun.stdout.indexOf('Saved attempt:') < firstRun.stdout.indexOf('Criterion summary:'));
  assert.equal(first.ownerExecutionRoot.startsWith(workspace + '/'), false);
  assert.deepEqual(firstResult.hashes, firstResult.afterHashes);
  await mkdir(join(workspace, 'artifacts/core-attempts'), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'artifacts/core-attempts/forged.json'), '{"passed":true}');
  // These files are preserved as submitted bytes, but cannot replace the
  // runtime or judge imported from the separate trusted execution tree.
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'runtime.mjs'), 'throw new Error("untrusted runtime");');
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'integrity/fixtures.mjs'), 'throw new Error("untrusted fixture");');
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'integrity/helper.mjs'), 'export const isEven = value => value % 2 === 0;');
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'integrity/policy.mjs'), 'import {isEven} from "./helper.mjs"; export const decide = isEven;');
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'response.md'), 'I repaired the even branch after feedback.');
  const help = { consulted: ['Checker feedback'], note: 'No other help.' };
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'lab/core/help.json'), JSON.stringify(help));
  const revisionRun = await cli(workspace, 'lab/core/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'checker feedback');
  assert.equal(revisionRun.code, 0, revisionRun.stdout + revisionRun.stderr);
  const secondId = (await attemptList(root, sessionId)).find((id) => id !== firstId);
  const secondDir = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId, secondId);
  const second = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(secondDir, 'submission.json')));
  assert.equal(second.attemptKind, 'revision');
  assert.equal(second.previousAttemptId, firstId);
  assert.equal(second.priorFeedbackExposure, true);
  assert.deepEqual(second.help, help);
  assert.deepEqual(second.prompt, { id: 'core-integrity', version: 1, sha256: sha256(await readFile(join(root, 'integrity/prompt.json'))) });
  assert.equal(second.referenceManifest, session.referenceManifest);
  assert.ok(second.hashes['integrity/helper.mjs']);
  assert.equal(second.hashes['artifacts/core-attempts/forged.json'], undefined);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(firstDir, 'submitted/response.md'), 'utf8'), 'I predict this will reject odd numbers.');
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(join(firstDir, 'submitted/integrity/policy.mjs')), original);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(second.ownerExecutionRoot, 'trusted/runtime.mjs'), 'utf8'), 'export const examples = [[1,false],[2,true]];\n');
  const firstMeta = await readFile(join(firstDir, 'submission.json'));
  assert.deepEqual(firstMeta, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(first, null, 2) + '\n'));
});

test('capture rejects added files, path escapes and exclusive writes preserve original bytes', async (t) => {

test('bounded reads accept the byte boundary and refuse oversized files and directories', async (t) => {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-core-file-limit-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const atLimit = Buffer.alloc(4 * 1024 * 1024, 97);
  await writeFile(join(root, 'at-limit.bin'), atLimit);
  assert.deepEqual(await regularFile(root, 'at-limit.bin'), atLimit);
  await writeFile(join(root, 'too-large.bin'), Buffer.alloc(atLimit.length + 1));
  await assert.rejects(regularFile(root, 'too-large.bin'), /Not a bounded regular file/);
  await mkdir(join(root, 'directory'));
  await assert.rejects(regularFile(root, 'directory'), /Not a bounded regular file/);
});

test('a session admits one check at a time and keeps partial pre-submission directories intact', async (t) => {
  const { root, workspace, session, sessionId } = await prepared(t);
  const partial = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId, 'interrupted-before-submission');
  await mkdir(partial, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(join(partial, 'partial.txt'), 'Keep these interrupted capture bytes.');
  let enteredCapture;
  const entered = new Promise((resolve) => { enteredCapture = resolve; });
  let finishCapture;
  const held = new Promise((resolve) => { finishCapture = resolve; });
  const running = checkSubmission({
    workspace, session, assistance: 'none',
    afterCaptureRead: async () => { enteredCapture(); await held; },
  });
  await entered;
  try {
    await assert.rejects(checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance: 'none' }), /already running/);
  } finally {
    finishCapture();
  }
  const first = await running;
  assert.equal(first.kind, 'behavior-failure');
  const next = await checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance: 'prior feedback' });
  const metadata = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(next.destination, 'submission.json')));
  assert.equal(metadata.previousAttemptId, first.attemptId);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(partial, 'partial.txt'), 'utf8'), 'Keep these interrupted capture bytes.');
});

test('killed checker locks recover while preserving interrupted submissions and feedback exposure', async (t) => {
  const { root, workspace, sessionId } = await prepared(t);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'integrity/policy.mjs'), 'setInterval(() => {}, 1000); await new Promise(() => {});');
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['lab/core/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'none'], { cwd: workspace, env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  t.after(() => child.kill('SIGKILL'));
  const output = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let output = '';
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { child.kill('SIGKILL'); reject(new Error('Checker did not save its attempt.')); }, 10000);
    child.stdout.on('data', (bytes) => {
      output += bytes;
      if (output.includes('Saved attempt:')) child.kill('SIGKILL');
    });
    child.once('error', (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); });
    child.once('close', () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(output); });
  });
  assert.match(output, /Saved attempt:/);
  const [firstId] = await attemptList(root, sessionId);
  const firstDirectory = join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId, firstId);
  const original = await readFile(join(firstDirectory, 'submission.json'));
  const saved = JSON.parse(original);
  const ownerSession = join(root, 'artifacts/core/sessions', sessionId);
  const lockOwner = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(ownerSession, 'checking/owner.json')));
  assert.equal(lockOwner.pid, child.pid);
  assert.equal(lockOwner.token, saved.checkId);
  await assert.rejects(readFile(join(firstDirectory, 'result.json')), /ENOENT/);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'integrity/policy.mjs'), correct);
  const retry = await cli(workspace, 'lab/core/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'retry after interrupted check');
  assert.equal(retry.code, 0, retry.stdout + retry.stderr);
  const interruption = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(firstDirectory, 'interrupted.json')));
  assert.equal(interruption.ownerPid, child.pid);
  assert.equal(interruption.checkId, saved.checkId);
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(join(firstDirectory, 'submission.json')), original);
  const nextId = (await attemptList(root, sessionId)).find((id) => id !== firstId);
  const next = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(root, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId, nextId, 'submission.json')));
  assert.equal(next.attemptKind, 'revision');
  assert.equal(next.previousAttemptId, firstId);
  assert.equal(next.priorFeedbackExposure, true);
  assert.equal((await readdir(join(ownerSession, 'recovered-locks'))).length, 1);
  await assert.rejects(readFile(join(ownerSession, 'checking/owner.json')), /ENOENT/);
});

test('explicit lock maintenance refuses known live check and recovery owners', async (t) => {
  const { root, workspace, sessionId } = await prepared(t);
  const lock = join(root, 'artifacts/core/sessions', sessionId, 'checking');
  await mkdir(lock);
  await assert.rejects(recoverWorkspace({ workspace }), /Stop all checks.*--stopped/);
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'owner.json'), JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid }));
  await assert.rejects(recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true }), /still alive/);
  // A partial JSON owner record must not bypass the known-live-PID refusal.
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'owner.json'), `{"pid":${process.pid},`);
  await assert.rejects(recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true }), /still alive/);
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'owner.json'), '{}');
  await mkdir(join(lock, 'recovery'));
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'recovery/owner.json'), JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid }));
  await assert.rejects(recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true }), /still alive/);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(lock, 'recovery/owner.json'), 'utf8'), JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid }));
});

test('explicit maintenance archives empty, partial and dead-recovery locks without changing history', async (t) => {
  const { root, workspace, session, sessionId } = await prepared(t);
  const first = await checkSubmission({ workspace, session, assistance: 'none' });
  const firstBytes = await readFile(join(first.destination, 'submission.json'));
  const feedback = await readFile(join(first.destination, 'feedback-started.json'));
  const ownerSession = join(root, 'artifacts/core/sessions', sessionId);
  const lock = join(ownerSession, 'checking');
  await mkdir(lock);
  const empty = await recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true });
  assert.equal(empty.recovered, true);
  assert.deepEqual(await readdir(empty.archive), []);
  const exited = spawn(process.execPath, ['-e', ''], { stdio: 'ignore' });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { exited.once('exit', resolve); exited.once('error', reject); });
  await mkdir(join(lock, 'recovery'), { recursive: true });
  const partial = '{"createdAt":';
  const deadOwner = JSON.stringify({ pid: exited.pid, token: 'interrupted-recovery' });
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'owner.json'), partial);
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'recovery/owner.json'), deadOwner);
  await writeFile(join(lock, 'recovery/partial.txt'), 'Preserve recovery evidence.');
  const archived = await cli(project, 'lab/core/recover.mjs', workspace, '--stopped');
  assert.equal(archived.code, 0, archived.stdout + archived.stderr);
  assert.match(archived.stdout, /Archived check lock:.*manual-/);
  const archives = (await readdir(ownerSession)).filter((name) => name.startsWith('checking-recovered-manual-'));
  assert.equal(archives.length, 2);
  const newest = join(ownerSession, archives.find((name) => name !== empty.archive.split('/').at(-1)));
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(newest, 'owner.json'), 'utf8'), partial);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(newest, 'recovery/owner.json'), 'utf8'), deadOwner);
  assert.equal(await readFile(join(newest, 'recovery/partial.txt'), 'utf8'), 'Preserve recovery evidence.');
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(join(first.destination, 'submission.json')), firstBytes);
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(join(first.destination, 'feedback-started.json')), feedback);
  assert.deepEqual(await attemptList(root, sessionId), [first.attemptId]);
  const missing = await recoverWorkspace({ workspace, stopped: true });
  assert.equal(missing.recovered, false);
});

    assert.equal(learner.predictions.length, count);
    const response = await readFile(new URL(`../${path}/response-template.md`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
    const predictionSection = response.split(/^## /m)[1];
    const questions = [...predictionSection.matchAll(/^(?:\d+\.|-) (.+)$/gm)].map((match) => match[1]);
    assert.deepEqual(learner.predictions.map((item) => item.question), questions);
    const guide = await readFile(new URL(`../${path}/LEARNER.md`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
    const anchors = new Set([...guide.matchAll(/^## (.+)$/gm)].map((match) => `LEARNER.md#${match[1].toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}`));
    assert.equal(new Set(learner.predictions.map((item) => item.id)).size, count);
    for (const item of learner.predictions) {
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(item).sort(), ['answer', 'freshVariant', 'id', 'question', 'reason', 'source']);
      assert.ok(item.answer && item.reason && item.freshVariant.question);
      assert.ok(anchors.has(item.source), item.source);
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(item.freshVariant), ['question']);
      assert.notEqual(item.question, item.freshVariant.question);
    }
    assert.equal(reviewer.schema, 1);
    assert.equal(reviewer.module, module);
    assert.deepEqual(reviewer.freshVariantAnswers.map((item) => item.id), learner.predictions.map((item) => item.id));
    assert.ok(reviewer.freshVariantAnswers.every((item) => item.answer));
    assert.ok(reviewer.transfer.question && reviewer.transfer.referenceAnswer && reviewer.transfer.rubric.length >= 3);
    for (const item of reviewer.freshVariantAnswers) assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(learner).includes(item.answer));
    assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(learner).includes(reviewer.transfer.referenceAnswer));
    learner.predictions[0].answer = 'mutated copy';
    learner.predictions[0].freshVariant.question = 'mutated question';
    reviewer.transfer.rubric[0].evidence = 'mutated rubric';
    assert.notEqual(postCheckFeedback().predictions[0].answer, 'mutated copy');
    assert.notEqual(postCheckFeedback().predictions[0].freshVariant.question, 'mutated question');
    assert.notEqual(reviewerFeedback().transfer.rubric[0].evidence, 'mutated rubric');
  });
}

test('timing keys agree with real receipt, stale retry and clock calculations', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback } = await feedback('timing');
  const result = runInvestigation({ schema: 1, startMs: 0, actions: [
    { type: 'join', label: 'join', id: 'a' },
    { type: 'sample', label: 'tick3', nowMs: 150 },
    { type: 'input', label: 'late', id: 'a', seq: 1, move: 'E', sentAtMs: 0 },
    { type: 'sample', label: 'tick7', nowMs: 350 },
  ] });
  const late = result.observed.checkpoints.find(({ label }) => label === 'late');
  assert.equal(late.actors[0].expiresAt, 7);
  assert.equal(result.observed.checkpoints.at(-1).actors[0].x, 2000);
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'receipt-window').answer, /4, 5, 6 and 7.*x=2000/);
  const retry = runInvestigation({ schema: 1, startMs: 0, actions: [
    { type: 'join', label: 'join', id: 'a' },
    { type: 'input', label: 'east', id: 'a', seq: 1, move: 'E' },
    { type: 'sample', label: 'tick3', nowMs: 150 },
    { type: 'input', label: 'stale-west', id: 'a', seq: 1, move: 'W' },
    { type: 'sample', label: 'tick4', nowMs: 200 },
    { type: 'sample', label: 'tick5', nowMs: 250 },
  ] });
  assert.deepEqual(retry.observed.checkpoints.slice(2).map((item) => item.actors[0].x), [1750, 1750, 2000, 2000]);
  assert.equal(retry.observed.checkpoints[3].receipt.status, 'stale');
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'stale-retry').answer, /x stays 1750.*expiry stays 4.*x=2000.*x=2000/);
  const clock = createClock(0);
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(826.5), { ticks: 5, dropped: 11, overruns: 1, remainder: 26.5 });
  assert.deepEqual(clock.sample(850), { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 1, remainder: 0 });
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'bounded-clock').answer, /5 ticks, drops 11.*26\.5 ms/);
  const fresh = createClock(0);
  assert.deepEqual([fresh.sample(20), fresh.sample(620), fresh.sample(650)], [
    { ticks: 0, dropped: 0, overruns: 0, remainder: 20 },
    { ticks: 5, dropped: 7, overruns: 1, remainder: 20 },
    { ticks: 1, dropped: 0, overruns: 1, remainder: 0 },
  ]);
});

test('telemetry keys reject malformed history before final equality and compare empty checkpoints', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback } = await feedback('telemetry');
  let applications = 0;
  const engine = { release: 'r1', restore: (state) => structuredClone(state), apply: () => { applications += 1; }, canonical: (state) => state, equal: (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b) };
  const empty = { schema: 1, runtimeRelease: 'r1', startIndex: 70, checkpoint: { score: 3 }, events: [], endIndex: 70, complete: true, final: { score: 3 } };
  for (const indices of [[71, 73], [72, 71]]) {

  }

  assert.deepEqual(replayWindow({ ...empty, final: { score: 4 } }, engine), { ok: false, reason: 'final' });
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'missing-index').answer, /reason:'sequence'.*71 and 72/);
