```mjs
});

test('recovery keys agree with target, compatibility, ordinal and UTF-16 rules', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback, reviewerFeedback } = await feedback('recovery');
  const evidence = {
    targetReleaseId: 'r1', releases: [{ id: 'r1', packageHash: 'p1', stateSchema: 1, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' }],
    configurations: [{ id: 'c1', hash: 'h1', releaseId: 'r1', stateSchema: 1 }],
    snapshots: [
      { id: 'older', hash: 's2', ordinal: 2, stateSchema: 1, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' },
      { id: 'z-ready', hash: 'sz', ordinal: 6, stateSchema: 1, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' },
      { id: 'a-ready', hash: 'sa', ordinal: 6, stateSchema: 1, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' },
      { id: 'newer', hash: 's10', ordinal: 10, stateSchema: 2, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' },
    ],
  };
  assert.equal(selectRecovery(evidence).snapshotId, 'a-ready');
  assert.equal(selectRecovery({ ...evidence, snapshots: evidence.snapshots.toReversed() }).snapshotId, 'a-ready');
  assert.deepEqual(selectRecovery({ ...evidence, targetReleaseId: 'r3' }), { ok: false, reason: 'unknown-target' });
  const incompatible = [{ id: 'wrong-hash', hash: 's1', ordinal: 1, stateSchema: 1, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h2' }, { id: 'wrong-schema', hash: 's2', ordinal: 2, stateSchema: 2, configId: 'c1', configHash: 'h1' }];
  assert.deepEqual(selectRecovery({ ...evidence, snapshots: incompatible }), { ok: false, reason: 'no-compatible-snapshot' });
  const tied = ['a-ready', 'Z-ready'].map((id) => ({ ...evidence.snapshots[0], id, ordinal: 9 }));
  assert.equal(selectRecovery({ ...evidence, snapshots: tied }).snapshotId, 'Z-ready');
  const practice = { ...evidence, snapshots: [
    { ...evidence.snapshots[3], ordinal: 13 },
    { ...evidence.snapshots[1], id: 'm-snap', ordinal: 8 },
    { ...evidence.snapshots[0], ordinal: 5 },
    { ...evidence.snapshots[2], id: 'B-snap', ordinal: 8 },
  ] };
  assert.equal(selectRecovery(practice).snapshotId, 'B-snap');
  assert.equal(selectRecovery({ ...practice, snapshots: practice.snapshots.toReversed() }).snapshotId, 'B-snap');
  assert.deepEqual(selectRecovery({ ...practice, targetReleaseId: 'r4' }), { ok: false, reason: 'unknown-target' });
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'snapshot-order').answer, /ordinal-8.*B-snap/);
  assert.match(reviewerFeedback().freshVariantAnswers.find(({ id }) => id === 'snapshot-order').answer, /Z-ready wins/);
});

test('capstone keys preserve distance, successful receipts, failed IDs and refusal precedence', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback } = await feedback('capstone');
  const request = { requestId: 'A', stationId: 'alpha' };
  const base = () => addActor(initialState(), 'actor-1');
  for (const [x, y, reason] of [[400, 0, 'repaired'], [300, 300, 'range']]) {
    const state = base();
    Object.assign(state.actors[0], { x, y });
    assert.equal(repair(state, 'actor-1', request).reason, reason);
  }
  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'range-boundary').answer, /160000.*180000>160000/);
  const first = repair(base(), 'actor-1', request);
  const moved = structuredClone(first.state);
  moved.actors[0].x = 900;
  const duplicate = repair(moved, 'actor-1', request);
  assert.equal(duplicate.reason, 'duplicate');
  assert.deepEqual(duplicate.receipt, first.receipt);
  assert.deepEqual(duplicate.state, moved);
  assert.equal(repair(moved, 'actor-1', { ...request, stationId: 'beta' }).reason, 'conflict');
  const failed = repair(moved, 'actor-1', { ...request, requestId: 'B' });
  assert.equal(failed.reason, 'range');
  assert.deepEqual(failed.state, moved);
  failed.state.actors[0].x = 0;
  const second = repair(failed.state, 'actor-1', { ...request, requestId: 'B' });
  assert.equal(second.reason, 'repaired');
  assert.equal(repair(second.state, 'actor-1', { ...request, requestId: 'C' }).reason, 'history-full');
  assert.equal(repair(second.state, 'actor-1', request).reason, 'duplicate');
  assert.equal(repair(second.state, 'actor-1', { requestId: 'C', stationId: 'missing' }).reason, 'station');
});

test('order v3 keys agree with admitted-state preservation and inclusive movement windows', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback, reviewerFeedback } = await feedback('lab/order');
  const empty = { lastSeq: 0, lastSeen: 0, expiresAt: 0, move: 'idle', pendingInteract: false };
  const west = admitInput(empty, { seq: 7, move: 'W', interact: false }, 1).next;
  const stale = admitInput(west, { seq: 6, move: 'E', interact: true }, 3);
  assert.equal(stale.status, 'stale');
  assert.deepEqual(stale.next, west);
  const ticksThrough4 = [2, 3, 4].filter((tick) => movementActive(stale.next, tick));

  assert.equal(stale.next.pendingInteract, false);
  assert.equal(stale.next.expiresAt, 5);
  const east = admitInput(empty, { seq: 3, move: 'E', interact: false }, 2).next;
  const active = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].filter((tick) => movementActive(east, tick));
  assert.deepEqual(active, [3, 4, 5, 6]);
  assert.equal(1000 + active.length * 250, 2000);
  const initialWest = admitInput(empty, { seq: 1, move: 'W', interact: false }, 2).next;
  const renewed = admitInput(initialWest, { seq: 2, move: 'W', interact: false }, 6).next;
  assert.equal(movementActive(renewed, 7), true);

  assert.match(byId(postCheckFeedback(), 'read-only-polling').answer, /T6.*T8 is x=2000/);
  assert.match(reviewerFeedback().transfer.question, /^An owned replay scrubber/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(reviewerFeedback().transfer.referenceAnswer, /expiresAt=/);
});
```

```mjs
test('staging coalesces interaction and lets the latest valid direction win', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'E', true);
    const duplicate = await input(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'W', true);
    assert.equal(duplicate.data.status, 'stale');
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 2, 'W', true);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 3, 'idle', false);
    await server.advance(1);
    const result = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    assert.deepEqual([result.actor.x, result.actor.y, result.actor.lastSeq], [1000, 1000, 3]);
    assert.deepEqual(result.lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'range', tick: 1 });
    await server.advance(1);
    assert.deepEqual((await state(server.base, actor.token)).lastDecision, result.lastDecision, 'pending interaction is consumed once');
    assert.equal(result.findings.length, 0, 'one coalesced denial is not three violations');
  });
});

test('malformed and forged authoritative fields never consume sequence or mutate state', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    const initial = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    const valid = { v: 1, seq: 1, move: 'idle', interact: false };
    const forged = ['score', 'x', 'y', 'position', 'inventory', 'cargo', 'id', 'token', 'clientTime'];
    const cases = forged.map((key) => JSON.stringify({ ...valid, [key]: key === 'score' ? 999 : 'forged' }));
    cases.push('{', 'null', '[]', JSON.stringify({ ...valid, v: 2 }), JSON.stringify({ ...valid, seq: 1.5 }),
      JSON.stringify({ ...valid, seq: 0 }), JSON.stringify({ ...valid, seq: 1000001 }),
      JSON.stringify({ ...valid, seq: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 }), JSON.stringify({ ...valid, move: 'NE' }),
      JSON.stringify({ ...valid, interact: 1 }), JSON.stringify({ v: 1, seq: 1, move: 'idle' }));
    for (const body of cases) {
      const response = await request(server.base, '/input', { method: 'POST', token: actor.token, body, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      assert.equal(response.status, 400, `malformed request must fail: ${body}`);
      assert.deepEqual(await state(server.base, actor.token), initial, 'rejected input must leave the entire snapshot unchanged');
    }
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'E');
    await server.advance(1);
    assert.equal((await state(server.base, actor.token)).actor.x, 1250);
  });
});

test('sessions isolate actors and targets; bearer token is the sole actor selector', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const alice = await join(server.base);
    const bob = await join(server.base);
    assert.notEqual(alice.id, bob.id);
    assert.notEqual(alice.token, bob.token);
    const beforeBob = await state(server.base, bob.token);
    await admitted(server.base, alice.token, 1, 'E');
    await server.advance(4);
    await admitted(server.base, alice.token, 2, 'E');
    await server.advance(2);
    await admitted(server.base, alice.token, 3, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    const aliceState = await state(server.base, alice.token);
    const bobState = await state(server.base, bob.token);
    assert.deepEqual([aliceState.actor.x, aliceState.actor.cargo], [2500, true]);
    assert.equal(bobState.actor.x, 1000);
    assert.deepEqual(bobState.core, beforeBob.core);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(aliceState).sort(), ['actor', 'arena', 'core', 'depot', 'findings', 'lastDecision', 'tick']);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(aliceState);
    assert.ok(!serialized.includes(alice.token) && !serialized.includes(bob.token));
    assert.ok(!serialized.includes(bob.id), 'private snapshot must not reveal another actor');
    const forged = await request(server.base, '/input', { method: 'POST', token: alice.token, json: { v: 1, seq: 4, move: 'W', interact: false, id: bob.id } });
    assert.equal(forged.status, 400);
    assert.equal((await state(server.base, bob.token)).actor.lastSeq, 0);
    await join(server.base);
    await join(server.base);
    assert.equal((await request(server.base, '/join', { method: 'POST', json: {} })).status, 429);
  });
});

test('allowed loopback Host and Origin, 512-byte limit and JSON media type', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {

  });

test('a legal detour clears the wall while the far wall edge remains solid', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    let seq = 0;
    for (const [move, ticks] of [['S', 4], ['S', 3], ['E', 4], ['E', 4], ['E', 4], ['E', 2], ['N', 4], ['N', 3]]) {
      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, move);
      await server.advance(ticks);
    }
    assert.deepEqual([(await state(server.base, actor.token)).actor.x, (await state(server.base, actor.token)).actor.y], [4500, 1000]);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'W');
    await server.advance(1);
    const stopped = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    assert.deepEqual([stopped.actor.x, stopped.actor.y], [4500, 1000]);
    assert.deepEqual(stopped.findings, []);
  });
});

test('the exact 250 mm interaction boundary succeeds, but 500 mm fails', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'E');
    await server.advance(4);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 2, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    assert.equal((await state(server.base, actor.token)).lastDecision.reason, 'range');
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 3, 'E', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    const edge = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    assert.deepEqual([edge.actor.x, edge.actor.cargo], [2250, true]);
    assert.equal(edge.lastDecision.reason, 'pickup');
  });
});

test('legal delayed retry and blocked movement are excluded from findings', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);

      await server.advance(1);

test('three range violations trigger advisory detection while legal movement continues', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);

      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, seq, 'idle', true);

  });

test('violations outside the 20-tick detector window do not accumulate forever', async () => {

test('altered local rendering with equivalent valid traffic is a declared detector miss', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const ordinary = await join(server.base);
    const altered = await join(server.base);
    const localView = structuredClone(await state(server.base, altered.token));
    localView.actor.score = 999; // Deliberately never transmitted.
    const transcript = [[1, 'E', false, 4], [2, 'E', false, 2], [3, 'idle', true, 1]];
    for (const [seq, move, interact, ticks] of transcript) {
      await admitted(server.base, ordinary.token, seq, move, interact);
      await admitted(server.base, altered.token, seq, move, interact);
      await server.advance(ticks);
    }
    const left = await state(server.base, ordinary.token);
    const right = await state(server.base, altered.token);
    delete left.actor.id;
    delete right.actor.id;
    assert.deepEqual(left, right, 'server sees equivalent valid messages, not rendering behavior');
    assert.deepEqual(right.findings, []);
    assert.equal(right.actor.score, 0);
    assert.notEqual(right.actor.score, localView.actor.score, 'local display edits do not set authoritative score');
    assert.equal(right.actor.cargo, true);
  });
});

test('disconnect and token resume preserve sequence, position and expired intent', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const connection = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true });

    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 9, 'W');
    await server.advance(1);
    assert.equal((await state(server.base, actor.token)).actor.x, 1750);
  });
});

test('restart invalidates all previous process capabilities', async () => {

test('record replays ordered HTTP admissions and owner ticks without capability secrets', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const { actor } = await honestWin(server);
    await input(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'E', true);
    const record = await server.record();
    assert.equal(record.version, 1);
    assert.equal(record.seed, 17);
    assert.equal(record.dropped, 0);
    assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(record).includes(actor.token));
    assert.equal(record.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'join').length, 1);
    assert.equal(record.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'input').length, 7, 'parsed stale inputs are part of replay');
    assert.equal(record.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'tick').length, 14);
    const { replay } = await import('../engine.mjs');
    assert.deepEqual(replay(record), record.final);
    assert.deepEqual(record.final.actors, [await state(server.base, actor.token)]);
    const altered = structuredClone(record);
    altered.events.find((event) => event.type === 'input').input.move = 'W';
    assert.throws(() => replay(altered), /./, 'changed transition transcript must not match the recorded final state');
  });
});

test('bounded record explicitly refuses complete replay after history drops', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    await join(server.base);

    const record = await server.record();
    assert.ok(record.events.length <= 4096);
    assert.ok(record.dropped > 0);
    const { replay } = await import('../engine.mjs');
    assert.throws(() => replay(record), /./);
  });

test('owner IPC disconnect and SIGTERM close listeners and exit cleanly', async () => {
  const disconnected = await startServer();
  try {
    disconnected.child.disconnect();
    assert.equal((await disconnected.waitForExit()).code, 0);
    await assert.rejects(request(disconnected.base, '/health'));
  } finally { await disconnected.stop(); }
  const signalled = await startServer();
  const heldConnection = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true });
  try {
    const actor = await join(signalled.base, { agent: heldConnection });
    await state(signalled.base, actor.token, { agent: heldConnection });
    signalled.child.kill('SIGTERM');
    assert.equal((await signalled.waitForExit()).code, 0);
    await assert.rejects(request(signalled.base, '/health'));
  } finally {
    heldConnection.destroy();
    await signalled.stop();
  }
});

test('test flag without parent IPC and unknown options cannot start an unsafe server', async () => {
  for (const args of [['--test'], ['--mutant', 'omit-proximity'], ['--not-an-option']]) {
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [serverPath, '--port', '0', ...args], { stdio: 'ignore' });
    try {
      const [code, signal] = await raceTimeout(once(child, 'exit'), 3000, 'Unsafe startup did not fail promptly.');
      assert.notEqual(code, 0);
      assert.equal(signal, null);
    } finally { if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL'); }
  }
});

test('normal monotonic clock advances over real HTTP and stops on SIGTERM', async (t) => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    const before = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 1, 'E');
    const deadline = performance.now() + 3000;
    let after = before;
    while (after.tick <= before.tick + 4 && performance.now() < deadline) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 30));
      after = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    }
    assert.ok(after.tick > before.tick + 4, 'normal runtime must advance without IPC');
    assert.equal(after.actor.x, 2000, 'normal runtime also expires a four-tick intent');
    assert.deepEqual(after.findings, []);
    t.diagnostic(`Real-clock smoke observed ticks ${before.tick}→${after.tick}; no exact wall-time guarantee asserted.`);
  }, { testMode: false });
});

test('100 bounded sequential HTTP state reads remain responsive', async (t) => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    const latencies = [];
    const started = performance.now();
    for (let index = 0; index < 100; index += 1) {
      const before = performance.now();
      await state(server.base, actor.token);
      latencies.push(performance.now() - before);
    }
    const elapsed = performance.now() - started;
    latencies.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    assert.ok(elapsed < 10000, 'local smoke must finish within its generous bounded budget');
    t.diagnostic(JSON.stringify({ requests: 100, totalMs: Number(elapsed.toFixed(2)), p50Ms: Number(latencies[49].toFixed(2)), p95Ms: Number(latencies[94].toFixed(2)), scope: 'local sequential smoke, not a capacity claim' }));
  });
});

```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/engine.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createWorld, join, admit, advance, snapshot, events, canonical, replay } from '../engine.mjs';
import { createDetector, expireObservations, interactionDenial, observeDenial } from '../defense.mjs';
import { parseInput } from '../protocol.mjs';

const input = (seq, move = 'idle', interact = false) => ({ v: 1, seq, move, interact });

function setup(seed = 17, options) {
  const world = createWorld(seed, options);
  const actor = join(world);
  return { world, actor };
}

function travel(world, actor, move, ticks) {
  let remaining = ticks;
  while (remaining > 0) {
    const count = Math.min(remaining, 4);
    assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, input(actor.lastSeq + 1, move)).status, 'admitted');
    advance(world, count);
    remaining -= count;
  }
}

function act(world, actor) {
  admit(world, actor.id, input(actor.lastSeq + 1, 'idle', true));
  advance(world, 1);
  return snapshot(world, actor.id);
}

test('initial snapshot has exactly the public detached shape and seeded targets', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  const initial = snapshot(world, actor.id);
  assert.deepEqual(initial, {
    tick: 0,
    actor: { id: 'actor-1', x: 1000, y: 1000, score: 0, cargo: false, lastSeq: 0, expiresAt: 0, nextInteractTick: 0 },
    core: { x: 2500, y: 1000 }, depot: { x: 1000, y: 1000 },
    arena: { width: 8000, height: 4000, wall: { x: 4000, y: 0, width: 250, height: 2500 } },
    lastDecision: null, findings: [],
  });
  initial.actor.x = 8000;
  initial.arena.wall.width = 0;
  initial.core.x = 0;
  initial.findings.push({ kind: 'fake' });
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).actor.x, 1000);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).arena.wall.width, 250);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).core.x, 2500);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, []);
  const zero = setup(0);
  assert.equal(snapshot(zero.world, zero.actor.id).core.x, 2000);
});

test('world rejects invalid seeds and mutants and limits deterministic joins', () => {
  for (const seed of [NaN, Infinity, 1.2, '17', Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1]) {
    assert.throws(() => createWorld(seed), /seed must be a safe integer/);
  }
  assert.throws(() => createWorld(17, { mutant: 'remote-code' }), /unknown mutant/);
  const world = createWorld(-1);
  assert.deepEqual(Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => join(world).id), ['actor-1', 'actor-2', 'actor-3', 'actor-4']);
  assert.throws(() => join(world), /session limit/);
  assert.equal(world.actors.length, 4);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, 'actor-1').core.x, 2500);
  assert.throws(() => snapshot(world, 'missing'), /unknown actor/);
});

test('strict parser accepts only the four declared fields and exact types', () => {
  for (const move of ['N', 'S', 'E', 'W', 'idle']) {
    for (const seq of [1, 1_000_000]) {
      const value = input(seq, move, true);
      assert.deepEqual(parseInput(JSON.stringify(value)), { ok: true, input: value });
    }
  }
  const invalid = [
    null, [], 7, 'text', {}, { ...input(1), score: 999 }, { ...input(1), id: 'actor-2' },
    { ...input(1), x: 5000 }, { ...input(1), clientTime: 0 }, { ...input(1), inventory: [] },
    { ...input(1), v: '1' }, { ...input(1), v: 2 }, { ...input(1), seq: 0 },
    { ...input(1), seq: -1 }, { ...input(1), seq: 1_000_001 }, { ...input(1), seq: 1.5 },
    { ...input(1), seq: '1' }, { ...input(1), move: 'NE' }, { ...input(1), move: null },
    { ...input(1), interact: 1 }, { ...input(1), interact: 'false' },
    { v: 1, seq: 1, move: 'E' }, { ...input(1), __protoField: 1 },
  ];
  for (const value of invalid) {
    const result = parseInput(JSON.stringify(value));
    assert.equal(result.ok, false, JSON.stringify(value));
    assert.equal(typeof result.reason, 'string');
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(result).sort(), ['ok', 'reason']);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(parseInput('{'), { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-json' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseInput(input(1)), { ok: false, reason: 'input-text-required' });
});

test('malformed and unknown-actor admission cannot consume sequence or mutate intent', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  const before = canonical(world);
  for (const value of [{ ...input(100), score: 999 }, input(0), { ...input(1), move: ['E'] }, null]) {
    assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, value).status, 'rejected');
  }
  assert.deepEqual(admit(world, 'missing', input(1)), { status: 'rejected', reason: 'unknown-actor', tick: 0, seq: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(canonical(world), before);
  assert.deepEqual(events(world).events, [{ type: 'join', id: actor.id }]);
  assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, input(1)).status, 'admitted');
});

test('duplicate same-tick input leaves the first direction and exactly one interaction', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  assert.deepEqual(admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'E', true)), { status: 'admitted', reason: 'accepted', tick: 0, seq: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'W', true)), { status: 'stale', reason: 'stale-sequence', tick: 0, seq: 1 });
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 1250);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'range', tick: 1 });
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision.tick, 1);
  assert.equal(actor.detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 1);
});

test('sequence gaps are allowed and a stale request changes neither intent nor lastSeen', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  admit(world, actor.id, input(2, 'N'));
  assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'E', true)).status, 'stale');
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y, actor.lastSeq, actor.lastSeen], [1000, 750, 2, 0]);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, null);
  assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, input(200, 'S')).status, 'admitted');
  assert.equal(actor.lastSeen, 1);
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.equal(actor.y, 1000);
  assert.equal(actor.lastSeq, 200);
});

test('new movement replaces old movement while interaction bits coalesce through false', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'E', true));
  admit(world, actor.id, input(2, 'W', true));
  admit(world, actor.id, input(3, 'idle', false));
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y, actor.lastSeq], [1000, 1000, 3]);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'range', tick: 1 });
  advance(world, 4);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision.tick, 1);
});

test('movement expires after four ticks and same-tick renewal has no gap', () => {
  const expired = setup();
  admit(expired.world, expired.actor.id, input(1, 'E'));
  advance(expired.world, 4);
  assert.equal(expired.actor.x, 2000);
  advance(expired.world, 3);
  assert.equal(expired.actor.x, 2000);
  const renewed = setup();
  admit(renewed.world, renewed.actor.id, input(1, 'E'));
  advance(renewed.world, 4);
  admit(renewed.world, renewed.actor.id, input(2, 'E'));
  advance(renewed.world, 1);
  assert.equal(renewed.actor.x, 2250);
  assert.equal(renewed.actor.expiresAt, 8);
  assert.equal(snapshot(renewed.world, renewed.actor.id).actor.expiresAt, 8);
});

test('a stale request at expiry cannot renew movement or queue an interaction', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  admit(world, actor.id, input(2, 'E'));
  advance(world, 4);
  assert.equal(admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'N', true)).status, 'stale');
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y, actor.expiresAt, actor.lastSeen], [2000, 1000, 4, 0]);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, null);
});

test('each tick moves before evaluating a staged interaction', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  travel(world, actor, 'E', 4);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 2000);
  admit(world, actor.id, input(actor.lastSeq + 1, 'E', true));
  advance(world, 1);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 2250);
  assert.equal(actor.cargo, true);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, { status: 'applied', reason: 'pickup', tick: 5 });

test('the honest six-tick route picks up and deposits once with cooldown', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  travel(world, actor, 'E', 6);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 2500);
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'pickup');
  assert.equal(actor.cargo, true);
  travel(world, actor, 'W', 6);
  const deposited = act(world, actor);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.score, actor.cargo], [1000, 1, false]);
  assert.deepEqual(deposited.core, { x: 2500, y: 1000 });
  assert.deepEqual(deposited.lastDecision, { status: 'applied', reason: 'deposit', tick: 14 });
  assert.equal(actor.nextInteractTick, 18);
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'cooldown');
  assert.deepEqual([actor.score, actor.cargo], [1, false]);
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'cooldown');
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'cooldown');
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'range');
  assert.equal(actor.score, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(replay(events(world)), canonical(world));
});

test('an unusual legal route uses the inclusive 250mm edge and isolates actor cargo', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  const other = join(world);
  travel(world, actor, 'E', 5);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 2250);
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'pickup');
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, other.id).actor.cargo, false);
  travel(world, actor, 'W', 4);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 1250);
  assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'deposit');
  assert.equal(actor.score, 1);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, other.id).actor.score, 0);
  travel(world, other, 'E', 5);
  assert.equal(act(world, other).lastDecision.reason, 'pickup');
  assert.equal(other.cargo, true);
  assert.deepEqual(replay(events(world)), canonical(world));
});

test('proximity is squared Euclidean distance and cooldown has priority', () => {
  const target = { x: 2500, y: 1000 };
  assert.equal(interactionDenial({ x: 2250, y: 1000, nextInteractTick: 0 }, target, 1), null);
  assert.equal(interactionDenial({ x: 2250, y: 1001, nextInteractTick: 0 }, target, 1), 'range');
  assert.equal(interactionDenial({ x: 2300, y: 850, nextInteractTick: 0 }, target, 1), null);
  assert.equal(interactionDenial({ x: 1000, y: 1000, nextInteractTick: 3 }, target, 2), 'cooldown');
  assert.equal(interactionDenial({ x: 1000, y: 1000, nextInteractTick: 3 }, target, 3), 'range');
});

test('all arena boundaries block overflow and do not produce cheating findings', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();

  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y], [1000, 0]);
  travel(world, actor, 'W', 5);

  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y], [0, 4000]);

  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, []);
  assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).lastDecision, null);

test('wall blocks its inclusive segment and can be passed below its end', () => {

  travel(world, actor, 'N', 1);
  travel(world, actor, 'W', 2);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y], [4500, 2500]);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, []);

test('three distant range denials in twenty ticks yield advisory findings', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) act(world, actor);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, [{ kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: 3 }]);
  assert.deepEqual([actor.score, actor.cargo], [0, false]);
  travel(world, actor, 'E', 1);
  assert.equal(actor.x, 1250);
  const other = setup();
  travel(other.world, other.actor, 'E', 5);
  act(other.world, other.actor);
  for (let count = 0; count < 3; count += 1) assert.equal(act(other.world, other.actor).lastDecision.reason, 'cooldown');
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(other.world, other.actor.id).findings, []);
  assert.equal(other.actor.cargo, true);
});

test('human pickup re-presses and near-target anticipation produce no findings', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  travel(world, actor, 'E', 3);
  for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) {
    admit(world, actor.id, input(actor.lastSeq + 1, 'E', true));
    advance(world, 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.cargo], [2500, true]);
  for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) assert.equal(act(world, actor).lastDecision.reason, 'cooldown');
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, []);
});

test('the detector excludes cooldown and the inclusive 500 mm boundary', () => {
  const detector = createDetector();
  for (let tick = 1; tick <= 3; tick += 1) {
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'cooldown', 1_000_000);
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'range', 250_000);
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'range', 62_501);
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'range');
  }
  assert.deepEqual(detector.findings, []);
  assert.equal(detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 0);
  for (let tick = 4; tick <= 6; tick += 1) observeDenial(detector, tick, 'range', 250_001);
  assert.deepEqual(detector.findings, [{ kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: 6 }]);
});

test('twenty-tick window excludes old violations and stale retry floods', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  act(world, actor);
  advance(world, 19);
  act(world, actor);
  act(world, actor);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, []);
  act(world, actor);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(world, actor.id).findings, [{ kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: 23 }]);
  advance(world, 20);
  assert.equal(actor.detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 0);
  const clean = setup();
  admit(clean.world, clean.actor.id, input(100, 'idle'));
  for (let count = 0; count < 500; count += 1) admit(clean.world, clean.actor.id, input(99, 'E', true));
  advance(clean.world, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(clean.world, clean.actor.id).findings, []);
  assert.equal(clean.actor.detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 0);
});

test('detector keeps a bounded ring and at most one bounded finding per tick', () => {
  const detector = createDetector();
  for (let tick = 1; tick <= 400; tick += 1) {
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'range', 1_000_000);
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'cooldown', 1_000_000);
    observeDenial(detector, tick, 'stale', 1_000_000);
  }
  assert.equal(detector.buckets.length, 20);
  assert.equal(detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 20);
  assert.equal(detector.findings.length, 128);
  assert.equal(new Set(detector.findings.map((finding) => finding.tick)).size, 128);
  assert.deepEqual(detector.findings.at(-1), { kind: 'repeated-invalid-action', tick: 400 });
  expireObservations(detector, 420);
  assert.equal(detector.buckets.flatMap((bucket) => bucket.observations).length, 0);
});

test('records preserve ordered valid inputs including stale admissions and detach all fields', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  const staged = input(2, 'N');
  admit(world, actor.id, staged);
  staged.move = 'E';
  admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'W', true));
  advance(world, 1);
  const record = events(world);
  assert.deepEqual(record.events, [
    { type: 'join', id: 'actor-1' },
    { type: 'input', id: 'actor-1', input: input(2, 'N') },
    { type: 'input', id: 'actor-1', input: input(1, 'W', true) },
    { type: 'tick' },
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(replay(record), canonical(world));
  record.events[1].input.move = 'E';
  record.final.actors[0].actor.x = 0;
  assert.equal(events(world).events[1].input.move, 'N');
  assert.equal(canonical(world).actors[0].actor.x, 1000);
});

test('replay is independent of JSON property order but rejects altered results and invalid events', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'E'));
  advance(world, 3);
  const reordered = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(events(world)), (_key, value) => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return value;
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).reverse());
  });
  assert.deepEqual(replay(reordered), canonical(world));
  const malformed = [
    { ...events(world), version: 2 }, { ...events(world), dropped: 1 },
    { ...events(world), events: null }, { ...events(world), events: [{ type: 'reset' }] },
    { ...events(world), events: [{ type: 'tick', ticks: 5 }] },
    { ...events(world), events: [{ type: 'join', id: 'actor-2' }] },
    { ...events(world), events: [{ type: 'input', id: 'missing', input: input(1) }] },
    { ...events(world), events: [{ type: 'join', id: 'actor-1' }, { type: 'input', id: 'actor-1', input: { ...input(1), score: 999 } }] },
  ];
  for (const record of malformed) assert.throws(() => replay(record), /replay|records/);
  const forged = events(world);
  forged.final.actors[0].actor.score = 999;
  assert.throws(() => replay(forged), /final state mismatch/);
  const reorderedActions = events(world);
  [reorderedActions.events[1], reorderedActions.events[2]] = [reorderedActions.events[2], reorderedActions.events[1]];
  assert.throws(() => replay(reorderedActions), /final state mismatch/);
});

test('event history caps at 4096 and dropped history cannot claim complete replay', () => {
  const { world, actor } = setup();
  for (let count = 0; count < 4096; count += 1) admit(world, actor.id, input(1));
  const record = events(world);
  assert.equal(record.events.length, 4096);
  assert.equal(record.dropped, 1);
  assert.equal(record.events[0].type, 'input');
  assert.throws(() => replay(record), /dropped records/);
  assert.throws(() => replay({ ...record, dropped: 0, events: [...record.events, { type: 'tick' }] }), /invalid replay events/);
});

test('advance refuses unbounded or invalid tick requests without changing state', () => {
  const { world } = setup();
  for (const ticks of [0, -1, 101, 1.5, Infinity, NaN, '1']) assert.throws(() => advance(world, ticks), /ticks must/);
  assert.equal(world.tick, 0);
  advance(world, 100);
  assert.equal(world.tick, 100);
});

test('omit-proximity negative control changes remote pickup, so the regression detects it', () => {
  const normal = setup();
  const broken = setup(17, { mutant: 'omit-proximity' });
  const legalState = act(normal.world, normal.actor);
  const mutantState = act(broken.world, broken.actor);
  assert.equal(legalState.actor.cargo, false);
  assert.equal(legalState.lastDecision.reason, 'range');
  assert.equal(mutantState.actor.cargo, true);
  assert.equal(mutantState.lastDecision.reason, 'pickup');
  assert.throws(() => assert.equal(mutantState.actor.cargo, false), assert.AssertionError);
  assert.throws(() => replay(events(broken.world)), /final state mismatch/);
});

test('omit-sequence negative control changes direction, so the regression detects it', () => {
  const normal = setup();
  const broken = setup(17, { mutant: 'omit-sequence' });
  for (const { world, actor } of [normal, broken]) {
    admit(world, actor.id, input(2, 'N'));
    admit(world, actor.id, input(1, 'E'));
    advance(world, 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual([normal.actor.x, normal.actor.y], [1000, 750]);
  assert.deepEqual([broken.actor.x, broken.actor.y], [1250, 1000]);
  assert.throws(() => assert.deepEqual([broken.actor.x, broken.actor.y], [1000, 750]), assert.AssertionError);
  assert.throws(() => replay(events(broken.world)), /final state mismatch/);
});
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm, symlink, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { checkSubmission } from '../lab/core/grade.mjs';
import { prepareWorkspace } from '../lab/core/prepare.mjs';
import { sealReference } from '../lab/core/seal.mjs';
import { readBundle, referenceFiles, sha256, writeBundle } from '../lab/core/trust.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const settings = { threshold: 3, windowTicks: 20, minDistanceMm: 500 };
const secondSettings = { threshold: 2, windowTicks: 8, minDistanceMm: 500 };

async function prepared(t, id = 'evaluation') {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-evaluation-custody-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  await writeBundle(root, await readBundle(project, await referenceFiles(project)));
  await sealReference(root);
  const preparation = await prepareWorkspace({ root, id });
  const { workspace, referenceRoot } = preparation;
  const session = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'lab/core/session.json')));
  const predictions = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json')));
  predictions.predictions.forEach((item) => { item.answer = 'Captured author calibration prediction.'; });
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), JSON.stringify(predictions));
  const api = await import(pathToFileURL(join(referenceRoot, 'evaluation/custody.mjs')));
  if (id === 'evaluation') await writeFile(join(workspace, 'evaluation/policy.mjs'), await readFile(join(root, 'evaluation/policy.mjs')));
  return { ...preparation, sourceRoot: root, session, api };
}

async function bytesFor(files) {
  return Promise.all(files.map(async ({ path, sha256: expected }) => {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    assert.equal(sha256(bytes), expected);
    return { path, bytes };
  }));
}

test('genuine preparation records every exploration, frozen plan and exposed evaluation with exact hashes', async (t) => {
  const { api, workspace, session } = await prepared(t);
  const one = await api.explore({ workspace, settings });
  const two = await api.explore({ workspace, settings: secondSettings });
  const frozen = await api.plan({ workspace, settings });
  assert.equal(one.report.split, 'exploration');
  assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(one.report, 'evaluation'), false);
  assert.equal(frozen.record.attemptKind, 'first');
  assert.equal(frozen.record.priorEvaluationExposure, false);
  const before = await bytesFor((await api.getEvidenceLinks({ workspace, session })).events.flatMap((event) => event.files));
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'evaluation/policy.mjs'), 'throw new Error("new source must not run the old plan");');
  const result = await api.run({ workspace, planId: frozen.planId });
  assert.equal(result.status, 'completed');
  assert.deepEqual(result.report.plan, frozen.plan);
  assert.ok(result.report.evaluation);
  const links = await api.getEvidenceLinks({ workspace, session });
  assert.deepEqual(links.events.map((event) => event.kind), ['explore', 'explore', 'plan', 'run']);
  assert.deepEqual(links.events.map((event) => event.eventId), [one.eventId, two.eventId, frozen.eventId, result.eventId]);
  assert.equal(links.latestPlanId, frozen.planId);
  assert.equal(links.evaluationExposed, true);
  for (const event of links.events) {
    assert.equal(event.sessionId, session.sessionId);
    assert.equal(event.referenceManifest, session.referenceManifest);
    assert.match(event.corpusSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    await bytesFor(event.files);
  }
  for (const item of before) assert.deepEqual(await readFile(item.path), item.bytes, item.path);
});

test('every subsequent plan requires a reason, preserves the first plan and declares prior exposure', async (t) => {
  const { api, workspace } = await prepared(t);
  const first = await api.plan({ workspace, settings });
  await assert.rejects(api.plan({ workspace, settings }), /declare --revision/);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'evaluation/policy.mjs'), (await readFile(join(workspace, 'evaluation/policy.mjs'), 'utf8')) + '\n// a revised candidate\n');
  await assert.rejects(api.plan({ workspace, settings: secondSettings }), /declare --revision/);
  await api.run({ workspace, planId: first.planId });
  const revision = await api.plan({ workspace, settings: secondSettings, revisionReason: 'Shorter window after the preserved evaluation result.' });
  assert.equal(revision.record.attemptKind, 'revision');
  assert.equal(revision.record.previousPlanId, first.planId);
  assert.equal(revision.record.priorEvaluationExposure, true);
  assert.equal(revision.record.priorRunIds.length, 1);
  assert.match(revision.record.revisionReason, /Shorter window/);
  assert.notEqual(revision.plan.sourceSha256, first.plan.sourceSha256);
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await readFile(first.path)), first.plan);
  await assert.rejects(api.run({ workspace, planId: first.planId }), /already started/);
});

test('failed evaluations keep source, exposure and failure evidence and cannot erase the first run', async (t) => {
  const { api, workspace } = await prepared(t);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, 'evaluation/policy.mjs'), 'export function evaluate() { throw new Error("learner failure"); }');
  const frozen = await api.plan({ workspace, settings });
  let failed;
  await assert.rejects(api.run({ workspace, planId: frozen.planId }), (error) => {

  });
  assert.equal(failed.status, 'failed');

  assert.equal(revision.record.priorRunIds[0], failed.eventId);
});
```

```mjs
  test(`correct policy passes every criterion: ${name}`, async () => {

    assert.equal(result.passed, true, JSON.stringify(result.criteria.filter((item) => !item.passed), null, 2));
    assert.equal(result.criteria.length, cases().length);
  });

for (const [name, candidate] of Object.entries(wrongPolicies)) {
  test(`calibration rejects plausible wrong policy: ${name}`, async () => {
    const result = await assess(candidate);
    assert.equal(result.passed, false, `${name} incorrectly passed`);
    const failures = result.criteria.filter((item) => !item.passed);
    assert.ok(failures.length > 0);
    for (const { error } of failures) {
      assert.ok(error.message.length > 0);
      assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(error, 'expected'));
      assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(error, 'actual'));
      assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(error, 'input'));
      assert.match(error.source, /^LEARNER\.md#/);
    }
  });
}

test('checker reports missing exports and thrown/non-JSON results without losing feedback', async () => {
  const absent = await assess({});
  assert.equal(absent.passed, false);
  assert.equal(absent.criteria.length, 2);
  const broken = await assess({ classify() { throw new Error('failed candidate'); }, evaluate() { return { metrics: NaN }; } });
  assert.equal(broken.passed, false);
  assert.deepEqual(broken.criteria[0].error.actual, { threw: 'failed candidate' });

test('classifier never receives case labels or metadata as input', () => {
  const raw = { id: 'label-trap', signals: [], get label() { throw new Error('read label before prediction'); } };
  assert.equal(classify(raw.signals, DEFAULT_SETTINGS), false);
  // A correct evaluate must read labels for scoring; changing them never changes its decisions.
  const a = evaluate([{ id: 'same-id', label: true, signals: [] }], DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  const b = evaluate([{ id: 'same-id', label: false, signals: [] }], DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  assert.deepEqual(a.decisions, b.decisions);
  assert.notDeepEqual(a.metrics, b.metrics);

  assert.deepEqual(corpus, generateCorpus());
  assert.equal(corpus.version, CORPUS_VERSION);
  assert.equal(corpus.cases.length, 14);
  assert.equal(new Set(corpus.cases.map((item) => item.id)).size, 14);
  assert.deepEqual(corpus.splits, SPLIT_IDS);
  for (const split of Object.keys(SPLIT_IDS)) {
    const projected = casesForSplit(corpus, split);
    assert.deepEqual(projected.map((item) => item.id), SPLIT_IDS[split]);
    assert.equal(projected.filter((item) => item.label).length, 1);
    assert.equal(projected.filter((item) => !item.label).length, 6);
    for (const item of projected) assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(item).sort(), ['id', 'label', 'signals']);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(await loadCorpus(corpus), corpus);
  assert.deepEqual(await loadCorpus(JSON.stringify(corpus)), corpus);
});

test('loadCorpus reads a local JSON file and refuses split, label, signal and replay alterations', async () => {
  const corpus = generateCorpus();
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'courier-evaluation-'));

    const path = join(directory, 'corpus.json');

    assert.deepEqual(await loadCorpus(path), corpus);
    const changedSplit = copy(corpus);
    changedSplit.splits.evaluation.reverse();

    const changedAutomation = copy(corpus);
    changedAutomation.cases[0].declaredAutomation = true;
    await assert.rejects(loadCorpus(changedAutomation), /declared automation metadata/);
    await assert.rejects(loadCorpus({ ...corpus, version: 'courier-synthetic-evaluation-v1' }), /Unsupported evaluation corpus/);
    const changedSignals = copy(corpus);
    changedSignals.cases[0].signals.push({ tick: 1, reason: 'range', distanceSquared: 1_000_000 });
    await assert.rejects(loadCorpus(changedSignals), /Signals do not match replay/);
    const changedRecord = copy(corpus);
    changedRecord.cases[0].record.final.actors[0].actor.score += 1;
    await assert.rejects(loadCorpus(changedRecord), /refused replay: final/);
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/harness.mjs`:

```mjs
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { request } from '../clients/http-client.mjs';

export const serverPath = fileURLToPath(new URL('../server.mjs', import.meta.url));

export async function startServer({ seed = 17, mutant, testMode = true, entry = serverPath, extraArgs = [] } = {}) {
  const args = ['--port', '0', '--seed', String(seed)];
  if (testMode) args.push('--test');
  if (mutant) args.push('--mutant', mutant);
  args.push(...extraArgs);
  const child = fork(entry, args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ipc'], execArgv: [] });
  let stdout = '';
  let stderr = '';
  let exited = false;
  let serial = 0;
  let exitInfo;
  const pending = new Map();
  const exitPromise = new Promise((resolve) => child.once('exit', (code, signal) => {
    exited = true;
    exitInfo = { code, signal };
    for (const item of pending.values()) item.reject(new Error(`Server exited (${code ?? signal}). ${stderr}`));
    pending.clear();
    resolve(exitInfo);
  }));
  child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => { stdout = (stdout + chunk).slice(-16384); });
  child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => { stderr = (stderr + chunk).slice(-16384); });
  child.on('message', (message) => {
    const item = pending.get(message?.requestId);
    if (!item) return;
    pending.delete(message.requestId);
    item.resolve(message);
  });
  const stop = async () => {
    if (exited) return exitInfo;
    if (testMode && child.connected) {
      try { await control('shutdown'); } catch { /* Escalate below if graceful shutdown failed. */ }
    }
    if (!testMode && !exited) child.kill('SIGTERM');
    return waitForExit();
  };
  const waitForExit = async () => {
    const result = await raceTimeout(exitPromise, 3000, 'Server did not shut down.').catch(async () => {
      child.kill('SIGKILL');
      await exitPromise;
      throw new Error(`Server needed SIGKILL during cleanup. ${stderr}`);
    });
    return result;
  };
  const control = async (type, values = {}) => {
    if (!child.connected || exited) throw new Error(`No live owner IPC channel. ${stderr}`);
    const requestId = `test-${++serial}`;
    const reply = new Promise((resolve, reject) => pending.set(requestId, { resolve, reject }));
    child.send({ type, requestId, ...values }, (error) => {
      if (!error) return;
      pending.get(requestId)?.reject(error);
      pending.delete(requestId);
    });
    try {
      const result = await raceTimeout(reply, 5000, `Owner ${type} acknowledgement timed out.`);
      if (result.ok !== true) throw new Error(`Owner ${type} failed: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
      return result;
    } finally {
      pending.delete(requestId);
    }
  };
  try {
    const ready = await raceTimeout(new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      child.on('message', function readyListener(message) {
        if (message?.type !== 'ready') return;
        child.off('message', readyListener);
        resolve(message);
      });
      child.once('error', reject);
      exitPromise.then((info) => reject(new Error(`Server exited before ready (${info.code ?? info.signal}). ${stderr}`)));
    }), 5000, 'Server ready acknowledgement timed out.');
    if (!Number.isInteger(ready.port) || ready.port < 1 || ready.port > 65535) throw new Error('Server returned an invalid port.');
    const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${ready.port}`;
    const health = await request(base, '/health');
    if (health.status !== 200 || health.data?.ok !== true) throw new Error('Ready server failed its HTTP health probe.');
    return {
      base, port: ready.port, child, control, stop, waitForExit,
      advance: (ticks) => control('advance', { ticks }),
      record: async () => (await control('record')).record,
      diagnostics: () => ({ stdout, stderr, exited, exitInfo }),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (!exited) child.kill('SIGTERM');
    await waitForExit();
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function withServer(callback, options) {
  const server = await startServer(options);
  try { return await callback(server); } finally {
    const exit = await server.stop();
    if (exit.code !== 0) throw new Error(`Server did not exit cleanly (${exit.code ?? exit.signal}). ${server.diagnostics().stderr}`);
  }
}

export function raceTimeout(promise, milliseconds, message) {
  let timer;
  const timeout = new Promise((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), milliseconds); });
  return Promise.race([promise, timeout]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
}
```

```mjs
    const result = await assess(control);
    assert.equal(result.passed, false);
    assert.ok(result.criteria.some((criterion) => !criterion.passed && criterion.error.message.includes('LEARNER.md')));
    assert.equal(result.criteria.find((criterion) => criterion.name === wrongTargets[control.name]).passed, false,
      `the intended defect must fail its corresponding criterion: ${control.name}`);
  });
}

test('the incomplete learner template returns failed criteria rather than a fake pass', async () => {
  const result = await assess(template);
  assert.equal(result.passed, false);
  assert.equal(result.criteria.find((criterion) => criterion.name === 'approved runtime bytes').passed, false);
});

test('failed verdict feedback preserves expected and actual values after JSON serialization', async () => {
  const assessed = await assess(wrongPolicies.find((policy) => policy.name === 'always-verified'));
  const result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(assessed));
  const failure = result.criteria.find((criterion) => criterion.name === 'actual runtime byte change');
  assert.deepEqual(failure.error.expected, { ok: false, reason: 'digest' });
  assert.deepEqual(failure.error.actual, { ok: true, reason: 'verified' });
  assert.equal(failure.error.code, 'ERR_ASSERTION');
  assert.equal(failure.error.operator, 'deepStrictEqual');
  assert.match(failure.error.message, /old approved reference must refuse changed engine.mjs bytes/);
  assert.match(failure.error.message, /LEARNER.md#decide-in-order/);
});

test('mutation feedback preserves the original and changed inventory', async () => {
  const assessed = await assess(wrongPolicies.find((policy) => policy.name === 'sort-input-in-place'));
  const result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(assessed));
  const failure = result.criteria.find((criterion) => criterion.name === 'inventory order is irrelevant');
  assert.notDeepEqual(failure.error.actual.observed, failure.error.expected.observed);
  assert.deepEqual(failure.error.actual.observed, [...failure.error.expected.observed].reverse());
  assert.match(failure.error.message, /must not mutate its inputs/);
  assert.match(failure.error.message, /LEARNER.md#your-editable-policy/);
});

test('a missing returned verdict is retained explicitly in JSON feedback', async () => {
  const result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(await assess({ checkPackage() {} })));
  const failure = result.criteria.find((criterion) => criterion.name === 'approved runtime bytes');
  assert.deepEqual(failure.error.expected, { ok: true, reason: 'verified' });
  assert.deepEqual(failure.error.actual, { type: 'undefined' });
});

test('the grader distinguishes a crashing candidate from a returned wrong verdict', async () => {
  await assert.rejects(assess({ checkPackage() { throw new Error('candidate failed to run'); } }), /candidate failed to run/);
  await assert.rejects(assess({}), /must export checkPackage/);
});

test('real engine byte changes refuse the old reference and allow a separately approved update', async () => {
  const cases = await integrityCases();
  const original = cases.find((item) => item.name === 'approved runtime bytes');
  const changed = cases.find((item) => item.name === 'actual runtime byte change');
  const update = cases.find((item) => item.name === 'approved compatible update');
  assert.deepEqual(original.input.observed.map((file) => file.path).sort(), [...FIXTURE_RUNTIME_PATHS].sort());
  assert.notEqual(original.input.observed.find((file) => file.path === 'engine.mjs').sha256,
    changed.input.observed.find((file) => file.path === 'engine.mjs').sha256);
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(original.input), { ok: true, reason: 'verified' });
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(changed.input), { ok: false, reason: 'digest' });
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(update.input), { ok: true, reason: 'verified' });
});

test('the compatible release actually increases bounded history without changing initial gameplay', async () => {
  const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await writeCompatibleUpdate(project, root);
    const updated = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, 'engine.mjs')));
    const world = updated.createWorld(17);
    const actor = updated.join(world);
    assert.deepEqual([actor.x, actor.y, actor.score, actor.cargo], [1000, 1000, 0, false]);
    for (let index = 0; index < 50; index += 1) updated.advance(world, 100);
    assert.equal(world.tick, 5000);
    assert.equal(world.history.length, 5001, 'the older 4096-entry limit would have discarded history');
    assert.equal(world.dropped, 0);
    for (let index = 0; index < 40; index += 1) updated.advance(world, 100);
    assert.equal(world.history.length, 8192, 'the update must still have a finite limit');
    assert.equal(world.dropped, 809);
  });
});

test('policy refuses malformed top-level shapes without throwing', () => {
  for (const value of [undefined, null, [], {}, { manifest: null, observed: [], supported: [] }]) {
    assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(value), { ok: false, reason: 'schema' });
  }
});

test('validation order reports malformed reference before unsupported release or observation', async () => {
  const input = structuredClone((await integrityCases())[0].input);
  input.manifest.release = 'not-supported';
  input.manifest.files[0].sha256 = 'invalid';
  input.observed = null;
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(input), { ok: false, reason: 'schema' });
  input.manifest.files[0].sha256 = 'a'.repeat(64);
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(input), { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported-release' });
  input.supported.push('not-supported');
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(input), { ok: false, reason: 'inventory' });
});

test('an empty supported set refuses every release; matching hashes cannot approve a release', async () => {
  const input = structuredClone((await integrityCases())[0].input);
  input.supported = [];
  assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(input), { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported-release' });
});

test('observer computes SHA-256 from complete regular-file bytes and sorts the independent inventory', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await mkdir(join(root, 'nested'));
    await writeFile(join(root, 'nested', 'one.mjs'), 'export const one = 1;\n');
    await writeFile(join(root, 'two.mjs'), Buffer.from([0, 255, 3, 10]));
    const observed = await observePackage(root, { paths: ['two.mjs', 'nested/one.mjs'] });
    const expected = [];
    for (const path of ['nested/one.mjs', 'two.mjs']) {
      expected.push({ path, sha256: createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(join(root, path))).digest('hex') });
    }
    assert.deepEqual(observed, expected);
  });
});

test('observer refuses unsafe and duplicate inventories before reading', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    for (const paths of [[], ['../outside'], ['/absolute'], ['a/../b'], ['a\\b'], ['a//b'], ['a', 'a']]) {
      await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths }), /Package observation refused/);
    }
  });
});

test('observer refuses absent files and directories instead of manufacturing an observation', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await mkdir(join(root, 'folder'));
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths: ['missing.mjs'] }), /ENOENT/);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths: ['folder'] }), /not a regular file/);
  });
});

test('observer refuses file, ancestor and root symbolic links including links into the package', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await mkdir(join(root, 'actual'));
    await writeFile(join(root, 'actual', 'runtime.mjs'), 'export const runtime = 1;');
    await symlink(join(root, 'actual', 'runtime.mjs'), join(root, 'link.mjs'));
    await symlink(join(root, 'actual'), join(root, 'alias'));
    await symlink(root, join(root, 'root-alias'));
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths: ['link.mjs'] }), /symbolic link/);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths: ['alias/runtime.mjs'] }), /symbolic link/);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(join(root, 'root-alias'), { paths: ['actual/runtime.mjs'] }), /real directory/);
  });
});

test('observer cannot follow a symlink to outside bytes', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await directory(async (outside) => {
      await writeFile(join(outside, 'secret.mjs'), 'outside this owned package');
      await symlink(outside, join(root, 'outside'));
      await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths: ['outside/secret.mjs'] }), /symbolic link/);
    });
  });
});

test('observer enforces file count, individual byte and total byte limits', async () => {
  await directory(async (root) => {
    await writeFile(join(root, 'a.mjs'), '1234');
    await writeFile(join(root, 'b.mjs'), '5678');
    const paths = ['a.mjs', 'b.mjs'];
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths, maxFiles: 1 }), /file count limit/);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths, maxFileBytes: 3 }), /file size limit/);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths, maxTotalBytes: 7 }), /total size limit/);
    assert.equal((await observePackage(root, { paths, maxFileBytes: 4, maxTotalBytes: 8 })).length, 2);
    await assert.rejects(observePackage(root, { paths, maxFiles: Infinity }), /positive safe integer/);
  });
});

test('portable inventories reject case-only aliases before observing physical files', async()=>{
 const original={manifest:{schema:1,packageId:'courier-runtime',release:'v1',files:[{path:'engine.mjs',sha256:'a'.repeat(64)},{path:'ENGINE.mjs',sha256:'b'.repeat(64)}]},observed:[],supported:['v1']};
 assert.deepEqual(checkPackage(original),{ok:false,reason:'schema'});
 await assert.rejects(observePackage(process.cwd(),{paths:['engine.mjs','ENGINE.mjs']}),/duplicate/);
});
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cp, mkdtemp, readdir, readFile, writeFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
const execute = promisify(execFile);
const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
async function run(cwd, file, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT; // This child is an independent CLI, not a nested node:test worker.
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [file, ...args], { cwd, timeout: 15000, env }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}
const prepared = existsSync(new URL('../lab/session.json', import.meta.url));
test('source lab preserves failed attempts, reasoning and the tested source snapshot', {
  skip: prepared ? 'Reference-authoring fixture; prepared workspaces run their own gameplay checks.' : false,
}, async () => {
  const temporary = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-courier-lab-'));
  try {
    for (const entry of await readdir(project)) {
      if (['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(entry)) continue;
      await cp(join(project, entry), join(temporary, entry), { recursive: true });
    }
    const sealed = await run(temporary, 'lab/order/seal.mjs');
    assert.equal(sealed.code, 0, sealed.stderr);
    const referenceRefused = await run(temporary, 'lab/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'author regression');
    assert.equal(referenceRefused.code, 2, 'a reference demo cannot become a learner submission');
    const prepare = await run(temporary, 'lab/prepare.mjs');
    assert.equal(prepare.code, 0, prepare.stderr);
    assert.equal((await run(temporary, 'lab/prepare.mjs')).code, 1, 'repeat prepare must preserve existing work');
    const workspace = join(temporary, 'artifacts/workspace');
    const starter = await readFile(join(workspace, 'defense.mjs'), 'utf8');
    const response = 'Author regression response: guard belongs on server; legal traffic cannot attest local code.';
    await writeFile(join(workspace, 'lab/response.md'), response);
    const predictions = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json')));
    predictions.predictions.forEach((item) => { item.answer = 'Captured author calibration prediction.'; });
    await writeFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), JSON.stringify(predictions));
    const failed = await run(workspace, 'lab/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'author regression: missing guard');
    assert.equal(failed.code, 1, failed.stdout);
    assert.match(failed.stdout, /remote pickup must leave cargo false/);
    const attempts = join(workspace, 'artifacts/attempts');
    const [first] = await readdir(attempts);
    assert.equal(await readFile(join(attempts, first, 'defense.mjs'), 'utf8'), starter);
    assert.equal(await readFile(join(attempts, first, 'response.md'), 'utf8'), response);
    const alternate = starter.replace('// TODO: deny interactions outside the inclusive 250 mm radius.', "if (!omitProximity && (actor.x - target.x) ** 2 + (actor.y - target.y) ** 2 > 62500) return 'range';");
    assert.notEqual(alternate, starter);
    await writeFile(join(workspace, 'defense.mjs'), alternate);
    const passed = await run(workspace, 'lab/check.mjs', '--assistance', 'author regression: equivalent correct repair');
    assert.equal(passed.code, 0, passed.stdout + passed.stderr);
    const all = await readdir(attempts);
    assert.equal(all.length, 2);
    assert.equal(await readFile(join(attempts, first, 'defense.mjs'), 'utf8'), starter, 'first submission is unchanged');
    const second = all.find((id) => id !== first);
    const bundle = join(attempts, second);
    const hashes = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(bundle, 'execution-hashes.json'), 'utf8'));
    const submission = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(bundle, 'submission.json'), 'utf8'));
    const session = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(workspace, 'lab/session.json')));
    assert.equal(submission.ownerExecutionRoot.startsWith(join(session.referenceRoot, 'artifacts/spatial-executions')), true);
    const actual = createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(join(submission.ownerExecutionRoot, 'defense.mjs'))).digest('hex');
    assert.equal(actual, hashes['defense.mjs']);
    assert.equal(await readFile(join(submission.ownerExecutionRoot, 'defense.mjs'), 'utf8'), alternate);
    assert.equal(existsSync(join(bundle, 'execution')), false, 'trusted execution stays outside the learner workspace');
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(await readFile(join(bundle, 'result.json'), 'utf8')).code, 0);
  } finally { await rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
```

```mjs
          current = await state(page);
          await answer(page, module, current.items.at(-1));
          assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth), false, `${name} ${unit.id}/${section.id} overflow`);
          sectionCount += 1;
        }
        await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `${name}-${unit.id}.png`), fullPage: true });
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Mastery check', exact: true }).click();
        await action(page, 'Start the three-item check');
        const current = await state(page);
        for (const id of current.masterySets.at(-1).itemIds) await answer(page, module, current.items.find((item) => item.id === id));
        assert.match(await page.locator('.status-box').textContent(), /Current status: mastered/, `${name} ${unit.id} objective coverage`);
      }
      const saved = await state(page);
      assert.equal(saved.units.filter((unit) => unit.status === 'mastered').length, 10);
      assert.equal(saved.exposures.length, sectionCount);
      assert.equal(saved.items.length, sectionCount * 2 + 30);
      assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
      results.push({ name, width, units: 10, sections: sectionCount, committedItems: saved.items.length, mastered: 10, overflow: false, errors, sourceAware: true });
      await page.close();
    }
  });
} finally {
  await browser.close(); await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  if (previous === undefined) delete process.env.LEARNING_DATA_DIR;
  if (previous !== undefined) process.env.LEARNING_DATA_DIR = previous;
}
await writeFile(join(output, 'browser-result.json'), JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/learning-early.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from 'node:util';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import * as spatial from '../learning/units/spatial.mjs';
import * as order from '../learning/units/order.mjs';
import * as testing from '../learning/units/testing.mjs';
import * as timing from '../learning/units/timing.mjs';
import { createWorld, join, admit, advance, snapshot } from '../engine.mjs';

const units = [spatial, order, testing, timing];
const seeds = [...Array.from({ length: 96 }, (_, seed) => seed), 65537, 2147483647, 4294967295];

function expectedSpatial(item) {
  const input = item.inputs;
  if (input.stepMm) {
    const x = input.actor.x + (input.move === 'E' ? input.stepMm : input.move === 'W' ? -input.stepMm : 0);
    const y = input.actor.y + (input.move === 'S' ? input.stepMm : input.move === 'N' ? -input.stepMm : 0);
    const distanceSquared = (x - input.target.x) ** 2 + (y - input.target.y) ** 2;
    return { x, y, distanceSquared, withinRange: Math.hypot(x - input.target.x, y - input.target.y) <= input.radiusMm };
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(input, 'radiusMm') && input.actor) {
    const distanceSquared = ['x', 'y'].reduce((sum, axis) => sum + (input.actor[axis] - input.target[axis]) ** 2, 0);
    return { distanceSquared, withinRange: distanceSquared <= input.radiusMm ** 2 };
  }
  if (input.vehicle) {
    const distance = Math.hypot(input.vehicle.x - input.station.x, input.vehicle.y - input.station.y);
    const reason = input.currentTick < input.vehicle.readyAtTick ? 'cooldown' : distance > input.radiusMm ? 'range' : input.vehicle.energy < input.cost ? 'energy' : 'repair';
    return { accepted: reason === 'repair', reason, energy: input.vehicle.energy - (reason === 'repair' ? input.cost : 0) };
  }
  let x = input.actor.x;
  let y = input.actor.y;
  if (input.move === 'N') y -= 250;
  if (input.move === 'S') y += 250;
  if (input.move === 'E') x += 250;
  if (input.move === 'W') x -= 250;
  const inRange = Math.hypot(x - input.target.x, y - input.target.y) <= 250;
  const denied = input.tick < input.actor.nextInteractTick ? 'cooldown' : !inRange ? 'range' : null;
  return { x, y, reason: denied ?? (input.actor.cargo ? 'deposit' : 'pickup'), cargo: denied ? input.actor.cargo : !input.actor.cargo, score: input.actor.score + Number(!denied && input.actor.cargo), nextInteractTick: denied ? input.actor.nextInteractTick : input.tick + 4 };
}

function expectedOrder(item) {
  const input = item.inputs;
  if (input.input) {
    const next = { ...input.state };
    const newer = input.input.seq > next.lastSeq;
    if (newer) Object.assign(next, { lastSeq: input.input.seq, lastSeen: input.tick, expiresAt: input.tick + 4, move: input.input.move, pendingInteract: next.pendingInteract || input.input.interact });
    return { status: newer ? 'admitted' : 'stale', next };
  }
  if (input.arrivals) {
    let lastSeq = input.state.lastSeq;
    const admitted = [];
    for (const arrival of input.arrivals) {
      if (arrival.seq <= lastSeq) continue;
      lastSeq = arrival.seq;
      admitted.push(arrival);
    }
    const pending = input.state.pendingInteract || admitted.some((arrival) => arrival.interact);
    return { lastSeq, pendingBeforeTick: pending, attemptedInteractions: Number(pending), cargoAfterTick: Boolean(input.actorAtTarget.cargo) !== Boolean(pending), scoreAfterTick: input.actorAtTarget.score + Number(pending && input.actorAtTarget.cargo), pendingAfterTick: false };
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(input, 'probeTick')) {
    const renews = input.arrivalBeforeProbe !== null && input.arrivalBeforeProbe.seq > input.lastSeq;
    const expiresAt = renews ? input.probeTick + 4 : input.initialExpiry;
    return { activeAtProbe: input.probeTick <= expiresAt, expiresAt, lastSeq: renews ? input.arrivalBeforeProbe.seq : input.lastSeq };
  }
  const state = { ...input.initial };
  const framesRead = [];
  for (const command of input.commands) {
    if (command.kind === 'read') framesRead.push(state.frame);
    if (command.kind === 'seek' && command.seq > state.lastSeq) Object.assign(state, { lastSeq: command.seq, frame: command.frame });
  }
  return { ...state, framesRead };
}

function combinations(values, count, start = 0, current = [], result = []) {
  if (current.length === count) { result.push([...current]); return result; }
  for (let index = start; index < values.length; index += 1) combinations(values, count, index + 1, [...current, values[index]], result);
  return result;
}

function expectedTesting(item) {
  const input = item.inputs;
  if (input.fixture && input.candidateRun) {
    const expectedChargeCount = input.fixture.initialChargeCount + new Set(input.fixture.requestIds).size;
    const control = input.correctRun;
    const candidate = input.candidateRun;
    const answer = (nextAction, reason) => ({ nextAction, reason, expectedChargeCount });
    if (control === null) return answer('run-correct-control', 'control-absent');
    if (control.ledger.chargeCount !== expectedChargeCount) return answer('repair-control', 'control-disagrees');
    if (!isDeepStrictEqual(control.requestIds, candidate.requestIds)) return answer('match-request-schedule', 'different-inputs');
    if (candidate.captureStatus !== 'complete' || candidate.ledger === null) return answer('finish-candidate-observation', 'no-completed-observation');
    if (candidate.processedRequestCount < candidate.requestIds.length) return answer('wait-for-worker', 'observation-too-early');
    if (candidate.ledger.source !== 'owner') return answer('read-owner-ledger', 'client-value-not-authoritative');
    assert.fail('transfer fixture must contain an evidence gap');
  }
  if (input.correct) {
    const path = input.allowedPaths.find((candidate) => !isDeepStrictEqual(input.correct[candidate], input.defect[candidate]));
    return { tick: input.correct.tick, path, expected: input.correct[path] };
  }
  if (input.assertions) {
    const ids = input.assertions.map((candidate) => candidate.id).sort();
    for (let size = 1; size <= ids.length; size += 1) {
      const candidates = combinations(ids, size);
      const result = candidates.find((chosen) => input.defects.every((defect) => chosen.some((id) => {
        const row = input.assertions.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
        return !isDeepStrictEqual(row.observed[defect], row.expected);
      })));
      if (result) return result;
    }
    assert.fail('generated matrix must be coverable');
  }
  const result = { detected: [], notDetected: [], inconclusive: [] };
  for (const run of input.runs) {
    const category = run.correct !== 'pass' ? 'inconclusive' : run.variant === 'pass' ? 'notDetected' : run.variant === 'assertion-fail' ? 'detected' : 'inconclusive';
    result[category].push(run.id);
  }
  Object.values(result).forEach((values) => values.sort());
  return result;
}

// Independent action-by-action oracle: it does not call the teaching generator's
// clock, investigation runtime, policy, expected result, or scoring function.
function simulate(record, defect = '') {
  let lastMs = record.startMs;
  let fraction = 0;
  let overruns = 0;
  let tick = 0;
  const actors = [];
  const checkpoints = [];
  for (const action of record.actions) {
    let receipt = null;
    let clock = null;
    const actor = actors.find((candidate) => candidate.connection === action.id);
    if (action.type === 'join') actors.push({ id: `actor-${actors.length + 1}`, connection: action.id, connected: true, lastSeq: 0, expiresAt: 0, x: 1000, direction: 0 });
    if (action.type === 'disconnect') {
      actor.connected = false;
      if (defect === 'clear-disconnected') actor.direction = 0;
    }
    if (action.type === 'resume') actor.connected = true;
    if (action.type === 'input') {
      const status = !actor.connected ? 'offline' : action.seq <= actor.lastSeq ? 'stale' : 'admitted';
      receipt = { status, tick, seq: action.seq };
      if (status === 'admitted') {
        actor.lastSeq = action.seq;
        actor.expiresAt = (defect === 'client-time' ? Math.floor((action.sentAtMs ?? lastMs) / 50) : tick) + 4;
        actor.direction = action.move === 'E' ? 1 : action.move === 'W' ? -1 : 0;
      }
    }
    if (action.type === 'sample') {
      const total = action.nowMs - lastMs + fraction;
      const whole = Math.floor(total / 50);
      const ticks = Math.min(5, whole);
      const dropped = whole - ticks;
      fraction = defect === 'discard-fraction' ? 0 : total % 50;
      lastMs = action.nowMs;
      overruns += Number(dropped > 0);
      for (let count = 0; count < ticks; count += 1) {
        tick += 1;
        actors.forEach((candidate) => {
          if (tick <= candidate.expiresAt + Number(defect === 'late-expiry')) candidate.x += 250 * candidate.direction;
        });
      }
      clock = { ticks, dropped, overruns, remainder: fraction };
    }
    checkpoints.push({ label: action.label, tick, actors: actors.map(({ direction, ...state }) => ({ ...state })), receipt, clock });
  }
  return checkpoints;
}

function expectedTiming(item, defect = '') {
  const input = item.inputs;
  if (input.readings) {
    const checkpoints = simulate({ startMs: input.startMs, actions: input.readings.map((nowMs, index) => ({ type: 'sample', label: String(index), nowMs })) }, defect);
    return checkpoints.map(({ tick, clock }) => ({ tick, ...clock }));
  }
  const checkpoints = simulate(input.record, defect);
  if (input.initialActor) {
    const atReceipt = checkpoints.find((checkpoint) => checkpoint.label === 'receipt');
    const final = checkpoints.at(-1);
    return { receiptTick: atReceipt.tick, expiresAt: atReceipt.actors[0].expiresAt, xAtReceipt: atReceipt.actors[0].x, processedTick: final.tick, xAfterSample: final.actors[0].x, clock: final.clock };
  }
  const final = checkpoints.at(-1);
  const result = { tick: final.tick, actors: final.actors, resumedReceipt: checkpoints.find((checkpoint) => checkpoint.label === 'resumed-receipt').receipt };
  if (input.reservation) result.reservationStatus = !input.reservation.sameClockOrigin ? 'unknown' : input.reservation.nowMs >= input.reservation.deadlineMs ? 'expired' : 'valid';
  return result;
}

const oracles = { spatial: expectedSpatial, order: expectedOrder, testing: expectedTesting, timing: expectedTiming };
```
