```mjs
test('ordering cases expose stale interaction, false cancellation and exclusive expiry mistakes', () => {
  let staleTrue = 0;
  let falseWouldCancel = 0;
  let inclusiveBoundary = 0;
  const statuses = new Set();
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const admission = order.makeItem({ mode: 'practice', key: 'admission', seed });
    statuses.add(admission.expected.status);
    if (admission.expected.status === 'stale' && admission.inputs.input.interact && !admission.inputs.state.pendingInteract) staleTrue += 1;
    const batch = order.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'coalescing', seed });
    if (batch.expected.pendingBeforeTick && batch.inputs.arrivals.at(-1).interact === false) falseWouldCancel += 1;
    const expiry = order.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'expiry', seed });
    if (expiry.inputs.probeTick === expiry.expected.expiresAt) {
      assert.equal(expiry.expected.activeAtProbe, true);
      inclusiveBoundary += 1;
    }
  }
  assert.deepEqual([...statuses].sort(), ['admitted', 'stale']);
  assert.ok(staleTrue > 5 && falseWouldCancel > 10 && inclusiveBoundary > 10);
});

test('testing matrix values are plausible owner-engine observations from the described fixtures', () => {
  for (const seed of seeds) {

    for (const fixture of item.inputs.fixtures) {
      const world = createWorld(17);
      const actor = join(world);
      const atTick = fixture.fixture === 'fourth-step' ? fixture.atTick - 4 : fixture.fixture === 'duplicate' ? fixture.atTick - 2 : fixture.atTick - 1;
      advance(world, atTick);
      if (fixture.fixture === 'duplicate') {
        admit(world, actor.id, { v: 1, seq: 10, move: 'E', interact: false });
        advance(world, 2);
        admit(world, actor.id, { v: 1, seq: 10, move: 'E', interact: false });
      }
      if (fixture.fixture === 'fourth-step') {
        actor.x = fixture.expected - 1000;
        admit(world, actor.id, { v: 1, seq: 10, move: 'E', interact: false });
        advance(world, 4);
      }
      if (fixture.fixture === 'stale-bit') {
        actor.x = world.core.x;
        admit(world, actor.id, { v: 1, seq: 10, move: 'idle', interact: false });
        admit(world, actor.id, { v: 1, seq: 9, move: 'idle', interact: true });
        advance(world, 1);
      }
      const field = fixture.path.slice('actor.'.length);
      assert.equal(snapshot(world, actor.id).actor[field], fixture.expected);
    }
  }

test('timing cases distinguish client clocks, lost fractions, late expiry and disconnect resets', () => {
  const differences = { 'client-time': 0, 'discard-fraction': 0, 'late-expiry': 0, 'clear-disconnected': 0 };
  const reservationStates = new Set();
  const receiptStates = new Set();
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const clock = timing.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'clock', seed });
    differences['discard-fraction'] += Number(!isDeepStrictEqual(clock.expected, expectedTiming(clock, 'discard-fraction')));
    const receipt = timing.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'receipt', seed });
    for (const defect of ['client-time', 'late-expiry']) differences[defect] += Number(!isDeepStrictEqual(receipt.expected, expectedTiming(receipt, defect)));
    const recovery = timing.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'transfer', seed });
    differences['clear-disconnected'] += Number(!isDeepStrictEqual(recovery.expected, expectedTiming(recovery, 'clear-disconnected')));
    reservationStates.add(recovery.expected.reservationStatus);
    receiptStates.add(recovery.expected.resumedReceipt.status);
    assert.equal(recovery.expected.actors[1].x, 1000);
    assert.equal(recovery.expected.actors[1].lastSeq, 0);
  }
  assert.ok(Object.values(differences).every((count) => count > 10), JSON.stringify(differences));
  assert.deepEqual([...reservationStates].sort(), ['expired', 'unknown', 'valid']);
  assert.deepEqual([...receiptStates].sort(), ['admitted', 'stale']);
});

// The runtime is owned by a parallel writer. This check activates when its file

  if (error.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND' || error.url !== new URL('../learning/grade.mjs', import.meta.url).href) throw error;

function plausibleWrong(item, right) {
  const wrong = structuredClone(right);
  if (item.inputs.assertions) return item.inputs.assertions.map((row) => row.id);
  if (item.inputs.readings) { wrong[0].remainder = 0; return wrong; }
  if (item.inputs.correct) return { tick: right.tick, path: 'http.status', expected: 200 };
  if (item.inputs.fixture && item.inputs.candidateRun) return { ...right, nextAction: 'increase-retries', reason: 'insufficient-load' };
  if (item.inputs.runs) return { detected: item.inputs.runs.map((run) => run.id).sort(), notDetected: [], inconclusive: [] };
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'withinRange')) { wrong.withinRange = !right.withinRange; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'pendingBeforeTick')) { wrong.pendingBeforeTick = !right.pendingBeforeTick; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'activeAtProbe')) { wrong.activeAtProbe = !right.activeAtProbe; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'framesRead')) { wrong.lastSeq -= 1; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'resumedReceipt')) { wrong.actors[0].lastSeq = 0; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'receiptTick')) { wrong.expiresAt -= 1; return wrong; }
  if (Object.hasOwn(right, 'accepted')) { wrong.accepted = !right.accepted; return wrong; }
  wrong.cargo = !right.cargo;
  return wrong;
}
test('integrated grader accepts independent answers and rejects plausible wrong responses', { skip: !grade && 'shared grader not yet integrated in this isolated unit branch' }, () => {
  for (const module of units) {
    for (const key of module.unit.masterySlots) {
      for (const seed of seeds.slice(0, 24)) {
        const item = module.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key, seed });
        const right = oracles[module.unit.id](item);
        assert.deepEqual(grade(item, JSON.stringify(right)).correct, true);
        const wrong = plausibleWrong(item, right);
        assert.notDeepEqual(wrong, right, 'the wrong model must actually disagree on this case');
        assert.equal(grade(item, JSON.stringify(wrong)).correct, false);
        assert.equal(grade(item, JSON.stringify({ ...right, extraUnrequiredField: true })).correct, false);
        assert.equal(grade(item, '{unfinished').status, 'format-error');
      }
    }
  }
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/learning-late.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as integrity from '../learning/units/integrity.mjs';
import * as telemetry from '../learning/units/telemetry.mjs';
import * as evaluation from '../learning/units/evaluation.mjs';
import * as retention from '../learning/units/retention.mjs';
import * as recovery from '../learning/units/recovery.mjs';
import * as capstone from '../learning/units/capstone.mjs';

const modules = [integrity, telemetry, evaluation, retention, recovery, capstone];
const project = new URL('../', import.meta.url);
const seeds = Array.from({ length: 128 }, (_, i) => `independent-${i * 7919 + 17}`);

// These oracles intentionally do not import the generators' helpers or their policy code.
function packageDecision({ manifest, observed, supported }) {
  if (!supported.some((r) => r === manifest.release)) return { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported-release' };
  const paths = observed.map((f) => f.path);
  if (paths.length !== manifest.files.length || manifest.files.some((f) => !paths.includes(f.path))) return { ok: false, reason: 'inventory' };
  for (const approved of manifest.files) {
    const actual = observed.find((f) => f.path === approved.path);
    if (actual.sha256.toLowerCase() !== approved.sha256.toLowerCase()) return { ok: false, reason: 'digest' };
  }
  return { ok: true, reason: 'verified' };
}
function replayReason({ record: r, engineRelease }) {
  if (r.schema !== 1) return 'schema';
  if (r.runtimeRelease !== engineRelease) return 'incompatible';
  if (!r.complete || !Array.isArray(r.events) || r.events.length > 256) return 'incomplete';
  if (r.endIndex - r.startIndex !== r.events.length) return 'sequence';
  for (let i = 0; i < r.events.length; i += 1) if (r.events[i].index - r.startIndex !== i + 1) return 'sequence';
  let total = r.checkpoint.score;
  for (const e of r.events) total += e.event.add;
  return total === r.final.score ? 'reproduced' : 'final';
}
function flag(signals, s, inclusive = false) {
  // Count at every integer tick rather than using the implementation's eligible-endpoint scan.
  const last = Math.max(0, ...signals.map((x) => x.tick));
  for (let end = 0; end <= last; end += 1) {
    let count = 0;
    for (const x of signals) {
      if (x.reason !== 'range' || x.distanceSquared <= s.minDistanceMm * s.minDistanceMm) continue;
      if (x.tick <= end && (inclusive ? x.tick >= end - s.windowTicks : x.tick > end - s.windowTicks)) count += 1;
    }
    if (count >= s.threshold) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function metrics(cases, settings) {
  const cells = [0, 0, 0, 0]; // tp, fp, tn, fn
  for (const c of cases) cells[flag(c.signals, settings) ? (c.label ? 0 : 1) : (c.label ? 3 : 2)] += 1;
  const [tp, fp, tn, fn] = cells;
  return { total: cases.length, tp, fp, tn, fn, precision: tp + fp ? tp / (tp + fp) : null, recall: tp + fn ? tp / (tp + fn) : null, falsePositiveRate: fp + tn ? fp / (fp + tn) : null };
}
function kept(events, s) {
  const eligible = [];
  for (const event of events) if (event.tick <= s.nowTick && s.nowTick - event.tick < s.maxAgeTicks) eligible.push(event);
  const output = [];
  for (let i = Math.max(0, eligible.length - s.maxEvents); i < eligible.length; i += 1) {
    const e = eligible[i];
    output.push({ tick: e.tick, actorId: e.actorId, reason: e.reason, distanceSquared: e.distanceSquared });
  }
  return output;
}
function selected(e) {
  const r = e.releases.find((x) => e.targetReleaseId === x.id);
  if (!r) return { ok: false, reason: 'unknown-target' };
  const c = e.configurations.find((x) => r.configId === x.id);
  if (!c || [c.hash !== r.configHash, c.releaseId !== r.id, c.stateSchema !== r.stateSchema].some(Boolean)) return { ok: false, reason: 'configuration-mismatch' };
  let best;
  for (const s of e.snapshots) {
    if (s.configId !== c.id || s.configHash !== c.hash || s.stateSchema !== r.stateSchema) continue;
    if (!best || s.ordinal > best.ordinal || (s.ordinal === best.ordinal && s.id < best.id)) best = s;
  }
  if (!best) return { ok: false, reason: 'no-compatible-snapshot' };
  return { ok: true, releaseId: r.id, packageHash: r.packageHash, configId: c.id, configHash: c.hash, snapshotId: best.id, snapshotHash: best.hash };
}
function repairProjection({ state, actorId, request }) {
  const a = state.actors.find((x) => x.id === actorId);
  const c = state.config;
  const existing = a.receipts.find((r) => r.requestId === request.requestId);
  let reason = existing ? (existing.stationId === request.stationId ? 'duplicate' : 'conflict') : null;
  const s = state.stations.find((x) => x.id === request.stationId);
  const refusals = [
    [!s, 'station'], [a.receipts.length >= c.receiptLimit, 'history-full'],
    [s && Math.hypot(a.x - s.x, a.y - s.y) > c.rangeMm, 'range'],
    [a.energy >= c.energyCap, 'full'], [a.credits < c.repairCost, 'funds'],
  ];
  if (!reason) reason = refusals.find(([fails]) => fails)?.[1] ?? 'repaired';
  if (reason !== 'repaired') return { reason, receipt: reason === 'duplicate' ? existing : null, energy: a.energy, credits: a.credits, receiptCount: a.receipts.length };
  const energy = Math.min(c.energyCap, a.energy + c.repairEnergy);
  const credits = a.credits - c.repairCost;
  return { reason, receipt: { requestId: request.requestId, stationId: request.stationId, energyAdded: energy - a.energy, creditsSpent: c.repairCost, energy, credits }, energy, credits, receiptCount: a.receipts.length + 1 };
}
function expectedFor(id, section, x) {
  if (id === 'integrity') {
    if (section !== 'trust') return packageDecision(x);
    const assurance = x.packageCanWriteApproval ? 'untrusted-reference' : x.plugins.some((p) => p.approvedHash !== p.observedHash) ? 'unapproved-bytes' : 'matching-only';
    return { start: assurance === 'matching-only', assurance };
  }
  if (id === 'telemetry') {
    if (section === 'checkpoint') return x.checkpoint.score + x.additions.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const reason = replayReason(x);
    return section === 'sequence' ? { ok: reason === 'reproduced', reason } : { reason, claim: reason === 'reproduced' ? 'consistent-only' : 'not-reproduced' };
  }
  if (id === 'evaluation') {
    if (section === 'window') return { flagged: flag(x.signals, x.settings) };
    if (section === 'metrics') return metrics(x.cases, x.settings);
    return { report: x.changedSettingsUsingThatFeedback ? 'revision' : 'first-committed-evaluation', twinFlagged: flag(x.twinSignals, x.settings), twinFlagsMustMatch: true, automationIdentifiable: false };
  }
  if (id === 'retention') {
    const retained = kept(x.events, x.settings);
    if (section === 'window') return { actorIds: retained.map((e) => e.actorId) };
    if (section === 'projection') return retained;
    const needed = x.events.filter((e) => e.tick <= x.settings.nowTick && x.settings.nowTick - e.tick < x.detectorWindowTicks);
    const missingCount = needed.filter((e) => !retained.some((r) => r.actorId === e.actorId)).length;
    return { canReconstructWindow: missingCount === 0, missingCount, otherExportRemains: x.separateExport !== x.deletedExport };
  }
  if (id === 'recovery') {
    if (section !== 'loss') {
      const answer = selected(x);
      return section === 'tuple' && answer.ok ? { ok: true, reason: 'compatible' } : answer;
    }
    const seq = [];
    for (let i = x.restoredLastSeq + 1; i <= x.highestBeforeRestore; i += 1) seq.push(i);
    return { reopenedStart: seq[0] ?? null, reopenedEnd: seq.at(-1) ?? null, reopenedCount: seq.length, lostScore: x.scoreBeforeRestore - x.restoredScore, sameActionWorks: x.actionAppliedAfterRestore, allAcknowledgedPreserved: seq.length === 0 };
  }
  if (x.experiment === 'matching-replies-hidden-state') {
    const duplicate = x.priorReceipts.filter((r) => r.actorId === x.actorId).some((r) => r.requestId === x.request.requestId);
    return {
      probe: 'actor-state', when: x.snapshotBefore === null ? 'before-and-after' : 'after',
      operation: duplicate ? 'duplicate' : 'new', creditsDelta: duplicate ? 0 : -x.config.repairCost,
      energyInvariant: duplicate ? 'unchanged' : 'add-up-to-cap', receiptCountDelta: duplicate ? 0 : 1,
      receiptIdentity: duplicate ? 'preserve-existing' : 'record-request', replyAloneSuffices: false,
    };
  }
  if (section !== 'observe') return repairProjection(x);
  const added = Math.min(x.config.repairEnergy, x.config.energyCap - x.before.energy);
  const energy = x.before.energy + added;
  const credits = x.before.credits - x.config.repairCost;
  const receiptMatches = x.observed.receipt.energyAdded === added && x.observed.receipt.creditsSpent === x.config.repairCost && x.observed.receipt.energy === energy && x.observed.receipt.credits === credits;
  return { energyMatches: x.observed.energy === energy, creditsMatch: x.observed.credits === credits, receiptMatches };
}

function assertCompletionWork(id, section, x) {
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(x.completedSteps) && x.completedSteps.length > 0);
  const shown = x.completedSteps.join('\n');
  const includes = (fragment) => assert.ok(shown.includes(String(fragment)), `missing correct partial result: ${fragment}`);
  switch (`${id}:${section}`) {
    case 'integrity:reference':
      includes(JSON.stringify([...x.manifest.files].map((f) => f.path).sort()));
      includes(`contains ${x.manifest.files.length} paths`);
      break;
    case 'integrity:compare':
      includes(JSON.stringify(x.observed.map((f) => ({ path: f.path, sha256: f.sha256.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US') }))));
      break;
    case 'integrity:trust':
      includes(`coreMatches=${x.coreMatches}`);
      includes(`giving ${x.plugins[0].approvedHash === x.plugins[0].observedHash}`);
      assert.ok(x.plugins.length > 1, 'at least one extension remains to be checked');
      break;
    case 'telemetry:checkpoint':
      assert.ok(x.additions.length > 1, 'a later operation remains after the supplied calculation');
      includes(`register is ${x.checkpoint.score + x.additions[0]}`);
      includes(`remaining ${x.additions.length - 1} operations`);
      break;
    case 'telemetry:sequence':
      includes(`${x.record.startIndex} + ${x.record.events.length} = ${x.record.endIndex}`);
      includes(`should be ${x.record.startIndex + 1}`);
      break;
    case 'telemetry:claim': {
      let subtotal = 0;
      for (const entry of x.record.events) subtotal += entry.event.add;
      includes(`sum to ${subtotal}`);
      includes('excludes the saved checkpoint');
      break;
    }
    case 'evaluation:window':
    case 'evaluation:claim': {
      const signals = section === 'window' ? x.signals : x.twinSignals;
      const minSquared = x.settings.minDistanceMm * x.settings.minDistanceMm;
      const ticks = [];
      for (const s of signals) if (s.reason === 'range' && s.distanceSquared > minSquared) ticks.push(s.tick);
      includes(`${minSquared} mm²`);
      includes(JSON.stringify(ticks));
      break;
    }
    case 'evaluation:metrics': {
      assert.ok(x.cases.length >= 2, 'later cases remain for the learner');
      const first = x.cases[0];
      const flagged = flag(first.signals, x.settings);
      const cell = flagged ? first.label ? 'tp' : 'fp' : first.label ? 'fn' : 'tn';
      includes(`flagged=${flagged}`);
      includes(`contributes one ${cell}`);
      includes(`other ${x.cases.length - 1} cases`);
      break;
    }
    case 'retention:window': {
      const eligible = x.events.filter((e) => x.settings.nowTick - e.tick < x.settings.maxAgeTicks && e.tick <= x.settings.nowTick);
      includes(JSON.stringify(eligible.map((e) => e.actorId)));
      includes('Apply the count bound next');
      break;
    }
    case 'retention:projection': {
      const selectedIds = kept(x.events, x.settings).map((e) => e.actorId);
      const positions = x.events.flatMap((e, i) => selectedIds.includes(e.actorId) ? [i] : []);
      includes(JSON.stringify(positions));
      includes('Build new four-field records');
      break;
    }
    case 'retention:evidence':
      includes(`export age edge is ${x.settings.nowTick - x.settings.maxAgeTicks}`);
      includes(`detector's old edge is ${x.settings.nowTick - x.detectorWindowTicks}`);
      break;
    case 'recovery:tuple': {
      const r = x.releases.find((v) => v.id === x.targetReleaseId);
      includes(r ? JSON.stringify({ id: r.id, stateSchema: r.stateSchema, configId: r.configId, configHash: r.configHash }) : 'no matching release');
      break;
    }
    case 'recovery:selection': {
      const r = x.releases.find((v) => v.id === x.targetReleaseId);
      const c = r && x.configurations.find((v) => v.id === r.configId);
      const partial = r && c ? x.snapshots.filter((s) => s.stateSchema === r.stateSchema && s.configId === c.id && s.configHash === c.hash) : [];
      includes(JSON.stringify(partial.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, ordinal: s.ordinal }))));
      includes('does not validate the configuration');
      break;
    }
    case 'recovery:loss':
      includes(`${x.scoreBeforeRestore} − ${x.restoredScore} = ${x.scoreBeforeRestore - x.restoredScore}`);
      includes('Complete the reopened sequence interval');
      break;
    case 'capstone:identity': {
      const actor = x.state.actors.find((a) => a.id === x.actorId);
      let position = -1;
      actor.receipts.forEach((r, i) => { if (r.requestId === x.request.requestId) position = i; });
      includes(`index ${position}`);
      includes("Another actor's receipt list was excluded");
      break;
    }
    case 'capstone:transaction': {
      const actor = x.state.actors.find((a) => a.id === x.actorId);
      includes(`${x.state.config.energyCap} − ${actor.energy} = ${x.state.config.energyCap - actor.energy}`);
      includes('complete all ordered admission checks');
      break;
    }
    case 'capstone:observe': {
      const gap = x.config.energyCap - x.before.energy;
      const addition = gap < x.config.repairEnergy ? gap : x.config.repairEnergy;
      includes(`${x.config.energyCap} − ${x.before.energy} = ${gap}`);
      includes(`min(${x.config.repairEnergy}, gap) = ${addition}`);
      break;
    }
    default: assert.fail('completion family has no independent scaffold check');
  }
}

for (const module of modules) {
  const { unit, makeItem } = module;
  test(`${unit.id}: sections, references, objectives and milestones are present`, () => {
    assert.ok(unit.sections.length >= 2 && unit.sections.length <= 4);
    assert.equal(unit.masterySlots.length, 3);
    assert.equal(unit.support.hints.length, 3);
    assert.ok(unit.support.milestones.length >= 3);
    for (const section of unit.sections) {
      assert.ok(section.paragraphs.length >= 2);
      assert.ok(section.worked.steps.length >= 3);
      assert.ok(section.worked.answer);
      assert.ok(section.completion.missing);
      assert.ok(unit.objectives.some((o) => section.objectiveIds.includes(o.id)));
      assert.ok(existsSync(fileURLToPath(new URL(section.source.path, project))));
    }
  });
  for (const mode of ['practice', 'completion', 'mastery']) {
    const keys = mode === 'mastery' ? unit.masterySlots : unit.sections.map((s) => s.id);
    keys.forEach((key, index) => {
      test(`${unit.id} ${mode}/${key}: 128 independently recomputed instances`, () => {
        const distinct = new Set();
        const section = unit.sections[index].id;
        for (const seed of seeds) {
          const item = makeItem({ mode, key, seed });
          assert.deepEqual(item, makeItem({ mode, key, seed }), 'same seed is reproducible');
          assert.deepEqual(item.expected, expectedFor(unit.id, section, item.inputs));
          if (mode === 'completion') assertCompletionWork(unit.id, section, item.inputs);
          if (mode !== 'completion') assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(item.inputs, 'completedSteps'), false);
          assert.equal(item.hints.length, mode === 'mastery' ? 0 : 3);
          assert.ok(item.explanation.length > 80);
          const objectiveIds = unit.id === 'capstone' && mode === 'mastery' && key === 'transfer'
            ? ['capstone.identity', 'capstone.transaction', 'capstone.observe'] : unit.sections[index].objectiveIds;
          assert.deepEqual(item.objectiveIds, objectiveIds);
          assert.ok(item.source.anchor && existsSync(fileURLToPath(new URL(item.source.path, project))));
          distinct.add(JSON.stringify(item.inputs));
        }
        assert.ok(distinct.size >= 60, `fresh inputs: ${distinct.size}/128`);
      });
    });
  }
  test(`${unit.id}: invalid routes fail explicitly`, () => {
    assert.throws(() => makeItem({ mode: 'solution', key: unit.sections[0].id, seed: 1 }), /mode/);
    assert.throws(() => makeItem({ mode: 'practice', key: 'absent', seed: 1 }), /key/);
  });
}

test('generated cases expose plausible wrong answers, including boundary and trust errors', () => {
  const caught = new Set();
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const i = integrity.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'refusal', seed });
    if (i.expected.reason === 'unsupported-release') caught.add('release-before-digest');
    const trust = integrity.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'transfer', seed });
    if (!trust.expected.start && trust.inputs.coreMatches) caught.add('core-match-approves-all');
    const t = telemetry.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'boundary', seed });
    if (t.expected !== t.inputs.additions.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)) caught.add('reset-checkpoint');
    const seq = telemetry.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'refusal', seed });
    if (seq.expected.reason === 'sequence') caught.add('final-equality-hides-gap');
    const e = evaluation.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'boundary', seed });
    if (e.expected.flagged !== flag(e.inputs.signals, e.inputs.settings, true)) caught.add('inclusive-old-edge');
    const m = evaluation.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'counts', seed });
    if (Object.values(m.expected).includes(null)) caught.add('undefined-rate-is-zero');
    if (m.inputs.cases.reduce((n, c) => n + c.signals.length, 0) !== m.expected.total) caught.add('signal-count-is-case-count');
    const r = retention.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'boundary', seed });
    const wrongTail = r.inputs.events.slice(-r.inputs.settings.maxEvents).filter((x) => x.tick <= r.inputs.settings.nowTick && x.tick > r.inputs.settings.nowTick - r.inputs.settings.maxAgeTicks).map((x) => x.actorId);
    if (JSON.stringify(wrongTail) !== JSON.stringify(r.expected.actorIds)) caught.add('count-before-age');
    const recover = recovery.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'newest', seed });
    if (recover.expected.ok && recover.expected.snapshotId !== 'future') caught.add('newest-incompatible');
    if (recover.expected.snapshotId === 'Z-ready') caught.add('wrong-string-tie');
    const repair = capstone.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'identity', seed });
    if (repair.expected.reason === 'duplicate') {
      caught.add('range-before-duplicate');
      assert.equal(repair.expected.credits, repair.inputs.state.actors[0].credits);
      assert.notEqual(repair.expected.credits, repair.inputs.state.actors[0].credits - repair.inputs.state.config.repairCost);
      caught.add('charge-duplicate');
    }
    const atomic = capstone.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'atomic', seed });
    if (atomic.expected.reason === 'range') {
      assert.equal(atomic.expected.credits, atomic.inputs.state.actors[0].credits);
      caught.add('debit-before-refusal');
    }
    if (atomic.expected.reason === 'repaired' && atomic.inputs.state.actors[0].x === atomic.inputs.state.config.rangeMm) caught.add('exclude-range-edge');
    const observe = capstone.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'transfer', seed });
    if (Object.values(observe.expected).includes(false)) caught.add('reason-only-test');
  }
  assert.deepEqual([...caught].sort(), ['release-before-digest', 'core-match-approves-all', 'reset-checkpoint', 'final-equality-hides-gap', 'inclusive-old-edge', 'undefined-rate-is-zero', 'signal-count-is-case-count', 'count-before-age', 'newest-incompatible', 'wrong-string-tie', 'range-before-duplicate', 'charge-duplicate', 'debit-before-refusal', 'exclude-range-edge', 'reason-only-test'].sort());
});

test('capstone transfer chooses a sufficient observation experiment when replies are identical', () => {
  const branches = new Set();
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const item = capstone.makeItem({ mode: 'mastery', key: 'transfer', seed });
    const x = item.inputs;
    const currentReceipts = x.priorReceipts.filter((r) => r.actorId === x.actorId).map(({ actorId, ...receipt }) => receipt);
    const repeated = currentReceipts.some((r) => r.requestId === x.request.requestId);
    const before = x.snapshotBefore ?? { energy: x.config.energyCap - 1, credits: x.config.repairCost + 9, receipts: currentReceipts };
    const correct = structuredClone(before);
    if (!repeated) {
      const addition = Math.min(x.config.repairEnergy, x.config.energyCap - before.energy);
      correct.energy += addition;
      correct.credits -= x.config.repairCost;
      correct.receipts.push({ ...x.request, energyAdded: addition, creditsSpent: x.config.repairCost, energy: correct.energy, credits: correct.credits });
    }
    const matchesInvariant = (after) => {
      const energy = item.expected.energyInvariant === 'unchanged' ? before.energy : Math.min(x.config.energyCap, before.energy + x.config.repairEnergy);
      const previousKept = before.receipts.every((r, i) => JSON.stringify(r) === JSON.stringify(after.receipts[i]));
      const newReceipt = after.receipts.at(-1);
      const receiptIdentity = item.expected.receiptIdentity === 'preserve-existing'
        ? previousKept
        : previousKept && newReceipt?.requestId === x.request.requestId && newReceipt.stationId === x.request.stationId && newReceipt.energyAdded === energy - before.energy && newReceipt.creditsSpent === x.config.repairCost;
      return after.energy === energy && after.credits - before.credits === item.expected.creditsDelta && after.receipts.length - before.receipts.length === item.expected.receiptCountDelta && receiptIdentity;
    };
    assert.equal(matchesInvariant(correct), true, 'the independently simulated correct transaction satisfies the chosen experiment');
    const incorrect = repeated ? { ...structuredClone(before), credits: before.credits - x.config.repairCost } : structuredClone(before);
    assert.equal(matchesInvariant(incorrect), false, 'a hidden duplicate debit or missing new transaction is exposed even with the same POST reply');
    assert.equal(item.expected.probe, 'actor-state');
    assert.equal(item.expected.when, x.snapshotBefore ? 'after' : 'before-and-after');
    assert.equal(item.expected.replyAloneSuffices, false);
    assert.ok(x.availableProbes.some((p) => p.id === item.expected.probe));
    const scope = !repeated && x.priorReceipts.some((r) => r.requestId === x.request.requestId) ? 'other-actor-id' : repeated ? 'duplicate' : 'fresh-id';
    branches.add(`${scope}:${item.expected.when}`);
    assert.notDeepEqual(item.expected, { ...item.expected, probe: 'repair-reply', replyAloneSuffices: true });
    assert.notDeepEqual(item.expected, { ...item.expected, when: x.snapshotBefore ? 'before-and-after' : 'after' });
  }
  assert.deepEqual([...branches].sort(), ['duplicate:after', 'duplicate:before-and-after', 'fresh-id:after', 'fresh-id:before-and-after', 'other-actor-id:after', 'other-actor-id:before-and-after'].sort());
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/mutants.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import {
  InvariantViolation, assertRemotePickupInvariant, assertStaleOrderingInvariant,
  honestWin, probeRemotePickup, probeStaleOrdering,
} from '../clients/scenarios.mjs';
import { withServer } from './harness.mjs';

const cases = [
  { name: 'omit-proximity', code: 'REMOTE_PICKUP', probe: probeRemotePickup, check: assertRemotePickupInvariant },
  { name: 'omit-sequence', code: 'STALE_DIRECTION', probe: probeStaleOrdering, check: assertStaleOrderingInvariant },
];

export async function runNegativeControls({ entry } = {}) {
  // A broken baseline cannot validate a negative control.
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    await honestWin(server);
    for (const item of cases) item.check(await item.probe(server));
  }, { entry });
  const results = [];
  for (const item of cases) {
    const result = await withServer(async (server) => {
      // A functioning legal game is required even when a guard is removed.
      await honestWin(server);
      const observed = await item.probe(server);
      let violation;
      try { item.check(observed); } catch (error) { violation = error; }
      assert.ok(violation instanceof InvariantViolation, `${item.name} must fail its authoritative state invariant; crashes or unrelated assertions are not kills`);
      assert.equal(violation.code, item.code);
      return {
        mutant: item.name, outcome: 'killed', invariant: violation.code,
        legalDelivery: 'passed', observed: observed.after,
      };
    }, { mutant: item.name, entry });
    results.push(result);
  }
  return { baseline: 'passed', controls: results };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  try {
    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(await runNegativeControls(), null, 2)}\n`);
  } catch (error) {
    process.stderr.write(`Negative controls failed: ${error.stack}\n`);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cp, mkdtemp, mkdir, readdir, readFile, writeFile, rm, symlink } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { captureBundle, sha256, verifyReference } from '../lab/trust.mjs';
import { assessResults, executeVariant } from '../lab/order/grade.mjs';
import { assertionEvidence } from '../author/order/worker.mjs';
import { CORRECT_VARIANTS, WRONG_VARIANTS } from '../author/order/variants.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const execute = promisify(execFile);
async function cli(cwd, script, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [script, ...args], { cwd, env, timeout: 90000, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024 }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}
async function reference(t) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-order-lab-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  for (const entry of await readdir(project)) {
    if (['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(entry)) continue;
    await cp(join(project, entry), join(root, entry), { recursive: true });
  }
  const sealed = await cli(root, 'lab/order/seal.mjs');
  assert.equal(sealed.code, 0, sealed.stderr);
  return { root, ...await verifyReference(root) };
}
async function commitPredictions(workspace) {
  const path = join(workspace, 'predictions.json');
  const document = JSON.parse(await readFile(path));
  document.predictions.forEach((item) => { item.answer = 'Captured author calibration prediction.'; });
  await writeFile(path, JSON.stringify(document, null, 2) + '\n');
}

async function adequate(bundle) {
  return {
    'admission.mjs': bundle['admission.mjs'],
    'learner-scenario.mjs': Buffer.from(bundle['author/order/adequate-scenario.mjs'].toString().replace('../../clients/http-client.mjs', './clients/http-client.mjs')),
  };
}

async function treeFiles(root, prefix = '') {
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of await readdir(join(root, prefix), { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const path = prefix + entry.name;
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...await treeFiles(root, path + '/'));
    if (entry.isFile()) files.push(path);
  }
  return files;
}

async function assertNoReferenceSources(workspace) {
  const files = await treeFiles(workspace);
  assert.deepEqual(files.filter((path) => path.includes('/author/') || path.startsWith('author/') || path.endsWith('/adequate-scenario.mjs') || path.endsWith('/reference-admission.mjs')), []);
  assert.equal(files.some((path) => path.includes('/execution/')), false, 'owner runtime copies must stay outside the learner workspace');
}

// assessment-09: accept independent correct solutions and detect causal wrongs.
test('inverse checker calibration accepts two correct policies and detects all seven wrongs for all seeds', async (t) => {
  const { root, bundle } = await reference(t);
  const captured = await adequate(bundle);
  const component = [];
  for (const seed of [17, 31, 99]) component.push(await executeVariant({ destination: join(root, 'calibration'), bundle, captured, mode: 'component', variant: 'submitted-component', seed }));
  const scenarios = [];
  for (const variant of [...CORRECT_VARIANTS, ...WRONG_VARIANTS]) {
    for (const seed of [17, 31, 99]) {
      const result = await executeVariant({ destination: join(root, 'calibration'), bundle, captured, mode: 'scenario', variant, seed });
      scenarios.push(result);
      assert.equal(result.kind, CORRECT_VARIANTS.includes(variant) ? 'pass' : 'assertion', `${variant}/${seed}: ${JSON.stringify(result.error)}`);
      assert.equal(result.healthy, true);
      assert.equal(result.trace.dropped, 0);
      assert.ok(result.hashes['admission.mjs']);
      assert.deepEqual(result.hashes, result.afterHashes);
    }
  }
  assert.ok(component.every((result) => result.kind === 'pass'), JSON.stringify(component.map((result) => result.criteria?.filter((item) => !item.passed))));
  assert.equal(assessResults(component, scenarios).passed, true);
  assert.equal(assessResults(component, scenarios.filter((item) => item.variant !== 'alternate-correct')).passed, false);
});

test('string-valued authoritative-state assertions pass both corrects and detect every wrong', async (t) => {
  const { root, bundle } = await reference(t);
  const captured = await adequate(bundle);
  const original = captured['learner-scenario.mjs'].toString();
  captured['learner-scenario.mjs'] = Buffer.from(original.replaceAll('seen.lastDecision, null', "seen.lastDecision?.reason ?? 'none', 'none'"));
  assert.notEqual(captured['learner-scenario.mjs'].toString(), original);
  const scenarios = [];
  for (const variant of [...CORRECT_VARIANTS, ...WRONG_VARIANTS]) {
    const result = await executeVariant({ destination: join(root, 'string-state'), bundle, captured, mode: 'scenario', variant, seed: 17 });
    scenarios.push(result);
    assert.equal(result.kind, CORRECT_VARIANTS.includes(variant) ? 'pass' : 'assertion', `${variant}: ${JSON.stringify(result.error)}`);
    assert.equal(result.healthy, true);
  }
  const staleInteraction = scenarios.find((result) => result.variant === 'stale-interact');
  assert.equal(staleInteraction.error.actual, 'range');
  assert.equal(staleInteraction.error.expected, 'none');
  assert.equal(assessResults([{ seed: 17, kind: 'pass' }], scenarios, [17]).scenarioPassed, true);
});

test('empty, always-failing and error-string-only scenarios cannot pass the inverse judge', async (t) => {
  const { root, bundle } = await reference(t);
  const sources = {
    empty: 'export async function scenario() {}',
    always: "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; export async function scenario() { assert.equal(1, 2); }",
    strings: "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { join, input } from './clients/http-client.mjs'; export async function scenario({base}) { const a = await join(base); await input(base,a.token,10); const r = await input(base,a.token,10); assert.equal(r.data.status, 'stale'); }",
  };
  for (const [name, source] of Object.entries(sources)) {
    const captured = { ...await adequate(bundle), 'learner-scenario.mjs': Buffer.from(source) };
    const scenarios = [];
    for (const variant of [...CORRECT_VARIANTS, ...WRONG_VARIANTS]) scenarios.push(await executeVariant({ destination: join(root, name), bundle, captured, mode: 'scenario', variant, seed: 17 }));
    assert.equal(assessResults([{ seed: 17, kind: 'pass' }], scenarios, [17]).scenarioPassed, false, name);
    if (name === 'empty') assert.ok(scenarios.every((item) => item.kind === 'pass'));
    if (name === 'always') assert.ok(scenarios.every((item) => item.kind === 'assertion'));
    if (name === 'strings') assert.equal(scenarios.find((item) => item.variant === 'equal-seq-admitted').kind, 'assertion');
  }
});

test('imports, crashes, timeouts and assertion lookalikes never count as detected variants', async (t) => {
  const { root, bundle } = await reference(t);
  const sources = {
    import: "import './missing.mjs'; export async function scenario() {}",
    crash: 'export async function scenario() { process.exit(1); }',
    timeout: 'export async function scenario() { await new Promise(() => {}); }',
    fake: "export async function scenario() { throw Object.assign(new Error('wrong'), {name:'AssertionError',code:'ERR_ASSERTION',actual:1,expected:2}); }",
  };
  for (const [name, source] of Object.entries(sources)) {
    const captured = { ...await adequate(bundle), 'learner-scenario.mjs': Buffer.from(source) };
    const result = await executeVariant({ destination: join(root, name), bundle, captured, mode: 'scenario', variant: 'equal-seq-admitted', seed: 17, timeout: 1500 });
    assert.equal(result.kind, 'runner-failure', name);
  }
  let normal;
  try { assert.equal(1, 2); } catch (error) { normal = error; }
  assert.equal(assertionEvidence(normal), true);
  let textOnly;
  try { assert.equal('admitted', 'stale'); } catch (error) { textOnly = error; }
  assert.equal(assertionEvidence(textOnly), true);
  assert.equal(assertionEvidence(Object.assign(new Error('fake'), { name: 'AssertionError', code: 'ERR_ASSERTION', actual: 'range', expected: 'none' })), false);
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/prediction-notebook.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { generateCorpus } from '../evaluation/corpus.mjs';
import { createPredictionStore } from '../public/prediction-notebook.js';

function memory() {
  const entries = new Map();
  return { get length() { return entries.size; }, key: index => [...entries.keys()][index], getItem: key => entries.get(key) ?? null, setItem: (key, value) => entries.set(key, value) };
}
const subject = { id: 'timing/pause', version: 1, question: 'Predict the tick at 826.5 ms.', inputs: { times: [826.5, 850] } };

test('first answers and exact prompt snapshots survive revision, exposure, new instances and question versions', () => {
  const storage = memory();
  let serial = 0;
  const open = () => createPredictionStore(storage, () => `entry-${++serial}`, () => '2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z');
  const store = open();
  store.append(subject, { kind: 'answer', answer: 'The pause processes every missed tick.' });
  store.append(subject, { kind: 'reveal', mode: 'prediction' });
  subject.inputs.times.push(900);
  open().append(subject, { kind: 'answer', answer: 'Revision: catch-up is bounded.' });
  const saved = open().forCase(subject);
  assert.equal(saved.length, 3);
  assert.equal(saved[0].answer, 'The pause processes every missed tick.');
  assert.deepEqual(saved[0].case.inputs.times, [826.5, 850]);
  assert.equal(saved[0].priorExposure, false);
  assert.equal(saved[2].priorExposure, true);
  assert.equal(saved[2].answer, 'Revision: catch-up is bounded.');
  assert.deepEqual(open().forCase({ ...subject, version: 2 }), []);
});

test('worked-example exposure never creates a prediction and survives reload before a first answer', () => {
  const storage = memory();
  const store = createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'worked');
  store.append(subject, { kind: 'reveal', mode: 'worked-example' });
  const reloaded = createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'later');
  reloaded.append(subject, { kind: 'answer', answer: 'After reading the worked result.' });
  const saved = reloaded.forCase(subject);
  assert.equal(saved.filter(event => event.kind === 'answer').length, 1);
  assert.equal(saved[1].priorExposure, true);
  assert.equal(saved[0].mode, 'worked-example');
});

test('failed or unverifiable writes report failure without replacing saved work', () => {
  const storage = memory();
  createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'first').append(subject, { kind: 'answer', answer: 'Keep this.' });
  const before = createPredictionStore(storage).read();
  storage.setItem = () => { throw new Error('Quota exceeded'); };
  assert.throws(() => createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'second').append(subject, { kind: 'reveal', mode: 'prediction' }), /Quota/);
  assert.deepEqual(createPredictionStore(storage).read(), before);
  storage.setItem = () => {};
  assert.throws(() => createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'third').append(subject, { kind: 'reveal', mode: 'prediction' }), /verified/);
  assert.deepEqual(createPredictionStore(storage).read(), before);
});

test('existing malformed entries are not silently discarded or overwritten', () => {
  const storage = memory();
  storage.setItem('courier-predictions-v1:old', '{');
  assert.throws(() => createPredictionStore(storage, () => 'new').append(subject, { kind: 'answer', answer: 'new' }));
  assert.equal(storage.length, 1);
  assert.equal(storage.getItem('courier-predictions-v1:old'), '{');
});

// The browser's input-only fixture must stay aligned with the source that produced saved results.
test('browser evaluation inputs retain the exact corpus labels and signals', async () => {
  const source = await readFile(new URL('../public/analysis.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  const snapshot = JSON.parse(source.match(/const evaluationInputs = ([\s\S]*);\s*$/)[1]);
  const expected = generateCorpus().cases.map(({ id, split, label, signals }) => ({ id, split, label, signals }));
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot, expected);
});
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cp, mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, realpath, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { prepareSpatialWorkspace } from '../lab/prepare.mjs';
import { executeSpatialTests } from '../lab/check.mjs';
import { snapshotReference } from '../lab/reference-snapshot.mjs';
import { verifyReference } from '../lab/trust.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const execute = promisify(execFile);
async function cli(cwd, file, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [file, ...args], { cwd, env, timeout: 60000, maxBuffer: 3 * 1024 * 1024 }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}

async function reference(t, change = async () => {}) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-legacy-continuity-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  for (const name of await readdir(project)) {
    if (['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(name)) continue;
    await cp(join(project, name), join(root, name), { recursive: true });
  }
  await change(root);
  const seal = await cli(root, 'lab/order/seal.mjs');
  assert.equal(seal.code, 0, seal.stderr);
  return root;
}

async function commitCalibrationPredictions(workspace) {
  const path = join(workspace, 'predictions.json');
  const predictions = JSON.parse(await readFile(path));
  predictions.predictions.forEach((item) => {
    item.skipReason = 'Author calibration checks source custody rather than written reasoning.';
  });

test('assertion values cannot classify a separate infrastructure failure as behavior', async (t) => {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-spatial-typed-events-'));

    import test from 'node:test';
    import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
    test('behavior mismatch', () => assert.deepEqual({code:'ERR_ASSERTION'}, {}));
    test('infrastructure failed', () => { throw Object.assign(new Error('ECONNREFUSED: server did not start'), {code:'ECONNREFUSED'}); });
  `);
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cp, mkdtemp, readdir, readFile, writeFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { withServer } from './harness.mjs';
import { join as joinGame, state, request } from '../clients/http-client.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const execute = promisify(execFile);
async function cli(cwd, file, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  for (const key of ['NODE_TEST_CONTEXT', 'NODE_OPTIONS', 'NODE_PATH']) delete env[key];
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [file, ...args], { cwd, env, timeout: 30000, maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024 }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}
async function reference(t) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-preparation-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  for (const entry of await readdir(project)) {
    if (['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(entry)) continue;
    await cp(join(project, entry), join(root, entry), { recursive: true });
  }
  const sealed = await cli(root, 'lab/order/seal.mjs');
  assert.equal(sealed.code, 0, sealed.stderr);
  return root;
}
async function files(root, prefix = '') {
  const result = [];
  for (const entry of await readdir(join(root, prefix), { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const path = prefix + entry.name;
    if (entry.isDirectory()) result.push(...await files(root, path + '/'));
    if (entry.isFile()) result.push(path);
  }
  return result.sort();
}
async function commitCalibrationPredictions(workspace) {
  const path = join(workspace, 'predictions.json');
  const predictions = JSON.parse(await readFile(path));
  predictions.predictions.forEach((item) => {
    item.skipReason = 'Author calibration checks source custody rather than written reasoning.';
  });
  await writeFile(path, JSON.stringify(predictions, null, 2) + '\n');
}

async function attemptNames(workspace) {
  try { return await readdir(join(workspace, 'artifacts/attempts')); }
  catch (error) { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; }
}
```

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import { join, state } from '../clients/http-client.mjs';
import { admitted, assertRemotePickupInvariant, honestWin, probeRemotePickup } from '../clients/scenarios.mjs';
import { withServer } from './harness.mjs';

// Kept separate so the editable defense lab can run these independent
// controls without relying on the learner's implementation or expected output.
test('honest delivery remains possible', async () => {
  await withServer(honestWin);
});

test('remote pickup cannot change authoritative cargo', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => assertRemotePickupInvariant(await probeRemotePickup(server)));
});

const boundaryCases = [
  {
    axis: 'x', position: [2250, 1000], depotPosition: [1250, 1000],
    outward: [['E', 4], ['E', 1]], homeward: [['W', 4]],
  },
  {
    axis: 'y', position: [2500, 1250], depotPosition: [1000, 1250],
    outward: [['E', 4], ['E', 2], ['S', 1]], homeward: [['W', 4], ['W', 2]],
  },
];

for (const example of boundaryCases) {
  test(`pickup and deposit include the exact 250 mm ${example.axis} boundary`, async () => {
    await withServer(async (server) => {
      const actor = await join(server.base);
      let seq = await walk(server, actor.token, example.outward);
      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'idle', true);
      await server.advance(1);
      const pickedUp = await state(server.base, actor.token);
      assert.deepEqual([pickedUp.actor.x, pickedUp.actor.y], example.position);
      assert.deepEqual([pickedUp.actor.cargo, pickedUp.actor.score], [true, 0]);
      assert.equal(pickedUp.lastDecision.reason, 'pickup', 'the inclusive range must accept equality');
      seq = await walk(server, actor.token, example.homeward, seq);
      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'idle', true);
      await server.advance(1);
      const deposited = await state(server.base, actor.token);
      assert.deepEqual([deposited.actor.x, deposited.actor.y], example.depotPosition);
      assert.deepEqual([deposited.actor.cargo, deposited.actor.score], [false, 1]);
      assert.equal(deposited.lastDecision.reason, 'deposit');
    });
  });
}

test('250 mm on both axes is outside the circular pickup range', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    const seq = await walk(server, actor.token, [['E', 4], ['E', 1], ['S', 1]]);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, seq + 1, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    const denied = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    assert.deepEqual([denied.actor.x, denied.actor.y], [2250, 1250]);
    assert.deepEqual([denied.actor.cargo, denied.actor.score], [false, 0], 'a square or x-only guard must not admit the diagonal');
    assert.deepEqual(denied.lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'range', tick: denied.tick });
    assert.equal(denied.actor.nextInteractTick, 0, 'a range denial must not start the success cooldown');
  });
});

test('range repair preserves the four-tick cooldown after pickup', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const actor = await join(server.base);
    let seq = await walk(server, actor.token, [['E', 4], ['E', 1]]);
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    const pickup = await state(server.base, actor.token);
    assert.equal(pickup.actor.cargo, true);
    assert.equal(pickup.actor.nextInteractTick, pickup.tick + 4);
    for (let offset = 1; offset <= 3; offset += 1) {
      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'idle', true);
      await server.advance(1);
      const denied = await state(server.base, actor.token);
      assert.deepEqual(denied.lastDecision, { status: 'denied', reason: 'cooldown', tick: pickup.tick + offset });
      assert.deepEqual([denied.actor.cargo, denied.actor.score], [true, 0]);
      assert.equal(denied.actor.nextInteractTick, pickup.tick + 4, 'denied retries must not extend cooldown');
    }
    await admitted(server.base, actor.token, ++seq, 'idle', true);
    await server.advance(1);
    assert.equal((await state(server.base, actor.token)).lastDecision.reason, 'range', 'cooldown ends exactly at N+4');
  });
});

test('repeated interactions after deposit cannot score again or extend cooldown', async () => {
  await withServer(async (server) => {
    const { actor, deposit } = await honestWin(server);
    assert.equal(deposit.actor.nextInteractTick, deposit.tick + 4);
    for (let offset = 1; offset <= 4; offset += 1) {
      await admitted(server.base, actor.token, 6 + offset, 'idle', true);
      await server.advance(1);
      const repeated = await state(server.base, actor.token);
      assert.deepEqual([repeated.actor.score, repeated.actor.cargo], [1, false]);
      assert.equal(repeated.actor.nextInteractTick, deposit.tick + 4);
      assert.equal(repeated.lastDecision.reason, offset < 4 ? 'cooldown' : 'range');
      assert.deepEqual(repeated.core, { x: 2500, y: 1000 });
    }
  });
});

async function walk(server, token, path, lastSeq = 0) {
  let seq = lastSeq;
  for (const [direction, ticks] of path) {
    await admitted(server.base, token, ++seq, direction);
    await server.advance(ticks);
  }
  return seq;
}
```

```mjs
test('in-memory export has only allowed fields, a declared byte limit and detached source data', () => {
  const source = events();

test('store boundary refuses malformed input and unsafe policy output before writing', async (t) => {
  const directory = await scratch(t);
  for (const value of [null, {}, { ...settings, nowTick: -1 }, { ...settings, maxAgeTicks: 0 }, { ...settings, maxEvents: Infinity }]) {
    assert.throws(() => validateSettings(value), /must be/);
  }
  for (const source of [null, [events()[0], { ...events()[1], tick: 6 }], [{ ...events()[0], actorId: '' }], [{ ...events()[0], distanceSquared: NaN }], new Array(MAX_SOURCE_EVENTS + 1)]) {
    assert.throws(() => validateEvents(source));
  }
  for (const name of ['copy excluded fields', 'delete source fields in place', 'retain future events', 'ignore count limit', 'reverse equal-tick order', 'round measured distance']) {
    const policy = wrongPolicies.find((item) => item.name === name).retain;
    const source = events().map((event) => event.tick === 12 ? { ...event, distanceSquared: 1.25 } : event);
    const configuration = { nowTick: 12, maxAgeTicks: 10, maxEvents: 2 };
    await assert.rejects(writeExport(join(directory, `${name}.json`), source, configuration, { policy }));
  }
  await assert.rejects(writeExport(join(directory, 'small.json'), events(), settings, { maxBytes: 1 }), /exceeds maxBytes/);
  assert.deepEqual(await readdir(directory), []);
});

test('actual export bytes are bounded and deleting its receipt leaves a separate export intact', async (t) => {
  const directory = await scratch(t);
  const source = events();
  const original = structuredClone(source);
  const path = join(directory, 'selected.json');
  const separatePath = join(directory, 'separate.json');
  const receipt = await writeExport(path, source, settings);
  const separate = await writeExport(separatePath, source, { ...settings, maxEvents: 1 });
  const bytes = await readFile(path);
  assert.equal(bytes.length, receipt.jsonBytes);
  assert.equal((await lstat(path)).mode & 0o777, 0o600);
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(bytes).events, retain(source, settings));
  assert.deepEqual((await readdir(directory)).sort(), ['selected.json', 'separate.json']);
  await assert.rejects(writeExport(path, source, settings), { code: 'EEXIST' });
  assert.deepEqual(await readFile(path), bytes);
  const deletion = await deleteExport(receipt);
  assert.equal(deletion.deleted, true);
  assert.equal(deletion.jsonBytes, bytes.length);
  assert.match(deletion.scope, /This export only/);
  await assert.rejects(readFile(path), { code: 'ENOENT' });
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await readFile(separatePath)).events, retain(source, { ...settings, maxEvents: 1 }));
  assert.deepEqual(source, original);
  assert.deepEqual(await readdir(directory), ['separate.json']);
  await assert.rejects(deleteExport(receipt), { code: 'ENOENT' });
  await deleteExport(separate);
  assert.deepEqual(await readdir(directory), []);
});

test('deletion refuses changed bytes and a symlink instead of removing a different artifact', async (t) => {
  const directory = await scratch(t);
  const path = join(directory, 'selected.json');
  const receipt = await writeExport(path, events(), settings);
  await writeFile(path, 'changed');
  await assert.rejects(deleteExport(receipt), /bytes changed/);
  assert.equal(await readFile(path, 'utf8'), 'changed');

  const target = join(directory, 'other.json');
  await writeFile(target, 'other');
  await symlink(target, path);
  await assert.rejects(deleteExport(receipt), /regular file/);
  assert.equal(await readFile(target, 'utf8'), 'other');
  await assert.rejects(deleteExport({ path }), /receipt/);
});

test('named workload report measures two settings and emits actual elapsed samples and JSON bytes', () => {
  const workload = createSyntheticWorkload(512);
  const before = structuredClone(workload);
  const configurations = [
    { nowTick: 511, maxAgeTicks: 400, maxEvents: 300 },
    { nowTick: 511, maxAgeTicks: 40, maxEvents: 20 },
  ];
  const report = measureRetention({ workload, settings: configurations, warmup: 1, samples: 3 });
  assert.equal(report.schema, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(report.settings, configurations);
  assert.equal(report.workload.name, WORKLOAD_NAME);
  assert.equal(report.workload.eventCount, 512);
  assert.equal(report.workload.inputJsonBytes, Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(workload.events)));
  assert.match(report.workload.sha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  assert.deepEqual(report.environment, { node: process.version, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch });
  assert.equal(report.warmup, 1);
  assert.equal(report.samples, 3);
  assert.equal(report.runs.length, 2);
  for (let index = 0; index < report.runs.length; index += 1) {
    const run = report.runs[index];
    assert.deepEqual(run.settings, configurations[index]);
    assert.equal(run.elapsedMs.length, 3);
    assert.ok(run.elapsedMs.every((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0));
    for (const name of ['policyMs', 'encodeMs', 'policyAndEncodeMs']) {
      assert.equal(run[name].length, 3);
      assert.ok(run[name].every((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0));
    }
    assert.deepEqual(run.policyAndEncodeMs, run.policyMs.map((value, index) => value + run.encodeMs[index]));
    for (const [name, samples] of [['wholeOperation', run.elapsedMs], ['policyAndEncode', run.policyAndEncodeMs]]) {
      assert.deepEqual(run.timingSummary[name], summarizeTimings(samples));
      assert.equal(run.timingSummary[name].tailStatistic, 'max');
      assert.equal(run.timingSummary[name].p95Ms, null);
    }
    assert.deepEqual(run.jsonByteSamples, Array(3).fill(buildExport(workload.events, configurations[index]).summary.jsonBytes));
    assert.equal(run.retainedCount, configurations[index].maxEvents);
  }
  assert.ok(report.runs[0].jsonBytes > report.runs[1].jsonBytes);
  assert.match(report.operation, /no disk I\/O/);
  assert.match(report.policyAndEncodeOperation, /excludes source validation, cloning/);
  assert.match(report.limits, /No production capacity/);
  assert.match(report.limits, /direct cost changed by the limits/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(report), /synthetic-actor|synthetic-example|synthetic-address|synthetic-device/);
  assert.deepEqual(workload, before);
  assert.throws(() => measureRetention({ workload, samples: 0 }), /samples/);
  assert.throws(() => measureRetention({ workload, settings: [settings] }), /Compare/);
});
```

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { DELIVERY_SCHEDULES, runDeliverySchedule } from '../clients/schedules.mjs';
import { withServer } from './harness.mjs';

for (const seed of [17, 31, 99]) {
  for (const name of DELIVERY_SCHEDULES) {
    test(`HTTP delivery schedule ${name}, seed ${seed}`, async () => {
      await withServer(async (server) => {
        const result = await runDeliverySchedule(server, name, { seed });
        assert.equal(result.name, name);
        assert.equal(result.seed, seed);
        assert.ok(result.checkpoints.length >= 3);
        assert.equal(new Set(result.checkpoints.map((checkpoint) => checkpoint.name)).size, result.checkpoints.length);
      }, { seed });
    });
  }
}

test('schedule fixtures reject unsupported names and seeds explicitly', async () => {
  await assert.rejects(runDeliverySchedule({}, 'invented'), /Unknown delivery schedule/);
  await assert.rejects(runDeliverySchedule({}, 'expiry-gap', { seed: 123 }), /No hand-authored schedule fixture/);
});
```

`courses/anti-cheat-engineering/courier-lab/tests/source-prediction-flow.test.mjs`:

```mjs
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cp, mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { prepareWorkspace } from '../lab/core/prepare.mjs';
import { checkSubmission } from '../lab/core/grade.mjs';
import { sealReference } from '../lab/core/seal.mjs';
import { PREDICTION_CONTRACT, predictionTemplate, validatePredictions } from '../lab/core/predictions.mjs';

const project = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const execute = promisify(execFile);
const json = async (path) => JSON.parse(await readFile(path, 'utf8'));
const save = (path, value) => writeFile(path, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n');
const listing = async (path) => readdir(path).catch((error) => { if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return []; throw error; });

async function cli(root, script, ...args) {
  const env = { ...process.env };
  delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT;
  try { return { code: 0, ...await execute(process.execPath, [script, ...args], { cwd: root, env, timeout: 90000, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024 }) }; }
  catch (error) { return { code: error.code, stdout: error.stdout, stderr: error.stderr }; }
}

async function reference(t) {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'ivy-prediction-flow-'));
  t.after(() => rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  await cp(project, root, { recursive: true, filter: (path) => !['artifacts', 'node_modules'].includes(path.split('/').at(-1)) });
  assert.equal((await cli(root, 'lab/order/seal.mjs')).code, 0);
  await sealReference(root);
  return root;
}

async function answer(path, { skip = false, text = 'My prediction before feedback.' } = {}) {
  const document = await json(path);
  document.predictions.forEach((item, index) => {
    item.answer = skip && index === 0 ? '' : text;
    item.skipReason = skip && index === 0 ? 'I need the worked explanation before answering this case.' : '';
  });
  await save(path, document);
  return document;
}

// practice-08 / feedback-01: a prediction commit precedes its keyed outcome.
test('all seven core modules refuse untouched predictions, preserve drafts, then capture skipped/answered and fresh revisions', async (t) => {
  const root = await reference(t);
  for (const id of ['integrity', 'telemetry', 'evaluation', 'retention', 'timing', 'recovery', 'capstone']) {
    await t.test(id, async () => {
      const { workspace, sessionId, referenceRoot } = await prepareWorkspace({ root, id });
      const session = await json(join(workspace, 'lab/core/session.json'));
      assert.equal(session.predictionContract, PREDICTION_CONTRACT);
      const args = { workspace, session, assistance: 'none' };
      const attempts = join(referenceRoot, 'artifacts/core/attempts', sessionId);
      const template = await readFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), 'utf8');
      const expected = await import(new URL(`../${id}/feedback.mjs`, import.meta.url));
      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(template), predictionTemplate(expected.postCheckFeedback(), id));
      assert.equal(await readFile(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json')).catch(() => null), null);
      const early = await checkSubmission({ ...args, fresh: true });
      assert.equal(early.kind, 'submission-refused');
      const refused = await checkSubmission(args);
      assert.equal(refused.kind, 'submission-refused');
      assert.equal(refused.graded, false);
      assert.deepEqual(await listing(attempts), []);
      assert.equal(await readFile(join(refused.destination, 'submitted/predictions.json'), 'utf8'), template);
      assert.equal(await readFile(join(refused.destination, 'feedback-started.json')).catch(() => null), null);
      await writeFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), '{unfinished draft');
      const malformed = await checkSubmission(args);
      assert.equal(malformed.kind, 'submission-refused');
      assert.equal(await readFile(join(malformed.destination, 'submitted/predictions.json'), 'utf8'), '{unfinished draft');
      await writeFile(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), template);
      const predictions = await answer(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), { skip: true });
      await cp(join(root, id, 'policy.mjs'), join(workspace, id, 'policy.mjs'));
      if (id === 'capstone') await cp(join(root, id, 'author-scenario.mjs'), join(workspace, id, 'scenario.mjs'));
      const first = await checkSubmission(args);
      assert.equal(first.passed, true, id + ': source grading is independent of arbitrary prose or explicit skips');
      const submission = await json(join(first.destination, 'submission.json'));
      assert.equal(submission.attemptKind, 'first');
      assert.equal(submission.assistanceClass, 'assisted');
      assert.equal(submission.predictionStatus, 'assisted-skipped');
      assert.deepEqual(submission.predictions, predictions);
      assert.equal(submission.proseGraded, false);
      const feedback = await json(join(first.destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'));
      assert.deepEqual(feedback.submittedPredictions, predictions);
      assert.equal(feedback.freshVariantAnswers, undefined);
      assert.equal(feedback.freshVariants, undefined);
      const blankFresh = await readFile(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json'), 'utf8');
      const freshRefused = await checkSubmission({ ...args, fresh: true });
      assert.equal(freshRefused.kind, 'submission-refused');
      assert.equal(await readFile(join(freshRefused.destination, 'submitted/fresh-practice.json'), 'utf8'), blankFresh);
      const freshAnswers = await answer(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json'));
      const fresh = await checkSubmission({ ...args, fresh: true });
      const freshSubmission = await json(join(fresh.destination, 'submission.json'));
      assert.equal(freshSubmission.attemptKind, 'first');
      assert.equal(freshSubmission.sourceAttemptId, first.attemptId);
      assert.deepEqual(freshSubmission.predictions, freshAnswers);
      assert.equal(fresh.graded, false);
      const freshFeedback = await json(join(fresh.destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'));
      assert.equal(freshFeedback.freshVariantAnswers.length, predictions.predictions.length);
      assert.ok(freshFeedback.freshVariantAnswers.every((item) => item.reason && item.answer && item.question));
      // Emulate interruption after a committed fresh submission: its identity and
      // feedback exposure must still survive if the feedback file is absent.
      await rm(join(fresh.destination, 'prediction-feedback.json'));
      await answer(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json'), { skip: true });
      const revision = await checkSubmission({ ...args, fresh: true });
      const revised = await json(join(revision.destination, 'submission.json'));
      assert.equal(revised.attemptKind, 'revision');
      assert.equal(revised.priorFeedbackExposure, true);
      assert.equal(revised.assistanceClass, 'assisted');
      assert.deepEqual(await json(join(fresh.destination, 'submitted/fresh-practice.json')), freshAnswers);
      await answer(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'));
      const sourceRevision = await checkSubmission(args);
      assert.equal((await json(join(sourceRevision.destination, 'submission.json'))).attemptKind, 'revision');
      assert.deepEqual(await json(join(first.destination, 'submitted/predictions.json')), predictions);
    });
  }
});

test('exact questions, all responses, and explicit mutually exclusive skips are required', async () => {
  const { postCheckFeedback } = await import('../timing/feedback.mjs');
  const template = predictionTemplate(postCheckFeedback(), 'timing');
  const completed = structuredClone(template);
  completed.predictions.forEach((item) => { item.answer = 'A committed prediction.'; });
  assert.equal(validatePredictions(JSON.stringify(completed), template).answeredCount, 4);
  for (const mutate of [
    (doc) => { doc.predictions[0].question += ' changed'; },
    (doc) => { doc.predictions[0].id = 'replacement'; },
    (doc) => { doc.predictions[0].answer = ' '; },
    (doc) => { doc.predictions[0].skipReason = 'Need help'; },
    (doc) => { doc.predictions.pop(); },
  ]) {
    const document = structuredClone(completed);
    mutate(document);
    assert.throws(() => validatePredictions(JSON.stringify(document), template));
  }
});

test('legacy spatial and order CLIs enforce the same prediction and fresh-practice commits', async (t) => {
  const root = await reference(t);
  for (const [id, prepare, workspacePath, check, attemptsName] of [
    ['spatial', 'lab/prepare.mjs', 'artifacts/workspace', 'lab/check.mjs', 'attempts'],
    ['order', 'lab/order/prepare.mjs', 'artifacts/order-workspace', 'lab/order/check.mjs', 'order-attempts'],
  ]) {
    await t.test(id, async () => {
      assert.equal((await cli(root, prepare)).code, 0);
      const workspace = join(root, workspacePath);
      const blank = await cli(workspace, check, '--assistance', 'none');
      assert.equal(blank.code, 2, blank.stderr);
      assert.match(blank.stdout, /without grading or answer release/);
      assert.deepEqual(await listing(join(workspace, 'artifacts', attemptsName)), []);
      await answer(join(workspace, 'predictions.json'), { skip: true });
      const checked = await cli(workspace, check, '--assistance', 'none');
      assert.ok([0, 1, 2].includes(checked.code), checked.stderr);
      const [first] = await listing(join(workspace, 'artifacts', attemptsName));
      assert.ok(first, checked.stderr);
      const submission = await json(join(workspace, 'artifacts', attemptsName, first, 'submission.json'));
      assert.equal(submission.attemptKind, 'first');
      assert.equal(submission.assistanceClass, 'assisted');
      assert.equal((await cli(workspace, check, '--fresh', '--assistance', 'none')).code, 2);
      await answer(join(workspace, 'fresh-practice.json'));
      const practice = await cli(workspace, check, '--fresh', '--assistance', 'none');
      assert.equal(practice.code, 0, practice.stderr);
      assert.match(practice.stdout, /Fresh practice saved before feedback/);
      const sessionPath = id === 'spatial' ? 'lab/session.json' : 'lab/order/session.json';
      const session = await json(join(workspace, sessionPath));
      delete session.predictionContract;
      await save(join(workspace, sessionPath), session);
      const downgrade = await cli(workspace, check, '--assistance', 'none');
      assert.equal(downgrade.code, 2);
      assert.match(downgrade.stderr, /prediction contract changed/);
    });
  }
});
```
