# 5. Rebuild after a failed hop

Choose a valid replacement circuit and explain why retrying cannot prove exactly-once delivery.

Your build: recoveryPlan chooses rebuild or stop; supplied lifecycle closes the old circuit and generates fresh keys.

Dependencies: 1, 3, 4.

## Failure leaves partial progress

A circuit can fail after earlier relays have already acted. If birch is unavailable, cedar may have opened the packet and recorded its sequence, while maple and the archive have seen nothing. Reusing the same packet from the start would now encounter cedar’s replay state. Clearing that state without considering old packets would remove the rule you just built.

The toy’s recovery policy closes the old circuit and establishes a replacement. Closing marks the old circuit unusable and discards its key handles. Establishing creates a new circuit ID, fresh forward and backward keys and empty receiver sets. Old packets cannot authenticate on those new keys. Sequence zero may be used again because its encryption keys are different.

Implement recoveryPlan using the directory and failed IDs. Keep the old path length and use the same distinctness and availability rules from module 1. Return a rebuild action with the new path, or a stop action with reason NO_PATH. The supplied recover function performs closure and setup; your work is the decision about the path. You may reuse a still-healthy relay on a fresh circuit.

**Commit practice q7:** A three-hop circuit fails. The directory has A, B, C, D online; B and D are failed. Enter the recovery action as a JSON string.

Run `node tools/practice.mjs q7` to see the submission route. Commit before reading its feedback; then continue.

## A missing reply is uncertain evidence

Now move the failure past the archive. The archive has received the lookup and made its reply, but the reply is lost before the client receives it. From the client’s missing reply alone, you cannot conclude that the request never arrived. A timeout describes what the client observed, not what every other participant did.

Our endpoint is a read-only catalog lookup. Repeating a lookup returns the record again without creating a second purchase or changing a balance. This makes an explicit retry suitable for the exercise. A general application that changes state would need its own duplicate-handling contract. An onion circuit does not provide exactly-once application effects.

Run the failover command after the module 5 check. It injects one unavailable relay, closes the old circuit, chooses a replacement and performs the read-only lookup. The report names the failed relay, new path and returned record. Separately, the lost-reply check confirms that an archive event exists before the client receives its error. Both are synthetic failures at declared function-call boundaries, not measurements of a live network.

**Commit practice q8:** The client receives no reply. Its only evidence is the missing reply. Can it conclude that the archive never received the request? Enter true or false.

Run `node tools/practice.mjs q8` to see the submission route. Commit before reading its feedback; then continue.

## Recover without strengthening the claim

Availability and privacy are different outcomes. A replacement path that works may still use relays controlled by one observer, and rebuilding cannot revoke a trace already recorded on the previous path. This exercise excludes known failed IDs, but online is not a synonym for trustworthy.

If fewer than the required number of distinct relays remain, return stop. Silently shortening the circuit changes the observer separation promised by the path contract. Another application could explicitly choose a different policy, but that would require a new contract and new reasoning. Your checker should expose that decision rather than hide it inside a convenient retry.

For the next module, preserve the difference between facts and inferences in your report. An authenticated record and a trace establish what this simulation did. They do not establish that an outside observer could not link two communications. You will now use the same observation discipline against that stronger claim.

**Commit application t5:** A rebuilt circuit includes the same healthy entry relay but has a new circuit ID, new keys and empty freshness sets. Its first valid sequence is 0. Should it be accepted? Enter true or false.

# 6. Challenge the privacy claim

Use synthetic timing evidence and endpoint observations to state defensible limits on an onion circuit.

Your build: correlate returns all compatible timing candidates; the capstone combines the working circuit with an evidence report.

Dependencies: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

## Compare gaps instead of clocks

An observer may see encrypted packets without seeing their contents. Their arrival times and sizes are still observations. Traffic correlation compares patterns at different points to look for possible links. The Tor Project explicitly describes observers at both ends as a limit of its threat model; adding encryption alone does not remove that observation channel.

The lab uses invented event times, measured in arbitrary ticks. It does not capture real traffic. Suppose one stream appears at times ten, thirteen and twenty. Its inter-event gaps are three and seven: subtract each time from the following time. A candidate at fifty, fifty-three and sixty has the same gaps despite its different clock offset. A candidate at fifty, fifty-seven and sixty has gaps seven and three, so it is a different pattern.

Implement correlate(entryTimes, candidates, tolerance). Each candidate has id and times. Keep candidates with the same number of events and with every corresponding gap differing by at most tolerance. For fewer than two entry events, return []; one point provides no gap evidence. Return all matching IDs. The inputs supplied here have finite ascending times and a nonnegative tolerance. This simple comparison is an exercise in reasoning from observations, not a traffic-analysis tool for third-party targets.

**Commit practice q9:** Compute the inter-event gaps for times [2, 7, 15, 18]. Enter a JSON array.

Run `node tools/practice.mjs q9` to see the submission route. Commit before reading its feedback; then continue.

## Keep ambiguity and endpoint facts visible

A compatible pattern is not a proven identity. Two candidates may match because they share a schedule or because the observation is too coarse. If both match, returning only the first invents certainty. If none match, that does not prove no communication occurred: the model omits jitter beyond tolerance, batching, missing events and many other network behaviors.

The endpoint is a different observer. In our lab it sees the plaintext lookup because it must answer it. The exit also sees that lookup because endpoint encryption is not part of the toy. A separately authenticated encrypted channel to an endpoint, such as HTTPS in a real application, changes the exit’s content visibility. It does not prevent the endpoint itself from reading the request or identifying an application account. We do not implement or simulate TLS and do not handle real credentials.

The whole simulator runs under one operator with all key material in memory. Its relay views are deliberately narrower than that operator’s access. Fresh keys, valid tags, distinct relay names and a passing test suite cannot turn this program into a real anonymity system. The useful artifact is a mechanism you can inspect and a precise argument about its limits.

**Commit practice q10:** Entry times are [0, 3, 10]. Candidates A=[20,23,30], B=[50,54,60], C=[90,96,100]. With tolerance 1, list every compatible candidate ID in alphabetical order.

Run `node tools/practice.mjs q10` to see the submission route. Commit before reading its feedback; then continue.

Finish the cumulative checks, then carry out CAPSTONE.md. Your deliverable is the code you wrote, a successful lookup trace, a rejected tamper and replay, a failed-hop recovery, and a report that separates each observer’s direct facts from inferences. Use the supplied report runner so the ordinary demonstration and your learner build are labeled distinctly.

The capstone changes the observation problem: scheduled senders may create the same pattern and a reply can be lost after endpoint receipt. You must keep uncertainty in your conclusions while still naming what the traces establish. No single catchphrase about encryption answers all of those cases. The capstone rubric checks the causal explanation beside the result.

Do the transfer tasks before opening any feedback for them. The public checks are practice tools whose cases you can inspect. The separate instructor assessment is outside the learner package and has no hints. Neither an author demonstration nor an assisted answer counts as an unaided learner result. If you need a hint, record it honestly and use a later fresh task to test the idea again.

export const transferCases = [
  {id:'A',entry:[0,4,13,18],tolerance:1,candidates:[
    {id:'A',times:[50,54,63,68]},{id:'B',times:[80,85,93,98]},{id:'C',times:[100,104,114,121]}]},
  {id:'B',entry:[0,1,2,3],tolerance:0,candidates:[
    {id:'P',times:[20,21,22,23]},{id:'Q',times:[60,61,62,63]},{id:'R',times:[90,91,92,93]}]},
];
function observe(action) {
  try { return {outcome:'returned',value:action()}; }
  catch(error) {return {outcome:'threw',code:error.code??error.name,detail:error.message};}
}
export async function capstoneReport(impl) {
  const checks=await evaluate(impl);
  if(checks.passed!==checks.total) return {mode:'learner-build',checks,scenarios:'NOT RUN: repair the failed requirements first.'};
  const c=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
  const reply=exchange(impl,c,{operation:'lookup',item:'tide'});
  const binding=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
  const reply7={record:'response to request 7'}, reply8={record:'response to request 8'};
  const packet7=deliverBackward(impl,binding,reply7,7), packet8=deliverBackward(impl,binding,reply8,8);
  const wrongRequest=observe(()=>impl.unwrapReply(binding.hops,packet7,8));
  const matching8=observe(()=>impl.unwrapReply(binding.hops,packet8,8));
  const matching7=observe(()=>impl.unwrapReply(binding.hops,packet7,7));
  const integrity=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
  const packet=impl.wrapRequest(integrity.hops,sampleRequest(),0),state=integrity.states[0];
  const changed=observe(()=>impl.peelForward(state,tamper(packet)));
  const seenAfterChanged=[...state.seenForward];
  const original=observe(()=>impl.peelForward(state,packet));
  const seenAfterOriginal=[...state.seenForward];
  const repeated=observe(()=>impl.peelForward(state,packet));
  // Do not report full ciphertext or key handles: only observations relevant to the argument.
  delete original.value;
  const broken=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
  const oldPacket=impl.wrapRequest(broken.hops,sampleRequest(),0);
  const failed=broken.path[1];
  const failure=observe(()=>deliverForward(impl,broken,oldPacket,{failAt:failed}));
  const replacement=recover(impl,broken,directory(),[failed]);
  const oldOnNew=observe(()=>impl.peelForward(replacement.circuit.states[0],oldPacket));
  const recoveredReply=exchange(impl,replacement.circuit);
  const lost=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
  const lostReply=observe(()=>exchange(impl,lost,sampleRequest(),{dropReply:true}));
  return {
    mode:'learner-build; offline simulation',checks,
    working:{path:c.path,reply,views:views(c)},
    replyBinding:{packetSequence:7,expectedSequence:8,wrongRequest,matching8,matching7,
      scope:'Matched requests may be unwrapped out of order. Replay acceptance is separate receiver state.'},
    integrity:{changed,seenAfterChanged,original,seenAfterOriginal,repeated},
    recovery:{failure,failedRelay:failed,oldCircuitId:broken.id,oldClosed:broken.closed,
      newCircuitId:replacement.circuit.id,newPath:replacement.circuit.path,oldOnNew,recoveredReply,
      noPath:impl.recoveryPlan(directory(),['cedar','birch','maple'],['cedar','birch','maple'])},
    lostReply:{client:lostReply,archiveEvents:views(lost).archive},
    transfer:transferCases.map(s=>({...s,retained:impl.correlate(s.entry,s.candidates,s.tolerance)})),
    reasoning:'UNASSESSED: complete REPORT-TEMPLATE.md and apply CAPSTONE.md rubric.',
  };
}

`courses/onion-network-course/observatory/runtime/crypto.mjs`:

```mjs
// Supplied platform code. Do not implement your own cryptographic primitive.
import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';

export class LabError extends Error {
  constructor(code, detail = code) { super(detail); this.name = 'LabError'; this.code = code; }
}
export const requireThat = (condition, code, detail) => {
  if (!condition) throw new LabError(code, detail);
};

// Key material stays in this process and is never written into reports or exports.
const materials = new WeakMap();
export function freshKey() {
  const handle = Object.freeze({ kind: 'ephemeral-toy-key' });
  materials.set(handle, { bytes: randomBytes(32), used: new Set() });
  return handle;
}
export function destroyKey(handle) {
  const material = materials.get(handle);
  if (material) material.bytes.fill(0);
  materials.delete(handle);
  // JS/crypto-library copies may remain: this is NOT a secure-erasure guarantee.
}
export function context(circuitId, relayId, direction, seq) {
  requireThat(typeof circuitId === 'string' && typeof relayId === 'string', 'BAD_CONTEXT');
  requireThat(['forward', 'backward'].includes(direction), 'BAD_DIRECTION');
  requireThat(Number.isSafeInteger(seq) && seq >= 0 && seq < 1024, 'BAD_SEQUENCE');
  return { protocol: 'onion-lab-v1', circuitId, relayId, direction, seq };
}
function aad(ctx) {
  // Canonical construction prevents object-key order from changing authentication.
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(context(ctx.circuitId, ctx.relayId, ctx.direction, ctx.seq)));
}
function materialFor(handle) {
  const material = materials.get(handle);
  requireThat(material, 'KEY_UNAVAILABLE', 'Key handle is unknown or its circuit is closed.');
  return material;
}
function nonceFor(seq) {
  const nonce = Buffer.alloc(12);
  nonce.writeUInt32BE(seq, 8);
  return nonce;
}
export function seal(handle, ctx, value) {
  const authenticated = aad(ctx);
  const material = materialFor(handle);
  // Every handle belongs to one hop and one direction of one circuit.
  // Reject reuse even with changed associated data: GCM needs unique key/nonce pairs.
  requireThat(!material.used.has(ctx.seq), 'NONCE_REUSE', 'Use a fresh sequence or rebuild with fresh keys.');
  const plaintext = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value));
  requireThat(plaintext.length <= 262144, 'OVERSIZE');
  const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', material.bytes, nonceFor(ctx.seq));
  cipher.setAAD(authenticated);
  const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext), cipher.final()]);
  material.used.add(ctx.seq);
  return { seq: ctx.seq, ciphertext: ciphertext.toString('base64'), tag: cipher.getAuthTag().toString('base64') };
}
export function open(handle, ctx, packet) {
  const authenticated = aad(ctx);
  const material = materialFor(handle);
  requireThat(packet && packet.seq === ctx.seq && typeof packet.ciphertext === 'string'
    && typeof packet.tag === 'string', 'BAD_PACKET');
  requireThat(packet.ciphertext.length <= 350000, 'OVERSIZE');
  try {
    const tag = Buffer.from(packet.tag, 'base64');
    requireThat(tag.length === 16, 'AUTH_FAILED');
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', material.bytes, nonceFor(ctx.seq));
    decipher.setAAD(authenticated);
    decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
    // No plaintext escapes until final() has authenticated the complete packet.
    const plaintext = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(Buffer.from(packet.ciphertext, 'base64')), decipher.final()]);
    return JSON.parse(plaintext.toString('utf8'));
  } catch {
    throw new LabError('AUTH_FAILED', 'Ciphertext, tag, context or key did not authenticate.');
  }
}

`courses/onion-network-course/observatory/runtime/network.mjs`:

```mjs
// Supplied in-process harness. There are no sockets, DNS calls or external relays.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { freshKey, destroyKey, requireThat, LabError } from './crypto.mjs';

export const directory = () => ['cedar', 'birch', 'maple', 'elm', 'ash'].map(id => ({ id, online: true }));
export const sampleRequest = () => ({ operation: 'lookup', item: 'luna' });
const catalog = { luna: 'Luna: a fictional lunar atlas', tide: 'Tide: a fictional ocean atlas' };

export function establish(path, relays = directory()) {
  requireThat(path.length >= 2 && new Set(path).size === path.length, 'BAD_PATH');
  requireThat(path.every(id => relays.some(r => r.id === id && r.online)), 'BAD_PATH');
  const circuitId = randomUUID();
  const hops = path.map(relayId => ({ circuitId, relayId, forwardKey: freshKey(), backwardKey: freshKey() }));
  // Omniscient setup is deliberately supplied. It is NOT a handshake or Tor telescoping.
  const states = hops.map((hop, i) => ({ ...hop, previous: path[i - 1] ?? 'client',
    next: path[i + 1] ?? 'archive', seenForward: new Set() }));
  return { id: circuitId, path: [...path], hops, states, nextSeq: 0, received: new Set(), closed: false, trace: [] };
}
export function closeCircuit(circuit) {
  circuit.closed = true;
  for (const hop of circuit.hops) { destroyKey(hop.forwardKey); destroyKey(hop.backwardKey); }
}
const bytes = packet => Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(packet));

export function deliverForward(implementation, circuit, packet, { failAt = null, modifyAt = null } = {}) {
  requireThat(!circuit.closed, 'CIRCUIT_CLOSED');
  let body = packet;
  for (const state of circuit.states) {
    if (state.relayId === failAt) throw new LabError('RELAY_DOWN', state.relayId);
    if (state.relayId === modifyAt) body = tamper(body);
    const size = bytes(body);
    const layer = implementation.peelForward(state, body);
    circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'forward', observer: state.relayId, previous: state.previous,
      next: layer.next, seq: body.seq, bytes: size, payload: layer.next === 'archive' ? layer.body : '[encrypted inner packet]' });
    body = layer.body;
  }
  return body;
}
export function deliverBackward(implementation, circuit, reply, seq) {
  let packet = reply;
  for (let i = circuit.hops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const hop = circuit.hops[i];
    packet = implementation.addReturnLayer(hop, packet, seq);
    circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'backward', observer: hop.relayId,
      previous: circuit.path[i + 1] ?? 'archive', next: circuit.path[i - 1] ?? 'client', seq, bytes: bytes(packet),
      payload: i === circuit.hops.length - 1 ? reply : '[encrypted inner packet]' });
  }
  return packet;
}
export function archive(request) {
  requireThat(request?.operation === 'lookup' && Object.hasOwn(catalog, request.item), 'BAD_REQUEST');
  return { item: request.item, record: catalog[request.item] };
}
export function exchange(implementation, circuit, request = sampleRequest(), fault = {}) {
  requireThat(!circuit.closed, 'CIRCUIT_CLOSED');
  const seq = circuit.nextSeq++;
  requireThat(seq < 1024, 'REBUILD_REQUIRED');
  const packet = implementation.wrapRequest(circuit.hops, request, seq);
  const arrived = deliverForward(implementation, circuit, packet, fault);
  const reply = archive(arrived);
  circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'endpoint', observer: 'archive', previous: circuit.path.at(-1), payload: arrived });
  if (fault.dropReply) throw new LabError('REPLY_LOST', 'Archive received the lookup; client did not receive its reply.');
  const response = deliverBackward(implementation, circuit, reply, seq);
  // The caller's request sequence is the expected identity at EVERY return layer.
  // Do not replace seq with a value read from an incoming packet.
  const unwrapped = implementation.unwrapReply(circuit.hops, response, seq);
  // Client replay tracking is supplied; M4 applies the same rule to relay state.
  requireThat(!circuit.received.has(seq), 'REPLAY');
  circuit.received.add(seq);
  return unwrapped;
}
export function tamper(packet) {
  const altered = structuredClone(packet);
  const bytes = Buffer.from(altered.ciphertext, 'base64');
  requireThat(bytes.length > 0, 'BAD_PACKET');
  bytes[0] ^= 1;
  altered.ciphertext = bytes.toString('base64');
  return altered;
}
export function recover(implementation, oldCircuit, relays, failedIds) {
  closeCircuit(oldCircuit);
  const plan = implementation.recoveryPlan(relays, failedIds, oldCircuit.path);
  if (plan.action === 'stop') return { plan, circuit: null };
  requireThat(plan.action === 'rebuild', 'BAD_PLAN');
  requireThat(!plan.path.some(id => failedIds.includes(id)), 'BAD_PLAN');
  return { plan, circuit: establish(plan.path, relays) };
}
export function views(circuit) {
  // A pedagogical projection, NOT isolation from the local process operator.
  return Object.fromEntries([...circuit.path, 'archive'].map(id =>
    [id, circuit.trace.filter(event => event.observer === id)]));
}

import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { cases } from '../checks/cases.mjs';

const root=resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'..');
const [command='help', stage='all', ...args]=process.argv.slice(2);
const flags=[stage,...args];
const getFlag=(name,fallback)=> { const i=flags.indexOf(name); return i<0?fallback:flags[i+1]; };
const sourcePath=resolve(root,getFlag('--impl','learner/solution.mjs'));
const assistance=getFlag('--help-used','none-declared');
const sha=text=>createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');

async function commitAttempt(kind, through) {
  const source=await readFile(sourcePath,'utf8');
  const questions=cases.filter(c=>c.module<=through).map(({id,requirement,input})=>({id,requirement,input}));
  const dependencies=['runtime/crypto.mjs','runtime/network.mjs','runtime/capstone.mjs','checks/cases.mjs','tools/lab.mjs','tools/worker.mjs'];
  const runtimeHashes=Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(dependencies.map(async file=>[file,sha(await readFile(join(root,file)))])));
  const id=`${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':','-')}-${randomUUID()}`;
  const folder=join(root,'attempts',id);
  // Fail before importing/executing learner code if its first attempt cannot be saved.
  await mkdir(folder,{recursive:true});
  const record={id,kind,through,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),sourcePath,sourceHash:sha(source),
    questionHash:sha(JSON.stringify(questions)),questions,runtimeHashes,contractHash:sha(JSON.stringify(runtimeHashes)),
    runtime:{node:process.version,openssl:process.versions.openssl},assistance,status:'committed-before-execution'};
  await writeFile(join(folder,'submission.mjs'),source,{flag:'wx'});
  await writeFile(join(folder,'attempt.json'),JSON.stringify(record,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
  return {folder,sourceHash:record.sourceHash};
}
async function main() {
  if(command==='help') {
    console.log('Circuit Observatory — offline toy, not Tor-compatible.\n'
      +'node tools/lab.mjs check 1|2|3|4|5|6|all [--help-used hint-1]\n'
      +'node tools/lab.mjs demo\nnode tools/lab.mjs failover\nnode tools/lab.mjs capstone\n'
      +'Edit learner/solution.mjs. Read README.md and lessons/01.md first.'); return;
  }
  if(!['check','demo','failover','capstone'].includes(command)) throw new Error(`Unknown command: ${command}`);
  const through=command==='check'?(stage==='all'?6:Number(stage)):6;
  if(!Number.isInteger(through)||through<1||through>6) throw new Error('Choose a module number 1–6 or all.');
  const {folder,sourceHash}=await commitAttempt(command,through);
  let result;
  try {
    const child=spawnSync(process.execPath,[join(root,'tools/worker.mjs'),sourcePath,sourceHash,command,String(through)],
      {timeout:5000,encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:512000});
    if(child.error) throw child.error;
    if(child.status!==0) throw new Error(`Worker exited ${child.status}: ${child.stderr.slice(0,1000)}`);
    result=JSON.parse(child.stdout);
  } catch(error) {result={executionFailure:true,code:error.code??error.name,detail:error.message};}
  await writeFile(join(folder,'result.json'),JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
  if(command==='check' && result.results) {
    for(const item of result.results) {
      console.log(`${item.pass?'PASS':'FAIL'} ${item.id}: ${item.requirement}`);
      if(!item.pass) console.log(`  ${item.code}: ${item.detail}\n  Input: ${JSON.stringify(item.input)}\n  Repair: ${item.lesson}`);
    }
    console.log(`${result.passed}/${result.total} requirements pass.`);
  } else console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
  console.log(`Attempt preserved: ${folder}`);
  if(result.executionFailure || (result.results && result.passed!==result.total)
    || (result.checks && result.checks.passed!==result.checks.total)) process.exitCode=1;
}
main().catch(error=>{console.error(`Cannot run: ${error.message}. Existing attempts are unchanged.`);process.exitCode=2;});

`courses/onion-network-course/observatory/tools/offline-worker.mjs`:

```mjs
// Executes the exact browser worker bundle using installed Node worker_threads.
// This checks the adapter offline; it does NOT establish browser/CSP compatibility.
import {Worker} from 'node:worker_threads';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
export function makeOfflineWorker(sourceText) {
  const bundleExpression=sourceText===undefined
    ? `readFileSync(${JSON.stringify(fileURLToPath(new URL('../workbench/learner-worker.js',import.meta.url)))},'utf8')`
    : JSON.stringify(sourceText);
  const source=`const {parentPort}=require('node:worker_threads');
    const {readFileSync}=require('node:fs');const vm=require('node:vm');
    globalThis.self=globalThis;
    globalThis.postMessage=data=>parentPort.postMessage(data);
    globalThis.addEventListener=(type,listener)=>{if(type==='message')parentPort.on('message',data=>listener({data}));};
    vm.runInThisContext(${bundleExpression});`;
  const thread=new Worker(source,{eval:true});
  const worker={onmessage:null,onerror:null,postMessage:data=>thread.postMessage(data),terminate:()=>thread.terminate()};
  thread.on('message',data=>worker.onmessage?.({data}));
  thread.on('error',error=>worker.onerror?.({message:error.message,preventDefault(){}}));
  return worker;
}
export function executeOffline(request,timeoutMs=10000) {
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const worker=makeOfflineWorker(),id=globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
    const timer=setTimeout(()=>{worker.terminate();reject(new Error('Offline worker timeout'));},timeoutMs);
    worker.onmessage=event=>{if(event.data.id!==id)return;clearTimeout(timer);worker.terminate();resolve(event.data.result);};
    worker.onerror=event=>{clearTimeout(timer);worker.terminate();reject(new Error(event.message));};
    worker.postMessage({id,request});
  });
}

import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { practice, gradePractice } from '../checks/practice.mjs';
const root=resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'..');
const [id,raw,help='none-declared']=process.argv.slice(2);
const item=practice.find(p=>p.id===id);
if(!item) {console.log('Use: node tools/practice.mjs ID [JSON-answer] [help-used]\n'+practice.map(p=>`${p.id}: ${p.prompt}`).join('\n'));process.exitCode=id?2:0;}
else if(raw===undefined) console.log(`${item.prompt}\nSubmit JSON, with shell single quotes around arrays or strings. Your response is saved before feedback.`);
else {
  try {
    const answer=JSON.parse(raw);
    const question={id:item.id,module:item.module,kind:item.kind,prompt:item.prompt};
    const attempt={id:randomUUID(),createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),question,answer,assistance:help,
      questionHash:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(question)).digest('hex')};
    const folder=resolve(root,'practice-attempts',attempt.id); await mkdir(folder,{recursive:true});
    await writeFile(resolve(folder,'attempt.json'),JSON.stringify(attempt,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
    const result=gradePractice(item,answer);
    await writeFile(resolve(folder,'feedback.json'),JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
    console.log(`${item.kind==='prediction'?'Prediction recorded':result.pass?'Supported answer':'Needs repair'}\nYou submitted ${JSON.stringify(answer)}. Expected ${JSON.stringify(result.expected)}.\n${result.reason}`);
    if(!result.pass&&result.repair) console.log(`Try fresh item: node tools/practice.mjs ${result.repair}`);
    console.log(`Saved: ${folder}`);
  } catch(error) {console.error(`Not submitted: ${error.message}. Check JSON syntax and writable storage. No feedback was revealed.`);process.exitCode=2;}
}

`courses/onion-network-course/observatory/tools/worker.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs already-authorized local learner code. Timeout is a liveness guard, not a sandbox.
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { evaluate } from '../checks/cases.mjs';
import { directory, establish, exchange, recover, sampleRequest, views } from '../runtime/network.mjs';
import { capstoneReport } from '../runtime/capstone.mjs';
const [sourcePath, expectedHash, command, through]=process.argv.slice(2);
console.log=(...args)=>console.error(...args);
let result;
try {
  const source=await readFile(sourcePath,'utf8');
  if(createHash('sha256').update(source).digest('hex')!==expectedHash) throw new Error('Source changed after submission. Run again to record the new version.');
  const impl=await import(pathToFileURL(sourcePath).href);
  if(command==='check') result=await evaluate(impl,Number(through));
  else if(command==='capstone') result=await capstoneReport(impl);
  else {
    const c=establish(impl.selectPath(directory()));
    if(command==='demo') result={mode:'offline simulation',reply:exchange(impl,c),views:views(c)};
    else {
      const failed=c.path[1]; let failure;
      try {exchange(impl,c,sampleRequest(),{failAt:failed});} catch(error){failure={code:error.code,message:error.message};}
      const next=recover(impl,c,directory(),[failed]);
      result={failure,oldClosed:c.closed,newPath:next.plan.path,reply:next.circuit?exchange(impl,next.circuit):null,
        retryLimit:'Read-only lookup. This does not implement exactly-once delivery.'};
    }
  }
} catch(error) {result={executionFailure:true,code:error.code??error.name,detail:error.message};}
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result));

```

`courses/onion-network-course/observatory/workbench/app.js`:

/* Supplied static reading/practice interface. No network requests or external assets. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const {course,practice,trace,contentHash}=window.LAB;
  const prefix='circuit-observatory/v1/';
  const root=document.querySelector('#lesson');
  const status=document.querySelector('#storage-status');
  let current=1,step=0,revealed=false;
  const el=(tag,text,className)=>{const node=document.createElement(tag);if(text!==undefined)node.textContent=text;if(className)node.className=className;return node;};
  function records() {
    const out=[];
    for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++) {
      const key=localStorage.key(i);
      if(key.startsWith(prefix)) out.push(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)));
    }
    return out.sort((a,b)=>a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
  }
  function save(record) {
    const id=crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():`${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
    const full={...record,id,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),contentHash};
    const key=prefix+id,value=JSON.stringify(full);
    localStorage.setItem(key,value);
    if(localStorage.getItem(key)!==value) throw new Error('Storage verification failed');
    status.textContent='Saved locally on this browser origin. Export a copy before moving the file.';
    return full;
  }
  function storageFailure(error) {
    status.textContent=`Could not save: ${error.message}. Your text remains on screen. No answer was submitted or feedback revealed. Use the CLI if this browser blocks file storage.`;
  }
  function matching(id) {return records().filter(r=>r.type==='response'&&r.question.id===id&&r.contentHash===contentHash);}
  function answerCard(item) {
    const card=el('div',undefined,'question');
    card.append(el('div',`${item.kind==='prediction'?'Predict before the reveal':'Apply the idea'} · ${item.id}`,'eyebrow'));
    const label=el('label',item.prompt);label.htmlFor=`answer-${item.id}`;card.append(label);
    const input=el('textarea');input.id=`answer-${item.id}`;input.rows=2;input.setAttribute('spellcheck','false');
    input.setAttribute('aria-describedby',`format-${item.id}`);card.append(input);
    const format=el('p','Use JSON: a number, true/false, a quoted string, or an array. Example format: ["first","second"].','small');format.id=`format-${item.id}`;card.append(format);
    const button=el('button','Commit response');button.type='button';card.append(button);
    const feedback=el('div',undefined,'feedback');feedback.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');card.append(feedback);
    function show(result,previous=false) {
      feedback.replaceChildren();
      feedback.append(el('strong',`${previous?'Latest saved response · ':''}${item.kind==='prediction'?'Prediction recorded':result.pass?'Supported answer':'Needs repair'}`));
      feedback.append(el('p',`You submitted ${JSON.stringify(result.answer)}. Expected ${JSON.stringify(item.answer)}.`));
      feedback.append(el('p',item.reason));
      feedback.append(el('p',`Help recorded: ${result.assistance?.join(', ')||'none declared'}. Earlier responses remain in your export.`,'small'));
      if(!result.pass&&item.repair) {
        const next=el('button',`Try a fresh case · ${item.repair}`,'secondary');
        next.onclick=()=>{next.replaceWith(answerCard(practice.find(q=>q.id===item.repair)));};feedback.append(next);
      }
    }
    button.onclick=()=>{
      let answer;
      try{answer=JSON.parse(input.value);}catch{feedback.textContent='Format not submitted. Use valid JSON; strings need double quotes.';return;}
      try{
        const assistance=records().filter(r=>r.type==='hint'&&r.module===item.module).map(r=>r.label);
        const result=save({type:'response',question:{id:item.id,module:item.module,kind:item.kind,prompt:item.prompt,
          versionHash:item.versionHash},answer,pass:JSON.stringify(answer)===JSON.stringify(item.answer),assistance});
        show(result); updateHintGate();
      }catch(error){storageFailure(error);}
    };
    try{const old=matching(item.id).at(-1);if(old){input.value=JSON.stringify(old.answer);show(old,true);}}
    catch(error){storageFailure(error);}
    return card;
  }
  function updateHintGate() {
    const last=document.querySelector('[data-final-hint]');if(!last)return;
    try{last.disabled=!records().some(r=>r.type==='response'&&r.question.module===current);}catch{last.disabled=true;}
  }
  function render(moduleId,moveFocus=false) {
    current=moduleId;const module=course.modules.find(m=>m.id===moduleId);root.replaceChildren();
    document.querySelectorAll('nav button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',Number(b.dataset.module)===current?'step':'false'));
    root.append(el('div',`MODULE ${module.id} / ${course.modules.length}`,'eyebrow'));
    const h1=el('h1',module.title);h1.tabIndex=-1;root.append(h1);
    root.append(el('p',module.goal,'lead'));
    root.append(el('p',`Your build: ${module.artifact}`,'artifact'));
    root.append(el('p',module.depends.length?`Builds on modules ${module.depends.join(', ')}. All modules remain open.`:'Start here. JavaScript and terminal familiarity assumed.','small'));
    for(const section of module.sections) {
      root.append(el('h2',section.title));
      for(const paragraph of section.text.split('\n\n'))root.append(el('p',paragraph));
      root.append(answerCard(practice.find(q=>q.id===section.question)));
    }
    root.append(el('h2','Build and check'));
    root.append(el('p',module.build,'command'));
    const links=el('p');const contract=el('a','Read the API contract');contract.href='../PROTOCOL.md';links.append(contract,' · ');
    const capstone=el('a','Capstone and report');capstone.href='../CAPSTONE.md';links.append(capstone);root.append(links);
    const coding=el('a','Edit and run your implementation in the browser workbench below');coding.href='#code-lab';root.append(coding);
    root.append(el('p','The browser workbench runs your source with async Web Crypto. The Node CLI remains available. The optional reference trace below is separate from your run.','small'));
    const hints=el('div',undefined,'hints');hints.append(el('h3','Optional help'));
    module.hints.forEach((hint,i)=>{
      const button=el('button',`Show hint ${i+1}${i===2?' · after a response':''}`,'secondary');if(i===2)button.dataset.finalHint='true';
      button.onclick=()=>{try{save({type:'hint',module:current,label:`hint-${i+1}`});button.replaceWith(el('p',hint));}catch(error){storageFailure(error);}};
      hints.append(button);
    });root.append(hints);updateHintGate();
    if(current===3)renderTrace(root);
    const footer=el('div',undefined,'chapter-footer');
    if(current>1){const prev=el('button','← Previous module','secondary');prev.onclick=()=>render(current-1,true);footer.append(prev);}
    if(current<6){const next=el('button','Next module →');next.onclick=()=>render(current+1,true);footer.append(next);}
    root.append(footer);document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('onion-module',{detail:{id:current}}));if(moveFocus)h1.focus();
  }
  function renderTrace(parent) {
    const panel=el('section',undefined,'trace');panel.append(el('h2','Step through a reference circuit'));
    panel.append(el('p','Predict which relay first sees the lookup as plaintext, then follow one reference run. This is generated from executed code; it is not your implementation.'));
    const field=el('input');field.setAttribute('aria-label','Your predicted relay');field.placeholder='Relay ID';panel.append(field);
    const reveal=el('button','Commit prediction and show trace');panel.append(reveal);
    const view=el('div');panel.append(view);
    reveal.onclick=()=>{
      if(!field.value.trim())return;
      try{save({type:'trace-prediction',prediction:field.value.trim(),question:'Which relay first sees plaintext lookup?',module:3});revealed=true;step=0;draw();}
      catch(error){storageFailure(error);}
    };
    function draw() {
      view.replaceChildren();if(!revealed)return;
      view.append(el('p',`Your prediction: ${field.value}. The first plaintext lookup is at maple, after its forward layer opens. Cedar and birch hold encrypted inner packets.`));
      const event=trace[step];
      view.append(el('p',`Step ${step+1} of ${trace.length}: ${event.observer} · ${event.direction}`,'eyebrow'));
      const route=el('div',undefined,'route');
      for(const id of ['client','cedar','birch','maple','archive'])route.append(el('span',id,id===event.observer?'active':''));view.append(route);
      const dl=el('dl');
      for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(event)){dl.append(el('dt',key),el('dd',typeof value==='object'?JSON.stringify(value):String(value)));}view.append(dl);
      const buttons=el('div',undefined,'trace-buttons');
      const back=el('button','← Previous step','secondary');back.disabled=step===0;back.onclick=()=>{step--;draw();};
      const forward=el('button','Next step →');forward.disabled=step===trace.length-1;forward.onclick=()=>{step++;draw();};
      const restart=el('button','Replay','secondary');restart.onclick=()=>{step=0;draw();};buttons.append(back,forward,restart);view.append(buttons);
      view.append(el('p','The process operator can inspect the complete trace. One relay’s displayed view is narrower. There is no network, TLS or real endpoint in this demonstration.','small'));
    }
    parent.append(panel);
  }
  const nav=document.querySelector('nav');
  course.modules.forEach(m=>{const button=el('button',`${m.id}. ${m.title}`,'nav-item');button.dataset.module=String(m.id);button.onclick=()=>render(m.id,true);nav.append(button);});
  document.querySelector('#export').onclick=()=>{
    try{
      const data={course:course.id,contentHash,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),records:records()};
      const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a=el('a');a.href=url;a.download='circuit-observatory-attempts.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
    }catch(error){storageFailure(error);}
  };
  render(1);
})();

Earlier committed scenarios and source were not changed.';}catch(error){status.textContent=`Draft not saved: ${error.message}. Download the scenario to keep it.`;}};
  downloadWorkshop.onclick=()=>downloadText('onion-scenario.json',JSON.stringify(workshop.snapshot(),null,2),'application/json');
  scenarioFile.onchange=async()=>{const selected=scenarioFile.files[0];if(!selected)return;if(selected.size>100000){status.textContent='Scenario file exceeds 100,000 bytes; unchanged.';return;}try{workshop.load(JSON.parse(await selected.text()));status.textContent='Scenario loaded; nothing executed.';}catch(error){status.textContent=`Could not load scenario: ${error.message}`;}};
  editor.addEventListener('input',updateStale);
  save.onclick=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('circuit-observatory/editor-draft',editor.value);status.textContent='Draft saved. Committed attempts were not changed.';}catch(error){status.textContent=`Draft not saved: ${error.message}. Download the source to keep a copy.`;}};
  download.onclick=()=>downloadText('browser-solution.js',editor.value);
  file.onchange=async()=>{const selected=file.files[0];if(!selected)return;if(selected.size>100000){status.textContent='File too large; editor unchanged.';return;}try{const text=await selected.text();editor.value=text;updateStale();status.textContent='Code loaded into the editor.   historyButton.onclick=()=>{try{downloadText('onion-project-history.json',JSON.stringify(session.exportRecords(),null,2),'application/json');}catch(error){status.textContent=`Export failed: ${error.message}`;}};
  historySelect.onchange=()=>{try{const entries=session.history(),receipt=entries.find(r=>r.kind==='result'&&r.id===historySelect.value),submission=entries.find(r=>r.kind==='submission'&&r.id===historySelect.value);if(receipt&&submission)showResult({receipt,submission,saved:true});}catch(error){status.textContent=error.message;}};
  document.addEventListener('onion-module',event=>{stage.value=String(event.detail.id);});
})();

  function save(record) {

</script><script>const ProjectSession=(()=>{

// Testable controller used by the real UI. Storage/worker are injected; no DOM or sockets.
async function digest(text) {
  return [...new Uint8Array(await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(text)))].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
const storagePrefix='circuit-observatory/code/v1/';
function createProjectSession({storage,makeWorker,buildId,runtimeHash,requirements,
  workshopContract,onStatus=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},timeoutMs=10000}) {
  let active=null;
  const unsaved=[];
  function put(kind,id,value) {
    const key=storagePrefix+kind+'/'+id;
    if(storage.getItem(key)!==null)throw new Error('Refusing to overwrite an existing project record.');
    const serialized=JSON.stringify(value);storage.setItem(key,serialized);
    if(storage.getItem(key)!==serialized)throw new Error('Project storage did not retain the record.');
  }
  function history() {
    const out=[];
    for(let i=0;i<storage.length;i++) {
      const key=storage.key(i);
      if(key?.startsWith(storagePrefix))out.push(JSON.parse(storage.getItem(key)));
    }
    return out.sort((a,b)=>a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
  }
  async function run({source,command,through=6,options={},assistance='none-declared',prediction=''}) {
    if(active)throw new Error('Stop or finish the current run before starting another.');
    if(typeof source!=='string'||source.length>100000||!source.trim())throw new Error('Use nonempty source under 100,000 characters.');
    // Snapshot before awaiting any hashing, so edits made while hashing belong to a later run.
    const snapshot={source,command,through,options:structuredClone(options),assistance,prediction};
    const token={id:globalThis.crypto.randomUUID(),cancelled:false};active=token;
    let record;
    try {
      if(command==='workshop'&&!workshopContract)throw new Error('The experiment contract is unavailable.');
      const question=command==='workshop'?{contract:workshopContract,scenario:snapshot.options.scenario}:command==='check'?requirements.filter(x=>x.module<=through):requirements;
      record={kind:'submission',id:token.id,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),...snapshot,
        sourceHash:await digest(snapshot.source),question,questionHash:await digest(JSON.stringify(question)),buildId,runtimeHash,
        ...(command==='workshop'?{scenarioHash:await digest(JSON.stringify(snapshot.options.scenario))}: {})};
      if(token.cancelled)return;
      put('submission',record.id,record);
    } catch(error) {if(active===token)active=null;onStatus('Submission not saved; no code executed.');throw error;}
    if(token.cancelled)return;
    let worker,timer,finished=false;
    function finish(result) {
      if(finished)return;finished=true;clearTimeout(timer);worker?.terminate();active=null;
      const receipt={kind:'result',id:record.id,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),sourceHash:record.sourceHash,
        questionHash:record.questionHash,buildId,runtimeHash,result,
        ...(record.scenarioHash?{scenarioHash:record.scenarioHash}:{})};
      let saved=true;
      try{put('result',record.id,receipt);}catch(error){saved=false;unsaved.push(receipt);onStatus(`Result is not saved: ${error.message}. Export it now; the submitted source is retained.`);}
      if(saved)onStatus('Run finished. Source and result saved as a new attempt.');
      onResult({submission:record,receipt,saved});
    }
    token.finish=finish;
    try {
      worker=makeWorker();
      worker.onmessage=event=>{if(event.data?.id===record.id&&event.data.type==='result')finish(event.data.result);};
      worker.onerror=event=>{event.preventDefault?.();finish({executionFailure:true,code:'WORKER_ERROR',detail:event.message??'Worker failed to start or execute.'});};
      timer=setTimeout(()=>finish({executionFailure:true,code:'TIMEOUT',detail:`Stopped after ${timeoutMs/1000} seconds; simplify the loop and retry.`}),timeoutMs);
      onStatus('Running your committed source in a disposable worker…');
      worker.postMessage({id:record.id,request:snapshot});
    }catch(error){finish({executionFailure:true,code:'WORKER_UNAVAILABLE',detail:error.message});}
    return record;
  }
  function cancel() {
    if(!active)return;
    active.cancelled=true;
    if(active.finish)active.finish({executionFailure:true,code:'CANCELLED',detail:'Stopped by the learner.'});
    else {active=null;onStatus('Cancelled before execution.');}
  }
  function exportRecords() {
    const records=[],invalidRecords=[];
    for(let i=0;i<storage.length;i++) {
      const key=storage.key(i);if(!key?.startsWith(storagePrefix))continue;
      const raw=storage.getItem(key);
      try{records.push(JSON.parse(raw));}catch(error){invalidRecords.push({key,raw,error:error.message});}
    }
    return {buildId,runtimeHash,records,invalidRecords,unsavedResults:[...unsaved]};
  }
  return {run,cancel,history,exportRecords,isRunning:()=>Boolean(active)};
}

return {digest,storagePrefix,createProjectSession};
})();

  function mount({container,make,initial,onChange}) {

      replacement.disabled=action.value!=='recover';length.disabled=action.value!=='open';
      relays.disabled=!['open','offline','online','recover'].includes(action.value);
      item.disabled=action.value!=='send';fault.disabled=action.value!=='send';
      hop.disabled=action.value!=='send'||!['drop-forward','corrupt-forward'].includes(fault.value);
      hint.textContent=action.value==='open'?'Relay names are excluded from this path.':action.value==='recover'?'Relay names are the failures you tell recoveryPlan about; offline relays also remain unavailable.':action.value==='send'?'Use a new packet name. A fault affects this delivery only; the original bytes are captured before injection.':action.value==='replay'?'Inject the exact saved forward packet into the named circuit; no re-encryption.':'Relay names apply to online/offline actions.     }
    action.onchange=enable;fault.onchange=enable;enable();
    const apply=make('button','Add step','secondary'),cancel=make('button','Cancel step edit','secondary');container.append(apply,cancel);
    const message=make('p','','small');message.setAttribute('role','status');container.append(message);
    function changed(){onChange?.();}
    function reset(){editIndex=null;apply.textContent='Add step';cancel.disabled=true;}
    function draw(){
      list.replaceChildren();
      scenario.steps.forEach((step,i)=>{
        const row=make('li');row.append(make('code',JSON.stringify(step)));
        for(const [label,fn] of [
          ['Edit',()=>{editIndex=i;action.value=step.action;circuit.value=step.circuit??'alpha';packet.value=step.packet??'newPacket';replacement.value=step.replacement??'delta';length.value=String(step.length??3);relays.value=(step.avoid??step.failed??step.relays??[]).join(', ');item.value=step.item??'luna';fault.value=step.fault?.kind??'none';hop.value=String(step.fault?.hop??0);apply.textContent='Update step';cancel.disabled=false;enable();}],
          ['Move up',()=>{[scenario.steps[i-1],scenario.steps[i]]=[step,scenario.steps[i-1]];reset();draw();changed();}],
          ['Move down',()=>{[scenario.steps[i+1],scenario.steps[i]]=[step,scenario.steps[i+1]];reset();draw();changed();}],
          ['Remove',()=>{scenario.steps.splice(i,1);reset();draw();changed();}]
        ]) {const button=make('button',label,'secondary');button.setAttribute('aria-label',`${label} step ${i+1}`);button.disabled=label==='Move up'&&i===0||label==='Move down'&&i===scenario.steps.length-1;button.onclick=fn;row.append(button);}
        list.append(row);
      });
    }
    apply.onclick=()=>{
      if(editIndex===null&&scenario.steps.length>=32){message.textContent='Use at most 32 steps.';return;}
      const step={action:action.value},names=relays.value.split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);

      if(['send','replay'].includes(step.action))step.packet=packet.value.trim();
      if(step.action==='send'){step.item=item.value;if(fault.value!=='none'){step.fault={kind:fault.value};if(fault.value!=='drop-reply')step.fault.hop=Number(hop.value);}}
      if(['offline','online'].includes(step.action))step.relays=names;
      if(step.action==='recover'){step.replacement=replacement.value.trim();step.failed=names;}
      if(editIndex===null)scenario.steps.push(step);else scenario.steps[editIndex]=step;
      reset();draw();changed();message.textContent='Scenario updated; nothing executed. The worker validates the complete scenario before running steps.';
    };
    cancel.onclick=reset;
    const predictionFields=[];
    container.append(make('h4','Predict before running'));
    const predictions=make('div',undefined,'workshop-predictions');container.append(predictions);
    for(const observer of ['client','cedar','birch','maple','elm','ash','archive','operator']) {
      const label=make('label',`${observer}: direct fact, inference, or still unknown?`),field=make('input');field.id=`prediction-${observer}`;
      field.value=scenario.predictions.filter(p=>p.observer===observer).map(p=>p.claim).join('\n');field.maxLength=2000;
      label.append(field);predictions.append(label);predictionFields.push({observer,field});field.addEventListener('input',changed);
    }
    title.addEventListener('input',changed);reset();draw();
    function snapshot(){return {version:1,title:title.value,predictions:predictionFields.filter(p=>p.field.value.trim()).map(p=>({observer:p.observer,claim:p.field.value})),steps:structuredClone(scenario.steps)};}
    function load(value){
      if(value?.version!==1||typeof value.title!=='string'||!Array.isArray(value.steps)||value.steps.length>32||!value.steps.every(s=>s&&typeof s==='object'&&!Array.isArray(s))||!Array.isArray(value.predictions)||!value.predictions.every(p=>p&&typeof p.observer==='string'&&typeof p.claim==='string'))throw new Error('Not a version 1 workshop scenario.');
      if(Object.keys(value).some(k=>!['version','title','predictions','steps'].includes(k))||value.predictions.length>12||value.predictions.some(p=>Object.keys(p).some(k=>!['observer','claim'].includes(k))||!predictionFields.some(f=>f.observer===p.observer)))throw new Error('Unknown scenario fields or observers; existing draft preserved.');
      if(predictionFields.some(p=>value.predictions.filter(x=>x.observer===p.observer).map(x=>x.claim).join('\n').length>2000))throw new Error('Keep each observer prediction within 2,000 characters.');
      scenario=structuredClone(value);title.value=value.title;
      for(const p of predictionFields)p.field.value=value.predictions.filter(x=>x.observer===p.observer).map(x=>x.claim).join('\n');
      reset();draw();changed();
    }
    return {snapshot,load};
  }
  function render({container,make,result}) {
    const area=make('div',undefined,'trace');area.append(make('h3',`Experiment · ${result.title}`),make('p',result.reasoning));
    area.append(make('p','Predictions committed before execution:'));

    label.append(select);area.append(label);const view=make('div');view.id='workshop-evidence';area.append(view);
    function draw(){

    }
    select.onchange=draw;draw();area.append(make('p',result.visibility,'small'));container.append(area);
  }
  return {mount,render};

const BrowserCrypto=(()=>{

// Browser adapter: only the platform's vetted AES-GCM implementation encrypts data.
class LabError extends Error {
  constructor(code, detail=code) {super(detail);this.name='LabError';this.code=code;}
}
function requireThat(condition,code,detail) {if(!condition)throw new LabError(code,detail);}
const utf8=value=>new TextEncoder().encode(value);
function toBase64(bytes) {
  let text='';for(const byte of bytes)text+=String.fromCharCode(byte);return btoa(text);
}
function fromBase64(text) {
  return Uint8Array.from(atob(text),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
}
function context(circuitId,relayId,direction,seq) {
  requireThat(typeof circuitId==='string'&&typeof relayId==='string','BAD_CONTEXT');
  requireThat(['forward','backward'].includes(direction),'BAD_DIRECTION');
  requireThat(Number.isSafeInteger(seq)&&seq>=0&&seq<1024,'BAD_SEQUENCE');
  return {protocol:'onion-lab-v1',circuitId,relayId,direction,seq};
}
function createCryptoPlatform(provider=globalThis.crypto) {
  requireThat(provider?.subtle&&provider?.getRandomValues,'CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE','This environment needs built-in Web Crypto.');
  const materials=new WeakMap();
  function freshKey() {
    const handle=Object.freeze({kind:'ephemeral-toy-key'}),raw=provider.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    const promise=provider.subtle.importKey('raw',raw,'AES-GCM',false,['encrypt','decrypt']).finally(()=>raw.fill(0));
    materials.set(handle,{promise,used:new Set(),active:true});return handle;
  }
  function destroyKey(handle) {
    const material=materials.get(handle);if(material)material.active=false;materials.delete(handle);
    // CryptoKey/JS memory cannot be securely erased by this application.
  }
  function materialFor(handle) {
    const material=materials.get(handle);requireThat(material?.active,'KEY_UNAVAILABLE');return material;
  }
  const aad=ctx=>utf8(JSON.stringify(context(ctx.circuitId,ctx.relayId,ctx.direction,ctx.seq)));
  const nonce=seq=>{const bytes=new Uint8Array(12);new DataView(bytes.buffer).setUint32(8,seq);return bytes;};
  async function seal(handle,ctx,value) {
    const additionalData=aad(ctx),material=materialFor(handle);
    requireThat(!material.used.has(ctx.seq),'NONCE_REUSE','Use a fresh sequence or rebuild with fresh keys.');
    const plaintext=utf8(JSON.stringify(value));requireThat(plaintext.length<=262144,'OVERSIZE');
    // Reserve synchronously, before any await, so concurrent calls cannot reuse a nonce.
    material.used.add(ctx.seq);
    const key=await material.promise;requireThat(material.active,'KEY_UNAVAILABLE');
    const combined=new Uint8Array(await provider.subtle.encrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:nonce(ctx.seq),additionalData,tagLength:128},key,plaintext));
    return {seq:ctx.seq,ciphertext:toBase64(combined.slice(0,-16)),tag:toBase64(combined.slice(-16))};
  }
  async function open(handle,ctx,packet) {
    const additionalData=aad(ctx),material=materialFor(handle);
    requireThat(packet&&packet.seq===ctx.seq&&typeof packet.ciphertext==='string'&&typeof packet.tag==='string','BAD_PACKET');
    requireThat(packet.ciphertext.length<=350000,'OVERSIZE');
    const key=await material.promise;requireThat(material.active,'KEY_UNAVAILABLE');
    try {
      const ciphertext=fromBase64(packet.ciphertext),tag=fromBase64(packet.tag);requireThat(tag.length===16,'AUTH_FAILED');
      const combined=new Uint8Array(ciphertext.length+tag.length);combined.set(ciphertext);combined.set(tag,ciphertext.length);
      const plaintext=await provider.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:nonce(ctx.seq),additionalData,tagLength:128},key,combined);
      return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(plaintext));
    }catch {throw new LabError('AUTH_FAILED','Ciphertext, tag, context or key did not authenticate.');}
  }
  return {freshKey,destroyKey,seal,open,context,requireThat,LabError};
}
const platform=createCryptoPlatform();
const {freshKey,destroyKey,seal,open}=platform;

return {LabError,requireThat,utf8,toBase64,fromBase64,context,createCryptoPlatform,freshKey,destroyKey,seal,open};

const BrowserAssert=(()=>{

// Narrow assertion adapter for the course's public cases; not a general test framework.
function failure(actual,expected,message) {
  const error=new Error(message??`Expected ${JSON.stringify(expected)}, observed ${JSON.stringify(actual)}`);
  error.code='ERR_ASSERTION';error.actual=actual;error.expected=expected;throw error;
}
function equivalent(a,b) {
  if(Object.is(a,b))return true;
  if(!a||!b||typeof a!=='object'||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(a)!==Array.isArray(b))return false;
  const keys=Object.keys(a),other=Object.keys(b);
  return keys.length===other.length&&keys.every(k=>Object.hasOwn(b,k)&&equivalent(a[k],b[k]));
}
const assert={
  equal:(a,b,message)=>{if(!Object.is(a,b))failure(a,b,message);},
  notEqual:(a,b,message)=>{if(Object.is(a,b))failure(a,`different from ${b}`,message);},
  ok:(value,message)=>{if(!value)failure(value,true,message);},
  deepEqual:(a,b,message)=>{if(!equivalent(a,b))failure(a,b,message);},
};

return {assert};
})();
const BrowserNetwork=(()=>{
const {freshKey,destroyKey,requireThat,LabError,utf8,toBase64,fromBase64}=BrowserCrypto;
// Supplied in-process harness. There are no sockets, DNS calls or external relays.
const randomUUID=()=>globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();

const directory = () => ['cedar', 'birch', 'maple', 'elm', 'ash'].map(id => ({ id, online: true }));
const sampleRequest = () => ({ operation: 'lookup', item: 'luna' });
const catalog = { luna: 'Luna: a fictional lunar atlas', tide: 'Tide: a fictional ocean atlas' };

function establish(path, relays = directory()) {
  requireThat(path.length >= 2 && new Set(path).size === path.length, 'BAD_PATH');
  requireThat(path.every(id => relays.some(r => r.id === id && r.online)), 'BAD_PATH');
  const circuitId = randomUUID();
  const hops = path.map(relayId => ({ circuitId, relayId, forwardKey: freshKey(), backwardKey: freshKey() }));
  // Omniscient setup is deliberately supplied. It is NOT a handshake or Tor telescoping.
  const states = hops.map((hop, i) => ({ ...hop, previous: path[i - 1] ?? 'client',
    next: path[i + 1] ?? 'archive', seenForward: new Set() }));
  return { id: circuitId, path: [...path], hops, states, nextSeq: 0, received: new Set(), closed: false, trace: [] };
}
function closeCircuit(circuit) {
  circuit.closed = true;
  for (const hop of circuit.hops) { destroyKey(hop.forwardKey); destroyKey(hop.backwardKey); }
}
const bytes = packet => utf8(JSON.stringify(packet)).length;

async function deliverForward(implementation, circuit, packet, { failAt = null, modifyAt = null, dropAt = null, onReceive = () => {} } = {}) {
  requireThat(!circuit.closed, 'CIRCUIT_CLOSED');
  let body = packet;
  for (const state of circuit.states) {
    if (state.relayId === failAt) throw new LabError('RELAY_DOWN', state.relayId);
    if (state.relayId === dropAt) throw new LabError('FORWARD_LOST', state.relayId);
    if (state.relayId === modifyAt) body = tamper(body);
    const size = bytes(body);
    onReceive({observer:state.relayId,previous:state.previous,seq:body.seq,bytes:size,phase:'received'});
    let layer;
    try { layer = await implementation.peelForward(state, body); }
    catch(error) { onReceive({observer:state.relayId,phase:'rejected',code:error.code??error.name}); throw error; }
    circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'forward', observer: state.relayId, previous: state.previous,
      next: layer.next, seq: body.seq, bytes: size, payload: layer.next === 'archive' ? layer.body : '[encrypted inner packet]' });
    body = layer.body;
  }
  return body;
}
async function deliverBackward(implementation, circuit, reply, seq) {
  let packet = reply;
  for (let i = circuit.hops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const hop = circuit.hops[i];
    packet = await implementation.addReturnLayer(hop, packet, seq);
    circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'backward', observer: hop.relayId,
      previous: circuit.path[i + 1] ?? 'archive', next: circuit.path[i - 1] ?? 'client', seq, bytes: bytes(packet),
      payload: i === circuit.hops.length - 1 ? reply : '[encrypted inner packet]' });
  }
  return packet;
}
function archive(request) {
  requireThat(request?.operation === 'lookup' && Object.hasOwn(catalog, request.item), 'BAD_REQUEST');
  return { item: request.item, record: catalog[request.item] };
}
async function exchange(implementation, circuit, request = sampleRequest(), fault = {}) {
  requireThat(!circuit.closed, 'CIRCUIT_CLOSED');
  const seq = circuit.nextSeq++;
  requireThat(seq < 1024, 'REBUILD_REQUIRED');
  const packet = await implementation.wrapRequest(circuit.hops, request, seq);
  const arrived = await deliverForward(implementation, circuit, packet, fault);
  const reply = archive(arrived);
  circuit.trace.push({ direction: 'endpoint', observer: 'archive', previous: circuit.path.at(-1), payload: arrived });
  if (fault.dropReply) throw new LabError('REPLY_LOST', 'Archive received the lookup; client did not receive its reply.');
  const response = await deliverBackward(implementation, circuit, reply, seq);
  // The caller's request sequence is the expected identity at EVERY return layer.
  // Do not replace seq with a value read from an incoming packet.
  const unwrapped = await implementation.unwrapReply(circuit.hops, response, seq);
  // Client replay tracking is supplied; M4 applies the same rule to relay state.
  requireThat(!circuit.received.has(seq), 'REPLAY');
  circuit.received.add(seq);
  return unwrapped;
}
function tamper(packet) {
  const altered = structuredClone(packet);
  const bytes = fromBase64(altered.ciphertext);
  requireThat(bytes.length > 0, 'BAD_PACKET');
  bytes[0] ^= 1;
  altered.ciphertext = toBase64(bytes);
  return altered;
}
async function recover(implementation, oldCircuit, relays, failedIds) {
  closeCircuit(oldCircuit);
  const plan = await implementation.recoveryPlan(relays, failedIds, oldCircuit.path);
  if (plan.action === 'stop') return { plan, circuit: null };
  requireThat(plan.action === 'rebuild', 'BAD_PLAN');
  requireThat(!plan.path.some(id => failedIds.includes(id)), 'BAD_PLAN');
  return { plan, circuit: establish(plan.path, relays) };
}
function views(circuit) {
  // A pedagogical projection, NOT isolation from the local process operator.
  return Object.fromEntries([...circuit.path, 'archive'].map(id =>
    [id, circuit.trace.filter(event => event.observer === id)]));
}

return {directory,sampleRequest,establish,closeCircuit,deliverForward,deliverBackward,archive,exchange,tamper,recover,views};
})();

    assert.deepEqual(await impl.unwrapReply(b.hops,independent,9),separate);
    assert.deepEqual(await impl.unwrapReply(a.hops,p2,2),early,
      'Unwrap is stateless: replay acceptance remains the receiver\'s separate responsibility.');
    await errorCode(async ()=>await impl.unwrapReply(b.hops,p9,9),'AUTH_FAILED');
  });
add('M3-wrong-route', 3, 'Reject an authenticated instruction that disagrees with local successor state.', { next:'ash', expected:'birch' }, async impl => {
  const c = circuit(); const s = c.states[0];
  const packet = await seal(s.forwardKey,context(c.id,s.relayId,'forward',6),{next:'ash',body:{}});
  await errorCode(async () => await impl.peelForward(s,packet),'BAD_ROUTE');
});
add('M3-missing-body', 3, 'Reject an authenticated matching route without a body before consuming its sequence.', { missing:'body' }, async impl => {
  const c=circuit(), s=c.states[0];
  const packet=await seal(s.forwardKey,context(c.id,s.relayId,'forward',10),{next:s.next});
  await errorCode(async ()=>await impl.peelForward(s,packet),'BAD_ROUTE');
  assert.equal(s.seenForward.size,0,'Rejected payload must not consume the sequence.');
});
add('M3-end-to-end', 3, 'Use the learner functions for the entire request and return.', { item:'luna' }, async impl => {
  const c=circuit(); assert.deepEqual(await exchange(impl,c),{item:'luna',record:'Luna: a fictional lunar atlas'});
  const v = views(c);
  assert.equal(v.cedar[0].payload,'[encrypted inner packet]');
  assert.equal(v.birch[0].payload,'[encrypted inner packet]');
  assert.deepEqual(v.maple[0].payload,sampleRequest());
  assert.equal(v.archive[0].previous,'maple');

add('M4-replay', 4, 'A relay must reject a repeated valid packet on the same circuit.', { repeatSeq:0 }, async impl => {
  const c=circuit(); const packet=await impl.wrapRequest(c.hops,sampleRequest(),0);

add('M4-circuit-separation', 4, 'A packet from another circuit must fail without poisoning this circuit.', { reusedSeq:0 }, async impl => {

add('M5-rebuild', 5, 'Replace a broken circuit with distinct available relays and fresh circuit identity.', { failed:['birch'] }, async impl => {
