```mjs
    requirement: 'steppers(keyFn) returns { code, delta, value, bound, store } for each store under a key-code test that writes a value plus or minus 1 and is guarded by a comparison with a constant; value is the compared expression (decoded), so on Lob II, where the power store is just the stored word plus 1, it is still the decoded power.',
    reread: `${L}, recognising shapes`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const steppers = await fn('flight.mjs', 'steppers');
      const evaluate = await fn('lift.mjs', 'evaluate');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 0], ['lob', 6]]) {
        const { key, host, truth } = await lifted(fn, game, mode, 3);
        const s = steppers(key);
        expectSame((s ?? []).map((x) => [x.code, x.delta]).sort(), [[1, -1], [2, 1], [3, 1], [4, -1]], { checked: `steppers on ${game}'s game_key`, what: '[code, delta] pairs, sorted' });
        host.press('ArrowRight'); host.press('ArrowUp');
        const now = (code) => evaluate(s.find((x) => x.code === code).value, liveEnv(host));
        if (!(Math.abs(now(2) - truth.angle()) < 1e-6) || now(3) !== truth.power()) fail({ checked: `the steppers' values evaluated on live memory (${game}, build ${mode})`, observed: `angle ${now(2)}, power ${now(3)}`, expected: `angle ${truth.angle()}, power ${truth.power()}: the value is the number as the game sees it` });
        const bounds = s.map((x) => [x.code, x.bound]).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map((x) => x[1]);
        expectSame(bounds, [5, 85, 99, 11], { checked: `the bounds of ${game}'s steppers, by key code`, what: 'bounds' });
      }
      // A build may store power + 1 as just the stored word plus 1: the value is the bound test's.
      const make = await fn('lift.mjs', 'make');
      const k = (v) => make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: v });
      const ld = (off) => make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: k(5000), offset: off });
      const decoded = make({ op: 'i32.sub', args: [ld(4), ld(8)] });
      // Its guard first says the key is not 1 (param0 != 1 holds), then that it is 3.
      const P0 = make({ op: 'param', index: 0 });
      const made = { stores: [{ addr: k(5000), offset: 4, type: 'i32.store', value: make({ op: 'i32.add', args: [ld(4), k(1)] }), guard: [{ cond: make({ op: 'i32.ne', args: [P0, k(1)] }), holds: true }, { cond: make({ op: 'i32.ne', args: [P0, k(3)] }), holds: false }, { cond: make({ op: 'i32.gt_s', args: [decoded, k(99)] }), holds: false }], at: 0 }], returns: [], calls: [] };
      const got = steppers(made);
      if (got?.length !== 1 || got[0].code !== 3 || got[0].delta !== 1 || got[0].value !== decoded || got[0].bound !== 99) fail({ checked: 'steppers on a made-up store of word + 1, guarded by "key is not 1", "key is 3" and the decoded value, the word at +4 less the word at +8, above 99 not holding', observed: show(got?.map((x) => ({ code: x.code, delta: x.delta, bound: x.bound, valueIsBoundTest: x.value === decoded }))), expected: '[{ code: 3, delta: 1, bound: 99, value: the expression the bound test compares }]' });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-decoding', title: 'decoding tells how a value is stored: plain, XOR with a key, or a key added',
    requirement: 'decoding(value, rawKey) returns { raw, key, op, float }: op is plain, xor or add; raw is the load of the stored word (told from the key by its place, rawKey); decoder(d, raw) builds the same decoding for another word; encode(m, d, value) gives the word the game would store.',
    reread: `${L}, recognising shapes`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const steppers = await fn('flight.mjs', 'steppers');
      const decoding = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoding');
      const decoder = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoder');
      const placeKey = await fn('lift.mjs', 'placeKey');
      const evaluate = await fn('lift.mjs', 'evaluate');
      const make = await fn('lift.mjs', 'make');
      const want = { lob: 'xor' };
      for (const game of ['lob']) {
        const { key, host, truth } = await lifted(fn, game, 6, 4);
        const a = steppers(key).find((x) => x.code === 2);
        const d = decoding(a.value, placeKey(a.store.addr, a.store.offset));
        if (d?.op !== want[game] || d.float !== true || placeKey(d.raw?.addr, d.raw?.offset) !== placeKey(a.store.addr, a.store.offset)) fail({ checked: `decoding of ${game}'s angle`, observed: show(d && { op: d.op, float: d.float, raw: where(d.raw?.addr, d.raw?.offset), key: d.key && where(d.key.addr, d.key.offset) }), expected: `op ${want[game]}, float true, raw the word the stepper stores to (${storeAt(a.store)})` });
        const p = steppers(key).find((x) => x.code === 3);
        const dp = decoding(p.value, placeKey(p.store.addr, p.store.offset));
        const rebuilt = decoder(d.float ? { ...d, float: false } : d, dp.raw);
        if (evaluate(rebuilt, liveEnv(host)) !== truth.power()) fail({ checked: `decoder rebuilding ${game}'s power from the angle's decoding`, observed: show(evaluate(rebuilt, liveEnv(host))), expected: `${truth.power()}` });
      }
      const word = make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: 400 }), offset: 0 });
      const plain = decoding(make({ op: 'f32.reinterpret_i32', args: [word] }), 'x');
      if (plain?.op !== 'plain' || plain.raw !== word || plain.key !== null) fail({ checked: 'decoding of a value stored as it is', observed: show(plain && { op: plain.op, key: plain.key }), expected: '{ op: "plain", raw: the load, key: null }' });
      const keyWord = make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: 400 }), offset: 8 });
      // An XOR whose key was made first, so it may come first among the operands: the
      // raw word is the one at the place the stepper stores to.
      const keyFirst = make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: 600 }), offset: 0 });
      const rawSecond = make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: 600 }), offset: 12 });
      const xored = decoding(make({ op: 'i32.xor', args: [rawSecond, keyFirst] }), placeKey(rawSecond.addr, rawSecond.offset));
      if (xored?.op !== 'xor' || xored.raw !== rawSecond || xored.key !== keyFirst || xored.float !== false) fail({ checked: 'decoding of a whole number XORed with a key, raw word at offset 12 of [600]', observed: show(xored && { op: xored.op, float: xored.float, raw: where(xored.raw?.addr, xored.raw?.offset), key: where(xored.key?.addr, xored.key?.offset) }), expected: '{ op: "xor", float: false, raw: [600]+12, key: [600]+0 }: rawKey names the stored word' });
      const added = decoding(make({ op: 'f32.reinterpret_i32', args: [make({ op: 'i32.sub', args: [word, keyWord] })] }), placeKey(word.addr, word.offset));
      if (added?.op !== 'add' || added.raw !== word || added.key !== keyWord || added.float !== true) fail({ checked: 'decoding of a float stored with a key added (word - key, read as a float)', observed: show(added && { op: added.op, float: added.float, rawIsWord: added.raw === word, keyIsKey: added.key === keyWord }), expected: '{ op: "add", float: true, raw: the word, key: the key }' });
      // encode is decoding run backwards: the word the game would store for a value.
      const encode = await fn('flight.mjs', 'encode');
      const overlay = await fn('lift.mjs', 'overlay');
      const mem = new Uint8Array(1024);
      new DataView(mem.buffer).setInt32(408, 1000, true);
      const scratch = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(4));
      scratch.setFloat32(0, 45, true);
      const bits45 = scratch.getInt32(0, true);
      const words = [encode(overlay(mem), { ...added, float: false }, 60), encode(overlay(mem), added, 45), encode(overlay(mem), { op: 'xor', raw: word, key: keyWord, float: false }, 60), encode(overlay(mem), { op: 'plain', raw: word, key: null, float: false }, 60)];
      expectSame(words, [1060, (bits45 + 1000) | 0, 60 ^ 1000, 60], { checked: 'encode with the key word 1000: 60 added, 45.0 added as a float, 60 XORed, 60 plain', what: 'words' });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-launch', title: 'the launch: the stores the fire key makes, found by their sin and cos',
    requirement: 'launchOf(keyFn) returns { code, stores, trig, fields, flying, flyingStore }: code is the key code of the stores that use sin or cos, stores every store under that code, trig those four, fields their place keys, and flyingStore the store of 1 made with them. aimValues(keyFn, launch) gives the angle (the stepped value inside sin and cos) and the power.',
    reread: `${L}, recognising shapes`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const launchOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'launchOf');
      const aimValues = await fn('flight.mjs', 'aimValues');
      const evaluate = await fn('lift.mjs', 'evaluate');
      const { key } = await lifted(fn, 'lob');
      const l = launchOf(key);
      if (l?.code !== 5 || l.trig?.length !== 4 || l.stores?.length !== 9) fail({ checked: 'launchOf on Lob', observed: show(l && { code: l.code, trig: l.trig?.length, stores: l.stores?.length }), expected: '{ code: 5, trig: 4 stores, stores: 9 }' });
      expectSame(l.trig.map(storeAt).sort(), ['*[78112]+40', '*[78112]+44', '*[78112]+48', '*[78112]+52'], { checked: 'the places the launch\'s sin and cos stores write', what: 'places' });
      if (storeAt(l.flyingStore ?? {}) !== '*[78112]+36') fail({ checked: 'the flying flag', observed: storeAt(l.flyingStore ?? {}), expected: '*[78112]+36, set to 1 with the launch' });
      const g2 = await lifted(fn, 'lob', 6, 2);
      const l2 = launchOf(g2.key);
      const aim = aimValues(g2.key, l2);
      g2.host.press('ArrowRight');
      if (!aim || !(Math.abs(evaluate(aim.angle.value, liveEnv(g2.host)) - g2.truth.angle()) < 1e-6) || evaluate(aim.power.value, liveEnv(g2.host)) !== g2.truth.power()) fail({ checked: 'aimValues on Lob build 6 (values scrambled), evaluated on live memory', observed: aim ? `angle ${evaluate(aim.angle.value, liveEnv(g2.host))}, power ${evaluate(aim.power.value, liveEnv(g2.host))}` : show(aim), expected: `angle ${g2.truth.angle()}, power ${g2.truth.power()}` });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-flight', title: 'the flight: six stores of game_tick, the landing, and the wind',
    requirement: 'flightOf(tickFn, launch) returns { stores, landing, landingKey, wind }: the slice for the launch\'s fields and the flying flag, plus the landing (the float store made under the same guard as the flag\'s reset); wind is what the sideways speed gains each frame, before the constant.',
    reread: `${L}, recognising shapes`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const launchOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'launchOf');
      const flightOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'flightOf');
      const evaluate = await fn('lift.mjs', 'evaluate');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 0], ['lob', 6]]) {
        const { key, tick, host, truth } = await lifted(fn, game, mode, 6);
        const f = flightOf(tick, launchOf(key));
        if (f?.stores?.length !== 6 || !f.landing) fail({ checked: `flightOf on ${game}`, observed: show(f && { stores: f.stores?.length, landing: f.landing && storeAt(f.landing) }), expected: '6 stores, the last being the landing' });
        setBarrel(host, truth, 45, 60);
        fireReal(host, truth);
        const m = host.memory(), dv = new DataView(m.buffer, m.byteOffset);
        const base = evaluate(f.landing.addr, liveEnv(host));
        const landed = dv.getFloat32(base + f.landing.offset, true);
        if (!(Math.abs(landed - truth.impactX()) < 1e-4)) fail({ checked: `the landing's place on ${game}, read after a real shot`, observed: `${landed}`, expected: `${truth.impactX()}, where the shell landed` });
        const line = truth.line().match(/WIND ([-+][\d.]+)/);
        const w = evaluate(f.wind, liveEnv(host));
        if (!line || !(Math.abs(w - Number(line[1])) <= 0.051)) fail({ checked: `the wind expression on ${game}, evaluated on live memory`, observed: show(w), expected: `within 0.05 of the status line's ${line?.[1]}` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-simulate', title: 'the simulator lands where the game lands, after the same number of frames',
    requirement: 'simulator(launch, aim, flight) returns simulate(bytes, { angle, power, wind }): on a copy of memory it stores the barrel the way the game stores it, runs the launch, then the flight a frame at a time until the flying flag is reset, and returns { x, frames }. With no wind given it uses the wind in memory. It writes nothing to the game.',
    reread: `${L}, the simulator`,
    timeLimitMs: 20000,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const launchOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'launchOf');
      const aimValues = await fn('flight.mjs', 'aimValues');
      const flightOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'flightOf');
      const simulator = await fn('flight.mjs', 'simulator');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 0], ['lob', 7], ['lob', 14]]) {
        const { key, tick, host, truth } = await lifted(fn, game, mode, 12);
        const launch = launchOf(key), simulate = simulator(launch, aimValues(key, launch), flightOf(tick, launch));
        for (const [angle, power] of [[30, 70], [62, 88], [17, 45], [80, 100]]) {
          host.press('KeyN'); host.tick(2);
          setBarrel(host, truth, 45, 60);
          const before = host.memory().slice();
          const wind = mode & 1 ? truth.serverWind() : undefined;
          const s = simulate(host.memory(), { angle, power, wind });
          if (!before.every((b, i) => b === host.memory()[i])) fail({ checked: 'what simulate wrote to the game', observed: 'the game\'s memory changed', expected: 'nothing: writes go to the copy' });
          setBarrel(host, truth, angle, power);
          const real = fireReal(host, truth);
          if (!s || s.x !== real.x || s.frames !== real.frames) fail({ checked: `simulate on ${game}, build ${mode}, at angle ${angle}, power ${power}${wind !== undefined ? `, with the server's wind ${wind.toFixed(3)} given` : ''}`, input: 'simulated with the barrel at 45 and 60, a setting the game was not set to', observed: show(s), expected: `{ x: ${real.x}, frames: ${real.frames} }, exactly` });
        }
      }
      // The wind given is the wind the flight uses, even on a build that keeps it in memory.
      {
        const { key, tick, host, truth } = await lifted(fn, 'lob', 0, 15);
        const launch = launchOf(key), simulate = simulator(launch, aimValues(key, launch), flightOf(tick, launch));
        const bytes = host.memory().slice();
        new DataView(bytes.buffer).setFloat32(truth.stateBase() + 8, 3.25, true);
        const given = simulate(host.memory(), { angle: 40, power: 80, wind: 3.25 }), stored = simulate(bytes, { angle: 40, power: 80 });
        if (!given || !stored || given.x !== stored.x || given.frames !== stored.frames) fail({ checked: 'simulate with wind 3.25 given, against simulate on memory that holds wind 3.25', input: 'Lob build 0, where the wind is kept in memory', observed: `${show(given)} with the wind given, ${show(stored)} with it in memory`, expected: 'the same landing: the wind given replaces the one in memory' });
      }
      // A struct can be reached through more than one pointer: resolve follows them all.
      const resolve = await fn('flight.mjs', 'resolve');
      const overlay = await fn('lift.mjs', 'overlay');
      const make = await fn('lift.mjs', 'make');
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(256), dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
      dv.setInt32(16, 64, true); dv.setInt32(68, 128, true);
      const chain = make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'load', type: 'i32.load', addr: make({ op: 'const', type: 'i32', value: 0 }), offset: 16 }), offset: 4 });
      const got = resolve(overlay(bytes), chain);
      if (got !== 128) fail({ checked: 'resolve on a pointer chain: [16] holds 64, and [64 + 4] holds 128', observed: show(got), expected: '128: follow every pointer the address goes through' });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-physics', title: 'learnPhysics confirms the physics with check shots, and refutes it when it is wrong',
    requirement: 'learnPhysics fires 3 check shots, each simulated from memory just before it leaves, and installs kit.physics = { game, says } only if every one lands within a pace of its simulation after the same number of frames. When the code read is not the game being played (a file with another gravity), the check shots disagree and kit.physics is null.',
    reread: `${L}, every finding is a hypothesis`,
    timeLimitMs: 30000,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const learnPhysics = await fn('engine.mjs', 'learnPhysics');
      const findValues = await fn('find.mjs', 'findValues');
      const setup = async (game, seed, bytes = null) => {
        const ref = referee({ game, mode: 0, seed });
        const host = bytes ? { ...ref.host, binary: () => bytes.slice() } : ref.host;
        const f = await findValues(ref.host, CONTROLS);
        const kit = { game: gameIdOf(game), controls: { ...CONTROLS }, statusLine: f.statusLine, message: f.message, found: f };
        return { ref, host, kit };
      };
      const ok = await setup('lob', 31);
      await learnPhysics(ok.host, ok.kit, envWith(ruleFor({ heuristic: () => 0 })));
      const fired = ok.ref.seen.shots;
      if (!ok.kit.physics || ok.kit.physics.game !== gameIdOf('lob') || typeof ok.kit.physics.says !== 'string') fail({ checked: 'kit.physics after learnPhysics on Lob', observed: show(ok.kit.physics), expected: '{ game: the gameId, says: what the code says about a shot, in words }' });
      if (fired < 3 || fired > 6) fail({ checked: 'check shots fired', observed: `${fired}`, expected: '3, and one more for each that hits (a hit gives no distance)' });
      // Lob played, but the file shown has the per-frame gravity step changed from
      // -5.00000048 to -6: the physics read is not this game's.
      const patched = gameBytes('lob').slice();
      const at = patched.findIndex((b, i) => b === 0x43 && patched[i + 1] === 0x01 && patched[i + 2] === 0x00 && patched[i + 3] === 0xa0 && patched[i + 4] === 0xc0);
      new DataView(patched.buffer).setFloat32(at + 1, -6, true);
      const wrong = await setup('lob', 31, patched);
      await learnPhysics(wrong.host, wrong.kit, envWith(ruleFor({ heuristic: () => 0 })));
      if (wrong.kit.physics) fail({ checked: 'kit.physics when the file read has another gravity than the game played', observed: show(wrong.kit.physics), expected: 'null: the check shots land far from that file\'s simulation' });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '05-level-2', title: 'level 2 passes within its budget',
    requirement: 'From the kit level 1 leaves, playLevel passes level 2 (9 of the last 10 shots within 3 paces) without going over 24 rounds and 16 shots.',
    reread: `${L}, level 2`,
    timeLimitMs: 60000,
    async run({ load }) {
      const engine = await load('engine.mjs');
      const kit = await kitBy(engine, 1);
      const r = await playOn(engine, 2, kit, ruleFor(engine));
      if (!r.pass) fail({ checked: 'level 2 from the kit level 1 left', observed: sayScore(r), expected: '9 of the last 10 shots within 3 paces, within the budget' });
      if (!kit.physics) fail({ checked: 'the kit after level 2', observed: 'no physics in it', expected: 'kit.physics: a fit is not exact enough for a target 3 paces wide' });
    },
  },
];

```

`courses/sightline/checks/06.mjs`:

```mjs
import { fail, expectSame, show, CONTROLS, observed, envWith, gameIdOf, playOn, sayScore, ruleFor, menusOf, kitBy, scripted, first, levelNo } from './harness.mjs';
import { makeGame } from '../host.mjs';
import { referee } from '../levels.mjs';

export const title = 'The game fights back';
const L = 'lesson 06';

function liveEnv(host) {
  const bytes = host.memory();
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const load = (type, a) => (a < 0 || a + 4 > bytes.byteLength ? null : type === 'i32.load' ? view.getInt32(a, true) : type === 'f32.load' ? view.getFloat32(a, true) : type === 'i32.load8_u' ? bytes[a] : null);
  return { load, call: () => null, memo: new Map() };
}

// The passes, run with your own functions, on one game.
async function passes(fn, game, mode, seed) {
  const parseModule = await fn('wasm.mjs', 'parseModule'), liftAll = await fn('lift.mjs', 'liftAll'), placeKey = await fn('lift.mjs', 'placeKey');
  const launchOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'launchOf'), aimValues = await fn('flight.mjs', 'aimValues'), flightOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'flightOf'), decoding = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoding');
  const g = makeGame({ game, mode, seed });
  const all = liftAll(parseModule(g.host.binary()));
  const key = all.get('game_key'), tick = all.get('game_tick');
  const launch = launchOf(key), aim = aimValues(key, launch), flight = flightOf(tick, launch);
  const d = decoding(aim.angle.value, placeKey(aim.angle.raw.addr, aim.angle.raw.offset));
  return { ...g, key, tick, launch, aim, flight, d };
}

// A state read from the game itself, for checkReader's tests.
const truthState = (truth, change = {}) => () => {
  const level = truth.windLevel();
  const line = truth.line().match(/WIND ([-+][\d.]+)/);
  return { angle: truth.angle(), power: truth.power(), wind: line ? Number(line[1]) : null, wind_arrows: line ? null : level, target_x: truth.targetX(), ...change };
};

// The kit levels 1 and 2 leave when every menu is answered with option 0: the
// controls, addresses from a search, a fit and the physics.
async function searchedKit(engine) {
  const kit = {};
  for (const n of [1, 2]) {
    const r = await playOn(engine, n, kit, first);
    if (!r.pass) fail({ checked: `the kit levels 1 and 2 leave with option 0 on every menu, which this check starts from`, input: `level ${n}`, observed: sayScore(r), expected: `level ${n} passed` });
  }
  if (!kit.found) fail({ checked: 'the kit levels 1 and 2 leave with option 0 on every menu', observed: `it holds ${Object.keys(kit).join(', ')}`, expected: 'addresses found by a search (kit.found): with option 0 the search comes before reading the code' });
  return kit;
}

export const cases = [
  {
    id: '06-flag', title: 'flagOf finds the hit radius and where the flag is stored',
    requirement: 'flagOf(tickFn, flight, key) finds the value game_tick subtracts from the landing before comparing the distance with a constant: { value, radius, raws }, raws being loads of the places the flag may be stored at. On every build of Lob there is one, and decoded it is the flag.',
    reread: `${L}, the flag, by the hit test`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const flagOf = await fn('reader.mjs', 'flagOf');
      const decoder = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoder');
      const evaluate = await fn('lift.mjs', 'evaluate');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 0], ['lob', 14], ['lob', 6]]) {
        const p = await passes(fn, game, mode, 7);
        const f = flagOf(p.tick, p.flight, p.d.key);
        if (f?.radius !== 12 || f.raws?.length !== 1) fail({ checked: `flagOf on ${game}, build ${mode}`, observed: show(f && { radius: f.radius, raws: f.raws?.length }), expected: '{ radius: 12, raws: one place }' });
        p.host.tick(30);
        const x = evaluate(decoder({ ...p.d, float: true }, f.raws[0]), liveEnv(p.host));
        if (!(Math.abs(x - p.truth.targetX()) < 1e-4)) fail({ checked: `the flag decoded from the place flagOf found (${game}, build ${mode})`, observed: show(x), expected: `${p.truth.targetX()}` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '06-read-state', title: 'readState reads the game through what the code says',
    requirement: 'readerFrom(aim, flight, flagRaw) gives expressions for angle, power, wind and flag; readState(host, reader, lineAddr) evaluates them on live memory and returns { angle, power, wind, wind_arrows, target_x }. Where the code takes the wind from the server, wind is null and wind_arrows comes from the status line.',
    reread: `${L}, a reader from what the code says`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const flagOf = await fn('reader.mjs', 'flagOf'), readerFrom = await fn('reader.mjs', 'readerFrom'), readState = await fn('reader.mjs', 'readState');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 2], ['lob', 6], ['lob', 7], ['lob', 15]]) {
        const p = await passes(fn, game, mode, 9);
        const reader = readerFrom(p.aim, p.flight, flagOf(p.tick, p.flight, p.d.key).raws[0]);
        for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
          p.host.press('KeyN'); p.host.tick(2 + 5 * r); p.host.press('ArrowUp');
          const s = readState(p.host, reader, p.truth.lineAddr());
          const line = p.truth.line().match(/WIND ([-+][\d.]+)/);
          const windOk = mode & 1 ? s.wind === null && s.wind_arrows === p.truth.windLevel() : typeof s.wind === 'number' && Math.abs(s.wind - Number(line[1])) <= 0.051 && s.wind_arrows === null;
```

`courses/sightline/checks/07.mjs`:

```mjs
import { fail, expectSame, show, CONTROLS, observed, envWith, gameIdOf, playOn, sayScore, ruleFor, kitBy, scripted, levelNo } from './harness.mjs';
import { makeGame } from '../host.mjs';
import { referee } from '../levels.mjs';

export const title = 'Race the clock';
const L = 'lesson 07';

function liveEnv(host) {
  const bytes = host.memory();
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const load = (type, a) => (a < 0 || a + 4 > bytes.byteLength ? null : type === 'i32.load' ? view.getInt32(a, true) : type === 'f32.load' ? view.getFloat32(a, true) : type === 'i32.load8_u' ? bytes[a] : null);
  return { load, call: (name, args) => (name.endsWith('.sin') ? Math.sin(args[0]) : name.endsWith('.cos') ? Math.cos(args[0]) : null), memo: new Map() };
}

async function passes(fn, game, mode, seed) {
  const parseModule = await fn('wasm.mjs', 'parseModule'), liftAll = await fn('lift.mjs', 'liftAll'), placeKey = await fn('lift.mjs', 'placeKey');
  const launchOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'launchOf'), aimValues = await fn('flight.mjs', 'aimValues'), flightOf = await fn('flight.mjs', 'flightOf'), decoding = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoding'), decoder = await fn('flight.mjs', 'decoder');
  const flagOf = await fn('reader.mjs', 'flagOf');
  const g = makeGame({ game, mode, seed });
  const all = liftAll(parseModule(g.host.binary()));
  const key = all.get('game_key'), tick = all.get('game_tick');
  const launch = launchOf(key), aim = aimValues(key, launch), flight = flightOf(tick, launch);
  const d = decoding(aim.angle.value, placeKey(aim.angle.raw.addr, aim.angle.raw.offset));
  const raw = flagOf(tick, flight, d.key).raws[0];
  return { ...g, tick, raw, flag: decoder({ ...d, float: true }, raw) };
}

// A game and its twin: the twin replays every press and tick of the first, so a
// path for the next frames can be read off a copy run ahead. Course code only.
function twinned(game, mode, seed) {
  const g = makeGame({ game, mode, seed });
  const log = [];
  const host = { ...g.host, press: (k) => { log.push(['p', k]); g.host.press(k); }, tick: (n = 1) => { log.push(['t', n]); g.host.tick(n); } };
  const ahead = (frames) => {
    const t = makeGame({ game, mode, seed });
    for (const [kind, v] of log) (kind === 'p' ? t.host.press(v) : t.host.tick(v));
    const path = [t.truth.targetX()];
    for (let k = 0; k < frames; k++) { t.host.tick(1); path.push(t.truth.targetX()); }
    return path;
  };
  return { host, truth: g.truth, ahead };
}

export const cases = [
  {
    id: '07-mover', title: 'the flag\'s motion is the slice of game_tick that decides the flag\'s word',
    requirement: 'moverOf(tickFn, flagRaw) is slice(tickFn.stores, [the flag\'s place]): 6 stores on Lob (the flag, its speed twice, its timer twice, the random generator).',
    reread: `${L}, the flag's motion in the code`,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const moverOf = await fn('race.mjs', 'moverOf');
      for (const [game, want] of [['lob', 6]]) {
        const p = await passes(fn, game, 0, 3);
        const m = moverOf(p.tick, p.raw);
        if (!Array.isArray(m) || m.length !== want) fail({ checked: `moverOf on ${game}`, observed: show(Array.isArray(m) ? `${m.length} stores` : m, 80), expected: `${want} stores` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '07-path', title: 'flagPath predicts the flag frame by frame',
    requirement: 'flagPath(bytes, mover, flag, frames) runs the motion slice on a copy of memory a frame at a time and decodes the flag after each: frames + 1 entries, path[0] now. On Lob builds 14 and 15 (bounces and random speed changes) it matches the game to 0.05 paces for 300 frames.',
    reread: `${L}, the flag's motion in the code`,
    timeLimitMs: 20000,
    async run({ fn }) {
      const moverOf = await fn('race.mjs', 'moverOf');
      const flagPath = await fn('race.mjs', 'flagPath');
      for (const [game, mode] of [['lob', 14], ['lob', 15]]) {
        const p = await passes(fn, game, mode, 13);
        const mover = moverOf(p.tick, p.raw);
        for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
          p.host.press('KeyN'); p.host.tick(2 + 17 * r);
          const before = p.host.memory().slice();
          const path = flagPath(p.host.memory(), mover, p.flag, 300);
          if (!before.every((b, i) => b === p.host.memory()[i])) fail({ checked: 'what flagPath wrote to the game', observed: 'the game\'s memory changed', expected: 'nothing' });
          if (!Array.isArray(path) || path.length !== 301) fail({ checked: `flagPath for 300 frames (${game}, build ${mode})`, observed: show(Array.isArray(path) ? `${path.length} entries` : path, 80), expected: '301 entries' });
          for (let k = 0; k <= 300; k++) {
            if (k) p.host.tick(1);
            if (!(Math.abs(path[k] - p.truth.targetX()) <= 0.05)) fail({ checked: `flagPath on ${game}, build ${mode}, round ${r + 2}`, observed: `after ${k} frames it says ${show(path[k])}`, expected: `${p.truth.targetX().toFixed(3)}, where the flag was` });
          }
        }

A path that ignores the bounce is refuted, and so is one that gives null so early that fewer than 20 frames are predicted.',

      const ok = run((t, frames) => t.ahead(frames));

    requirement: 'When the model decides and answers "Wait and look again", playRounds lets the decider\'s frames pass, then looks and plans again before it asks again or fires. A model that always waits still gets one shot fired in each round once 600 frames have passed, from a plan made after its last wait, so those shots hit as level 6 asks.',
    reread: `${L}, fire or wait`,
    timeLimitMs: 240000,
    async run({ load }) {
      const engine = await load('engine.mjs');
      const kit = await kitBy(engine, 6);
      kit.decider = { who: 'model', frames: 9 };
      const ref = referee({ ...levelNo(6), seed: 66 });
      let frames = 0;
      const host = { ...ref.host, tick: (n = 1) => { frames += n; ref.host.tick(n); } };
      const asked = [];
      const picker = { calls: [], async decide(text, labels) { asked.push(frames); return { choice: labels[1]?.startsWith('Wait') && asked.length % 2 === 1 ? 1 : 0, ms: 150 }; } };
      await engine.playRounds(host, { ...levelNo(6), rounds: 3 }, kit, envWith(picker));
      const gaps = [];
      for (let i = 0; i + 1 < asked.length; i += 2) gaps.push(asked[i + 1] - asked[i]);
      if (!gaps.length || gaps.some((g) => g < 9)) fail({ checked: 'frames between a "wait" and the next question', observed: show(gaps), expected: 'at least 9 each time, the decider\'s frames' });

      // A model that answers "wait" every time, for ten rounds: each round's 600
      // frames run out right after a wait. The engine must read the game again after
      // that wait and fire the plan it makes then; a plan made before the wait aims
      // for a moment that has passed, and on a moving flag it misses.
      const ref2 = referee({ ...levelNo(6), seed: 67 });
      const events = [];
      const host2 = {
        ...ref2.host,
        tick: (n = 1) => { events.push(['tick', n]); ref2.host.tick(n); },
        memory: () => { events.push(['read']); return ref2.host.memory(); },
        press: (key) => { events.push(['press', key]); ref2.host.press(key); },
      };
      let streak = 0, longest = 0, shotsSeen = 0, tooLong = false;
      const waiter = {
        calls: [],
        async decide(text, labels) {
          if (ref2.seen.shots !== shotsSeen) { shotsSeen = ref2.seen.shots; streak = 0; }
          // Past 300 questions in one round the clock is missing: answer "Fire now"
          // from then on, so the check ends quickly and says so.
          const wait = !tooLong && labels[1]?.startsWith('Wait') && ++streak <= 300;
          longest = Math.max(longest, streak);
          if (streak > 300) tooLong = true;
          events.push(['answer', wait ? 1 : 0]);
          return { choice: wait ? 1 : 0, ms: 150 };
        },
      };
      // This model answers in 30 frames, half a second, so a round holds about 20 waits.
      const slow = { ...kit, decider: { who: 'model', frames: 30 } };
      await engine.playRounds(host2, { ...levelNo(6), rounds: 10 }, slow, envWith(waiter));
      const always = 'a model that answers "Wait and look again" every time, in 30 frames, for ten rounds of level 6';
      if (longest > 300) fail({ checked: always, observed: `the engine asked ${longest} times in one round and was still asking`, expected: 'it stops asking once 600 frames of the round have passed, and fires' });
      if (ref2.seen.shots !== 10) fail({ checked: always, observed: `${ref2.seen.shots} shots fired`, expected: '10, one a round: once 600 frames have passed the engine fires without asking' });
      // Until the first shot leaves, no more than the decider's 30 frames may pass
      // between two reads of the memory: a wait is followed by a look, and so is a
      // frame let pass because the plan wasn't ready.
      let since = 0, most = 0;
      for (const [kind, n] of events) {
        if (kind === 'press' && n === kit.controls.fire) break;
        if (kind === 'read') since = 0;
        if (kind === 'tick') { since += n; most = Math.max(most, since); }
      }
      if (most > 30) fail({ checked: `${always}: the most frames that passed between two reads of the game's memory before the first shot left`, observed: `${most} frames`, expected: 'at most 30, the decider\'s frames: after a wait, and after a frame let pass for a plan that wasn\'t ready, the engine looks again, also when the 600 frames have run out' });
      // And the shot must come from that look: fired from a plan made after the last
      // wait, the shots hit as they do when the model answers at once.
      const misses = ref2.shots.slice(-10).map((x) => x.miss);
      const hits = misses.filter((m) => m <= 12).length;
      if (hits < 9) fail({ checked: `${always}: the shots fired when the 600 frames ran out`, observed: `${hits} of 10 within 12 paces; misses ${misses.map((m) => m.toFixed(1)).join(', ')}`, expected: 'at least 9 of 10, as level 6 asks: each shot leaves from the plan made after the last wait, aimed for the frame it leaves, not from a plan made before the wait' });
    },
  },
  {
    id: '07-sweep', title: 'FRAME_BUDGET is what your own sweep gives',
    requirement: 'FRAME_BUDGET in race.mjs is the largest unplanned delay at which your sweep of level 6 still hit 9 of 10, less 1.',
    reread: `${L}, planned delay and surprise delay`,
    timeLimitMs: 90000,
    async run({ load }) {
      const engine = await load('engine.mjs');
      const race = await load('race.mjs');
      const kit = await kitBy(engine, 6);
      const level = levelNo(6);
      const rows = await engine.sweep(() => makeGame({ game: level.game, mode: level.mode, seed: level.seed }).host, level, kit, envWith(ruleFor(engine)), [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12]);
      const best = Math.max(...rows.filter((r) => r.unplanned >= 9).map((r) => r.latency));
      if (race.FRAME_BUDGET !== best - 1) fail({ checked: 'FRAME_BUDGET against your sweep of level 6', observed: `FRAME_BUDGET is ${race.FRAME_BUDGET}; your sweep: ${rows.map((r) => `${r.latency} frames late, ${r.unplanned} hits unplanned`).join('; ')}`, expected: `${best - 1}: the largest unplanned delay that still hit 9 of 10 (${best}), less the frame the plan already counts` });
    },
  },
  ...[6, 7].map((n) => ({
    id: `07-level-${n}`, title: `level ${n} passes within its budget`,
    requirement: `From the kit level ${n - 1} leaves, playLevel passes level ${n}, ${levelNo(n).name}, within ${levelNo(n).budget.rounds} rounds and ${levelNo(n).budget.shots} shots.`,
    reread: `${L}, levels 6 and 7`,
    timeLimitMs: 90000,
    async run({ load }) {
      const engine = await load('engine.mjs');
      const kit = await kitBy(engine, n - 1);
      const r = await playOn(engine, n, kit, ruleFor(engine));
      if (!r.pass) fail({ checked: `level ${n} from the kit level ${n - 1} left`, observed: sayScore(r), expected: `${levelNo(n).pass} of the last 10 shots within 12 paces, within the budget` });
    },
  })),
];
```

`courses/sightline/checks/08.mjs`:

```mjs
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fail, show, envWith, gameIdOf, playOn, sayScore, ruleFor, kitBy, first, levelNo, LEVELS } from './harness.mjs';
import { makeGame } from '../host.mjs';

export const title = 'A game you have never seen';
const L = 'lesson 08';

// Climb all ten levels from an empty kit with one picker; a level that is not
// passed does not stop the climb.
async function climbWith(engine, picker) {
  const kit = {}, rows = [];
  for (const level of LEVELS) rows.push(await playOn(engine, level.n, kit, picker));
  return rows;
}

// The text of a file with its comments taken out and the insides of its strings blanked,
// so a name in a comment or a log message is not mistaken for code.
function codeOnly(src) {
  let out = '', i = 0;
  while (i < src.length) {
    const c = src[i], d = src[i + 1];
    if (c === '/' && d === '/') { while (i < src.length && src[i] !== '\n') i++; continue; }
    if (c === '/' && d === '*') { const j = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2); i = j < 0 ? src.length : j + 2; out += ' '; continue; }
    if (c === "'" || c === '"') { let j = i + 1; while (j < src.length && src[j] !== c && src[j] !== '\n') j += src[j] === '\\' ? 2 : 1; out += c + c; i = j + 1; continue; }
    if (c === '`') {
      let j = i + 1; out += '`';
      while (j < src.length && src[j] !== '`') {
        if (src[j] === '\\') { j += 2; continue; }
        if (src[j] === '$' && src[j + 1] === '{') { let depth = 1, k = j + 2; while (k < src.length && depth) { if (src[k] === '{') depth++; else if (src[k] === '}') depth--; k++; } out += ' ' + src.slice(j + 2, k - 1) + ' '; j = k; continue; }
        j++;
      }
      out += '`'; i = j + 1; continue;
    }
    out += c; i++;
  }
  return out;
}

      const left = ['found', 'shots', 'fit', 'physics', 'reader', 'mover'].filter((k) => kit[k] && (kit[k].game === lob || k === 'found' || k === 'shots'));
```

`courses/sightline/checks/format.mjs`:

```mjs
// Turns check results into plain sentences for the terminal.

export const FINISH = `You built Sightline: one engine that reads a game's memory and screen, finds
where the game keeps its values, takes its compiled code apart, lifts it into
expressions and works out from them the physics, a reader for state that moves
and is scrambled, and the flag's motion. Nothing it found went into the kit until
a test against the game had confirmed it. Where more than one repair was worth
trying, a decision model could pick, on a budget of rounds and shots, and you
measured what its picks were worth against option 0, random picks and a rule of
your own. The same passes, tests and loop climbed Lob II, a game made
separately.

What you can do next: run "node lab.mjs measure ./work --pickers rule,first,live"
with a decision model on Ollama and compare its picks with your rule; change a
level's seed with --seed and see what still holds; or open one of the games in
Ghidra or another disassembler and use it to check your own passes.

This course works on the games it ships. It does not teach getting past anyone
else's protections.

The course's code work is complete.`;

function caseLines(r) {
  const lines = [`FAIL ${r.id}: ${r.title}`];
  if (r.kind === 'not-written') {
    const m = r.message.match(/not written yet:\s*(.*)$/);
    lines.push(`  Your ${m ? m[1] : 'function'} is not written yet: the starter's version is still in place.`);
    lines.push('  Next: write it, then run this check again.');
  } else if (r.kind === 'timeout') {
    lines.push(`  What was checked: ${r.requirement}`);
    lines.push(`  Observed: your code did not finish within ${r.limitMs / 1000} seconds, so the check stopped it.`);
    lines.push('  Expected: an answer well inside that limit (the course\'s own solution takes a small fraction of it).');
    lines.push('  Next: look for a loop that never ends, such as waiting for a shot that never lands or a search with no step limit.');
  } else if (r.kind === 'error') {
    lines.push(`  What was checked: ${r.requirement}`);
    lines.push(`  Observed: your code threw ${r.message}${r.where ? ` (in ${r.where})` : ''}.`);
    lines.push('  Expected: a result without an error.');
  } else {
    const f = r.fields;
    lines.push(`  What was checked: ${f.checked ?? r.requirement}`);
    if (f.input) lines.push(`  Input: ${f.input}`);
    lines.push(`  Observed: ${f.observed}`);
    if (f.expected) lines.push(`  Expected: ${f.expected}`);
    if (f.diff) lines.push(`  First difference: ${f.diff}`);
  }
  if (r.kind !== 'not-written' && r.reread) lines.push(`  Where it is taught: ${r.reread}`);
  return lines;
}

export function formatModule(report, { attemptPath, partial = false } = {}) {
  const rows = report.results;
  const passed = rows.filter(r => r.pass);
  const failed = rows.filter(r => !r.pass);
  const lines = [];
  const variant = report.variant ? ` (variant ${report.variant}: fresh random instances)` : '';
  if (failed.length === 0) {
    lines.push(partial ? `Module ${report.module}, ${report.title}: the ${rows.length} named check${rows.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} passed (${rows.map((r) => r.id).join(', ')}). The module's other checks were not run.` : `Module ${report.module}, ${report.title}${variant}: all ${rows.length} checks passed.`);
  } else {
    lines.push(`Module ${report.module}, ${report.title}${variant}: ${passed.length} of ${rows.length} checks passed, ${failed.length} failed.`);
    for (const r of failed) lines.push('', ...caseLines(r));
    if (passed.length) lines.push('', `Passed: ${passed.map(r => r.id).join(', ')}`);
  }
  if (attemptPath) lines.push(`This attempt is saved in ${attemptPath}. Add --json for the machine-readable record.`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function formatAll(reports, opts = {}) {
  const parts = reports.map(r => formatModule(r));
  const passing = reports.filter(r => r.pass).length;
  const summary = passing === reports.length
    ? `All ${reports.length} modules pass.\n\n${FINISH}`
    : `${passing} of ${reports.length} modules pass. Failing: ${reports.filter(r => !r.pass).map(r => r.module).join(', ')}.`;
  if (opts.attemptPath) parts.push(`This attempt is saved in ${opts.attemptPath}. Add --json for the machine-readable record.`);
  return parts.join('\n\n') + '\n\n' + summary;
}
```

`courses/sightline/checks/harness.mjs`:

```mjs
// Shared helpers for Sightline's module checks. A check either returns (pass) or throws a
// CheckFailure that says what was checked, the input, what was observed and what was required.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { LEVELS, referee, score } from '../levels.mjs';
import { scripted, random, first } from '../models.mjs';
import { makeGame as newGame, gameBytes } from '../host.mjs';

const courseRoot = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

export class CheckFailure extends Error {
  constructor(fields) {
    super(fields.observed ?? 'check failed');
    this.fields = fields;
  }
}

export function fail(fields) {
  throw new CheckFailure(fields);
}

export const NOT_WRITTEN = 'not written yet';

// Short, readable rendering of a value (never raw multi-line JSON).
export function show(value, limit = 240) {
  const text = render(value);
  return text.length > limit ? text.slice(0, limit - 3) + '...' : text;
}
function render(value) {
  if (value === undefined) return 'nothing (undefined)';
  if (value === null) return 'null';
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) value = Array.from(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return '[' + value.map(render).join(', ') + ']';
  if (typeof value === 'string') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    return '{ ' + Object.entries(value).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${render(v)}`).join(', ') + ' }';
  }
  return String(value);
}

export function same(a, b) {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(a)) a = Array.from(a);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(b)) b = Array.from(b);
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => same(x, b[i]));
  if (a && b && typeof a === 'object' && typeof b === 'object') {
    const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b);
    return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every(k => same(a[k], b[k]));
  }
  return Object.is(a, b) || (a === 0 && b === 0);
}

// Describe the first place two values differ, with its position.
export function firstDifference(observed, expected, path = '') {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(observed)) observed = Array.from(observed);
  if (Array.isArray(expected)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(observed)) return `${path || 'the value'} should be a list but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    const n = Math.min(observed.length, expected.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (!same(observed[i], expected[i])) return firstDifference(observed[i], expected[i], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}position ${i}`);
    }
    if (observed.length !== expected.length) {
      return `${path ? path + ': ' : ''}yours has ${observed.length} entries, the required value has ${expected.length}` +
        (observed.length > expected.length ? ` (first extra entry at position ${n}: ${show(observed[n], 60)})` : ` (first missing entry at position ${n}: ${show(expected[n], 60)})`);
    }
    return null;
  }
  if (expected && typeof expected === 'object') {
    if (!observed || typeof observed !== 'object') return `${path || 'the value'} should be an object but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    for (const k of Object.keys(expected)) {
      if (!same(observed[k], expected[k])) return firstDifference(observed[k], expected[k], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}field ${k}`);
    }
    return null;
  }
  return `at ${path || 'the value'}: yours is ${show(observed, 60)}, required ${show(expected, 60)}`;
}

export function expectSame(observed, expected, { checked, input, what = 'your result' }) {
  if (same(observed, expected)) return;
  fail({ checked, input, observed: `${what}: ${show(observed)}`, expected: show(expected), diff: firstDifference(observed, expected) });
}

// Run fn, expecting it to throw. A starter "not written yet" error is passed through.
export function thrown(fn) {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (error) {
    if (String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
    return error;
  }
  return null;
}

export function fixtureJson(name) {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, 'fixtures', name), 'utf8'));
}

// The controls the help text describes. Checks use them so each module can be
// checked on its own, whatever an earlier module did.
export const CONTROLS = Object.freeze({ angle_up: 'ArrowRight', angle_down: 'ArrowLeft', power_up: 'ArrowUp', power_down: 'ArrowDown', fire: 'Space', new_round: 'KeyN' });
export const LIMITS = Object.freeze({ angle_min: 5, angle_max: 85, power_min: 10, power_max: 100 });
export const near = (a, b, tol) => typeof a === 'number' && Math.abs(a - b) <= tol;

// Load learner modules from the work folder.
export function makeLoader(workDir) {
  const cache = new Map();
  async function load(file) {
    if (!cache.has(file)) {
      let mod;
      try {
        mod = await import(pathToFileURL(join(workDir, file)).href);
      } catch (error) {
        throw new CheckFailure({
          checked: `loading your ${file}`,
          observed: `${file} could not be loaded: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0].split(workDir).join('work')}`,
          expected: `${file} loads as an ES module (look for a syntax error or a misspelled import)`,
          loadError: true,
        });
      }
      cache.set(file, mod);
    }
    return cache.get(file);
  }
  async function fn(file, name) {
    const mod = await load(file);
    if (typeof mod[name] !== 'function') {
      fail({ checked: `${file} exports ${name}`, observed: `${file} has no exported function named ${name}`, expected: `export function ${name}(...) in ${file}` });
    }
    return mod[name];
  }
  return { load, fn };
}

// A host that counts what an engine did with it, so a check never has to take
// the engine's word for how many rounds it played or how many shots hit.
export function observed({ host, truth }) {
  const seen = { presses: {}, hits: 0, frames: 0, writes: 0 };
  let last = truth.message();
  const look = () => { const m = truth.message(); if (m !== last) { if (m.startsWith('HIT')) seen.hits++; last = m; } };
  return {
    seen,
    host: {
      binary: () => host.binary(),
      memory: () => host.memory(),
      write: (addr, type, value) => { seen.writes++; host.write(addr, type, value); },
      press: (key) => { seen.presses[key] = (seen.presses[key] ?? 0) + 1; host.press(key); look(); },
      tick: (frames = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) { host.tick(1); seen.frames++; look(); } },
      screen: () => host.screen(),
    },
  };
}

// ---------- the engine, the ladder and scripted pickers ----------

export { scripted, random, first, LEVELS };
export const levelNo = (n) => LEVELS[n - 1];

// What the lab hands your engine, with a log the check can read afterwards.
export function envWith(models) {
  const entries = [];
  return { models, log: (e) => { entries.push(e); }, entries };
}

// The gameId your engine.mjs works out with gameId(host), for one of the course's games.
export function gameIdOf(game) {
  const bytes = gameBytes(game);
  let sum = 0;
  for (const b of bytes) sum = (sum * 31 + b) >>> 0;
  return `${bytes.length}:${sum}`;
}

// A picker that answers repair menus with your own heuristic and every other menu
// with option 0, the way the lab's default does, and records what it was asked.
export function ruleFor(engine, { otherwise = () => 0 } = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  return {
    calls,
    async decide(text, labels, options) {
      const problem = options?.[0]?.problem;
      const choice = problem ? engine.heuristic(problem, options) : otherwise(text, labels);
      calls.push({ text, labels, choice, problem: problem ?? null, kinds: problem ? options.map((o) => o.kind) : null });
      return { choice, ms: 1, model: 'rule' };
    },
  };
}

// The repair menus a picker was shown: [{ part, kinds, choice }].
export const menusOf = (picker) => (picker.calls ?? []).filter((c) => c.problem || c.kinds).map((c) => ({ part: c.problem?.part, kinds: c.kinds ?? null, choice: c.choice, text: c.text }));

// Play level n with an engine on a host the referee watches. Returns the
// referee's score (with what the level used against its budget), what the picker
// was asked, and the engine's log.
export async function playOn(engine, n, kit, models, over = {}) {
  const level = { ...levelNo(n), ...over };
  const ref = referee(level);
  const env = envWith(models);
  let error = null;
  try { await engine.playLevel(ref.host, level, kit, env); } catch (e) { error = e; }
  if (error && String(error?.message ?? error).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
  return { ...score(level, ref.shots, ref.seen), error, ref, env, level, calls: models.calls ?? [] };
}

// A level's result in words, with what the engine did, so a failure says more than a score.
export function sayScore(r) {
  const tail = (r.env?.entries ?? []).slice(-4).map((e) => `[${e.rung}] ${e.step}: ${String(e.result).split('\n')[0].slice(0, 110)}`).join(' / ');
  const voided = (r.ref?.shots ?? []).filter((s) => s.written).length;
  const used = r.used ? `; it used ${r.used.rounds} of ${r.level.budget.rounds} rounds and ${r.used.shots} of ${r.level.budget.shots} shots` : '';
  return `${r.hits} of the last ${r.rounds} shots within ${r.level.radius} paces (${r.fired} shots landed in all${voided ? `, ${voided} of them not counted because memory was written during their round` : ''})${used}`
    + `${r.error ? `; the engine stopped with "${String(r.error.message).split('\n')[0]}"` : ''}`
    + `.${tail ? ` Its last logged steps: ${tail}` : ' It logged nothing.'}`;
}

// The kit a passed level leaves, made here by playing the levels before it with
// your engine and your heuristic. Each check that needs one builds it fresh.
export async function kitBy(engine, upTo) {
  const kit = {};
  for (let n = 1; n <= upTo; n++) {
    const r = await playOn(engine, n, kit, ruleFor(engine));
    if (!r.pass) fail({ checked: `the kit your engine builds on levels 1 to ${upTo}, which this check starts from`, input: `level ${n}, with your heuristic answering the menus`, observed: `level ${n} was not passed: ${sayScore(r)}`, expected: `level ${n} passed within its budget, as its own check requires` });
  }
  return kit;
}
```

`courses/sightline/checks/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs the cases of one module against a folder of learner files, one process per case.
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const MODULES = ['01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06', '07', '08'];
export const DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS = 8000;

// The lesson section that teaches each check, from lessons/sections.json.
export function sectionFor(id) {
  let map;
  try { map = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(here, '..', 'lessons', 'sections.json'), 'utf8')).checks; } catch { return null; }
  const m = map[id];
  return m ? `lesson ${m.lesson}, "${m.section}"` : null;
}

export async function listCases(module) {
  const { cases, title } = await import(`./${module}.mjs`);
  return { title, cases };
}

function runCase(workDir, module, c, variant) {
  const limit = c.timeLimitMs ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS;
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const child = fork(join(here, 'worker.mjs'), [], { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe', 'ipc'], execArgv: ['--max-old-space-size=512', '--stack-size=4000'] });
    let done = false;
    let stderr = '';
    child.stderr.on('data', d => { if (stderr.length < 2000) stderr += d; });
    const finish = r => {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      child.kill('SIGKILL');
      resolve(r);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'timeout', limitMs: limit }), limit);
    child.once('message', finish);
    child.once('error', e => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: e.message }));
    child.once('exit', (code, signal) => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `the check process ended early (exit code ${code}${signal ? ', signal ' + signal : ''})${stderr ? ': ' + stderr.trim().split('\n').slice(-1)[0] : ''}` }));
    child.send({ workDir, module, caseId: c.id, variant });
  });
}

export async function runModule(workDir, module, { variant = 0, only = null } = {}) {
  const { title, cases } = await listCases(module);
  const results = [];
  for (const c of cases) {
    if (only && !only.includes(c.id)) continue;
    const r = await runCase(workDir, module, c, variant);
    results.push({ ...r, title: c.title, reread: sectionFor(c.id) ?? c.reread, requirement: c.requirement });
  }
  return { module, title, variant, results, pass: results.every(r => r.pass) };
}
```

`courses/sightline/checks/worker.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs one check case in its own process so an endless loop can be stopped.
import { makeLoader, CheckFailure, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';
// Work files never run the game. host.mjs keeps its own reference to WebAssembly, taken when
// it loads; after that the global goes, so a work file that reaches for it finds nothing.
import '../host.mjs';
delete globalThis.WebAssembly;

function whereInWork(error, workDir) {
  const lines = String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n');
  for (const line of lines) {
    const i = line.indexOf(workDir);
    if (i >= 0) {
      const m = line.slice(i + workDir.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${m[1]} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

process.on('message', async ({ workDir, module, caseId, variant }) => {
  let result;
  try {
    const { cases } = await import(`./${module}.mjs`);
    const c = cases.find(x => x.id === caseId);
    const loader = makeLoader(workDir);
    await c.run({ ...loader, variant, workDir });
    result = { id: caseId, pass: true };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = String(error?.message ?? error);
    if (error instanceof CheckFailure) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'failure', fields: error.fields };
    else if (message.includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'not-written', message: message.split('\n')[0] };
    else result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${message.split('\n')[0]}`, where: whereInWork(error, workDir) };
  }
  process.send(result, () => process.exit(0));
});
```

`courses/sightline/host.mjs`:

```mjs
// The game, loaded in Node, and the only six calls an engine may make on it.
// Course code uses makeGame, which also returns the game's own view of itself
// (`truth`) so checks can compare your findings with what the game knows.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

// The game runs here and only here. This file keeps its own reference to WebAssembly,
// taken when it loads: the check worker removes the global before it loads any work file.
const WA = globalThis.WebAssembly;

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const KEYS = { ArrowLeft: 1, ArrowRight: 2, ArrowUp: 3, ArrowDown: 4, Space: 5, KeyN: 6 };
export const MODES = { normal: 0, server: 1, moving: 2, scrambled: 4, flag: 8 };
export const WIDTH = 960, HEIGHT = 540, GROUND = 500;

// The lab's recorder. "node lab.mjs watch" sets a tap to record every game made
// while it runs; nothing else uses it, and an engine never sees it.
let tap = null;
export function setTap(t) { tap = t; }

const bytesCache = new Map();
export function gameBytes(game = 'lob') {
  if (!bytesCache.has(game)) bytesCache.set(game, new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(here, 'game', `${game}.wasm`))));
  return bytesCache.get(game);
}

// Lob II names its drawing functions without saying what they draw.
const GETTERS = {
  lob: { target: 'r_target_x', angle: 'r_angle', power: 'r_power', line: 'r_line_ptr', msg: 'r_msg_ptr', flying: 'r_flying', impact: 'r_impact_x', level: 'r_wind_level' },
  lob2: { target: 'g3', angle: 'g0', power: 'g1', line: 'g6', msg: 'g7', flying: 'g4', impact: 'g5', level: 'g2' },
};

function xorshift(seed) {
  let x = (seed ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0 || 1;
  return () => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x / 4294967296; };
}

export function makeGame({ game = 'lob', mode = 0, seed = 1 } = {}) {
  const bytes = gameBytes(game);
  const rand = xorshift(seed);
  const server = { wind: 0 };
  const env = {
    sin: Math.sin, cos: Math.cos,
    server_wind: () => server.wind,
    server_round: () => { server.wind = -5 + rand() * 10; return Math.max(-3, Math.min(3, Math.round(server.wind / 1.5))); },
  };
  const { exports: x } = new WA.Instance(new WA.Module(bytes), { env });
  x.game_init(seed >>> 0, mode);
  const g = GETTERS[game];
  const view = () => new DataView(x.memory.buffer);
  const cstr = (ptr) => {
    const m = new Uint8Array(x.memory.buffer);
    let s = '';
    while (m[ptr] && s.length < 300) s += String.fromCharCode(m[ptr++]);
    return s;
  };
  let rec = null;
  const host = Object.freeze({
    binary: () => bytes.slice(),
    memory: () => { if (rec) tap.read?.(rec); return new Uint8Array(x.memory.buffer); },
    write(addr, type, value) {
      if (type === 'f32') view().setFloat32(addr, value, true);
      else if (type === 'i32') view().setInt32(addr, value, true);
      else throw new Error(`write needs type 'f32' or 'i32', not ${type}`);
      if (rec) tap.write?.(rec, addr);
    },
    press(key) {
      if (!(key in KEYS)) throw new Error(`unknown key ${key}; keys are ${Object.keys(KEYS).join(', ')}`);
      x.game_key(KEYS[key]);
      if (rec) tap.press?.(rec, key);
    },
    tick(frames = 1) { for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) { x.game_tick(); if (rec) tap.frame?.(rec); } },
    screen: () => render(x[g.target]()),
  });
  const truth = {
    exports: x,
    targetX: () => x[g.target](),
    angle: () => x[g.angle](),
    power: () => x[g.power](),
    flying: () => x[g.flying]() !== 0,
    impactX: () => x[g.impact](),
    windLevel: () => x[g.level](),
    serverWind: () => server.wind,
    line: () => cstr(x[g.line]()),
    message: () => cstr(x[g.msg]()),
    lineAddr: () => x[g.line](),
    msgAddr: () => x[g.msg](),
    // Lob only: where its state struct is now. Lob II keeps that to itself.
    stateBase: () => (game === 'lob' ? x.r_state() : null),
  };
  if (tap) rec = tap.start({ game, mode, seed, truth });
  return { host, truth };
}

export function makeHost(opts) {
  return makeGame(opts).host;
}

// A plain frame: sky, ground, and the flag. Only the flag's cloth is red.
function render(targetX) {
  const data = new Uint8ClampedArray(WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < HEIGHT; y++) {
    const [r, g, b] = y < GROUND ? [214, 235, 255] : [239, 231, 212];
    for (let x = 0; x < WIDTH; x++) {
      const i = (y * WIDTH + x) * 4;
      data[i] = r; data[i + 1] = g; data[i + 2] = b; data[i + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  const tx = Math.round(targetX);
  for (let y = GROUND - 48; y < GROUND; y++) paint(data, tx, y, [71, 85, 105]);
  for (let y = GROUND - 48; y < GROUND - 35; y++) for (let x = tx + 1; x <= tx + 20; x++) paint(data, x, y, [229, 72, 77]);
  return { width: WIDTH, height: HEIGHT, data };
}

function paint(data, x, y, [r, g, b]) {
  if (x < 0 || x >= WIDTH || y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return;
  const i = (y * WIDTH + x) * 4;
  data[i] = r; data[i + 1] = g; data[i + 2] = b;
}
```
