```mjs
  {
    id: '08.one-step',
    title: 'begin runs nothing; each step runs one instruction and returns its event',
    requirement: 'After begin(\'game_init\', [seed, mode]): running is true, state.calls is 1, state.tick is 0 and state.frames is [{ func: 4, at: 0, ... }]. Each step() returns { tick, func, at, op, writes } for the instruction named by the innermost frame\'s func and at, adds 1 to state.tick, and reports one write for a store and none otherwise. The first 300 instructions follow the listing\'s loop exactly, and game_init runs exactly as many instructions as the rules for branches give. step() is a method of the class, and invoke runs every instruction through it.',
    timeLimitMs: 20000,
    async run({ cls, workDir }) {
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      if (typeof Machine.prototype.step !== 'function') fail({ checked: 'step() is a method of your Machine class', observed: 'Machine.prototype.step is not a function', expected: 'class Machine { step() { ... } }: the checks of lessons 09 to 13 count instructions by counting calls to Machine.prototype.step' });
      const counter = countSteps(Machine); // as lessons 09 to 13 count: calls to Machine.prototype.step
      const program = readProgram('lob');
      const init = program.exportIndex('game_init');
      const steps = fixture('first-steps');
      for (const { seed, mode, ticks } of steps.lengths) {
        const input = `new Machine(readProgram('lob'), makeWorld(${seed}).imports), then begin('game_init', [${seed}, ${mode}])`;
        const m = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(seed).imports, { input, workDir });
        const startMemory = Buffer.from(ArrayBuffer.isView(m.state?.memory) ? m.state.memory : []);
        attempt(() => m.begin('game_init', [seed, mode]), { checked: 'begin(\'game_init\', [seed, mode])', input, expected: 'the call begins', workDir });
        const s = m.state;
        if (m.running !== true) fail({ checked: 'machine.running after begin', input, observed: show(m.running), expected: 'true: a call is unfinished' });
        if (s.tick !== 0) fail({ checked: 'state.tick after begin', input, observed: show(s.tick), expected: '0: begin runs nothing' });
        if (s.calls !== 1) fail({ checked: 'state.calls after begin', input, observed: show(s.calls), expected: '1: one call has begun' });
        if (memoryDifference(s.memory, startMemory)) fail({ checked: 'memory after begin', input, observed: 'memory changed', expected: 'unchanged: begin runs nothing' });
        if (!Array.isArray(s.frames) || s.frames.length !== 1 || s.frames[0]?.func !== init || s.frames[0]?.at !== 0) fail({ checked: 'state.frames after begin', input, observed: show(Array.isArray(s.frames) ? s.frames.map(f => ({ func: f?.func, at: f?.at })) : s.frames), expected: `one frame, { func: ${init}, at: 0 }: game_init is function ${init}, and its next instruction is its first` });
        const first = pick(attempt(() => m.step(), { checked: 'the first step() of game_init', input, expected: 'its event', workDir }));
        const want = { tick: 1, func: init, at: 0, op: 'i32.const', writes: [] };
        if (!same(first, want)) fail({ checked: 'the event of the first step()', input, observed: show(first), expected: show(want), diff: firstDifference(first, want) });
        if (m.state.tick !== 1) fail({ checked: 'state.tick after one step', input, observed: show(m.state.tick), expected: '1' });
        if (m.state.frames?.length !== 1 || m.state.frames[0]?.at !== 1) fail({ checked: 'state.frames after one step', input, observed: show(Array.isArray(m.state.frames) ? m.state.frames.map(f => ({ func: f?.func, at: f?.at })) : m.state.frames), expected: `one frame, { func: ${init}, at: 1 }: the position of the next instruction` });
        // Step on to the end of game_init: every event must match the frame it ran in.
        let tick = 1;
        while (m.running) {
          const top = m.state.frames[m.state.frames.length - 1];
          const topFunc = top?.func, topAt = top?.at; // read before the step: it may change the frame in place
          const name = top ? insText(program, topFunc, topAt) : 'nothing';
          const e = attempt(() => m.step(), { checked: `step() at tick ${tick}`, input: `${input}; the next instruction is ${name}`, expected: 'its event', workDir });
          tick++;
          if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') fail({ checked: `what step() returns at tick ${tick}`, input, observed: show(e), expected: 'the event { tick, func, at, op, writes }' });
          const k = tick - 1; // index into the fixture's first instructions (first[0] is instruction 1)
          if (k < steps.first.length) {
            const [wf, wa, ww] = steps.first[k];
            const ours = pick(e);
            const wantEvent = { tick, func: wf, at: wa, op: opAt(program, wf, wa), writes: ww.map(([address, size, b, a]) => ({ address, size, before: fromHex(b), after: fromHex(a) })) };
            if (!same(ours, wantEvent)) fail({ checked: `instruction ${tick} of game_init`, input, observed: show(ours), expected: `${show(wantEvent)}${ours.func === wf && ours.at !== wa && k > 0 ? `. ${hintAfter(program, steps.first[k - 1][0], steps.first[k - 1][1])}` : ''}`, diff: firstDifference(ours, wantEvent) });
          }
          if (e?.tick !== tick || m.state.tick !== tick) fail({ checked: `the tick of instruction ${tick}`, input, observed: `the event says tick ${show(e?.tick)} and state.tick is ${show(m.state.tick)}`, expected: `both ${tick}: the event's tick is the number of instructions run, counting this one` });
          if (e.func !== topFunc || e.at !== topAt) fail({ checked: `which instruction step() ran at tick ${tick}`, input, observed: `the event names (${e.func}, ${e.at}) but the innermost frame said ${name} was next`, expected: 'the instruction the innermost frame names: frames[frames.length - 1] holds the func and at of the next instruction' });
          if (e.op !== opAt(program, e.func, e.at)) fail({ checked: `the op of instruction ${tick}`, input, observed: show(e.op), expected: `${show(opAt(program, e.func, e.at))}, the name of ${insText(program, e.func, e.at)} in the listing` });
          if (!Array.isArray(e.writes)) fail({ checked: `the writes of instruction ${tick}`, input, observed: show(e.writes), expected: 'an array, [] when the instruction stores nothing' });
          if (store(e.op) ? e.writes.length !== 1 : e.writes.length !== 0) fail({ checked: `the writes of ${insText(program, e.func, e.at)} at tick ${tick}`, input, observed: plural(e.writes.length, 'write'), expected: store(e.op) ? 'exactly one write: every store reports one, even when it writes the bytes already there' : 'none: only stores write' });
          if (store(e.op) && e.writes[0]?.size !== WIDTH[e.op]) fail({ checked: `the size of the write of ${insText(program, e.func, e.at)} at tick ${tick}`, input, observed: show(e.writes[0]?.size), expected: `${WIDTH[e.op]}: ${e.op} writes ${plural(WIDTH[e.op], 'byte')}` });
          if (tick > 400000) fail({ checked: 'game_init ends', input, observed: 'more than 400,000 instructions and still running', expected: `game_init(${seed}, ${mode}) runs ${plural(ticks, 'instruction')}. ${RULES}` });
        }
        if (m.state.frames.length !== 0) fail({ checked: 'state.frames after game_init returns', input, observed: show(m.state.frames.map(f => ({ func: f?.func, at: f?.at }))), expected: '[]' });
        if (tick !== ticks) fail({ checked: `how many instructions game_init(${seed}, ${mode}) runs`, input, observed: plural(tick, 'instruction'), expected: `${plural(ticks, 'instruction')}. ${RULES} If 08.control and 08.numbers pass, compare your machine with Node's engine: node lab.mjs agree ...` });
        // invoke runs every instruction through Machine.prototype.step and returns undefined for a function without a result.
        counter.reset();
        const before = m.state.tick;
        const r = attempt(() => m.invoke('game_key', [3]), { checked: 'invoke(\'game_key\', [3])', input: `${input}, then invoke('game_key', [3])`, expected: 'undefined', workDir });
        if (r !== undefined) fail({ checked: 'what invoke returns for a function with no result', input: `${input}, then invoke('game_key', [3])`, observed: show(r), expected: 'undefined' });
        if (counter.count !== m.state.tick - before || counter.count === 0) fail({ checked: 'invoke runs every instruction through step()', input: `${input}, then invoke('game_key', [3])`, observed: `state.tick went up by ${m.state.tick - before} and Machine.prototype.step was called ${plural(counter.count, 'time')}`, expected: 'the same number: invoke calls this.step() until the call returns, and step is a method of the class. Lessons 09 to 13 count instructions by counting calls to Machine.prototype.step' });
      }
    },

    id: '08.writes',
    title: 'Every store in a run of Lob reports the bytes it wrote, and only stores do',
    requirement: 'Over a run of Lob that moves its state, re-keys it and fires: each store reports one write of its width; before holds the bytes memory had there just before the store; after holds what it wrote; applying every after in order to Node\'s memory before the call gives Node\'s memory after it.',
    timeLimitMs: 20000,
    async run({ cls, workDir }) {
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      const program = readProgram('lob');
      const seed = 909, mode = 14, world = 3;
      const calls = session({ seed, mode, plan: [['up', 2], ['right', 1], ['fire'], ['frames', 45], ['new'], ['down', 3], ['left', 1], ['fire'], ['frames', 4]] });
      const describe = `lob, session({ seed: ${seed}, mode: ${mode}, ... }): ${calls.length} calls (mode 14 moves the state each round, re-keys it and moves the flag), answered by makeWorld(${world})`;
      const m = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(world).imports, { input: describe, workDir });
      const node = await nodeGame('lob', makeWorld(world).imports);
      const shadow = Uint8Array.from(new Uint8Array(node.memory.buffer));
      const seen = new Set();
      for (let k = 0; k < calls.length; k++) {
        const c = calls[k];
        const input = `${describe}; call ${k}, ${callText(c)}`;
        attempt(() => m.begin(c.name, c.args), { checked: `begin for call ${k}`, input, expected: 'the call begins', workDir });
        let n = 0;
        while (m.running) {
          const e = attempt(() => m.step(), { checked: `step() in call ${k}`, input, expected: 'its event', workDir });
          if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') fail({ checked: `what step() returns in call ${k}`, input, observed: show(e), expected: 'the event { tick, func, at, op, writes }' });
          if (++n > 200000) fail({ checked: `call ${k} ends`, input, observed: 'more than 200,000 instructions', expected: 'the call returns' });
          const where = `${insText(program, e.func, e.at)} at tick ${e.tick}`;
          const writes = e?.writes;
          if (!Array.isArray(writes)) fail({ checked: `the writes of ${where}`, input, observed: show(writes), expected: 'an array' });
          if (!store(e.op)) { if (writes.length) fail({ checked: `the writes of ${where}`, input, observed: show(writes.map(pick)), expected: '[]: only stores write' }); continue; }
          seen.add(e.op);
          if (writes.length !== 1) fail({ checked: `the writes of ${where}`, input, observed: plural(writes.length, 'write'), expected: 'exactly one write: a store that writes the bytes already there still reports a write' });
          const w = writes[0];
          const before = bytesOf(w?.before), after = bytesOf(w?.after);
          const ok = (b) => Array.isArray(b) && b.length === WIDTH[e.op] && b.every(x => Number.isInteger(x) && x >= 0 && x <= 255);
          if (w?.size !== WIDTH[e.op] || !Number.isInteger(w?.address) || w.address < 0 || w.address + WIDTH[e.op] > shadow.length || !ok(before) || !ok(after)) fail({ checked: `the write of ${where}`, input, observed: show({ address: w?.address, size: w?.size, before, after }), expected: `{ address, size: ${WIDTH[e.op]}, before, after }: an address inside memory, and before and after as ${WIDTH[e.op]} byte values each` });
          const was = Array.from(shadow.subarray(w.address, w.address + w.size));
          if (!same(before, was)) fail({ checked: `before, in the write of ${where}`, input, observed: `before is ${show(before)}`, expected: `${show(was)}: the bytes at ${w.address} just before the store (Node's memory before this call, with the earlier writes of the call applied). Read before from memory before you store` });
          shadow.set(after, w.address);
          const now = Array.from(m.state.memory.subarray(w.address, w.address + w.size));
          if (!same(now, after)) fail({ checked: `after, in the write of ${where}`, input, observed: `after is ${show(after)} but your memory at ${w.address} now holds ${show(now)}`, expected: 'after holds the bytes the store left in memory at the write\'s address, which is the popped address plus the offset' });
        }
        attempt(() => node[c.name](...c.args), { checked: 'Node\'s engine', input, expected: 'runs', workDir });
        const d = memoryDifference(shadow, new Uint8Array(node.memory.buffer));
        if (d) fail({ checked: `the writes of call ${k} account for every byte it changed`, input, observed: `Node's memory before the call with your writes applied: ${memoryText(d)}`, expected: 'Node\'s memory after the call: every store reports its write, at its address, with the bytes it wrote' });
        const own = memoryDifference(m.state.memory, shadow);
        if (own) fail({ checked: `your memory after call ${k}`, input, observed: memoryText(own, 'Node\'s engine'), expected: 'Node\'s memory after the call' });
      }
      const missing = Object.keys(WIDTH).filter(op => !seen.has(op));
      if (missing.length) fail({ checked: 'the run stores with every width', input: describe, observed: `no ${missing.join(', ')} ran`, expected: 'every store instruction ran (this is a fault in the check, not in your code: report it)' });
    },

  {
    id: '08.plain-state',
    title: 'A copy of machine.state, put back, carries on exactly, in the middle of a call and between calls',
    requirement: 'structuredClone(machine.state) works at any moment. Put back with machine.state = copy, on the same machine or on a new one, the machine runs the same instructions with the same events and ends with the same memory and ticks as it did the first time, whether the copy was taken inside a nested call or between calls.',
    timeLimitMs: 20000,
    async run({ cls, workDir }) {
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      const program = readProgram('lob');
      const seed = 31, mode = 14;
      // Mode 14 has no server: the game asks only sin and cos, whose answers depend on their
      // arguments alone, so running the same instructions again gets the same answers.
      const calls = session({ seed, mode, plan: [['right', 3], ['up', 4], ['fire'], ['frames', 90], ['new'], ['left', 2], ['fire'], ['frames', 40]] });
      const describe = `lob, session({ seed: ${seed}, mode: ${mode}, ... }) with ${calls.length} calls`;
      const m = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(1).imports, { input: describe, workDir });
      const clone = (what, input) => attempt(() => structuredClone(m.state), { checked: `structuredClone(machine.state) ${what}`, input, expected: 'a copy: state holds only plain data (numbers, BigInts, strings, arrays, plain objects, typed arrays), no functions and no class instances whose methods it needs', workDir });
      // Step n instructions, beginning the session's next call whenever the last one has returned.
      const drive = (mm, next, n, input, { until = null, what = 'running the session' } = {}) => {
        const events = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          if (!mm.running) { if (next >= calls.length) break; const c = calls[next++]; attempt(() => mm.begin(c.name, c.args), { checked: `${what}: begin(${callText(c)})`, input, expected: 'the call begins', workDir }); }
          events.push(pick(attempt(() => mm.step(), { checked: `${what}: step() number ${i + 1}`, input, expected: 'the event of the same instruction as the first time', workDir })));
          if (until && until(events[events.length - 1], mm)) return { events, next, found: true };
        }
        return { events, next, memory: Buffer.from(mm.state.memory), tick: mm.state.tick, frames: mm.state.frames.map(f => [f.func, f.at]) };
      };
      const compare = (a, b, checked, input) => {
        const k = a.events.findIndex((e, i) => !same(e, b.events[i]));
        if (k >= 0 || a.events.length !== b.events.length) fail({ checked, input, observed: k >= 0 ? `instruction ${k + 1} after the copy: ${show(b.events[k])}` : `${b.events.length} instructions`, expected: k >= 0 ? `${show(a.events[k])}, as the first time` : `${a.events.length} instructions, as the first time`, diff: k >= 0 ? firstDifference(b.events[k], a.events[k]) : undefined });
        const d = memoryDifference(b.memory, a.memory);
        if (d) fail({ checked, input, observed: `memory at the end: ${memoryText(d, 'the first run')}`, expected: 'the same memory as the first time' });
        if (a.tick !== b.tick || !same(a.frames, b.frames)) fail({ checked, input, observed: `state.tick ${b.tick}, frames ${show(b.frames)}`, expected: `state.tick ${a.tick}, frames ${show(a.frames)}, as the first time` });
      };
      // Copies in the middle of calls, each taken just after an instruction that pushed a value
      // while two or more frames are in progress: the value stack then holds live values.
      const PUSHES = new Set(['i32.const', 'f32.const', 'i64.const', 'local.get', 'local.tee', 'global.get', 'i32.load', 'i32.load8_u', 'f32.load']);
      const W = 1500;
      attempt(() => m.invoke(calls[0].name, calls[0].args), { checked: `call 0, ${callText(calls[0])}`, input: describe, expected: 'runs', workDir });
      let next = 1;
      for (let p = 0; p < 6; p++) {
        const lead = drive(m, next, 30000, describe, { until: (e, mm) => e.tick % 997 > 400 + 50 * p && PUSHES.has(e.op) && mm.state.frames.length >= 2 });
        if (!lead.found) fail({ checked: 'the check finds a place to copy the state', input: describe, observed: 'none within 30,000 instructions', expected: 'an instruction that pushes a value inside a nested call (a fault in the check, not your code, if every other case passes: report it)' });
        next = lead.next;
        const last = lead.events[lead.events.length - 1];
        const midInput = `${describe}: a copy taken at tick ${m.state.tick}, in call ${next - 1}, ${callText(calls[next - 1])}, just after ${insText(program, last.func, last.at)}, with ${m.state.frames.length} frames in progress`;
        const copy = clone('in the middle of a call', midInput);
        const first = drive(m, next, W, midInput);
        attempt(() => { m.state = structuredClone(copy); }, { checked: 'machine.state = copy', input: midInput, expected: 'the machine takes the copy as its state', workDir });
        const again = `the same machine, put back with machine.state = copy, runs the next ${W.toLocaleString('en-US')} instructions as it did the first time`;
        compare(first, drive(m, next, W, midInput, { what: again }), again, midInput);
        const fresh = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(2).imports, { input: midInput, workDir });
        attempt(() => { fresh.state = structuredClone(copy); }, { checked: 'machine.state = copy on a new machine', input: midInput, expected: 'the machine takes the copy as its state', workDir });
        const other = `a new machine given the copy with machine.state = copy runs the next ${W.toLocaleString('en-US')} instructions as the first one did`;
        compare(first, drive(fresh, next, W, midInput, { what: other }), other, midInput);
        next = first.next;
      }
      // Between calls.
      while (m.running) attempt(() => m.step(), { checked: 'step()', input: describe, expected: 'its event', workDir });
      const betweenInput = `${describe}: a copy taken between calls, before call ${next}, ${callText(calls[next])}`;
      const copy2 = clone('between calls', betweenInput);
      const runCalls = (mm) => {
        const out = [];
        for (let k = next; k < Math.min(calls.length, next + 30); k++) {
          const r = attempt(() => mm.invoke(calls[k].name, calls[k].args), { checked: `call ${k}`, input: betweenInput, expected: 'runs', workDir });
          const px = attempt(() => mm.invoke('r_px', []), { checked: 'r_px()', input: betweenInput, expected: 'runs', workDir });
          out.push([callText(calls[k]), r ?? null, mm.state.tick, hashMemory(mm.state.memory).slice(0, 16), px]);
        }
        return { out, memory: Buffer.from(mm.state.memory), calls: mm.state.calls };
      };
      const a = runCalls(m);
      attempt(() => { m.state = structuredClone(copy2); }, { checked: 'machine.state = copy', input: betweenInput, expected: 'the machine takes the copy as its state', workDir });
      const b = runCalls(m);
      const fresh2 = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(3).imports, { input: betweenInput, workDir });
      attempt(() => { fresh2.state = structuredClone(copy2); }, { checked: 'machine.state = copy on a new machine', input: betweenInput, expected: 'the machine takes the copy as its state', workDir });
      const c = runCalls(fresh2);
      for (const [x, who] of [[b, 'the same machine'], [c, 'a new machine']]) {
        if (!same(x.out, a.out)) fail({ checked: `${who}, given the copy, runs the next 30 calls as before`, input: betweenInput, observed: show(x.out.find((r, i) => !same(r, a.out[i]))), expected: `${show(a.out.find((r, i) => !same(r, x.out[i])))} (call, result, state.tick, start of the memory hash, r_px)`, diff: firstDifference(x.out, a.out) });
        const d = memoryDifference(x.memory, a.memory);
        if (d || x.calls !== a.calls) fail({ checked: `${who}, given the copy, ends 30 calls later where it did before`, input: betweenInput, observed: d ? memoryText(d, 'the first run') : `state.calls ${x.calls}`, expected: d ? 'the same memory' : `state.calls ${a.calls}` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '08.speed',
    title: 'A run of about 900,000 instructions takes your machine less than 5 seconds',
    requirement: 'A session of Lob of about 900,000 instructions, run with invoke, finishes within 5 seconds, and leaves the same memory as Node\'s engine. Lessons 09 to 13 replay runs like it many times.',
    timeLimitMs: 30000,
    async run({ cls, workDir }) {
      const LIMIT_MS = 5000;
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      const program = readProgram('lob');
      const seed = 8, mode = 0, world = 4;
      const calls = session({ seed, mode, plan: plan({ seed, shots: 3, flight: 300 }) });
      const describe = `lob, session({ seed: ${seed}, mode: ${mode}, plan: plan({ seed: ${seed}, shots: 3, flight: 300 }) }), ${calls.length} calls answered by makeWorld(${world})`;
      const m = newMachine(Machine, program, makeWorld(world).imports, { input: describe, workDir });
      const started = performance.now();
      for (let k = 0; k < calls.length; k++) {
        attempt(() => m.invoke(calls[k].name, calls[k].args), { checked: `call ${k}, ${callText(calls[k])}`, input: describe, expected: 'runs', workDir });
        const ms = performance.now() - started;
        if (ms > LIMIT_MS) fail({ checked: 'how long your machine takes for the run', input: describe, observed: `after ${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s your machine had run ${k + 1} of ${calls.length} calls, ${plural(m.state.tick, 'instruction')} (${Math.round(m.state.tick / ms * 1000).toLocaleString('en-US')} a second)`, expected: `the whole run, about 900,000 instructions, within ${LIMIT_MS / 1000} s. Look up what each instruction does once, when the machine is made, not on every step; avoid making new arrays or objects on every step except the event` });
      }
      const ms = performance.now() - started;
      const node = await nodeGame('lob', makeWorld(world).imports);
      for (const c of calls) node[c.name](...c.args);
      const d = memoryDifference(m.state.memory, new Uint8Array(node.memory.buffer));
      if (d) fail({ checked: 'memory after the timed run', input: describe, observed: memoryText(d), expected: 'the same memory as Node\'s engine after the same calls (08.lob-agrees finds the first call that differs)' });
      if (m.state.tick < 800000) fail({ checked: 'the length of the timed run', input: describe, observed: `state.tick is ${m.state.tick} after ${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`, expected: 'about 900,000 instructions' });
    },
  },
];
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/09.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 09: record and replay. Recordings here are made three ways: by your own
// machine (to check record), by Node's WebAssembly engine with a world your code
// cannot reach (to check replay), and, for firstDivergence, stored in
// fixtures/09/divergence.json with the tick where each tampered replay first has
// different memory. Those ticks were found when the course was built by stepping
// both replays in lockstep and comparing memory after every instruction.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fail, show, program as readProgram, wasmBytes, courseRoot, NOT_WRITTEN, CheckFailure, firstDifference, same, countSteps } from './harness.mjs';
import { makeWorld } from '../public/world.mjs';
import { hashMemory } from '../public/hash.mjs';
import { session, plan } from '../public/sessions.mjs';

export const title = 'Record and replay';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared with tools/make-fixtures.mjs

// Record calls on Node's own engine: the recording a correct record() makes.
export async function nodeRecord(game, imports, calls) {
  const program = readProgram(game);
  const answers = [];
  const env = {};
  for (const im of program.imports) env[im.name] = (...args) => { const result = imports[im.name](...args); answers.push({ name: im.name, args, result }); return result; };
  const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(wasmBytes(`targets/${game}.wasm`), { env });
  const ex = instance.exports;
  const results = [], hashes = [];
  for (const c of calls) {
    const r = ex[c.name](...c.args);
    results.push(r === undefined ? null : r);
    hashes.push(hashMemory(new Uint8Array(ex.memory.buffer)));
  }
  return { format: 'ttd2-recording-1', program: program.name, sha256: program.sha256, calls: calls.map(c => ({ name: c.name, args: [...c.args] })), results, answers, hashes };
}

// A world no code outside this file can make: its server answers come from its own
// generator, and its sin and cos are a little off, so a replay that asks Math.sin
// itself, or any makeWorld, gets other answers than the recording holds.
export function privateWorld(seed) {
  let x = (seed * 2246822519 + 3) >>> 0 || 1;
  const next = () => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x / 4294967296; };
  return {
    sin: (v) => Math.sin(v) * (1 + 1 / 1024),
    cos: (v) => Math.cos(v) * (1 - 1 / 1024),
    server_round: () => Math.floor(next() * 7) - 3,
    server_wind: () => Math.fround((next() * 2 - 1) * 4.5),
  };
}

// Getter calls between the game's calls, so some results are numbers.
export function withGetters(calls, getters, every = 37) {
  const out = [];
  calls.forEach((c, k) => { out.push(c); if (k % every === every - 1) out.push({ name: getters[(k / every | 0) % getters.length], args: [] }); });
  return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

let divergenceFixture = null;
const fixture = () => divergenceFixture ??= JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, 'checks', 'fixtures', '09', 'divergence.json'), 'utf8'));
const plural = (n, word) => `${Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US')} ${word}${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
const callText = (c) => `${c.name}(${c.args.join(', ')})`;
const LOB_GETTERS = ['r_px', 'r_power', 'r_wind_level', 'r_target_x', 'r_flying', 'r_angle', 'r_py', 'r_result'];
const LOB2_GETTERS = ['g0', 'g1', 'g2', 'g3', 'g4', 'g5'];

function whereInWork(error, workDir) {
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    const i = workDir ? line.indexOf(workDir) : -1;
    if (i >= 0) {
      const m = line.slice(i + workDir.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return ` (${m[1]} line ${m[2]})`;
    }
  }
  return '';
}
const passThrough = (error) => error instanceof CheckFailure || String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN);
function attempt(run, { checked, input, expected, workDir }) {
  try { return run(); } catch (error) {
    if (passThrough(error)) throw error;
    fail({ checked, input, observed: `your code threw ${error?.name ?? 'an error'}: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}${whereInWork(error, workDir)}`, expected });
  }
}
// Run fn expecting it to throw; returns the error, or null.
function throws(run) {
  try { run(); } catch (error) { if (passThrough(error)) throw error; return error; }
  return null;
}

// Numbers compare exactly, except that -0 and 0 are one number in JSON.
function jsonSame(a, b) {
  if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') return a === b || (Number.isNaN(a) && Number.isNaN(b));
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => jsonSame(x, b[i]));
  if (a && b && typeof a === 'object' && typeof b === 'object') { const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b); return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every(k => jsonSame(a[k], b[k])); }
  return Object.is(a, b);
}
// The first place a value holds something JSON cannot carry, or null.
function notJson(value, path) {
  if (value === null || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean') return null;
  if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? null : `${path} is ${value}, which JSON cannot hold`;
  if (value === undefined) return `${path} is undefined, which JSON drops or turns into null`;
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return `${path} is a BigInt (${value}n), which JSON.stringify refuses`;
  if (typeof value === 'function' || typeof value === 'symbol') return `${path} is a ${typeof value}`;
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value) || value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return `${path} is a ${Object.prototype.toString.call(value).slice(8, -1)}, which JSON turns into an object of numbered keys; use a plain array`;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Array.prototype) return `${path} is an instance of ${value.constructor?.name}, not a plain array`;
    for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) { if (!(i in value)) return `${path}[${i}] is a hole in the array`; const p = notJson(value[i], `${path}[${i}]`); if (p) return p; }
    return null;
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (proto !== Object.prototype && proto !== null) return `${path} is a ${value.constructor?.name ?? 'class instance'}, not a plain object`;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) { const p = notJson(v, `${path}.${k}`); if (p) return p; }
  return null;
}

// Answers import calls from a recording, in order; stops at the first question the
// recording does not hold next. Counts instructions itself, so the tick it reports
// is the number of instructions run before the call instruction that asked.
class Stop extends Error {}
function expectedRun(Machine, program, recording, context) {
  let next = 0, ran = 0, k = 0, mismatch = null;
  const imports = {};
  for (const im of program.imports) imports[im.name] = (...args) => {
    const a = recording.answers[next];
    if (!a || a.name !== im.name || a.args.length !== args.length || a.args.some((x, i) => !Object.is(x, args[i]))) {
      mismatch = { tick: ran, call: k, asked: `${im.name}(${args.join(', ')})`, holds: a ? `${a.name}(${a.args.join(', ')})` : 'no more answers' };
      throw new Stop();
    }
    next++;
    return a.result;
  };
  const m = attempt(() => new Machine(program, imports), { checked: 'new Machine(program, imports)', expected: 'a machine', ...context });
  const ends = [];
  for (k = 0; k < recording.calls.length; k++) {
    const c = recording.calls[k];
    try {
      m.begin(c.name, c.args);
      while (m.running) { m.step(); ran++; }
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof Stop || mismatch) return { mismatch, ends };
      if (passThrough(e)) throw e;
      fail({ checked: 'your machine runs the recording (needed to work out the expected ticks)', input: context.input, observed: `your machine threw ${e?.name}: ${String(e?.message).split('\n')[0]}${whereInWork(e, context.workDir)} in call ${k}, ${callText(c)}`, expected: 'the machine passes the checks of unit 08' });
    }
    ends.push(ran);
  }
  return { mismatch, ends };
}

function checkDivergence(error, want, { checked, input, workDir }) {
  if (!error) fail({ checked, input, observed: 'replay returned without throwing', expected: `an error whose divergence field is { tick: ${want.tick}, call: ${want.call}, reason }: ${want.why}` });
  const d = error.divergence;
  if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') fail({ checked, input, observed: `replay threw ${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}${whereInWork(error, workDir)}, with no divergence field`, expected: `an error whose divergence field is { tick: ${want.tick}, call: ${want.call}, reason }: ${want.why}` });
  const ours = { tick: d.tick, call: d.call };
  if (!same(ours, { tick: want.tick, call: want.call })) fail({ checked, input, observed: `divergence ${show({ ...ours, reason: d.reason })}`, expected: `tick ${want.tick} and call ${want.call}: ${want.why}`, diff: firstDifference(ours, { tick: want.tick, call: want.call }) });
  if (typeof d.reason !== 'string' || !d.reason.trim()) fail({ checked, input, observed: `divergence.reason is ${show(d.reason)}`, expected: 'a sentence saying what differed' });
}

function applyTamper(original, change) {
  const t = structuredClone(original);
  for (const [i, a] of change.answers ?? []) t.answers[i] = a;
  for (const [i, c] of change.calls ?? []) t.calls[i] = c;
  return t;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the cases

async function recordAndCompare({ fn, cls, workDir }, game, seed, mode, world) {
  const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
  const record = await fn('recorder.mjs', 'record');
  const program = readProgram(game);
  const calls = withGetters(session({ seed, mode, plan: plan({ seed, shots: 2, flight: 200 }) }), game === 'lob' ? LOB_GETTERS : LOB2_GETTERS);
  const input = `record(readProgram('${game}'), makeWorld(${world}).imports, calls), calls being session({ seed: ${seed}, mode: ${mode}, plan: plan({ seed: ${seed}, shots: 2, flight: 200 }) }) with a getter call after every 37th call: ${calls.length} calls`;
  // The same calls on your own Machine, noting every answer the world gives.
  const w = makeWorld(world);
  const answers = [];
  const noting = {};
  for (const [name, f] of Object.entries(w.imports)) noting[name] = (...args) => { const result = f(...args); answers.push({ name, args, result }); return result; };
  const m = attempt(() => new Machine(program, noting), { checked: 'new Machine', input, expected: 'a machine', workDir });
  const results = [], hashes = [];
  for (const c of calls) {
    const r = attempt(() => m.invoke(c.name, c.args), { checked: `your machine runs ${callText(c)}`, input, expected: 'the machine passes the checks of unit 08', workDir });
    results.push(r === undefined ? null : r);
    hashes.push(hashMemory(m.state.memory));
  }
  // Your record(), with a world that counts its answers.
  const w2 = makeWorld(world);
  let asked = 0;
  const counting = {};
  for (const [name, f] of Object.entries(w2.imports)) counting[name] = (...args) => { asked++; return f(...args); };
  const callsCopy = structuredClone(calls);
  const rec = attempt(() => record(program, counting, callsCopy), { checked: 'record(program, imports, calls)', input, expected: 'a recording', workDir });
  if (!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') fail({ checked: 'what record returns', input, observed: show(rec), expected: 'a recording object' });
  if (!same(callsCopy, calls)) fail({ checked: 'record leaves the calls it is given as they were', input, observed: 'the calls list changed', expected: 'unchanged: copy what you keep' });
  const head = { format: rec.format, program: rec.program, sha256: rec.sha256 };
  const wantHead = { format: 'ttd2-recording-1', program: program.name, sha256: program.sha256 };
  if (!same(head, wantHead)) fail({ checked: 'the recording\'s format, program and sha256', input, observed: show(head), expected: `${show(wantHead)}: the program's name and sha256 from its listing`, diff: firstDifference(head, wantHead) });
  for (const field of ['calls', 'results', 'answers', 'hashes']) if (!Array.isArray(rec[field])) fail({ checked: `recording.${field}`, input, observed: show(rec[field], 80), expected: 'an array' });
  const ourCalls = rec.calls.map(c => ({ name: c?.name, args: Array.isArray(c?.args) ? Array.from(c.args) : c?.args }));
  if (!same(ourCalls, calls)) fail({ checked: 'recording.calls: every call, in order', input, observed: `${plural(ourCalls.length, 'call')}`, expected: `the ${plural(calls.length, 'call')} given, each as { name, args }`, diff: firstDifference(ourCalls, calls) });
  if (!same(rec.results, results)) fail({ checked: 'recording.results: what each call returned', input, observed: show(rec.results, 120), expected: 'one entry per call: what invoke returned, or null when the function returns nothing', diff: firstDifference(rec.results, results) });
  const ourAnswers = rec.answers.map(a => ({ name: a?.name, args: Array.isArray(a?.args) ? Array.from(a.args) : a?.args, result: a?.result }));
  if (!jsonSame(ourAnswers, answers)) fail({ checked: 'recording.answers: every import call the game made, in order', input, observed: `${plural(ourAnswers.length, 'answer')}`, expected: `${plural(answers.length, 'answer')}, each { name, args, result }: the import's name, the arguments the game passed and what the world returned`, diff: firstDifference(ourAnswers, answers) });
  if (asked !== answers.length) fail({ checked: 'record asks the world once per import call', input, observed: `the world was asked ${plural(asked, 'time')}`, expected: `${answers.length}: run the calls once, with imports that pass each question to the world and note the answer` });
  if (!same(rec.hashes, hashes)) fail({ checked: 'recording.hashes: the memory hash after each call', input, observed: show(rec.hashes, 120), expected: 'one hashMemory(memory) per call, taken when the call has returned', diff: firstDifference(rec.hashes, hashes) });
}

      const seed = 9606;
      const a = await nodeRecord('lob', privateWorld(1), session({ seed, mode: 1, plan: [['right', 4], ['fire'], ['frames', 150], ['new'], ['frames', 2]] }));
      const b = await nodeRecord('lob', privateWorld(2), session({ seed, mode: 1, plan: [['left', 3], ['up', 2], ['fire'], ['frames', 150], ['new'], ['frames', 2]] }));
      const c = await nodeRecord('lob', privateWorld(3), session({ seed, mode: 0, plan: [['fire'], ['frames', 20]] }));
      const d = await nodeRecord('lob2', privateWorld(4), withGetters(session({ seed: 9707, mode: 1, plan: plan({ seed: 9707, shots: 2, flight: 200 }) }), LOB2_GETTERS));
      const sins = d.answers.map((x, i) => [x, i]).filter(([x]) => x.name === 'sin').map(([, i]) => i);
      const edited = structuredClone(d);
      const j = sins[sins.length - 1];
      edited.answers[j].args = [edited.answers[j].args[0] * (1 + 2 ** -40)];
      const cut = structuredClone(a);
      cut.answers.length = Math.floor(a.answers.length * 0.6);
      // A shot asks cos(angle), then sin(angle): swap the two names and only the name differs.
      const swapped = structuredClone(a);
      const ci = swapped.answers.findIndex((x, i) => x.name === 'cos' && swapped.answers[i + 1]?.name === 'sin');
      [swapped.answers[ci].name, swapped.answers[ci + 1].name] = ['sin', 'cos'];
      const trials = [
        [lob, { ...a, answers: b.answers }, { check: false }, `a recording of lob mode 1 whose answers are those of another session of the same game (it aims elsewhere before it fires), replayed with { check: false }`],
        [lob, { ...a, answers: c.answers }, { check: false }, `a recording of lob mode 1 whose answers are those of a session in mode 0, which never asks server_round, replayed with { check: false }`],
        [lob2, edited, undefined, `a recording of lob2 mode 1 with its last sin answer's argument changed by one part in 2^40, replayed with the default check: true`],
        [lob, cut, undefined, `a recording of lob mode 1 with only the first ${cut.answers.length} of its ${a.answers.length} answers, replayed with the default check: true`],
        [lob, swapped, undefined, `a recording of lob mode 1 whose answers ${ci} and ${ci + 1}, cos(x) and sin(x) for the shot, have their names swapped (same argument), replayed with the default check: true`],
      ];
      for (const [program, recording, options, what] of trials) {
        const input = `replay(readProgram('${program.name}'), recording${options ? ', { check: false }' : ''}): ${what}`;
        const { mismatch } = expectedRun(Machine, program, recording, { input, workDir });
        if (!mismatch) fail({ checked: 'the check itself', input, observed: 'no question differed', expected: 'a difference (report this: it is a fault in the check)' });
        const error = throws(() => options ? replay(program, recording, options) : replay(program, recording));
        checkDivergence(error, { ...mismatch, why: `in call ${mismatch.call}, ${callText(recording.calls[mismatch.call])}, after ${plural(mismatch.tick, 'instruction')} the game asks ${mismatch.asked} but the recording's next answer is ${mismatch.holds}; tick is the number of instructions run before the call instruction that asked` }, { checked: 'the divergence replay reports for a question the recording does not hold next', input, workDir });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '09.replay-check',
    title: 'With check: true, a result or memory hash that differs from the recording is a divergence; with check: false it is not',
    requirement: 'replay(program, recording) with the default check: true throws an error whose divergence field is { tick, call, reason } at the end of the first call whose result or memory hash differs from the recording: call is its index and tick the number of instructions run when it returned. With { check: false } the same recording replays to its end and returns the true results and hashes.',
    timeLimitMs: 30000,
    async run({ fn, cls, workDir }) {
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      const replay = await fn('recorder.mjs', 'replay');
      const program = readProgram('lob');
      const seed = 9808;

      const getterAt = rec.calls.map((c, i) => [c, i]).filter(([c]) => c.name.startsWith('r_')).map(([, i]) => i);
      const k1 = Math.floor(rec.calls.length * 0.45), k2 = getterAt[Math.floor(getterAt.length * 0.7)];
      const badHash = structuredClone(rec);
      badHash.hashes[k1] = (badHash.hashes[k1][0] === '0' ? '1' : '0') + badHash.hashes[k1].slice(1);
      const badResult = structuredClone(rec);
      badResult.results[k2] = rec.results[k2] + 1;
      const { ends } = expectedRun(Machine, program, rec, { input: 'a recording of lob mode 1', workDir });

        [badResult, k2, `the result of call ${k2} (${callText(rec.calls[k2])}) changed from ${rec.results[k2]} to ${badResult.results[k2]}`],
      ];
      for (const [recording, k, what] of trials) {
        const input = `replay(readProgram('lob'), recording), a recording of lob mode 1 (${plural(rec.calls.length, 'call')}) with ${what}`;

'memory hash' : 'result'} differs from the recording, and ${plural(ends[k], 'instruction')} have run when it returns` }, { checked: 'the divergence replay reports with check: true', input, workDir });
        const out = attempt(() => replay(program, recording, { check: false }), { checked: 'replay(program, recording, { check: false })', input: input.replace('recording)', 'recording, { check: false })'), expected: 'the replay runs to its end: with check: false only a question the recording does not hold stops it', workDir });
        if (!same(out?.hashes, rec.hashes) || !same(out?.results, rec.results)) fail({ checked: 'what replay returns with check: false', input, observed: `results ${show(out?.results, 60)}, hashes ${show(out?.hashes, 60)}`, expected: 'the results and hashes the calls really give, which are the untampered recording\'s', diff: firstDifference({ results: out?.results, hashes: out?.hashes }, { results: rec.results, hashes: rec.hashes }) });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '09.divergence',
    title: 'firstDivergence finds the exact tick where a tampered replay first has different memory',
    requirement: 'For tampered copies of recordings the lessons never use (a server_wind answer changed early or late, a server_round answer changed in game_init or later, a cos answer changed, a key press changed, a shot turned into a key press), firstDivergence(program, original, tampered) returns the smallest tick after which the tampered replay\'s memory differs from the original\'s: the tick of the first instruction whose writes leave the two memories different.',

  // The budgets (fixtures/09/divergence.json, made by tools/make-fixtures.mjs 09), counted
  // as calls to step(); each budget is 3 x the reference, rounded up to a thousand:
  //
  //   tamper (late server_wind)  run      tick     reference  lockstep  bisect calls  bisect ticks  budget
  //   lob-60601  mode 1          587,064  448,755  453,696    897,510   5,330,897     18,682,516    1,362,000
  //   lob-70702  mode 11         440,283  335,559  341,349    671,118   3,709,607     13,991,581    1,025,000
  //   lob2-80803 mode 5          458,591  349,976  355,744    699,952   3,902,365     14,581,669    1,068,000
  //
  // reference: replay the tampered recording once, compare each call's memory hash with the
  // original's, then bisect inside the first call that differs from a copy of its starting
  // state. lockstep: step both recordings side by side and compare memory after every
  // instruction (2 x the tick; passes). bisect calls: bisect over call indexes, replaying the
  // tampered recording from the start for each probe (fails, about 4 x the budget). bisect
  // ticks: bisect over ticks, replaying both recordings from the start for every probe
  // (fails, about 14 x the budget). Measured 2026-11-13.

    id: '09.divergence-budget',
    title: 'firstDivergence replays about as much as one replay of the run, not a bisection from the start',
    requirement: 'On three late tampers, firstDivergence returns the tick 09.divergence asks for and runs at most the budget in instructions (counted as calls to your Machine\'s step). The budget is three times what the worked solution for this course runs: enough to replay the tampered recording once to the call whose hash differs and then search inside that call from a saved state, or to step both recordings side by side once; far too little to bisect the whole run, replaying both recordings from the start for every probe (about 40 replays\' worth).',
    timeLimitMs: 60000,
    async run({ fn, cls, workDir }) {
      const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
      const firstDivergence = await fn('recorder.mjs', 'firstDivergence');
      const counter = countSteps(Machine);
      const fx = fixture();
      for (const t of fx.tampers.filter(x => x.budget)) {
        const original = fx.recordings[t.recording];
        const program = readProgram(original.program);
        const tampered = applyTamper(original, t.change);
        const input = `firstDivergence(readProgram('${original.program}'), original, tampered): ${fx.about[t.recording]}; tampered: ${t.what}`;
        counter.reset();
        const tick = attempt(() => firstDivergence(program, original, tampered), { checked: 'firstDivergence', input, expected: `tick ${t.expected}`, workDir });
        const n = counter.count;
        if (tick !== t.expected) fail({ checked: 'what firstDivergence returns', input, observed: show(tick), expected: `${t.expected} (09.divergence checks the ticks)` });
        if (n < t.expected) fail({ checked: 'the instructions firstDivergence runs are counted', input, observed: `${plural(n, 'call')} to step() on the Machine class from your machine.mjs`, expected: `at least ${t.expected.toLocaleString('en-US')}: memory after ${t.expected.toLocaleString('en-US')} instructions cannot be known without running them. Make your recorder use the Machine it imports from ./machine.mjs, and run every instruction through step()` });
        if (n > t.budget) fail({ checked: 'how many instructions firstDivergence runs', input, observed: plural(n, 'instruction'), expected: `at most ${t.budget.toLocaleString('en-US')}. The run is ${plural(t.run, 'instruction')} long and the memory first differs at tick ${t.expected.toLocaleString('en-US')}. The recording's hashes say which call first ends with different memory after one replay of the tampered recording; inside that call, search from a copy of the state at its start instead of replaying from tick 0` });
      }
    },
  },
];

async function runDivergence({ fn, workDir }, which) {
  const firstDivergence = await fn('recorder.mjs', 'firstDivergence');
  const fx = fixture();
  for (const t of fx.tampers.filter(which)) {
    const original = fx.recordings[t.recording];
    const program = readProgram(original.program);
    const tampered = applyTamper(original, t.change);
    const copies = [structuredClone(original), structuredClone(tampered)];
    const input = `firstDivergence(readProgram('${original.program}'), original, tampered): ${fx.about[t.recording]}; tampered: ${t.what}`;
    const tick = attempt(() => firstDivergence(program, original, tampered), { checked: 'firstDivergence(program, original, tampered)', input, expected: t.expected === null ? 'null' : `tick ${t.expected}`, workDir });
    if (tick !== t.expected) {
      const near = typeof tick === 'number' && t.expected !== null && Math.abs(tick - t.expected) <= 2;
      fail({
        checked: 'the tick firstDivergence returns', input, observed: show(tick),
        expected: t.expected === null
          ? `null: ${t.why}`
          : `${t.expected}: ${t.why}${near ? '. The tick is that of the instruction whose writes first leave the memories different, as its event says: memory after that many instructions differs, after one fewer it does not' : ''}`,
      });
    }
    if (!same(original, copies[0]) || !same(tampered, copies[1])) fail({ checked: 'firstDivergence leaves both recordings unchanged', input, observed: 'a recording changed', expected: 'unchanged' });
  }
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/10.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 10: run backwards. Your debugger's answers are compared with a brute-force
// replay of the same recording on your own machine (checks/trace.mjs), and its
// replay costs are counted on calls to your Machine's step().
import { fail, show, countSteps } from './harness.mjs';
import { trace, statesAt, scan, lastWriteAt, nextAt, callOf, uncounted, hash, loadRecording, describeTick } from './trace.mjs';

export const title = 'Run backwards';

const rng = (seed) => { let x = seed >>> 0 || 1; return (n) => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x % n; }; };

async function setup({ cls }, fixture = 'checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json') {
  const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
  const Debugger = await cls('debugger.mjs', 'Debugger');
  const counter = countSteps(Machine);
  const { recording, program } = loadRecording(fixture);
  const T = uncounted(counter, () => trace(Machine, program, recording));
  counter.reset();
  const d = new Debugger(program, recording);
  const opened = counter.count;
  return { Machine, Debugger, counter, recording, program, T, d, opened, fixture };
}

const memoryOf = (d) => d.read(0, 131072);
function expectPosition(d, T, states, t, input) {
  if (d.tick !== t) fail({ checked: 'the debugger stands at the position it moved to', input, observed: `tick is ${d.tick}`, expected: `tick ${t}` });
  const w = d.where();
  const n = nextAt(T, t);
  const want = { tick: t, call: callOf(T, t), func: n ? n.func : null, at: n ? n.at : null };
  if (!w || w.tick !== want.tick || w.call !== want.call || w.func !== want.func || w.at !== want.at) fail({ checked: 'where() names the instruction that runs next', input, observed: `where() returned ${show(w)}`, expected: show(want) });
  const mine = hash(memoryOf(d)), theirs = hash(states.get(t).memory);
  if (mine !== theirs) {
    const a = memoryOf(d), b = states.get(t).memory;
    let k = 0; while (k < a.length && a[k] === b[k]) k++;
    fail({ checked: 'memory at this position equals a replay from tick 0', input, observed: `read(0, 131072) differs first at address ${k}: yours ${a[k]}`, expected: `${b[k]}, as replaying the recording from tick 0 to tick ${t} gives` });
  }
}

const positions = (T, seed, n) => { const r = rng(seed); const out = [0, T.end, T.callStart[40], T.callStart[41] + 17]; while (out.length < n) out.push(r(T.end + 1)); return out; };

    async run(env) {
      const { d, T, Machine, program, recording, counter } = await setup(env);
      const ps = positions(T, 101, 14);
      const states = uncounted(counter, () => statesAt(Machine, program, recording, ps));
      for (const t of ps) { const r = d.seek(t); if (r !== t) fail({ checked: 'seek returns the new position', input: `seek(${t})`, observed: `returned ${show(r)}`, expected: String(t) }); expectPosition(d, T, states, t, `seek(${t}) on ${env.fixture ?? 'checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json'}`); }
    },

      plan.push([5, 'stepBack', 9], [T.end - 4, 'step', 10]);

      for (const [p, how, n] of plan) {

      d.seek(T.end);
      const snaps = d.snapshots;
      if (!Array.isArray(snaps) || snaps.length < 2) fail({ checked: 'the debugger keeps snapshots', input: 'after seek(end)', observed: `snapshots is ${show(snaps, 80)}`, expected: 'an array of { tick, pages }, one every few thousand instructions' });
      const distinct = new Set();
      for (const s of snaps) {
        if (!Number.isInteger(s.tick) || !Array.isArray(s.pages) || !s.pages.every((p) => p instanceof Uint8Array)) fail({ checked: 'a snapshot is { tick, pages }', input: 'after seek(end)', observed: show(s, 120), expected: '{ tick, pages: [Uint8Array, ...] }' });
        const length = s.pages.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0);
        if (length !== 131072) fail({ checked: 'a snapshot\'s pages cover all of memory', input: `snapshot at tick ${s.tick}`, observed: `${length} bytes`, expected: '131072 bytes' });
        for (const p of s.pages) distinct.add(p);
      }
      const held = [...distinct].reduce((n, p) => n + p.byteLength, 0);
      const full = snaps.length * 131072;
      if (held > full / 4) fail({ checked: 'snapshots share unchanged pages', input: `${snaps.length} snapshots after seek(end)`, observed: `they hold ${held} bytes in ${distinct.size} distinct pages`, expected: `at most ${full / 4} bytes, a quarter of ${snaps.length} full copies. An unchanged page must be the same Uint8Array object as in the previous snapshot, and pages must be 16 KiB or smaller (yours are ${snaps[0].pages[0].byteLength} bytes): a game frame writes only a few small pages` });
      const sample = snaps.filter((_, k) => k % Math.max(1, Math.floor(snaps.length / 20)) === 0);
      const states = uncounted(counter, () => statesAt(Machine, program, recording, sample.map((s) => s.tick)));
      for (const s of sample) {
        const whole = new Uint8Array(131072);
        let o = 0; for (const p of s.pages) { whole.set(p, o); o += p.length; }
        if (hash(whole) !== hash(states.get(s.tick).memory)) fail({ checked: 'a snapshot\'s pages are the memory at its tick', input: `snapshot at tick ${s.tick}`, observed: 'its pages differ from the memory at that tick', expected: 'the memory a replay from tick 0 gives (did a replay write into a page a snapshot holds?)' });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '10.budget', title: 'backward questions near the end replay a few thousand instructions, not the run', timeLimitMs: 40000,
    requirement: 'Opening the debugger may replay the run about twice; each backward question afterwards stays within its budget.',
    async run(env) {
      const { d, T, opened, counter } = await setup(env);
      if (opened > 2 * T.end + 20000) fail({ checked: 'opening the debugger replays the run at most about twice', input: `new Debugger on a run of ${T.end} instructions`, observed: `${opened} instructions`, expected: `at most ${2 * T.end + 20000}` });
      const near = T.end - 3000;
      d.seek(near);
      // To stand at position `near` your machine must have run at least `near`
      // instructions through step(); fewer means it ran some uncounted.
      if (counter.count < near) fail({ checked: 'every instruction your debugger replays runs through your Machine\'s step()', input: `new Debugger, then seek(${near})`, observed: `${counter.count} instructions counted through Machine.step()`, expected: `at least ${near}: the debugger cannot stand at position ${near} without running that many instructions (API.md, machine.mjs: every instruction goes through step())` });
      const b = d.read(78112, 4);
      const g = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, 4).getInt32(0, true);
      const questions = [
        ['stepBack(1)', () => d.stepBack(1)],
        ['stepBack(1)', () => d.stepBack(1)],
        ['stepBack(600)', () => d.stepBack(600)],
        // Function stops are lesson 12's; a breakpoint at update_hud's instruction 0 stops at the same places.
        ['continueBack to update_hud\'s first instruction', () => d.continueBack({ breakpoints: [{ func: 6, at: 0 }] })],
        ['continueBack to update_hud\'s first instruction', () => d.continueBack({ breakpoints: [{ func: 6, at: 0 }] })],
        [`lastWrite(${g + 72}), the frame counter`, () => d.lastWrite(g + 72)],
        [`continueBack watching the frame counter at ${g + 72}`, () => d.continueBack({ watches: [{ address: g + 72, size: 4 }] })],
        ['continueBack to game_tick\'s first instruction', () => d.continueBack({ breakpoints: [{ func: 8, at: 0 }] })],
        [`lastWrite(${g + 76}), the cloud's position, rewritten every frame`, () => d.lastWrite(g + 76)],
        ['stepBack(1) after a long backward search', () => d.stepBack(1)],
      ];
      d.seek(near);
      for (const [label, ask] of questions) {
        const before = counter.count;
        const from = d.tick;
        ask();
        const cost = counter.count - before;
        if (cost > BUDGET_PER_QUESTION) fail({ checked: 'a backward question near the end replays a few thousand instructions', input: `at tick ${from} of ${T.end}, ${label}`, observed: `${cost} instructions replayed (it stopped at tick ${d.tick})`, expected: `at most ${BUDGET_PER_QUESTION}; replaying from tick 0 would cost about ${from}` });
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '10.lob2', title: 'the same answers on Lob II', timeLimitMs: 40000,
    requirement: 'seek, stepBack, lastWrite and continueBack agree with a replay from tick 0 on a Lob II recording.',
    async run(env) {
      const { d, T, Machine, program, recording, counter } = await setup(env, 'checks/fixtures/10/lob2-m1.json');
      const r = rng(31);
      const ps = [r(T.end), r(T.end), T.end - 1];
      const states = uncounted(counter, () => statesAt(Machine, program, recording, [...ps, ...ps.map((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))]));
      for (const p of ps) {
        d.seek(p); expectPosition(d, T, states, p, `Lob II: seek(${p})`);
        d.stepBack(1); expectPosition(d, T, states, Math.max(0, p - 1), `Lob II: seek(${p}), stepBack(1)`);
        const address = T.writes.address[r(T.writes.address.length)];
        d.seek(p);
        const want = lastWriteAt(T, program, address, p), got = d.lastWrite(address);
        if (!(want === null ? got === null : got && got.tick === want.tick && got.address === want.address)) fail({ checked: 'lastWrite on Lob II', input: `seek(${p}), lastWrite(${address})`, observed: show(got), expected: show(want) });

        if (got2.tick !== back.tick) fail({ checked: 'continueBack on Lob II', input: `seek(${p}), continueBack(${show(stops)})`, observed: show(got2), expected: `tick ${back.tick}` });
      }
    },
  },

// Budget per backward question near the end of a run of 654,610 instructions. The
// reference (a snapshot every 1,000 instructions) needs at most 1,872 for any of these
// questions; 20,000 leaves room for snapshots up to several thousand instructions
// apart and is still about a thirtieth of a replay from tick 0, over 640,000 here.
const BUDGET_PER_QUESTION = 20000;
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/11.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 11: question a recording. Generated questions about recordings the lessons
// never use. lastWriter answers are given in full; sources answers are kept as the
// length and a salted hash of each list, so a failure says which list differs
// without giving the list away.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { fail, show, countSteps, readJson, program as namedProgram, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';
import { loadProgram } from '../public/program.mjs';
import { trace, uncounted } from './trace.mjs';

export const title = 'Question a recording';

const LOB = ['checks/fixtures/11/lob-mode1.json', 'checks/fixtures/11/lob-mode6.json', 'checks/fixtures/11/lob-mode9.json'];
const LOB2 = ['checks/fixtures/11/lob2-mode1.json'];
const MIXER = ['checks/fixtures/11/mixer.json'];

function open(rel) {
  const f = readJson(rel);
  return { f, program: f.program ? loadProgram(f.program) : namedProgram(f.recording.program) };
}

async function index({ fn, cls }, rel) {
  const buildIndex = await fn('query.mjs', 'buildIndex');
  const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
  const counter = countSteps(Machine);
  const { f, program } = open(rel);
  counter.reset();
  const idx = buildIndex(program, f.recording);
  return { idx, f, program, built: counter.count, counter, Machine };
}

const hashOf = (salt, list) => createHash('sha256').update(salt + JSON.stringify(list)).digest('hex');
const LISTS = ['stores', 'answers', 'args', 'initial'];

function checkSources(idx, f, rel, env) {
  let T = null;   // what each tick ran, worked out only when a question fails
  const named = (tick) => { try { T ??= uncounted(env.counter, () => trace(env.Machine, env.program, f.recording)); return `, the store at tick ${tick} is instruction (${T.func[tick]}, ${T.at[tick]})`; } catch { return ''; } };
  for (const q of f.questions.filter((x) => x.kind === 'sources')) {
    const [tick] = q.args;
    const input = `${rel} (open it with node debug.mjs PROJECT ${rel}): sources(${tick})`;
    if (q.answer === 'throws') {
      let threw = false;
      try { idx.sources(tick); } catch (e) { if (String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw e; threw = true; }
      if (!threw) fail({ checked: 'sources throws for a tick that is not a store', input, observed: 'it returned a value', expected: 'an error: the instruction at that tick did not store anything' });
      continue;
    }
    let got;
    try { got = idx.sources(tick); } catch (e) { if (String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw e; fail({ checked: 'sources answers for a store', input, observed: `it threw: ${e.message}`, expected: 'the four lists' }); }
    for (const name of LISTS) {
      const list = got?.[name];
      const want = q.answer[name];
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) fail({ checked: `sources returns a ${name} list`, input, observed: show(got, 200), expected: '{ stores, answers, args, initial }, each an array' });
      if (list.length !== want.length || hashOf(f.salt, list) !== want.sha256) {
        fail({
          checked: `the ${name} list of the chain`, input: input + named(tick),
          observed: `your ${name}: ${show(list, 160)} (${list.length} entries)`,
          expected: list.length !== want.length ? `${want.length} entries` : `${want.length} entries, but not these ones (or not in increasing order without repeats)`,
          diff: `the other lists: ${LISTS.filter((n) => n !== name).map((n) => `${n} ${Array.isArray(got[n]) && got[n].length === q.answer[n].length && hashOf(f.salt, got[n]) === q.answer[n].sha256 ? 'right' : 'wrong'}`).join(', ')}`,
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

export const cases = [
  {
    id: '11.last-writer', title: 'lastWriter answers every generated question', timeLimitMs: 60000,
    requirement: 'lastWriter(address, beforeTick) returns the write by the instruction with the greatest tick below beforeTick that touched the byte, or null.',
    async run(env) {
      for (const rel of [...LOB, ...LOB2]) {
        const { idx, f } = await index(env, rel);
        for (const q of f.questions.filter((x) => x.kind === 'lastWriter')) {
          const got = idx.lastWriter(...q.args);
          const want = q.answer;
          const same = want === null ? got === null : got && ['tick', 'func', 'at', 'address', 'size'].every((k) => got[k] === want[k]);
          if (!same) fail({ checked: 'lastWriter names the last write of the byte before the tick', input: `${rel}: lastWriter(${q.args.join(', ')})`, observed: show(got), expected: show(want) });
        }
      }
    },
  },
  {
    id: '11.sources-lob', title: 'sources follows values on Lob', timeLimitMs: 60000,
    requirement: 'sources(tick) returns the stores, answers, call arguments and initial bytes on the value chain of the store at that tick, by the rules in API.md.',
    async run(env) { for (const rel of LOB) { const x = await index(env, rel); checkSources(x.idx, x.f, rel, x); } },
  },
  {
    id: '11.sources-lob2', title: 'sources follows values on Lob II', timeLimitMs: 60000,
    requirement: 'The same chains on Lob II, whose state is reached through two pointers and scrambled by adding a key.',
    async run(env) { for (const rel of LOB2) { const x = await index(env, rel); checkSources(x.idx, x.f, rel, x); } },
  },
  {
    id: '11.sources-rules', title: 'sources follows the rules Lob never tests', timeLimitMs: 30000,
    requirement: 'A small program exercises what the games do not: a global carrying a value, arguments into and results out of a defined function, a block that leaves a value, a branch that drops values, and a call argument stored directly.',
    async run(env) { for (const rel of MIXER) { const x = await index(env, rel); checkSources(x.idx, x.f, rel, x); } },
  },
  {
    id: '11.no-replay', title: 'questions are answered from the index, without replaying', timeLimitMs: 60000,
    requirement: 'buildIndex replays the recording at most about twice; answering questions afterwards runs no instruction.',
    async run(env) {
      const rel = LOB[0];
      const { idx, f, built, counter } = await index(env, rel);
      const end = f.about.instructions;
      if (built > 2 * end + 1000) fail({ checked: 'buildIndex replays the recording at most twice', input: `${rel}, a run of ${end} instructions`, observed: `${built} instructions`, expected: `at most ${2 * end + 1000}` });
      counter.reset();
      for (const q of f.questions) {
        try { if (q.kind === 'lastWriter') idx.lastWriter(...q.args); else idx.sources(...q.args); } catch (e) { if (String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw e; }
      }
      if (counter.count) fail({ checked: 'answering questions runs no instruction', input: `${f.questions.length} questions about ${rel}`, observed: `${counter.count} instructions run while answering`, expected: '0: everything a question needs was kept by buildIndex' });
      if (idx.end !== end) fail({ checked: 'index.end is the number of instructions in the run', input: rel, observed: show(idx.end), expected: String(end) });
    },
  },
];
```

```mjs
// Unit 12: stack and names. Names are compared with what the files hold; stacks,
// function stops and stepOut with a brute-force replay on your own machine.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fail, show, countSteps, readJson, courseRoot } from './harness.mjs';
import { trace, statesAt, scan, uncounted, loadRecording } from './trace.mjs';

export const title = 'Stack and names';
const rng = (seed) => { let x = seed >>> 0 || 1; return (n) => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x % n; }; };
const bytesOf = (rel) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, rel)));

async function setup({ cls }) {
  const Machine = await cls('machine.mjs', 'Machine');
  const Debugger = await cls('debugger.mjs', 'Debugger');
  const counter = countSteps(Machine);
  const { recording, program } = loadRecording('checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json');
  const T = uncounted(counter, () => trace(Machine, program, recording));
  return { Machine, counter, recording, program, T, d: new Debugger(program, recording) };
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/13.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 13: the ladder. Each case runs your investigations/N.txt through debug.mjs
// with your own files, counts every instruction your machine runs, and compares the
// answer it names with the first bad write of build N. The answers are kept only as
// slow salted hashes (scrypt, about a fifth of a second each), so this file cannot
// tell you what they are, and trying every store of a run would take hours.
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { scryptSync } from 'node:crypto';
import { fail, readJson, NOT_WRITTEN, courseRoot } from './harness.mjs';
import { runInvestigation } from '../debug.mjs';

export const title = 'The ladder';

const rungs = () => readJson('ladder.json');
const answers = () => readJson('checks/fixtures/13/answers.json');
export const answerKey = (salt, n, a) => scryptSync(`${a.func}:${a.at}:${a.address}:${a.tick}`, `${salt}:${n}`, 32, { N: 2 ** 17, r: 8, p: 1, maxmem: 256 * 1024 * 1024 }).toString('hex');

function commands(text) {
  return text.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith('#'));
}

export const cases = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => ({
  id: `13.build-${n}`,
  title: `investigations/${n}.txt names the first bad write of build ${n}`,
  timeLimitMs: 60000,
  requirement: `Run through debug.mjs, investigations/${n}.txt ends with an answer that names build ${n}'s first bad write (function, instruction, address and tick) and replays no more instructions than the build's budget.`,
  async run({ workDir }) {
    const rung = rungs().find((r) => r.n === n);
    const file = join(workDir, 'investigations', `${n}.txt`);
    if (!existsSync(file) || !commands(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).length) throw Error(`investigations/${n}.txt: ${NOT_WRITTEN} (lesson 13)`);
    let r;
    try {
      r = await runInvestigation(workDir, rung, readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
    } catch (e) {
      if (String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw e;
      fail({ checked: `investigations/${n}.txt runs to its end`, input: `node lab.mjs investigate PROJECT ${n}`, observed: `a command failed: ${e.message}`, expected: 'every command runs; end with answer' });
    }
    if (!r.answer) fail({ checked: `investigations/${n}.txt gives an answer`, input: `node lab.mjs investigate PROJECT ${n}`, observed: 'no answer command ran', expected: 'the script ends with answer, standing right after the first bad write' });
    // Standing right after a store at tick T means your machine ran at least T
    // instructions through step(); fewer means instructions ran uncounted.
    if (r.replayed < r.answer.tick) fail({ checked: `your machine ran the instructions the investigation of build ${n} stood on`, input: `node lab.mjs investigate PROJECT ${n}`, observed: `${r.replayed} instructions counted through Machine.step(), but your answer stands at tick ${r.answer.tick}`, expected: 'every instruction your machine runs goes through step() (API.md, machine.mjs)' });
    const key = answers();
    if (answerKey(key.salt, n, r.answer) !== key.builds[String(n)]) {
      fail({ checked: `the answer names build ${n}'s first bad write`, input: `node lab.mjs investigate PROJECT ${n}`, observed: `your answer: function ${r.answer.func}, instruction ${r.answer.at}, address ${r.answer.address}, tick ${r.answer.tick}`, expected: 'a different write: the earliest store whose value a correct build would not have written there. Check the function and instruction, then whether an earlier write on the same chain was already wrong.' });
    }
    if (rung.budget !== null && r.replayed > rung.budget) fail({ checked: `the investigation of build ${n} stays within its replay budget`, input: `node lab.mjs investigate PROJECT ${n}`, observed: `${r.replayed} instructions replayed`, expected: `at most ${rung.budget}` });
  },
}));

export { courseRoot };

```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/fixtures/08/first-steps.json`:


`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/harness.mjs`:

```mjs
// Shared helpers for the checks. A check either returns (pass) or throws a
// CheckFailure saying what was checked, the input, what was observed and what
// was required.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { loadProgram } from '../public/program.mjs';

export const courseRoot = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
export const NOT_WRITTEN = 'not written yet';

export class CheckFailure extends Error {
  constructor(fields) { super(fields.observed ?? 'check failed'); this.fields = fields; }
}
export function fail(fields) { throw new CheckFailure(fields); }

// Short, readable rendering of a value.
export function show(value, limit = 240) {
  const text = render(value);
  return text.length > limit ? text.slice(0, limit - 3) + '...' : text;
}
function render(value) {
  if (value === undefined) return 'nothing (undefined)';
  if (value === null) return 'null';
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return `${value}n`;
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) value = Array.from(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return '[' + value.map(render).join(', ') + ']';
  if (typeof value === 'string') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Object.is(value, -0)) return '-0';
  if (typeof value === 'object') return '{ ' + Object.entries(value).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${render(v)}`).join(', ') + ' }';
  return String(value);
}

export function same(a, b) {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(a)) a = Array.from(a);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(b)) b = Array.from(b);
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => same(x, b[i]));
  if (a && b && typeof a === 'object' && typeof b === 'object') {
    const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b);
    return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every(k => same(a[k], b[k]));
  }
  return Object.is(a, b);
}

export function firstDifference(observed, expected, path = '') {
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(observed)) observed = Array.from(observed);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(expected)) expected = Array.from(expected);
  if (Array.isArray(expected)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(observed)) return `${path || 'the value'} should be a list but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    const n = Math.min(observed.length, expected.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!same(observed[i], expected[i])) return firstDifference(observed[i], expected[i], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}position ${i}`);
    if (observed.length !== expected.length) return `${path ? path + ': ' : ''}yours has ${observed.length} entries, the required value has ${expected.length}`;
    return null;
  }
  if (expected && typeof expected === 'object') {
    if (!observed || typeof observed !== 'object') return `${path || 'the value'} should be an object but is ${show(observed, 60)}`;
    for (const k of Object.keys(expected)) if (!same(observed[k], expected[k])) return firstDifference(observed[k], expected[k], `${path}${path ? ', ' : ''}field ${k}`);
    const extra = Object.keys(observed).filter(k => !(k in expected));
    if (extra.length) return `${path ? path + ': ' : ''}yours has a field the required value lacks: ${extra[0]}`;
    return null;
  }
  return `at ${path || 'the value'}: yours is ${show(observed, 60)}, required ${show(expected, 60)}`;
}

export function expectSame(observed, expected, { checked, input, what = 'your result' }) {
  if (same(observed, expected)) return;
  fail({ checked, input, observed: `${what}: ${show(observed)}`, expected: show(expected), diff: firstDifference(observed, expected) });
}

// Run fn, expecting it to throw. A starter "not written yet" error is passed through.
export function thrown(fn) {
  try { fn(); } catch (error) {
    if (String(error?.message ?? '').includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw error;
    return error;
  }
  return null;
}

export function readJson(rel) { return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, rel), 'utf8')); }
export function program(name) { return loadProgram(readJson(`programs/${name}.json`)); }
export function wasmBytes(rel) { return new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(courseRoot, rel))); }

// Load learner modules from the work folder.
export function makeLoader(workDir) {
  const cache = new Map();
  async function load(file) {
    if (!cache.has(file)) {
      let mod;
      try {
        mod = await import(pathToFileURL(join(workDir, file)).href);
      } catch (error) {
        throw new CheckFailure({
          checked: `loading your ${file}`,
          observed: `${file} could not be loaded: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0].split(workDir).join('work')}`,
          expected: `${file} loads as an ES module (look for a syntax error or a misspelled import)`,
          loadError: true,
        });
      }
      cache.set(file, mod);
    }
    return cache.get(file);
  }
  async function get(file, name, kind = 'function') {
    const mod = await load(file);
    if (typeof mod[name] !== 'function') fail({ checked: `${file} exports ${name}`, observed: `${file} has no exported ${kind} named ${name}`, expected: `export ${kind === 'class' ? 'class' : 'function'} ${name} in ${file}` });
    return mod[name];
  }
  return { load, fn: (file, name) => get(file, name), cls: (file, name) => get(file, name, 'class') };
}

// Count every instruction your machine runs: patch Machine.prototype.step in this
// check process. Returns { count, reset() }. Every machine made from your class
// afterwards is counted, wherever your code makes it.
export function countSteps(MachineClass) {
  const proto = MachineClass.prototype;
  if (proto.__counted) return proto.__counted;
  const original = proto.step;
  if (typeof original !== 'function') fail({ checked: 'your Machine has a step() method', observed: 'Machine.prototype.step is not a function', expected: 'step() defined on the Machine class' });
  const counter = { count: 0, reset() { this.count = 0; } };
  proto.step = function (...args) { counter.count++; return original.apply(this, args); };
  Object.defineProperty(proto, '__counted', { value: counter });
  return counter;
}
```
