`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs the cases of one unit against a folder of learner files, one process per case,
// so an endless loop is stopped by a time limit and one case cannot disturb another.
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const UNITS = ['08', '09', '10', '11', '12', '13'];
export const DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS = 10000;

// The lesson section that teaches each check, from lessons/sections.json.
export function sectionFor(id) {
  let map;
  try { map = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(here, '..', 'lessons', 'sections.json'), 'utf8')).checks; } catch { return null; }
  const m = map[id];
  return m ? `lesson ${m.lesson}, "${m.section}"` : null;
}

export async function listCases(unit) {
  const { cases, title } = await import(`./${unit}.mjs`);
  return { title, cases };
}

function runCase(workDir, unit, c) {
  const limit = c.timeLimitMs ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT_MS;
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const child = fork(join(here, 'worker.mjs'), [], { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe', 'ipc'], execArgv: ['--max-old-space-size=1024', '--stack-size=4000'] });
    let done = false;
    let stderr = '';
    const started = Date.now();
    // Keep the end of stderr: after an uncaught error Node prints the error, its stack and then
    // its own version line, so the useful line is near the end but not last.
    child.stderr.on('data', d => { stderr = (stderr + d).slice(-8000); });
    const finish = r => {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      child.kill('SIGKILL');
      resolve({ ...r, ms: Date.now() - started });
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'timeout', limitMs: limit }), limit);
    child.once('message', finish);
    child.once('error', e => finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: e.message }));
    // 'close' comes after the IPC channel has delivered its last message; 'exit' can come first,
    // which would report a finished check as one that ended early.
    child.once('close', (code, signal) => { const why = lastErrorLine(stderr); finish({ id: c.id, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `the check process ended early (exit code ${code}${signal ? ', signal ' + signal : ''})${why ? ': ' + why : ''}` }); });
    child.send({ workDir, unit, caseId: c.id });
  });
}

// The line of a child's stderr that says what went wrong: the last line that names an error,
// else the last line that is neither a stack frame nor Node's version line.
function lastErrorLine(text) {
  const lines = text.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l && !/^at /.test(l) && !/^Node\.js v\d/.test(l));
  return [...lines].reverse().find((l) => /^\w*(Error|Exception)\b/.test(l)) ?? lines.at(-1) ?? '';
}

export async function runUnit(workDir, unit, { only = null, jobs = 1 } = {}) {
  const { title, cases } = await listCases(unit);
  const todo = cases.filter(c => !only || only.includes(c.id));
  const results = new Array(todo.length);
  let next = 0;
  const lane = async () => { while (next < todo.length) { const k = next++; const c = todo[k]; const r = await runCase(workDir, unit, c); results[k] = { ...r, title: c.title, reread: sectionFor(c.id), requirement: c.requirement }; } };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(jobs, todo.length)) }, lane));
  return { unit, title, results, pass: results.every(r => r.pass) };
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/trace.mjs`:

```mjs
// The checks' brute force for lessons 10 to 12: replay a recording once on YOUR
// machine, from tick 0, and keep what every instruction did. The checks compare
// your debugger's answers with scans over this trace.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readJson, program as loadNamed, countSteps } from './harness.mjs';
import { loadProgram } from '../public/program.mjs';

export const hash = (bytes) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');

// Answers imports from the recording in order.
export function answersFrom(program, recording) {
  let next = 0;
  const imports = {};
  for (const i of program.imports) imports[i.name] = () => recording.answers[next++].result;
  return imports;
}

// Run work() without its instructions counting towards your debugger's budget.
export function uncounted(counter, work) {
  const before = counter.count;
  try { return work(); } finally { counter.count = before; }
}

export function loadRecording(rel) {
  const recording = readJson(rel);
  return { recording, program: loadNamed(recording.program) };
}

// One pass: for instruction t (1-based) its function and position, and every write.
export function trace(Machine, program, recording) {
  const m = new Machine(program, answersFrom(program, recording));
  let cap = 1 << 20;
  let func = new Int32Array(cap), at = new Int32Array(cap), depth = new Int8Array(cap);
  const wTick = [], wAddress = [], wSize = [], wChanged = [], wMask = [];
  const callStart = [];
  let t = 0;
  for (const c of recording.calls) {
    callStart.push(t);
    m.begin(c.name, c.args);
    while (m.running) {
      const e = m.step();
      t = e.tick;
      if (t >= cap) { cap *= 2; const f = new Int32Array(cap); f.set(func); func = f; const a = new Int32Array(cap); a.set(at); at = a; const dd = new Int8Array(cap); dd.set(depth); depth = dd; }
      func[t] = e.func; at[t] = e.at; depth[t] = m.state.frames.length;
      for (const w of e.writes) { let mask = 0; w.before.forEach((b, k) => { if (b !== w.after[k]) mask |= 1 << k; }); wTick.push(t); wAddress.push(w.address); wSize.push(w.size); wChanged.push(mask !== 0); wMask.push(mask); }
    }
  }
  return { end: t, func, at, depth, callStart, writes: { tick: wTick, address: wAddress, size: wSize, changed: wChanged, mask: wMask } };
}

// Frames in progress at position p: depth[p] after instruction p (0 between calls and at 0).

// The next instruction at position p is instruction p + 1 (null at the end).
export const nextAt = (T, p) => (p < T.end ? { func: T.func[p + 1], at: T.at[p + 1] } : null);

// Which call position p belongs to: the call of instruction p + 1, or calls.length at the end.
export function callOf(T, p) {
  if (p >= T.end) return T.callStart.length;
  let lo = 0, hi = T.callStart.length - 1;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (T.callStart[mid] <= p) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1; }
  // Several calls can start at the same tick only if a call runs no instruction; none does.
  return lo;
}

// Positions where each kind of stop fires, as the API defines them.
export function firesAt(T, stops, p) {
  const kinds = [];
  const n = nextAt(T, p);
  if (n) {
    if ((stops.breakpoints ?? []).some((b) => b.func === n.func && b.at === n.at)) kinds.push('breakpoint');
    if ((stops.functions ?? []).some((f) => f === n.func && n.at === 0)) kinds.push('function');
  }
  return kinds;
}
export function watchFires(T, watches, p) {
  // instruction p (position p is right after it) changed a watched byte
  if (p < 1 || !watches?.length) return false;
  const W = T.writes;
  let lo = 0, hi = W.tick.length;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (W.tick[mid] < p) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; }
  for (let k = lo; k < W.tick.length && W.tick[k] === p; k++) {
    if (!W.changed[k]) continue;
    // A watch fires only when a byte inside its range changed.
    for (const w of watches) for (let b = Math.max(w.address, W.address[k]); b < Math.min(w.address + (w.size ?? 1), W.address[k] + W.size[k]); b++) if (W.mask[k] & (1 << (b - W.address[k]))) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function scan(T, stops, from, direction) {
  const kindsAt = (p) => { const k = firesAt(T, stops, p); if (watchFires(T, stops.watches, p)) k.push('watchpoint'); return k; };
  if (direction > 0) { for (let p = from + 1; p <= T.end; p++) { const k = kindsAt(p); if (k.length) return { tick: p, kinds: k }; } return { tick: T.end, kinds: ['end'] }; }
  for (let p = from - 1; p >= 0; p--) { const k = kindsAt(p); if (k.length) return { tick: p, kinds: k }; }
  return { tick: 0, kinds: ['start'] };
}

// The last write touching byte `address` by an instruction with tick <= p.
export function lastWriteAt(T, program, address, p) {
  const W = T.writes;
  for (let k = W.tick.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
    if (W.tick[k] > p) continue;
    if (W.address[k] <= address && address < W.address[k] + W.size[k]) return { tick: W.tick[k], func: T.func[W.tick[k]], at: T.at[W.tick[k]], address: W.address[k], size: W.size[k] };
  }
  return null;
}

// What happened at position p, for failure messages: the instruction that ran last
// (with its writes, and which watched bytes it changed) and the one that runs next.
export function describeTick(T, p, watches = []) {
  if (p < 0 || p > T.end) return `position ${p} is outside the run`;
  const parts = [];
  if (p >= 1) {
    const W = T.writes;
    const writes = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < W.tick.length; k++) if (W.tick[k] === p) {
      const changed = [];
      for (let b = 0; b < W.size[k]; b++) if (W.mask[k] & (1 << b)) changed.push(W.address[k] + b);
      const inWatch = changed.filter((a) => watches.some((w) => a >= w.address && a < w.address + (w.size ?? 1)));
      writes.push(`${W.size[k]} bytes at ${W.address[k]}, ${changed.length ? `changing ${changed.join(' ')}` : 'changing nothing'}${watches.length ? (inWatch.length ? ' (inside a watch)' : ' (none inside a watch)') : ''}`);
    }
    parts.push(`instruction ${p} was (${T.func[p]}, ${T.at[p]})${writes.length ? `, which wrote ${writes.join('; ')}` : ', which wrote nothing'}`);
  }
  const n = nextAt(T, p);
  parts.push(n ? `the next is (${n.func}, ${n.at})` : 'nothing runs next');
  return parts.join('; ');
}

// The machine state at each requested position, from one replay (positions sorted).
export function statesAt(Machine, program, recording, positions) {
  const want = [...new Set(positions)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const out = new Map();
  const m = new Machine(program, answersFrom(program, recording));
  let k = 0;
  const take = () => { while (k < want.length && want[k] === m.state.tick) { out.set(want[k], structuredClone(m.state)); k++; } };
  for (const c of recording.calls) {
    take();
    if (k >= want.length) break;
    m.begin(c.name, c.args);
    while (m.running) { m.step(); if (m.running) take(); }
  }
  take();
  return out;
}

export { countSteps, loadProgram };
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/checks/worker.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs one check case in its own process.
import { makeLoader, CheckFailure, NOT_WRITTEN } from './harness.mjs';

function whereInWork(error, workDir) {
  for (const line of String(error?.stack ?? '').split('\n')) {
    const i = line.indexOf(workDir);
    if (i >= 0) {
      const m = line.slice(i + workDir.length).match(/^\/?([^:]+):(\d+)/);
      if (m) return `${m[1]} line ${m[2]}`;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

process.on('message', async ({ workDir, unit, caseId }) => {
  let result;
  try {
    const { cases } = await import(`./${unit}.mjs`);
    const c = cases.find(x => x.id === caseId);
    await c.run({ ...makeLoader(workDir), workDir });
    result = { id: caseId, pass: true };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = String(error?.message ?? error);
    if (error instanceof CheckFailure) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'failure', fields: error.fields };
    else if (message.includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'not-written', message: message.split('\n')[0] };
    else result = { id: caseId, pass: false, kind: 'error', message: `${error?.name ?? 'Error'}: ${message.split('\n')[0]}`, where: whereInWork(error, workDir) };
  }
  process.send(result, (error) => process.exit(error ? 3 : 0));
});
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/debug.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// A command line for YOUR debugger: node debug.mjs PROJECT TARGET [SCRIPT]
//   PROJECT  your project folder (it uses your machine.mjs, recorder.mjs,
//            debugger.mjs, query.mjs and names.mjs)
//   TARGET   a ladder build number (1 to 6), or a recording file such as one
//            you saved with record()
//   SCRIPT   a file of commands, one per line; without it, commands are read
//            from the keyboard or from piped input. Type help for the list.
// Typed or piped commands carry on after an error. A script file stops at its
// first error. Every instruction your machine runs is counted; `cost` shows the count.
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { loadProgram } from './public/program.mjs';

const root = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const readJson = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
const NOT_WRITTEN = 'not written yet';

export const HELP = `Commands (FUNC is a function index or name; ADDR a byte address, decimal or 0x hex):
  where                 the tick, the call and the instruction that runs next
  stack                 the functions in progress, outermost first, each at the instruction
                        it runs next (a caller's is the one after its call)
  calls                 how many calls the run has
  call N                go to the start of call N (a binary search: about 20 seeks)
  seek TICK | step [N] | back [N]
  break FUNC[:AT]       stop before that instruction (without :AT, where a call to FUNC begins)
  watch ADDR [SIZE]     stop right after an instruction changes one of these bytes
  clear                 remove every breakpoint and watch
  continue | rcontinue  run forward / backward to the next stop
  finish                run until the current function returns
  read ADDR [SIZE] [u8|i32|f32|text]
  listing [FUNC:AT] [N] the instructions from N before AT to N after it (default: around
                        what runs next, with N 8)
  last-write ADDR       go to the last write of ADDR at or before here (your Debugger.lastWrite)
  who ADDR              the same question asked of your index (your query.mjs; builds it once)
  sources [N|all]       where the value stored by the instruction at this tick came from:
                        how many stores its chain holds, the newest N of them (default 8)
                        with tick, function and address, then its answers, call arguments
                        and initial bytes
  writes [N]            step N instructions forward (default 20), listing every byte each one
                        changed; the debugger then stands N instructions later
  getters               every getter's value at this point (between calls)
  diverge               the first call after which this build's getters differ from the good build's
  compare               this build's getters beside the good build's after the same calls (and,
                        for a build of Lob, its status line, message line and help text)
  answer                name the write made by the instruction at this tick as your answer
  cost                  instructions your machine has run so far, opening included
  help | quit
Typed or piped commands carry on after an error. A script file stops at its first error.`;

function counter(Machine) {
  const proto = Machine.prototype;
  if (proto.__counted) return proto.__counted;
  const original = proto.step;
  const c = { count: 0, reset() { this.count = 0; } };
  proto.step = function (...args) { c.count++; return original.apply(this, args); };
  Object.defineProperty(proto, '__counted', { value: c });
  return c;
}

// What a target needs: the program, the recording, the .wasm file to read names
// from, the line table if there is one, and the good build to compare with.
export function resolveTarget(target) {
  const rungs = existsSync(join(root, 'ladder.json')) ? readJson(join(root, 'ladder.json')) : [];
  const rung = typeof target === 'object' ? target : rungs.find((r) => String(r.n) === String(target) || r.recording === String(target).replace(/^\.\//, ''));
  if (rung) {
    const program = loadProgram(readJson(join(root, rung.program)));
    const wasm = join(root, rung.wasm);
    return { program, recording: readJson(join(root, rung.recording)), wasm, lines: null, good: goodBuild(program), label: rung.title };
  }
  const file = resolve(target);
  if (!existsSync(file)) throw Error(`No ladder build or recording named ${target}`);
  const json = readJson(file);
  // A check fixture holds its recording (and, for a small program, its listing) inside.
  const recording = json.recording ?? json;
  // A fixture may carry its own listing as an object; a plain recording names its program instead.
  const listing = json.program && typeof json.program === 'object' ? json.program : readJson(join(root, 'programs', `${recording.program}.json`));
  const program = loadProgram(listing);
  const named = join(root, 'targets', `${recording.program}-names.wasm`);
  const lines = join(root, 'lines', `${recording.program}.json`);
  const plain = join(root, 'targets', `${recording.program}.wasm`);
  // A fixture's small program (the mixer) has no .wasm beside it: then there are no names to read.
  const wasm = existsSync(named) ? named : existsSync(plain) ? plain : null;
  return { program, recording, wasm, lines: existsSync(lines) ? readJson(lines) : null, good: null, label: String(target) };
}

function goodBuild(program) {
  const names = program.exports.map((e) => e.name);
  if (names.includes('r_px')) return { wasm: join(root, 'targets', 'lob.wasm'), name: 'lob.wasm' };
  if (names.includes('g0')) return { wasm: join(root, 'targets', 'lob2.wasm'), name: 'lob2.wasm' };
  return null;
}

async function optional(dir, file) {
  const p = join(dir, file);
  if (!existsSync(p)) return null;
  return import(pathToFileURL(p).href);
}

export async function openSession(dir, target) {
  const t = resolveTarget(target);
  const { Machine } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'machine.mjs')).href);
  const cost = counter(Machine);
  const { Debugger } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'debugger.mjs')).href);
  const query = await optional(dir, 'query.mjs');
  const namesMod = await optional(dir, 'names.mjs');
  let names = {};
  try { if (namesMod && t.wasm) names = namesMod.functionNames(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(t.wasm))) ?? {}; } catch (e) { if (!String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) throw e; }
  const lineOf = (offset) => {
    if (!t.lines || !namesMod) return null;
    try { return namesMod.lineAt(t.lines.rows ?? t.lines, offset); } catch (e) { if (String(e.message).includes(NOT_WRITTEN)) return null; throw e; }
  };
  cost.reset();   // your Debugger's first pass, if it makes one, counts too
  const d = new Debugger(t.program, t.recording);
  try { void d.end; } catch { /* a Debugger not written yet says so where it's used */ }
  const opening = cost.count;
  return { t, Machine, cost, opening, d, query, names, lineOf, stops: { breakpoints: [], watches: [], functions: [] }, index: null, answer: null };
}

const num = (s) => { if (s === undefined) return undefined; const n = /^0x/i.test(s) ? parseInt(s, 16) : Number(s); if (!Number.isInteger(n)) throw Error(`${s} is not a whole number`); return n; };

function funcRef(S, text) {
  if (/^\d+$/.test(text)) return Number(text);
  const hit = Object.entries(S.names).find(([, n]) => n === text);
  if (!hit) throw Error(`No function named ${text}${Object.keys(S.names).length ? '' : ' (no names: write functionNames in names.mjs, lesson 12)'}`);
  return Number(hit[0]);
}

function describe(S, func, at) {
  if (func === null || func === undefined) return 'nothing: the run has ended';
  const f = S.t.program.func(func);
  const ins = f.code[at];
  const line = S.lineOf(f.offsets[at]);
  return `function ${func}${S.names[func] ? ` (${S.names[func]})` : ''}, instruction ${at}: ${ins.map(String).join(' ')}${line ? (line.line ? `  [line ${line.line}]` : '  [no line]') : ''}`;
}

// Imports that refuse to answer: a plain object with one function per import name (API.md), so a
// machine that lists its imports finds them all.
function refusingImports(program, why) {
  return Object.fromEntries(program.imports.map((i) => [i.name, () => { throw Error(why); }]));
}

function getterValues(S, state, program) {
  const m = new S.Machine(program, refusingImports(program, 'a getter asked the outside world'));
  const out = {};
  for (const e of program.exports) {
    if (e.kind !== 'func' || e.name.startsWith('game_')) continue;
    m.state = structuredClone(state);
    out[e.name] = m.invoke(e.name, []);
  }
  return out;
}

// The texts a build of Lob shows, each found through the getter that returns its
// address. Lob II's getters are named so they don't say what they hold, so its texts
// aren't shown.
const TEXTS = [['status line', 'r_line_ptr'], ['message line', 'r_msg_ptr'], ['help text', 'r_help_ptr']];

async function nodeGetters(wasm, calls, upTo, answers) {
  let next = 0;
  const env = {
    sin: (x) => answers ? answers[next++].result : Math.sin(x),
    cos: (x) => answers ? answers[next++].result : Math.cos(x),
    server_round: () => { if (!answers) throw Error('server'); return answers[next++].result; },
    server_wind: () => { if (!answers) throw Error('server'); return answers[next++].result; },
  };
  const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(readFileSync(wasm), { env });
  const snaps = [];
  const read = () => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(instance.exports).filter(([n, f]) => typeof f === 'function' && !n.startsWith('game_')).map(([n, f]) => [n, f()]));
  for (let k = 0; k < upTo; k++) { instance.exports[calls[k].name](...calls[k].args); snaps.push(read()); }
  // After the last call: each text, read from memory up to its terminating 0.
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(instance.exports.memory.buffer);
  const texts = {};
  for (const [label, getter] of TEXTS) {
    if (typeof instance.exports[getter] !== 'function') continue;
    const at = instance.exports[getter]() >>> 0, end = bytes.indexOf(0, at);
    texts[label] = Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(at, Math.min(end < 0 ? bytes.length : end, at + 400))).toString('latin1');
  }
  return Object.assign(snaps, { texts });
}

// The stores of a chain for `sources`: how many there are, then the newest few, newest first,
// each with its function and address. `sources` gives only ticks, so each shown store is found
// in the index by a byte it wrote: one walk back through every byte's writes between the oldest
// and the newest tick shown. It asks only lastWriter, so it replays nothing and costs nothing.
const SOURCES_SHOWN = 8;
function chainStores(S, ticks, limit) {
  if (!ticks.length) return ['stores: none'];
  const n = limit === undefined ? SOURCES_SHOWN : limit === 'all' ? ticks.length : num(limit);
  if (n < 1) throw Error('sources takes a number of stores to show, 1 or more, or all');
  const shown = ticks.slice(-n).reverse();
  const want = new Set(shown), found = new Map();
  const lo = shown.at(-1), hi = shown[0];
  const size = (S.t.program.memory?.min ?? 2) * 65536;
  for (let address = 0; address < size && found.size < want.size; address++) {
    for (let w = S.index.lastWriter(address, hi + 1); w && w.tick >= lo; w = S.index.lastWriter(address, w.tick)) {
      if (want.has(w.tick) && !found.has(w.tick)) found.set(w.tick, w);
    }
  }
  const head = shown.length === ticks.length
    ? `stores: ${ticks.length} on the chain, newest first:`
    : `stores: ${ticks.length} on the chain; the newest ${shown.length}, newest first (sources N shows N, sources all every one):`;
  return [head, ...shown.map((t) => {
    const w = found.get(t);
    return w ? `  tick ${t}: ${describe(S, w.func, w.at)} wrote ${w.size} byte${w.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} at ${w.address}` : `  tick ${t}`;
  })];
}

export async function command(S, text) {
  const [verb, ...a] = text.trim().split(/\s+/);
  const d = S.d;
  const here = () => { const w = d.where(); return `tick ${w.tick}, call ${w.call}${S.t.recording.calls[w.call] ? ` (${[S.t.recording.calls[w.call].name, ...S.t.recording.calls[w.call].args].join(' ')})` : ''}, next: ${describe(S, w.func, w.at)}`; };
  switch (verb) {
    case undefined: case '': return null;
    case 'help': return HELP;
    case 'where': return here();
    case 'stack': {
      const frames = d.stack();
      return frames.length ? frames.map((f, k) => `${k}: ${describe(S, f.func, f.at)}`).join('\n') : 'between calls: no functions in progress';
    }
    case 'calls': return `${S.t.recording.calls.length} calls; the run has ${d.end} instructions`;
    case 'call': {
      const n = num(a[0]);
      let lo = 0, hi = d.end;   // the first position whose where().call reaches n
      while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; d.seek(mid); if (d.where().call >= n) hi = mid; else lo = mid + 1; }
      d.seek(lo);
      return here();
    }
    case 'seek': d.seek(num(a[0])); return here();
    case 'step': d.step(num(a[0]) ?? 1); return here();
    case 'back': d.stepBack(num(a[0]) ?? 1); return here();
    case 'break': {
      const [f, at] = a[0].split(':');
      const func = funcRef(S, f);
      if (at === undefined) S.stops.functions.push(func); else S.stops.breakpoints.push({ func, at: num(at) });
      return `stops: ${JSON.stringify(S.stops)}`;
    }
    case 'watch': S.stops.watches.push({ address: num(a[0]), size: num(a[1]) ?? 1 }); return `stops: ${JSON.stringify(S.stops)}`;
    case 'clear': S.stops = { breakpoints: [], watches: [], functions: [] }; return 'no stops';
    case 'continue': { const r = d.continue(S.stops); return `${r.reason} at ${here()}`; }
    case 'rcontinue': { const r = d.continueBack(S.stops); return `${r.reason} at ${here()}`; }
    case 'finish': d.stepOut(); return here();
    case 'read': {
      const address = num(a[0]), kind = a[2] ?? (a[1] && !/^\d/.test(a[1]) ? a[1] : 'u8');
      const size = /^\d/.test(a[1] ?? '') || /^0x/i.test(a[1] ?? '') ? num(a[1]) : kind === 'i32' || kind === 'f32' ? 4 : kind === 'text' ? 64 : 1;
      const bytes = d.read(address, size);
      const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
      if (kind === 'i32') return Array.from({ length: size >> 2 }, (_, k) => view.getInt32(4 * k, true)).join(' ');
      if (kind === 'f32') return Array.from({ length: size >> 2 }, (_, k) => view.getFloat32(4 * k, true)).join(' ');
      if (kind === 'text') { const end = bytes.indexOf(0); return JSON.stringify(Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(0, end < 0 ? bytes.length : end)).toString('latin1')); }
      return Array.from(bytes).join(' ');
    }
    case 'listing': {
      let func, at, n = 8;
      if (a[0] && a[0].includes(':')) { const [f, x] = a[0].split(':'); func = funcRef(S, f); at = num(x); n = num(a[1]) ?? 8; }
      else { const w = d.where(); if (w.func === null) return 'at the end of the run: give FUNC:AT'; func = w.func; at = w.at; n = num(a[0]) ?? 8; }
      const f = S.t.program.func(func);
      const from = Math.max(0, at - n), to = Math.min(f.code.length - 1, at + n);
      const out = [];
      for (let k = from; k <= to; k++) out.push(`${k === at ? '>' : ' '} ${String(k).padStart(5)}  ${f.code[k].map(String).join(' ')}`);
      return `function ${func}${S.names[func] ? ` (${S.names[func]})` : ''}\n${out.join('\n')}`;
    }
    case 'last-write': {
      const w = d.lastWrite(num(a[0]));
      if (!w) return `nothing wrote byte ${a[0]} at or before tick ${d.tick}`;
      d.seek(w.tick);
      return `tick ${w.tick}: ${describe(S, w.func, w.at)} wrote ${w.size} bytes at ${w.address}`;
    }
    case 'who': {
      if (!S.query) return 'no query.mjs in this project';
      S.index ??= S.query.buildIndex(S.t.program, S.t.recording);
      const w = S.index.lastWriter(num(a[0]), d.tick + 1);
      if (!w) return `nothing wrote byte ${a[0]} at or before tick ${d.tick}`;
      d.seek(w.tick);
      return `tick ${w.tick}: ${describe(S, w.func, w.at)} wrote ${w.size} bytes at ${w.address}`;
    }
    case 'sources': {
      if (!S.query) return 'no query.mjs in this project';
      S.index ??= S.query.buildIndex(S.t.program, S.t.recording);
      const s = S.index.sources(d.tick);
      return [...chainStores(S, s.stores, a[0]), `answers: ${s.answers.map((k) => `${k} (${S.t.recording.answers[k].name})`).join(' ') || 'none'}`, `call arguments: ${s.args.map(([c, p]) => `call ${c} argument ${p}`).join(', ') || 'none'}`, `initial bytes: ${s.initial.join(' ') || 'none'}`].join('\n');
    }
    case 'writes': {
      const n = num(a[0]) ?? 20;
      if (n < 1 || n > 500) throw Error('writes takes 1 to 500 instructions');
      const out = [];
      const noWorld = refusingImports(S.t.program, 'outside world');
      for (let k = 0; k < n && d.tick < d.end; k++) {
        // Run the next instruction once more on a copy of the state, to see its writes,
        // even a store that rewrote the value it found; then move the debugger on.
        let ev = null;
        if (d.state().frames.length) {
          const m = new S.Machine(S.t.program, noWorld);
          m.state = d.state();
          try { ev = m.step(); } catch { ev = null; }
        }
        d.step(1);
        for (const w of ev?.writes ?? []) out.push(`tick ${d.tick}: ${describe(S, ev.func, ev.at)} wrote ${w.size} byte${w.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} at ${w.address}: ${w.before.join(' ')} -> ${w.after.join(' ')}`);
      }
      return out.length ? out.join('\n') : `no instruction wrote memory up to tick ${d.tick}`;
    }
    case 'getters': {
      if (d.state().frames.length) return 'getters can be read only between calls: use call N first';
      return Object.entries(getterValues(S, d.state(), S.t.program)).map(([k, v]) => `${k} = ${v}`).join('\n');
    }
    case 'diverge': case 'compare': {
      if (!S.t.good) return 'this target has no good build to compare with (open a ladder build by its number: node debug.mjs PROJECT N)';
      const calls = S.t.recording.calls;
      const upTo = verb === 'compare' ? d.where().call : calls.length;
      const ours = await nodeGetters(S.t.wasm, calls, upTo, S.t.recording.answers);
      let good;
      try { good = await nodeGetters(S.t.good.wasm, calls, upTo, null); } catch { return `${S.t.good.name} needs the server's answers on these calls, so it cannot be run beside this build`; }
      if (verb === 'compare') {
        if (!upTo) return 'no calls have run yet';
        const x = ours[upTo - 1], y = good[upTo - 1];
        const rows = Object.keys(y).map((k) => `${k.padEnd(14)} this build ${String(x[k]).padEnd(14)} ${S.t.good.name} ${y[k]}${Object.is(x[k], y[k]) ? '' : '   <- differs'}`);
        for (const [label] of TEXTS) {
          const a = ours.texts[label], b = good.texts[label];
          if (a === undefined && b === undefined) continue;
          if (a === b) rows.push(`${label.padEnd(14)} the same in both builds: ${JSON.stringify(a)}`);
          else rows.push(`${label.padEnd(14)} this build ${JSON.stringify(a)}`, `${''.padEnd(14)} ${S.t.good.name.padEnd(10)} ${JSON.stringify(b)}   <- differs`);
        }
        return rows.join('\n');
      }
      const skip = new Set(['r_state', 'r_trail_ptr', 'r_line_ptr', 'r_msg_ptr', 'r_help_ptr', 'g6', 'g7']);
      for (let k = 0; k < upTo; k++) {
        const diff = Object.keys(good[k]).filter((g) => !skip.has(g) && !Object.is(ours[k][g], good[k][g]));
        if (diff.length) return `after call ${k} (${[calls[k].name, ...calls[k].args].join(' ')}): ${diff.map((g) => `${g} is ${ours[k][g]} here, ${good[k][g]} in ${S.t.good.name}`).join('; ')}`;
      }
      return `the getters agree with ${S.t.good.name} after every call (addresses are left out: they differ by design)`;
    }
    case 'answer': {
      const t = d.tick;
      if (t === 0) throw Error('answer names the write of the instruction at this tick; you are at tick 0');
      d.seek(t - 1);
      const m = new S.Machine(S.t.program, refusingImports(S.t.program, 'the instruction at this tick is not a store'));
      m.state = d.state();
      const ev = m.step();
      d.seek(t);
      if (!ev.writes.length) throw Error(`the instruction at tick ${t} (${ev.op}) wrote nothing: answer must stand right after a store`);
      const w = ev.writes[0];
      S.answer = { func: ev.func, name: S.names[ev.func] ?? null, at: ev.at, address: w.address, size: w.size, tick: t };
      return `answer: function ${ev.func}${S.names[ev.func] ? ` (${S.names[ev.func]})` : ''}, instruction ${ev.at} (${ev.op}), address ${w.address}, tick ${t}`;
    }
    case 'cost': return `${S.cost.count} instructions run by your machine so far, ${S.opening} of them while your Debugger opened the recording`;
    default: throw Error(`Unknown command ${verb}. Type help.`);
  }
}

// Run an investigation script: used by node lab.mjs investigate and the checks.
export async function runInvestigation(dir, rung, script, { echo = false } = {}) {
  const S = await openSession(dir, rung);
  for (const raw of script.split('\n')) {
    const text = raw.trim();
    if (!text || text.startsWith('#')) continue;
    if (text === 'quit') break;
    if (echo) console.log(`> ${text}`);
    const out = await command(S, text);
    if (echo && out) console.log(out);
  }
  return { answer: S.answer, replayed: S.cost.count };
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const [dir, target, scriptPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (!dir || !target) { console.error('Usage: node debug.mjs PROJECT TARGET [SCRIPT]'); process.exit(2); }
  try {
    const S = await openSession(resolve(dir), target);
    console.log(`${S.t.label}: ${S.t.recording.calls.length} calls, ${S.d.end} instructions. Type help for commands.`);
    if (scriptPath) {
      for (const raw of readFileSync(scriptPath, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        const text = raw.trim();
        if (!text || text.startsWith('#')) continue;
        if (text === 'quit') break;
        console.log(`> ${text}`);
        // Stop at the first error, as lab.mjs investigate and the checks do.
        try { const out = await command(S, text); if (out) console.log(out); } catch (e) { console.log(`error: ${e.message}`); process.exitCode = 1; break; }
      }
    } else {
      // Commands from the keyboard or from piped input. The line iterator keeps lines
      // that arrive while a command runs, and ends at end of input (Ctrl-D) or Ctrl-C.
      // A command that fails prints its error, and the session carries on.
      const rl = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout, prompt: 'debug> ' });
      let open = true, waiting = false;   // waiting: a prompt is showing and no line has come yet
      rl.on('close', () => { open = false; if (waiting) process.stdout.write('\n'); waiting = false; });
      rl.on('SIGINT', () => rl.close());
      const ask = () => { if (open) { rl.prompt(); waiting = true; } };
      ask();
      for await (const text of rl) {
        waiting = false;
        // Piped input isn't echoed, so end the prompt's line before leaving.
        if (text.trim() === 'quit') { if (!process.stdin.isTTY) process.stdout.write('\n'); break; }
        try { const out = await command(S, text); if (out) console.log(out); } catch (e) { console.log(`error: ${e.message}`); }
        ask();
      }
      rl.close();
    }
  } catch (e) { console.error(e.message); process.exitCode = 2; }
}
```

```mjs
// Acceptance cases for lesson 13's new application; no changesOf is supplied.
// Every invocation copies the submitted files into a new attempt folder first,
// then checks that copy in a separate process with a time limit.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL, URL } from 'node:url';
import { loadRecording } from '../checks/trace.mjs';
// Plain reads and writes, not fs.copyFileSync: copying file metadata can fail
// with EPERM where the project folder belongs to another user.
const copyFileSync = (from, to) => writeFileSync(to, readFileSync(from));

const CASES = 6;
// One replay of the whole run, forward, plus room for one restore and a short
// replay back to where the question started.
const SLACK = 2000;
const FILES = [
  'machine.mjs',
  'recorder.mjs',
  'debugger.mjs',
  'changes.mjs',
  'PROJECT.json',
];
const checkerPath = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const promptPath = fileURLToPath(new URL('../lessons/13.md', import.meta.url));
const digest = (file) =>
  createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
function attemptIdentity(folder) {
  const route = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(join(folder, 'PROJECT.json'), 'utf8'),
  ).unit12_start_route;
  return {
    ...(['write', 'supplied'].includes(route)
      ? { unit12_start_route: route }
      : {}),
    format: 'ttd2-changes-attempt-1',
    application: 'changes',
    prompt: {
      file: 'lesson-13.md',
      sha256: digest(join(folder, 'lesson-13.md')),
    },
    checker: {
      file: 'check-changes.mjs',
      sha256: digest(join(folder, 'check-changes.mjs')),
    },
  };
}

const [directory, flag, help] = process.argv.slice(2);
const checkingSnapshot = directory === '--snapshot';
if (
  !directory ||
  (!checkingSnapshot && flag !== '--help-used') ||
  !help ||
  process.argv.length !== 5
) {
  console.error(
    'Usage: node examples/check-changes.mjs PROJECT --help-used "what helped"',
  );
  process.exit(2);
}

if (!checkingSnapshot) {
  const project = resolve(directory);
  let attempt;
  try {
    const identity = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(join(project, 'PROJECT.json'), 'utf8'),
    );
    if (identity.course !== 'time-travel-debugger-part-two')
      throw Error(`${directory} is not a debugger part two project`);
    for (const file of FILES)
      if (!existsSync(join(project, file)))
        throw Error(`${directory}/${file} is missing`);
    attempt = join(
      project,
      'attempts',
      `${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}-changes`,
    );
    mkdirSync(attempt, { recursive: true });
    for (const file of FILES)
      copyFileSync(join(project, file), join(attempt, file));
    if (existsSync(join(project, 'report.md')))
      copyFileSync(join(project, 'report.md'), join(attempt, 'report.md'));
    copyFileSync(promptPath, join(attempt, 'lesson-13.md'));
    copyFileSync(checkerPath, join(attempt, 'check-changes.mjs'));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Could not start the check: ${error.message}`);
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const evidence = attemptIdentity(attempt);
  const child = spawnSync(
    process.execPath,
    [checkerPath, '--snapshot', attempt, help],
    { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 120000, maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 },
  );
  process.stdout.write(child.stdout ?? '');
  process.stderr.write(child.stderr ?? '');
  let receipt;
  try {
    receipt = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(join(attempt, 'changes-receipt.json'), 'utf8'),
    );
  } catch {
    /* A timeout or early exit may not produce a receipt. */
  }
  const complete =
    receipt?.format === evidence.format &&
    receipt.unit12_start_route === evidence.unit12_start_route &&
    receipt.prompt?.sha256 === evidence.prompt.sha256 &&
    receipt.checker?.sha256 === evidence.checker.sha256 &&
    receipt.help_used === help &&
    Array.isArray(receipt.results) &&
    typeof receipt.pass === 'boolean';
  if (child.error || child.signal || !complete) {
    const message =
      child.error?.code === 'ETIMEDOUT'
        ? 'The check did not finish within 120 seconds; each question should replay the run about once.'
        : `Check process ended without a complete result: ${child.error?.message ?? child.signal ?? child.status}`;
    writeFileSync(
      join(attempt, 'changes-receipt.json'),
      JSON.stringify(
        {
          ...evidence,
          help_used: help,
          pass: false,
          results: [{ name: 'check process', pass: false, message }],
        },
        null,
        2,
      ) + '\n',
    );
    console.log(`FAIL ${message}\nSaved files and results in ${attempt}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const passed =
    receipt.pass &&
    receipt.results.length === CASES &&
    receipt.results.every((result) => result.pass === true);
  process.exit(child.status === 0 && passed ? 0 : 1);
}

// The child process: check the copied files in the attempt folder.
const attempt = resolve(flag);
const evidence = attemptIdentity(attempt);
assert.equal(
  digest(checkerPath),
  evidence.checker.sha256,
  'Checker changed after this attempt was saved',
);
const results = [];
const notWritten = (error) =>
  String(error?.message).includes('changesOf: not written yet');
const check = async (name, run) => {
  try {
    await run();
    results.push({ name, pass: true });
    console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = notWritten(error)
      ? 'changesOf is not written yet'
      : error.message;
    results.push({ name, pass: false, message });
    console.log(`FAIL ${name}: ${message}`);
  }
};

// One pass over a recording on the submitted Machine, before any counting: for
// every byte, each tick at which an instruction changed it, with the value before
// and after, and how many stores rewrote it with the value it already held.
function history(Machine, program, recording) {
  let next = 0;
  const imports = {};
  for (const { name } of program.imports)
    imports[name] = () => recording.answers[next++].result;
  const m = new Machine(program, imports);
  const initial = m.state.memory.slice();
  const changes = new Map();
  const same = new Map();
  for (const call of recording.calls) {
    m.begin(call.name, call.args);
    while (m.running) {
      const event = m.step();
      for (const w of event.writes)
        for (let i = 0; i < w.size; i++) {
          const a = w.address + i;
          if (w.before[i] === w.after[i]) {
            same.set(a, (same.get(a) ?? 0) + 1);
            continue;
          }
          if (!changes.has(a)) changes.set(a, []);
          changes.get(a).push([event.tick, w.before[i], w.after[i]]);
        }
    }
  }
  return { initial, changes, same, end: m.state.tick };
}

// The byte values at [address, address + size) at position t.
function valueAt(H, address, size, t) {
  const out = [];
  for (let a = address; a < address + size; a++) {
    let v = H.initial[a];
    for (const [tick, , after] of H.changes.get(a) ?? []) {
      if (tick > t) break;
      v = after;
    }
    out.push(v);
  }
  return out;
}

// Every tick at or before `here` that changed one of the bytes, with the bytes
// just before and just after it.
function expected(H, address, size, here) {
  const ticks = new Set();
  for (let a = address; a < address + size; a++)
    for (const [tick] of H.changes.get(a) ?? [])
      if (tick <= here) ticks.add(tick);
  return [...ticks]
    .sort((x, y) => x - y)
    .map((tick) => ({
      tick,
      before: valueAt(H, address, size, tick - 1),
      after: valueAt(H, address, size, tick),
    }));
}

try {
  const load = (file) => import(pathToFileURL(join(attempt, file)).href);
  const { Machine } = await load('machine.mjs');
  const { Debugger } = await load('debugger.mjs');
  const { changesOf } = await load('changes.mjs');
  assert.equal(
    typeof changesOf,
    'function',
    'Export changesOf(debugger, { address, size }) from changes.mjs',
  );
  let counting = false;
  let steps = 0;
  const step = Machine.prototype.step;
  Machine.prototype.step = function (...args) {
    if (counting) steps++;
    return step.apply(this, args);
  };
  const open = (fixture) => {
    const { recording, program } = loadRecording(fixture);
    const H = history(Machine, program, recording);
    const d = new Debugger(program, recording);
    return { H, d };
  };
  // Ask one question from `here` and compare with the pass above.
  const ask = (H, d, here, address, size) => {
    const want = expected(H, address, size, here);
    d.seek(here);
    steps = 0;
    counting = true;
    let got;
    try {
      got = changesOf(d, { address, size });
    } finally {
      counting = false;
    }
    const input = `changesOf(d, { address: ${address}, size: ${size} }) at position ${here}`;
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(got), `${input} returned ${got}, not an array`);
    const plain = got.map((c) => ({
      tick: c?.tick,
      before: Array.from(c?.before ?? []),
      after: Array.from(c?.after ?? []),
    }));
    assert.equal(
      plain.length,
      want.length,
      `${input} listed ${plain.length} changes; there are ${want.length}${want.length ? `, the first at tick ${want[0].tick}` : ''}`,
    );
    plain.forEach((c, k) =>
      assert.deepEqual(
        c,
        want[k],
        `${input}: change ${k + 1} is ${JSON.stringify(c)}; it should be ${JSON.stringify(want[k])}`,
      ),
    );
    assert.equal(
      d.tick,
      here,
      `${input}: the debugger must stand where it started, ${here}, not ${d.tick}`,
    );
    const budget = d.end + SLACK;
    assert.ok(
      steps <= budget,
      `${input} replayed ${steps} instructions; at most ${budget}, one replay of the run plus ${SLACK}`,
    );
    return want.length;
  };
  // The first 4-byte-aligned address that `test` accepts, with its changes up to here.
  const pick = (H, here, test) => {
    for (const address of [...H.changes.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
      if (address % 4) continue;
      const n = expected(H, address, 4, here).length;
      if (test(address, n)) return address;
    }
    throw Error('the check itself found no bytes to ask about (report this)');
  };

  const lob = open('checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json');
  const here = lob.H.end - 37;
  const word = (H, address, t) => {
    const b = valueAt(H, address, 4, t);
    return b[0] | (b[1] << 8) | (b[2] << 16) | (b[3] << 24);
  };
  const g = word(lob.H, 78112, here);

  await check(
    'bad questions are refused before moving or running',
    async () => {
      for (const bad of [
        { address: 131072, size: 1 },
        { address: 131070, size: 4 },
        { address: -1, size: 1 },
        { address: 100, size: 0 },
        { address: 100.5, size: 1 },
        { address: 100, size: 1.5 },
      ]) {
        lob.d.seek(here);
        steps = 0;
        counting = true;
        let refused = false;
        try {
          changesOf(lob.d, bad);
        } catch (error) {
          if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
          refused = true;
        } finally {
          counting = false;
        }
        assert.ok(refused, `refuse ${JSON.stringify(bad)}`);
        assert.equal(lob.d.tick, here, `${JSON.stringify(bad)}: do not move`);
        assert.equal(
          steps,
          0,
          `${JSON.stringify(bad)}: refuse before replaying`,
        );
      }
    },
  );

  await check('the pointer at 78112, changed only in game_init', async () => {
    assert.ok(ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, 78112, 4) > 0, 'the pointer changes');
  });

  await check(
    'a counter changed on every game frame, from the middle of the run',
    async () => {
      ask(lob.H, lob.d, Math.floor(here / 2), g + 72, 4);
    },
  );

  await check('nothing has run at position 0', async () => {
    ask(lob.H, lob.d, 0, g + 72, 4);
  });

  await check(
    'stores that rewrite the value already there are not changes',
    async () => {
      const address = [...lob.H.same.keys()]
        .sort((a, b) => a - b)
        .find(
          (a) =>
            (lob.H.changes.get(a) ?? []).filter(([t]) => t <= here).length >= 2,
        );
      assert.ok(
        address !== undefined,
        'the check itself found no byte to ask about (report this)',
      );
      ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, address, 1);
    },
  );

  await check('Lob II: a 4-byte value changed a few times', async () => {
    const lob2 = open('checks/fixtures/10/lob2-m1.json');
    const here2 = lob2.H.end - 101;
    const address = pick(lob2.H, here2, (a, n) => n >= 3 && n <= 50);
    ask(lob2.H, lob2.d, here2, address, 4);
  });
} catch (error) {
  results.push({
    name: 'load submitted files',
    pass: false,
    message: error.message,
  });
  console.log(`FAIL load submitted files: ${error.message}`);

const pass = results.length === CASES && results.every((result) => result.pass);
writeFileSync(
  join(attempt, 'changes-receipt.json'),
  JSON.stringify({ ...evidence, help_used: help, pass, results }, null, 2) +
    '\n',
```

```mjs
    'checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json',

  // One pass over the recording on the submitted Machine, before any counting:
  // the frames after every instruction and the instruction run at every tick.
  const T = trace(Machine, program, recording);
  // The line of every instruction of every function: the last row at or before
  // its offset, 0 for a line-0 row or before the first row.
  const lineOf = new Map();
  for (const f of program.functions)
    lineOf.set(
      f.index,
      f.offsets.map((offset) => {
        let line = 0;
        for (const row of rows) {
          if (row.offset > offset) break;
          line = row.line;
        }
        return line;
      }),
    );
  // At position p: the frames in progress, and the line of what runs next.
  const depth = (p) => T.depth[p];
  const line = (p) => (p < T.end ? lineOf.get(T.func[p + 1])[T.at[p + 1]] : 0);
  // The first later position that has fewer frames, or the same number and a
  // line of its own that differs from the start's. null between calls.
  const expected = (p) => {
    if (depth(p) === 0) return null;
    for (let q = p + 1; q <= T.end; q++) {
      if (depth(q) < depth(p)) return q;
      if (depth(q) === depth(p) && line(q) !== 0 && line(q) !== line(p))
        return q;
    }
    return T.end;
  };
  // The most frames between two positions.
  const deepest = (p, q) => {
    let most = 0;
    for (let k = p + 1; k < q; k++) most = Math.max(most, depth(k));
    return most;
  };
  // The first position from `from` that `test(p, q)` accepts.
  const pick = (from, to, test) => {
    for (let p = from; p < to; p++) {
      if (depth(p) === 0) continue;
      const q = expected(p);
      if (test(p, q)) return p;
    }
    throw Error(
      'the check itself found no position to ask about (report this)',
    );
  };

  let counting = false;
  let steps = 0;
  const step = Machine.prototype.step;
  Machine.prototype.step = function (...args) {
    if (counting) steps++;
    return step.apply(this, args);
  };
  const d = new Debugger(program, recording);
  const describe = (p) =>
    `position ${p} (${depth(p)} frames, next: function ${T.func[p + 1]}, instruction ${T.at[p + 1]}, line ${line(p)})`;
  // Ask from `here` and compare with the scan of the pass above.
  const ask = (here) => {
    const want = expected(here);
    d.seek(here);
    steps = 0;
    counting = true;
    let got;
    try {
      got = nextLine(d, program, rows);
    } finally {
      counting = false;
    }
    const input = `nextLine at ${describe(here)}`;
    assert.equal(
      got,

    );

      want,

    );

    assert.ok(
      steps <= budget,
      `${input} ran ${steps} instructions; it moves ${want - here}, so at most ${budget}`,
    );
    return got;
  };

  const later = T.callStart[61];

    async () => {
      for (const here of [T.callStart[60], T.end]) {
        d.seek(here);
        steps = 0;
        counting = true;

        try {

        } catch (error) {
          if (notWritten(error)) throw error;
          refused = true;
        } finally {
          counting = false;
        }
        assert.ok(

          `nextLine at position ${here}, between calls, must throw an error`,

        assert.equal(d.tick, here, `position ${here}: do not move`);
        assert.equal(

      }

          far = p;
```

```mjs
// One pass over a recording on the submitted Machine, counted separately from the
// search: for every byte, each tick at which an instruction changed it, and for
// every 4,096-byte page, the last tick any instruction wrote it.
function history(Machine, program, recording) {
  let next = 0;
  const imports = {};
  for (const { name } of program.imports)
    imports[name] = () => recording.answers[next++].result;
  const m = new Machine(program, imports);
  const initial = m.state.memory.slice();
  const changes = new Map();
  const pageLast = new Map();
  for (const call of recording.calls) {
    m.begin(call.name, call.args);
    while (m.running) {
      const event = m.step();
      for (const w of event.writes)
        for (let i = 0; i < w.size; i++) {
          const a = w.address + i;
          pageLast.set(a >> 12, event.tick);
          if (w.before[i] === w.after[i]) continue;
          if (!changes.has(a)) changes.set(a, []);
          changes.get(a).push([event.tick, w.before[i], w.after[i]]);
        }
    }
  }
  return { initial, changes, pageLast, end: m.state.tick };
}

// The byte values at [address, address + size) at position t.
function valueAt(H, address, size, t) {
  const out = [];
  for (let a = address; a < address + size; a++) {
    let v = H.initial[a];
    for (const [tick, , after] of H.changes.get(a) ?? []) {
      if (tick > t) break;
      v = after;
    }
    out.push(v);
  }
  return out;
}

// The greatest position before `here` where the bytes equal `equals`, or null.
// The bytes change only at the ticks in H.changes, so only those moments and
// the position just before each one need testing.
function brute(H, address, size, equals, here) {
  const moments = new Set([here - 1]);
  for (let a = address; a < address + size; a++)
    for (const [tick] of H.changes.get(a) ?? [])
      if (tick <= here) moments.add(tick - 1);
  const same = (t) =>
    valueAt(H, address, size, t).every((v, i) => v === equals[i]);
  const sorted = [...moments].filter((t) => t >= 0).sort((a, b) => b - a);
  for (const t of sorted) if (same(t)) return t;
  return null;
}

try {
  const load = (file) => import(pathToFileURL(join(attempt, file)).href);
  const { Machine } = await load('machine.mjs');
  const { Debugger } = await load('debugger.mjs');
  const { reverseFind } = await load('reverse-find.mjs');
  assert.equal(
    typeof reverseFind,
    'function',
    'Export reverseFind(debugger, { address, size, equals }) from reverse-find.mjs',
  );
  let counting = false;
  let steps = 0;
  const step = Machine.prototype.step;
  Machine.prototype.step = function (...args) {
    if (counting) steps++;
    return step.apply(this, args);
  };
  const open = (fixture) => {
    const { recording, program } = loadRecording(fixture);
    const H = history(Machine, program, recording);
    const d = new Debugger(program, recording);
    return { H, d };
  };
  // Ask one question from `here` and compare with the brute-force answer.
  const ask = (H, d, here, address, size, equals, budget = BUDGET) => {
    const want = brute(H, address, size, equals, here);
    d.seek(here);
    steps = 0;
    counting = true;
    let got;
    try {
      got = reverseFind(d, { address, size, equals });
    } finally {
      counting = false;
    }
    const input = `reverseFind(d, { address: ${address}, size: ${size}, equals: [${equals}] }) at position ${here}`;
    assert.equal(got, want, `${input} returned ${got}; the answer is ${want}`);
    assert.equal(
      d.tick,
      want === null ? here : want,
      `${input}: the debugger must stand at ${want === null ? 'the position it started from' : 'the answer'}, not ${d.tick}`,
    );
    if (want !== null)
      assert.deepEqual(
        [...d.read(address, size)],
        equals,
        `${input}: memory at the answer holds the value`,
      );
    assert.ok(
      steps <= budget,
      `${input} replayed ${steps} instructions; at most ${budget}, since a replay from position 0 would cost about ${here}`,
    );
    return got;
  };
  // A byte whose last change came `from` to `to` instructions before here, on a
  // page written as often as `pageTest` asks; equals is its value before that change.
  const pick = (H, here, from, to, pageTest) => {
    for (const [address, list] of [...H.changes].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) {
      const last = list.filter(([tick]) => tick <= here).at(-1);
      if (!last || here - last[0] < from || here - last[0] > to) continue;
      if (!pageTest(H.pageLast.get(address >> 12))) continue;
      return { address, equals: [last[1]], changed: last[0] };
    }
    throw Error('the check itself found no byte to ask about (report this)');
  };

  const lob = open('checks/fixtures/10/lob-m1.json');
  const here = lob.H.end - 37;

  await check(
    'a valid question works, and bad ones are refused before moving',
    async () => {
      const t = pick(lob.H, here, 3000, 9000, () => true);
      lob.d.seek(here);
      assert.equal(
        typeof reverseFind(lob.d, {
          address: t.address,
          size: 1,
          equals: t.equals,
        }),
        'number',
        'a value the byte held a few thousand instructions ago is found',
      );
      for (const bad of [
        { address: 131072, size: 1, equals: [0] },
        { address: 131070, size: 4, equals: [0, 0, 0, 0] },
        { address: 100, size: 0, equals: [] },
        { address: 100, size: 2, equals: [0] },
        { address: 100, size: 1, equals: [256] },
        { address: 100, size: 1, equals: [1.5] },
      ]) {
        lob.d.seek(here);
        steps = 0;
        counting = true;
        try {
          assert.throws(
            () => reverseFind(lob.d, bad),
            `refuse ${JSON.stringify(bad)}`,
          );
        } finally {
          counting = false;
        }
        assert.equal(lob.d.tick, here, `${JSON.stringify(bad)}: do not move`);
        assert.equal(
          steps,
          0,
          `${JSON.stringify(bad)}: refuse before replaying`,
        );
      }
    },
  );

  await check('a value held a few thousand instructions back', async () => {
    const t = pick(lob.H, here, 3000, 9000, () => true);
    ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, t.address, 1, t.equals);
  });

  await check(
    'a value last held in game_init, on a page nothing has written since',
    async () => {
      const t = pick(lob.H, here, 300000, Infinity, (last) => last < 100000);
      ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, t.address, 1, t.equals);
    },
  );

  await check('the value the bytes hold now, four bytes wide', async () => {
    const t = pick(lob.H, here, 300000, Infinity, (last) => last < 100000);
    const address = t.address - (t.address % 4);
    ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, address, 4, valueAt(lob.H, address, 4, here));
  });

  await check(
    'a value the bytes never held: null, and the debugger stays',
    async () => {
      const t = pick(lob.H, here, 300000, Infinity, (last) => last < 100000);
      const seen = new Set([lob.H.initial[t.address]]);
      for (const [, , after] of lob.H.changes.get(t.address)) seen.add(after);
      let never = 0;
      while (seen.has(never)) never++;
      ask(lob.H, lob.d, here, t.address, 1, [never], 4 * BUDGET);
    },
  );

  await check(
    'Lob II: a value held a few thousand instructions back',
    async () => {
      const lob2 = open('checks/fixtures/10/lob2-m1.json');
      const here2 = lob2.H.end - 101;
      const t = pick(lob2.H, here2, 3000, 9000, () => true);
      ask(lob2.H, lob2.d, here2, t.address, 1, t.equals);
    },
  );
} catch (error) {
  results.push({
    name: 'load submitted files',
    pass: false,
    message: error.message,
  });
  console.log(`FAIL load submitted files: ${error.message}`);
}
const pass = results.length === CASES && results.every((result) => result.pass);
writeFileSync(
  join(attempt, 'rfind-receipt.json'),
  JSON.stringify({ ...evidence, help_used: help, pass, results }, null, 2) +
    '\n',
);
console.log(`Saved files and results in ${attempt}`);
process.exitCode = pass ? 0 : 1;
```

```mjs
        () => trimRecording(lob, full, n),

      );

        before,
        'Changing the trimmed copy must not change the input',
      );

    assert.equal(out.hashes.length, middle);
    assert.equal(out.hashes.at(-1), full.hashes[middle - 1]);

    pass: false,
    message: error.message,
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/debugger-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 10 debugger: run backwards over one recording. API.md, "debugger.mjs", is
// the contract. Lesson 12 adds stack(), stepOut() and function stops to this file.
//
// Position t is the state after t instructions of the whole run, counted across
// calls. Between two calls no function is running, and the next instruction is
// the first one of the next call. The constructor replays the recording once and
// keeps a snapshot every `every` instructions; a page of memory that no
// instruction wrote since the previous snapshot is that snapshot's page object.
//
// Options: { every = 1000, pageSize = 4096, check = true }. With check, the first
// pass compares memory after every call with the recording's hash.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { Machine } from './machine.mjs';
import { recordedImports, ReplayDivergence } from './recorder.mjs';

export class Debugger {
  // region: constructor
  constructor(
    program,
    recording,
    { every = 1000, pageSize = 4096, check = true } = {},
  ) {
    whole(every, 'every', 1);
    whole(pageSize, 'pageSize', 1);
    this.program = program;
    this.recording = recording;
    this.every = every;
    this.pageSize = pageSize;
    // The function each call starts in: what runs next between calls.
    this.callFunc = recording.calls.map(
      (call) =>
        program.exports.find((e) => e.kind === 'func' && e.name === call.name)
          .index,
    );
    // One machine for the whole session. Its imports ask this.answers, which
    // restore() replaces, so a replay answers from the right place.
    const imports = {};
    for (const { name } of program.imports)
      imports[name] = (...args) => this.answers.imports[name](...args);
    this.machine = new Machine(program, imports);
    this.answers = recordedImports(program, recording, () => this.machine);
    this.snapshots = [];
    this.end = this.firstPass(check);
    this.restore(this.snapshots[0]);
  }

  get tick() {
    return this.machine.state.tick;
  }
  // endregion: constructor

  // region: first-pass
  firstPass(check) {
    const m = this.machine;
    const written = new Uint8Array(
      Math.ceil(m.state.memory.length / this.pageSize),
    );
    this.snapshots.push(this.capture());
    for (let k = 0; k < this.recording.calls.length; k++) {
      do {
        const event = this.forward();
        for (const w of event.writes) {
          const first = Math.floor(w.address / this.pageSize);
          const last = Math.floor((w.address + w.size - 1) / this.pageSize);
          for (let p = first; p <= last; p++) written[p] = 1;
        }
        if (m.state.tick % this.every === 0) {
          this.snapshots.push(this.capture(this.snapshots.at(-1), written));
          written.fill(0);
        }
      } while (m.running);
      if (check) this.checkCall(k);
    }
    return m.state.tick;
  }
  // endregion: first-pass

  // region: capture
  capture(previous = null, written = null) {
    const { memory, ...rest } = this.machine.state;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 0; p * this.pageSize < memory.length; p++) {
      const start = p * this.pageSize;
      pages.push(
        previous && !written[p]
          ? previous.pages[p]
          : memory.slice(start, start + this.pageSize),
      );
    }
    return {
      tick: rest.tick,
      pages,
      state: globalThis.structuredClone(rest),
      answered: this.answers.position(),
    };
  }
  // endregion: capture

  // region: restore
  restore(snapshot) {
    const bytes = snapshot.pages.reduce((n, page) => n + page.length, 0);
    const memory = new Uint8Array(bytes);
    snapshot.pages.forEach((page, p) => memory.set(page, p * this.pageSize));
    this.machine.state = {
      ...globalThis.structuredClone(snapshot.state),
      memory,
    };
    this.answers = recordedImports(
      this.program,
      this.recording,
      () => this.machine,
      snapshot.answered,
    );
  }
  // endregion: restore

  // rr's checksum mode: after each call, memory must be what the recording says.
  checkCall(k) {
    const want = this.recording.hashes?.[k];
    const { memory, tick } = this.machine.state;
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(memory).digest('hex');
    if (want !== undefined && hash !== want)
      throw new ReplayDivergence({
        tick,
        call: k,
        reason: `memory after call ${k} differs from the recording`,
      });
  }

  // region: move
  forward() {
    const m = this.machine;
    if (!m.running) {
      const call = this.recording.calls[m.state.calls];
      m.begin(call.name, call.args);
    }
    return m.step();
  }

  moveTo(t) {
    const snapshot = this.snapshots[Math.floor(t / this.every)];
    if (this.tick > t || this.tick < snapshot.tick) this.restore(snapshot);
    while (this.tick < t) this.forward();
  }

  seek(tick) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(tick) || tick < 0 || tick > this.end)
      throw RangeError(`seek: ${tick} is not a position from 0 to ${this.end}`);
    this.moveTo(tick);
    return this.tick;
  }

  step(n = 1) {
    this.moveTo(Math.min(this.end, this.tick + whole(n, 'step')));
    return this.tick;
  }

  stepBack(n = 1) {
    this.moveTo(Math.max(0, this.tick - whole(n, 'stepBack')));
    return this.tick;
  }
  // endregion: move

  read(address, size) {
    const memory = this.machine.state.memory;
    if (
      !Number.isInteger(address) ||
      !Number.isInteger(size) ||
      address < 0 ||
      size < 0 ||
      address + size > memory.length
    )
      throw RangeError(
        `read: ${size} bytes at ${address} are not inside memory`,
      );
    return memory.slice(address, address + size);
  }

  // The instruction that runs next: the innermost frame's or, between calls, the
  // first instruction of the next call's function. null at end.
  nextInstruction() {
    const { frames, calls } = this.machine.state;
    const top = frames.at(-1);
    if (top) return { func: top.func, at: top.at };
    if (calls < this.callFunc.length)
      return { func: this.callFunc[calls], at: 0 };
    return null;
  }

  where() {
    const { frames, calls } = this.machine.state;
    const next = this.nextInstruction();
    return {
      tick: this.tick,
      call: frames.length ? calls - 1 : calls,
      func: next ? next.func : null,
      at: next ? next.at : null,
    };
  }

  state() {
    return globalThis.structuredClone(this.machine.state);
  }

  // region: stops
  stopHere({ breakpoints = [], watches = [] }, event) {
    if (event && event.writes.some((w) => changesWatched(w, watches)))
      return 'watchpoint';
    const next = this.nextInstruction();
    if (
      next &&
      breakpoints.some((b) => b.func === next.func && b.at === next.at)
    )
      return 'breakpoint';
    return null;
  }

  continue(stops = {}) {
    while (this.tick < this.end) {
      const event = this.forward();
      const reason = this.stopHere(stops, event);
      if (reason) return { reason, tick: this.tick };
    }
    return { reason: 'end', tick: this.tick };
  }
  // endregion: stops

  // region: search-back
  continueBack(stops = {}) {
    const here = this.tick;
    if (here === 0) return { reason: 'start', tick: 0 };
    const pages = (stops.watches ?? []).flatMap((w) =>
      pagesOf(w.address, w.size ?? 1, this.pageSize),
    );
    const watchesOnly = !stops.breakpoints?.length;
    const found = this.searchBack(
      here - 1,
      (event) => {
        const reason = this.stopHere(stops, event);
        return reason ? { reason, tick: this.tick } : null;
      },
      (i) => !watchesOnly || this.mayHaveWritten(i, pages),
    );
    if (found) {
      this.moveTo(found.tick);
      return found;
    }
    this.moveTo(0);
    return { reason: this.stopHere(stops, null) ?? 'start', tick: 0 };
  }

  searchBack(last, test, mayMatch = () => true) {
    for (let i = Math.ceil(last / this.every) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!mayMatch(i)) continue;
      const snapshot = this.snapshots[i];
      const stop = Math.min(last, snapshot.tick + this.every);
      this.restore(snapshot);
      let found = null;
      while (this.tick < stop) {
        const finding = test(this.forward());
        if (finding) found = finding;
      }
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  mayHaveWritten(i, pages) {
    const a = this.snapshots[i];
    const b = this.snapshots[i + 1];
    return !b || pages.some((p) => a.pages[p] !== b.pages[p]);
  }
  // endregion: search-back

  // region: last-write
  lastWrite(address) {
    const size = this.machine.state.memory.length;
    if (!Number.isInteger(address) || address < 0 || address >= size)
      throw RangeError(`lastWrite: ${address} is not an address inside memory`);
    const back = this.capture();
    const page = Math.floor(address / this.pageSize);
    const found = this.searchBack(
      back.tick,
      (event) => {
        const w = event.writes.findLast(
          (w) => address >= w.address && address < w.address + w.size,
        );
        if (!w) return null;
        const { tick, func, at } = event;
        return { tick, func, at, address: w.address, size: w.size };
      },
      (i) => this.mayHaveWritten(i, [page]),
    );
    this.restore(back);
    return found;
  }
  // endregion: last-write

  // region: stack
  stack() {
    throw Error('stack: not written yet (lesson 12)');
  }
  // endregion: stack

  // region: step-out
  stepOut() {
    throw Error('stepOut: not written yet (lesson 12)');
  }
  // endregion: step-out
}

// Whether a write changed a byte inside one of the watched ranges. A byte the
// store rewrote with the same value does not count. A watch without a size
// watches one byte.
function changesWatched(write, watches) {
  for (let i = 0; i < write.size; i++) {
    const byte = write.address + i;
    if (
      write.before[i] !== write.after[i] &&
      watches.some((w) => byte >= w.address && byte < w.address + (w.size ?? 1))
    )
      return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// The pages that hold the bytes [address, address + size).
function pagesOf(address, size, pageSize) {
  const pages = [];
  const last = Math.floor((address + size - 1) / pageSize);
  for (let p = Math.floor(address / pageSize); p <= last; p++) pages.push(p);
  return pages;
}

function whole(n, what, least = 0) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < least)
    throw RangeError(
      `${what}: ${n} is not a whole number of at least ${least}`,
    );
  return n;
}
```
