`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/machine-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 08 Machine. Runs the program listings in programs/*.json
// one instruction at a time, keeping everything it knows in one plain object
// (machine.state), so a debugger can copy, compare and restore it.
//
// state = { memory, globals, stack, frames, tick, calls, result }
//   memory  Uint8Array, the linear memory
//   globals the global variables (numbers)
//   stack   the value stack (numbers; an i64 is a BigInt)
//   frames  one entry per function call in progress, innermost last:
//           { func, at, locals, base, labels }, labels = [{ end, height, arity, loop }]
//   tick    instructions executed since the machine was made
//   calls   export calls started
//   result  what the last finished export call returned (undefined for none)
const PAGE = 65536;

// The course hands the machine a program already loaded (public/program.mjs
// loadProgram). A raw listing is accepted too and loaded the same way here, so
// this file needs nothing but itself.
export function loaded(program) {
  if (program?.loaded === true) return program;
  if (program?.format !== 'ttd2-program-1')
    throw Error('Machine: not a program listing (format ttd2-program-1)');
  const p = globalThis.structuredClone(program);
  for (const f of p.functions)
    f.code = f.code.map((ins) =>
      ins[0] === 'i64.const'
        ? [ins[0], BigInt(String(ins[1]).replace(/n$/, ''))]
        : ins,
    );
  p.data = p.data.map((d) => ({
    offset: d.offset,
    bytes:
      typeof d.bytes === 'string'
        ? Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(d.bytes, 'hex'))
        : d.bytes,
  }));
  const byIndex = new Map(p.functions.map((f) => [f.index, f]));
  Object.defineProperties(p, {
    loaded: { value: true },
    func: { value: (index) => byIndex.get(index) },
    typeOf: {
      value: (index) =>
        index < p.imports.length
          ? p.types[p.imports[index].type]
          : p.types[byIndex.get(index)?.type],
    },
    exportIndex: {
      value: (name) =>
        p.exports.find((x) => x.kind === 'func' && x.name === name)?.index,
    },
  });
  return p;
}

export class Machine {
  constructor(program, imports = {}) {
    this.program = loaded(program);
    // Per function: a number for each instruction (faster to switch on than its name)
    // and, for each block, the position of its matching end.
    this.prepared = new Map(
      this.program.functions.map((f) => [f.index, prepare(f)]),
    );
    this.imports = this.program.imports.map((i) => {
      const f = imports[i.name];
      if (typeof f !== 'function')
        throw Error(`Machine: no function given for the import ${i.name}`);
      return f;
    });
    // region: initial-state
    const memory = new Uint8Array(this.program.memory.min * PAGE);
    for (const d of this.program.data) memory.set(d.bytes, d.offset);
    this.state = {
      memory,
      globals: this.program.globals.map((g) => g.init),
      stack: [],
      frames: [],
      tick: 0,
      calls: 0,
      result: undefined,
    };
    // endregion: initial-state
  }

  // region: call-entry
  get running() {
    return this.state.frames.length > 0;
  }

  // Start a call to an export. Nothing runs until step().
  begin(name, args = []) {
    if (this.running)
      throw Error(`Machine: ${name} called while another call is unfinished`);
    const e = this.program.exports.find(
      (x) => x.name === name && x.kind === 'func',
    );
    if (!e) throw Error(`Machine: no exported function named ${name}`);
    const type = this.program.typeOf(e.index);
    if (args.length !== type.params.length)
      throw Error(
        `Machine: ${name} takes ${type.params.length} arguments, got ${args.length}`,
      );
    this.state.calls++;
    this.state.result = undefined;
    this.enter(
      e.index,
      args.map((a, i) => coerce(type.params[i], a)),
    );
  }

  // Run a whole export call and return its result.
  invoke(name, args = []) {
    this.begin(name, args);
    while (this.running) this.step();
    return this.state.result;
  }

  enter(index, args) {
    const fn = this.prepared.get(index);
    const locals = [...args, ...fn.locals.map(zeroOf)];
    this.state.frames.push({
      func: index,
      at: 0,
      locals,
      base: this.state.stack.length,
      labels: [],
    });
  }
  // endregion: call-entry

  // Execute one instruction. Returns { tick, func, at, op, writes }, where each
  // write is { address, size, before, after } with before and after as byte arrays.
  // region: step-start
  step() {
    const s = this.state;
    const frame = s.frames[s.frames.length - 1];
    if (!frame)
      throw Error('Machine: no call in progress; use begin(name, args) first');
    const fn = this.prepared.get(frame.func);
    const at = frame.at;
    const ins = fn.code[at];
    const op = fn.ops[at];
    const event = {
      tick: s.tick + 1,
      func: frame.func,
      at,
      op: ins[0],
      writes: [],
    };
    const st = s.stack;
    frame.at = at + 1;
    // endregion: step-start
    switch (op) {
      case 0:
        /* block */ frame.labels.push({
          end: fn.ends[at],
          height: st.length,
          arity: ins[1] ? 1 : 0,
          loop: false,
        });
        break;
      case 1:
        /* loop */ frame.labels.push({
          end: at,
          height: st.length,
          arity: 0,
          loop: true,
        });
        break;
      case 2:
        /* br */ this.branch(frame, ins[1]);
        break;
      case 3:
        /* br_if */ if (st.pop() !== 0) this.branch(frame, ins[1]);
        break;
      case 4 /* end */:
        if (frame.labels.length) frame.labels.pop();
        else this.leave(frame);
        break;
      case 5:
        /* return */ this.leave(frame);
        break;
      case 6: /* call */ {
        const callee = ins[1];
        const type = this.program.typeOf(callee);
        const args = st.splice(
          st.length - type.params.length,
          type.params.length,
        );
        if (callee < this.imports.length) {
          const r = this.imports[callee](...args);
          if (type.results.length) st.push(coerce(type.results[0], r));
        } else this.enter(callee, args);
        break;
      }
      case 7:
        /* local.get */ st.push(frame.locals[ins[1]]);
        break;
      case 8:
        /* local.set */ frame.locals[ins[1]] = st.pop();
        break;
      case 9:
        /* local.tee */ frame.locals[ins[1]] = st[st.length - 1];
        break;
      case 10:
        /* global.get */ st.push(s.globals[ins[1]]);
        break;
      case 11:
        /* global.set */ s.globals[ins[1]] = st.pop();
        break;
      case 12: /* select */ {
        const c = st.pop(),
          b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(c !== 0 ? a : b);
        break;
      }
      case 13:
        /* i32.const */ st.push(ins[1]);
        break;
      case 14:
        /* i64.const */ st.push(ins[1]);
        break;
      case 15:
        /* f32.const */ st.push(Math.fround(ins[1]));
        break;
      // loads: [align, offset]
      case 20:
        st.push(this.view(st.pop(), ins[2], 4).getInt32(0, true));
        break; // i32.load
      case 21:
        st.push(this.view(st.pop(), ins[2], 1).getUint8(0));
        break; // i32.load8_u
      case 22:
        st.push(this.view(st.pop(), ins[2], 4).getFloat32(0, true));
        break; // f32.load
      // stores: [align, offset]
      case 30: {
        const v = st.pop();
        this.store(event, st.pop(), ins[2], 4, (d) => d.setInt32(0, v, true));
        break;
      } // i32.store
      case 31: {
        const v = st.pop();
        this.store(event, st.pop(), ins[2], 1, (d) => d.setUint8(0, v & 255));
        break;
      } // i32.store8
      case 32: {
        const v = st.pop();
        this.store(event, st.pop(), ins[2], 2, (d) =>
          d.setUint16(0, v & 65535, true),
        );
        break;
      } // i32.store16
      case 33: {
        const v = st.pop();
        this.store(event, st.pop(), ins[2], 4, (d) => d.setFloat32(0, v, true));
        break;
      } // f32.store
      case 34: {
        const v = st.pop();
        this.store(event, st.pop(), ins[2], 8, (d) =>
          d.setBigInt64(0, v, true),
        );
        break;
      } // i64.store
      // i32 arithmetic and comparisons
      case 40:
        st.push(st.pop() === 0 ? 1 : 0);
        break; // i32.eqz
      case 41: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a !== b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.ne
      case 42: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a < b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.lt_s
      case 43: {
        const b = st.pop() >>> 0,
          a = st.pop() >>> 0;
        st.push(a < b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.lt_u
      case 44: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a > b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.gt_s
      case 45: {
        const b = st.pop() >>> 0,
          a = st.pop() >>> 0;
        st.push(a > b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.gt_u
      case 46: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a <= b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.le_s
      case 47: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a >= b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // i32.ge_s
      case 48: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push((a + b) | 0);
        break;
      } // i32.add
      case 49: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push((a - b) | 0);
        break;
      } // i32.sub
      case 50: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(Math.imul(a, b));
        break;
      } // i32.mul
      case 51: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop(); // i32.div_s
        if (b === 0) throw trap('integer divide by zero');
        if (a === -2147483648 && b === -1) throw trap('integer overflow');
        st.push((a / b) | 0);
        break;
      }
      case 52: {
        const b = st.pop() >>> 0,
          a = st.pop() >>> 0; // i32.div_u
        if (b === 0) throw trap('integer divide by zero');
        st.push(Math.floor(a / b) | 0);
        break;
      }
      case 53: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop(); // i32.rem_s
        if (b === 0) throw trap('integer divide by zero');
        st.push(b === -1 ? 0 : (a % b) | 0);
        break;
      }
      case 54: {
        const b = st.pop() >>> 0,
          a = st.pop() >>> 0; // i32.rem_u
        if (b === 0) throw trap('integer divide by zero');
        st.push((a % b) | 0);
        break;
      }
      case 55: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a & b);
        break;
      } // i32.and
      case 56: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a | b);
        break;
      } // i32.or
      case 57: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a ^ b);
        break;
      } // i32.xor
      case 58: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a << (b & 31));
        break;
      } // i32.shl
      case 59: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a >> (b & 31));
        break;
      } // i32.shr_s
      case 60: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push((a >>> (b & 31)) | 0);
        break;
      } // i32.shr_u
      // f32
      case 70: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(Math.fround(a + b));
        break;
      } // f32.add
      case 71: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(Math.fround(a - b));
        break;
      } // f32.sub
      case 72: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(Math.fround(a * b));
        break;
      } // f32.mul
      case 73: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(Math.fround(a / b));
        break;
      } // f32.div
      case 74:
        st.push(Math.fround(Math.sqrt(st.pop())));
        break; // f32.sqrt
      case 75:
        st.push(-st.pop());
        break; // f32.neg
      case 76: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a < b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // f32.lt
      case 77: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a > b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // f32.gt
      case 78: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a <= b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // f32.le
      case 79: {
        const b = st.pop(),
          a = st.pop();
        st.push(a >= b ? 1 : 0);
        break;
      } // f32.ge
      case 80:
        st.push(Math.fround(st.pop()));
        break; // f32.convert_i32_s
      case 81:
        st.push(Math.fround(st.pop() >>> 0));
        break; // f32.convert_i32_u
      case 82:
        st.push(Math.fround(st.pop()));
        break; // f32.demote_f64
      case 83:
        break; // f64.promote_f32
      case 84: {
        SCRATCH.setFloat32(0, st.pop(), true);
        st.push(SCRATCH.getInt32(0, true));
        break;
      } // i32.reinterpret_f32
      case 85: {
        SCRATCH.setInt32(0, st.pop(), true);
        st.push(SCRATCH.getFloat32(0, true));
        break;
      } // f32.reinterpret_i32
      case 86: {
        const x = st.pop(); // i32.trunc_sat_f32_s
        st.push(
          Number.isNaN(x)
            ? 0
            : x >= 2147483647
              ? 2147483647
              : x <= -2147483648
                ? -2147483648
                : Math.trunc(x) | 0,
        );
        break;
      }
      default:
        throw Error(`Machine: instruction ${ins[0]} is not supported`);
    }
    s.tick++;
    return event;
  }

  // region: branch
  branch(frame, depth) {
    const st = this.state.stack;
    // A branch past every open block targets the function body itself: it returns.
    if (depth === frame.labels.length) {
      this.leave(frame);
      return;
    }
    const label = frame.labels[frame.labels.length - 1 - depth];
    const kept = label.arity ? st.slice(st.length - label.arity) : [];
    st.length = label.height;
    st.push(...kept);
    if (label.loop) {
      frame.labels.length -= depth; // keep the loop's own label
      frame.at = label.end + 1; // back to the first instruction inside the loop
    } else {
      frame.labels.length -= depth + 1;
      frame.at = label.end + 1; // just past the block's end
    }
  }
  // endregion: branch

  // region: return-frame
  leave(frame) {
    const s = this.state;
    const type = this.program.typeOf(frame.func);
    const results = type.results.length
      ? s.stack.slice(s.stack.length - type.results.length)
      : [];
    s.stack.length = frame.base;
    s.frames.pop();
    if (s.frames.length) s.stack.push(...results);
    else s.result = results[0];
  }
  // endregion: return-frame

  // region: memory
  view(base, offset, size) {
    const address = (base >>> 0) + offset;
    const memory = this.state.memory;
    if (address + size > memory.length)
      throw trap(`out of bounds memory access at ${address}`);
    return new DataView(memory.buffer, memory.byteOffset + address, size);
  }

  store(event, base, offset, size, write) {
    const view = this.view(base, offset, size);
    const address = view.byteOffset - this.state.memory.byteOffset;
    const before = Array.from(
      this.state.memory.subarray(address, address + size),
    );
    write(view);
    event.writes.push({
      address,
      size,
      before,
      after: Array.from(this.state.memory.subarray(address, address + size)),
    });
  }
  // endregion: memory
}

const SCRATCH = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));
function trap(message) {
  const e = Error(`trap: ${message}`);
  e.trap = true;
  return e;
}
function zeroOf(type) {
  return type === 'i64' ? 0n : 0;
}
function coerce(type, v) {
  if (type === 'i32') return v | 0;
  if (type === 'f32') return Math.fround(v);
  if (type === 'i64') return BigInt.asIntN(64, BigInt(v));
  return +v;
}
const OPS = {
  block: 0,
  loop: 1,
  br: 2,
  br_if: 3,
  end: 4,
  return: 5,
  call: 6,
  'local.get': 7,
  'local.set': 8,
  'local.tee': 9,
  'global.get': 10,
  'global.set': 11,
  select: 12,
  'i32.const': 13,
  'i64.const': 14,
  'f32.const': 15,
  'i32.load': 20,
  'i32.load8_u': 21,
  'f32.load': 22,
  'i32.store': 30,
  'i32.store8': 31,
  'i32.store16': 32,
  'f32.store': 33,
  'i64.store': 34,
  'i32.eqz': 40,
  'i32.ne': 41,
  'i32.lt_s': 42,
  'i32.lt_u': 43,
  'i32.gt_s': 44,
  'i32.gt_u': 45,
  'i32.le_s': 46,
  'i32.ge_s': 47,
  'i32.add': 48,
  'i32.sub': 49,
  'i32.mul': 50,
  'i32.div_s': 51,
  'i32.div_u': 52,
  'i32.rem_s': 53,
  'i32.rem_u': 54,
  'i32.and': 55,
  'i32.or': 56,
  'i32.xor': 57,
  'i32.shl': 58,
  'i32.shr_s': 59,
  'i32.shr_u': 60,
  'f32.add': 70,
  'f32.sub': 71,
  'f32.mul': 72,
  'f32.div': 73,
  'f32.sqrt': 74,
  'f32.neg': 75,
  'f32.lt': 76,
  'f32.gt': 77,
  'f32.le': 78,
  'f32.ge': 79,
  'f32.convert_i32_s': 80,
  'f32.convert_i32_u': 81,
  'f32.demote_f64': 82,
  'f64.promote_f32': 83,
  'i32.reinterpret_f32': 84,
  'f32.reinterpret_i32': 85,
  'i32.trunc_sat_f32_s': 86,
};

function prepare(f) {
  const ops = f.code.map((ins) => {
    const n = OPS[ins[0]];
    if (n === undefined)
      throw Error(`Machine: instruction ${ins[0]} is not supported`);
    return n;
  });
  const ends = new Array(f.code.length).fill(-1);
  const open = [];
  f.code.forEach((ins, i) => {
    if (ins[0] === 'block' || ins[0] === 'loop') open.push(i);
    else if (ins[0] === 'end' && open.length) ends[open.pop()] = i;
  });
  return { code: f.code, ops, ends, locals: f.locals };
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/names-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 12: names and lines. API.md, "names.mjs", is the contract.
// functionNames reads the function names a .wasm file keeps in its "name"
// custom section; lineAt finds the C line of a file offset in a line table.
//
// A .wasm file is 8 fixed bytes ("\0asm" and a version), then sections: an id
// byte, the section's size in bytes, then its contents. Sizes, counts, indexes
// and lengths are LEB128 numbers; a name is its length followed by its bytes.

// Reads a .wasm file from a position, one value at a time.
class Reader {
  constructor(bytes, pos = 0) {
    this.bytes = bytes;
    this.pos = pos;
  }

  byte() {
    if (this.pos >= this.bytes.length)
      throw Error(`functionNames: the file ends early (at byte ${this.pos})`);
    return this.bytes[this.pos++];
  }

  // region: leb128
  // Unsigned LEB128: 7 bits per byte, lowest first. A byte with its top bit
  // set says another byte follows.
  u32() {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;
    do {
      b = this.byte();
      value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
      shift += 7;
    } while (b & 0x80);
    return value;
  }

  // A length, then that many bytes of UTF-8 text.
  name() {
    const length = this.u32();
    const end = this.pos + length;
    if (end > this.bytes.length)
      throw Error('functionNames: a name runs past the end of the file');
    const text = new globalThis.TextDecoder().decode(
      this.bytes.subarray(this.pos, end),
    );
    this.pos = end;
    return text;
  }
  // endregion: leb128
}

// region: sections
// { [index]: name } for every function the "name" section names; {} without one.
export function functionNames(bytes) {
  const magic = [0x00, 0x61, 0x73, 0x6d];
  if (!magic.every((b, i) => bytes[i] === b))
    throw Error('functionNames: not a WebAssembly file');
  const r = new Reader(bytes, 8);
  while (r.pos < bytes.length) {
    const id = r.byte();
    const size = r.u32();
    const end = r.pos + size;
    if (id === 0 && r.name() === 'name') return functionSubsection(r, end);
    r.pos = end;
  }
  return {};
}
// endregion: sections

// region: subsections
// Inside the name section: subsections, each an id byte, a size and contents.
// Subsection 1 is a count, then each function's index and name; skip the rest.
function functionSubsection(r, end) {
  const names = {};
  while (r.pos < end) {
    const id = r.byte();
    const size = r.u32();
    const next = r.pos + size;
    if (id === 1) {
      for (let n = r.u32(); n > 0; n--) {
        const index = r.u32();
        names[index] = r.name();
      }
    }
    r.pos = next;
  }
  return names;
}
// endregion: subsections

// region: line-at
// { line, column } of the last row at or before `offset`, or null when every
// row comes after it. Rows are sorted by offset.
export function lineAt(lines, offset) {
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = lines.length;
  // Rows before lo are at or before offset; rows from hi on come after it.
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (lines[mid].offset <= offset) lo = mid + 1;
    else hi = mid;
  }
  if (lo === 0) return null;
  return { line: lines[lo - 1].line, column: lines[lo - 1].column };
}
// endregion: line-at
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/query-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 11 query: question a recording. API.md, "query.mjs", is the contract.
//
// buildIndex replays the recording once on your machine and keeps two things:
// every write, so that lastWriter can name the last write of a byte before any
// tick, and for every value the program makes, the producers it was made from,
// so that sources can follow a stored value back to where it came from. Both
// questions are answered from what was kept, without running the program again.
//
// It reads the machine's state.stack (the value stack) and state.result (what a
// finished call returned), which lesson 08's machine keeps.
import { Machine } from './machine.mjs';
import { recordedImports } from './recorder.mjs';

// How each of the 62 instructions moves values. Every instruction a program
// uses must be in exactly one of these.
const KIND = {
  block: 'block',
  loop: 'loop',
  br: 'br',
  br_if: 'br_if',
  end: 'end',
  return: 'return',
  call: 'call',
  'local.get': 'local.get',
  'local.set': 'local.set',
  'local.tee': 'local.tee',
  'global.get': 'global.get',
  'global.set': 'global.set',
  select: 'select',
  'i32.const': 'const',
  'i64.const': 'const',
  'f32.const': 'const',
  'i32.load': 'load',
  'f32.load': 'load',
  'i32.load8_u': 'load',
  'i32.store': 'store',
  'i32.store8': 'store',
  'i32.store16': 'store',
  'f32.store': 'store',
  'i64.store': 'store',
};
const LOAD_SIZE = { 'i32.load': 4, 'f32.load': 4, 'i32.load8_u': 1 };
for (const op of [
  'i32.eqz',
  'f32.sqrt',
  'f32.neg',
  'f32.convert_i32_s',
  'f32.convert_i32_u',
  'f32.demote_f64',
  'f64.promote_f32',
  'i32.reinterpret_f32',
  'f32.reinterpret_i32',
  'i32.trunc_sat_f32_s',
])
  KIND[op] = 'unary';
for (const op of [
  'i32.ne',
  'i32.lt_s',
  'i32.lt_u',
  'i32.gt_s',
  'i32.gt_u',
  'i32.le_s',
  'i32.ge_s',
  'i32.add',
  'i32.sub',
  'i32.mul',
  'i32.div_s',
  'i32.div_u',
  'i32.rem_s',
  'i32.rem_u',
  'i32.and',
  'i32.or',
  'i32.xor',
  'i32.shl',
  'i32.shr_s',
  'i32.shr_u',
  'f32.add',
  'f32.sub',
  'f32.mul',
  'f32.div',
  'f32.lt',
  'f32.gt',
  'f32.le',
  'f32.ge',
])
  KIND[op] = 'binary';

// A typed array that grows by doubling: push one number, and done() for a
// copy of exactly what was pushed.
class List {
  constructor(Type, size = 1 << 16) {
    this.a = new Type(size);
    this.n = 0;
  }
  push(x) {
    if (this.n === this.a.length) {
      const bigger = new this.a.constructor(this.a.length * 2);
      bigger.set(this.a);
      this.a = bigger;
    }
    this.a[this.n++] = x;
  }
  done() {
    return this.a.slice(0, this.n);
  }
}

export function buildIndex(program, recording) {
  if (recording?.format !== 'ttd2-recording-1')
    throw Error('buildIndex: not a recording (format ttd2-recording-1)');
  if (program.sha256 && recording.sha256 && program.sha256 !== recording.sha256)
    throw Error(
      `buildIndex: the recording was made with another program (${recording.program})`,
    );
  const calls = recording.calls;

  // One machine, its imports answered from the recording as in lesson 09.
  let m;
  const answered = recordedImports(program, recording, () => m);
  m = new Machine(program, answered.imports);
  const s = m.state;
  const memorySize = s.memory.length;
  const nImports = program.imports.length;

  // Each defined function's instructions, sorted by how they move values.
  const prepared = new Map();
  for (const f of program.functions) {
    const kinds = f.code.map((ins) => {
      if (!KIND[ins[0]])
        throw Error(`buildIndex: instruction ${ins[0]} is not one of the 62`);
      return KIND[ins[0]];
    });
    prepared.set(f.index, {
      code: f.code,
      kinds,
      locals: f.locals.length,
      results: program.typeOf(f.index).results.length,
    });
  }

  // region: keep-writes
  // Every write, one entry in each list, in tick order.
  const wTick = new List(Int32Array);
  const wFunc = new List(Int32Array);
  const wAt = new List(Int32Array);
  const wAddress = new List(Int32Array);
  const wSize = new List(Int32Array);
  // Per byte: the tick of the store that last wrote it so far, 0 if none.
  const writer = new Int32Array(memorySize);
  const keepWrites = (event, t) => {
    for (const w of event.writes) {
      wTick.push(t);
      wFunc.push(event.func);
      wAt.push(event.at);
      wAddress.push(w.address);
      wSize.push(w.size);
      writer.fill(t, w.address, w.address + w.size);
    }
  };
  // endregion: keep-writes

  // region: leaves
  // A producer is one whole number: 0 is nothing (a constant), t > 0 is the
  // instruction at tick t, and the leaves are negative: the answers first, then
  // every argument of every call, then the initial bytes by address.
  const nAnswers = recording.answers.length;
  const argBase = [];
  let nArgs = 0;
  for (const c of calls) {
    argBase.push(nArgs);
    nArgs += c.args.length;
  }
  const argCall = new Int32Array(nArgs);
  const argPos = new Int32Array(nArgs);
  calls.forEach((c, k) =>
    c.args.forEach((_, i) => {
      argCall[argBase[k] + i] = k;
      argPos[argBase[k] + i] = i;
    }),
  );
  const answerId = (a) => -1 - a;
  const argId = (k, i) => -1 - nAnswers - argBase[k] - i;
  const initialId = (address) => -1 - nAnswers - nArgs - address;
  // endregion: leaves

  // region: producers
  // Per tick: where its inputs start in deps, and whether it was a store.
  const depStart = new List(Int32Array);
  const deps = new List(Int32Array);
  const isStore = new List(Uint8Array);
  depStart.push(0); // tick 0 is no instruction
  isStore.push(0);

  // The producers of what the machine holds right now: one per stack value,
  // one per global, and the frames with one per local.
  let P = new Int32Array(1024);
  let sp = 0;
  const G = new Int32Array(program.globals.length);
  const frames = []; // { func, locals, base, labels: [{ height, arity, loop }] }
  const push = (id) => {
    if (sp === P.length) {
      const bigger = new Int32Array(P.length * 2);
      bigger.set(P);
      P = bigger;
    }
    P[sp++] = id;
  };

  // A computed value. With no operand producer it is nothing; with one, it
  // carries that operand's chain, so it takes its producer; with more, it is
  // tick t, whose inputs are the operands' producers.
  const scratch = new Int32Array(8);
  let nScratch = 0;
  const add = (id) => {
    if (id === 0) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < nScratch; i++) if (scratch[i] === id) return;
    scratch[nScratch++] = id;
  };
  const made = (t) => {
    if (nScratch === 0) return 0;
    if (nScratch === 1) return scratch[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < nScratch; i++) deps.push(scratch[i]);
    return t;
  };
  // endregion: producers

  // region: frames
  // A branch keeps its target's results and cuts the producers back with the
  // stack; a loop's label stays, because the loop can be branched to again.
  const branch = (frame, depth) => {
    const label = frame.labels[frame.labels.length - 1 - depth];
    for (let i = 0; i < label.arity; i++)
      P[label.height + i] = P[sp - label.arity + i];
    sp = label.height + label.arity;
    frame.labels.length -= label.loop ? depth : depth + 1;
  };
  // A return hands the results' producers back to the caller; the outermost
  // call's result leaves the machine.
  const leave = () => {
    const frame = frames.pop();
    const n = prepared.get(frame.func).results;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P[frame.base + i] = P[sp - n + i];
    sp = frame.base + (frames.length ? n : 0);
  };
  // A call's arguments become the new frame's first locals; the other locals
  // start as nothing.
  const enter = (func, args) => {
    const locals = new Int32Array(args.length + prepared.get(func).locals);
    locals.set(args);
    frames.push({ func, locals, base: sp, labels: [] });
  };
  // endregion: frames

  // region: follow
  // Move the producers as the instruction at tick t is about to move values.
  // stack is the machine's value stack before the instruction runs.
  const follow = (kind, ins, frame, t, stack) => {
    switch (kind) {
      case 'block':
        frame.labels.push({ height: sp, arity: ins[1] ? 1 : 0, loop: false });
        break;
      case 'loop':
        frame.labels.push({ height: sp, arity: 0, loop: true });
        break;
      case 'br':
        branch(frame, ins[1]);
        break;
      case 'br_if':
        sp--; // the condition is a decision: on no chain
        if (stack[stack.length - 1] !== 0) branch(frame, ins[1]);
        break;
      case 'end':
        if (frame.labels.length) frame.labels.pop();
        else leave();
        break;
      case 'return':
        leave();
        break;
      case 'call': {
        const n = program.typeOf(ins[1]).params.length;
        if (ins[1] < nImports) {
          sp -= n; // an import's arguments are not followed
          if (program.typeOf(ins[1]).results.length)
            push(answerId(answered.position()));
        } else {
          const args = P.slice(sp - n, sp);
          sp -= n;
          enter(ins[1], args);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'local.get':
        push(frame.locals[ins[1]]);
        break;
      case 'local.set':
        frame.locals[ins[1]] = P[--sp];
        break;
      case 'local.tee':
        frame.locals[ins[1]] = P[sp - 1];
        break;
      case 'global.get':
        push(G[ins[1]]);
        break;
      case 'global.set':
        G[ins[1]] = P[--sp];
        break;
      case 'const':
        push(0);
        break;
      case 'unary':
        break; // the same operand, so the same chain
      case 'binary':
        nScratch = 0;
        add(P[sp - 2]);
        add(P[sp - 1]);
        sp -= 1;
        P[sp - 1] = made(t);
        break;
      case 'select':
        nScratch = 0;
        add(P[sp - 3]);
        add(P[sp - 2]);
        add(P[sp - 1]);
        sp -= 2;
        P[sp - 1] = made(t);
        break;
      case 'load':
        load(ins, t, stack);
        break;
      case 'store':
        store();
        break;
    }
  };
  // endregion: follow

  // region: memory
  // A load depends on the bytes it read, each on the store that last wrote
  // it, or on the byte itself if no store has. Its address is not followed.
  const load = (ins, t, stack) => {
    const address = (stack[stack.length - 1] >>> 0) + ins[2];
    nScratch = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < LOAD_SIZE[ins[0]]; i++) {
      if (address + i >= memorySize) break;
      const w = writer[address + i];
      add(w !== 0 ? w : initialId(address + i));
    }
    P[sp - 1] = made(t);
  };
  // A store's only input is its value's producer; its address is not
  // followed. keepWrites then makes this tick the writer of every byte.
  const store = () => {
    const value = P[--sp];
    sp--;
    if (value !== 0) deps.push(value);
  };
  // endregion: memory

  // region: replay
  for (let k = 0; k < calls.length; k++) {
    m.begin(calls[k].name, calls[k].args);
    enter(
      program.exportIndex(calls[k].name),
      calls[k].args.map((_, i) => argId(k, i)),
    );
    while (m.running) {
      const top = s.frames[s.frames.length - 1];
      const frame = frames[frames.length - 1];
      const fn = prepared.get(top.func);
      const ins = fn.code[top.at];
      const kind = fn.kinds[top.at];
      const t = s.tick + 1;
      depStart.push(deps.n);
      isStore.push(kind === 'store' ? 1 : 0);
      follow(kind, ins, frame, t, s.stack);
      const asked = answered.position();
      const event = m.step();
      keepWrites(event, t);
      // The producers must still match the machine: its stack, its frames and
      // the answers it has used.
      const used = kind === 'call' && ins[1] < nImports ? 1 : 0;
      if (
        frame.func !== top.func ||
        sp !== s.stack.length ||
        frames.length !== s.frames.length ||
        answered.position() !== asked + used ||
        (event.writes.length !== 0) !== (kind === 'store')
      )
        throw Error(
          `buildIndex: lost track of the machine at tick ${t} (${ins[0]} at (${event.func}, ${event.at}))`,
        );
    }
    const result = s.result === undefined ? null : s.result;
    if (!Object.is(result, recording.results[k]))
      throw Error(
        `buildIndex: call ${k} returned ${result}, the recording says ${recording.results[k]}`,
      );
  }
  depStart.push(deps.n);
  // endregion: replay

  return makeIndex({
    end: s.tick,
    memorySize,
    leaves: { nAnswers, nArgs, argCall, argPos },
    depStart: depStart.done(),
    deps: deps.done(),
    isStore: isStore.done(),
    writes: {
      tick: wTick.done(),
      func: wFunc.done(),
      at: wAt.done(),
      address: wAddress.done(),
      size: wSize.done(),
    },
  });
}

function makeIndex({
  end,
  memorySize,
  leaves,
  depStart,
  deps,
  isStore,
  writes,
}) {
  // region: by-byte
  // Per byte, the writes that touched it in tick order:
  // byteWrites[byteStart[a]] up to byteWrites[byteStart[a + 1]].
  const byteStart = new Int32Array(memorySize + 1);
  for (let w = 0; w < writes.tick.length; w++)
    for (let i = 0; i < writes.size[w]; i++)
      byteStart[writes.address[w] + i + 1]++;
  for (let a = 0; a < memorySize; a++) byteStart[a + 1] += byteStart[a];
  const byteWrites = new Int32Array(byteStart[memorySize]);
  const next = byteStart.slice(0, memorySize);
  for (let w = 0; w < writes.tick.length; w++)
    for (let i = 0; i < writes.size[w]; i++)
      byteWrites[next[writes.address[w] + i]++] = w;
  // endregion: by-byte

  // region: last-writer
  const lastWriter = (address, beforeTick) => {
    if (!Number.isInteger(address) || address < 0 || address >= memorySize)
      throw Error(
        `lastWriter: ${address} is not an address in memory (0 to ${memorySize - 1})`,
      );
    if (typeof beforeTick !== 'number' || Number.isNaN(beforeTick))
      throw Error(`lastWriter: beforeTick must be a number, got ${beforeTick}`);
    // Binary search for the first write at or after beforeTick.
    let lo = byteStart[address];
    let hi = byteStart[address + 1];
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
      if (writes.tick[byteWrites[mid]] < beforeTick) lo = mid + 1;
      else hi = mid;
    }
    if (lo === byteStart[address]) return null;
    const w = byteWrites[lo - 1];
    return {
      tick: writes.tick[w],
      func: writes.func[w],
      at: writes.at[w],
      address: writes.address[w],
      size: writes.size[w],
    };
  };
  // endregion: last-writer

  // region: sources
  // seenTick[t] === epoch: tick t was visited during the current question.
  const { nAnswers, nArgs, argCall, argPos } = leaves;
  const seenTick = new Int32Array(end + 1);
  const seenLeaf = new Int32Array(nAnswers + nArgs + memorySize);
  let epoch = 0;
  const sources = (tick) => {
    if (!Number.isInteger(tick) || tick < 1 || tick > end || !isStore[tick])
      throw Error(
        `sources: tick ${tick} is not the tick of a store instruction`,
      );
    epoch++;
    const stores = [];
    const answers = [];
    const args = [];
    const initial = [];
    const todo = [];
    for (let i = depStart[tick]; i < depStart[tick + 1]; i++)
      todo.push(deps[i]);
    while (todo.length) {
      const id = todo.pop();
      if (id > 0) {
        if (seenTick[id] === epoch) continue;
        seenTick[id] = epoch;
        if (isStore[id]) stores.push(id);
        for (let i = depStart[id]; i < depStart[id + 1]; i++)
          todo.push(deps[i]);
        continue;
      }
      const leaf = -1 - id;
      if (seenLeaf[leaf] === epoch) continue;
      seenLeaf[leaf] = epoch;
      if (leaf < nAnswers) answers.push(leaf);
      else if (leaf < nAnswers + nArgs) args.push(leaf - nAnswers);
      else initial.push(leaf - nAnswers - nArgs);
    }
    const up = (a, b) => a - b;
    return {
      stores: stores.sort(up),
      answers: answers.sort(up),
      args: args.sort(up).map((x) => [argCall[x], argPos[x]]),
      initial: initial.sort(up),
    };
  };
  // endregion: sources

  return { end, lastWriter, sources };
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/recorder-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 09 recorder: record a run, replay it exactly from the recording, and
// find the first tick where a tampered replay's memory parts from the original.
// API.md, "recorder.mjs", is the contract. This file uses the Machine in the
// same project folder, so every instruction it runs goes through your step().
//
// The lab and the checks pass a program already loaded by readProgram. A raw
// listing works too, because the Machine loads whatever it is given.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { Machine } from './machine.mjs';

// The course's memory hash, the same one public/hash.mjs and the checks use.
export const hashMemory = (memory) =>
  createHash('sha256').update(memory).digest('hex');

// The error replay throws when the run leaves its recording.
export class ReplayDivergence extends Error {
  constructor(divergence) {
    super(
      `replay diverged at tick ${divergence.tick} (call ${divergence.call}): ${divergence.reason}`,
    );
    this.divergence = divergence;
  }
}

// region: record
export function record(program, imports, calls) {
  const answers = [];
  const noting = {};
  for (const { name } of program.imports) {
    noting[name] = (...args) => {
      const result = imports[name](...args);
      answers.push({ name, args, result });
      return result;
    };
  }
  const machine = new Machine(program, noting);
  const results = [];
  const hashes = [];
  for (const call of calls) {
    const result = machine.invoke(call.name, call.args);
    results.push(result === undefined ? null : result);
    hashes.push(hashMemory(machine.state.memory));
  }
  return {
    format: 'ttd2-recording-1',
    program: program.name,
    sha256: program.sha256,
    calls: calls.map((call) => ({ name: call.name, args: [...call.args] })),
    results,
    answers,
    hashes,
  };
}
// endregion: record

// region: recorded-imports
export function recordedImports(program, recording, machineOf, start = 0) {
  let next = start;
  const imports = {};
  for (const { name } of program.imports) {
    imports[name] = (...args) => {
      const answer = recording.answers[next];
      const state = machineOf().state;
      const where = { tick: state.tick, call: state.calls - 1 };
      const asked = `${name}(${args.join(', ')})`;
      if (!answer)
        throw new ReplayDivergence({
          ...where,
          reason: `the program asked ${asked} after the recording's last answer`,
        });
      if (
        answer.name !== name ||
        answer.args.length !== args.length ||
        answer.args.some((value, i) => !Object.is(value, args[i]))
      )
        throw new ReplayDivergence({
          ...where,
          reason: `the program asked ${asked}, the recording holds ${answer.name}(${answer.args.join(', ')})`,
        });
      next++;
      return answer.result;
    };
  }
  return { imports, position: () => next };
}
// endregion: recorded-imports

// region: replay
export function replay(program, recording, { check = true } = {}) {
  let machine;
  const answered = recordedImports(program, recording, () => machine);
  machine = new Machine(program, answered.imports);
  const results = [];
  const hashes = [];
  recording.calls.forEach((call, k) => {
    const value = machine.invoke(call.name, call.args);
    const result = value === undefined ? null : value;
    const hash = hashMemory(machine.state.memory);
    results.push(result);
    hashes.push(hash);
    const where = { tick: machine.state.tick, call: k };
    if (check && !Object.is(result, recording.results[k]))
      throw new ReplayDivergence({
        ...where,
        reason: `call ${k} returned ${result}, the recording says ${recording.results[k]}`,
      });
    if (check && hash !== recording.hashes[k])
      throw new ReplayDivergence({
        ...where,
        reason: `memory after call ${k} differs from the recording`,
      });
  });
  return { machine, results, hashes };
}
// endregion: replay

// region: find-call
export function firstDivergence(program, original, tampered) {
  let machine;
  const answered = recordedImports(program, tampered, () => machine);
  machine = new Machine(program, answered.imports);
  for (let k = 0; k < tampered.calls.length; k++) {
    const start = globalThis.structuredClone(machine.state);
    const answerAt = answered.position();
    let left = false;
    try {
      machine.invoke(tampered.calls[k].name, tampered.calls[k].args);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof ReplayDivergence)) throw error;
      left = true;
    }
    const same =
      !left && hashMemory(machine.state.memory) === original.hashes[k];
    if (same) continue;
    return bisectCall(program, original, tampered, k, start, answerAt);
  }
  return null;
}
// endregion: find-call

// region: run-from
function runFrom(program, recording, k, start, answerAt, limit) {
  let machine;
  const answered = recordedImports(program, recording, () => machine, answerAt);
  machine = new Machine(program, answered.imports);
  machine.state = globalThis.structuredClone(start);
  machine.begin(recording.calls[k].name, recording.calls[k].args);
  let ran = 0;
  try {
    while (machine.running && ran < limit) {
      machine.step();
      ran++;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof ReplayDivergence)) throw error;
    return { machine, ran, left: true };
  }
  return { machine, ran, left: false };
}
// endregion: run-from

// region: bisect
function bisectCall(program, original, tampered, k, start, answerAt) {
  const run = (recording, limit) =>
    runFrom(program, recording, k, start, answerAt, limit);
  const a = run(original, Infinity);
  const b = run(tampered, Infinity);
  const differs = (t) => {
    const x = run(original, t);
    const y = run(tampered, t);
    if (y.left && y.ran < t) return true;
    return (
      hashMemory(x.machine.state.memory) !== hashMemory(y.machine.state.memory)
    );
  };
  let lo = 0; // memory is equal after lo instructions of call k
  let hi = Math.max(a.ran, b.left ? b.ran + 1 : b.ran); // and differs after hi
  while (hi - lo > 1) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if (differs(mid)) hi = mid;
    else lo = mid;
  }
  return start.tick + hi;
}
// endregion: bisect
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/route.mjs`:

```mjs
// Shared by the chapter route commands (start-chapter, start-recorder,
// start-debugger, start-query, start-names) and by start-changes. Files are
// written with readFileSync and writeFileSync, which need only read access to
// the source and write access to the project, and every failure ends in one
// plain sentence instead of a stack trace.
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

export const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

// A mistake the learner can fix: printed as it is, without "Could not ...".
export class RouteError extends Error {}

// Run a route command; on failure print one sentence and exit with status 1.
export function run(main) {
  try {
    main();
  } catch (error) {
    const said = String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0];
    console.error(
      error instanceof RouteError
        ? said
        : `Could not finish: ${said}. Nothing you wrote was replaced; run the same command again, or check that you can write to the project folder.`,
    );
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Copy one course file into the project with plain reads and writes.
export function copyCourseFile(from, to) {
  writeFileSync(to, readFileSync(join(root, from)));
}

// Read a route command's PROJECT ROUTE arguments, or explain the usage.
export function routeArguments(command) {
  const [destination, route] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (
    !destination ||
    !['write', 'supplied'].includes(route) ||
    process.argv.length !== 4
  )
    throw new RouteError(
      `Usage: node examples/${command} PROJECT write|supplied`,
    );
  return { destination, route, project: resolve(destination) };
}

// An existing debugger part two project: its PROJECT.json path and contents, or
// a sentence saying how to make one.
export function projectFolder(destination, project) {
  const metadataPath = join(project, 'PROJECT.json');
  if (!existsSync(metadataPath))
    throw new RouteError(
      `${destination} is not a project folder. Make one first, for example: node examples/start-chapter.mjs ${destination} supplied`,
    );
  const metadata = JSON.parse(readFileSync(metadataPath, 'utf8'));
  if (metadata.course !== 'time-travel-debugger-part-two')
    throw new RouteError(`${destination} is not a debugger part two project`);
  return { metadataPath, metadata };
}

// Add a new application's stub to an existing project when it has none; an
// existing file is never replaced. Returns whether the stub was added.
export function addApplication(project, application) {
  const target = join(project, application);
  if (existsSync(target)) return false;
  copyCourseFile(join('starter', application), target);
  return true;
}

// Start one unit in an existing project. The unit's file is written when the
// project has none, or replaced while it is still the untouched stub that
// `node lab.mjs start` made; otherwise nothing changes. The new application's
// stub is added when it is missing and never replaced.
export function startUnit({
  command,
  unit,
  file,
  starter,
  checkpoint,
  application,
}) {
  const { destination, route, project } = routeArguments(command);
  const { metadataPath, metadata } = projectFolder(destination, project);
  const target = join(project, file);
  const stub = readFileSync(join(root, 'starter', file), 'utf8');
  if (existsSync(target) && readFileSync(target, 'utf8') !== stub)
    throw new RouteError(
      `Refusing: ${destination}/${file} is neither missing nor the untouched stub, so it may hold your work. Nothing was changed. Move it aside, or use a new project.`,
    );
  copyCourseFile(route === 'write' ? starter : checkpoint, target);
  const extraNew = addApplication(project, application);
  metadata[`unit${unit}_start_route`] = route;
  writeFileSync(metadataPath, JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2) + '\n');
  return { destination, route, extraNew };
}
```

```mjs
// Build your index of a recording and print what it kept and what it cost.
// Usage: node examples/show-index.mjs PROJECT RECORDING
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { readProgram } from '../public/program.mjs';

const [project, file] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!project || !file || process.argv.length !== 4) {
  console.error('Usage: node examples/show-index.mjs PROJECT RECORDING');
  process.exit(2);
}
const load = (name) => import(pathToFileURL(join(resolve(project), name)).href);
const { Machine } = await load('machine.mjs');
const { buildIndex } = await load('query.mjs');
let steps = 0;
const step = Machine.prototype.step;
Machine.prototype.step = function (...args) {
  steps++;
  return step.apply(this, args);
};

const recording = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
const index = buildIndex(readProgram(recording.program), recording);
const built = steps;
console.log(
  `${file}: ${index.end} instructions in ${recording.calls.length} calls`,
);
console.log(`building the index ran ${built} instructions on your machine`);

// Walk every byte's list backward through lastWriter, from the end of the run.
let entries = 0;
let written = 0;
let most = { address: 0, writes: 0 };
let stores = 0;
const memory = readProgram(recording.program).memory.min * 65536;
for (let address = 0; address < memory; address++) {
  let writes = 0;
  for (
    let w = index.lastWriter(address, index.end + 1);
    w;
    w = index.lastWriter(address, w.tick)
  ) {
    writes++;
    if (w.address === address) stores++;
  }
  entries += writes;
  if (writes) written++;
  if (writes > most.writes) most = { address, writes };
}
console.log(
  `per-byte lists: ${entries} entries, for ${written} bytes written at least once`,
);
console.log(
  `the most written byte is ${most.address}, written ${most.writes} times; a binary search in its list takes at most ${Math.ceil(Math.log2(most.writes + 1))} comparisons`,
);

// Ask sources about every store, newest first, and count instructions again.
steps = 0;
let longest = 0;
for (let address = 0; address < memory; address++)
  for (
    let w = index.lastWriter(address, index.end + 1);
    w;
    w = index.lastWriter(address, w.tick)
  )
    if (w.address === address)
      longest = Math.max(longest, index.sources(w.tick).stores.length);
console.log(
  `sources asked about all ${stores} stores: the longest chain holds ${longest} stores`,
);
console.log(`instructions run while answering those questions: ${steps}`);

```

```mjs
// Read the function names of two builds of Lob with your functionNames.
// Usage: node examples/show-names.mjs PROJECT
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL, URL } from 'node:url';

const [project] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!project || process.argv.length !== 3) {
  console.error('Usage: node examples/show-names.mjs PROJECT');
  process.exit(2);
}
const { functionNames } = await import(
  pathToFileURL(join(resolve(project), 'names.mjs')).href
);
const course = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));

for (const file of ['targets/lob-names.wasm', 'targets/lob.wasm']) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(course, file)));
  const names = functionNames(bytes);
  const entries = Object.entries(names);
  if (!entries.length) {
    console.log(`${file}: ${bytes.length} bytes, no name section, so {}`);
    continue;
  }
  console.log(`${file}: ${bytes.length} bytes, ${entries.length} names`);
  // Four to a line, each as INDEX NAME.
  for (let k = 0; k < entries.length; k += 4)
    console.log(
      '  ' +
        entries
          .slice(k, k + 4)
          .map(([index, name]) => `${index} ${name}`.padEnd(18))
          .join('')
          .trimEnd(),
    );
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/show-recording.mjs`:

```mjs
// Print what a recording made by `node lab.mjs record` holds.
// Usage: node examples/show-recording.mjs FILE [OTHER_FILE]
// With two files it also names the first call whose memory hashes differ.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const files = process.argv.slice(2);
if (files.length < 1 || files.length > 2)
  throw Error('Usage: node examples/show-recording.mjs FILE [OTHER_FILE]');

const text = (x) => `${x.name}(${x.args.join(', ')})`;
const recordings = files.map((file) => {
  const json = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const r = JSON.parse(json);
  console.log(`${file}: ${r.format}, program ${r.program}`);
  console.log(
    `  ${r.calls.length} calls, ${r.answers.length} answers, ${r.hashes.length} hashes`,
  );
  console.log(
    `  call 0: ${text(r.calls[0])} returned ${r.results[0]}; memory hash after it ${r.hashes[0].slice(0, 16)}...`,
  );
  console.log(
    `  answer 0: ${text(r.answers[0])} returned ${r.answers[0].result}`,
  );
  return r;
});

if (recordings.length === 2) {
  const [a, b] = recordings;
  const k = a.hashes.findIndex((hash, i) => hash !== b.hashes[i]);
  console.log(
    k < 0
      ? 'The two recordings have the same memory hash after every call.'
      : `First call whose memory hashes differ: call ${k}, ${text(a.calls[k])}`,
  );
}
```

```mjs
// Open a recording with your Debugger and print what its snapshots hold.
// Usage: node examples/show-snapshots.mjs PROJECT RECORDING
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { readProgram } from '../public/program.mjs';

const [project, file] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!project || !file || process.argv.length !== 4) {
  console.error('Usage: node examples/show-snapshots.mjs PROJECT RECORDING');
  process.exit(2);
}
const { Debugger } = await import(
  pathToFileURL(join(resolve(project), 'debugger.mjs')).href
);
const recording = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
const d = new Debugger(readProgram(recording.program), recording);
const snaps = d.snapshots;
const memory = snaps[0].pages.reduce((n, page) => n + page.length, 0);
const distinct = new Set(snaps.flatMap((s) => s.pages));
let held = 0;
for (const page of distinct) held += page.length;
const copied = snaps
  .slice(1)
  .map(
    (s, i) => s.pages.filter((page, p) => page !== snaps[i].pages[p]).length,
  );
const most = Math.max(...copied);
console.log(`${file}: ${d.end} instructions, ${snaps.length} snapshots`);
console.log(
  `each snapshot: ${snaps[0].pages.length} pages of ${snaps[0].pages[0].length} bytes, ${memory} bytes in all`,
);
console.log(
  `full copies would hold ${snaps.length * memory} bytes; these hold ${held} (${((100 * held) / (snaps.length * memory)).toFixed(2)}%)`,
);
console.log(
  `pages copied by a snapshot after the first: at most ${most}, on average ${(copied.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / copied.length).toFixed(2)}`,
);
const last = snaps.at(-1);
const owners = last.pages.map((page) =>
  snaps.findIndex((s) => s.pages.includes(page)),
);
console.log(
  'the last snapshot, page by page, holds the copy made by snapshot:',
);
for (let p = 0; p < owners.length; p += 8)
  console.log(`  pages ${p}-${p + 7}: ${owners.slice(p, p + 8).join(' ')}`);
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/stack-checkpoint.mjs`:

```mjs
// Unit 10 debugger: run backwards over one recording. API.md, "debugger.mjs", is
// the contract. Lesson 12 adds stack(), stepOut() and function stops to this file.
//
// Position t is the state after t instructions of the whole run, counted across
// calls. Between two calls no function is running, and the next instruction is
// the first one of the next call. The constructor replays the recording once and
// keeps a snapshot every `every` instructions; a page of memory that no
// instruction wrote since the previous snapshot is that snapshot's page object.
//
// Options: { every = 1000, pageSize = 4096, check = true }. With check, the first
// pass compares memory after every call with the recording's hash.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { Machine } from './machine.mjs';
import { recordedImports, ReplayDivergence } from './recorder.mjs';

export class Debugger {
  // region: constructor
  constructor(
    program,
    recording,
    { every = 1000, pageSize = 4096, check = true } = {},
  ) {
    whole(every, 'every', 1);
    whole(pageSize, 'pageSize', 1);
    this.program = program;
    this.recording = recording;
    this.every = every;
    this.pageSize = pageSize;
    // The function each call starts in: what runs next between calls.
    this.callFunc = recording.calls.map(
      (call) =>
        program.exports.find((e) => e.kind === 'func' && e.name === call.name)
          .index,
    );
    // One machine for the whole session. Its imports ask this.answers, which
    // restore() replaces, so a replay answers from the right place.
    const imports = {};
    for (const { name } of program.imports)
      imports[name] = (...args) => this.answers.imports[name](...args);
    this.machine = new Machine(program, imports);
    this.answers = recordedImports(program, recording, () => this.machine);
    this.snapshots = [];
    this.end = this.firstPass(check);
    this.restore(this.snapshots[0]);
  }

  get tick() {
    return this.machine.state.tick;
  }
  // endregion: constructor

  // region: first-pass
  firstPass(check) {
    const m = this.machine;
    const written = new Uint8Array(
      Math.ceil(m.state.memory.length / this.pageSize),
    );
    this.snapshots.push(this.capture());
    for (let k = 0; k < this.recording.calls.length; k++) {
      do {
        const event = this.forward();
        for (const w of event.writes) {
          const first = Math.floor(w.address / this.pageSize);
          const last = Math.floor((w.address + w.size - 1) / this.pageSize);
          for (let p = first; p <= last; p++) written[p] = 1;
        }
        if (m.state.tick % this.every === 0) {
          this.snapshots.push(this.capture(this.snapshots.at(-1), written));
          written.fill(0);
        }
      } while (m.running);
      if (check) this.checkCall(k);
    }
    return m.state.tick;
  }
  // endregion: first-pass

  // region: capture
  capture(previous = null, written = null) {
    const { memory, ...rest } = this.machine.state;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 0; p * this.pageSize < memory.length; p++) {
      const start = p * this.pageSize;
      pages.push(
        previous && !written[p]
          ? previous.pages[p]
          : memory.slice(start, start + this.pageSize),
      );
    }
    return {
      tick: rest.tick,
      pages,
      state: globalThis.structuredClone(rest),
      answered: this.answers.position(),
    };
  }
  // endregion: capture

  // region: restore
  restore(snapshot) {
    const bytes = snapshot.pages.reduce((n, page) => n + page.length, 0);
    const memory = new Uint8Array(bytes);
    snapshot.pages.forEach((page, p) => memory.set(page, p * this.pageSize));
    this.machine.state = {
      ...globalThis.structuredClone(snapshot.state),
      memory,
    };
    this.answers = recordedImports(
      this.program,
      this.recording,
      () => this.machine,
      snapshot.answered,
    );
  }
  // endregion: restore

  // rr's checksum mode: after each call, memory must be what the recording says.
  checkCall(k) {
    const want = this.recording.hashes?.[k];
    const { memory, tick } = this.machine.state;
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(memory).digest('hex');
    if (want !== undefined && hash !== want)
      throw new ReplayDivergence({
        tick,
        call: k,
        reason: `memory after call ${k} differs from the recording`,
      });
  }

  // region: move
  forward() {
    const m = this.machine;
    if (!m.running) {
      const call = this.recording.calls[m.state.calls];
      m.begin(call.name, call.args);
    }
    return m.step();
  }

  moveTo(t) {
    const snapshot = this.snapshots[Math.floor(t / this.every)];
    if (this.tick > t || this.tick < snapshot.tick) this.restore(snapshot);
    while (this.tick < t) this.forward();
  }

  seek(tick) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(tick) || tick < 0 || tick > this.end)
      throw RangeError(`seek: ${tick} is not a position from 0 to ${this.end}`);
    this.moveTo(tick);
    return this.tick;
  }

  step(n = 1) {
    this.moveTo(Math.min(this.end, this.tick + whole(n, 'step')));
    return this.tick;
  }

  stepBack(n = 1) {
    this.moveTo(Math.max(0, this.tick - whole(n, 'stepBack')));
    return this.tick;
  }
  // endregion: move

  read(address, size) {
    const memory = this.machine.state.memory;
    if (
      !Number.isInteger(address) ||
      !Number.isInteger(size) ||
      address < 0 ||
      size < 0 ||
      address + size > memory.length
    )
      throw RangeError(
        `read: ${size} bytes at ${address} are not inside memory`,
      );
    return memory.slice(address, address + size);
  }

  // The instruction that runs next: the innermost frame's or, between calls, the
  // first instruction of the next call's function. null at end.
  nextInstruction() {
    const { frames, calls } = this.machine.state;
    const top = frames.at(-1);
    if (top) return { func: top.func, at: top.at };
    if (calls < this.callFunc.length)
      return { func: this.callFunc[calls], at: 0 };
    return null;
  }

  where() {
    const { frames, calls } = this.machine.state;
    const next = this.nextInstruction();
    return {
      tick: this.tick,
      call: frames.length ? calls - 1 : calls,
      func: next ? next.func : null,
      at: next ? next.at : null,
    };
  }

  state() {
    return globalThis.structuredClone(this.machine.state);
  }

  // region: stops
  stopHere({ breakpoints = [], watches = [], functions = [] }, event) {
    if (event && event.writes.some((w) => changesWatched(w, watches)))
      return 'watchpoint';
    const next = this.nextInstruction();
    if (
      next &&
      breakpoints.some((b) => b.func === next.func && b.at === next.at)
    )
      return 'breakpoint';
    // A function's instruction 0 runs next only where a call to it begins.
    if (next && next.at === 0 && functions.includes(next.func))
      return 'function';
    return null;
  }

  continue(stops = {}) {
    while (this.tick < this.end) {
      const event = this.forward();
      const reason = this.stopHere(stops, event);
      if (reason) return { reason, tick: this.tick };
    }
    return { reason: 'end', tick: this.tick };
  }
  // endregion: stops

  // region: search-back
  continueBack(stops = {}) {
    const here = this.tick;
    if (here === 0) return { reason: 'start', tick: 0 };
    const pages = (stops.watches ?? []).flatMap((w) =>
      pagesOf(w.address, w.size ?? 1, this.pageSize),
    );
    const watchesOnly = !stops.breakpoints?.length && !stops.functions?.length;
    const found = this.searchBack(
      here - 1,
      (event) => {
        const reason = this.stopHere(stops, event);
        return reason ? { reason, tick: this.tick } : null;
      },
      (i) => !watchesOnly || this.mayHaveWritten(i, pages),
    );
    if (found) {
      this.moveTo(found.tick);
      return found;
    }
    this.moveTo(0);
    return { reason: this.stopHere(stops, null) ?? 'start', tick: 0 };
  }

  searchBack(last, test, mayMatch = () => true) {
    for (let i = Math.ceil(last / this.every) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!mayMatch(i)) continue;
      const snapshot = this.snapshots[i];
      const stop = Math.min(last, snapshot.tick + this.every);
      this.restore(snapshot);
      let found = null;
      while (this.tick < stop) {
        const finding = test(this.forward());
        if (finding) found = finding;
      }
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  mayHaveWritten(i, pages) {
    const a = this.snapshots[i];
    const b = this.snapshots[i + 1];
    return !b || pages.some((p) => a.pages[p] !== b.pages[p]);
  }
  // endregion: search-back

  // region: last-write
  lastWrite(address) {
    const size = this.machine.state.memory.length;
    if (!Number.isInteger(address) || address < 0 || address >= size)
      throw RangeError(`lastWrite: ${address} is not an address inside memory`);
    const back = this.capture();
    const page = Math.floor(address / this.pageSize);
    const found = this.searchBack(
      back.tick,
      (event) => {
        const w = event.writes.findLast(
          (w) => address >= w.address && address < w.address + w.size,
        );
        if (!w) return null;
        const { tick, func, at } = event;
        return { tick, func, at, address: w.address, size: w.size };
      },
      (i) => this.mayHaveWritten(i, [page]),
    );
    this.restore(back);
    return found;
  }
  // endregion: last-write

  // region: stack
  stack() {
    return this.machine.state.frames.map((f) => ({ func: f.func, at: f.at }));
  }
  // endregion: stack

  // region: step-out
  // Forward to the first position with fewer frames than now. Between calls no
  // function is running, so stepOut runs the whole next call and stops where it
  // has returned, at the next position between calls. At the end it stays.
  stepOut() {
    const depth = this.machine.state.frames.length;
    if (depth === 0) {
      if (this.tick < this.end) {
        do {
          this.forward();
        } while (this.machine.running);
      }
    } else {
      while (this.machine.state.frames.length >= depth) this.forward();
    }
    return this.tick;
  }
  // endregion: step-out
}

// Whether a write changed a byte inside one of the watched ranges. A byte the
// store rewrote with the same value does not count. A watch without a size
// watches one byte.
function changesWatched(write, watches) {
  for (let i = 0; i < write.size; i++) {
    const byte = write.address + i;
    if (
      write.before[i] !== write.after[i] &&
      watches.some((w) => byte >= w.address && byte < w.address + (w.size ?? 1))
    )
      return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// The pages that hold the bytes [address, address + size).
function pagesOf(address, size, pageSize) {
  const pages = [];
  const last = Math.floor((address + size - 1) / pageSize);
  for (let p = Math.floor(address / pageSize); p <= last; p++) pages.push(p);
  return pages;
}

function whole(n, what, least = 0) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < least)
    throw RangeError(
      `${what}: ${n} is not a whole number of at least ${least}`,
    );
  return n;
}
```

`courses/time-travel-debugger-part-two/examples/start-chapter.mjs`:

```mjs
// Create a fresh project for either chapter route of lesson 08. Never replace
// existing work: an existing path, even an empty folder, is refused.
import { lstatSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  RouteError,
  copyCourseFile,
  root,
  routeArguments,
  run,
} from './route.mjs';

run(() => {
  const { destination, route, project } = routeArguments('start-chapter.mjs');
  let exists = false;
  try {
    lstatSync(project);
    exists = true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
  }
  if (exists)
    throw new RouteError(
      `Refusing existing path: ${destination}. Choose a new project folder.`,
    );
  const started = spawnSync(
    process.execPath,
    [join(root, 'lab.mjs'), 'start', project],
    { encoding: 'utf8' },
  );
  if (started.error) throw started.error;
  if (started.stderr) process.stderr.write(started.stderr);
  if (started.status !== 0) {
    process.stdout.write(started.stdout ?? '');
    process.exit(started.status ?? 1);
  }
  // lab start created this directory exclusively. Only its fresh Machine stub is replaced.
  copyCourseFile(
    route === 'write'
      ? 'starter/machine-build.mjs'
      : 'examples/machine-checkpoint.mjs',
    join(project, 'machine.mjs'),
  );
  copyCourseFile('starter/run-slice.mjs', join(project, 'run-slice.mjs'));
  const metadataPath = join(project, 'PROJECT.json');
  const metadata = JSON.parse(readFileSync(metadataPath, 'utf8'));
  metadata.unit08_start_route = route;
  writeFileSync(metadataPath, JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log(`Created ${destination}. Unit 08 initial route: ${route}.`);
  console.log(
    route === 'supplied'
      ? 'The supplied Machine should pass the unit 08 checks; reading and exercises remain.'
      : 'The Machine has six unfinished regions; its initial unit 08 checks should fail.',
  );
  console.log(`Work in ${destination}/machine.mjs.`);
  console.log(
    'The new application remains unfinished in run-slice.mjs on both routes.',
  );
});
```
