```mjs
function nodeDetails(){if(!activeState)return;const id=Number($('node-select').value);$('node-detail').textContent=JSON.stringify(explainNode(activeState,id),null,2);const overlay=$('geometry-overlay'),v=activeState.frame.viewport;overlay.width=v.width;overlay.height=v.height;const ctx=overlay.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,v.width,v.height);if(!$('show-geometry').checked)return;for(const r of overlayShapes(activeState,id)){ctx.strokeStyle=r.color;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.setLineDash(r.label==='content box'?[3,2]:[]);ctx.strokeRect(r.x+.5,r.y+.5,Math.max(0,r.width-1),Math.max(0,r.height-1));}}
function workerRequest(worker,message){
 const requestId=++request;setBusy(true);
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const finish=(error,result)=>{clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;worker.onmessage=null;worker.onerror=null;if(error){if(!error.recoverable){worker.terminate();if(activeWorker===worker)activeWorker=null;}reject(error);return;}resolve(result);};
  timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(Error('Worker exceeded 5 seconds. Your committed source is preserved; no successful result was recorded.')),5000);
  worker.onerror=e=>{e.preventDefault();finish(Error('The worker stopped. Check syntax and the supplied server response policy.'));};
  worker.onmessage=({data})=>{if(data?.requestId!==requestId)return;if(data.kind==='error'){finish(Object.assign(Error(`${data.code}: ${data.message}`),{recoverable:data.recoverable,state:data.state}));return;}finish(null,data);};
  worker.postMessage({requestId,...message});
 });
}

 const id=await record({kind:'submit',mode,module,source,sourceHash,packet,packetHash,assistance:$('assistance').value});return {id,source,packet,module};
```
```json
}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/public/diagnostics.mjs`:

```mjs
import {stable} from './supplier.mjs';

export function explainNode(state,nodeId){
 const node=state.doc.nodes.find(n=>n.id===nodeId);if(!node)throw Error('Choose a current node handle.');
 const elementId=node.kind==='text'?node.parent:node.id,frame=state.frame;
 return {node,computed:frame.styles[elementId]??null,box:frame.layout.boxes.find(b=>b.nodeId===elementId)??null,glyphs:frame.layout.glyphs.filter(g=>g.nodeId===node.id||g.ownerId===node.id||g.ancestors?.includes(node.id)),commands:frame.display.commands.filter(c=>c.nodeId===node.id||c.ownerId===node.id),hitRegions:frame.display.regions.filter(r=>r.nodeId===elementId)};
}
function semanticDOM(doc){return {root:doc.root,nodes:doc.nodes.map(({span,...node})=>node)};}
function valueStyles(styles){return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(styles).map(([id,s])=>[id,s.values]));}
export function frameDifference(before,after){
 if(!before)return {status:'initial-frame',changed:['DOM','computed values','layout','display'],firstChanged:'DOM',note:'There is no earlier frame. This reports changes, not correctness.'};
 const comparisons=[['DOM',semanticDOM(before.doc),semanticDOM(after.doc)],['computed values',valueStyles(before.frame.styles),valueStyles(after.frame.styles)],['layout',before.frame.layout,after.frame.layout],['display',before.frame.display,after.frame.display]];
 const changed=comparisons.filter(([,a,b])=>stable(a)!==stable(b)).map(([name])=>name);
 return {status:changed.length?'changed':'same-stage-products',changed,firstChanged:changed[0]??null,stageCalls:Object.fromEntries(['styles','layout','display'].map(name=>[name,after.counters[name]-before.counters[name]])),note:'The first changed stage is not necessarily a defect. Compare with your prediction and the contract.'};
}
export function overlayShapes(state,nodeId){
 const detail=explainNode(state,nodeId),scroll=state.frame.viewport.scrollY,shapes=[];
 if(detail.box){const b=detail.box;shapes.push({label:'border box',color:'#1266c2',x:b.x,y:b.y-scroll,width:b.width,height:b.height});shapes.push({label:'content box',color:'#b64c10',x:b.contentX,y:b.contentY-scroll,width:b.contentWidth,height:b.contentHeight});}
 else for(const g of detail.glyphs)shapes.push({label:'glyph cell',color:'#7f3592',x:g.x,y:g.y-scroll,width:g.width,height:g.height});
 return shapes;
}
```

```mjs
export const NOTEBOOK_VERSION=1;
export const fresh=()=>({version:NOTEBOOK_VERSION,revision:0,draft:'',events:[],notes:''});
export function validate(value){
 if(!value||value.version!==1||!Number.isSafeInteger(value.revision)||value.revision<0||!Array.isArray(value.events)||typeof value.draft!=='string'||typeof value.notes!=='string')throw Error('Unrecognized notebook format.');
 if(value.draft.length>131072||value.notes.length>12000||value.events.length>160||JSON.stringify(value).length>4000000)throw Error('Notebook exceeds the local evidence limit. Export the existing notebook before starting another.');
 const ids=new Map();
 for(const e of value.events){
  if(!e||typeof e.id!=='string'||ids.has(e.id)||!['submit','result','quiz','prediction','note','interaction','interaction-result'].includes(e.kind))throw Error('Invalid or duplicate notebook event.');
  if(e.kind==='submit'&&(typeof e.source!=='string'||e.source.length>131072||!(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/).test(e.sourceHash)||!(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/).test(e.packetHash)||!e.packet||JSON.stringify(e.packet).length>262144))throw Error('Submission source, packet or hashes are missing.');
  if(e.kind==='result'&&(ids.get(e.forSubmit)!=='submit'||!e.output||JSON.stringify(e.output).length>262144))throw Error('Result is missing its earlier submission or is too large.');
  if(e.kind==='interaction'&&(ids.get(e.forSubmit)!=='submit'||!e.input||JSON.stringify(e.input).length>262144))throw Error('Interaction is missing its source submission or bounded input.');
  if(e.kind==='interaction-result'&&(ids.get(e.forInteraction)!=='interaction'||!e.output||JSON.stringify(e.output).length>262144))throw Error('Interaction result is missing its input or bounded output.');
  ids.set(e.id,e.kind);
 }
 return structuredClone(value);
}
export function append(book,event){
 const next=structuredClone(book);next.revision++;next.events.push({...structuredClone(event),id:`event-${next.revision}-${next.events.length+1}`});return validate(next);
}
export function updateDraft(book,draft,notes=book.notes){const next=structuredClone(book);next.revision++;next.draft=draft;next.notes=notes;return validate(next);}
export function merge(book,incoming){
 incoming=validate(incoming);let merged=append(book,{kind:'note',text:'Draft preserved before notebook import.',draftBackup:book.draft});const mapping=new Map();
 for(const event of incoming.events){const value={...event,imported:true};delete value.id;if(value.forSubmit)value.forSubmit=mapping.get(value.forSubmit);if(value.forInteraction)value.forInteraction=mapping.get(value.forInteraction);merged=append(merged,value);mapping.set(event.id,merged.events.at(-1).id);}
 return updateDraft(merged,incoming.draft,incoming.notes);
}
```

```mjs
import {tokenize,parseCSS,uaRules,validateViewport,load,flush,runAction,copy} from './supplier.mjs';

// Supplier-owned fixtures contain data, not implementations of learner stages.
export const blockPacket={name:'M3 block geometry bench',html:'<main><div id="header"></div><div id="card"></div><button id="next"></button></main>',css:'main {padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px} #header {height:20px;background-color:#cbdde5} #card {height:36px;padding-top:4px;padding-bottom:4px;background-color:#e8bc73} #next {height:16px;background-color:#286273}',viewport:{width:160,height:120,scrollY:0}};
export function inspectStage(engine,unit,packet){
 const number=Number(unit.slice(1));if(number<1||number>8)throw Error('Unknown stage.');
 if(number>=7){const s=load(engine,packet);flush(engine,s);return {unit,stage:'scheduled frame',input:packet,doc:s.doc,styles:s.frame.styles,layout:s.frame.layout,display:s.frame.display,viewport:s.viewport,counters:s.counters};}
 const viewport=validateViewport(packet.viewport),tokens=tokenize(packet.html),doc=engine.buildDOM(tokens);
 const result={unit,stage:'document',input:packet,tokens,doc,viewport};if(number===1)return result;
 const rules=[...uaRules(),...parseCSS(packet.css)];result.styles=engine.styles(doc,rules);result.stage='computed styles';if(number===2)return result;
 result.layout=engine.layout(doc,result.styles,viewport);result.stage='layout';if(number<=4)return result;
 result.display=engine.display(doc,result.styles,result.layout,viewport);result.stage='display';if(number===5)return result;
 // M6 uses a simple full rebuild after dispatch. The learner replaces this
 // scheduling policy in M7; no invalidation answer is supplied here.
 const session={doc,events:[]},bindings=(packet.listeners??[]).map(l=>({...copy(l),nodeId:doc.nodes.find(n=>n.attrs?.id===l.id)?.id}));
 if(bindings.some(l=>l.nodeId===undefined))throw Error('Packet listener has no matching element.');
 if(bindings.length){const target=bindings[0].nodeId;result.event=engine.dispatch(doc,target,bindings,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true},l=>runAction(engine,session,l.action));if(!result.event.canceled)for(const action of packet.defaultActions??[]){if(doc.nodes.find(n=>n.attrs?.id===action.id)?.id===target)runAction(engine,session,action.action);}result.mutations=session.events;result.styles=engine.styles(doc,rules);result.layout=engine.layout(doc,result.styles,viewport);result.display=engine.display(doc,result.styles,result.layout,viewport);result.stage='one activation and full rebuild';}
 return result;
}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/public/raster.mjs`:

```mjs
import {glyphs,FONT_ID} from './font.mjs';
import {fail,intersect,validateViewport,LIMITS} from './supplier.mjs';
export {FONT_ID};
const rgb=s=>{if(!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(s))fail('raster_color','Use #RRGGBB colors.');return [1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(s.slice(i,i+2),16));};
function validRect(r){if(!r||!['x','y','width','height'].every(k=>Number.isSafeInteger(r[k]))||r.width<0||r.height<0)fail('raster_geometry','Raster rectangles must have integer coordinates and nonnegative extents.');}
export function raster(display,rawViewport){
  const v=validateViewport(rawViewport),output=new Uint8ClampedArray(v.width*v.height*4).fill(255);
  if(!Array.isArray(display?.commands)||display.commands.length>LIMITS.commands)fail('command_limit','Invalid display command count.');
  const viewport={x:0,y:v.scrollY,width:v.width,height:v.height};
  function rect(r,color,clip){
    validRect(r);validRect(clip);const bounds=intersect(intersect(r,clip),viewport),c=rgb(color);
    for(let y=bounds.y;y<bounds.y+bounds.height;y++)for(let x=bounds.x;x<bounds.x+bounds.width;x++){
      const i=((y-v.scrollY)*v.width+x)*4;output[i]=c[0];output[i+1]=c[1];output[i+2]=c[2];output[i+3]=255;
    }
  }
  for(const cmd of display.commands){
    if(cmd.kind==='rect'){rect(cmd,cmd.color,cmd.clip);continue;}
    if(cmd.kind!=='glyph')fail('raster_command','Unknown display command.');
    if(!Number.isInteger(cmd.x)||!Number.isInteger(cmd.y)||!Object.hasOwn(glyphs,cmd.char))fail('raster_glyph','Glyph position or supplied glyph is invalid.');

  }
  return output;
}
```

```mjs
// Original supplied infrastructure. Browser-engine decisions are learner callbacks.
export const PROFILE = 'TBE-1-local-0.1';
export const LIMITS = Object.freeze({nodes:512,depth:32,rules:128,text:32768,packet:262144,commands:16384,width:1024,height:768,extent:32768});
export const fail = (code, message, detail={}) => { throw Object.assign(new Error(message), {code, detail}); };
export const copy = value => structuredClone(value);
export const node = (doc,id) => doc.nodes.find(n=>n.id===id) ?? fail('unknown_handle',`Node ${id} does not exist.`);
export const connected = (doc,id) => {
  const seen=new Set(); let n=node(doc,id);
  while(n.parent!==null){ if(seen.has(n.id))return false; seen.add(n.id); n=node(doc,n.parent); }
  return n.id===doc.root;
};
export const tags = new Set(['main','div','p','span','button']);
export const identifier = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/;
export function textValue(value){
  if(typeof value!=='string'||value.length>LIMITS.text||/[^\x09\x0a\x0d\x20-\x7e]/.test(value))fail('unsupported_character','Use printable ASCII text, spaces, tabs or line breaks.');
  return value;
}
function decode(s){
  const entities={amp:'&',lt:'<',gt:'>',quot:'"',apos:"'"};
  return textValue(s.replace(/&([^;\s]*);|&/g,(all,name)=>entities[name]??fail('unsupported_entity',`Unsupported entity ${all}.`)));
}
export function tokenize(html){
  if(typeof html!=='string'||html.length>LIMITS.packet)fail('packet_limit','HTML is missing or exceeds the packet limit.');
  const result=[]; let pos=0;
  while(pos<html.length){
    const start=pos;
    if(html[pos]!=='<'){
      let end=html.indexOf('<',pos); if(end<0)end=html.length;
      result.push({kind:'text',text:decode(html.slice(pos,end)),span:[start,end]}); pos=end; continue;
    }
    const end=html.indexOf('>',pos); if(end<0)fail('packet_syntax','Unclosed tag.',{offset:pos});
    const raw=html.slice(pos+1,end); pos=end+1;
    const closing=/^\/([a-z]+)\s*$/.exec(raw);
    if(closing){ if(!tags.has(closing[1]))fail('unsupported_tag',`Unsupported tag ${closing[1]}.`); result.push({kind:'end',tag:closing[1],span:[start,pos]}); continue; }
    const match=/^([a-z]+)([\s\S]*)$/.exec(raw);
    if(!match||!tags.has(match[1]))fail('unsupported_tag',`Use main, div, p, span or button.`,{offset:start});
    const attrs={}; let rest=match[2];
    while(rest.trim()){
      const attr=/^\s+(id|class)\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*')/.exec(rest);
      if(!attr)fail('packet_syntax','Only quoted id and class attributes are supported.',{offset:start});
      if(Object.hasOwn(attrs,attr[1]))fail('packet_syntax','Duplicate attribute.',{offset:start});
      const value=attr[2].slice(1,-1);
      const words=value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      if(words.some(w=>!identifier.test(w))||(attr[1]==='id'&&words.length!==1))fail('invalid_value','IDs/classes must be ASCII identifiers.');
      attrs[attr[1]]=attr[1]==='class'?[...new Set(words)]:words[0]; rest=rest.slice(attr[0].length);
    }
    result.push({kind:'start',tag:match[1],attrs,span:[start,pos]});
  }
  return result;
}
const sides=['top','right','bottom','left'];
export const defaults=Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries([
  ['display','inline'],['width','auto'],['height','auto'],['color','#000000'],['background-color','transparent'],['line-height',20],['overflow','visible'],
  ...sides.flatMap(s=>[[`padding-${s}`,0],[`border-${s}-width`,0],[`border-${s}-style`,'solid'],[`border-${s}-color`,'#000000']])
]));
export const geometryProperties = ['display','width','height','line-height',...sides.flatMap(s=>[`padding-${s}`,`border-${s}-width`,`border-${s}-style`])];
export function valueFor(property,raw){
  if(!Object.hasOwn(defaults,property))fail('unsupported_property',`Unsupported property ${property}.`);
  const v=raw.trim();
  if(['width','height'].includes(property)&&v==='auto')return v;
  if(['width','height','line-height'].includes(property)||property.startsWith('padding-')||property.endsWith('-width')){
    if(!/^\d+px$/.test(v))fail('invalid_value',`${property} needs nonnegative integer px.`);
    const n=Number(v.slice(0,-2)); if(n>LIMITS.extent||(property==='line-height'&&n<16))fail('invalid_value',`${property} is out of range.`); return n;
  }
  if(property==='display'&&['block','inline','none'].includes(v))return v;
  if(property==='overflow'&&['visible','hidden'].includes(v))return v;
  if(property.endsWith('-style')&&['solid','none'].includes(v))return v;
  if((property==='color'||property.endsWith('-color'))&&/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v))return v.toLowerCase();
  if(property==='background-color'&&v==='transparent')return v;
  fail('invalid_value',`Unsupported value ${v} for ${property}.`);
}
export function parseSelector(source){
  const parts=[]; let pos=0, relation=null;
  while(pos<source.length){
    const ws=/^\s+/.exec(source.slice(pos)); if(ws){pos+=ws[0].length;if(parts.length)relation='descendant';}
    if(pos===source.length)break;
    if(source[pos]==='>'){
      if(!parts.length||parts.at(-1).pending)fail('selector_syntax','Misplaced child combinator.');
      relation='child';pos++; const space=/^\s*/.exec(source.slice(pos))[0];pos+=space.length;
    }
    const atoms=[];
    while(pos<source.length&&!/[\s>]/.test(source[pos])){
      const m=/^(\*|[.#]?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)/.exec(source.slice(pos));
      if(!m)fail('unsupported_selector',`Unsupported selector near ${source.slice(pos)}.`);
      const token=m[0]; const type=token==='*'?'universal':token[0]==='.'?'class':token[0]==='#'?'id':'tag';
      if((type==='tag'||type==='universal')&&atoms.length)fail('selector_syntax','Type selector must begin a compound.');
      atoms.push({type,value:['class','id'].includes(type)?token.slice(1):token});pos+=token.length;
    }
    if(!atoms.length)fail('selector_syntax','Missing selector after combinator.');
    parts.push({atoms,relation:parts.length?relation:null});relation=null;
  }
  if(!parts.length)fail('selector_syntax','Empty selector.');return parts;
}
export function parseCSS(css){
  if(typeof css!=='string'||css.length>LIMITS.packet)fail('packet_limit','Stylesheet exceeds limit.');
  const rules=[];let pos=0;
  while(css.slice(pos).trim()){
    const open=css.indexOf('{',pos),close=css.indexOf('}',open+1);
    if(open<0||close<0)fail('css_syntax','Each rule needs { declarations }.');
    const selector=css.slice(pos,open).trim();const body=css.slice(open+1,close);
    const parts=parseSelector(selector);const declarations=[];
    for(const line of body.split(';').filter(s=>s.trim())){
      const m=/^\s*([a-z-]+)\s*:\s*([^:]+?)\s*$/.exec(line);
      if(!m)fail('css_syntax',`Invalid declaration ${line}.`);
      declarations.push({property:m[1],value:valueFor(m[1],m[2]),order:declarations.length});
    }
    rules.push({id:`r${rules.length+1}`,origin:1,order:rules.length,selector,parts,declarations});pos=close+1;
    if(rules.length>LIMITS.rules)fail('rule_limit','Too many style rules.');
  }
  return rules;
}
export const uaRules=()=>parseCSS('main {display:block} div {display:block} p {display:block} button {display:block}').map((r,i)=>({...r,id:`ua${i}`,origin:0}));
export const intersect=(a,b)=>{const x=Math.max(a.x,b.x),y=Math.max(a.y,b.y);return{x,y,width:Math.max(0,Math.min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-x),height:Math.max(0,Math.min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-y)};};
export const inside=(r,x,y)=>r.width>0&&r.height>0&&x>=r.x&&y>=r.y&&x<r.x+r.width&&y<r.y+r.height;
export function validateViewport(v){
  if(!v||!Number.isInteger(v.width)||!Number.isInteger(v.height)||v.width<1||v.height<1||v.width>LIMITS.width||v.height>LIMITS.height||!Number.isInteger(v.scrollY??0)||(v.scrollY??0)<0||(v.scrollY??0)>LIMITS.extent)fail('viewport','Invalid integer viewport.');
  return {width:v.width,height:v.height,scrollY:v.scrollY??0};
}
export const support={LIMITS,fail,copy,node,connected,tags,identifier,textValue,defaults,geometryProperties,intersect,inside};
export const required=['buildDOM','mutate','styles','layout','display','target','dispatch','invalidation'];
export function compile(body){
  if(typeof body!=='string'||body.length>131072)fail('source_limit','Source must fit within 128 KiB.');
  const engine=new Function('support',`"use strict";\n${body}`)(support);
  for(const name of required)if(typeof engine?.[name]!=='function')fail('interface',`Return an engine with ${name}().`);
  return engine;
}
export function load(engine,packet){
  if(!packet||typeof packet.html!=='string'||typeof packet.css!=='string')fail('packet','Supply html and css strings.');
  if(JSON.stringify(packet).length>LIMITS.packet)fail('packet_limit','Whole packet exceeds 256 KiB.');
  for(const key of ['listeners','defaultActions'])if(packet[key]!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(packet[key])||packet[key].length>128))fail('binding_limit',`${key} must be an array of at most 128 bindings.`);
  const viewport=validateViewport(packet.viewport??{width:640,height:480,scrollY:0});
  const doc=engine.buildDOM(tokenize(packet.html));const rules=[...uaRules(),...parseCSS(packet.css)];
  const bind=l=>{
    if(!l||typeof l.id!=='string'||!identifier.test(l.id)||!Array.isArray(l.action)||l.action.length>64)fail('listener_binding','A binding needs an element ID and at most 64 actions.');
    const n=doc.nodes.find(n=>n.kind==='element'&&n.attrs.id===l.id);if(!n)fail('listener_binding',`Missing listener ID ${l.id}.`);
    return {...copy(l),nodeId:n.id};
  };
  const bindings=(packet.listeners??[]).map(bind),defaultActions=(packet.defaultActions??[]).map(bind);
  return {doc,rules,viewport,bindings,defaultActions,packet:copy(packet),frame:null,frameId:0,stale:true,counters:{styles:0,layout:0,display:0},events:[]};
}
export function flush(engine,session,change={type:'initial'}){
  const trace={change:copy(change),documentRevision:session.doc.revision,viewport:copy(session.viewport),steps:[]};session.lastFlush=trace;
  const compute=(stage,fn)=>{const step={stage,status:'running'};trace.steps.push(step);session.counters[stage]++;try{const value=fn();step.status='computed';return value;}catch(error){step.status='failed';step.code=error.code??'engine_error';throw error;}};
  try{
    const prev=session.frame;
    const pre=engine.invalidation({phase:'before',...change});
    let styles=prev?.styles;
    const restyled=!prev||!!pre.restyle;
    if(restyled)styles=compute('styles',()=>engine.styles(session.doc,session.rules));else trace.steps.push({stage:'styles',status:'reused'});
    const old=prev?.styles??{};let geometryChanged=false,paintChanged=false;
    for(const [id,s]of Object.entries(styles??{})){
      if(!old[id]){geometryChanged=true;paintChanged=true;continue;}
      if(geometryProperties.some(p=>s.values[p]!==old[id].values[p]))geometryChanged=true;
      if(JSON.stringify(s.values)!==JSON.stringify(old[id].values))paintChanged=true;
    }
    if(Object.keys(old).length!==Object.keys(styles??{}).length)geometryChanged=true;
    const shape=JSON.stringify(session.doc.nodes.filter(n=>connected(session.doc,n.id)).map(n=>[n.id,n.parent,n.children]));
    const textSignature=JSON.stringify(session.doc.nodes.filter(n=>connected(session.doc,n.id)&&n.kind==='text').map(n=>[n.id,n.text]));
    const post=engine.invalidation({phase:'after',...change,geometryChanged,paintChanged,structureChanged:prev?.shape!==shape,textChanged:prev?.textSignature!==textSignature});
    trace.decisions={before:pre,after:post,geometryChanged,paintChanged,structureChanged:prev?.shape!==shape,textChanged:prev?.textSignature!==textSignature};
    let layout=prev?.layout,display=prev?.display;
    const laidOut=!prev||!!post.layout,painted=!prev||!!post.paint;
    if(laidOut)layout=compute('layout',()=>engine.layout(session.doc,styles,session.viewport));else trace.steps.push({stage:'layout',status:'reused'});
    if(painted)display=compute('display',()=>engine.display(session.doc,styles,layout,session.viewport));else trace.steps.push({stage:'display',status:'reused'});
    if(!styles||!layout||!display)fail('schedule','Invalidation omitted a required product.');
    const version=(stage,computed)=>({generation:(prev?.stages?.[stage]?.generation??0)+(computed?1:0),builtAtDocumentRevision:computed?session.doc.revision:prev.stages[stage].builtAtDocumentRevision,validatedForDocumentRevision:session.doc.revision,computedThisFrame:computed,viewportDependency:stage==='layout'?{width:session.viewport.width}:stage==='display'?copy(session.viewport):null});
    const stages={styles:version('styles',restyled),layout:version('layout',laidOut),display:version('display',painted)};trace.status='published';
    session.frame={id:++session.frameId,documentRevision:session.doc.revision,viewport:copy(session.viewport),shape,textSignature,styles,layout,display,stages,schedule:copy(trace)};
    session.stale=false;session.error=null;return session.frame;
  }catch(error){trace.status='failed';session.stale=true;session.error={code:error.code??'engine_error',message:error.message};throw error;}
}
export function runAction(engine,session,action){
  const flags={stop:false,immediate:false,cancel:false};
  for(const command of action??[]){
    if(command.kind==='stop'){flags.stop=true;continue;}
    if(command.kind==='immediate'){flags.immediate=true;flags.stop=true;continue;}
    if(command.kind==='cancel'){flags.cancel=true;continue;}
    let op=copy(command);
    if(op.id){const n=session.doc.nodes.find(n=>n.attrs?.id===op.id&&connected(session.doc,n.id));if(!n)fail('action_target',`Missing connected action target ${op.id}.`);op.nodeId=n.id;delete op.id;}
    if(op.kind==='toggleClass'){const n=node(session.doc,op.nodeId),classes=n.attrs.class??[];op={kind:'setClasses',nodeId:n.id,classes:classes.includes(op.className)?classes.filter(c=>c!==op.className):[...classes,op.className]};}
    const result=engine.mutate(session.doc,op);if(result.status==='applied')session.stale=true;logEvent(session,{kind:'mutation',operation:op,result});
    if(result.status==='rejected'){flags.error=result;break;}
  }
  return flags;
}
export function click(engine,session,{x,y,targetId}={}){
  if(session.stale||!session.frame)fail('stale_input','Render the current document before activating the page.');
  const target=targetId??engine.target(session.frame.display,{x,y:y+session.viewport.scrollY},session.viewport);
  if(target===null)return {target:null,trace:[],canceled:false};
  if(!connected(session.doc,target))fail('detached_target','The activation target is detached.');
  const revision=session.doc.revision;
  const result=engine.dispatch(session.doc,target,session.bindings,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true},listener=>runAction(engine,session,listener.action));
  logEvent(session,{kind:'dispatch',target,...result});
  if(!result.canceled)for(const action of session.defaultActions??[]){if(action.nodeId!==target)continue;const outcome=runAction(engine,session,action.action);if(outcome.error)result.defaultFailed=true;logEvent(session,{kind:'default-action',target,outcome});}
  flush(engine,session,{type:session.doc.revision===revision?'noop':'mutation'});return result;
}
export function logEvent(session,event){if(session.events.length>=512)fail('event_limit','This run reached 512 trace events. Export the trace and render a fresh session.');session.events.push(event);}
export function applyOperation(engine,session,operation){
 if(!session.frame)fail('stale_input','Establish an initial frame before interactive mutation.');
 const repairing=session.stale;
 const result=engine.mutate(session.doc,copy(operation));if(result.status==='applied')session.stale=true;logEvent(session,{kind:'operation',operation:copy(operation),result});
 flush(engine,session,{type:repairing?'initial':result.status==='applied'?(operation.kind==='setText'?'text':'mutation'):'noop'});return result;
}
export const stable=value=>JSON.stringify(value,(_key,v)=>v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>[k,v[k]])):v);
export async function digest(value){const bytes=typeof value==='string'?new TextEncoder().encode(value):value;const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes);return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/public/worker-entry.js`:

```js
// Bundled with original supplied modules by tools/build.mjs. No author code.
let activeEngine=null,activeSession=null;
self.onmessage=({data})=>{
 const send=(value,transfer=[])=>self.postMessage({requestId:data.requestId,...value},transfer);
 try{
  if(data.kind==='check'){const e=compile(data.source);const result=checkStage(e,data.unit);send({kind:'checks',result});return;}
  if(data.kind==='inspect'){const result=inspectStage(compile(data.source),data.unit,data.packet);const pixels=result.display?raster(result.display,result.viewport):null;if(JSON.stringify(result).length>16777216)throw Error('Stage output exceeds 16 MiB.');send({kind:'stage',result,pixels:pixels?.buffer},pixels?[pixels.buffer]:[]);return;}
  if(data.kind==='hit'){
   if(!activeSession?.frame||activeSession.stale)throw Error('Render a current frame before probing input.');
   const point={x:data.point.x,y:data.point.y+activeSession.viewport.scrollY};const target=activeEngine.target(activeSession.frame.display,point,activeSession.viewport);send({kind:'hit',target,point,frame:activeSession.frame.id});return;
  }
  if(data.kind==='start'){activeEngine=compile(data.source);activeSession=load(activeEngine,data.packet);flush(activeEngine,activeSession);}
  if(data.kind==='click'){
   if(!activeSession)throw Error('Render your engine first.');click(activeEngine,activeSession,data.point);
  }
  if(data.kind==='scroll'){
   if(!activeSession)throw Error('Render your engine first.');activeSession.viewport=validateViewport({...activeSession.viewport,scrollY:data.scrollY});flush(activeEngine,activeSession,{type:'scroll'});
  }
  if(data.kind==='resize'){
   if(!activeSession)throw Error('Render your engine first.');activeSession.viewport=validateViewport({...activeSession.viewport,width:data.width,height:data.height});flush(activeEngine,activeSession,{type:'resize'});
  }
  if(data.kind==='mutate'){
   if(!activeSession)throw Error('Render your engine first.');applyOperation(activeEngine,activeSession,data.operation);
  }
  if(!['start','click','scroll','resize','mutate'].includes(data.kind))throw Error('Unknown worker operation.');
  const pixels=raster(activeSession.frame.display,activeSession.viewport);
  const state={doc:activeSession.doc,frame:activeSession.frame,counters:activeSession.counters,events:activeSession.events,lastFlush:activeSession.lastFlush,stale:activeSession.stale};
  if(JSON.stringify(state).length>16777216)throw Error('Trace exceeds 16 MiB; reduce this packet.');
  send({kind:'frame',state,pixels:pixels.buffer},[pixels.buffer]);
 }catch(error){const recoverable=!!activeEngine&&!!activeSession?.frame;send({kind:'error',recoverable,state:recoverable?{doc:activeSession.doc,frame:activeSession.frame,counters:activeSession.counters,events:activeSession.events,lastFlush:activeSession.lastFlush,stale:activeSession.stale}:null,code:error.code??'engine_error',message:String(error.message??error).slice(0,2000)});}
};
```

```mjs
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
```

```mjs
// Observe grader inputs, not a learner solution. These probes deliberately do not
// implement DOM or layout and their aggregate checkStage results are not passes.
function probe() {
 const calls=[];
 return {calls,engine:{
  buildDOM(tokens){return {tokens,nodes:[]};},
  layout(doc,styles){
   calls.push({doc,styles});
   if(doc.tokens)throw new Error('structural fixture probe');
   return {boxes:[{nodeId:2,contentHeight:4},{nodeId:4,y:4}],glyphs:[],height:4};
  }
 }};
}
function visibleText({doc,styles}) {
 const found=[];
 function visit(id){
  const n=doc.nodes.find(n=>n.id===id);
  if(!n || styles[n.id]?.values.display==='none')return;
  if(n.kind==='text' && n.text.trim())found.push(n.text);
  for(const child of n.children)visit(child);
 }
 visit(doc.root);return found;
}
test('M3 successful geometry fixtures require no text-line implementation',()=>{

 assert.equal(calls.length,result.results.length);
 for(let i=0;i<result.results.length;i++){
  if(result.results[i].expected==='diagnostic')continue;
  assert.deepEqual(visibleText(calls[i]),[],result.results[i].id);
 }
 const i=result.results.findIndex(r=>r.id==='fixed-height-overflow');
 assert.equal(calls[i].styles[2].values.height,4);
 assert.equal(calls[i].styles[3].values.height,20);
 assert.deepEqual(result.results[i].expected,[4,4]);
 assert.ok(result.results.some(r=>r.id==='block-in-inline'&&r.expected==='diagnostic'));
});

 const {calls,engine}=probe();const result=checkStage(engine,'M4');
 assert.equal(result.results[0].id,'fixed-height-text-overflow');
 assert.deepEqual(visibleText(calls[0]),['AB CD']);
 assert.deepEqual(result.results[0].expected,[4,4]);
});
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/tools/render.mjs`:

```mjs
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {deflateSync} from 'node:zlib';
import {compile,load,flush,click} from '../public/supplier.mjs';
import {raster} from '../public/raster.mjs';
import {readPacket} from './packet.mjs';
export function png(rgba,width,height){
 const table=Array.from({length:256},(_,n)=>{let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xedb88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;return c>>>0;});
 const crc=bytes=>{let c=0xffffffff;for(const x of bytes)c=table[(c^x)&255]^(c>>>8);return(c^0xffffffff)>>>0;};
 const chunk=(name,data)=>{const label=Buffer.from(name),size=Buffer.alloc(4),sum=Buffer.alloc(4);size.writeUInt32BE(data.length);sum.writeUInt32BE(crc(Buffer.concat([label,data])));return Buffer.concat([size,label,data,sum]);};
 const header=Buffer.alloc(13);header.writeUInt32BE(width,0);header.writeUInt32BE(height,4);header[8]=8;header[9]=6;
 const rows=Buffer.alloc((width*4+1)*height);for(let y=0;y<height;y++)Buffer.from(rgba.buffer,rgba.byteOffset+y*width*4,width*4).copy(rows,y*(width*4+1)+1);
 return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]),chunk('IHDR',header),chunk('IDAT',deflateSync(rows)),chunk('IEND',Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('/render.mjs')||process.argv[1]==='tools/render.mjs'){
 const path=process.argv[2],page=process.argv[3]??'board',output=process.argv[4]??'render.png';
 if(!path)throw Error('Usage: node tools/render.mjs your.body.js [board|field|packet.json] output.png [click]');
 const e=compile(readFileSync(path,'utf8')),s=load(e,readPacket(page));flush(e,s);if(process.argv[5]==='click')click(e,s,{targetId:s.doc.nodes.find(n=>n.tag==='button').id});
 writeFileSync(output,png(raster(s.frame.display,s.viewport),s.viewport.width,s.viewport.height));
 console.log(JSON.stringify({output,page,frame:s.frameId,stageCalls:s.counters,nodes:s.doc.nodes.length,commands:s.frame.display.commands.length}));
}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/tools/replay.mjs`:

```mjs
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {Worker,isMainThread,parentPort,workerData} from 'node:worker_threads';
import {compile,load,flush,click,applyOperation,validateViewport} from '../public/supplier.mjs';
import {raster} from '../public/raster.mjs';
import {checkStage} from '../public/checks.mjs';
import {inspectStage} from '../public/progression.mjs';
import {validate} from '../public/notebook.mjs';
const hash=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
function summary(s){return {frame:s.frame.id,revision:s.doc.revision,counters:{...s.counters},rgbaSha256:hash(raster(s.frame.display,s.viewport))};}
export function replay(book){
 const outcomes=[];
 for(const event of book.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='submit')){
  const row={forSubmit:event.id,sourceHash:event.sourceHash,mode:event.mode,interactions:[]};outcomes.push(row);
  if(hash(event.source)!==event.sourceHash||hash(JSON.stringify(event.packet))!==event.packetHash){row.status='hash-mismatch';continue;}
  try{
   const engine=compile(event.source);
   if(event.mode==='check'){row.result=checkStage(engine,event.module);row.status='replayed';continue;}
   if(event.mode==='inspect'){const result=inspectStage(engine,event.module,event.packet);row.result={stage:result.stage};row.status='replayed';continue;}
   if(event.mode!=='render')throw Error('Unknown submission mode.');
   const session=load(engine,event.packet);flush(engine,session);row.initial=summary(session);
   for(const action of book.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='interaction'&&e.forSubmit===event.id)){
    const item={forInteraction:action.id,input:action.input};row.interactions.push(item);
    try{const m=action.input;
     if(m.kind==='click')item.result=click(engine,session,m.point);
     else if(m.kind==='hit'){if(session.stale)throw Error('Cannot probe a stale frame.');const point={x:m.point.x,y:m.point.y+session.viewport.scrollY};item.result={target:engine.target(session.frame.display,point,session.viewport),point};}
     else if(m.kind==='mutate')item.result=applyOperation(engine,session,m.operation);
     else if(m.kind==='scroll'){session.viewport=validateViewport({...session.viewport,scrollY:m.scrollY});flush(engine,session,{type:'scroll'});}
     else if(m.kind==='resize'){session.viewport=validateViewport({...session.viewport,width:m.width,height:m.height});flush(engine,session,{type:'resize'});}
     else throw Error('Unknown interaction.');
     item.status='replayed';item.frame=summary(session);
    }catch(error){item.status='error';item.error=error.message;}
   }
   row.status='replayed';
  }catch(error){row.status='error';row.error=error.message;}
 }
 return {version:1,scope:'Deterministic local replay of retained trusted source; not authenticated grading.',outcomes};
}
if(!isMainThread){try{parentPort.postMessage({ok:true,report:replay(workerData.book)});}catch(error){parentPort.postMessage({ok:false,error:error.message});}}
else if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('/replay.mjs')||process.argv[1]==='tools/replay.mjs'){
 const [path,output='replay-report.json']=process.argv.slice(2);if(!path)throw Error('Usage: node tools/replay.mjs notebook.json replay-report.json');
 const bytes=readFileSync(path);if(bytes.length>8000000)throw Error('Notebook file exceeds import limit.');const book=validate(JSON.parse(bytes));
 const worker=new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url),{workerData:{book}}),timer=setTimeout(()=>{worker.terminate();console.error('Replay exceeded 5 seconds; no successful report recorded.');process.exitCode=1},5000);
 worker.once('message',result=>{clearTimeout(timer);writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify({output,ok:result.ok,attempts:result.report?.outcomes.length}));if(!result.ok)process.exitCode=1;worker.terminate();});worker.once('error',e=>{clearTimeout(timer);console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1});
}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/tools/serve.mjs`:

```mjs
// Optional local launcher. Not started during authoring without a shared server slot.
import {createServer} from 'node:http';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {resolve,dirname,join,extname} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
const root=resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'../build');
const manifest=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root,'build.json'),'utf8'));
const allowed=new Set([...manifest.files.map(f=>f.name),'build.json']);
const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.mjs':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.md':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};
const server=createServer((req,res)=>{
 if(req.method!=='GET'&&req.method!=='HEAD'){res.writeHead(405);res.end();return;}
 let name;try{name=decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url,'http://localhost').pathname).slice(1)||'index.html';}catch{res.writeHead(400);res.end();return;}
 if(!allowed.has(name)){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not in the learner package.');return;}
 try{const bytes=readFileSync(join(root,name));res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[extname(name)]??'application/octet-stream','Content-Length':bytes.length,'X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Cache-Control':'no-store','Content-Security-Policy':name==='worker.js'?"default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'":"default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'"});res.end(req.method==='HEAD'?undefined:bytes);}catch{res.writeHead(500);res.end('Could not read learner asset.');}
});
server.listen(Number(process.argv[2]??0),'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log(`Tiny Browser local candidate: http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/`));
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/tools/session.mjs`:

```mjs
// Supplied terminal I/O and recovery. Engine decisions remain learner methods.
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,readdirSync,mkdirSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {resolve,join} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {compile,load,flush,click,applyOperation,validateViewport} from '../public/supplier.mjs';
import {fresh,append,updateDraft,validate} from '../public/notebook.mjs';
import {raster} from '../public/raster.mjs';
import {readPacket} from './packet.mjs';
import {png} from './render.mjs';
const hash=data=>createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
const json=(path,limit=8000000)=>{const bytes=readFileSync(path);if(bytes.length>limit)throw Error('Input file exceeds the size limit.');return JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8'));};
const write=(path,data)=>writeFileSync(path,data,{flag:'wx'});
export function verifyBook(value){
 const book=validate(value);
 for(const event of book.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='submit')){
  if(hash(event.source)!==event.sourceHash||hash(JSON.stringify(event.packet))!==event.packetHash)throw Error('Source or packet hash mismatch; notebook was not restored.');
 }
 return book;
}
function latest(directory){
 const versions=readdirSync(directory).map(name=>({name,match:/^book-(\d+)\.json$/.exec(name)})).filter(x=>x.match).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.match[1])-Number(b.match[1]));
 if(!versions.length)throw Error('No versioned notebook found in this workspace.');return verifyBook(json(join(directory,versions.at(-1).name)));
}
export function applyInput(engine,session,input){
 if(input.kind==='click')return click(engine,session,input.point);
 if(input.kind==='mutate')return applyOperation(engine,session,input.operation);
 if(input.kind==='hit'){
  if(session.stale)throw Error('Cannot probe a stale frame.');
  const point={x:input.point.x,y:input.point.y+session.viewport.scrollY};
  return {target:engine.target(session.frame.display,point,session.viewport),point};
 }
 if(input.kind==='scroll'){session.viewport=validateViewport({...session.viewport,scrollY:input.scrollY});flush(engine,session,{type:'scroll'});return {scrolled:true};}
 if(input.kind==='resize'){session.viewport=validateViewport({...session.viewport,width:input.width,height:input.height});flush(engine,session,{type:'resize'});return {resized:true};}
 throw Error('Unknown terminal session input.');
}
export function restoreState(book){
 const submission=book.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='submit'&&e.mode==='render').at(-1);
 if(!submission)throw Error('No render submission to resume.');
 const engine=compile(submission.source),session=load(engine,submission.packet);flush(engine,session);
 const replay=[];
 for(const event of book.events.filter(e=>e.kind==='interaction'&&e.forSubmit===submission.id)){
  try{replay.push({id:event.id,result:applyInput(engine,session,event.input)});}catch(error){replay.push({id:event.id,error:error.message});}
 }
 return {submission,engine,session,replay};
}
export function receipt(session){
 if(!session?.frame)return {status:'no-frame'};
 const frame=session.frame;
 return {status:session.stale?'stale':'rendered',frame:frame.id,documentRevision:session.doc.revision,frameDocumentRevision:frame.documentRevision,counters:{...session.counters},viewport:frame.viewport,rgbaSha256:hash(raster(frame.display,frame.viewport))};
}
function snapshot(directory,book,session){
 const stem=`book-${String(book.revision).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 write(join(directory,`${stem}.json`),JSON.stringify(verifyBook(book),null,2)+'\n');
 if(session?.frame){
  const state={doc:session.doc,frame:session.frame,events:session.events,counters:session.counters,stale:session.stale,lastFlush:session.lastFlush};
  write(join(directory,`${stem}.frame.json`),JSON.stringify(state,null,2)+'\n');
  const v=session.frame.viewport;write(join(directory,`${stem}.png`),png(raster(session.frame.display,v),v.width,v.height));
 }
 return {workspace:resolve(directory),notebook:join(resolve(directory),`${stem}.json`),revision:book.revision,receipt:receipt(session)};
}
function newDirectory(path){if(existsSync(path))throw Error('Use a new workspace directory; existing evidence is never replaced.');mkdirSync(path,{recursive:true});}
export function run(argv){
 const [command,a,b,c]=argv;
 if(command==='start'){
  if(!a||!b||!c)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs start engine.body.js board|field|packet.json NEW_WORKSPACE');
  const source=readFileSync(a,'utf8');if(source.length>131072)throw Error('Engine source exceeds 128 KiB.');
  const packet=readPacket(b);let book=updateDraft(fresh(),source);
  book=append(book,{kind:'submit',mode:'render',module:'M8',source,sourceHash:hash(source),packet,packetHash:hash(JSON.stringify(packet)),assistance:'terminal-self-reported-unlabeled'});
  const id=book.events.at(-1).id;newDirectory(c);let session,error;
  try{const e=compile(source);session=load(e,packet);flush(e,session);}catch(e){error=e.message;}
  book=append(book,{kind:'result',forSubmit:id,output:error?{status:'error',message:error}:receipt(session)});
  return {ok:!error,error,...snapshot(c,book,session)};
 }
 if(command==='restore'){
  if(!a||!b)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs restore EXPORTED_NOTEBOOK.json NEW_WORKSPACE');
  const book=verifyBook(json(a)),state=restoreState(book);newDirectory(b);return {ok:true,restored:true,...snapshot(b,book,state.session)};
 }
 if(command==='export'){
  if(!a||!b)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs export WORKSPACE NEW_EXPORT.json');const book=latest(a);write(b,JSON.stringify(book,null,2)+'\n');return {ok:true,export:resolve(b),sha256:hash(readFileSync(b)),revision:book.revision};
 }
 if(command==='inspect'){
  if(!a)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs inspect WORKSPACE');const book=latest(a),state=restoreState(book);return {ok:true,revision:book.revision,sourceHash:state.submission.sourceHash,receipt:receipt(state.session),state:{doc:state.session.doc,frame:state.session.frame,events:state.session.events},replay:state.replay};
 }
 if(command==='note'){
  if(!a||!b)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs note WORKSPACE TEXT');let book=latest(a);const state=restoreState(book);book=append(book,{kind:'note',text:b});return {ok:true,...snapshot(a,book,state.session)};
 }
 if(command==='apply'){
  if(!a||!b)throw Error('Usage: session.mjs apply WORKSPACE INPUT.json|INLINE_JSON');
  const input=b.trim().startsWith('{')?JSON.parse(b):json(b,262144);let book=latest(a);const state=restoreState(book);
  book=append(book,{kind:'interaction',forSubmit:state.submission.id,input});const id=book.events.at(-1).id;let result,error;
  try{result=applyInput(state.engine,state.session,input);}catch(e){error=e.message;}
  const output=error?{status:'error',message:error}:{...receipt(state.session),result};
  book=append(book,{kind:'interaction-result',forInteraction:id,output});
  return {ok:!error&&result?.status!=='rejected',error,result,...snapshot(a,book,state.session)};
 }
 throw Error('Usage: node tools/session.mjs start|apply|inspect|note|export|restore ...');
}
if(process.argv[1]&&resolve(process.argv[1])===fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)){
 try{const result=run(process.argv.slice(2));console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));if(!result.ok)process.exitCode=1;}
 catch(error){console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1;}
}
```

`courses/tiny-browser-engine/tools/stage.mjs`:

```mjs
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {Worker,isMainThread,parentPort,workerData} from 'node:worker_threads';
import {compile} from '../public/supplier.mjs';
import {inspectStage,blockPacket} from '../public/progression.mjs';
import {readPacket} from './packet.mjs';
if(!isMainThread){try{parentPort.postMessage({ok:true,result:inspectStage(compile(workerData.source),workerData.unit,workerData.packet)});}catch(error){parentPort.postMessage({ok:false,error:error.message,code:error.code??'engine_error'});}}
else{
 const [path,unit='M1',output='stage.json',page]=process.argv.slice(2);if(!path)throw Error('Usage: node tools/stage.mjs your.body.js M1..M8 output.json [board|field|packet.json]');
 const worker=new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url),{workerData:{source:readFileSync(path,'utf8'),unit,packet:page===undefined&&unit==='M3'?blockPacket:readPacket(page??'board')}});
 const timer=setTimeout(()=>{worker.terminate();console.error('Stage exceeded 5 seconds.');process.exitCode=1},5000);
 worker.once('message',result=>{clearTimeout(timer);writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify({output,ok:result.ok,stage:result.result?.stage,error:result.error}));if(!result.ok)process.exitCode=1;worker.terminate();});worker.once('error',error=>{clearTimeout(timer);console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1});
}
```
